notes.title: [Update] Weapon paint decoder adjustment
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e7cf0e00f017ffd429cd3325600723d70a412de6.jpg"][/img]
[/p][p]Hello. This is Counter-Strike Nexon.

The Weapon Paint Decoder's content probability rules and guaranteed giveaway system will be changed to the following during the 10/1 (Wed) update.

We would like to inform you of the following changes and hope they do not cause any inconvenience in your use of our services.

[/p][h2]Weapon Paint Decoder Major Changes[/h2][p]
- Period: 10/1 (Wed) after maintenance - Permanent

[/p][h3]1. Probability Adjustment[/h3][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p]Previous[/p][/th][th][p]Change[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]Weapon Paint Group 1[/p][p]Weapon Paint Group 2[/p][p]Weapon Paint Group 3[/p][/td][td][p]Weapon Paint Group 1 [/p][p](23 kinds) 50%[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Weapon Paint Group 4[/p][p]Weapon Paint Group 5[/p][/td][td][p]Weapon Paint Group 2 [/p][p](24 kinds) 50%[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]

[b]Individual Probability[/b]
[list][*] Items within the groups have the same probabilities based on the number of items.[/list]
※ When a new item is added, the probabilities will automatically change based on the above rule.
※ The individual probabilities of the Decoder can be viewed on the forum after the 10/1 (Wed) maintenance.

[/p][h3]2. Guaranteed Giveaway related point adjustment[/h3][list][*][p] Before: Upon using Decoder x30, Give Weapon Paint Selection Box (Select 1 between 2 kinds in Group 1)
[/p][/*][*][p] Change: Upon using Decoder x60, Give Weapon Paint Collection Box (Select 1 from the entire group)
[/p][/*][*][p] The total Guaranteed Points collected will remain.[/p][/*][/list][h3]3. Handling an current Selection Boxes[/h3][list][*][p] Your current Weapon Paint Selection Boxes will be converted into Weapon Paint Collection Boxes at a 1 to 1 rate.
[/p][/*][*][p] Your current Weapon Paint Selection Boxes will all be converted to Weapon Paint Collection Boxes during the 10/1 maintenance.[/p][/*][/list][p]
We will continue to work hard to provide a better service.

Thank you!
[/p]

notes.title: 11th Anniversary Free DLC Information (Available until 12/31)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/acba29b72e63b9c5c9a7d8042432c2542a610ada.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Survivors.

Thanks to your love and support, we've reached our 11th anniversary.
To celebrate it, a free DLC package will be available for everyone!
We will continue striving to bring you joy and wonderful memories.

[h1]Free DLC - 11th Anniversary Fever Pack[/h1]
This free DLC was created to capture the excitement of our 11th anniversary.
Can only be purchased once per account. (Available until 12/31)
After you purchase the DLC, it will automatically be sent to your inventory.

[h3]11th Anniversary Fever Pack Contents[/h3]
[list][*]FEVER Spray x1
[*]FEVER Weapon Paint x1
[*][Medal] FEVER x1
[*]Transcendence Weapon Pass (11 Days)[/list]

[h1][Promotion] 11th Anniversary Box[/h1]
One more thing!
The 11th Anniversary Celebration Box will be on sale during the event period.
Enjoy the celebration box's special compositions at a special price!

[h3]11th Anniversary Box[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ff07f8ed08a40ad411b4dbc111d3f300c9e2dabe.png[/img]
[list][*]Promotion Period: 9/17 - 10/1
[*]Don't miss the opportunity to obtain Arbalest and Sandalphon. (Each item's drop rate: 0.0750%) [url=https://forum.nexon.com/csnexon/board_list?board=5377]link[/url]
[*]Gain 15 Mileage for every 11th Anniversary Box opened.
[*]Unused 11th Anniversary Boxes will automatically be opened, and the contents will be given after the 10/1 maintenance.[/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes : September 17th
notes.content:
Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!
Please see [url=https://forum.nexon.com/csnexon/board_list?board=5377]here[/url] for the Decoder rates.

[list][b][*]New Zombie Escape Map: Exodus[/b]
[b][*]Added 11 new medals. [/b]
[b][*][Hero's Path] Escape Operation - Another Battlefield (9/17 - 10/1)[/b]
[b][*][Hero Classic] Z-Virus Update Celebration Log-in Event (9/17 - 10/1)[/b]
[b][*][Upgrade] SPAS-12 Superior Returns! (9/17 - 11/26)[/b]
[b][*]Try the Counter Exchange CP Event! (9/17 - 10/1)[/b]
[b][*]CP Challenge! Attendance Event (9/17 - 10/1)[/b]
[b][*]CP Challenge! Play Event (9/17 - 10/1)[/b]
[b][*]Zombie Scenario Raid Mission (9/24 - 10/8)[/b]
[b][*]Zombie Scenario Golden Zombie Increased Appearance Event (9/24 - 10/8)[/b]
[b][*][Fever time] Daily Rally Event (9/17 - 9/27)[/b]
[b][*][Fever time] Charge up Event (9/17 - 10/1)[/b]
[b][*][Millia & Karin] New Transcendence Class Promotion (9/17 - 10/29) [/b]
[b][*][Millia & Karin] New Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (9/17 - 10/29) [/b]
[b][*]New Spray & Class Decoder Promotion (9/17 - 10/29)[/b]
[b][*][ZHC] Advanced Decoder Special Price Promotion (9/17 - 10/1)[/b][/list]
[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Update Information[/h2]

[h3]New Zombie Escape Map: Exodus[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/fcc04c90f58de63826e3105727bc3be26ec22abf.png[/img]
Location: Centers on the shelter's interior and exterior, starting from inside the shelter and culminating in escaping by car outside the shelter.
Eligible Modes: Zombie Escape

[h3]Added 11 new medals. [/h3]

[list][*]Conditions/Rewards
[list][*]Pitcher
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/11893a0d5fbff0efa4b861d66bc9af480d81e075.png[/img]
[list][*]Throw 2000 Zombie Bombs 
[*]Can be obtained in Zombie Hero and Hero Classic Modes
[*]Honor Points: 10[/list][/list][/list]
[list][list][*]Precise Explosion
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d0435208f6607fefaa75523fb31159d65eeba6cf.png[/img]
[list][*]Deal 5000 damage with Zombie Bombs
[*]Can be obtained in Zombie Hero and Z Modes
[*]Honor Points: 10[/list][/list][/list]
[list][list][*]Supply Expert
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/aba077ce13dd5c013d3f20981da1c88a25fbfd75.png[/img]
[list][*]Acquire 100 Supply Boxes as a Human 
[*]Can be obtained in Zombie Hero, Hero Classic, and Z Modes
[*]Honor Points: 10[/list][/list][/list]
[list][list][*]Volcano Eruption
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/fa47ff58e383dea031372094d124a255c5380998.png[/img]
[list][*]Deal 1000 damage with Fire Bombs 
[*]Can be obtained in Zombie Hero and Z Modes
[*]Honor Points: 5[/list][/list][/list]
[list][list][*]Hot Bath
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f551a2131ec026d4ebd25d86fd1c1389fc0ffd30.png[/img]
[list][*]Take damage from a Fire Bomb for 20 seconds or longer 
[*]Can be obtained in Zombie Hero and Z Modes
[*]Honor Points: 5[/list][/list][/list]
[list][list][*]Pacifist
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/183b25047776e757f20c3046f6ee6d683bd1c851.png[/img]
[list][*]Win 1 round as a Human without dealing damage to Zombies 
[*]Can be obtained in Zombie Classic, Hero, Hero Classic, and Z Modes
[*]Honor Points: 10[/list][/list][/list]
[list][list][*]Gun Prohibition
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ed00572f6e32f19c044b8c39c193c84cb229c994.png[/img]
[list][*]Win 10 rounds without dealing damage with your Primary or Secondary Weapon
[*]You may possess guns, but you may not use them.
[*]Can be obtained in Zombie Classic, Hero, Hero Classic, and Z Modes
[*]Honor Points: 5[/list][/list][/list]
[list][list][*]Power of Fury
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/4abba6ccc30f99920f8a8bb7d82f562571562550.png[/img]
[list][*]Reach 200% or higher Morale Boost 10 times as a Human 
[*]Progress only counts once per round
[*]Can be obtained in Zombie Hero, Hero Classic, and Z Modes
[*]Honor Points: 10[/list][/list][/list]
[list][list][*]Medic
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b161871f9d2b78074929b6c4b099b5bce95fbd2c.png[/img]
[list][*]Recover 50000 HP as a Human 
[*]Can be obtained in Zombie Hero and Z Modes
[*]Honor Points: 10[/list][/list][/list]
[list][list][*]Always 1st
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/fd04332b9366a4f1e1c6ceac3520e098eb7ed716.png[/img]
[list][*]Reach 1st place at the end of a game 100 times 
[*]Can only make progress in rooms with 3 or more players.
[*]Can be obtained in Zombie Classic, Hero, Hero Classic, and Z Modes
[*]Honor Points: 10[/list][/list][/list]
[list][list][*]Honor Student
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/08e1a5add9f181911d2cf5b92d92352ab75fe4b6.png[/img]
[list][*]Place 3rd or higher at the end of a game 200 times 
[*]Can only make progress in rooms with 6 or more players.
[*]Can be obtained in Zombie Classic, Hero, Hero Classic, and Z Modes
[*]Honor Points: 10[/list][/list][/list]

[h2]Event Information[/h2]

[h3][Hero's Path] Escape Operation - Another Battlefield (9/17 - 10/1)[/h3]
The hero's path is far from over. This time, escape is survival. Your first act of survival in the new Zombie Escape map marks the beginning of a new chapter in your journey.

[list][*]Conditions/Rewards
[list][*]Successfully escape (yourself) 1 time in the new Zombie Escape Mode map - Exodus
[*]Once per account
[*]Survivor Marking Spray x1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/80ecf414fda5a4c57edab2e0a801a538899266da.png[/img]
[*]Normal Modification Material x10
[*]30 CP[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Only rooms with 3+ players count toward the event.
[*]Obtained CP can be viewed directly in the Counter Exchange, rather than in your inventory.[/list][/list]

[h3][Hero Classic] Z-Virus Update Celebration Log-in Event (9/17 - 10/1)[/h3]
To celebrate the Zombie Hero Classic Z-Virus update, the following items will be given on your first log-in during the event period:

[list][*]Conditions/Rewards
[list][*]Upon your first login to the game during the event period, you will receive all of the following items (once per account):
[*]AS50 Pink Gold (7 Days)
[*]UTS-15 Pink Gold (7 Days)
[*]Winchester M1887 Xmas Edition (7 Days)
[*]Gold Double Barrel Shotgun (7 Days)
[*]PKM Gold Edition (7 Days)
[*]M60E4 Gold Edition (7 Days)
[*]MG36 Xmas Edition (7 Days)
[*]MG36 Gold Edition (7 Days)
[*]WA2000 Gold Edition (7 Days)
[*]SL8 Gold Edition (7 Days)
[*]Winchester M1887 Gold Edition (7 Days)
[*]MG3 Gold Edition (7 Days)

[*]The rewards are bound and cannot be used for Auction/Disassembly/Family Storage.[/list][/list]

[h3][Upgrade] SPAS-12 Superior Returns! (9/17 - 11/26)[/h3]
Complete the final form of the SPAS-12 with your own two hands, once again, in 2025! Obtain the [ZHC] SPAS-12 (Permanent) from the Counter Exchange, and participate in the Upgrade Event.

[list][*]Conditions/Rewards
[list][*]Upon reaching 300 Upgrade Kill Points with the [ZHC] SPAS-12 (Permanent) (100 Total Daily Max Kill Points)
[*][ZHC] SPAS-12 Deluxe (Permanent) (Once per account)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Conditions/Rewards
[list][*]Upon reaching 300 Upgrade Kill Points with the [ZHC] SPAS-12 Deluxe (Permanent) (100 Total Daily Max Kill Points)
[*][ZHC] SPAS-12 Superior (Permanent) (Once per account)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Upgrade Kill Points Obtained
[list][*]Human Kills: 5 points (Team Deathmatch, Deathmatch)
[*]Zombie Kill: 10 points (Zombie Escape) / 15 points (Zombie Classic, Zombie Mutant, Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, Zombie Evolution, Zombie Hero Classic)
[*]Bot Kill: 1 point (Zombie Scenario, Deathmatch (AI), Team Deathmatch (AI), Zombie (AI) / 5 points (Original Mode (AI))[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]You can participate in this event while playing in a room with 3 or more players.
[*]Only the survivors with a [ZHC] SPAS-12 (Permanent) can participate in this event.
[*]The non-[ZHC] version of the SPAS-12 (Permanent) is not eligible for the event.
[*]You can get the [ZHC] SPAS-12 (Permanent) from the Counter Exchange.
[*]The weapons of the previous stages are retained after the upgrade.
[*]Upgrade rewards can be obtained only once per account.[/list][/list]

[h3]Try the Counter Exchange CP Event! (9/17 - 10/1)[/h3]
CP earned in any Zombie Mode! Get CP for just playing, and exchange them for your desired rewards at the Counter Exchange!

[list][*]Changes to the Seasonal Rewards
[list][*]Daily Exchange Limit: none
[*][ZHK] JANUS-1 (Permanent)
[*][ZHK] JANUS-5 (Permanent)
[*][ZHK] JANUS-7 (Permanent)
[*][ZHC] SKULL-4 (Permanent)
[*][ZHC] SKULL-6 (Permanent)
[*][ZHC] SKULL-8 (Permanent)
[*]Ladder Spray (Permanent)
[*]Host Zombie Spray (Permanent)
[*]200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x1
[*]1000 Mileage Coupon x1
[*]Transcendence Decoder x1[/list][/list]

[list][*]How to Participate
[list][*]Earn 2 CP for every 10 Kill Points from Zombie kills or assists as a Human, or infections as a Zombie (except bots) in Zombie (+Zombie Hero Classic) Mode (up to 10 CP per day).
[*]Earn 1 CP for every 5 minutes of in-game playtime (up to 5 CP per day)[/list][/list]

[list][*]How to Earn Kill Points
[list][*]Zombie Kills as a Human: 3 Points (excluding bots)
[*]Zombie Assists as a Human: 1 Point (excluding bots)
[*]Human Infections as a Zombie: 4 Points (excluding bots)
[*]Human Infection Assists as a Zombie: 0 Points[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]You can earn up to 15 CP a day.
[*]Daily Missions reset every day at midnight.
[*]Besides playtime, in-game missions do not count toward participation in Studio Mode.
[*]Only rooms with 3+ players count toward the event.
[*]Autohunt kills are excluded, regardless of mode.
[*]Event Decoders can be used until midnight of the day they were obtained, and are removed afterward.
[*]CP and [ZHC] Daily Selection Boxes are removed when the event ends.[/list][/list]

[h3]CP Challenge! Attendance Event (9/17 - 10/1)[/h3]
You can obtain additional CP by completing attendance missions!

[list][*]Conditions/Rewards
[list][*]1-Day Total Attendance: 5 CP
[*]3-Day Total Attendance: 10 CP
[*]5-Day Total Attendance: 15 CP
[*]7-Day Total Attendance: 20 CP[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]You can earn up to 50 CP during the event.
[*]Cumulative Attendance: Consecutive attendance is not necessary. The attendance count does not reset after obtaining the 3-Day Cumulative Attendance reward. (If you claim the 3-Day Cumulative Attendance reward, you are eligible to achieve 5-Day Cumulative Attendance by checking in for 2 more days)
[*]CP is removed when the event ends.[/list][/list]

[h3]CP Challenge! Play Event (9/17 - 10/1)[/h3]
You can obtain additional CP by completing play missions!

[list][*]Conditions/Rewards
[list][*]Upon reaching 100 Kill Points with the [ZHC] SPAS-12 (Permanent): 50 CP[/list][/list]

[list][*]Upgrade Kill Points Obtained
[list][*]Human Kills: 5 points (Team Deathmatch, Deathmatch)
[*]Zombie Kill: 10 points (Zombie Escape) / 15 points (Zombie Classic, Zombie Mutant, Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, Zombie Evolution, Zombie Hero Classic)
[*]Bot Kill: 1 point (Zombie Scenario, Deathmatch (AI), Team Deathmatch (AI), Zombie (AI) / 5 points (Original Mode (AI))[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]You can participate in this event while playing in a room with 3 or more players.
[*]Only the survivors with a [ZHC] SPAS-12 (Permanent) can participate in this event.
[*]Obtained CP can be viewed directly in the Counter Exchange, rather than in your inventory.[/list][/list]

[h3]Zombie Scenario Raid Mission (9/24 - 10/8)[/h3]
Defeat the bosses appearing on designated days, and on designated battlefields, during the event period to earn rewards!

[list][*]Conditions/Rewards
[list][*]9/24: Score 1 kill on Phobos Prototype in [Pursuit: Last Clue]
[*]9/25: Score 1 kill on Oberon in [Pursuit: Dead End]
[*]9/26: Score 1 kill on Dione in [Pursuit: Poisonous Wound]
[*]9/27: Score 1 kill on Angra in [Pursuit: Angra Nest]

[*]Event-Decoder x5[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]You can join each boss kill event once per day and up to 6 times over the event period. Each account can obtain up to 30 Event Decoders.
[*]Event Decoders can be used until midnight of the day they were obtained, and are removed afterward.[/list][/list]

[h3]Zombie Scenario Golden Zombie Increased Appearance Event (9/24 - 10/8)[/h3]
During the event period, Golden Zombies appearing in the Zombie Scenario will temporarily have a 20% higher chance of spawning! Don't miss out on this opportunity!

[h3][Fever time] Daily Rally Event (9/17 - 9/27)[/h3]
Fever Time on! Celebrate our 11th anniversary with rewards every day for 11 days for logging in! Log in now and join the excitement!

[list][*]Conditions/Rewards
[list][*]Rewards for Each Day
[*]9/17: Event Decoder x5
[*]9/18: Unique Decoder x5
[*]9/19: Weapon Paint Decoder x5
[*]9/20: 10,000 Mileage Coupon x1
[*]9/21: Normal Modification Material x5
[*]9/22: Advanced Modification Material x5
[*]9/23: Unique Premium Decoder x5
[*]9/24: Dehancement Material Parts Rate Box x5
[*]9/25: Epic Weapon Pass (2 Days), [ZHC] Advanced Decoder x5
[*]9/26: Class Decoder x5
[*]9/27: Transcendence Decoder x5[/list][/list]

[h3][Fever time] Charge up Event (9/17 - 10/1)[/h3]
11th Anniversary Fever Time – ON! Blazing Heat, Bottomless Rewards!

[h2]Shop Update[/h2]

[h3][Millia & Karin] New Transcendence Class Promotion (9/17 - 10/29) [/h3]
The following Classes will make a special appearance in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders during the event:

[list][*]Probability
[list][*]Premium Class Decoder: Millia and Karin each have a 2% chance to appear.
[*]Class Decoder: Millia and Karin each have a 0.5% chance to appear.
[*]Acquiring Millia will automatically provide a Pillow Fairy (Permanent).
[*]Acquiring Karin will automatically provide a Small Ember (Permanent).[/list][/list]

[list][*]Millia
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f090b17636377b63a5d899ec433160605c9ad188.png[/img]
[list][*]A fairy of sleep who was slumbering peacefully in her forest, until Karin dragged her into this world. She's happy being anywhere she can catch a nap, but she does think this new world makes a better resting place. It may seem like she's always dozing, but she works hard behind the scenes in a lot of situations.
[*]Transcendence Class CT

[*]Paired Weapon: Drakar I, II, III
[*]Increased <Tempest Slash> damage / Decreased number of bullet hits needed to increase gun stage[/list][/list]

[*] - Applies 8% Additional Damage for Elite Zombies and 4% Additional Damage for Boss Zombies.
[*]Active:
[*]- Active: Provides a buff that continuously heals you and allies, and grants a special barrier effect when activated. If the barrier breaks before it expires, it grants an Attack Power buff. If the barrier does not break, it grants an HP Recovery buff.

[*]+10% EXP/Points
[*]In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes.
[*]This character adds 1 initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
[*]This character displays your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
[*]Upon killing an enemy, this character leaves a unique mark at the target location.
[*]Marks Zombies at 20% HP or below in Zombie Mode.[/list][/list][/list]

[list][*]Karin
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/af536634f2dd69de28f1f272fd6e9663679e8e00.png[/img]
[list][*]A fairy who came to this world out of curiosity after watching Nyx and Skadi disappear. She said she's looking for a way back, but currently she's spending her days learning about the new world and dealing with the attention she receives. Her confidence leads her into all kinds of commotion, but she always emerges unscathed...because Millia is secretly looking out for her.
[*]Transcendence Class TR
[*]Transcendence Class-exclusive voices are applied.
[*]Paired Weapon: Drakar I, II, III
[*]- Increased <Tempest Slash> damage & attack range[/list][/list]
[list][list][*]Zombie Scenario Skill: Baptism of Fire
[list][*]Passive:
[*] - Increased Passive: When playing in Zombie Scenario mode with Millia, Critical Strike increases slightly, and damage taken decreases slightly (connection effect applied, cannot be stacked).
[*] - Applies the Explosive Ammo Add-On Effect (which can be stacked, increasing the effect).
[*] - Applies 8% Additional Damage for Elite Zombies and 4% Additional Damage for Boss Zombies.
[*]Active:
[*]Provides an infinite ammo buff and special barrier effect. If the barrier breaks before it expires, it grants a movement speed buff. If the barrier does not break, it grants an Attack Power buff.

[*]+10% EXP/Points
[*]In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes.
[*]This character adds 1 initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
[*]This character displays your current damage at the bottom of the screen.

notes.title: [Update] VIP system update preview
notes.content:
[p]Greetings from the CSN team!  [/p][p]Based on the feedback and data from Survivors regarding the VIP system, we've taken a deep look at our current rank and reward structure.  [/p][p]The existing VIP system had limitations built-in to immediately react to changing spending patterns or playstyles. We've seen continuous feedback that some rewards didn't feel very rewarding.  [/p][p]So, we at the development team have completely overhauled the reward system to make it more helpful and easier to understand, with the goal of increasing the actual value of VIP rank.  [/p][p]This first update, which includes system improvements, will be applied during the October 1st (Wed) patch. Details and the schedule of the upcoming second update will be announced separately at a later time.  [/p][p]We'll continue to listen to your feedback and make improvements to the VIP system.   [/p][olist][*][p]Changes to VIP Rank Application Time  [/p][olist][*][p]Implementation of Real-time VIP Rank Calculation System[/p][list][*][p]Previously, the VIP rank was calculated on the first of every month based on your cumulative purchases over the past three months, but after maintenance, it will be calculated in real-time based on your purchase date. Your cumulative purchases over the past 90 days will be summed up in real-time and reflected immediately.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Transitional Period Purchase Counting Time Extension[/p][list][*][p]With the VIP rank calculation changed from a monthly basis to real-time, the transitional period will be handled as follows:[/p][/*][*][p]This extension is a one-time measure to provide flexibility in terms of maintaining or advancing to VIP rank.[/p][/*][*][p]After the enhancement update is applied, the normal real-time calculation will be applied and there will be no extension period.   [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="229,,229"][tr][th colwidth="229"][p]Purchased Month[/p][/th][th][p](Current) Tier Retention[/p][/th][th colwidth="229"][p](Updated) Tier Extension Action[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td colwidth="229"][p]July Purchases[/p][/td][td][p]Until October 31st[/p][/td][td colwidth="229"][p]Until Friday, November 28th[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="229"][p]August Purchases[/p][/td][td][p]Until November 30th[/p][/td][td colwidth="229"][p]Until Monday, December 29th[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="229"][p]September Purchases[/p][/td][td][p]Until December 31st[/p][/td][td colwidth="229"][p]Until Wednesday, January 28th[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="229"][p]Purchases made before October 1st[/p][/td][td][p]Until January 31st[/p][/td][td colwidth="229"][p]Until Thursday, January 29th[/p][/td][/tr][/table][/*][/list][/*][/olist][/*][*][p]Changes to Bronze/Silver Rank Maintenance Method [/p][olist][*][p]After the revamp, your rank will change in the same way as other tiers, dropping/staying/rising based on your recent cumulative purchase amount.  [/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p]VIP Reward Renewal – Addition[/p][list][*][p]Exclusive rewards are now organized by VIP ranks, with tiered rewards for each tier.   [/p][/*][/list][olist][*][p]Penalty and Loss Invalidation Pass [/p][list][*][p]You can use an unlimited number of <Penalty and Loss Invalidation>, which prevents you from being penalized for forcing a session to end for as long as the benefit is active, and any Penalty and Loss Invalidation items you already own are not consumed.   [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]VIP Room Host Benefits [/p][list][*][p]If someone with this benefit hosts a room, the lobby of that room will be decorated with an exclusive background, and the room will be visually emphasized. [/p][/*][*][p]The host receives a 50% bonus to EXP and Medal progression, while participants receive a 10% bonus to EXP and Medal progression. [/p][/*][*][p]* The Medal progress bonus's remainder values are only maintained while staying online. [/p][/*][*][p]* This effect is only applied if someone with the benefit creates the room and actually plays. If that person leaves the room, the room is changed to a regular one, and no longer grants the benefit.   [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Monthly Purchase Reward [/p][list][*][p]A monthly purchase reward will be added. [/p][/*][*][p]You'll receive a Goodie Box if you upgrade or maintain your rank with the first payment of the month, based on your real-time VIP rank at the time of that purchase. [/p][/*][*][p]If you achieve a new VIP rank or maintain your existing rank through purchases within the month, you will receive a VIP Goodie Box box for each rank. (You can receive up to 12 VIP Goodie Boxes per month.) [/p][/*][*][p]If you increase your rank multiple times at once with a single purchase, it'll be considered reaching each of the ranks in sequence, and the rewards for each rank will be given all at once. [/p][/*][*][p](Example) If a Bronze rank player gets promoted straight to Platinum rank, four Goodie Boxes, one each for Silver, Gold, and Platinum, will all be awarded at that time. [/p][/*][*][p]The rewards for each rank can only be received once per month, and even if you drop from a rank and regain it within the same month, you will not re-receive that same award in that same month.  [/p][/*][*][p]* The reward acquisition count for each rank resets at midnight on the 1st of each month.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",268,57"][tr][th][p]Rank Reached[/p][/th][th colwidth="268"][p]Rewards[/p][/th][th colwidth="57"][p]Qty[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]Regular[/p][/td][td colwidth="268"][p]-[/p][/td][td colwidth="57"][p]-[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Bronze[/p][/td][td colwidth="268"][p]-[/p][/td][td colwidth="57"][p]-[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Silver[/p][/td][td colwidth="268"][p]Goodie Box[/p][/td][td colwidth="57"][p]1[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Gold[/p][/td][td colwidth="268"][p]Goodie Box[/p][/td][td colwidth="57"][p]1[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Platinum[/p][/td][td colwidth="268"][p]Goodie Box[/p][/td][td colwidth="57"][p]2[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Diamond[/p][/td][td colwidth="268"][p]Goodie Box[/p][/td][td colwidth="57"][p]2[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]VIP[/p][/td][td colwidth="268"][p]Goodie Box[/p][/td][td colwidth="57"][p]3[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]VVIP[/p][/td][td colwidth="268"][p]Goodie Box[/p][/td][td colwidth="57"][p]3[/p][/td][/tr][/table][/*][*][p]\Goodie Box Contents[/p][list][*][p]200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x1[/p][/*][*][p]Normal Modification Material x1[/p][/*][*][p]Advanced Modification Material x1[/p][/*][*][p]Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x1[/p][/*][*][p]100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x2[/p][/*][*][p]50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3[/p][/*][*][p]Random -1 Dehancement Material x3[/p][/*][*][p]Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x3
* The contents of the Goodie Box are subject to change.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Class Premium Pass [/p][list][*][p]While you have this pass, you can use classes that you would normally become a VVIP to access. [/p][/*][*][p]*     Classes obtained from the pass cannot be (Exploration) enhanced or disassembled.  [/p][/*][/list][/*][/olist][/*][*][p]VIP Reward Renewal – Removal [/p][list][*][p]Following the renewal, the following rewards will be removed. [/p][/*][*][p]Mileage Payback/Login Supplies/Zombie Scenario Clear (Very Hard/Hell/Inferno) + Reward Box (Intermediate/Advanced)/100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon/Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box Exploration Success Rate-Up +20%/Nickname Change  [/p][/*][*][p]As per the October 1st renewal update, the previous rank achievement rewards will not be given after that date. If you have yet to receive the previous rewards, please make sure to receive them before the October 1st (Wed) maintenance.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Notifications when VIP Rank Changes [/p][list][*][p]If  your VIP rank is about to be lowered, you'll be notified in advance with a reminder message, and you'll be given a notification that shows what rank you'll be changed to after the change. notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/df5e9c09c4cd3d76a1cb86a1d403441272a65e32.jpg[/img]
Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!
Please see [url=https://forum.nexon.com/csnexon/board_list?board=5377]here[/url] for the Decoder rates.

[list][b][*]Nightmare Teddy Terror Returns for the Summer! (8/20 - 9/3)[/b]

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Update Information[/h2]

[h3]Nightmare Teddy Terror Returns for the Summer! (8/20 - 9/3)[/h3]

[list][*]Annihilated: Nightmare Key Giveaway

[list][*]Conditions/Rewards

[*]Cousteau (Permanent/Bound)
[*]Hauteclere (Permanent/Bound)
[*]Lightning Fury (Permanent/Bound)
[*]Whip Sword (Permanent/Bound)
[*]Cousteau (15 Days/Bound)
[*]Hauteclere (15 Days/Bound)
[*]Lightning Fury (15 Days/Bound)
[*]Whip Sword (15 Days/Bound)
[*]1000 Mileage Coupon x1
[*]500 Mileage Coupon x1
[*]300 Mileage Coupon x1
[*]100 Mileage Coupon x1
[*]Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x5
[*]Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x1
[*]Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x1
[*]Dehancement Material Parts Rate Box x1
[*]100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x1
[*]200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x1
[*]50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x1
[*]Exploration Level Enhancement EXP Coupon x1
[*]Rare Decoder x3
[*]Unique Decoder x2[/list][/list]

[list][list][*]Dehancement Material Parts Rate Box Contents

[*]Damage -1 Dehancement Material Parts x10
[*]Weight -1 Dehancement Material Parts x10
[*]Accuracy -1 Dehancement Material Parts x10
[*]Fire Rate -1 Dehancement Material Parts x10
[*]Recoil -1 Dehancement Material Parts x10
[*]Ammo -1 Dehancement Material Parts x10
[*]The Reward Box can be earned up to 3 times a day.

[list][*]Cumulative Rewards

[*]6 Reward Boxes: Rare Decoder x3

Complete the final form of M134 Predator with your own two hands, once again, in 2025! Obtain the [ZHC] M134 Minigun (Permanent) from the Counter Exchange, and participate in the Upgrade Event.

[list][*]Conditions/Rewards
[list][*]Upon reaching 2025 Upgrade Kill Points with [ZHC] M134 Minigun (Permanent)
[*][ZHC] M134 Predator (Permanent) x1 (once per account)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Upgrade Kill Points Obtained
[list][*]Human Kills: 5 points (Team Deathmatch, Deathmatch)
[*]Zombie Kill: 10 points (Zombie Escape) / 15 points (Zombie Classic, Zombie Mutant, Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, Zombie Evolution, Zombie Hero Classic)

[*]Only the survivors with a [ZHC] M134 Minigun (Permanent) can participate in this event.

[*][ZHC] SKULL-11 (3 Days)

CP earned in any Zombie Mode! You can now earn CP from not just Zombie Hero Classic, but any Zombie Mode! Get CP for just playing, and exchange them for your desired rewards at the Counter Exchange!

notes.title: Developer's Letter
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/975691648607c30caea046a062e7ffb42feb124a.jpg[/img]

Greetings from the CSN team.

We would like to take this opportunity to share our honest thoughts on the recent updates, as well as our future direction and plans.

[h2][Improvements to Fatigue From Events and Missions]
[/h2]We have noticed that the recent simultaneous launch of various events and missions, with their complex and difficult achievement conditions, has caused fatigue among our Survivors. Thus, we plan to make adjustments to events and missions in general.
Events and missions were originally designed with a focus on natural flow in eligible modes, rewards, and play experience. Zombie Hero Classic was structured around the Counter Exchange, while Zombie and Zombie Scenario were centered on the Epic Shop and Fragment Event. However, this separation forced players into play experiences they did not prefer, leading to fatigue with mission completion.

Thus, adjustments were made in the August 6th update to expand the CP acquisition modes in the Counter Exchange, simplify conditions, and reduce the overall fatigue from event and mission completion.

Going forward, when planning events, we will prioritize your actual play experience and feedback, carefully reviewing the appropriateness of mission conditions and structures to ensure that they do not compromise your usual play experience while providing enough fun and motivation to complete missions. We will establish flexible and intuitive event strategies to achieve this.

[h2][Zombie Hero Classic Mode Update Plan]
[/h2]We have received various feedback about Zombie Hero Classic Mode and are deeply aware of your disappointment about the recent update pace.

To respond to your support and expectations, we have adjusted the overall update roadmap and schedule to enable faster updates. Starting with the introduction of the Change Shot ON/OFF setting in the 8/20 (Wed) update, we are preparing for multiple updates beginning on 9/3 (Wed).

First, the Z-VIRUS update will be implemented through the 9/3 (Wed) patch. 
Along with the return of various weapons that many players have been waiting for, such as Ripper, BALROG, Dragon Sword, and Thunderbolt, Venom Sting and Venom Guard will also be introduced. At the same time, we will be making overall balance adjustments through system reforms, including the addition of a Morale Boost group bonus, the setting to choose the duration of the permanent death grace period, and zombie restriction features.

In October, we are preparing for the return of various weapons, including Gaebolg, and in subsequent weapon updates, we will maintain overall balance by considering various factors to ensure that the core fun and balance of Zombie Hero Classic Mode are not compromised.
In addition to weapons, we are preparing new zombies, and when they are introduced, the overall faction balance will also be adjusted accordingly.

We humbly accept the valuable feedback and constructive criticism you all have provided, and we will continue to strive to make Zombie Hero Classic Mode a mode that can be enjoyed for a long time through ongoing updates and maintenance.

We will do our best to provide an even more enjoyable and satisfying play environment in the future.

Thank you.
Counter-Strike Nexon Development Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1eef60286f060e5463eaffccb86b89ab9909e48f.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!
Please see [url=https://forum.nexon.com/csnexon/board_list?board=5377]here[/url] for the Decoder rates.

https://youtu.be/C_q-Wi9-Q_g
[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Update Information[/h2]

[h3]Mission Chain Update Information (7/23/25 - 2/18/26)[/h3]
The Mission Chain System has been revamped!

[*]Flame Jackhammer (Permanent) x1[/list][/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Note: The table above only shows the stage rewards and final rewards, excluding the interim rewards, from checking out the guides, or the individual mission rewards.
[*]You can proceed to the next stage mission only if you complete the stage mission in progress by midnight.[/list][/list]

[h2]Event Information[/h2]

[h3]Vestige of Wolf Spirits Collection Event (7/23 - 9/17)[/h3]
The power of the wolf is scattered across the earth. Collect the Vestiges of Wolf Spirits to call forth that power. Obtain Vestiges of Wolf Spirits via Play Missions to exchange them for Lycaon, USAS-12 Thunderfall, etc.!

[list][*]Conditions/Rewards
[list][*]1. Every 4 Kill Points by kills, assists as a human, or infections as a zombie in Zombie Mode (excluding bots): Vestige of Wolf Spirits x1 (up to 20 per day)
[*]2. Every 1 session clear after reaching 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard difficulty or higher: Vestige of Wolf Spirits x5 (up to 25 per day)
[*]3. Every 20 minutes of playtime (including Studio Mode): Vestige of Wolf Spirits x7 (up to twice per day)
[*]4. Every use of a Vestige of Wolf Spirits Box granted through the use of an Epic Decoder (probability varies by count): Vestige of Wolf Spirits x3 - x100 (no limit)
[*]You can only earn up to a total of 30 Vestiges of Wolf Spirits from Missions No.1-3 (excluding Epic Decoder uses) per day (ex. if you earned 20 from Mission No.1, you can only earn up to 10 from Mission No.2).[/list][/list]

[list][*]How to Earn Kill Points
[list][*]Zombie Kills as a Human: 3 Points (excluding bots)
[*]Zombie Assists as a Human: 1 Point (excluding bots)
[*]Human Infections as a Zombie: 4 Points (excluding bots)
[*]Human Infection Assists as a Zombie: 0 Points[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]You can only obtain up to 30 Vestiges of Wolf Spirits a day per account from the Play Missions (excluding those obtained from Epic Decoders).
[*]The Wolf Spirit Shop has a wide and exciting selection of items available for purchase with Vestiges of Wolf Spirits. Vestiges of Wolf Spirits will be deducted after a purchase, but don't forget that you get different amounts of rebate based on items!
[*]You can earn up to 1,290 Vestige of Wolf Spirits per account during the event.
[*]Eligible Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic/Zombie Mutant/Zombie Hero/Zombie Z/Zombie Evolution/Zombie Hero Classic
[*]Excluded Zombie Scenarios: Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos.
[*]You must play for at least 5 minutes to get credit for Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]You can only participate in rooms with 3 or more players. (Studio Mode is excluded, except for missions with 60 minutes of playtime.)
[*]Autohunt kills are excluded, regardless of mode.
[*]All unused Vestiges of Wolf Spirits will be replaced with 15 Mileage each and removed during maintenance on 9/17.
[*]All unused Vestiges of Wolf Spirits Boxes will be replaced with 30 mileage each and removed during maintenance on 9/17.[/list][/list]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[b][*][Hero Classic] They Have Returned...! (7/9 - 8/6)[/b]To celebrate the launch of Zombie Hero Classic, SKULL series and Zombie items will be given upon first log-in.

[b][*][Hero Classic] Humans Get Stronger by Log-in Every Day! (7/9 - 8/6)[/b]Feel how the humans grow stronger just by logging in every day! You will receive a reward for your first log-in during the event period. 

[b][*][Upgrade Event] Master Combat Knife Returns! (7/9 - 11/26)[/b]Obtain the [ZHC] Combat Knife (Permanent) from the Counter Exchange and participate in the Upgrade Event!

[b][*][Good Week] New Transcendence Weapon 'Vortex Drill' Experience Event (7/9 - 7/23)[/b]To celebrate the release of a new Transcendence Weapon, you will receive a Vortex Drill (1 Day) upon your first log-in!

[b][*][Good Week] Enhancement Series Weapon Giveaway (7/9 - 7/23)[/b]Meet the conditions every day during the event period and obtain Enhancement Series Weapons!

[b][*][Good Week] Try The Counter Exchange CP Event! (7/9 - 7/23)[/b]Earn CP by completing missions during the event.

[b][*][Good Week] CP Challenge! Attendance Event (7/9 - 7/23)[/b]You can obtain additional CP by completing the attendance mission!

[b]Attention Survivors,[/b]


2025-7-9 10:00 A.M. CEST Update:
The maintenance for June 25th has been completed. Thank you for your patience throughout.

-----------------------------------------------------------

We're going to perform a regular maintenance on July 9th, 2025, at 4:00 A.M. CEST. All servers during this period will be unavailable and we are anticipating the maintenance to conclude at around 11:00 A.M. CEST. Please refer below for more details on the maintenance.

[*]SEA (UTC+7): 9:00 A.M. – 4:00 P.M.
[*]CEST: 4:00 A.M. – 11:00 A.M.
[*]ET: 8th, 10:00 P.M. – 5:00 A.M.
[*]PT: 7:00 P.M. – 2:00 A.M.
[*][i][b]Note[/b]: Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.[/i][/list]

[h1][b]Maintenance Details[/b][/h1]
[list][*]New Content & Events.[/list]
Thank you for your understanding and support in advance.

- The CSN Team

[h3][Summer Special Sale] Transcendence Decoder Supply Box (7 Days) (6/25 - 7/9)[/h3]
Don't miss this fantastic chance to get the Transcendence Decoders at a special price!

[*]Used immediately upon acquisition, duration cannot be extended.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]This product can be purchased up to twice per account during the event period.
[*]Once purchased, you can purchase the item again after 7 days.[/list][/list]

[h2]Other Information[/h2]

[h3]Zombie Hero Classic Update News[/h3]
[quote=dev]Greetings from the CSN dev team.

Ever since the release of Zombie Hero Classic mode, we've been going through the feedback of all you Survivors.
We're trying our best to implement your feedback as soon as possible, but unfortunately, not all the improvements were able to be included in this week's update.

The following changes will be made during the 7/9 update,
and we'd like to ask for your understanding regarding the delay.

1. Bringing Back the Kill Notification/Sounds

We're preparing to bring back the old kill notification/sounds per the request many of you have made.
Currently, we're updating our resources to fit the current resolution and UI environment.

2. Adding Support for Studio Mode

Although it is separate content from Zombie Hero mode, we'll be adding Zombie Hero Classic mode to the Studio per the request many of you have made.

3. Adding an Option to Disable The Permanent Death of Zombies (Limited)

Although it's not a feature that was available in the past, we're testing to see if a limited form of such a feature would be feasible, considering gameplay flow and balance. We're also preparing a balance adjustment as well, after the Zombies' early respawns.

4. Adding Variety to Weapon Availability

To break up the monotony in the current play pattern, the Zombie Classic Enhanced Weapon series will be made available for use.
We're currently planning that they not be provided as separate ZHC-exclusive items, but available as they are with their enhancement status.
Also, we're preparing weapons and enhancement materials for Survivors who are returning to the game.

5. Separation of Paired Class (Fernando, Blair) Weapons

The weapons bound to specific classes, such as Holy Water Grenade and Silver Medal Luger, will be unbound and be available to use independently.
The Transcendence Classes will also be separated in the same way. This will be applied to all modes.

6. CP Acquisition Balance Improvements

We're planning an adjustment to the CP acquisition value that many of you have found exhausting to lower the hurdle.

We'll make further improvements and add content to make Zombie Hero Classic mode feel even more complete, even after the 7/9 update.

Thank you all for your feedback, and please keep sending your love and support as always.

Thank you!
Counter-Strike Nexon Development Team[/quote]

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Update Information[/h2]

[h3]Zombie Hero Classic Released (6/11 - Permanent)[/h3]
The Change Shot and powerful zombies return! Enjoy the classic-feeling Zombie Hero mode and get various rewards!
See [Zombie Hero Classic Mode Preview] for more details.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/273110/view/539981772672207467

[h3]Weapon Modification System Added (6/11 - Permanent)[/h3]

[list][*]1. Weapon Modification System Overview
[list][*]A system where a lower-rank modification-exclusive weapon can be swapped out for a higher-rank weapon using the system.
[*]You can grant EXP to the weapon using Modification Materials, and the weapon can be exchanged for a higher-rank weapon once it reaches max EXP.
[*][!] The lower-rank item disappears upon modifying to obtain a higher-rank weapon.[/list][/list]

[list][*]2. Weapon Stage
[list][*]Modification Weapon can be divided into 6 stages.
[*][!] Stage 1 (Rare) → Stage 2 (Unique) → Stage 3 (Unique) → Stage 4 (Transcendence) → Stage 5 (Transcendence) → Stage 6 (Legendary)
[*]Each weapon of each rank is provided as a separate item.[/list][/list]

[list][*]3. Modification Material Items
[list][*]A material needed to grant weapons EXP, and different materials are required for each rank of the weapon.[/list][/list]

[list][list][*]Items / Usage
[list][*]Normal Modification Material / Can be used for weapons at Unique Rank or lower.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b5cc8591d0687cd780b21b9920da49299bbd52f2.png[/img]
[*]Advanced Modification Material / Can be used for Transcendence Rank weapons.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2eb5523daebb792f0fc0361a9d7bd9c1bc1528e2.png[/img]
[*]Special Modification Material / Can be used for Legendary Rank weapon's special features (★)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/8a96a244cfb61264f75c2f0bd2b1e454eb30a469.png[/img]
[/list][/list][/list]
[list][*]4. Acquisition Methods for Modification Weapons other than the Modification System
[list][*]Each Modification-exclusive weapon can be exchanged for a higher-ranked version via the Modification system, and weapons of certain ranks can be obtained via the Shop or Decoders as well.
[*]Stage 1 (Rare Rank): Shop, Unique Decoder, Unique Premium Decoder
[*]Stage 2 (Unique Rank): Unique Decoder, Unique Premium Decoder
[*]Stage 5 (Transcendence Rank): Transcendence Decoder, Transcendence Premium Decoder
[*]* You can find more detailed information in the Weapon Modification System Preview.[/list][/list]https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/273110/view/539981772672207469

[h3]Exploration Rewards Update (6/11 - Permanent)[/h3]
You can obtain not only permanent weapons, but also Transcendence Decoders every time you reach 100 points!

[list][*]Conditions/Rewards
[list][*]You will receive the reward on the right every time you reach 100 points.

[*]Transcendence Decoder (new)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Exploration Points for Difficulty - EASY: 1 point / NORMAL: 2 points / HARD: 4 points
[*]You can earn up to 4 points a day.[/list][/list]

[h3][Hero Classic] Humans Get Stronger by Log-in Every Day! (6/11 - 7/9)[/h3]
Feel how the humans are getting stronger just by logging in every day! You will receive a reward for your first log-in during the event period.

[h3][Hero Classic] Weekend Log-in Benefits (6/11 - 7/9)[/h3]
Log in over the weekend to earn bonus rewards. 

[list][*]Conditions/Rewards

[h3][Hero Classic] 2012 Respawn for Survivors - [ZHC] Black Dragon Cannon & [ZHC] SKULL-9 Raffle Event (6/14 - 6/15)[/h3]
One lucky winner will be selected for each timeframe among the survivors who have the [Victorious] medal and logged in during the specific timeframe to receive both [ZHC] Black Dragon Cannon and [ZHC] SKULL-9.

[h3][Hero Classic] They Have Returned...! (6/11 - 7/9)[/h3]

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Update Information[/h2]

[h3]New Weapon Information[/h3]

[list][*]New Weapons
[list][*]Compound Bow Blank
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1da7a85e68c8e6c1e0c7b0ba3bf68ee0594b3432.png[/img]
[*]Type: Primary Weapon
[*]Description: The Compound Bow has 60 Arrows made from Carbon Fiber. It has lethal armor penetration power when holding alt-fire to fully draw the bow before firing. It has two firing modes: regular fire and Charge Shot. Its damage is increased compared to the original Compound Bow, but its regular fire mode's firing rate is decreased. Fire Rate Enhancement will increase the rate of regular fire as well as the charging speed of Charge Shot. Regular fire rate will only increase in the earlier few enhancement levels, and only the charging speed will increase from further enhancements. The Recoil Enhancement will remove the recoil of regular fire on the first, and of Charge Shot on the second level. Weight Enhancement will improve the movement speed while charging as well.
[*]This weapon can be enhanced and have parts equipped.
[*]This weapon will be added to the New Classic (Zombie) Arms Restriction list.
[*]This weapon has no appearance changes at enhancement +6 or +8.
[*]This weapon can be painted with the Semitransparent Weapon Paint.[/list][/list]

Type: Primary Weapon
Description: The Compound Bow has 60 Arrows made from Carbon Fiber. It has lethal armor penetration power when holding alt-fire to fully draw the bow before firing. It has two firing modes: regular fire and Charge Shot. Its damage is increased compared to the original Compound Bow, but its regular fire mode's firing rate is decreased. Fire Rate Enhancement will increase the rate of regular fire as well as the charging speed of Charge Shot. Regular fire rate will only increase in the earlier few enhancement levels, and only the charging speed will increase from further enhancements. The Recoil Enhancement will remove the recoil of regular fire on the first, and of Charge Shot on the second level. Weight Enhancement will improve the movement speed while charging as well.
This weapon can be enhanced and have parts equipped.
This weapon will be added to the New Classic (Zombie) Arms Restriction list.
This weapon has no appearance changes at enhancement +6 or +8.
This weapon can be painted with the Semitransparent Weapon Paint.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/6af10d30b3005f147ead1fa7a1f273b8132e9a6b.jpg[/img]
[b]Attention Survivors,[/b]

We're going to perform a regular maintenance on May 28th, 2025, at 4:00 A.M. CEST. All servers during this period will be unavailable and we are anticipating the maintenance to conclude at around 8:00 A.M. CEST. Please refer below for more details on the maintenance.

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes : May 14th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/3ece2d352623a024e87fdceabf852b55f9758e03.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!
Please see [url=https://forum.nexon.com/csnexon/board_list?board=5377]here[/url] for the Decoder rates.

[list][b][*]Zombie Z Update Information[/b]With this update, the Extend-exclusive maps will be removed, and the features from the Extend maps will be applied to all of Zombie Z.

[b][*]Rendering Improvement VFX Settings (Beta)[/b]
[b][*]Studio Future Theme Update[/b]
[b][*]Studio Cube Fragments Giveaway (5/14 - 6/11)[/b]Donate Cubes to the studio map you're rooting for, and get rewards!

[b][*]Studio Event Decoder Raffle Event (5/14 - 6/11)[/b]Cheer for other players' Studio maps, and get a chance to win a raffle!

[b][*]Studio Cheer Cube Fragment Use-up Event (5/14 - 6/11)[/b]Meet the following conditions during the event to get rewards.

[b][*]Try The Counter Exchange CP Event! (5/14 - 6/11)[/b]Earn CP (CSN Event Points) by completing missions during the event.

[b][*]CP Challenge! Attendance Event (5/21 - 6/11)[/b]You can obtain additional CP by trying out the attendance mission!

[b][*]Skill Perk Collection Event (5/14 - 6/11)[/b]Log in to the game and get Skill Perk items! 

[b][*]Zombie Hero Mode (Rebalanced) Medal Acquisition Event (5/14 - Permanent)[/b]Play Zombie Hero Mode with Rebalanced settings to obtain a new medal.

[b][*]May is a Great Month 2 Play with Zombies (5/14 - 6/11)[/b]Get 2 points every day to make it a rich May!

[b][*]New User Package/Welcome Back Supply Box Rework (5/14 - Permanent)[/b]Get various items from the welcome supply box prepared for new and returning players!

[b][*]Login Supplies Event (5/14 - 6/10)[/b]Logging in during the event will give you daily and cumulative rewards!

[b][*]New Transcendence Class [Amy & Pablo] Promotion (5/14 - 6/11) [/b]The following Classes will make a special appearance in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders during the event.

[b][*]New Transcendence Class [Amy & Pablo] Guaranteed Giveaway (5/14 - 6/11) [/b]Get two new guaranteed Transcendence Classes (Amy, Pablo) based on how many Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders are used during the event!

[b][*]New Transcendence Class [Amy & Pablo] Medal Giveaway (5/14 - 6/11) [/b]When you own all items in the new Transcendence Classes set, you will receive the Transcendence Class medal.

[b][*]New Spray & Class Decoder Promotion (5/14 - 6/11)[/b]
[b][*][Pulse Reactor] Transcendence Weapon Promotion (5/14 - 6/11)[/b]The Pulse Reactor can drop from the Transcendence Premium Decoder and Transcendence Decoder during the event.

[b][*][Pulse Reactor] Transcendence Weapon Guaranteed Giveaway (5/14 - 6/11)[/b]Depending on the number of Transcendence Premium Decoders and Transcendence Decoders used during the event, you may be guaranteed to receive the Pulse Reactor![/list]

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Update Information[/h2]

[h3]Zombie Z Update Information[/h3]
With this update, the Extend-exclusive maps will be removed, and the features from the Extend maps will be applied to all of Zombie Z.

[list][*]1. EXP Limit
[list][*]There will be a max level limit per round.
[*]1st round limit is Lv. 4. Increases by 4 each round.
[*]You will no longer earn EXP at max level, but will gain increased Karma.[/list][/list]

[list][*]2. Special Mutation System Added
[list][*]Once you reach a certain round, you can choose between two Special Mutations to obtain.
[*]Special Mutations do not cost Mutation Points.[/list][/list]

[list][list][*]Name/Mutation Effects
[list][*]Zombie Booster: While playing as a Zombie, obtain all Zombie/Human Karma.
[*]Patience: Significantly decreases Attack at the beginning of the round, but increases Attack later.
[*]Unlock Increase: Weapon Unlock level increased, but attack also increased.
[*]Friend: Combat power increases when with a friend.
[*]Self Progression: Do not level up automatically, but gain Mutation Reobtain Count.
[*]Revival Chance: Revive as a Human one time during the Game.
[*]Diversity: Gain additional effect when all weapons in use have different ranks.
[*]Bonus: Gain Additional Mutation.
[*]Escape Artist: Gain additional effect for a set duration when HP decreases.
[*]Vampire: Recover HP when inflicting damage.
[*]Mature Savings: Gain additional effect when achieving max level.
[*]SMG Master: Increase SMG attack power.
[*]Rifle Master: Increase Rifle attack power.
[*]Shotgun Master: Increase Shotgun attack power.
[*]Machine Gun Master: Increase Machine Gun attack power.
[*]Desperado: Cannot use Primary Weapon, increased Secondary Weapon attack power.[/list][/list][/list]

[list][*]3. Mutation Reobtain System
[list][*]You can use the Mutation Reobtain feature (L key) to remove unwanted Mutations and obtain a different one.
[*]* Special Mutations and fixed Mutations cannot be removed.[/list][/list]

[list][*]4. Karma Effect Changes
[list][*]Sub Karma effect is removed and some per-team Karma effects have changed.[/list][/list]

[list][list][*]Team - Humans
[list][*]Karma Level 1: Gain 1 Mutation Reobtain Count
[*]Karma Level 2: All Human Mutation activated during Karma using round, Gain 1 Mutation Reobtain Count
[*]Karma Level 3: Gain 1 Mutation Reobtain Count[/list][/list][/list]

[list][list][*]Team - Zombies
[list][*]Karma Level 1: Increases maximum HP until game ends
[*]Karma Level 2: Reduced Respawn Time, Hero Zombie Play
[*]Karma Level 3: Knockback/Stun lasts until game ends, 6s Invincibility, Max HP, Defense increase buff for set duration[/list][/list][/list]

[list][*]5. Purchase Random Weapon Changes
[list][*]We made a change so that more efficient choices of weapons can be purchased (weapons that have a higher selection rate will be provided first), but reward effects are removed, and the cost will slowly increase per round.
[*]For more details, please refer to the Zombie Z Update Preview.[/list][/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/273110/view/539979243764844781

[h3]Rendering Improvement VFX Settings (Beta)[/h3]

[list][*]Rendering Improvement
[list][*]Some features will be optionally available in certain maps to allow you to experience modern graphics.
[*]This feature will be available in [Settings - Video] for detailed settings with the name VFX (Visual Effects).
[*]* If you have VFX enabled, you can toggle it in real-time with the F8 key.
[*]* If you want to change the key, you can change it in [Settings] - [Key Mode] - [Misc.] - [Enable/Disable VFX] settings.
[*]* Currently, two maps are applicable for VFX Settings: Italy and Dust.
[*]* You can find more detailed information in the Rendering Improvement VFX Settings Preview.[/list][/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/273110/view/539979243764844785

[h3]Studio Future Theme Update[/h3]

[list][*]New Studio Sample Map
[list][*]A [Future Town] map will be released, consisting of future-themed blocks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ead3104df542740fcfbfc6aa8f4f3596972e86fc.png[/img]
[*]Description: Create stunning, creative maps with the new Studio theme, set in a futuristic, virtual new city. (Supports Studio - Hide and Seek mode.)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Studio - Future Themed Block Updates
[list][*]A variety of new blocks, including 59 standard, 12 decorative, and 12 device blocks, have been added.
[*]* You can view the new blocks in Creation Mode without adding a separate theme pack.[/list][/list]

[h2]Event Information[/h2]

[h3]Studio Cube Fragments Giveaway (5/14 - 6/11)[/h3]
Donate Cubes to the studio map you're rooting for, and get rewards!

[list][*]Conditions/Rewards
[list][*]Reach 30 minutes of playtime on a studio map
[*]Cheer Cube Fragment x50[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Can only participate once per day per account.
[*]You can only participate in rooms with 3 or more players.[/list][/list]

[h3]Studio Event Decoder Raffle Event (5/14 - 6/11)[/h3]
Cheer for other players' Studio maps, and get a chance to win a raffle!

[list][*]Conditions/Rewards
[list][*]Reach 10 minutes of playtime on a Studio map another player created & donate 100 Cubes or more (5 people)
[*]Event Decoder x30[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Reward Distribution: 6/13
[*]Only the playtime and donation during the event period will count.
[*]You must reach 10 minutes of playtime on the map.
[*]Event Decoders can be used until midnight of the day they were obtained, and are removed afterwards.[/list][/list]

[h3]Studio Cheer Cube Fragment Use-up Event (5/14 - 6/11)[/h3]
Meet the following conditions during the event to get rewards.

[list][*]Conditions/Rewards
[list][*]Each time 10,000 Cheer Cube Fragments are used
[*]10,000 Mileage Coupon x1
[*]Can only participate once per day per account.[/list][/list]

[h3]Try The Counter Exchange CP Event! (5/14 - 6/11)[/h3]
Earn CP (CSN Event Points) by completing missions during the event.

[list][*]Special Rewards
[list][*]This is a special category of items that have difficult unlock requirements.
[*]Unlock requirements are based on the total CP (CSN Event Points) each item requires.

[*]Unlock Requirements (Total CP): 210
[*]Special Reward: CP Special Box

[*]2021 Transcendence Class Selection Box x1
[*]Devastator (Permanent) x1
[*]Special Transcendence Weapon Box x1
[*]Gold Weapon Selection Box x1[/list][/list][/list]

[list][list][*]Special Transcendence Weapon Box Contents

[list][*]How to Participate
[list][*]Earn 1 CP for every 10 Kill Points from zombie kills or assists as a human, or infections as a zombie (except bots) in Zombie Mode (up to 7 CP per day).
[*]Earn 1 CP for every 30 Kill Points from zombie kills or assists as a human, or infections as a zombie (bots only) in Zombie Mode (up to 2 CP per day).
[*]Earn 3 CP for every 2 session clears after scoring 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard or higher (up to 9 CP per day)
[*]Earn 1 CP for every 20 minutes of in-game playtime (up to 2 CP per day)[/list][/list][list][list][*]Earn 1 CP when you complete 2 of the following missions (up to 1 CP per day):
[list][*]Replace Equipped Skill Perk once.
[*]Purchase a Point Transcendence Decoder or a Point Class Decoder from the Shop.

[h3]CP Challenge! Attendance Event (5/21 - 6/11)[/h3]

[list][*]Amy
[list][*]A humanoid android made by Kronos. It is very well made to the point that it almost looks human, except for certain parts. It was originally made to be obedient to humans, but after meeting a certain doctor, its mental defenses were neutralized, leaving it in a somewhat broken state. It acts like an android should normally, but when it's stressed out, it vents its rage and anxiety, and sometimes becomes extremely aggressive.

[*]This character leaves a unique mark at the target location upon killing an enemy.
[*]Marks Zombies at 20% HP or below in Zombie Mode.[/list][/list][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b675764c4a1d2e6ee6e12e79e86b3a5d8b91ba8e.png[/img]
[list][*]Pablo
[list][*]A doctor whose great appearance and skill earned him the title of godlike. As he always takes patients with a smile, he is very popular. Although he is no doubt a professional, he lacks sympathy or kindness, naturally making the people around him suffer, to the point where no one was able to work with him for longer than a week. Because of that reason, the government has paired him up with a special android nurse to work with him.

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes : April 30th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/113836bfd42483778ce48d2d31566adbe3a077e5.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!
Please see [url=https://forum.nexon.com/csnexon/board_list?board=5377]here[/url] for the Decoder rates.

[list][b][*]New Weapon Information[/b]Gilboa Viper Blank

[b][*]1st CP Challenge! Play Event (4/30 - 5/14)[/b]You can obtain additional CP by playing various challenges!

[b][*]2nd CP Challenge! Play Event (5/7 - 5/14)[/b]You can obtain additional CP by playing various challenges!

[b][*]Gilboa Viper Blank Giveaway (4/30 - 5/14)[/b]Meet the condition below every day during the event period, and get various rewards, including the new Classic Weapon! 

[b][*]Random Weapon Zombie Hero Event (4/30 - 5/14)[/b]Test how skilled you really are in Zombie Hero Mode with randomized weapons!

[b][*]Spring Break Event (4/30 - 5/7)[/b]Enjoy daily rewards during the event period!

[b][*]Mileage Auction Event (4/30 - 5/13)[/b]You can access the auction during the event from the Mileage Auction button at the bottom of the lobby screen.

[b][*]3,000 Mileage Auction Event! (4/30 - 5/6)[/b]Sometimes great deals on listings will appear! You could become the lucky winner of an item at a special cost of 3,000 Mileage!

[b][*]Rotation Class Promotion (4/30 - 5/14)[/b]The classes below will be part of the new Rotation Group for the Class Decoder during the event.

[b][*]Rotation Class Guaranteed Giveaway (4/30 - 5/14)[/b]Select a guaranteed Class from the Rotation Group based on Class Decoder usage during the event!

[b][*]Surprise Dev Talk Video Reward Event (4/30 - 5/14)[/b]It's a surprise gift from the Dev Talk video! Complete the mission below and get rewards![/list]

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Update Information[/h2]

[h3]New Weapon Information[/h3]

[list][*]New Weapons
[list][*]Gilboa Viper Blank
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a4e36db25021b38b266cbfc99b447ee7dd2e0a91.png[/img]
[*]Type: Primary Weapon
[*]Description: The Gilboa Viper uses 5.56mm bullets for 60-foot straight shots. Manufactured with a double-row barrel, boasting twice the firepower of the basic rifle. It has a regular mode that fires one bullet, and a special fire mode that shoots two bullets at once. This version of the Gilboa Viper has improved accuracy and recoil compared to its original version, but its special fire rate is slower. Damage enhancements can increase the stun effect of regular fire, decrease the stun effect, and increase the knockback effect of special fire. Fire Rate enhancements will only increase the special fire mode's rate, not affecting the regular fire mode's rate.
[*]This weapon can be enhanced and have parts equipped.
[*]This weapon will be added to the New Classic (Zombie) Arms Restriction list.
[*]This weapon has no appearance changes at enhancement +6 or +8.
[*]This weapon can be painted with the Semitransparent Weapon Paint.[/list][/list]

[h2]Event Information[/h2]

[h3]1st CP Challenge! Play Event (4/30 - 5/14)[/h3]
You can obtain additional CP by playing various challenges!

[list][*]How to Participate
[list][*]Reach 10 hours of total playtime: 8 CP (Up to 8 CP)
[*]Complete 100 rounds in modes with rounds: 8 CP (Up to 8 CP)
[*]Win 20 games in modes with win/loss: 8 CP (Up to 8 CP)
[*]Try out 7 different maps for at least 20 min each in any game mode: 8 CP (Up to 8 CP)
[*]Score 10 Human Victories as a Hero in Zombie Evolution/Zombie Hero/Zombie Z: 8 CP (Up to 8 CP)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Regardless of how you obtain your points, you can earn up to 40 CP during the event period.
[*]You can only participate in rooms with 3 or more players.
[*]You must play for at least 5 minutes to get credit for Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]You can participate in all modes, including Studio Mode.
[*]CP is removed when the event ends.
[*]Zombie Scenario/Human Scenario rounds are also counted for Play Missions that require modes with rounds.
[*]The condition for winning in modes with win/loss refers to seeing the victory shown on the session completion screen.[/list][/list]

[h3]2nd CP Challenge! Play Event (5/7 - 5/14)[/h3]
You can obtain additional CP by playing various challenges!

[list][*]How to Participate
[list][*]Play for 5 hours with a Family member: 14 CP (Up to 14 CP)
[*]Earn 30 headshots against players (excluding bots): 14 CP (Up to 14 CP)
[*]Try out 5 different modes for at least 30 minutes each: 14 CP (Up to 14 CP)
[*]Win 30 rounds as a Human in Zombie Evolution/Zombie Hero/Zombie Z: 14 CP (Up to 14 CP) 
[*]Score 20 different player class kills, regardless of whether they are human/zombie (excluding bots): 14 CP (Up to 14 CP)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Each account can only participate once per mission.
[*]Regardless of how you obtain points, you can earn up to 70 CP over the event period.
[*]You can only participate in rooms with 3 or more players.
[*]Regarding the condition to play with a Family member, only one Family member is required as long as there are at least 3 players in the room.
[*]You can participate in all modes, including Studio Mode.
[*]CP is removed when the event ends.[/list][/list]

[h3]Gilboa Viper Blank Giveaway (4/30 - 5/14)[/h3]
Meet the condition below every day during the event period, and get various rewards, including the new Classic Weapon! 

[list][*]Conditions/Rewards
[list][*]Reach 30 minutes of Playtime
[*]1x: Rare Decoder x3 + 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x1 + Gilboa Viper Blank (10 Days) x1
[*]2x: Rare Decoder x5 + 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x2 + Enhanced Weapon Free Ticket (1 Day) x1
[*]3x: Rare Decoder x7 + 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3 + Dehancement Material Parts Rate Box x1
[*]4x: Event Decoder x5 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x4 + Enhanced Weapon Free Ticket (7 Days) x1
[*]5x: Event Decoder x7 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5 + Gilboa Viper Blank (Permanent)
[*]7x: Event Decoder x9 + 200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3 + Blank Series Selection Box x1[/list][/list]

[list][*]Blank Series Selection Box Contents (select 1)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5a6192fdae81d05e94927279e5c22d6d9a9bc6a6.png[/img]
[list][*]M134 Minigun Blank (Permanent)
[*]Gilboa Viper Blank (Permanent)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Can only participate once per day per account.
[*]Only rooms with 3+ players count toward the event.
[*]An Enhanced Weapon Free Ticket is an item that allows you to use an enhanced weapon while you possess it. The enhanced weapon from the ticket cannot be further enhanced or disassembled.
[*]Event Decoders can be used until midnight of the day they were obtained, and are removed afterwards.
[*]Unused Blank Series Selection Boxes are removed when the event ends.[/list][/list]

[h3]Random Weapon Zombie Hero Event (4/30 - 5/14)[/h3]
Test how skilled you really are in Zombie Hero Mode with randomized weapons!

[list][*]New Weapons Added
[list][*]Ascalon
[*]M134 Minigun Blank
[*]Gilboa Viper Blank
[*]Abyss Repulsor[/list][/list]

[list][*]Featured Maps
[list][*]Compatible Event Maps: Italy, Assault, Dust, Abyss 2, and Estate[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]When you're on the Zombie Team, your class will be selected randomly.
[*]When you're on the Human Team, your primary weapon, secondary weapon, melee weapon, and grenade will be selected randomly.
[*]Base game rules are the same as Zombie Hero.
[*]Available weapons are determined regardless of individual ownership.
[*]Armor distribution is fixed.
[*]The Shop Window in the Supply Box will be unavailable. Instead, another random weapon will be chosen.
[*]Human heroes cannot be selected while in this mode.[/list][/list]

[h3]Spring Break Event (4/30 - 5/7)[/h3]
Enjoy daily rewards during the event period!

[list][*]Conditions/Rewards
[list][*]Reach 10 minutes of Playtime
[*]Reached for a total of 1 Day: Event Decoder x1
[*]Reached for a total of 2 Days: Event Decoder x2
[*]Reached for a total of 3 Days: Event Decoder x3
[*]Reached for a total of 4 Days: Event Decoder x4
[*]Reached for a total of 5 Days: Transcendence Decoder x3
[*]Can only participate once per day per account.[/list][/list]

[h3]Mileage Auction Event (4/30 - 5/13)[/h3]
You can access the auction during the event from the Mileage Auction button at the bottom of the lobby screen.

[list][*]Permanent Auction Items Added
[list][*]Death Eater[/list][/list]

[list][*]Auction Details
[list][*]Auction Time: 1 hour for all items
[*]Number of Listings: 2 (Can be increased based on VIP rank)
[*]Market Price of Items: When listing an item, you can check the current Auction House market price (Lowest bid and direct purchase prices).
[*]Item Display: Only items with the lowest bid or have a direct purchase price are displayed.
[*]Auction Settings: You can search by bid/direct purchase price, enhancement level, and weapon name.
[*]Sell-to-System Feature: When an auction is unsuccessful, you'll have the opportunity to use the sell-to-system feature.
[*]Auction Hours: 24 Hours (12:00 AM - 11:59 PM). When the auction is over, all currently listed items will be canceled.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Other Details
[list][*]The remaining time is shown in 5-minute increments for listed auction items.
[*]You can only bid on one item at a time.
[*]Regular auction items will be listed with a 30% fee included in the initial bidding price.
[*]If an item listed for auction is not sold, the item will be returned.
[*]Items listed for auction can be purchased immediately at the direct purchase price.
[*]If you list an item for auction, you cannot withdraw it until the auction's duration has ended.
[*]The item you listed may be shown on the bid page.
[*]When listing an item, you can easily check the actual amount you will receive under the Net Reward section.
[*]Some recently released weapons cannot be listed at auction.[/list][/list]

[h3]3,000 Mileage Auction Event! (4/30 - 5/6)[/h3]
Sometimes great deals on listings will appear! You could become the lucky winner of an item at a special cost of 3,000 Mileage!

[list][*]Time/Special Items
[list][*]4/30 CEST 4:00 PM / 9:00 PM - Auction Fee Discount Coupon (30%) x1
[*]5/1 CEST 4:00 PM / 9:00 PM - Abyss Repulsor (Permanent)
[*]5/2 CEST 4:00 PM / 9:00 PM  - Cousteau (Permanent)
[*]5/3 CEST 4:00 PM / 9:00 PM - Transcendence Class Selection Ticket x1
[*]5/4 CEST 4:00 PM / 9:00 PM - Cousteau (Permanent)
[*]5/5 CEST 4:00 PM / 9:00 PM - Transcendence Weapon Selection Ticket x1
[*]5/6 CEST 4:00 PM / 9:00 PM - Auction Fee Discount Coupon (30%) x1[/list][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e168148e239326d730cac7682d0edb8115a3eb86.png[/img]
[list][*]* How to use the Auction Fee Discount Coupon (30%) & Notes
[list][*]1. Press the "Use" button on the Auction Fee Discount Coupon (30%) in your inventory
[*]2. Check the "COUPON BOX" in the Auction System screen
[*]3. Once an item registered on Auction is sold, apply the coupon before claiming the money
[*]> Check if the 30% Fee Discount is applied[/list][/list]

[list][*]Other Details
[list][*]The 3,000 Mileage Auction items only appear at specific times.
[*]After the 3,000 Mileage auction is over, participants who haven't won will have their 3,000 Mileage refunded.
[*]3,000 Mileage bids can be made 10 minutes after the special auction begins.
[*]Claim the contents by clicking "Obtain" after winning.
[*]You cannot win multiple rewards during the event.
[*]The Auction Fee Discount Coupon (30%) grants you a 30% discount on the Auction Fee.
[*]The Auction Fee Discount Coupon (30%) can be used until 5/13, when the Auction Event ends.[/list][/list]

[h3]Rotation Class Promotion (4/30 - 5/14)[/h3]
The classes below will be part of the new Rotation Group for the Class Decoder during the event.

[list][*]Appearing Classes: Skadi/Nyx/Special Agent Mei/Pyromaniac Yuri
[list][*]Upon winning with a rotating class, you will automatically obtain their exclusive costume.
[*] - Winning Skadi will automatically provide Sword Wings (Permanent).
[*] - Winning Nyx will automatically provide Moonlight Orb (Permanent).
[*] - Winning Special Agent Mei will automatically provide Mikey Panda (Permanent).
[*] - Winning Pyromaniac Yuri will automatically provide Bomb Bot (Permanent).
[*]The Rotation Group will be removed from the possible contents of the decoder once the event ends.
[*]The contents of the Rotation Group can change at any time.
[*]The Rotation Group is added to Class Decoders only during the event.[/list][/list]

[h3]Rotation Class Guaranteed Giveaway (4/30 - 5/14)[/h3]
Select a guaranteed Class from the Rotation Group based on Class Decoder usage during the event!

[list][*]Classes in the Rotation Group: Skadi/Nyx/Special Agent Mei/Pyromaniac Yuri
[list][*]Each time you reach 150 Guaranteed Points, you can choose 1 class from the Rotation Group.
[*]You'll get 1 Guaranteed Point each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
[*]Upon winning with a rotating class, you will automatically obtain their exclusive costume.[/list][/list]

[h3]Surprise Dev Talk Video Reward Event (4/30 - 5/14)[/h3]
It's a surprise gift from the Dev Talk video! Complete the mission below and get rewards!

[list][*]Conditions/Rewards
[list][*]Reach 10 minutes of Playtime
[*]Class Pass (5 Days) x1
[*]Transcendence Weapon Pass (5 Days) x1
[*]Rewards can only be obtained once per account.[/list][/list]

[h2]Other Information[/h2]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where using the Abyss Repulsor would return the player to the waiting room.[/list]
