notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/02408c91d8ae001b921956c3887587bffc5e75bd.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*]Season 17: Egypt (10/04 - 1/24)[/b]For details, please refer to the Season 17 Pass Preview.

[b][*] Chuseok Moonlight Event (10/4 - 10/18)[/b]Participate in the event and earn lots of great rewards!

[b][*] Autumn Enhancement Item Giveaway (10/4 - 10/18)[/b]Receive rewards just by playing during the event!

[b][*] Holiday Mileage Auction Event (10/4 - 10/17)[/b]You can access the auction via the 'Mileage Auction' button at the bottom of the lobby during the event.

[b][*] Twin Light Axes/Twin Shadow Axes Promotion (10/4 - 11/15)[/b]During the promotion, Twin Light Axes and Twin Shadow Axes will make a special appearance in Epic Decoders![/list]

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Update Information[/h2]

[h3]Releasing a New Map[/h3]
[list][*]New Map Extension
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/fbbcb9bb17818954fec80f109fc7423075094749.png[/img]
[*]Location: Extension Building Site
[*]Eligible Modes: Team Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch (AI), Deathmatch, Deathmatch (AI), Gun Deathmatch, Zombie, Zombie Classic, Zombie Mutant, Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, Zombie Evolution, Super Soldier, and All-Star.[/list]

[h3]Season 17: Egypt (10/04 - 1/24)[/h3]
For details, please refer to the Season 17 Pass Preview.

[list][*]Black Market Opens Early
[list][*]The Black Market will open early for players who reach Rank 100.
[*]Upon reaching Rank 100 on the current Season Pass, Season Missions will end while missions that offer Black Market Badges will refresh.
[*]New Items Added:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a75f867bfac375f16b67cf9b4ca800c19bd3780b.png[/img]
 CSO Energy Drink, Laser Storm (Parts Applied), Avalanche TECH, Dart Pistol TECH, Crowbar Maverick TECH, and Cyborg Normal Zombie (Costume) [/list][/list]

[list][*]Season Pass Discount Coupon
[list][*]Description: This is a coupon that reduces the purchase price of the next Season Pass. The Discount Coupon is given to those who have reached Season Pass Rank 100.
[*]* Logging in during the following season will automatically redeem the coupon.
[*]    (For example, if you receive the Discount Coupon during Season 17, it will reduce the price of the Season 18 Pass.)
[*]* If you do not log in during the following season, however, the coupon will be automatically removed.
[*]    (For example, if you received the coupon in Season 17 but didn't log in during Season 18, the discount will not be applied if you returned during Season 19.)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Repurchasing Previous Season Passes
[list][*]A page where previous season items can be purchased will become available to those who reach Rank 100 on the Season Pass!
[*]The page begins with the player's progress from the past season, and they can purchase Season Pass Ranks from the page to obtain items.
[*]Available Previous Season Passes: Seasons 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15
[*]The Black Market can be accessed via the [Missions] menu after reaching Rank 100.
[*]All Black Market Badges you've obtained will disappear once a new season begins.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Season Reward Weapons
[list][*]Dual Katana Anubis
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e87a1f7e8fd0ced4f750420c53dbe5a72da9a9d9.png[/img]
[list][*]Wield two sharp Katanas and strike down anyone who stands in your way. The special attack skill, Two-Handed Slash, can deal devastating amounts of damage to a single opponent.[/list]

[*]Sapientia Anubis
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/7264b47bfbfd9539fdd42c7be6b6ab9b6f9991df.png[/img]
[list][*] This pistol uses special 'Holy Bullets', which after being shot, explode in a wave of shrapnel, damaging all zombies in a certain area.[/list]

[*]Thunderbolt Anubis
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/34bab79544b60987708e476eb206cc90029d588b.png[/img]
[list][*]A railgun that uses electromagnetic energy to fire projectiles at supersonic speeds. It is incredibly destructive but must be reloaded after each shot.[/list]

[*]M249 Ra
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9c9d4973d5b758e39e22d8e3875f4928267a6e05.png[/img]
[list][*]A special machine gun that holds 100 rounds of .50 caliber special ammunition, highly effective against zombies. The generous magazine capacity gives this weapon great battle sustainability.
[*]*Special Feature <Summon Uraeus>:\nRight-click when the special round is charged to fire a powerful energy wave. [/list][/list][/list]


[list][*]Zombie Costumes
[list][*]Anubis Guard Normal Zombie
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ed1daa59270575529d8784f6365bab0f8e446ad7.png[/img]
[list][*]Grants access to the Anubis Guard Normal Zombie. This will change the appearance of your Normal Zombie.[/list][/list][/list]

[list][*]Weapon Paints
[list][*]Egyptian Weapon Paint
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5eb7e054a8ee69f982c781582b0146c055269bbd.png[/img]
[list][*]Eligible Weapons: MP5 Egypt, Petrol Boomer Egypt, THANATOS-9 Egypt, Failnaught Egypt, and Battle Python Egypt [/list][/list]

[list][*]Pharaoh Weapon Paint
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/8034faf4e300fe1354c6d8508a226e0c61ff9e28.png[/img]
[*]Eligible Weapons: MP5 Pharaoh, Petrol Boomer Pharaoh, THANATOS-9 Pharaoh, Failnaught Pharaoh, and Battle Python Pharaoh  [/list][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f18b10e053073f5d6bba6a48fc6a781de4d83f0a.png[/img]
[*]Pharaoh Crook and Flail (Back)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0e156820858a0d22b0504e80774c6c79fb371245.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/bfec82d98877ce5ea81ea25d522895365090eb96.png[/img]
[/list][/list]

[list][*]Sprays

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2495cf02afc46c2d7a39eacae8b7bf01a67e6bcd.png[/img]
[*]SD Egyptian Mirage Spray
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1ec4d9c6b1e95451381549c69a68356add249f54.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/fc051b34e2954eb57a4b18fae5f445a03a827f15.png[/img]
[/list][/list]

[list][*]Nameplates
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d352633754ad9dd6da4c620deee2609d28c6eb69.png[/img]
[list][*]Season Pass Nameplate (17)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Damage Fonts
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/896a28003d7c78babcc7a2c63a9feb4833f84a0c.png[/img]
[list][*]Season Pass Font (17)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Medals
[list][*]Season 17 Pioneer Medal (Pass)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/6507a5c23a2a0ee392ec6c992fc3e9fa9f06114e.png[/img]
[*]Season 17 Conqueror Medal (Highest Rank Reached)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a7b8aafe68e31844d76ef397a32e5e020e81db1c.png[/img]
[/list][/list]

[h3]League Season 13 (10/4 - 1/24)[/h3]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Items have been added to the Achievement Shop.
New Items Added: Surprised Emoji Spray (Mei), Lazy Spring Cat Nameplate, Cheerful Summer Cat Nameplate, Quiet Autumn Cat Nameplate, Smug Winter Cat Nameplate[/list][/list]

[h3]Return of the Family Bonus Event[/h3]
Gather up the family! Receive rewards based on the number of family members that are logged in and the playtime accumulated.

[list][*]Simultaneous Log In Conditions and Rewards
[list][*]2 or more logged in: Magnum Launcher
[*]4 or more logged in: Psychic Harmonium
[*]7 or more logged in: NEGEV NG-7 Ajax
[*]10 or more logged in: Spell Lance Scarlet Rose[/list][/list]

[list][*]Family Game Playtime Conditions and Rewards
[list][*]Reach 60 Hours: Rare Decoder x5
[*]Reach 80 Hours: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5
[*]Reach 100 Hours: Event Decoder x5
[*]Reach 120 Hours: 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP x5
[*]Reach 140 Hours: Transcendence Weapon Pass (5 Days)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]The weapons provided cannot be owned or disassembled.
[*]Rewards are provided based on the combined playtime of all family members.
[*]Playtime only counts in rooms with 2 or more players.
[*]Playing with family members gives an additional 10% accumulated playtime.
[*]Must contribute at least 1 hour of playtime to be eligible for rewards.
[*]Weekly playtime records reset every Monday at 12 AM.
[*]Players who log in after Monday at 12 AM are not eligible to receive the previous week's Family Time achievement rewards.
[*]Rewards can be claimed once upon logging in within one week and are unavailable after that time.[/list][/list]


[h2]Event Information[/h2]

[h3]Chuseok Moonlight Event (10/4 - 10/18)[/h3]
Participate in the event and earn lots of great rewards!

[list][*]Participation Requirements
[list][*]Receive 2 points for every 6 Kill Points from Zombie Kills, Assists, or Human Infections (bots excluded) (up to 30 points per day).
[*]Earn 5 points for clearing 1 session by reaching 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard difficulty or higher (up to 30 points a day).
[*]Earn 1 point for every 5 minutes of in-game playtime (up to 8 points a day)
[*]Earn 2 points each time you log in (once a day)[/list][/list]

[list][*]How to Get Zombie Mode Kill Points
[list][*]Zombie Kill as a Human: 3 Points (excluding bots)
[*]Zombie Assist as a Human: 1 Point (excluding bots) 
[*]Human Infection as Zombie: 4 Points (excludes bots)
[*]Human Infection Assist as Zombie: 0 Points [/list][/list]

[list][*]Point Accumulation Rewards
[list][*]40 Points: Rare Decoder x3 + Exploration Success Rate-Up +10% x3
[*]80 Points: Rare Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x3
[*]120 Points: Unique Decoder x3
[*]200 Points: Unique Decoder x5
[*]280 Points: 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3 + Event Decoder x2
[*]320 Points: Transcendence Weapon Pass + 200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3
[*]360 Points: 10,000 Mileage Coupon x1 + Moonglow Costume (Permanent)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f26a8be8615f2b8a410a02da68bf17f623660d69.png[/img]
[*]400 Points: Event Decoder x6
[*]440 Points: Class Decoder x7
[*]480 points: Transcendence Decoder x7
[*]520 Points: Season Badge x100[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice

[h3]Autumn Enhancement Item Giveaway (10/4 - 10/18)[/h3]
Receive rewards just by playing during the event!

[list][*]Rewards
[list][*]Reach 10 minutes of playtime: Random -1 Dehancement Material / 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon / 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon
[*]Reach 30 minutes of playtime: Random -1 Dehancement Material / 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon / 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon

[*]Eligible Zombie Modes: all

[*]Player Requirement: 3 or more

[h3]Holiday Mileage Auction Event (10/4 - 10/17)[/h3]
You can access the auction via the 'Mileage Auction' button at the bottom of the lobby during the event.

[list][*]Auction Feature / Content
[list][*]Item Rank: Premium (All weapons except for premium are Normal Rank)
[*]Auction Time: 1 hour for all items
[*]Number of Auction Listings: 2 (Increases based on VIP rank)
[*]Market Price of Items: When listing an item, you can check the current Auction House market price (Lowest bid and direct purchase prices).
[*]Item Display: Only items with the lowest bid or direct purchase price are displayed.
[*]Auction Settings: You can search by bid/direct purchase price, enhancement level, and weapon name.
[*]Sell-to-System Feature: When an auction is unsuccessful, you'll have the opportunity to use the sell-to-system feature.
[*]Auction Hours: 24 Hours (12: 00: 00 AM – 11: 59: 59 PM) - When auction hours end, currently listed items will be canceled.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]The remaining time is shown in 5-minute increments for listed auction items.
[*]You can only bid on 1 item at a time.
[*]Regular auction items will be listed with a 30% fee included in the initial bidding price.
[*]If an item listed for auction is not sold, the item will be returned.
[*]Items listed for auction can be purchased immediately at the direct purchase price.
[*]If you list an item for auction, you cannot withdraw it until the auction's duration has ended.
[*]The item you listed may be shown on the bid page.
[*]When listing an item, you can easily check the actual amount you will receive under the Net Reward section.
[*]Some recently released weapons cannot be listed at auction.[/list][/list]


[h3]1,000 Mileage Auction Event (10/4 - 10/17)[/h3]

[*]CEST (GMT +1) 4:30 - 5:30 PM High Elf Natasha[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]1,000-Mileage auction items will appear periodically during auction hours.
[*]Special items will appear within 10 minutes of the beginning of each auction hour, with bidding open for 10 minutes.
[*]Those who did not win the auction will be refunded 1,000 Mileage when the auction closes.
[*]Claim rewards by clicking Obtain after winning.[/list][/list]


[h3]Zombie Scenario Golden Zombie Kill Event (10/4 - 1/24)[/h3]
Earn rewards by killing Golden Zombies when you play Zombie Scenario during the Season 17.

[list][*]Total Golden Zombies Killed / Obtainable Items
[list][*]1x - You can select 1 from the list: Zombie Scenario Add-On Selection Box x2 / Transcendence Weapon Selection Box / Guaranteed Transcendence Class Box / 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x4 / Random -1 Dehancement Material x10 / 2,000 Mileage

[h3]Twin Light Axe Blueprint Promotion (10/4 - 11/15)[/h3]
You can purchase the Twin Light Axes blueprint during the promotion.

[list][*]Notice

[list][*]The Twin Light Axes blueprint can only be purchased by those who own the Twin Shadow Axes (Permanent) or Twin Light Axes (Permanent).

[h3]Transcendence Weapon Promotion: Cyclops (10/4 - 10/18)[/h3]
Cyclops will now drop from Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders!

[list][*]Cyclops

Holding the weapon or firing basic rounds for a set amount of time will charge special rounds. These special rounds can be spent to use 2 types of <Special Features> in strategic ways.[/list][/list]


[h3]Cyclops Guaranteed Giveaway (10/4 - 10/18)[/h3]
Depending on the number of Transcendence Premium Decoders and Transcendence Decoders used during the event, you could receive a Cyclops (Permanent)!

[list][*]Reward Thresholds
[list][*]Upon Reaching 300 Guaranteed Points[/list][/list]

[*]Transcendence Decoder: 0.45%[/list][/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: September 20th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1cc679d5fc930677c86e1b6befd6df3307704bf3.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*]Back-to-School Name Stickers Event! (09/20 - 10/4)[/b]New semester has begun! Collect Name Stickers to obtain items like the Shy Light Zombie Nameplate and the Transcendence Decoder!

[b][*] Two New Parts Celebration Event (9/20 - 10/4)[/b]To celebrate the release of 'Bomb Boost' and 'Bomb Self-Shield', we've made it so you can get rewards simply by playing the game!

[b][*] CSN:S 9th Anniversary Event (09/20 - 10/4)[/b]It's the 9th Anniversary of CSN:S! Join the event and claim your rewards!

[b][*] CSN:S 9th Anniversary Box Sale (09/20 - 10/4)[/b]Come celebrate the 9th Anniversary of CSN:S with a special promotion![/list]

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Update Information[/h2]

[h3]Zombie New Scenario 8-4 Map[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/3102dbc6c2117beb39fa5d3067ffe652e4c2283a.png[/img]
Survival: Isolation
Survivors of the Aegis Institute received intel that Super Soldiers and Kronos were meeting up and decided they must surprise them with an ambush. Instead, after arriving at the rendezvous point, the team gets surrounded by a horde of enemies.

[h3]New Part Information[/h3]
[list][*]Bomb Boost Part - Grades 1 - 6
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/84c7cd73672726356318bfadd5bc16939e88e38d.png[/img]
[list][*]Type: Part
[*]Content: A part that can be equipped on the bomb to enhance its performance.
[*]In Zombie Mode, a set percentage of the bomb's attack power will be increased, depending on the grade of the part.
[*]In Zombie Scenario, a set percentage of the bomb's attack power will be increased, depending on the grade of the part.
[*]* Bombs that can be equipped with parts have a Parts Emblem before the bomb's name.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Bomb Self-Shield Part - Grades 1 - 6
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/4f60ccad2515319eb7a0db9e89420ec7da1c1630.png[/img]
[list][*]Type: Part
[*]Content: A part that can be equipped on the bomb to enhance its performance.
[*]- In Zombie Mode, reduces the maximum set amount of damage done to self from equipped bombs, depending on the grade of the part (based on 100 Armor).
[*]- In Zombie Scenario, reduces the maximum set amount of damage done to self from equipped bombs depending on the grade of the part (based on 100 Armor).
[*]* Bombs that can be equipped with parts have a Parts Emblem before the bomb's name.[/list][/list]


[h2]Event Information[/h2]

[h3]Back-to-School Name Stickers Event! (09/20- 10/4)[/h3]
New semester has begun! Collect Name Stickers to obtain items like the Shy Light Zombie Nameplate and the Transcendence Decoder!

[list][*]Event Requirements / How to Participate
[list][*](Any mode) Get 1 Name Sticker for every 20 / 40 minutes of play time. (Up to 2 a day)
[*]Score 100 kills and clear the new Zombie Scenario map, Survival: Isolation, on Hard or higher difficulty to earn 3 Name Stickers (up to a maximum of 3 during the event).[/list][/list]
[list][*]Cumulative Rewards:
[list][*]x2: Rare Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x5
[*]x4: Unique Decoder + Grade 3 Parts Reward Box x10
[*]x6: Unique Decoder x2 + 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3
[*]x8: Unique Decoder x5
[*]x10: 10,000 Mileage Coupon + 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*]x12: Event Decoder x4 + Class Decoder
[*]x14: Shy Light Zombie Nameplate (300 Days) + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x4
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/7d26a7712d0c0d51aba7f3d97a24dc371f62b82c.png[/img]
[*]x16: Class Decoder x3 + 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*]x18: 10,000 Mileage Coupon + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*]x20: Event Decoder x6
[*]x22: Class Decoder x6
[*]x24: Transcendence Decoder x7
[*]x26: Season Badge x100[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Pileup reward is limited to once per account.
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (including Studio Mode).
[*]At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]Excludes auto hunt kills regardless of mode.
[*]Playtime missions can be completed in all modes.
[*]All Name Stickers will be removed during maintenance on 10/4.
[*]If you have obtained all Season Badges and cannot earn more, you will receive a Black Market Badge instead.
[*]The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list][/list]


[h3]Two New Parts Celebration Event (09/20- 10/4)[/h3]
To celebrate the release of 'Bomb Boost' and 'Bomb Self-Shield', we've made it so you can get rewards simply by playing the game!
[list][*]Conditions / Rewards
[list][*]Reach 5 minutes of playtime to obtain one of each Grade 3 Part from the total of 18 available.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Rewards are limited to one per account.
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (including Studio Mode).[/list][/list]


[h3]Bonus Disassembly Event (09/20- 10/4)[/h3]
You can participate in the Bonus Disassembly Event by clicking "Bonus Disassembly" at the bottom of the Lobby. During the event, 10 players can select the weapons they want to disassemble, with one lucky player receiving extra mileage. Participants can get 500 mileage for each weapon they disassemble.
[list][*]Details
[list][*]Weekdays and Weekends - 1:00 PM - 5:00 PM CEST
[*]Minimum Participation Mileage: 5,000
[*]Some items will be adjusted based on the weapon's rarity.
[*]Table ranks are in the order of highest value first.
[*]Weapon criteria are determined the day the Bonus Disassembly Event starts. If the weapon's rank changes, its value in the Bonus Disassembly Event will be updated.
[*]New items for disassembly: Gravity Repulsor, M3 Azhi Dahaka, DESERT MG3, DESERT M2, DESERT SPAS-12, DESERT HAMMER, DESERT WA2000, DESERT M95, DESERT Dual Infinity Final, DESERT M60E4[/list][/list]


[h3]CSN:S 9th Anniversary Event (09/20- 10/4)[/h3]
It's the 9th Anniversary of CSN:S! Join the event and claim your rewards!
[list][*]Participation Requirements
[list][*]Log-in: Event Decoder
Play 10/20/30 minutes a day: 1 Point[/list][/list]
[list][*]Point Accumulation Rewards
[list][*]3 Points: Norinco Type 86S
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b05fb3ff9bdcd52a88c59933aec904dcec1fc9ef.png[/img]
[*]9 Points: Rare Decoder x10
[*]15 Points: Unique Decoder x8
[*]18 Points: Unique Premium Decoder x5
[*]21 Points: 10,000 Mileage Coupon x3
[*]27 Points: Transcendence Weapon Pass (3 Days)
[*]30 Points: Class Decoder x10
[*]33 Points: Festival Nameplate (Permanent)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1c74b60734f20dee7d3a2f03dfdbc29d77a49b45.png[/img]
[*]36 points: Transcendence Decoder x10[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Rewards are limited to one per account.
[*]You can earn up to 3 points a day.
[*]Eligible Zombie Modes: No mode restrictions
[*]You can participate in Studio Mode
[*]Player Requirement: 3 or more 
[*]Can participate in Laboratory Mode[/list][/list]


[h3]CSN:S 9th Anniversary Medal Giveaway (09/20 - 09/24)[/h3]
Log in to celebrate the CSN:S 9th Anniversary and claim your medal!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5cbf92a0c94bf60689fd0797db66e527679c66ba.png[/img]
[list][*]Participation Requirements
[list][*]Log in during 9/20 - 9/24 to receive your permanent CSN:S 9th Anniversary Celebration Medal[/list][/list][list][*]Notice
[list][*]Rewards are limited to one per account.[/list][/list]


[h3]Good-Bye Season 16 Double-Up Event (09/20- 10/4)[/h3]
Earn double the amount of Season Badges from daily and weekly missions during the event.


[h2]Shop Update[/h2]

[h3]CSN:S 9th Anniversary Box Sale (09/20 - 10/4)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d8d2bb7a34a5617bf1da66f2561bacee800739aa.png[/img]
Come celebrate the 9th Anniversary of CSN:S with a special promotion!
[list][*]Products On Offer
[list][*]Transcendence Enhanced Weapon
[*]Ignite-10 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e5261478a0290e453c4105e316445dad8ed230ef.png[/img]
[list][*]The latest release of Aegis Institute, the Ignite can swiftly take on multiple enemies.
[*]Ignition Blast: Right-click to detonate immediately, inflicting damage on enemies in front of you and reducing their movement speed for a short time.
[*]Probability: 1% [/list]
[*]Two 9th Anniversary Special Items (Void Avenger / Divine Blaster), Probability of Each: 0.075% [/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Earn 15 mileage just for opening the box!
[*]Unused boxes will be automatically opened with their contents awarded during the 10/4 maintenance.[/list][/list]


[h3]CSN:S 9th Anniversary Box Discount Sale (09/20 - 10/4)[/h3]
9th Anniversary Celebration Boxes will be discounted up to 90%
[list][*]Discounted Content
[list][*]Anniversary Box x10: 90% Discount
[*]Anniversary Box x25: 54% Discount[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Each discounted product can only be purchased once per account.[/list][/list]


[h2]Misc.[/h2]
[olist][*]Fixed an issue in Zombie Scenario: Nexus Space Rift where you could travel across the map in an unexpected way.
[*]Fixed an issue in Zombie Mode where holding the Drakar and then dropping it would remove any mutations obtained by Karma.
[*]Fixed an issue where you would be transported to the waiting room when a creature was destroyed by a Fire Bomb.
[*]Fixed an issue in Zombie Z mode where you could purchase weapons in an unexpected way.
[*]Closed Random Transformation: Truth Uncovered, Random Transformation: End of Madness, and Exciting: Revenge maps.[/olist]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: September 6th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/af70928fc220dce9e6c026faa37c65b6fc553b0b.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*] Last Days of Summer Event (09/06 - 09/20)[/b]Let's say goodbye to the long summer by collecting lots of points and having lots of fun!

[b][*] New Transcendence Weapon Promotion (09/06 - 10/04)[/b]Drakar I and Drakar III will make a special appearance during the event in [Drakar Decoder]

[b][*] Drakar Coin Giveaway (09/06 - 10/04)[/b]Earn mission points during the event and collect Drakar Coins!

[b][*] Guaranteed Class Decoder Rotation Group Giveaway Event (9/6 - Until Next Transcendence Class Promotion)[/b]Select a guaranteed class from the rotation group based on Class Decoder usage during the event![/list]

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Update Information[/h2]

[h3]Zombie Z Update Information[/h3]
[list][*]Fire Bomb Changes
[list][*]Damage has been slightly increased when Fire Bomb ends in Zombie Hero, Zombie Hero (Laboratory), Zombie Z, and Zombie Z (Laboratory) modes.
[*]Fire Bomb's HP has been slightly increased in Zombie Hero, Zombie Hero (Laboratory), Zombie Z, and Zombie Z (Laboratory) modes.
[*]The reduction to Movement Speed while inside the range of Fire Bomb has been slightly decreased in Zombie Hero, Zombie Hero (Laboratory), Zombie Z, and Zombie Z (Laboratory) modes.
[*]You can now obtain points and Karma by destroying the Fire Bomb in Zombie Hero, Zombie Hero (Laboratory), Zombie Z, and Zombie Z (Laboratory) modes.[/list][/list]

[h3]New Zombie Scenario Medal[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/acc36f3e75af8ff75f9cb9c951e31fa904dae303.png[/img]
[list][*]Zombie Scenario 8-4 Nexus Space Rift Medal
[*]Condition: Zombie Scenario - Clear Pursuit: Ep. Nexus Space Rift 100 times[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list][*] Some changes have been made to how the notification window is displayed.
[list][*]Removed permanent displays notifications (permanent weapons and other items will be displayed without the duration)
[*]Unused limited-time items: display the applicable duration (Ex: 1 Day, 3 Days, 6 Days)
[*]Items with an expiration date: display applicable dates (Ex: Expiration - 9/20/2023 at 4:00PM)[/list][/list]


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[h3]Last Days of Summer Event (09/06 - 09/20)[/h3]
Let's say goodbye to the long summer by collecting lots of points and having lots of fun!

[list][*]Participation Requirements / Obtainable Items
[list][*]Reach 30 / 40 minutes of playtime: 6 Points each (up to 12 points a day)
[*]Log-in: 3 Points (up to 3 points a day)
[*]Score 6 Kill Points by kills or assists (bots excluded for both) as a human in Zombie Mode: 1 Point (up to 15 points a day)
[*]Score 6 Kill Points by human infection (bots excluded) as a zombie in Zombie Mode: 2 Points (up to 15 points a day)
[*]Clear a Zombie Scenario mode on Hard or higher after scoring 100 Kill Points: 3 Points[/list][/list]

[list][*]How to Earn Kill Points
[list][*]Zombie Kill as a Human: 3 Points (excluding bots)
[*]Zombie Assist as a Human: 1 Point (excluding bots)
[*]Human Infection as Zombie: 3 Points (excluding bots)
[*]Human Infection Assist as Zombie: No Points[/list][/list]

[list][*]Daily Rewards
[list][*]Obtain 30 points every day to earn an Event Decoder[/list][/list]

[list][*]Total Point Rewards
[list][*]30 Points: Rare Decoder x3
[*]60 Points: Rare Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x5
[*]90 Points: Unique Decoder x3 + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x5
[*]150 Points: Unique Decoder x7 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3
[*]210 Points: Class Decoder x3 + Summer Hunting Zombie Spray (Permanent)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5c9f77df529c598c04d4a968c0687894d3e75ed2.png[/img]
[*]270 Points: Transcendence Decoder x2 + Transcendence Weapon Pass (3 Days)
[*]330 Points: Class Decoder x7
[*]360 points: Transcendence Decoder x5
[*]390 Points: Season Badge x100[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]You can earn up to 30 points a day.
[*]Cumulative rewards are given once per account.
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (excludes Studio Mode).
[*]Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*]Excluded Zombie Scenario Maps: Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*]At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]Excludes auto hunt kills regardless of mode.
[*]Playtime missions can be completed in all modes.
[*]All points will be removed during maintenance on 9/20.
[*]If you have obtained all Season Badges and cannot earn more, you will receive a Black Market Badge instead.
[*]The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list][/list]


[h3]1st Daily Play Event (09/06 - 09/12 23:59:59)[/h3]
Earn rewards during the event with the following missions!

[list][*]Requirements
[list][*]Log in for 3 days during the event and play for 20 minutes each day to earn Event Decoder x3 + 3,000 Mileage Coupon[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Cumulative rewards are given once per account.
[*]Only rooms with 3 or more players count toward these goals.
[*]The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is collected.[/list][/list]


[h3]2nd Daily Play Event (09/13 at 12:00 AM - 09/20 before maintenance)[/h3]

[list][*]Requirements
[list][*]Log in for 3 days during the event and play for 20 minutes each day to earn Event Decoder x3 + 3,000 Mileage Coupon[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Cumulative rewards are given once per account.
[*]Only rooms with 3 or more players count toward these goals.
[*]The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is collected.[/list][/list]


[h3]Login Supplies Event Guide (9/6 - 10/4 11: 59: 59)[/h3]

[list][*]Login Reward
[list][*]Daily Weapons Supply
[*]Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (1 Day) & M3 Black Dragon (1 Day) & Barrett M95 White Tiger (1 Day)
[*]3 types all provided + 2 types out of Rare, Unique, or Transcendence provided according to probabilities + 1 Transcendence Class (1 Day) provided according to probabilities + all contents of Daily Attendance Reward Box provided.
[*]Transcendence Classes (1 Day): Dorothy Dark Knight, Flora Paladin, Transcendence Ji Yoon Choi, Transcendence Yuri, Sonya Lycanthrope, Elizabeth Crimson Hunter, Transcendence Michaela, Transcendence Fernando, Transcendence Blair, and Rose Phoenix
[*]Daily Attendance Reward Box: Damage Display (1 Day), Killer Display (1 Day), Penalty and Loss Invalidation x1, Rare Decoder x3
[*]All weapons and classes from the Daily Supply are bound and cannot be used for Auction/Disassembly/Family Storage (Extension X).[/list][/list]

[list][*]Cumulative Rewards
[list][*]5 Days: X-TRACKER (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]10 Days: Spell Lance Scarlet Rose (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]15 Days: Trinity Grenade (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]20 Days: Lightning Fury (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]25 Days: Heaven Splitter (5 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]Cumulative Attendance Reward Box contents: C4 Countdown Room Host (5 Days), Shorten Respawn Time (5 Days) Lucky Gunslinger (5 Days), Daily Mission Difficulty Change x15, Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon (7 Days)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Attendance rewards will be provided directly as rewards instead of the Daily/Cumulative Attendance Reward Box items.
[*]Rewards can be claimed immediately after logging in and are available until midnight every day.[/list][/list]


[h2]Shop Update[/h2]

[h3]New Transcendence Weapon Promotion (09/06 - 10/04)[/h3]
Drakar I and Drakar III will make a special appearance during the event in [Drakar Decoder]

[list][*]Decoder
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/429d5f9baf4ee11675344f0374f4bf57b692977c.png[/img]
[list][*]Drakar Decoder
[*]You can exchange the Transcendence Decoders you own with Drakar Decoders during the event via [Crafting] - [Disassemble].[/list][/list]

[list][*]Drakar I
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2000aa988df07008c128ae5218113868fe17fb92.png[/img]
[list][*]Type: Primary Weapon (Unique)
[*]Description: A Viking-inspired tactical rifle that fires 60 rounds of 5.56mm bullets. Charge the gauge by hitting enemies and use it to increase the firearm's stage. Reloading will grant special ammo, and the firearm's stage will increase or decrease depending on the gauge amount. Use the special ammo to inflict damage to enemies in rage for a short time.
[*]Drop Rate: 2.46%[/list][/list]

[list][*]Drakar III
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5b07b35991b10f8896c9e2fedc0e172805ceeafc.png[/img]
[list][*]Type: Primary Weapon (Unique)
[*]Description: A Viking-inspired tactical rifle that fires 60 rounds of 5.56mm bullets, with enhanced performance from its predecessor, the Drakar II. Charge the gauge by hitting enemies. Reloading while the gauge is at max will increase the firearm's stage, however, if the gauge is not full, it will decrease instead. The weapon's performance changes every three stages, and reloading gives you special ammo that inflicts damage to enemies in range for a short time.
[*]Drop Rate: 0.45%[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]All unused Drakar Decoders will be removed during maintenance on 10/4.
[*]85 mileage will be given for each Drakar Decoder removed.
[*]Drakar Decoders will keep their contents until the 10/4 maintenance.
[*]You can exchange the Transcendence Decoders you own with Drakar Decoders during the event via [Crafting] - [Disassemble].[/list][/list]


[h3]New Transcendence Weapon Guaranteed Giveaway (09/06 - 10/04)[/h3]
Use [Drakar Decoders] during the event to receive [Drakar Coins], which, depending on the amount, guarantees either Drakar I or Drakar III!

[list][*]Conditions
[list][*]Collect Drakar Coins x50 to receive Drakar I (Permanent) (once per account)
[*]Each time you collect Drakar Coins x300 (300/600/900/etc.), you will receive Drakar III (Permanent)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]For every Drakar Decoder you use, you'll receive a Drakar Coin.
[*]All Drakar Coins will be removed during maintenance on 10/04.
[*]You can exchange any Transcendence Decoders you own with Drakar Decoders during the event via [Crafting] - [Disassemble].[/list][/list]


[h3]Drakar Coin Giveaway (09/06 - 10/04)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5d7518f17c85116bf949c592f4dcda9352a1b433.png[/img]
Earn mission points during the event and collect Drakar Coins!

[list][*]Conditions
[list][*]Reach 40 / 60 minutes of playtime: 15 Mission Points each (once each per account)
[*]Score 6 Kill Points by kills or assists (bots excluded for both) as a human in Zombie Mode: 1 Mission Point (up to 20 Mission Points per account)
[*]Score 6 Kill Points by human infection (bots excluded) as a zombie in Zombie Mode: 2 Mission Points (up to 20 Mission Points per account)
[*]Clear a Zombie Scenario mode on Hard or higher after scoring 100 Kill Points: 3 Mission Points (up to 24 Mission Points per account)[/list][/list]

[list][*]How to Earn Kill Points
[list][*]Zombie Kill as a Human: 3 Points (excluding bots)
[*]Zombie Assist as a Human: 1 Point (excluding bots)
[*]Human Infection as Zombie: 3 Points
[*]Human Infection Assist as Zombie: 0 Points[/list][/list]

[list][*]Cumulative Rewards
[list][*]Accumulate 50 Mission Points to earn 45 Drakar Coins[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Total Mission Points available during the event period: 50 Points
[*]Playtime missions can be completed in all modes.
[*]Cumulative rewards are given once per account.
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (excludes Studio Mode).
[*]Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*]Excluded Zombie Scenario Maps: Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*]At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]Excludes auto hunt kills regardless of mode.
[*]Playtime missions can be completed in all modes.
[*]All Drakar Coins and Mission Points will be removed during maintenance on 10/4.[/list][/list]


[h3]Drakar Upgrade Event (09/06 - 10/04)[/h3]
Based on the number of Drakar I's collected during the event, they will be upgraded to Drakar II or Drakar III (Permanent).

[list][*]Conditions
[list][*]Collect Drakar I (Permanent) x3 to obtain Drakar II (Permanent)
[*]Collect Drakar I (Permanent) x7 to obtain Drakar III (Permanent)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Drakar II
[list][*]Type: Primary Weapon (Unique-Part)
[*]Description: A Viking-inspired tactical rifle that fires 50 rounds of 5.56mm bullets, with enhanced performance from its predecessor, the Drakar I. Charge the gauge by hitting enemies. Reloading while the gauge is at max will increase the firearm's stage, however, if the gauge is not full, it will decrease instead. The weapon's performance changes every two stages, and reloading gives you special ammo that inflicts damage to enemies in range for a short time.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Collection rewards for each stage are given only once per account.
[*]Drakar I is not kept when upgrading it to the Drakar II or III.
[*]You can potentially obtain the Drakar I (Permanent) in [Drakar Decoders] or by accumulating [Drakar Coin] x50 for the first time (up to once per account).[/list][/list]


[h3]Drakar Decoder Exchange Giveaway (09/06 - 10/04)[/h3]
Each Transcendence Decoder will be exchanged with 1 [Drakar Decoder] during the event.
[list][*]How to Exchange: Disassemble the Transcendence Decoder in the [Crafting] - [Disassemble] tab, to receive 1 [Drakar Decoder] for each Transcendence Decoder.
[*]Transcendence Decoders cannot be disassembled after the event.[/list]


[h3]Class Rotation Group Appearance Event (9/6 - Until Next Transcendence Class Promotion)[/h3]
The classes below will be part of the new Rotation Group for the Class Decoder during the event.

[list][*]Appearing Classes
[list][*]Ismael / Ethan / Roy / Romy[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]The Rotation Group will no longer be available via the decoder once the event ends.
[*]The contents of the Rotation Group may change at any time.
[*]The Rotation Group is added to Class Decoders only during the event.
[*]Upon winning with a rotating class, you will automatically obtain their exclusive costume.
[*]Upon winning as Roy, you will automatically obtain Roy's Keepsake Hat (Permanent).
[*]Upon winning as Romy, you will automatically obtain Romy's Survival Pack (Permanent).
[*]Upon winning as Ismael, you will automatically obtain the Black Rose Shuriken (Permanent).
[*]Upon winning as Ethan, you will automatically obtain the Inquisitor's Hourglass (Permanent)[/list][/list]


[h3]Guaranteed Class Decoder Rotation Group Giveaway Event (9/6 - Until Next Transcendence Class Promotion)[/h3]
Select a guaranteed class from the rotation group based on Class Decoder usage during the event!

[list][*]Conditions and Rewards
[list][*]Each time you reach 150 points, you can choose 1 of the following classes:
[*]Roy
[*]Romy
[*]Ismael
[*]Ethan[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]You'll earn 1 Guaranteed Point each time you use a Class Decoder.
[*]Selecting the class in a guaranteed giveaway event will provide the exclusive costume of the class.[/list][/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: August 23rd
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/74548df00c93cd27a561a4693399ef5f9a0ba54a.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*] Collect Points and Beat the Heat! Event (8/23 - 9/6)[/b]Beat the heat by collecting Play Points and earn lots of great rewards!

[b][*] Chilseok Puzzle Collection Event (8/23 - 9/6)[/b]It's the day when the Cowherd and the Weaver Girl finally meet! Celebrate Chilseok by collecting puzzles to let the Cowherd and Weaver Girl cross the Magpie Bridge!

[b][*] Zombie Scenario New Map 8-4 Event (8/23 - 9/6)[/b]Experience the new Zombie Scenario and earn rewards during the event!

[b][*] DESERT Weapon Giveaway II (8/23 - 9/20)[/b]Play for 30 minutes each day during the event and earn the new DESERT weapons and other rewards!

[b][*] End of Summer Event (8/23 - 9/6)[/b]Play during the event and earn rewards![/list]

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Update Information[/h2]

[h3]Zombie New Scenario 8-4 Map[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f932a4cc64d730dedbd4d26b325ec16815400249.png[/img]
[list][*]Pursuit: Nexus Space Rift
[list][*]David Black and his company successfully get in contact with Yuri, and they discuss meeting at the rendezvous point. She tells them about Kronos' secret laboratory and suggests that if they help her destroy it, she will consider joining them. David Black requests Alin and Dominique help her destroy the lab and provides the coordinates. When Alin and Dominique arrive at the rendezvous point, Yuri is nowhere to be found. Instead, they find a village filled with strange rifts.
[*]You can find detailed information in the [Zombie Scenario 8-4 Preview].[/list][/list]


[h3]New Zombie Scenario Medal[/h3]
[list][*]Season 8 Veteran Medal
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/cf67a1c59d92197444c7fecad12efabdee905cb4.png[/img]
[list][*]Condition: Clear all Zombie Scenarios for Season 8 (An Approaching Threat / Planned Tragedy / Abandoned Hound / Nexus Space Rift)[/list][/list]


[h2]Improvements[/h2]

[h3]Improved the <Notification> window to display and manage all rewards previously presented individually after logging in.[/h3]

[h3]<Reward History> tab has been added to the <Notification> window.[/h3]
[list][*]This records a history of various rewards and automatically removes them after a certain amount of time.
[*] (Rewards will be saved in your inventory like normal. Only the record of rewards will be stored and later removed.)
[*]New reward records will appear in the menu at the top of the screen.[/list]


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[h3]Collect Points and Beat the Heat! Event (8/23 - 9/6)[/h3]
Beat the heat by collecting Play Points and earn lots of great rewards!

[list][*]Event Requirements / Obtainable Items
[list][*]Earn 1 point by reaching 20 minutes of playtime (up to 3 points per day).
[*]Earn 1 point for every 8 Kill Points by kills or assists as a human, or infections as a zombie in Zombie Mode (up to 7 per day).
[*]Earn 1 point each time you clear 1 session by reaching 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard difficulty or higher (up to 7 points per day).
[*]Playtime missions can be completed in all modes.[/list][/list]

[list][*]How to Earn Kill Points
[list][*]Zombie Kill as a Human: 3 Points (excluding bots)
[*]Zombie Assist as a Human: 1 Point (excluding bots)
[*]Human Infection as Zombie: 3 Points (excluding bots)
[*]Human Infection Assist as Zombie: 0 Points[/list][/list]

[list][*]Rewards By Points
[list][*]10 Points: Rare Decoder x3 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x3
[*]20 Points: Rare Decoder x5 + 1000 Mileage Coupon
[*]30 Points: Unique Decoder x4
[*]50 Points: Unique Decoder x6 + Summer Night Camping Nameplate (30 Days)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/4e5281777a67e74775fec1659fe463cdfb736073.png[/img]
[*]70 Points: Event Decoder x7 + 10,000 Mileage Coupon
[*]100 Points: Event Decoder x7 
[*]110 Points: Class Decoder x7
[*]120 Points: Transcendence Decoder x7
[*]130 Points: Season Badge x100[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]You can obtain up to 10 points a day.
[*]Cumulative rewards are given once per account.
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (excluding Studio Mode).
[*]Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*]Excluded Zombie Scenario Maps: Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*]A minimum playtime of 5 minutes is required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]Excludes auto hunt kills regardless of mode.
[*]All points will be removed during maintenance on 09/06.
[*]If you have obtained all Season Badges and cannot earn more, you will receive a Black Market Badge instead.
[*]The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list][/list]


[h3]Chilseok Puzzle Collection Event (8/23 - 9/6)[/h3]
It's the day when the Cowherd and the Weaver Girl finally meet! Celebrate Chilseok by collecting puzzles to let the Cowherd and Weaver Girl cross the Magpie Bridge!

[list][*]How to Collect Magpie Bridge Puzzles / Obtainable Items
[list][*]Earn 300 Mileage by reaching 7 minutes of playtime (up to 7 times per day)
[*]Earn 1 Magpie Bridge Point by reaching 49 minutes of playtime in a single day (once a day)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ab7ff38425b4a5d3cac95de8bf352b8318aa9176.png[/img]
[*]Earn a Magpie Bridge Puzzle by accumulating 7 Magpie Bridge Points (once per person)[/list][/list]

[list][*]How to Collect Weaver Girl Puzzles / Obtainable Items
[list][*]Score 100 kills and clear Zombie Scenario on hard or higher difficulty: Event Decoder + 1 Weaver Girl Point (once a day / up to 5x during the event)
[*]Earn a Weaver Girl Puzzle by accumulating 5 Weaver Girl Points (once per person)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/02d73db004482b94250074c0139f5b24ddb12328.png[/img]
[/list][/list]

[list][*]How to Collect Cowherd Puzzles / Obtainable Items
[list][*]Perform a Zombie Kill, Assist, or Human Infection in Zombie Mode 7 times: Event Decoder + 1 Cowherd Point (once a day / up to 5x during the event)
[*]Earn a Cowherd Puzzle by accumulating 5 Cowherd Points (once per person)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1512f001cfdbedb0dc1d8a9332c58639c55ad6f4.png[/img]
[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Different puzzles will be available at different times. (The Cowherd Puzzle Collection Event will be available starting on 8/28)
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (excluding Studio Mode).
[*]Eligible Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*]Excluded Zombie Scenario Maps: Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*]A minimum playtime of 5 minutes is required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]Excludes auto hunt kills regardless of mode.

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: August 9th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c24188cf84f8fc0328b7e258460316451ebdbd1b.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*] Random Weapon Zombie Hero Event (8/9– 8/23)[/b]The perfect opportunity to play Random Weapon Zombie Hero!

[b][*] Ad Balloon Popping Event (8/9 - 9/6)[/b]Earn rewards based on how many ad balloons you pop during the event. (The number of times you attack a popped balloon is irrelevant; you receive credit for attacking it at least once.)

[b][*] Heat Wave Targets and Water Balloon Grenade Giveaway (8/9 - 8/23)[/b]Score zombie kills with the Water Balloon Grenade in Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Evolution to receive rewards

[b][*] August Holiday event (8/9 - 8/23)[/b]Log in during the event to receive rewards based on how many days you've logged in

[b][*] Transcendence Class Promotion (8/9 - 9/6)[/b]Two Transcendence Classes, Immortal Eric and Smile Mary, are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders.

[b][*] Transcendence Weapon Promotion: Death Eater (8/9 - 9/6)[/b]Death Eater will now drop from Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders![/list]

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Update Information[/h2]
[h3]Part Open Weapon Information[/h3]
[list][*]Part Weapon Expansion
[list][*]Star Chaser SR[/list][/list]


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[h3]Random Weapon Zombie Hero Event (8/9– 8/23)[/h3]
The perfect opportunity to play Random Weapon Zombie Hero!

[list][*]Featured Maps
[list][*]Italy/Assault/Dust/Abyss 2[/list][/list]

[list][*]Weapon Update
[list][*]Cousteau, Doom Blaster, Tyrant's Mace, Laser Storm, Avalanche TECH, Crowbar Maverick TECH, Dart Pistol TECH, AUG Guardians, Queen's SL8, Queen's Special Duck Foot Gun, Queen's Tomahawk, Ignite-7, Demolition Hammer, Gravity Repulsor, and M3 Azhi Dahaka[/list][/list]


[h3]Ad Balloon Popping Event (8/9 - 9/6)[/h3]
Earn rewards based on how many ad balloons you pop during the event. (The number of times you attack a popped balloon is irrelevant; you receive credit for attacking it at least once.)

[list][*]Popped Balloons / Rewards
[list][*]5: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x10 + Season Badge x20
[*]10: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5 + Season Badge x30
[*]15: Unique Decoder x3+ 10,000 Mileage
[*]25: Event Decoder x3 + Season Badge x50
[*]35: Class Decoder x5 + 10,000 Mileage
[*]50: Transcendence Decoder x5 + Season Badge x100[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Each account can participate in the mission up to 5 times per day.
[*]Each account can only receive rewards once.
[*]Eligible Maps: Dust 2, Militia, Estate, Mouse Hole, Italy, Assault
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with 3 or more players (includes Laboratory Mode, excludes Studio Mode).

[h3]Ad Balloon Medal Event (8/9 - 9/6)[/h3]

[list][*]Receive [Honor] Killer B Medal + Transcendence Decoder x10 for scoring 300 Kills of the Ad Balloon (depending on the last hit).[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Players who already possess the [Honor] Killer B medal cannot receive another one, but they will still receive the Transcendence Decoder reward.
[*]Only the player that delivers the final hit that pops the balloon will add it to their total kill count (for the purpose of this achievement).[/list][/list]


[h3]Heat Wave Targets and Water Balloon Grenade Giveaway (8/9 - 8/23/2023)[/h3]
Score zombie kills with the Water Balloon Grenade in Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Evolution to receive rewards
Water Balloon Grenade: 30% Damage + Knockback Probability

[list][*]Kills / Rewards
[list][*]1 Kill: 500 Mileage + Rare Decoder x3
[*]3 Kills: Zombie Damage Meter (7 Days) + Rare Decoder x5 + Unique Decoder x1
[*]5 Kills: Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x5 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*]6 Kills: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x5 + Unique Decoder x3
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ef4d2fcc8e0fd5e4ff6080d584f5a67bc69dae2f.png[/img]
[*]7 Kills: Point Transcendence Decoder x10 + Point Class Decoder x10 + Event Decoder x3 + Great Vacation Nameplate (300 Days)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Each account can participate in the mission up to 5 times per day.

[*]Excludes auto hunt kills regardless of mode.
[*]The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list][/list]


[h3]August Holiday event (8/9 - 8/23[/h3]
Log in during the event to receive rewards based on how many days you've logged in:

[list][*]Rewards

[*]Reach 3 days of total login: Unique Decoder x5
[*]Reach 6 days of total login: Class Decoder x3
[*]Reach 7 days of total login: Event Decoder x5
[*]Reach 9 days of total login: Event Decoder x10
[*]Reach 10 days of total login: Transcendence Decoder x3
[*]Reach 11 days of total login: Class Decoder x5
[*]Reach 12 days of total login: Transcendence Decoder x5[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Each account can only receive rewards once.
[*]You will receive your rewards each time you log in.[/list][/list]


[h2]Shop Update[/h2]

[h3]Transcendence Class Promotion (8/9 - 9/6)[/h3]
Two Transcendence Classes, Immortal Eric and Smile Mary, are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders.

[list][*]Immortal Eric
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2be6331296434b42ea9734483d7dee4da00e8535.png[/img]
[list][*]Background story: After a near-death experience during a zombie attack, his wounds healed up and he returned with an incredible new power. As his superhuman self-recovery rate and physical strength granted him with the resources to compete with the zombies, he willingly fought the undead on the front lines to help others. Fitting his nickname, Immortal, he returns alive every time there is a rumor that he had died. It is known that he is not part of any organizations or groups, but that he does work with Smile Mary.
[*]Paired Weapon: Death Eater
[*]Paired Effect: Special Attack ammo recharge rate increase
[list][*]Hyperbeam: Fire a beam that deals damage to enemies ahead of you. Knocks zombies back in Zombie modes.[/list]
[*]Area duration skill
[list][*](Zombie Scenario) Passive: Passively restores HP and increases Defense
[*](Zombie Scenario) Active: Maximizes the HP recovery and Defense increase effects on self and nearby allies[/list]
[*]Connection buff skill
[list][*](Zombie Scenario) Playing with Smile Mary grants a chance to not take damage upon hit[/list]
[*]Add-On Feature
[list][*](Zombie Scenario) <Ironclad> Add-On effect is applied by default, and stacking it will increase only the 10% Decreased Damage effect[/list][/list][/list]


[list][*]Smile Mary
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/edcdb8f9cb80746aaf8bd54550a8382e0bc69667.png[/img]
[list][*]Background story: As the zombie invasion brought dangers to the everyday lives of the people, some of the general public began to awaken their special abilities. Mary is one of those, having the ability to control the aggression of zombies through psychokinesis, amplify the powers of allies, and control minds. Nobody approaches her as it is said that she could even read the minds of others, but there is a rumor that she sticks with Immortal Eric, another psychic.
[*]Paired Weapon: Death Eater
[*]Paired Effect: Special Attack max ammo increase
[list][*]Hyperbeam: Fire a beam that deals damage to enemies ahead of you. Knocks zombies back in Zombie modes.[/list]
[*]Area duration skill
[list][*]Passive: (Zombie Scenario) When you and your nearby allies are hit, this grants a chance to not take damage and instead increase damage for you and allies nearby
[*]Active: (Zombie Scenario) Maximizes the effects that grant a chance to not take damage and instead increase damage for you and allies nearby upon hit[/list]
[*]Connection buff skill
[list][*](Zombie Scenario) Playing with Immortal Eric grants a chance to not take damage upon hit[/list]
[*]Add-On Feature
[list][*](Zombie Scenario) <Deft Movement> Add-on effect is applied by default, and using the identical Add-on will stack.[/list][/list][/list]


[h3]New Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (8/9 - 9/6)[/h3]
Get guaranteed 2 Transcendence Classes (Immortal Eric and Smile Mary) based on how many Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders are used during the event!

[list][*]Conditions and Rewards
[list][*]Upon reaching 150 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use.
[*]Upon reaching 300 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use.
[*]Select one from Immortal Eric + Eric's Hero Helmet or Smile Mary + Mary's Cube[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]1 Guaranteed Point given each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
[*]3 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Class Premium Decoder.
[*]Selecting Immortal Eric will automatically provide Eric's Hero Helmet (Permanent).
[*]Selecting Smile Mary will automatically provide Mary's Cube (Permanent).
[*]Guaranteed Giveaway rewards can only be received once per account.[/list][/list]


[h3]Transcendence Weapon Promotion: Death Eater (8/9 - 9/6)[/h3]
Death Eater will now drop from Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders!

[list][*]Death Eater Drop Rate
[list][*]Transcendence Premium Decoder: 3%
[*]Transcendence Decoder: 0.45%[/list][/list]

[list][*]Death Eater
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/638ee27eb3869435758bd358c74c2de383b17d0c.png[/img]
[list][*]Description: A shotgun developed with alien technology that can hit nearby targets simultaneously with its basic attacks. Its special attack, Hyper Beam, deals damage to enemies in front of the wielder.[/list][/list]


[h3]Death Eater Guaranteed Giveaway (8/9 - 9/6)[/h3]
Depending on the number of Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders used, you may be guaranteed to receive the Death Eater permanently!

[list][*]Reward Thresholds
[list][*]Upon Reaching 300 Guaranteed Points[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]6 Guaranteed Points each time you use 1 Transcendence Premium Decoder.
[*]1 Guaranteed Point every time you use 1 Class Decoder.[/list][/list]

[h3]Resonance Energy Collection Event (7/26 - 9/6)[/h3]
Gather Resonance Energy from Epic Decoders and complete missions to earn more items!

[list][*]How to Obtain Resonance Energy
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/697699813ed95d5bda6d32976fcd11b768c83ac2.png[/img]
[list][*]Score 6 Kill Points with Kills, Assists, or Human Infections (excluding bots) in Zombie mode: Resonance Energy x1 (up to 20 per day)
[*]Clear Zombie Scenario mode on Hard or higher after scoring 100 Kill Points: Resonance Energy x3 (up to 25 per day)
[*]Reach 60 minutes of playtime in any mode: Resonance Energy x15 (up to 15 per day)
[*]You have a chance to obtain 3 – 100 Resonance Energy when using a Resonance Energy Box.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]How to Get Zombie Mode Kill Points: Zombie Kill as a Human: 3 Points (excluding bots) / Zombie Kill Assist as a Human: 1 Point/ Human Infection as Zombie: 3 Points (Excluding bots)/ Human Infection Assist as Zombie: 0 Points
[*]You can only obtain up to 30 Resonance Energy per day per account (excludes Resonance Energy obtained from Epic Decoders).
[*]The Resonance Energy Shop has a wide and exciting selection of items available for purchase with Resonance Energy. Resonance Energy will be deducted upon a purchase, but don't forget that you'll get bonus fragments with each item!
[*]Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*]Excludes Zombie Scenario: Survival: Double Gate / Survival: Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*]At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (excludes Studio Mode).[/list][/list]

[h3]Mileage Auction Event (8/2 - 8/15)[/h3]
You can access the auction via the 'Mileage Auction' button on the bottom of the lobby during the event.

[list][*]Permanent Auction Items Added: NEGEV NG7 Ajax and Eternity Laser Fist[/list]

[list][*]Auction Feature / Content

[*]Number of Auction Listings: 2 (Increases based on VIP rank)
[*]Market Price of Items: When listing an item, you can check the current Auction House market price (Lowest bid and direct purchase prices).

[list][*]Notice

[*]Daily Attendance Reward Box: Damage Display (1 Day), Killer Display (1 Day), Penalty and Loss Invalidation x1, Rare Decoder x3
[*]All weapons and classes from the Daily Supply are bound and cannot be used for Auction/Disassembly/Family Storage (Extension X).[/list][/list]

[list][*]Cumulative Rewards

[*]10 Days: Negev NG7 Ajax (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]15 Days: Spell Lance Scarlet Rose (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: July 12th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/48ff6c0adc8c9a100c0b0c1b19f0c2ee346f51cb.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*]Daily Play Event (7/12 - 8/9)[/b]Log-in now to collect event pieces and find out how powerful the new Demolition Hammer is for yourself!

[b][*]Demolition Core Collection Event (7/12 - 8/9)[/b]Participate in special missions to collect Demolition Cores.

[b][*]Super Soldier Landing Event (7/12 - 7/26)[/b]Check out the Expert system and the SVP in Super Soldier Mode today!

[b][*]Al-Hijra Holiday Event (7/12 - 7/26)[/b]Complete the mission during the event to earn rewards.

[b][*]Bonus Disassembly Event (7/12 – 7/26)[/b]You can participate in the Bonus Disassembly Event by clicking "Bonus Disassembly" at the bottom of the Lobby. During the event, 10 players can select the weapons they want to disassemble, with one lucky player receiving extra mileage. Participants can get 500 mileage for each weapon they disassemble.[/list]

Check out the following sections for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[u][h2]New contents[/h2][/u]

[h3]Super Soldier Mode Update Information[/h3]
 Experience superior combat like never before!
 For more information, please refer to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/3684556169318885907][Super Soldier Mode Preview][/url].

[list][*]Super Soldier Mode Guide
[list][*]A PVP mode based on Team Deathmatch where humans compete against each other.
[*]Super Soldier players have powerful specs such as High HP and DEF, plus a double jump! Enhanced physical abilities and addition of skills make them formidable in any battle.
[*]Play strategically with the 4 experts: Fighter, Defender, Brawler, and Sniper.
[*]Each expert has specific skills.
[*]You can set hotkeys for each Expert through the Option / Skill Bar Settings.
[*]Collecting the S.V.P. Supply Box during the game will significantly enhance your Attack Power and Movement Speed.
[*]Player specs will be changed based on the Weapon Restriction Options.[/list][/list]


[h3]Zombie Hero and Zombie Z Update Information[/h3]

[list][*]Fire Bomb Options (Zombie Z, Zombie Z Laboratory, Zombie Hero, and Zombie Hero Laboratory)
[list][*]You can now turn on/off the use of Fire Bombs in Room Settings.
[*]Room Settings > Advanced Options
[*] (Fire Bomb will be 'on' when Zombie Restriction > Normal Zombies Only is selected)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Option added to restrict the amount of Zombie Z Mutations (Zombie Z and Zombie Z Laboratory)
[list][*]An option that limits the number of Mutations obtained in Zombie Z.
[*]Select 20, 25, 30, 35, or 40 in the drop-down menu in Room Settings.
[*]Selecting 20 will allow you to acquire a maximum of 20 Mutations. You cannot collect any more after reaching 20.
[*] (This amount does not include mutations increased by Class, etc.)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Added option for Mutation Restriction (Zombie Z and Zombie Z Laboratory)
[list][*]This is an option that removes up to 4 selected Mutations in Zombie Z.
[*]You cannot remove Mutations that are automatically provided at certain levels.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Damage from the end of Fire Bomb ending has been adjusted (Zombie Z, Zombie Z Laboratory, Zombie Hero, and Zombie Hero Laboratory)
[list][*]Damage from the end of Fire Bomb has been adjusted.[/list][/list]

[list][*]The projectile angle of Fire Bomb has been adjusted (Zombie Hero)
[list][*]The projectile angle of Fire Bomb has been adjusted.[/list][/list]


[h3]New Zombie Scenario Medals[/h3]
[list][*]Two New Zombie Scenario Medals have been added.
[list][*]Period: 7/12 after maintenance - Permanent[/list][/list]

[list][*]Grim Reaper
[list][*]Private Medal <Grim Reaper> has been added.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Treasure Trove
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5df40abd2c1e1f266389ee7c592474e0117808f4.png[/img]
[list][*]Condition: Acquire 1 million points in Zombie Scenario drop box to obtain medals.[/list][/list]


[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list][*]Added a feature that asks for changes upon receiving a new Nameplate.
[*]Added Weapon/Enhancement/Part/Paint information to <Mission Chain>.
[*]Added a feature that displays what restrictions are in place by hovering your cursor over the <Restrictions> in the lobby.[/list]


[u][h2]New Events[/h2][/u]

[h3]Daily Play Event (7/12 - 8/9)[/h3]
Log-in now to collect event pieces and find out how powerful the new Demolition Hammer is for yourself!

[list][*]How to Participate
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/255b5cd8754c928cee94d0f11c30f38a8c4bb9dc.png[/img]
[list][*]Reach 30 minutes of play to obtain a Demolition Core (up to a maximum of 60 during the event)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Cumulative Login Reward
[list][*]Day 1: Demolition Core, Point Transcendence/Class Decoder (x1 each), and 500 Mileage Coupon
[*]Day 2: Demolition Core, Point Transcendence/Class Decoder (x1 each), and 500 Mileage Coupon
[*]Day 3: Demolition Core x2, Point Transcendence/Class Decoder (x2 each), and 500 Mileage Coupon x2
[*]Day 4: Demolition Core x2, Point Transcendence/Class Decoder (x2 each), and 500 Mileage Coupon x2
[*]Day 5: Demolition Core x3, Point Transcendence/Class Decoder (x3 each), and 500 Mileage Coupon x3
[*]Day 6: Demolition Core x3, Point Transcendence/Class Decoder (x3 each), and 500 Mileage Coupon x3
[*]Day 7: Demolition Core x6, Point Transcendence/Class Decoder (x4 each), and 500 Mileage Coupon x4
[*]Day 8: Demolition Core x6, Point Transcendence/Class Decoder (x4 each), and 500 Mileage Coupon x4
[*]Day 9: Demolition Core x8, Point Transcendence/Class Decoder (x5 each), and 500 Mileage Coupon x4
[*]Day 10: Demolition Core x8, Point Transcendence/Class Decoder (x5 each), and 500 Mileage Coupon x5
[*]Day 11: Demolition Core x10, Point Transcendence/Class Decoder (x6 each), and 500 Mileage Coupon x6
[*]Day 12: Demolition Core x10, Point Transcendence/Class Decoder (x6 each), and 500 Mileage Coupon x6[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Rewards for cumulative log-in days are limited to once per account.
[*]Demolition Cores stack, and you can collect up to a maximum of 300. (Overages don't accumulate)
[*]All remaining Demolition Cores will be removed during maintenance on 8/9.[/list][/list]


[h3]Demolition Core Collection Event (7/12 - 8/9)[/h3]
Participate in special missions to collect Demolition Cores.

[list][*]How to Participate
[list][*]Earn 4 Demolition Cores by playing 10 minutes in Super Soldier Mode (up to 4 per day).
[*]Earn 1 Demolition Core for every 8 Kill Points by kills or assists as a human, or infections as a zombie in Zombie Mode (up to 16 per day).
[*]Earn 2 Demolition Cores for every 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard difficulty or higher (up to 16 per day).
[*]* You can acquire up to 20 Demolition Cores per day through special mission rewards.[/list][/list]

[list][*]How to Earn Kill Points
[list][*]Zombie Kill as a Human: 3 Points (excluding bots)
[*]Zombie Assist as a Human: 1 Point (excluding bots)
[*]Human Infection as Zombie: 3 Points
[*]Human Infection Assist as Zombie: 0 Points[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Cumulative rewards are given once per account.
[*]Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Evolution / Zombie Z
[*]Excludes Zombie Scenario: Survival: Double Gate / Survival: Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*]At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]Participation in Special Missions will only count in rooms with 3 or more players (includes Laboratory Mode, excludes Studio Mode).
[*]Excludes auto hunt kills regardless of mode.
[*]Demolition Cores stack, and you can collect up to a maximum of 300. (Overages don't accumulate)
[*]All remaining Demolition Cores will be removed during maintenance on 8/9.[/list][/list]


[h3]Collect the Cores! Demolition Hammer Collection Event (7/12 - 8/9)[/h3]
Collect 300 Demolition Cores during the event to obtain the new weapon, the Demolition Hammer!

[list][*]Reward Conditions
[list][*]First Login: Demolition Hammer (1 Day)
[*]10 Cores: Demolition Hammer (15 Days) + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x5
[*]50 Cores: Rare Decoder x10 + Zombie Damage Meter (5 Days)
[*]100 Cores: Unique Decoder x10 + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x5
[*]150 Cores: Event Decoder x10 + 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*]200 Cores: Class Decoder x10 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*]250 Cores: Transcendence Decoder x10 + 200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*]300 Cores: Demolition Hammer (Permanent)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Demolition Hammer
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0b19d9160ec733804c2d0aa532d83fa7e34152b6.png[/img]
[list][*]A melee weapon created using technology from the Aegis Institute. It is a heavy two-handed hammer, that is massive and imposing when held. Charging its gauge unleashes a powerful downward strike attack, and a follow up with its steel handle.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Cumulative rewards are given only once per account.
[*]Demolition Cores stack, and you can collect up to a maximum of 300. (Overages don't accumulate and you cannot collect any more if you've already acquired the Demolition Hammer)
[*]All remaining Demolition Cores will be removed during maintenance on 8/9.
[*]The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list][/list]


[h3]Super Soldier Landing Event (7/12 - 7/26)[/h3]
Check out the Expert system and the SVP in Super Soldier Mode today!

[list][*]Conditions
[list][*]Use an Expert Exclusive Skill 60 times in Super Soldier Mode to earn a Class Decoder
[*]Score 20 or more kills while SVP is active in Super Soldier Mode to earn a Transcendence Decoder.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]You can participate a maximum of once per account.
[*]Only rooms with 3 or more players count toward these goals.[/list][/list]


[h3]Super Soldier Mode Weapon Support Event (7/12 - 7/26)[/h3]
Use support weapons in the new Super Soldier Mode today!

[list][*]Conditions
[list][*]Write and enter 'True Super Soldier' in the chat window to obtain a Transcendence Temporary Weapon Box.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Temporary Transcendence Weapon Box Contents (Select 1)
[list][*]Spell Lance Scarlet Rose (1 Day)
[*]Psychic Harmonium (1 Day)
[*]Lightning Fury (1 Day)
[*]Barrett M95 White Tiger (1 Day)
[*]Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (1 Day)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Rewards can only be obtained once a day per account.
[*]The Temporary Transcendence Weapon Box will be removed during maintenance on 7/26.[/list][/list]


[h3]Login Supplies Event Guide (07/12 - 07/25 11: 59)[/h3]
[list][*]Login Reward
[list][*]Daily Weapons Supply
[*]Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (1 Day) & M3 Black Dragon (1 Day) & Barrett M95 White Tiger (1 Day)
[*]3 types all provided + 2 types out of Rare, Unique, or Transcendence provided according to probabilities + 1 Transcendence Class (1 Day) provided according to probabilities + all contents of Daily Attendance Reward Box provided.
[*]Transcendence Classes (1 Day): Dorothy Dark Knight, Flora Paladin, Transcendence Ji Yoon Choi, Transcendence Yuri, Sonya Lycanthrope, Elizabeth Crimson Hunter, Transcendence Michaela, Transcendence Fernando, Transcendence Blair, and Rose Phoenix
[*]Daily Attendance Reward Box: Damage Display (1 Day), Killer Display (1 Day), Penalty and Loss Invalidation x1, Rare Decoder x3
[*]All weapons and classes from the Daily Supply are bound and cannot be used for Auction/Disassembly/Family Storage (Extension X).[/list][/list]

[list][*]Cumulative Rewards
[list][*]5 Days: X-TRACKER (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]10 Days: Negev NG7 Ajax (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]Cumulative Attendance Reward Box contents: C4 Countdown Room Host (5 Days), Shorten Respawn Time (5 Days) Lucky Gunslinger (5 Days), Daily Mission Difficulty Change x15, Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon (7 Days)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Attendance rewards will be provided directly as rewards instead of the Daily/Cumulative Attendance Reward Box items.
[*]Rewards can be claimed immediately after logging in and are available until midnight every day.[/list][/list]


[h3]Al-Hijra Holiday Event (7/12 - 7/26)[/h3]
Complete the mission during the event to earn rewards.

[list][*]Event Participation Requirements
[list][*]Log in to earn an Event Decoder (once per day)
[*]Earn 1 point each time you play for 20/40/60 minutes (up to 3 points per day).[/list][/list]

[list][*]Point Accumulation Rewards
[list][*]3 Points: Rare Decoder x10
[*]9 Points: Unique Decoder x8
[*]15 Points: Unique Premium Decoder x5
[*]18 Points: 10,000 Mileage Coupon x3
[*]21 Points: Class Decoder x5
[*]27 points: Transcendence Decoder x7
[*]30 Points: Crescent Moon Nameplate
[*]33 points: Transcendence Decoder x10
[*]36 Points: Class Decoder x10[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Pileup reward is limited to once per account.
[*]You can earn up to 3 points a day.
[*]No mode restrictions.
[*]You can participate in Studio Mode.
[*]Can participate in Laboratory Mode.
[*]Player Requirement: 3[/list][/list]


[h3]Bonus Disassembly Event (7/12 – 7/26)[/h3]
You can participate in the Bonus Disassembly Event by clicking "Bonus Disassembly" at the bottom of the Lobby. During the event, 10 players can select the weapons they want to disassemble, with one lucky player receiving extra mileage. Participants can get 500 mileage for each weapon they disassemble.

[list][*]Details
[list][*]Weekdays and Weekends - 1:00 PM – 5:00 PM CEST
[*]Minimum Participation Mileage: 5,000
[*]Some items will be adjusted based on the weapon's rarity.
[*]Table ranks are in the order of highest value first.
[*]Weapon criteria are determined the day the Bonus Disassembly Event starts. If the weapon's rank changes, its value in the Bonus Disassembly Event will be updated.
[*]New items for disassembly: Demolition Hammer, Tyrant's Mace, Electron-V, Ignite-7[/list][/list]


[u][h2]Shop Update[/h2][/u]

[h3]Transcendence Weapon "Devastator" Promotion (7/12 - 8/9)[/h3]
Devastator is now available in Transcendence and Transcendence Premium Decoders!

[list][*]Devastator Drop Rate
[list][*]Transcendence Premium Decoder: 3%
[*]Transcendence Decoder: 0.45%[/list][/list]


[h3]Devastator Guaranteed Giveaway (7/12 - 8/9)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/8c9d242296df7c78b84ea0eed6406237c1a41b07.png[/img]
Depending on the number of Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders used, you may be guaranteed to receive the Devastator permanently!

[list][*]Reward Thresholds
[list][*]Upon Reaching 300 Guaranteed Points[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]6 Guaranteed Points each time you use 1 Transcendence Premium Decoder.
[*]1 Guaranteed Point each time you use 1 Class Decoder.[/list][/list]


[h3]Class Rotation Group Appearance Event (7/12 - Until Next Transcendence Class Promotion)[/h3]
The classes below will be part of the new Rotation Group for the Class Decoder during the event.

[list][*]Appearing Classes
[list][*]Anemone / Mirage / Roy / Romy[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Check Decoder Rate details after the 7/12 maintenance.
[*]The Rotation Group will no longer be available via the decoder once the event ends.
[*]The contents of the Rotation Group may change at any time.
[*]The Rotation Group is added to Class Decoders only during the event.
[*]Upon winning with a rotating class, you will automatically obtain their exclusive costume.
[*]Upon winning as Roy will automatically obtain Roy's Keepsake Hat (Permanent).
[*]Upon winning as Romy will automatically obtain Romy's Survival Pack (Permanent).
[*]Upon winning as Anemone, you will automatically obtain Anemone's Drone.
[*]Upon winning as Mirage, you will automatically obtain the Mirage's VR HMD.[/list][/list]


[h3]Guaranteed Class Decoder Rotation Group Giveaway Event (7/12 - Until Next Transcendence Class Promotion)[/h3]
Select a guaranteed class from the rotation group based on Class Decoder usage during the event!

[list][*]Conditions and Rewards
[list][*]Each time you reach 150 points, you can choose 1 of the following classes:
[*]Roy
[*]Romy
[*]Anemone
[*]Mirage[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]You'll earn 1 Guaranteed Point each time you use a Class Decoder.
[*]Selecting the class in a guaranteed giveaway event will provide the exclusive costume of the class.[/list][/list]

Super Soldier Mode Guide
[*]A PVP mode based on Team Deathmatch where humans compete against each other.
[*]Super Soldier players have powerful specs such as High HP and DEF, plus a double jump! Enhanced physical abilities and addition of skills make them formidable in any battle.
[*]Play strategically with the 4 experts: Fighter, Defender, Brawler, and Sniper.
[*]Each expert has specific skills.
[*]You can set hotkeys for each Expert through the Option / Skill Bar Settings.
[*]Collecting the S.V.P. Supply Box during the game will significantly enhance your Attack Power and Movement Speed.
[*]Player specs will be changed based on the Weapon Restriction Options.

Fire Bomb Options (Zombie Z, Zombie Z Laboratory, Zombie Hero, and Zombie Hero Laboratory)
[list][*]You can now turn on/off the use of Fire Bombs in Room Settings.
[*]Room Settings > Advanced Options
[*] (Fire Bomb will be 'on' when Zombie Restriction > Normal Zombies Only is selected)[/list]

Option added to restrict the amount of Zombie Z Mutations (Zombie Z and Zombie Z Laboratory)
[list][*]An option that limits the number of Mutations obtained in Zombie Z.
[*]Select 20, 25, 30, 35, or 40 in the drop-down menu in Room Settings.
[*]Selecting 20 will allow you to acquire a maximum of 20 Mutations. You cannot collect any more after reaching 20.
[*] (This amount does not include mutations increased by Class, etc.)[/list]

Added option for Mutation Restriction (Zombie Z and Zombie Z Laboratory)
[list][*]This is an option that removes up to 4 selected Mutations in Zombie Z.
[*]You cannot remove Mutations that are automatically provided at certain levels.[/list]
