notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a1aa5c0e85855144eccec0a3f8463fac93eb54aa.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*]Lotus Leaf Rice Grenade Giveaway (6/28 - 7/12)[/b]Log in each day during the event to receive a Lotus Leaf Rice Grenade.

[b][*]Find the Zombie Event(6/28- 7/12)[/b]You can participate via the Find the Zombie event button at the bottom of the Lobby screen.

[b][*]Eid al-Adha Event (6/28 - 7/12)[/b]Complete the mission during the event to earn the fantastic costumes and rewards!

[b][*]Ignite-7 Promotion (6/28 - 7/12)[/b]This Unique Weapon will make a special appearance in Unique Decoders and Unique Premium Decoders during the event.

[b][*]1,000 Mileage Auction Event (6/28 - 7/4)[/b]During the auction period, a special item sold for 1,000 Mileage will appear at certain times.[/list]

Check out the following sections for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[u][h2]Event Information[/h2][/u]

[h3]Lotus Leaf Rice Grenade Giveaway (6/28 - 7/12)[/h3]
Log in each day during the event to receive a Lotus Leaf Rice Grenade.

[list][*]Lotus Leaf Rice Grenade
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/16f47bb34ef014de3043af87a5b3e73fca9b0a59.png[/img]
[list][*]During the event, the Lotus Leaf Rice Grenade can be used for free, but it will be removed during the 7/12 maintenance.[/list][/list]


[h3]Lotus Leaf Rice Grenade Destruction Event (6/28 - 7/12)[/h3]
Get rewarded for killing zombies with the Lotus Leaf Grenade in Zombie Mutant, Zombie Evolution, Zombie Hero, and Zombie Z modes, where a variety of damage amounts can occur.
Damage Amount: 50% chance for normal damage, 40% chance for 2x damage, and 10% chance for one-hit-kill damage

[list][*]Conditions / Rewards
[list][*]Earn an Event Reward Box by killing a zombie with the Lotus Leaf Rice Grenade in each of the Zombie Mutant, Zombie Evolution, Zombie Hero and Zombie Z modes.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Event Reward Box Contents
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/43ec9ac575bfb1f58745204ea32576253d346b70.png[/img]
[list][*](You will have a chance to receive one of these items)
[*]Rare Decoder x1
[*]Event Decoder x1
[*]Nickname Change x1
[*]100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x1
[*]Random -1 Dehancement Material x1
[*]300 Mileage Coupon x1
[*]500 Mileage Coupon x1
[*]1000 Mileage Coupon x1
[*]Class Pass (1 Day)
[*]Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x1
[*]Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x1
[*]Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x1
[*]Jackpot Point Box x1
[*]Anemone (15 Day)
[*]Mirage (15 Day)
[*]Ismael (15 Day)
[*]Ethan (15 Day)
[*]Anemone (Permanent)
[*]Mirage (Permanent)
[*]Ismael (Permanent)
[*]Ethan (Permanent[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Lotus Leaf Rice Grenade Destruction Event rewards can be obtained up to 5 times per day.
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with 3 or more players (includes Laboratory Mode, excludes Studio Mode).
[*]Excludes auto hunt kills regardless of mode.
[*]All unused Event Reward Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 7/12.
[*]The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list][/list]


[h3]Event Reward Box Pileup Event (6/28 - 7/12)[/h3]
Kill zombies with Lotus Leaf Rice Grenades during the event to earn great rewards!

[list][*]Conditions / Rewards
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/dc6f200425932fa10327cd43ac319a39be9cb0d1.png[/img]
[list][*]Obtain [Event Reward Box] x40 to earn a Lotus Leaf Rice Mask (Permanent)
[*]Rewards can only be obtained once per account.[/list][/list]


[h3]Find the Zombie Event(6/28- 7/12)[/h3]
You can participate via the Find the Zombie event button at the bottom of the Lobby screen.

[list][*]How to Participate
[list][*]Click the Find the Zombie event button at the bottom of the lobby screen.
[*]Among a group of 16 characters (12 zombies, 4 humans), find and hit the zombies using the right bullets.
[*]Get these bullets from the Find the Zombie Bullet Giveaway.
[*]Hitting a zombie will increase your reward by 1 and allow you to take an additional shot. Hitting a human will decrease your reward by 1 and reset the Find the Zombie in progress.
[*]The reward grade can be increased up to a High Class Gold Box if you hit enough zombies in a row, and you can claim the current reward by clicking "Surrender."
[*]Click "Automatic Fire" to quickly proceed through one game.[/list][/list]

[list][*]What is "Automatic Fire"?
[list][*]Proceed by randomly firing in a game.
[*]You must have more than 1 bullet to continue.
[*]If you are in the Claim Reward state, you must claim your reward to use this feature.
[*]Temporary items obtained from the Silver Box last for a fixed amount of time. Bound weapons obtained from the Gold Box cannot be used for Auction/Disassembly/Family Storage.

You won't receive exclusive costumes from selecting a class in this Selection Box.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Mystery Box

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Reward grade will be reset upon claiming the current reward by clicking "Surrender."
[*]The grade can be increased up to a High Class Gold Box, and players can earn better rewards by consecutively hitting zombies.
[*]Temporary items obtained from the Silver Box last for a fixed duration. Bound weapons obtained from the Gold Box cannot be used for Auction/Disassembly/Family Storage
[*]If you own both event and purchased bullets, event bullets will be consumed first.
[*]Click on "Claim Reward" to receive reward items.
[*]Chance to Find a Zombie: Remaining Zombies / Remaining Slots (Example: If there are 10 zombies left and 14 slots left → 10/14, there is about 71% chance to find a zombie.)
[*]All unused Old-Time Weapon Paint Selection Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 7/12.
[*]All unused Blue B Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 7/12.
[*]All unused Mystery Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 8/9.[/list][/list]


[h3]Find the Zombie Bullet Giveaway Event (6/28– 7/12)[/h3]
Locked and loaded! Before you take down those zombies, you're going to need some ammo! After 1 hour of daily playtime, you'll earn 30 bullets every 15 minutes.

[list][*]Conditions and Items
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e0ab95cf439f28093e4dac2af35bf48fa0257c9d.png[/img]
[list][*]Get 15 Find the Zombie Bullets for Every 15 Minutes of Play Time[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Each account can obtain up to 120 bullets per day.
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (includes Studio and Laboratory Modes).
[*]All unused Find the Zombie bullets will be removed during maintenance on 7/12.[/list][/list]


[h3]Bullet Pileup Reward Giveaway (6/28 - 7/12)[/h3]
 Keeping collecting bullets, and the rewards will be delivered with a BANG!

[list][*] Total Bullets / Rewards
[list][*]x540: Transcendence Decoder x2
[*]x720: Transcendence Decoder x4
[*]x840: Transcendence Decoder x7 + Find the Zombie Event Nameplate (300 Days)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1d72a7173460b608a21f0e98f082ac492a331819.png[/img]
[/list][/list]


[h3]Daily Bullet Collection Event (6/28 - 7/12)[/h3]
Keep collecting bullets to get your own reward!

[list][*]Daily Total Bullets / Rewards
[list][*]x45: Event Decoder x1[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Obtain up to one a day per account.
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (includes Studio and Laboratory Modes).[/list][/list]


[h3]New and Returning Player Welcome Event (6/28 - 8/9)[/h3]
Welcome, new and returning players!

[list][*]Conditions and Items
[list][*](Daily Achievement Mission) Clear 3 Daily Missions during the event to earn 500 mileage[/list][/list]

[list][*]Total Mission Days/Total Mission Achievement Reward
[list][*]1 Day : Sonya Lycanthrope Pass (7 Days) + Exploration Success Rate-Up 10% x5 + 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x2
[*]2 Days: Magnum Shooter (3 Days) + SKULL-T9 (3 Days) + 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3
[*]3 Days: SG552 Cerberus (3 Days) + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x5 + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x3
[*]4 Days: Laser Ripper (3 Days) + Random -1 Dehancement Material x7
[*]5 Days: Twin Hawk (3 Days) + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x2
[*]6 Days: Transcendence Weapon Pass (1 Day) + Class Decoder x1 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*]7 Days: Mystery Box x1 + Class Pass (7 Days)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Only new or returning players (with longer than 30 days of inactivity) can participate in this event.
[*]The Daily Achievement Mission reward can be claimed once a day, and the pileup reward can only be claimed once per account.[/list][/list]


[h3]Eid al-Adha Event (6/28 - 7/12)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/14f0f32c185eb9c18b74ff8c2546ae40f1f5e52c.jpg[/img]
Complete the mission during the event to earn the fantastic costumes and rewards!

[list][*]How to Participate
[list][*]Earn 1 point each time you reach 10/20/30 minutes of playtime (up to 3 points per day).
[*]Earn Event Decoder x1 by reaching 30 minutes of playtime (up to once a day)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Total Points and Rewards
[list][*]3 points: Rare Decoder x10
[*]6 Points: Unique Decoder x8
[*]9 Points: Unique Premium Decoder x5
[*]15 Points: 10,000 Mileage Coupon x3
[*]18 Points: Class Decoder x5
[*]24 points: Transcendence Decoder x5
[*]30 Points: Sheep's Head Costume (Permanent) x1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1f58e1e768727599e6c0c6ca3bfa62641f97bad3.png[/img]
[*]33 points: Transcendence Decoder x7
[*]36 Points: Class Decoder x10[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Pileup reward is limited to once per account.
[*]You can earn up to 3 points a day
[*]No mode restrictions
[*]You can participate in Studio Mode
[*]Can participate in Laboratory Mode
[*]Player Requirement: 3[/list][/list]


[h3]Eid al-Adha Celebration Mileage Auction (6/28 - 7/4)[/h3]
The Mileage Auction will take place to celebrate Eid al-Adha! Auctions are available for a limited time only, so don't miss out!

[list][*]Auction Feature / Content
[list][*]Auction Time: 1 hour for all items
[*]Number of Auction Listings: 2 (Increases based on VIP rank)
[*]Market Price of Items: When listing an item, you can check the current Auction House market price (Lowest bid and direct purchase prices).
[*]Item Display: Only items with the lowest bid or direct purchase price are displayed.
[*]Auction Settings: You can search by bid/direct purchase price, enhancement level, and weapon name.
[*]Sell-to-System Feature: When an auction is unsuccessful, you'll have the opportunity to use the sell-to-system feature.
[*]Auction Hours: 24 Hours (12: 00: 00 AM – 11: 59: 59 PM) - When auction hours end, currently listed items will be canceled.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]The remaining time is shown in 5-minute increments for listed auction items.
[*]You can only bid on 1 item at a time.
[*]Regular auction items will be listed with a 30% fee included in the initial bidding price.
[*]If an item listed for auction is not sold, the item will be returned.
[*]Items listed for auction can be purchased immediately at the direct purchase price.
[*]If you list an item for auction, you cannot withdraw it until the auction's duration has ended.
[*]The item you listed may be shown on the bid page.
[*]When listing an item, you can easily check the actual amount you will receive under the Net Reward section.
[*]Some recently released weapons cannot be listed at auction.[/list][/list]


[h3]1,000 Mileage Auction Event (6/28 - 7/4)[/h3]
During the auction period, a special item sold for 1,000 Mileage will appear at certain times.
[list][*]Time / Special Items
[list][*]CEST (GMT +1) 15:30 - 16:30 Lightning Fury
[*]CEST (GMT +1) 16:30 - 17:30 Satellite Mine[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]1,000-Mileage auction items will appear periodically during auction hours.
[*]Special items will appear within 10 minutes of the beginning of each auction hour, with bidding open for 10 minutes.
[*]Those who did not win the auction will be refunded 1,000 Mileage when the auction closes.
[*]Claim rewards by clicking Obtain after winning.[/list][/list]


[u][h2]Shop Update[/h2][/u]

[h3]Ignite-7 Promotion (6/28 - 7/12)[/h3]
This Unique Weapon will make a special appearance in Unique Decoders and Unique Premium Decoders during the event.

[list][*]Ignite-7
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/57d6929c89d8dc579f133ed55bff85704c6e8c03.png[/img]
[list][*]Unique Premium Decoder Drop Rate: 5%
[*]Unique Decoder Drop Rate: 1%
[*]Description: The newest product from the Aegis Institute. The split magazine and the Ignite system allow you to take on multiple enemies with ease.
[*]Ignite-7 will be permanently added to the Unique Decoder and the Unique Premium Decoder starting 7/12 until the event ends.[/list][/list]


[h3]Ignite-7 Guaranteed Giveaway (6/28 - 7/12)[/h3]
Depending on the number of Unique Premium Decoders and Unique Decoders used during the event, you could receive the Ignite-7 (Permanent)!

[list][*]Reward Thresholds
[list][*]Upon Reaching 150 Guaranteed Points[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]5 Guaranteed Points are earned each time you use 1 Unique Premium Decoder.
[*]1 Guaranteed Point is earned each time you use 1 Unique Decoder.[/list][/list]


[u][h2]Other Information[/h2][/u]

[list][*]Some parts of the Breezeway map will be changed to improve frame rate issues and balance.
[list][*]Fixed an issue where remaining players would be moved to the waiting room when the player who obtained specific Karma in Zombie Z Laboratory and Hero Laboratory would quit the session.[/list][/list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d7c869f932500fb300e8a847bc11ef43272975e5.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*]Season 16: Alice in Wonderland (06/14 - 10/04)[/b]For details, please refer to the Season 16 Pass Preview.

[b][*]Zombie Scenario Golden Zombie Kill Event (06/14 - 10/04)[/b]Earn rewards by killing Golden Zombies when you play Zombie Scenario during Season 16.

[b][*]New Transcendence Class Promotion (6/14- 7/12)[/b]Two new Transcendence Classes, Blue Rabbit Mirage and Alpaca Anemone, are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders.[/list]

Check out the following sections for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[u][h2]Content Guide[/h2][/u]

[h3]New Map Information[/h3]
[list][*]Breezeway
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e54854add92ef5f4b661dd2cc9e665473c4a8147.png[/img]

[*]Auction Time: 1 hour for all items

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: May 3rd
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/82e0a8147a49cdb939142cbc496e7e6db7314077.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*]Cheer The Workers Event (05/03 - 05/17)[/b]Don't miss out on these daily rewards!

[b][*]Bonus Disassembly Event (05/03 – 05/17)[/b]You can participate in the Bonus Disassembly Event by clicking "Bonus Disassembly" at the bottom of the Lobby. During the event, 10 players can select the weapons they want to disassemble, with one lucky player receiving extra mileage. Participants can get 500 mileage for each weapon they disassemble.

[b][*]Class Rotation Group Appearance Event (05/03 - Until Next Transcendence Class Promotion)[/b]The classes below will be part of the new Rotation Group for the Class Decoder during the event.[/list]

Check out the following sections for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[u][h2]Event Information[/h2][/u]

[h3]Cheer The Workers Event (05/03 - 05/17)[/h3]
Don't miss out on these daily rewards!

[list][*]How to Participate
[list][*]Earn 2 Cheer Gauges each time you score 2 kills or 6 assists as a human, or infect 2 humans as a zombie in Zombie Mode (up to 40 Cheer Gauges per day, excludes bots).
[*]Earn 5 Cheer Gauges each time you clear 1 session by reaching 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard difficulty or higher (up to 40 Cheer Gauges per day).
[*]Earn 1 Cheer Gauge each time you reach 5 minutes of playtime (up to 10 Cheer Gauges per day).
[*]Earn 2 Cheer Gauges each time you log in (once a day).[/list][/list]

[list][*]Cumulative Rewards
[list][*]50 Cheer Gauges: Rare Decoder x3
[*]100 Cheer Gauges: Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x10 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3
[*]150 Cheer Gauges: Anemone (15 Days) + Exploration Success Rate-Up 10% x4
[*]250 Cheer Gauges: Unique Decoder x4 + Zombie Damage Meter (7 Days)
[*]350 Cheer Gauges: Class Decoder x2 + 10,000 Mileage Coupon
[*]450 Cheer Gauges: Ismael (15 Days) + Ethan (15 Days) + 200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3
[*]500 Cheer Gauges: Transcendence Decoder + Class Decoder + Mirage (15 Days)
[*]550 Cheer Gauges: Class Decoder x6 + Event Decoder x5
[*]600 Cheer Gauges: Transcendence Decoder x7 + Event Decoder x5
[*]650 Cheer Gauges: Season Badge x100
[*]700 Cheer Gauges: Season Badge x100[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Each account can collect up to 50 Cheer Gauges per day.
[*]Playtime missions can be completed in all modes.
[*]Aside from the playtime missions, studio mode is excluded from the eligibility to complete all other in-game missions.
[*]Rewards are distributed only once per account.
[*]Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*]Excludes Zombie Scenario: Survival: Double Gate / Survival: Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*]At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]Only rooms with 3 or more players count toward these goals.
[*]Excludes auto hunt kills regardless of mode.
[*]All accumulated Cheer Gauges will be removed during maintenance on 5/17.
[*]The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list][/list]


[h3]Bonus Disassembly Event (05/03 – 05/17)[/h3]
You can participate in the Bonus Disassembly Event by clicking "Bonus Disassembly" at the bottom of the Lobby. During the event, 10 players can select the weapons they want to disassemble, with one lucky player receiving extra mileage. Participants can get 500 mileage for each weapon they disassemble.

[list][*]Details
[list][*]Weekdays and Weekends - 1:00 PM – 5:00 PM CEST
[*]Minimum Participation Mileage: 5,000
[*]Some items will be adjusted based on the weapon's rarity.
[*]Table ranks are in the order of highest value first.
[*]Weapon criteria are determined the day the Bonus Disassembly Event starts. If the weapon's rank changes, its value in the Bonus Disassembly Event will be updated.
[*]New items for disassembly: Arbalest, Hécate II Umbra, Cousteau, and Doom Blaster[/list][/list]


[u][h2]Shop Update[/h2][/u]

[h3]Class Rotation Group Appearance Event (05/03 - Until Next Transcendence Class Promotion)[/h3]
The classes below will be part of the new Rotation Group for the Class Decoder during the event.

[list][*]Appearing Classes
[list][*]Ismael / Ethan / Anemone / Mirage[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Check for details in Decoder Rates after the 5/3 (Wed) maintenance.
[*]The Rotation Group will no longer be available via the decoder once the event ends.
[*]The contents of the Rotation Group may change at any time.
[*] The Rotation Group is added to Class Decoders only during the event.
[*]Upon winning with a rotating class, you will automatically obtain their exclusive costume.
[*]Upon winning as Ismael, you will automatically obtain the Black Rose Shuriken.
[*]Upon winning as Ethan, you will automatically obtain the Inquisitor's Hourglass.
[*]Upon winning as Anemone, you will automatically obtain Anemone's Drone.
[*]Upon winning as Mirage, you will automatically obtain the Mirage's VR HMD.[/list][/list]


[h3]Guaranteed Class Decoder Rotation Group Giveaway Event (05/03 - Until Next Transcendence Class Promotion)[/h3]
Select a guaranteed Class from the Rotation Group based on Class Decoder usage during the event!

[list][*]Conditions and Rewards
[list][*]Each time you reach 150 points, you can choose 1 of the following classes.
[*]Ismael
[*]Ethan
[*]Anemone
[*]Mirage[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]You'll earn 1 Guaranteed Point each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
Selecting the Class in a guaranteed giveaway event will provide the exclusive costume of the class.[/list][/list]

[list][*]New Content & Events.[/list]

notes.title: [Upcoming] Temporary Maintenance: April 19th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9cb5778993db56529d92cc47da45330f536ed525.jpg[/img]


[b]Attention Survivors,[/b]

We're going to perform a temporary maintenance today starting at 3:30 P.M. CEST, April 19th, 2023. All servers during this period will be unavailable and we are anticipating the maintenance to conclude at around 4:30 P.M. CEST. Please refer below for more details on the maintenance.

[list][*][b]Note[/b]: Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.[/list]

[h1][b]Maintenance Details[/b][/h1]
[list][*] Bug fix regarding Eid Event
[list][*] There was a bug regarding Play time mission that allowed users to complete all the missions in a day. This bug will be fixed through this maintenance.
[*] As compensation, additional rewards will be given out to players who complete the 30 minutes of playtime mission daily
[list][*] The compensation includes: One Transcendence Decoder / One Unique Decoder / One Rare Decoder / One Event Decoder. It will be given out during the 5/3 maintenance.[/list]
[*] Players who have already completed the mission will also receive the compensation by playing the game for more than 30 minutes daily.
[/list][/list]

Thank you for your understanding and support in advance.

- The CSN:S Team

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: April 19th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/997497190ded4168500e7616318e553ca171422c.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*]The Stars of the Cosmos Event (4/19 - 5/3)[/b]Collect the stars of the night sky to claim your rewards!

[b][*]Eid Celebration Event (4/19 - 5/3)[/b]Wishing you a pleasant and happy holidays! We are celebrating Eid with a new event.

[b][*]1,000 Mileage Auction Event (04/19 - 05/02 23 : 59 : 59)[/b]During the auction period, a special item sold for 1,000 Mileage will appear at certain times.

[b][*]Divine Blaster/Doom Blaster Promotion (4/19 - 5/17)[/b]During the promotion, Divine Blaster and Doom Blaster will make a special appearance in Epic Decoders!

[b][*]Blaster Blueprint Promotion (4/19 – 5/17)[/b]You can purchase the Divine Blaster blueprint during the promotion.

[b][*]Transcendence Weapon Promotion: Satellite Mine/Laevateinn (4/19 – 5/17)[/b]Satellite Mine and Laevateinn will now drop from Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders![/list]

Check out the following sections for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[u][h2]New Content[/h2][/u]

[h3]Zombie Z Laboratory Release and Other Changes[/h3]
[list][*]Zombie Laboratory (Zombie Z)
[list][*]Zombie Z Laboratory mode has been added for pre-release game testing.
[*]Zombie Laboratory (Zombie Z) Italy map has been added.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Daily Mission/Weekly Mission/Honor Mission Player Count Adjustment
[list][*]The minimum number of players required to clear the mission has been reduced from 4 to 3.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Ban List Cap Increase
[list][*]The cap for the ban list has been increased from 200 to 250.[/list][/list]
[list][*]The text regarding the end of the permanent event has now been changed.[/list]


[h3]Studio Mode Update[/h3]
Studio Sample New Map Release! A new map showcasing the new decorations and devices in all their glory, "Yuri's Secret Aquarium" is getting released.
[list][*]Studio New Block Update
[list][*]A variety of new devices, characters, and decoration blocks have been updated. (7 basic and 49 decorative types)
[*]You can view the new blocks via Creation Mode without adding a separate theme pack.[/list][/list]


[u][h2]Event Information[/h2][/u]

[h3]The Stars of the Cosmos Event (4/19 - 5/3)[/h3]
Collect the stars of the night sky to claim your rewards!
[list][*]How to Participate (Conditions and Rewards)
[list][*]Earn 2 points each time you score 2 kills or 6 assists as a human, or infect 2 humans as a zombie in Zombie Mode (up to 40 points per day, excludes bots).
[*]Earn 5 points each time you clear 1 session by reaching 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard difficulty or higher (up to 40 points per day).
[*]Earn 1 point for each round you use Fire Bomb in Zombie Hero / Zombie Z mode (up to 5 points per day).
[*]Earn 1 point each time you reach 5 minutes of playtime (up to 10 points per day).
[*]Earn 2 points each time you log in (once a day).[/list][/list]
[list][*]Starlight Box Contents
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c945add7f1d2722090bcf50a84e157a3aaa01463.png[/img]
[list][*]* Accumulate 50 points to earn 1 Starlight Box.
[*](You will have a chance to receive one of these items)
[*]Dragon Knight Kyrix (Permanent/15 Days)
[*]High Elf Natasha (Permanent/15 Days)
[*]Anemone (Permanent/15 Days)
[*]Mirage (Permanent/15 Days)
[*]Event Decoder x5
[*]Transcendence Decoder x3
[*]Unique Decoder x5
[*]Class Decoder x3
[*]200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x2
[*]100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3
[*]3,000 Mileage
[*]Grade 5 Parts Reward Box
[*]Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x2
[*]Grade 3 Parts Reward Box x3
[*]Random -1 Dehancement Material x3
[*]1,000 Mileage
[*]Rare Decoder x5
[*]Exploration Success Rate-Up +10% x2[/list][/list]
[list][*]Starlight Box Pileup Reward
[list][*]1 Box: Rare Decoder x3
[*]3 Boxes: Unique Decoder x3 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3
[*]5 Boxes: Run Zombie Run 1 (Permanent) + Zombie Damage Meter (7 Days)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/85785b1cf68861c9d9cc77f22f538ef55f60573a.png[/img]
[*]7 Boxes: Feast of the Night Sky Nameplate (300 Days) + Event Decoder x5
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5a051b88bda47125e06c3ed4de4c359ff25405d2.png[/img]
[*]9 Boxes: Run Zombie Run 2 (Permanent) + Class Decoder x5
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/06882c369842a3ad15172591d8617d5f0ab9eac1.png[/img]
[*]12 Boxes: Transcendence Decoder x7 + Class Decoder x3
[*]13 Boxes: Season Badge x100
[*]14 Boxes: Season Badge x100[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Each account can obtain up to 50 play points per day.
[*]Playtime missions can be completed in all modes.
[*]Aside from the playtime missions, studio mode is excluded from the eligibility to complete all other in-game missions.
[*]Pileup reward is limited to once per account.
[*]Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*]Excludes Zombie Scenario: Survival: Double Gate / Survival: Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*]At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]Only rooms with 3 or more players count toward these goals.
[*]Excludes auto hunt kills regardless of mode.
[*]All unused Starlight Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 5/3.
[*]The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list][/list]


[h3]Eid Celebration Event (4/19 - 5/3)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/45b96eb11427988087ffa85d8474d88ba7587840.jpg[/img]
Wishing you a pleasant and happy Eid! We are celebrating Eid with a new event.
[list][*]How to Participate 
[list][*]Earn 1 point for each log in (up to 1 point per day)
[*]Earn 2 points + Event Decoder every time you reach 30 minutes of playtime (up to once a day)[/list][/list]
[list][*]Total Points and Rewards
[list][*]3 Points: Rare Decoder x10 + Event Decoder
[*]6 Points: Unique Decoder x3 + Event Decoder
[*]9 Points: Unique Premium Decoder + Event Decoder
[*]15 Points: Class Decoder x5 + Event Decoder
[*]21 Points: Transcendence Decoder x3 + Event Decoder
[*]27 Points: 10,000 Mileage Coupon x2 + Event Decoder
[*]30 Points: Blue Lantern (Permanent) + Event Decoder x3
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0bec267e418015fa47791cc1ab4195c615b16cf9.png[/img]
[*]33 Points: Unique Decoder x5 + Event Decoder x3
[*]36 Points: Unique Premium Decoder x2 + Event Decoder x3
[*]39 Points: Class Decoder x10 + Event Decoder x3
[*]42 Points: Transcendence Decoder x10 + Event Decoder x3[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Pileup reward is limited to once per account.
[*]You can earn up to 3 points a day
[*]No mode restrictions
[*]You can participate in Studio Mode
[*]Can participate in Laboratory Mode
[*]Player Requirement: 3 [/list][/list]


[h3]Lebaran Celebration Mileage Auction (04/19 - 05/02 23: 59: 59)[/h3]
Mileage Auction will take place to celebrate Lebaran! Auctions are available for a limited time only so don't miss out!
[list][*]Auction Feature / Content
[list][*]Auction Time: 1 hour for all items
[*]Number of Auction Listings: 2 (Increases based on VIP rank)
[*]Market Price of Items: When listing an item, you can check the current Auction House market price (Lowest bid and direct purchase prices).
[*]Item Display: Only items with the lowest bid or direct purchase price are displayed.
[*]Auction Settings: You can search by bid/direct purchase price, enhancement level, and weapon name.
[*]Sell-to-System Feature: When an auction is unsuccessful, you'll have the opportunity to use the sell-to-system feature.
[*]Auction Hours: 24 Hours (12: 00: 00 AM – 11: 59: 59 PM) - When auction hours end, currently listed items will be canceled.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]The remaining time is shown in 5-minute increments for listed auction items.
[*]You can only bid on 1 item at a time.
[*]Regular auction items will be listed with a 30% fee included in the initial bidding price.
[*]If an item listed for auction is not sold, the item will be returned.
[*]Items listed for auction can be purchased immediately at the direct purchase price.
[*]If you list an item for auction, you cannot withdraw it until the auction's duration has ended.
[*]The item you listed may be shown on the bid page.
[*]When listing an item, you can easily check the actual amount you will receive under the Net Reward section.
[*]Some recently released weapons cannot be listed at auction.[/list][/list]


[h3]1,000 Mileage Auction Event (04/19 - 05/02 23: 59: 59)[/h3]
During the auction period, a special item sold for 1,000 Mileage will appear at certain times.
[list][*]Time / Special Items
[list][*]CEST (GMT +1) 16:00 - 17:00 Failnaught, Devastator, Satellite Mine, and Spell Lance Scarlet Rose
[*]CEST (GMT +1) 20:00 - 21:00 Failnaught, Devastator, Satellite Mine, and Spell Lance Scarlet Rose[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]1,000-Mileage auction items will appear periodically during auction hours.
[*]Special items will appear within 10 minutes of the beginning of each auction hour, with bidding open for 10 minutes.
[*]Those who did not win the auction will be refunded 1,000 Mileage when the auction closes.
[*]Claim rewards by clicking Obtain after winning.[/list][/list]


[h3]Login Supplies Event Guide (4/19 – 5/17)[/h3]
[list][*]Login Reward
[list][*]Daily Weapons Supply
[*]Both Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (1 Day) and M3 Black Dragon (1 Day) provided + one of the Transcendence Enhancement or Part equipped Unique weapon (1 Day) randomly provided + all contents of Daily Attendance Reward Box provided
[*]Daily Attendance Reward Box: Damage Display (1 Day), Killer Display (1 Day), Penalty and Loss Invalidation x1, Rare Decoder x3
[*]1 out of the following Transcendence Classes will be provided at a set chance (1 Day): Dorothy Dark Knight, Flora Paladin, Transcendence Ji Yoon Choi, Transcendence Yuri, Sonya Lycanthrope, Elizabeth Crimson Hunter, Transcendence Michaela, Transcendence Fernando, Transcendence Blair, and Rose Phoenix[/list][/list]
[list][*]Cumulative Rewards
[list][*]5 Days: X-TRACKER (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]10 Days: Negev NG7 Ajax (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]15 Days: Spell Lance Scarlet Rose (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]20 Days: Lightning Fury (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]25 Days: Dread Nova (10 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]Cumulative Attendance Reward Box contents: C4 Countdown Room Host (5 Days), Shorten Respawn Time (5 Days) Lucky Gunslinger (5 Days), Daily Mission Difficulty Change x15, Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon (7 Days)[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Attendance rewards will be provided directly as rewards instead of the Daily/Cumulative Attendance Reward Box items.
[*]Rewards can be claimed immediately after logging in and are available until midnight every day.[/list][/list]


[u][h2]Shop Update[/h2][/u]

[h3]Divine Blaster/Doom Blaster Promotion (4/19 - 5/17)[/h3]
During the promotion, Divine Blaster and Doom Blaster will make a special appearance in Epic Decoders!
[list][*]Weapon Rates
[list][*]Divine Blaster: 0.175%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/226dcae438fd592152c8d1d5bda41f638ef61b16.png[/img]
[*]Description: A weapon of the heavens, made with unknown technology. Allows the wielder to fire 50 scatter-shot rounds, summon Purifying Wings to burn enemies who approach, and draw energy from the wings to blast foes with Purifying Light.
[*]Doom Blaster: 0.175%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1a3a7bf83e1d572446c481e88e9470f2420a1475.png[/img]
[*]Description: A demonic weapon, forged in the depths of hell. Allows the wielder to fire 60 scatter-shot rounds, summon the Wings of Doom to burn any enemies who approach, and draw energy to blast foes with the Doomsday Strike.[/list][/list]


[h3]Divine Blaster/Doom Blaster Guaranteed Giveaway (4/19 – 5/17)[/h3]
Get Guaranteed Points when you use Epic Decoders during the promotion!
[list][*]Conditions and Rewards
[list][*]Each time you reach 300 points, you can choose 1 of the following weapons:
[*]Divine Blaster / Doom Blaster / Negev NG-7 Ajax / Spell Lance Scarlet Rose / Lightning Fury / Psychic Harmonium[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]You'll earn 1 Guaranteed Point each time you use 1 Epic Decoder.
[*]A reward can be obtained every 300 points. Meaning that you can select 1 weapon at 300 points, 600 points, 900 points, and so on.
[*]All unused Epic Decoders will be replaced with 100 mileage each and removed during the maintenance on 5/17 (Wed).[/list][/list]

[h3]Divine Blaster / Doom Blaster Crafting Event (4/19 – 5/17)[/h3]
You can obtain the Divine Blaster or Doom Blaster if you purchase the Blaster blueprint while you own the Doom Blaster or Divine Blaster during the event.
[list][*]How to Craft
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b9a54eff7cadf5a1d80a78346fc61f13597770a3.png[/img]
[list][*]Divine Blaster (Permanent) can be obtained by pressing [Use] on the Blaster blueprint while both the Doom Blaster (Permanent) and the Blaster blueprint are in your inventory.
[*]Doom Blaster (Permanent) can be obtained by pressing [Use] on the Blaster blueprint while both the Divine Blaster (Permanent) and the Blaster blueprint are in your inventory.
[*]Press [Use] on the Blaster blueprint while the Doom Blaster (Permanent), the Divine Blaster (Permanent), and the Blaster blueprint are all present in your inventory to select and claim either the Doom Blaster (Permanent) or the Divine Blaster (Permanent).[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Completing [Use] of the Blaster blueprint will remove the Blaster blueprint from your inventory.
[*]You have to press [Use] on the Blaster blueprint after the purchase to craft it into Divine Blaster (Permanent) or Doom Blaster (Permanent)
[*]It can only be crafted once per account.
[*]If you have not used the Blaster blueprint during the event, they will be used automatically on the 5/17 (Wed) maintenance (Conditions to obtain and rewards are same as the above)[/list][/list]


[h3]Blaster Blueprint Promotion (4/19 – 5/17)[/h3]
You can purchase the Divine Blaster blueprint during the promotion.
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]The Blaster blueprint can only be purchased by those who own the Doom Blaster (Permanent) or Divine Blaster (Permanent).
[*]It can only be purchased once per account.[/list][/list]


[h3]Transcendence Weapon Promotion: Satellite Mine/Laevateinn (4/19 – 5/17)[/h3]
Satellite Mine and Laevateinn will now drop from Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders!
[list][*]Satellite Mine/Laevateinn Drop Rate
[list][*]Transcendence Premium Decoder: 3%
[*]Transcendence Decoder: 0.45%[/list][/list]
[list][*]Satellite Mine
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e454a78f866aaa8452bc3acdbe3f8534623333e0.png[/img]
[list][*]Description: A special mine armed with cutting-edge satellite technology. It can either seek nearby enemies on its own or be manually detonated. When activated, it creates a zone that hinders enemy movement, then calls down a laser bombardment that only harms enemies after a short delay.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Laevateinn
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d3651be67321ae24dfe290155a1477b568473cbf.png[/img]
[list][*]A pistol that holds 50 rounds of 5.7mm explosive ammo that explodes when it hits the target. When you fire beyond a certain number of rounds, a special feature becomes available.
[*]Special Feature <Electric Area>: Right-clicking after the gauge is charged 25% removes the Slow debuff on self, deals a set amount of damage to enemies approaching the area, and pushes them back.
[*]Special Feature <Paralysis Area>: Right-clicking after the gauge is charged 100% removes the Slow debuff on self, disables the attacks/skills/movement of enemies within the area, and pushes them back. A set portion of the damage dealt is restored as HP. (Attack/skill/movement disabling and AoE HP leeching features do not work in certain modes).[/list][/list]


[h3]Satellite Mine/Laevateinn Guaranteed Giveaway (4/19 – 5/17)[/h3]
Depending on the number of Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders used, you may be guaranteed to receive the Satellite Mine/Laevateinn permanently!
[list][*]Reward Thresholds
[list][*]Upon Reaching 300 Guaranteed Points[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]6 Guaranteed Points each time you use 1 Transcendence Premium Decoder.
[*]1 Guaranteed Point each time you use 1 Transcendence Decoder.
[*]All unused Premium Transcendence Decoders will be replaced with 500 mileage each and removed during the maintenance on 5/17 (Wed).[/list][/list]

[u][h2]Other Changes[/h2][/u]

[olist][*]Hardware Acceleration function's default value has been set to On.
[*]The existing VVIP Free Pass and VIP Free Pass names, appearance, and descriptions have been adjusted.
[*]Class Pass, a new Diamond rank reward, has been added.
[*]Fixed an issue where an abnormal texture would display after reloading the Heaven Splitter.
[*]Fixed an issue where equipping the UTS-15 Pink Gold would misalign the hand placement in 3rd Person POV.

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: April 5th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/52e9146b0a48e4378d81f02377e7a4f7447f3e13.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*]April Fool's Day Celebration Spring Event (4/5 - 4/19)[/b]New items have arrived with Spring! Participate in the new event and earn new gear!

[b][*]Easter Celebration Costume Event (4/5 - 4/19)[/b]Participate in the event and earn lots of great rewards! 

[b][*]New Transcendence Class Promotion (4/5–5/3)[/b]Two new Transcendence Classes, Special Agent May and Pyromaniac Yuri, are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders.[/list]

Check out the following sections for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[u][h2]New Content[/h2][/u]

[h3]Map Added (4/5 - 4/19)[/h3]
[list][*]Chindren's Estate
[list][*]The existing Estate map has undergone a Easter Day renovation.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Castle Land
[list][*]A map with an amusement park theme.[/list][/list]


[u][h2]New Event[/h2][/u]

[h3]April Fool's Day Celebration Spring Event (4/5 - 4/19)[/h3]
New items have arrived with Spring! Participate in the new event and earn new gear!
[list][*]How to Participate
[list][*]Earn 2 points each time you score 2 kills or 6 assists as a human, or infect 2 humans as a zombie in Zombie Mode (up to 40 points per day, excludes bots).
[*]Earn 5 points each time you clear 1 session by reaching 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard difficulty or higher (up to 40 points per day).
[*]Earn 1 point each time you reach 5 minutes of playtime (up to 10 points per day).
[*]Earn 2 points each time you log in (once a day).
[*]* Each account can obtain up to 50 play points per day.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Event Rewards
[list][*]50 Points: Rare Decoder x3
[*]100 Points: Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x10 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3
[*]150 Points: Unique Decoder x3 + Exploration Success Rate-Up 10% x3
[*]250 Points: Plunger (Permanent) + Zombie Damage Meter (7 Days)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/71ee752503e93b75fe06a9c339bb4b16da5a5561.png[/img]
[*]350 Points: Cute SD Character's Nameplate (300 Days) + 10,000 Mileage Coupon
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/df2e6116612891f0201343d7a521b9b199e349fa.png[/img]
[*]450 Points: Spring Breeze (Light Zombie) Spray (Permanent) + 200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/bb3f8205153d83077dd20dd86c0704e73cc818c4.png[/img]
[*]500 Points: Ice Cream Cone (Permanent)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/43a5a046153b077f557dc96c1cb135e82fbc094a.png[/img]
[*]550 Points: Class Decoder x6 + Event Decoder x5
[*]600 Points: Transcendence Decoder x6 + Event Decoder x5
[*]650 Points: Season Badge x100
[*]700 Points: Season Badge x100[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]These rewards ares given only once per Nexon account.
[*]Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*]Excludes Zombie Scenario: Survival: Double Gate / Survival: Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*]At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (excludes Studio Mode).
[*]Excludes auto hunt kills regardless of mode.
[*]All remaining play points will be removed during maintenance on 4/19.
[*]The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list][/list]


[h3]Easter Celebration Costume Event (4/5 - 4/19)[/h3]
Participate in the event and earn lots of great rewards! 
[list][*]How to Participate
[list][*]Earn 1 balloon by reaching 30 / 45 / 60 minutes of Total Login Time (up to 3 balloons per day)
[*]Earn 1 balloon by reaching 10 / 25 / 40 minutes of Total Playtime (up to 3 balloons per day)
[*]Earn 2 balloons by reaching 10 / 25 / 40 minutes of Total Playtime in the Easter Estate or Castle Land (up to 6 balloons per day)
[*]Earn 1 balloon by using any decoder (up to 1 balloon per day)
[*]Earn 1 balloon during Exploration (up to 1 balloon per day)
[*]Earn 1 balloon for clicking the Claim Reward on the Login Supplies window (up to 1 balloon per day)
[*]Earn 1 balloon by performing any of the following actions (up to 1 balloon per day): Weapon Enhancement / Disassembly / Part Equipment, Combination / Painting[/list][/list]
[list][*]Event Rewards
[list][*]60 Balloons: Balloon Nameplate (300 Days)
[*]80 Balloons: Propeller Hat (Permanent)
[*]110 Balloons: Cotton Candy (Permanent)[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]You can obtain up to 10 balloons per day.
[*]All balloons are removed during maintenance on the day that the event ends.
[*]All rewards can be claimed only once per account.
[*]Eligible Modes: All
[*]Cannot participate in Studio Mode
[*]Can participate in Laboratory Mode
[*]Player Requirement: 3 [/list][/list]

[u][h2]Shop Update[/h2][/u]

[h3]New Transcendence Class Promotion (4/5–5/3)[/h3]
Two new Transcendence Classes, Special Agent May and Pyromaniac Yuri, are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders.
[list][*]Special Agent May
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/75b6df5a437352efa682fef3d0d304808bc76231.png[/img]
[list][*]Background: May is a Chinese-born special agent who works for the Intelligence Agency and is trained in high-level combat. Most recently, she had been assigned to assist a fellow agent, but has found this difficult. In a turn of events that wrecked her resume, May has been unable to track her target due to their masterful disguise. When she discovered that the troublesome pyromaniac that had been terrorizing the world was actually the agent that she had been told to support, May became extremely conflicted, but carried on. Still struggling to find the pyromaniac agent, she eventually received intel that they had met up with David's company, so now May is on the move again to finally provide support.
[*]Paired Weapon: Dual Sword Phantom Slayer
[list][*]<Feast> activation time decreased and damage increased[/list]
[*]Zombie Scenario Skill: Special Agent's Stance
[list][*]Passive: Damage dealt to the boss is increased when playing alongside Pyromaniac Yuri (Connection effect applied, cannot be stacked). Buff effect is amplified if the connection effect is active, and Pyromaniac Yuri or Special Agent May is in the same room (up to 2 players). 
[*]<Trap Evasion> Add-On effect is applied by default.
[*]Active: Uses Conceal in Zombie Scenario, which will obscure you. Your HP will slowly recover during this time, but inflicting damage on an enemy will reveal you. Once Conceal is disabled, your movement speed will return to normal and a set amount of HP will be restored immediately for you and your allies within a set range.[/list]
[*]Transcendence Class exclusive voices are applied.
[*]+10% EXP/Points
[*]In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes.
[*]This character adds 1 initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
[*]This character displays your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
[*]Marks enemies at or below 20% HP.
[*]This character leaves a unique mark at the target location upon killing an enemy.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Pyromaniac Yuri
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f0ed63fef3b67d8e25da7d00298fec62ccdb1e06.png[/img]
[list][*]Background: A mysterious girl with an amazing talent for handling explosives, Yuri is known for working exclusively on more destructive activities. Although she successfully completes most of her missions, she once unintentionally injured Jennifer while on an assignment. Yuri is a master of disguise and can infiltrate any location to get the job done, but recently, she has been on the run from May, who has been persistently chasing her after Yuri had planned on using David Black and his company but ended up exposing her current whereabouts to May. Now, the two of them find the chase and each other’s company to be getting exhausting.
[*]Paired Weapon: Dual Beretta Gunslinger
[list][*]<Gun Kata> damage is now unaffected by distance, rather than decreasing the farther away your target is.
[*]<Gun Kata> damage has been increased[/list]
[*]Zombie Scenario Skill: Blow It Up
[list][*]Passive: Damage dealt to the boss is increased when playing alongside Special Agent May (Connection effect applied, cannot be stacked). Buff effect is amplified if the connection effect is active, and Pyromaniac Yuri or Special Agent May is in the same room (up to 2 players).  
[*]<Giant's Feet> Add-On effect is applied by default.
[*]Active: Applies explosion damage within a set range around you in Zombie Scenario (Not applicable to objects).
[*]Damage of allies within the explosion range is increased for a set duration.
[*]Explosive Ammo is loaded in your magazines, which explode at set intervals.[/list]
[*]Transcendence Class exclusive voices are applied.
[*]+10% EXP/Points
[*]In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes.
[*]This character adds 1 initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
[*]This character displays your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
[*]Marks enemies at or below 20% HP.
[*]This character leaves a unique mark at the target location upon killing an enemy.[/list][/list]


[h3]New Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (4/5–5/3)[/h3]
Get 2 guaranteed new Transcendence Classes (Special Agent May and Pyromaniac Yuri) based on the number of Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders used during the event!
[list][*]Conditions and Rewards
[list][*]Upon reaching 150 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use.
[*]Upon reaching 300 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use.
[*]Select either: Special Agent May + Mikey Panda or Pyromaniac Yuri + Bomb Bot[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]1 Guaranteed Point given each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
[*]3 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Class Premium Decoder.
[*]Selecting Special Agent May will automatically provide Mikey Panda (Permanent).
[*]Selecting Pyromaniac Yuri will automatically provide Bomb Bot (Permanent).
[*]Guaranteed Giveaway rewards can be granted once per account.[/list][/list]


[h3]New Transcendence Class Medal Giveaway (4/5 – Permanent)[/h3]
When you own all items in the new Transcendence Classes set, you will receive the Transcendence Class medal.
[list][*]Conditions and Items
[list][*]Collect Special Agent May, Pyromaniac Yuri, Mikey Panda, and Bomb Bot to earn the Spy medal.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Spy
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/677c4bab6a1eddc6034900289ba42d0da6c54f41.png[/img]
[list][*]Honor Points: 10
[*]The Spy medal doesn't have an event period limit and can be obtained after the 11/30 (Wed) maintenance.
[*]This medal can be obtained once per account.[/list][/list]


[u][h2]Other Information[/h2][/u]

[olist][*]Some auto aim weapons will no longer attack the Fire Bomb.
[*]Changed the amount of Karma gained from Zombie Kill/Assist.
[*]Fixed the issue where occasionally, the client would crash or players would be moved to the wait room while playing.[/olist]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: March 22nd
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/7cf0df5c8e92cc3deb34540c584235e84250e9c8.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*]Spring Seed Event (3/22 - 4/5)[/b]Grow the seed that you get upon your daily first login into a fruit to get all kinds of rewards!

[b][*]Transcendence Weapon Promotion: Cousteau (3/22 - 4/19)[/b]A new weapon, Cousteau, will now drop from Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders![/list]

Check out the following sections for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[u][h2]New Content[/h2][/u]

[h3]Zombie Mode Changes[/h3]
[list][*]Zombie Scenario Mode
[list][*]Elite Monster Probability (%) slightly decreased
[*]Elite spawns will now stop in the sections of certain maps where you cannot use your weapon.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Zombie Hero Balance Categories Added
[list][*]Added Fire Bomb skill
[*]Adjusted knockback and stun whenever a Host Zombie appears.
[*]Human Recover HP skill
[*]HP recovery is restored according to the amount of Morale Boost.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Zombie Z Mode
[list][*]Weapon Unlock Level Changes
[list][*]Weapon/Change Level
[*]Pierrot Magic Bow: 22 -> 25
[*]FG Launcher: 10 -> 15
[*]Laser Storm: 20 -> 18
[*]Avalanche TECH: 8 -> 7
[*]Crowbar Maverick TECH: 8 -> 5
[*]Dart Pistol TECH: 3 -> 1[/list]
[*]EXP earned by zombies for infecting humans has been decreased.
[*]The way that Intellectual mutation acquires EXP has been changed. The in-game description has been updated to be more accurate.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Studio Mode Improvements
[list][*]HP value of the Monster Spawner Device has been increased ( HP is now identical to regular monsters)[/list][/list]


[h3]Convenience Updates[/h3]
[list][*]BGM Playlist
[list][*]Added a feature where you can preview and change the Lobby BGM in a playlist.
[*]This feature can be found in the [Options] - [Audio] - [Playlist] menu.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Grouped Missions and Search Feature
[list][*]Similar missions will now be displayed in groups.
[*]A new search feature has been added that can be found on the left side of [Go to Mission Chain] in the [Missions] page.
[*]The search feature will only display results that include the keywords found on mission or event titles and content.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Inventory Specific
[list][*]You can now choose multiple selectable rewards and review what you already own.[/list][/list]


[u][h2]Event Information[/h2][/u]

[h3]Spring Seed Event (3/22 - 4/5)[/h3]
Grow the seed that you get upon your daily first login into a fruit to get all kinds of rewards!
[list][*]Item Conditions and Rewards
[list][*]Seed: First Login / Rare Decoder X5
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/dc72c557cef64a25bea00d4f43c3a0127baf8801.png[/img]
[*]Sprout: Reach 20 minutes of playtime after getting a seed. / Event Decoder
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1663ff2da149abb3c3940cc771fb37b4255a2604.png[/img]
[*]Fruit: Reach 20 minutes of play time in one of the missions below:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ead9b4aee85513d4a6cdb1b67118a3d2ec9449d5.png[/img]
[olist]
[*] Score 10 Zombie Kills as a human, or 10 Human Infections as a zombie (bots excluded in both)
[*] Score 100 kills and clear 1 session in Hard or higher difficulty in the Zombie Scenario mode.
[*] Achieve 4 or more rounds where the Fire Bomb was used in Zombie Hero mode / Get Harvested Fruit + one of the following items based on their chance: Dragon Knight Kyrix (15 Days/Permanent), High Elf Natasha (15 Days/Permanent), Anemone (15 Days/Permanent), Mirage (15 Days/Permanent), Event Decoder (x2, x5, x10 and x20), Unique Decoder (x3), 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon (x3), 3,000 Mileage Coupon, 2,000 Mileage Coupon, Grade 5 Parts Reward Box, Rare Decoder (x3 and x5), Zombie Damage Meter (7 Days).
[/olist]
[*]Harvested Fruit
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d5271bf96b2f1e7b3d6db6cfcac4ce6bf83edb2d.png[/img]
[list][*]3 Total: Unique Decoder x2 + Event Decoder x2
[*]5 Total: Transcendence Decoder + Class Decoder

[*]Cumulative Harvested Fruit rewards are given once per account.

[list][*]Login Reward
[list][*]Daily Weapons Supply

[list][*]Attendance rewards will be provided directly as rewards instead of the Daily/Cumulative Attendance Reward Box items.

A new weapon, Cousteau, will now drop from Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders!

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: March 8th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/94358d72596306e4f63cc09e24d5d68568c1b6e3.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*]New Semester Play Event (3/8 - 3/22)[/b]Earn rewards by reaching the playtime and play point goals during the event.

[b][*]Mileage Auction Event (3/8 - 3/14)[/b]Log in now to get the items you need!

[b][*]Transcendence Classes Kai/Lynn Promotion (3/8 - 4/5)[/b]Kai and Lynn will make a special appearance in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders during the event.

[b][*]Electron-V Promotion (3/8 - 3/22)[/b]This Unique Weapon will make a special appearance in Unique Decoders and Unique Premium Decoders during the event.[/list]

Check out the following sections for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[u][h2]New Content[/h2][/u]

[h3]New Semester Play Event (3/8 - 3/22)[/h3]
Earn rewards by reaching the playtime and play point goals during the event.

[list][*]Daily Rewards and Conditions
[list][*]Reach 30 mins of playtime to earn Event Decoder + 1 Point
[*]Reach 60 mins of playtime to earn Event Decoder + 1 Point
[*]Get 10 Human Player Kills or 15 Zombie Player Kills (Excluding Bots) to earn 1 Point
[*]Clear 1 session of Zombie Scenario in Hard or higher after scoring 100 kills to earn 1 Point[/list]

[*]Cumulative Rewards and Conditions
[list][*]Score 9 Total Points to earn Unique Decoder x2 + Event Decoder x2
[*]Score 18 Total Points to earn Unique Decoder x3 + Transcendence Decoder x1 + Class Decoder x2
[*]Score 27 Total Points to earn Unique Decoder x5 + Transcendence Decoder x2 + Class Decoder x3
[*]Score 36 Total Points to earn 10,000 Mileage Coupon x2 + Transcendence Decoder x4 + Unique Decoder x5
[*]Score 42 Total Points to earn Season Badge x400[/list]

[*]Notice
[list][*]Cumulative rewards are given only once per account.
[*]You can obtain up to 3 play points a day per account.
[*]Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*]Excludes Zombie Scenario: Survival: Double Gate / Survival: Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*]At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (excludes Studio Mode).
[*]Excludes auto hunt kills regardless of mode.
[*]All remaining play points will be removed during maintenance on 3/22.[/list][/list]


[h3]Mileage Auction Event (3/8 - 3/14)[/h3]
Log in now to get the items you need!

[list][*]Auction Feature / Content
[list][*]Item Rank: Premium (All weapons except for premium are Normal Rank)
[*]Auction Time: 1 hour for all items
[*]Number of Auction Listings: 2 (Increases based on VIP rank)
[*]Market Price of Items: When listing an item, you can check the current Auction House market price (Lowest bid and direct purchase prices).
[*]Item Display: Only items with the lowest bid or direct purchase price are displayed.
[*]Auction Settings: You can search by bid/direct purchase price, enhancement level, and weapon name.
[*]Sell-to-System Feature: When an auction is unsuccessful, you'll have the opportunity to use the sell-to-system feature.
[*]Auction Hours: 24 Hours (12: 00: 00 AM – 11: 59: 59 PM) - When auction hours end, currently listed items will be canceled.[/list]

[*]Notice
[list][*]The remaining time is shown in 5-minute increments for listed auction items.
[*]You can only bid on 1 item at a time.
[*]Regular auction items will be listed with a 30% fee included in the initial bidding price.
[*]If an item listed for auction is not sold, the item will be returned.
[*]Items listed for auction can be purchased immediately at the direct purchase price.
[*]If you list an item for auction, you cannot withdraw it until the auction's duration has ended.
[*]The item you listed may be shown on the bid page.
[*]When listing an item, you can easily check the actual amount you will receive under the Net Reward section.
[*]Some recently released weapons cannot be listed at auction.[/list][/list]


[u][h2]Shop Update[/h2][/u]

[h3]Transcendence Classes Kai/Lynn Promotion (3/8 - 4/5)[/h3]
Kai and Lynn will make a special appearance in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders during the event.

[list][*]Kai
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/3a29f01b3b794ff76f8fe793a9b35ec80be9482c.png[/img]
[list][*]Description: After losing his parents in a sudden accident, a young child named William was taken into an orphanage with the help of Victor. There, he met Lynn, and together forged a sibling-like bond. After leaving the orphanage, William joined the Special Forces with Lynn and began assisting Victor, until he learned that his parents had died thanks to Victor's quarantine order to help reduce the spread of the virus. After learning the truth, William changed his name to Kai and swore a vow to make everyone who was involved with the death of his parents meet a painful end.
[*]Paired Weapon: Whip Sword
[*]Paired Effect: Decreases attack count required to use the Fall continuous attack for the Whip Sword by one.
[*]Exclusive Skill: Time for Revenge
[list][*]Passive: Increases damage dealt to Elite and Boss monsters.
Applies the Swiftfoot Add-On Effect (Can be stacked to increase the effect)
Increases damage when playing a Scenario with a Lynn character (Connection effect applied).
[*]Active: Generates a Smokescreen Grenade that neutralizes enemy attacks and briefly grants the Conceal effect (Conceal is removed upon taking damage).
Increased Critical Strike chance and Melee Weapon damage for a short time upon losing Conceal status.[/list][/list]

[*]Lynn
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d047fb3f65545f8586737cb4b5eb429d652b9001.png[/img]
[list][*]Description: Lynn grew up in an orphanage after being rescued by Victor, who found her during a mission. She met William at the orphanage and followed him around like he was her older brother, and would later join Victor's Special Forces with him. One day, William left the unit without notice, and Lynn would later discover the shocking truth that he had become the terrorist known as Kai. Despite the devastating news, Lynn started to chase after Kai, hoping to turn him back to the right side.
[*]Paired Weapon: Whip Sword
[*]Paired Effect: Decreases attack count required to use the Decay continuous attack for the Whip Sword by one.
[*]Exclusive Skill: Silent Takedown
[list][*]Passive: Increases damage dealt to Elite and Boss monsters.
Applies the Revenge Add-On Effect (Can be stacked to increase the effect).
Increases damage when playing a Scenario with a Kai character (Connection effect applied).
[*]Active: Generates a Smokescreen Grenade that neutralizes enemy attacks and briefly grants the Conceal effect (Conceal is removed upon taking damage).
Increased attack evasion rate and Melee Weapon damage for a short time upon losing Conceal status.[/list][/list][/list]


[h3]Transcendence Classes Kai/Lynn Guaranteed Giveaway (3/8 - 4/5)[/h3]
Get 2 guaranteed new Transcendence Classes (Kai, Lynn) based on how many Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders are used during the event!

[list][*]Conditions and Rewards
[list][*]Upon reaching 150 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use.
[*]Upon reaching 300 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use.
[*]Select one: Kai + Tactical Goggles OR Lynn + Dragon Mask
[list][*]Tactical Goggles
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/93ab5b2dbccd8393a4f2855a28c05f203ec866f0.png[/img]
[*]Dragon Mask
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e53816e90ca46b8c088626fe6cfb4ce8b27a0be5.png[/img][/list][/list]
[*]Notice
[list][*]1 Guaranteed Point given each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
[*]3 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Class Premium Decoder.
[*]Upon selecting Kai, automatically get the permanent exclusive costume, Tactical Goggles.
[*]Upon selecting Lynn, automatically get the permanent exclusive costume, Dragon Mask.
[*]Guaranteed Giveaway rewards can only be received once per account.[/list][/list]


[h3]Electron-V Promotion (3/8 - 3/22)[/h3]
This Unique Weapon will make a special appearance in Unique Decoders and Unique Premium Decoders during the event.

[list][*]Electron-V
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/6aa7a721ee6803d7617e9274515c0bcd238e27c7.png[/img]
[list][*]Unique Premium Decoder Drop Rate: 5%
[*]Unique Decoder Drop Rate: 1%
[*]Description: A two-shot burst assault rifle that fires a total of 50 energy rounds. Its Special Feature allows the use of special ammo that charges automatically upon firing and can be used immediately in your immediate surroundings, or fired towards your desired target.
[*]Electron-V will be permanently added to the Unique Decoder and the Unique Premium Decoder starting 3/22 until the promotion ends.[/list][/list]

[u][h2]MISC[/h2][/u]
[list][*]Notice: The latest exchange rates have been reflected as of March 8, 2023. Please be advised.[/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: February 22nd
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9cb9c6a513658c3d72490b51f880bd30e98c7c57.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list]
[b][*]Content: New Zombie Scenario 8-3 Map Released[/b]Experience Ritsuka's story in the new Zombie Scenario!

[b][*] Content: Season 15: Cyborgs[/b]The theme for Season 15 is [Cyborgs], the future of humanity!

[b][*] Spring Fling Event (2/22 - 3/8)[/b]Participate in missions every day during the event to earn points!

[b][*] Transcendence Weapon "Whip Sword" Promotion (2/22 - 3/22)[/b]The Whip Sword can drop from the Transcendence Premium Decoder and Transcendence Decoder during the event.[/list]

Check out the following sections for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[u][h2]New Content[/h2][/u]

[h3]Zombie New Scenario 8-3 Map[/h3]
[list][*]Pursuit: Abandoned Hound
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/740bcab1c1c5aa04ea1131fa1c7fe4ab0d4ab62d.png[/img]
[list][*]This is the tale of Ritsuka's return to the Asia Red Army's hideout.

[*]Ritsuka received the request from Douglas Jacob to stop David Black and Erica. She ambushed them, but the mission was a failure, forcing her to retreat to the Asia Red Army's hideout.
However, the Asia Red Army's hideout is in ruins, as if a full-blown war had happened.
Ritsuka investigated the area to assess what had happened there.
Uncontrollable zombies swarmed out of the hideout, with no trace of the Asia Red Army allies anywhere. Ritsuka found herself enraged as she approached the truth.

[*]You can find detailed information in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/3641759926135697835][Zombie Scenario 8-3 Preview][/url].[/list][/list]

[h3]Season 15: Cyborg [/h3]
For details, please refer to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/3641759926135716419]Season 15 Pass Preview.[/url]

[list][*]Black Market Opens Early
[list][*]The Black Market will open early for players who reach Rank 100.
[*]Upon reaching Rank 100 on the current Season Pass, Season Missions will end while missions that offer Black Market Badges will refresh.
[*]New Item Added: CSO Pendant
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b73f3091327385d2691e2e9c956029a9ecc91d9a.png[/img]
[/list]

[*]Repurchasing Past Season Passes
[list][*]A page where past season items can be purchased will become available to those who reach Rank 100 on the Season Pass!
[*]The page begins with the player's progress from the past season, and they can purchase Season Pass Ranks from the page to obtain items.
[*]Available Previous Season Passes: Seasons 9, 10, 11, 12, 13
[*]The Black Market can be accessed via the [Missions] menu after reaching Rank 100.
[*]All Black Market Badges you've obtained will disappear once a new season begins.[/list]

[*]Season Reward Weapons
[list][*]Dart Pistol TECH (Secondary Weapon)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e4515819015f3fa727d27625ecbdb65aa5a8aa7d.png[/img]
[list][*]A pistol designed to fire 7 special darts. It may seem like a regular toy gun, but it has a hidden feature which will shock opponents, causing targets to suffer damage over time after being hit.[/list]

[*]Crowbar Maverick TECH (Melee Weapon)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/bcc96d1b2792ca8fb37f8dec448412a036fed332.png[/img]
[list][*]A crowbar, which is used to remove or dismantle nails and was redesigned by an unknown terrorist group. It is equipped with a taser that causes a stiffening effect, transforming it into a powerful melee weapon.[/list]

[*]Avalanche TECH (Primary Weapon)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/fddbfbda3dafdddd08c5d3750faf12d359707aba.png[/img]
[list][*]This machine gun, which fires 200 rounds of 7.62mm ammo, features a rapid-fire mode that can be used to mow down the enemy. It's created from unknown technology.[/list]

[*]Laser Storm (Primary Weapon)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1a662b4e3996b0620398b484d084d35b8351c277.png[/img]
[list][*]A sub-machine gun that fires 45 rounds of 45.ACP ammo. It has very low recoil and a high rate of fire. It's made of an extremely light material through unknown means, which makes it highly portable. Normal attacks charge special rounds, which can be used for a special attack by right-clicking.[/list][/list]

[*]Zombie Costumes
[list][*]Cyborg Normal Zombie
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ebf0ec03335ea5b55a75cfe2bc8fa044c42fa466.png[/img]
[*]Allows the use of Cyborg Zombie. This will change the appearance of your Cyborg Zombie.[/list]

[*]Weapon Paints
[list][*]Cyborg Weapon Paint
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/196f4e8aa7bc9678bfe7f926381f012537c73e7b.png[/img]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: February 8th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a6b8a33bb4b5033e8c0058181d28384cf10e3af6.jpg[/img]
Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list]
[b][*] Random Weapon Zombie Hero Event (2/8 – 2/22)[/b]The perfect opportunity to play Random Weapon Zombie Hero!

[b][*] First Lunar New Year Full Moon - Moon Gazing Event (2/8 – 2/22)[/b]Gaze up and wish upon a moon! 

[b][*] Valentine Heart Attack Event (2/8 – 2/22)[/b]Love blooms this Valentine's in the form of explosive, event-exclusive Heart Grenades! Share the love and get rewards!

[b][*] Agent Ritsuka & Pop Star Alin Transcendence Class Promotion (2/8 – 3/8)[/b]Agent Ritsuka and Pop Star Alin will make a special appearance in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders during the event.[/list]

Check out the following sections for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h3]Random Weapon Zombie Hero Event (2/8 – 2/22)[/h3]
The perfect opportunity to play Random Weapon Zombie Hero!
[list][*]Featured Maps
[list][*]Italy
[*]Assault
[*]Dust
[*]Abyss 2[/list][/list]
[list][*]Weapon Update
[list][*]Ancient Keeper
[*]Ancient Bringer
[*]Ancient Berserker
[*]Cyclops
[*]Hauteclere
[*]Twin Hawk
[*]Arbalest
[*]Hécate II Umbra[/list][/list]


[h3]Good-Bye Season 14 Double-Up Event (2/8 – 2/22)[/h3]
Earn double the amount of Season Badges from daily and weekly missions during the event.


[h3]First Lunar New Year Full Moon - Moon Gazing Event (2/8 – 2/22)[/h3]
Gaze up and wish upon a moon! 
[list][*]How to Participate
[list][*]Reach 20/40/60 minutes of playtime in any mode to Moon Gaze 1 time each (up to 3 times a day)[/list][/list]
[list][*]Conditions / Rewards
[list][*]Moon Gazing 3 times: Rare Decoder x10
[*]Moon Gazing 6 times: Unique Decoder x2
[*]Moon Gazing 9 times: Event Decoder x2 + Rare Decoder x10  
[*]Moon Gazing 15 times: 10,000 Mileage Coupon + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x5
[*]Moon Gazing 21 times: First Lunar New Year Full Moon Nameplate (300 Days)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/08326abfc519fc562f1f2b77374da87954924797.png[/img]
[*]Moon Gazing 27 times: Class Decoder x5 + Rare Decoder x10
[*]Moon Gazing 33 times: Transcendence Decoder x3 + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5 
[*]Moon Gazing 36 times: Class Decoder x5 + 10,000 Mileage Coupon[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]You can only Moon Gaze up to 3 times a day 
[*]Rewards can only be received once per account
[*]Player Requirement: 3 or more[/list][/list]


[h3]Valentine Heart Grenade Giveaway (2/8 – 2/22)[/h3]
Celebrate Valentine's with a bang! Instead of gifting chocolates, start chucking these once-a-year Heart Grenades!
[list][*]Receive a Heart Grenade upon First Login
[list][*]Use for free during the event.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Heart Grenades will be removed when the event ends.[/list][/list]


[h3]Valentine Heart Attack Event (2/8 – 2/22)[/h3]
Love blooms this Valentine's in the form of explosive, event-exclusive Heart Grenades! Share the love and get rewards!
[list][*]Conditions
[list][*]Receive an event reward for each Kill you get with a Heart Grenade!
[*]When you use the Heart Grenade in Zombie Mutant, Zombie Evolution, Zombie Hero, or Zombie Z modes, damage will be randomly applied to the blast.
[*]- Damage Chances: 50% chance for normal damage, 40% chance for 2x damage, and 10% chance for one-hit-kill damage[/list][/list]
[list][*]Event Rewards
[list][*]Get 1 of the following rewards at random:
[*]100 Mileage Coupon
[*]Zombie Damage Meter (7 Days)
[*]Left Heart Spray
[*]Right Heart Spray
[*]Heart of Love Spray
[*]Grade 1 Parts Reward Box
[*]Grade 2 Parts Reward Box
[*]Grade 3 Parts Reward Box
[*]Grade 4 Parts Reward Box
[*]Grade 5 Parts Reward Box
[*]Unique Decoder
[*]Rare Decoder x20
[*]Event Decoder
[*]Nickname Change
[*]Reduced Respawn Time (30 Days)
[*]Laugh Emoji Spray (Yuri) (Permanent)
[*]Bleh Emoji Spray (Yuri) (Permanent)
[*]Flustered Emoji Spray (Yuri) (Permanent)
[*]Angry Emoji Spray (Yuri) (Permanent)
[*]Sad Emoji Spray (Yuri) (Permanent)
[*]Wink Emoji Spray (Yuri) (Permanent)
[*]Heart Emoji Spray (Yuri) (Permanent)[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Player Requirement: 3 or more
[*]Excludes Studio Mode.
[*]Get rewards up to 8 times a day per account. [/list][/list]


[h3]Heart Grenade Kill Count Event (2/8 – 2/22)[/h3]
Rack up kills with the Heart Grenade during the event to receive rewards!
[list][*]Rewards
[list][*]8 Kills: 500 Mileage + Rare Decoder x3
[*]24 Kills: Zombie Damage Meter (7 Days) + Rare Decoder x5 + Unique Decoder x1
[*]40 Kills: Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x5 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*]48 Kills: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x5 + Unique Decoder x3
[*]56 Kills: Point Transcendence Decoder x10 + Point Class Decoder x10 + Event Decoder x3[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Each account can only receive rewards once.[/list][/list]


[u][h2]Shop Update[/h2][/u]

[h3]Transcendence Weapon Guaranteed Giveaway (2/8 – 2/22)[/h3]
Based on the number of Transcendence Premium Decoders and Transcendence Decoders used during the event, you will be guaranteed 1 weapon from the Rotation Group!
[list][*]Weapons in the Rotation Group
[list][*]Negev NG7 Ajax / Spell Lance Scarlet Rose / Lightning Fury / Satellite Mine[/list][/list]
[list][*]Conditions and Items
[list][*]Every 300 points, you can select 1 weapon from the Rotation Group.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]1 Guaranteed Point every time you use 1 Transcendence Decoder.[/list][/list]


[h3]Agent Ritsuka & Pop Star Alin Transcendence Class Promotion (2/8 – 3/8)[/h3]
Agent Ritsuka and Pop Star Alin will make a special appearance in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders during the event.
[list][*]Agent Ritsuka
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/acba22b17f89f8b29cd7601cff5a59655fff39c5.png[/img]
[list][*]Born in Asia, Ritsuka wandered from one war zone to the next and grew up in the midst of battle. She is currently under the employ of Kronos to kidnap or murder those who dare to resist the company. After being placed under heavy scrutiny due to the failed kidnapping of Ji Yoon Choi, she hid her affiliation and personally engages in missions to ensure their success. * This class has changed to the CT team.
[*]Exclusive Skill: You Think I'm Joking? - The skill activates automatically upon encountering an elite monster in a Zombie Scenario for a chance to instantly kill elite monsters and increase Ritsuka's attack power upon activation.
[*]The Shadow Blade Add-On effect is applied on this character in Zombie Scenario mode. (Can be stacked with other Add-Ons and the effect increases).[/list][/list]
[list][*]Pop Star Alin
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5b44c56ab3085b6dea1508d17a6404528c820170.png[/img]
[list][*]After making her escape with the help of the mercenaries, she couldn't risk revealing herself to the world. Even if she chose to go public, she could be marked for elimination by Kronos and the government agencies that work with them. That's why she chose to hide her identity and adopt the new persona of an idol. Idol by day and terrorist by night, she received a reinforcement request from Victor while out with Dominique to destroy another Kronos factory.
[*]Exclusive Skill: One, Two, Happiness! - Increases the Movement Speed of self and nearby allies within range. Creates a shield for allies and grants invincibility for self for a set duration.
[*]The Group Tactics Add-On effect is applied on this character in Zombie Scenario mode. (Can be stacked with other Add-Ons and the effect increases)
[*]A humming sound has been added when using the Psychic Sizer.[/list][/list]


[h3]Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (2/8 – 3/8)[/h3]
Get 2 guaranteed new Transcendence Classes (Agent Ritsuka, Pop Star Alin) based on how many Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders are used during the event!
[list][*]Conditions and Rewards
[list][*]Upon reaching 150 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use
[*]Upon reaching 300 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use
[*]Select one: Agent Ritsuka + Agent Sunglasses OR Pop Star Alin + Pink Crystal[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]1 Guaranteed Point given each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
[*]3 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Class Premium Decoder.
[*]Upon selecting Agent Ritsuka, automatically get the permanent exclusive costume, Agent Sunglasses.
[*]Upon selecting Pop Star Alin, automatically get the permanent exclusive costume, Pink Crystal.
[*]Guaranteed Giveaway rewards can only be received once per account.[/list][/list]


[h2][u]Other Changes[/u][/h2]

[list][*] Mission chain bug fix
[list][*] The mission chain bug will be fixed [/list]

[*] Arbalest update
[list][*] The normal attack won't be blocked by allies.
[*] The Cosmic Blackhole recharging time will be shorten.
[*] The weapon sound won't be played repeatably when using Cosmic Wave and Emotion same time.[/list]

[*] Studio contest reward distribution
[list][*] The studio contest reward will be distributed again[/list][/list]
