notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: October 5th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/6f571647994f9864e309d096dfeaa7558dd93973.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b]Content: New Zombie Scenario 8-2 Map Released[/b]
Experience the New Super Soldier Project of Kronos: Queen's Story of the Past in the new Zombie Scenario! 

[b]Event: Start the Firework Festival with a bang from the Firework Set! (10/5 – 10/19)[/b]
Play every day and collect Firework Sets to earn rewards! 

[b]Event: Epic Weapon Heaven Splitter Guaranteed Giveaway! (10/5 – 11/2)[/b]
Based on the amount of Epic Decoders used during the event, you could receive a Heaven Splitter (Permanent)!

[b]Event: Asura Hell Splitter Blueprint Promotion (10/5 – 11/2)[/b]
The Asura Hell Splitter is here! Purchase the Asura Hell Splitter blueprint for a guaranteed acquisition of the Asura Hell Splitter. [/list]
Check out the Details section below for more information.


[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]New Content[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/8484053203ad3b47eb7e05e6b261a6a7a6430a51.jpg[/img]
[h3][u]Zombie New Scenario 8-2 Map [/u][/h3]Pursuit: Planned Tragedy
[list][*] New Super Soldier Project of Kronos: Queen's Story of the Past
[*] A sudden power outage resulted in all the doors of the laboratory's experimental wards to open. Experiments such as Queen and Cyborg ended up escaping in midst of the chaos, even succeeding in hijacking a helicopter for their escape. Meanwhile, lab researchers monitored them from within the lab. They put together a tracking unit to lure them to a secure location and forced a crash landing by knocking out the helicopter rotors. Still, the Queen and her fellow experiments wished only to escape, but as they tried to leave the lavish, lifeless neon city, they were met by a horde of zombies and other, new experiments. All the while, the Kronos researchers were watching. Now a new experiment begins.
[*] You can find detailed information in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/3311859113637627185][Zombie Scenario 8-2 Preview][/url].[/list]


[h3][u]Game Improvements [/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] Inventory Lock System
- Added a locking feature to prevent important items from being accidentally lost.
- Locking the item will prevent the item from being auto-filled in situations where the item would be spent, such as disassembly, Enhancement Material selection, and auction use.
- Some items (provided by default, event items, etc.)  will have restricted locking features.

[*] Enhancement Simplification
- Inserting EXP Material has been removed from the process. A feature that guides the player when a high rank weapon is inserted has been added.
- Enhancement Guide and result pop-up window has been improved.

[*] Zombie Scenario Player Experience Improvements
- An escape feature has been added to use in when a character is stuck within the map. If you are unable to move for a set period of time, [ESC > Map Escape] becomes activated, and you can use it to move to the spawn area.
- Fixed an issue where some Phobos wouldn't appear during Pursuit: Last Clue.

[*] 6 BGM is now added to the Music Block in Studio Mode.

[*] Other Changes
- Hitbox errors, unnatural modeling, and animations have been revised through class modeling and animation improvements.
- Please refer to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/3300598937414642555][Developer's Letter][/url] for more details.[/list]



[h2]New Events[/h2]
[h3][u]Event: Mileage Auction Event (10/5 – 10/18)[/u][/h3]October opens with an open Mileage Auction! Log in now to get the items you need!
[list][*] Permanent Auction Item Added: Trinity Grenade

[*] Auction Feature / Content
- Item Rank: Premium (All weapons except for premium are Normal Rank)
- Auction Time: 1 hour for all items
- Number of Auction Listings: 2 (Increases based on VIP rank)
- Regarding the Market Price of Items:  When listing an item, you can check the current Auction House market price (Lowest bid and direct purchase prices)
- Item Display: Only items with the lowest bid or direct purchase price are displayed
- Auction Settings: You can search by bid or direct purchase price, enhancement level, and weapon name.
- Sell-to-System Feature: When an auction is unsuccessful, you'll have the opportunity to use the sell-to-system feature.
- Auction Hours: 24 Hours (12: 00: 00 AM – 11: 59: 59 PM) - When auction hours end, currently listed items will be canceled.

[*] Notice
- As the Trinity Grenade has been added, the M95 White Tiger has been removed from the premium.
- Lower Price Limit: 50,000 / Upper Price Limit: None
- The remaining time is shown in 5-minute increments for listed auction items.
- You can only bid on 1 item at a time.
- Regular auction items will be listed with a 30% fee included in the initial bidding price.
- If an item listed for auction is not sold, the item will be returned.
- Items listed for auction can be purchased immediately at the direct purchase price.
- If you list an item for auction, you cannot withdraw it until the auction's duration has ended.
- The item you listed may be shown on the bid page.
- When listing an item, you can easily check the actual amount you will receive under the Net Reward section.
- Some recently released weapons cannot be listed at auction.[/list]


[u][h3]1,000 Mileage Auction Event (10/7 – 10/9)[/h3][/u]During the auction period, a special item sold for 1,000 Mileage will appear at certain times.
[list][*] Time / Special Items
- 3:00 PM – 4:00 PM (CEST) / Spell Lance Scarlet Rose

[*] Notice
- 1,000-Mileage auction items will appear periodically during auction hours.
- Special items will appear within 10 minutes of the beginning of each auction hour, with bidding open for 10 minutes.
- Those who did not win the auction will be refunded 1,000 Mileage when the auction closes.
- Claim rewards by clicking Obtain after winning.[/list]


[u][h3]Start the Firework Festival with a bang from the Firework Set! (10/5 – 10/19)[/h3][/u]Play every day to get the Firework Set!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/3733cb977f6c837d56c9cb8131d13945afbf1d25.png[/img]
[list][*] How to Participate / Reward
- When you reach 20 minutes of playtime, you will receive 1 Firework Set (up to 3 a day).
- Get 1 Firework Set for clearing 1 session (success) by reaching 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard difficulty or higher. (Up to 7 a day)
- Get 3 Firework Sets for clearing 1 session (success) in Zombie Scenario Mode: Planned Tragedy on Hard difficulty or higher. (Up to 3 a day)
- Get 1 Firework Set each time you earn 8 Kill Points from kills/assists/human infections in a Zombie Mode. (Up to 7 a day)
- Get 3 Firework Sets for using Awakening skill 5 times in Zombie Conquest (beta). (Up to 3 a day)

[*] How to Earn Kill Points
- Zombie Kill as a Human: 3 Points
- Zombie Assist as a Human: 1 Point
- Human Infection as Zombie: 3 Points (Excluding bots)
- Human Infection Assist as Zombie: 0 Points

[*] Notice
- You can earn up to 10 Firework Sets a day.
- Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (excludes Studio Mode).

notes.title: Developer's Letter
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1e95bcc7124a5a9f096f394742a7e968be908cc5.jpg[/img]

Hello. This is the Dev team for Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio. 
 
Thanks to the large amount of interest that players have shown in the various contents of Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio, we were able to consider the future direction of development in many ways. 
 
The 10/05 (Wed) patch content will be communicated with Counter-Strike players here, 
for us to create a Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio for everyone, together. 
 
Today, we'd like to introduce some improvements we have prepared in response  
to the opinions of Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio's fans. 
  
#Character Modeling Revision #Zombie Scenario Unstuck Feature #Inventory Lock Feature & Enhancement Simplification 

 
[u][b][h3]Character Modeling Revision [/h3][/b][/u][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/157e68920fe259daaeb3576361ac4b94844029b4.jpg[/img]
Character Modeling has been revised for this patch. 
Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio's playable teams are divided in to Counter-Terrorist (CT) and Terrorist (TR) sides. 
For some weapons, the character grip animation on the weapon will vary between the two teams. 
 

[b]<Weapon Grip Animation Differences Per Team> [/b]
  
The problem was that certain classes were using the team motions wrong. The model shown in the game  
and the model on the game server weren't matching, so there were issues with hit detection. 
  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/3de23c5f833d17ffd4b0118c10b36a1858db8144.gif[/img]
<Before revision: Displayed appearance and the actual hitbox were misaligned, and shooting the target would not detect the hits>
  
To resolve this issue, we are going through the character modeling  
[b]and using a procedure where we are syncing the game server and in-game character models to be uniform. We began with the revision of human classes for now. 
After this update, we will be improving abnormal hitboxes. [/b]

 On another note,[b] the character animations of certain male and female classes will be improved to be more natural. [/b]The animations below are scheduled for improvement.

[b]<Male Class Fixes> [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e6c63efafae8863a43efb1cd278b3460576279b3.jpg[/img]
Aside from "Immortal Eric", who does not have the relevant issues, all classes were revised. 
 
[b]<Female Class Fixes>[/b]
Turtle neck issue 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/32fe058b29a79f781e84a13323119feae78951ac.jpg[/img]
  
Shoulder fix 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5d3fde27e94d0069d85f6da44e858c5be5138007.jpg[/img]

Other joints 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/32fe058b29a79f781e84a13323119feae78951ac.jpg[/img]
Aside from the classes without the relevant issues listed below, all female classes were revised. 

1	Queen
2	Anemone
3	Mirage
4	Ismael
5	Romy
6	Agent Ritsuka
 
We are continuously improving the game to enhance its overall quality, and we will do our best to quickly address other similar issues that remain in the game. 
 
[h3][u]Introduction of Zombie Scenario Unstuck Feature [/u][/h3]
There were issues of being stuck in Zombie Scenario, where the player would have to leave the game and try again as they could not progress in the game while stuck. 
To resolve this issue, [b]we have added the Unstuck feature in this update that you can use when you are stuck for more than a short time.  [/b]
If you are stuck and unable to move for more than 5 seconds, the Map Escape button will be activated in the ESC menu. 
  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f1113fa8f0e211d614c3bf3876148970ecb0591a.jpg[/img]
  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b1edfa8fe5bdafab773c12bb972a8e58ab7b0094.jpg[/img]
  
Pressing the Map Escape button will move the character to the current spawn point. The character will be moved to one of the spawn areas if they're stuck in the boss stage. 
   
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1e938da501c613067347e22c04b83ed95975b178.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/26f2c40afd4750f2a6709dd15de1f16de1581e5a.jpg[/img]
Please note that there is a cooldown before you can use the feature again. 
 
[u][h3]Inventory Lock Feature & Enhancement Simplification [/h3][/u][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/dc8079c0734b7641b6ac31611f30df26652cf670.png[/img]
Weapons, classes, items, etc. are being utilized as a materials for other systems, after a variety of items and system were added to the game. 
We confirmed that there were many cases where players were losing their items unintentionally as materials while using these systems, and that this has been a great inconvenience to them. 
Some players have suggested that there should be a feature to lock important items so that they cannot be disassembled or used as materials.
So, [b]we have added a Lock feature where valuable items can be locked so that they cannot be lost as materials through disassembly or trade.  [/b]
 
Some event items or pass items were already unavailable for trade or to be used as materials, so those will be distributed in the locked state. 
We will continuously improve and enhance this feature to avoid instances where player assets are unintentionally lost. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2064ac14c6858156cf04d08669a8f9b419ac8f6e.png[/img]
 
The existing Weapon Enhancement system is divided into 2 stages. One is where the Enhancement Material is added, and the other is the Enhancement attempt. So, it always required two clicks. 
There were some suggestions that this was inconvenient, so [b]we simplified them into a single click that takes care of both the material selection and the Enhancement attempt.  [/b]
Also, we added a step for weapons of high value, confirming that they have been selected as material, so that we can prevent a highly-valued weapon being accidentally used as material.  
 
 
We will continue to do our best to incorporate all of your suggestions and ideas to create a better gameplay experience for Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio. 
 
Thank you.

[*] Base game rules are the same as Zombie Hero.
[*] Available weapons are determined regardless of individual ownership.
[*] Armor distribution is fixed.
[*] When using a Supply Box (E key), instead of a shop window, you will be select another random weapon.
[*] Human heroes cannot be selected in this event mode.[/list]

[u][h3]Mystery Fragment Collection Event 1 (9/21 - 10/5)[/h3][/u]What rewards can you get by collecting Mystery Fragments? Log in now and collect to find out! Reach 10 minutes of playtime to receive the reward once a day.

[b]Log in count / reward[/b]
[list][*]  1 Day
- Mystery Fragment x1 + 500 Mileage Coupon x1 + Point Class Decoder x1
[*]  2 Days
- Mystery Fragment x1 + 500 Mileage Coupon x1 + Point Transcendence Decoder x1
[*]  3 Days
- Mystery Fragment x2 + 500 Mileage Coupon x2 + Point Class Decoder x1
[*]  4 Days
- Mystery Fragment x2 + 500 Mileage Coupon x2 + Point Transcendence Decoder x1
[*]  5 Days
- Mystery Fragment x3 + 500 Mileage Coupon x3 + Point Class Decoder x2
[*]  6 Days
- Mystery Fragment x3 + 500 Mileage Coupon x3 + Point Transcendence Decoder x2
[*]  7 Days
- Mystery Fragment x6 + 500 Mileage Coupon x4 + Point Class Decoder x2
[*]  8 Days
- Mystery Fragment x6 + 500 Mileage Coupon x4 + Point Transcendence Decoder x2
[*]  9 Days
- Mystery Fragment x8 + 500 Mileage Coupon x5 + Point Class Decoder x3
[*]  10 Days
- Mystery Fragment x8 + 500 Mileage Coupon x5 + Point Transcendence Decoder x3
[*]  11 Days
- Mystery Fragment x10 + 500 Mileage Coupon x6 + Point Class Decoder x3
[*]  12 Days
- Mystery Fragment x10 + 500 Mileage Coupon x6 + Point Transcendence Decoder x3
[*]  13 Days
- 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3 + Point Class Decoder x4
[*]  14 Days
- 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3 + Point Transcendence Decoder x4[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]  You can obtain up to 60 Mystery Fragments per account during this event.
[*]  This is an event that includes Studio Mode participation.
[*]  All Mystery Fragments will be removed during maintenance on 10/5 (Wed.)[/list]

[u][h3]Mystery Fragment Collection Event 2 (9/21 - 10/5) [/h3][/u]It's the second Mystery Fragment Collection! Collect the fragments by participating in special missions during the event!

[b]How to Participate / Reward[/b]
[list][*] Get 1 Mystery Fragment each time you earn 8 Kill Points from kills/assists/human infections in a Zombie Mode. (Up to 16 a day)
[*] Get 2 Mystery Fragments for clearing 1 session (success) by reaching 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode in hard or higher difficulty. (Up to 16 a day)
[*] Get 1 Mystery Fragment for each use of an Awakening skill in Zombie Conquest (beta). (Up to 5 a day)
[*] Get 2 Mystery Fragments for reaching 40 and 60 minutes of playtime. (Up to 4 a day)[/list]
[b]How to Earn Kill Points[/b]
[list][*] Zombie Kill as a Human: 3 Points
[*] Zombie Assist as a Human: 1 Point
[*] Human Infection as Zombie: 3 Points (Excluding bots)
[*] Human Infection Assist as Zombie: 0 Points[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*] You can obtain up to 20 Mystery Fragments per account during this event.
[*] Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (excludes Studio Mode).
[*] The event includes Laboratory mode, but excludes auto hunt kills.
[*] Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution / Zombie Darkness / Zombies Conquest (beta)
[*] Excludes Zombie Scenario: Survival: Double Gate / Survival: Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*] At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario Mode missions.
[*] All Mystery Fragments will be removed during maintenance on 10/5 (Wed.)[/list]

[u][h3]Mystery Fragment Collection Event 3 - Who wants to open the Mystery Reward Box? (9/21 - 10/5) [/h3][/u]You will receive additional rewards for the total amount of Mystery Fragments collected over the event period.

[b]Mystery Fragment Total Count / Reward[/b]
[list][*] (For First Login)/ Magnum Shooter (3 Days) + SG552 Cerberus (3 Days) + SKULL-T9 (3 Days)
[*] 10 Fragments/ Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x5 + 3,000 Mileage Coupon
[*] 50 Fragments/ Rare Decoder x10 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*] 100 Fragments/ Unique Decoder x10 + 6,000 Mileage Coupon
[*] 150 Fragments/ Event Decoder x10 + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x5
[*] 200 Fragments/ Class Decoder x10 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*] 250 Fragments/ Transcendence Decoder x10 + 10,000 Mileage Coupon
[*] 300 Fragments/ Mystery Box x1 + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x10 + 200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x10[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*] Select and obtain one item from the Mystery Box: Magnum Shooter / SG552 Cerberus / SKULL-T9 Permanent
[*] Cumulative reward can only be obtained once per account.
[*] Mystery Fragments and Mystery Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 10/5 (Wed.)[/list]

[u][h3]Bonus Disassembly Event (9/21 – 10/4)[/h3][/u]You can participate in the Bonus Disassembly Event by clicking the "Bonus Disassembly" button at the bottom of the Lobby. During the event, 10 players can select the weapons they want to disassemble. One player will receive extra mileage. Participants can get 500 mileage for each weapon they disassemble.

[b]Details[/b]
[list][*] Weekdays and Weekends - 14:00 - 18:00 CEST
[*] Minimum Participation Mileage: 5,000
[*] Some items will be adjusted based on the weapon's rarity.
[*] Table ranks are in the order of highest value first.
[*] Weapon criteria are determined on the day the Bonus Disassembly Event starts. If the weapon's rank changes, its value in the Bonus Disassembly Event will be updated.[/list]


[h2]Shop Update[/h2]
[u][h3]Transcendence Class ‘Ismael, Ethan’ Promotion (9/21 - 10/19)[/h3][/u]Two new Transcendence Classes (Ismael and Ethan) will make a special appearance in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders during the event.

[b]Decoder Drop Rates[/b]
[list][*] Premium Class Decoder: Ismael and Ethan are each 2%
[*] Class Decoder: Ismael and Ethan are each 0.5%[/list]
[b]Ismael[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/68f41de924648253f239ac4d78c8b338ed92e684.png[/img]
[list][*]  As a human-vampire hybrid born into a noble family, she has lived her life suffering from discrimination and abuse because of her mixed blood. Her pride as nobility has become a twisted defense mechanism that leads her to look down upon everything. While she appears human, her vampiric blood gives her incredible physical abilities. She is the sole survivor of her family, her parents having been executed by inquisitors when the townsfolk sold them out. She joined a hunter's guild that highly values her abilities, making a living killing those who could be her brothers or sisters.
[*]  Paired Effect: Increases the maximum penetration for Failnaught's charged shot.
[*]  Exclusive Skill: Feast of Blood - In Zombie Scenario, she can use this skill to increase the attack power of herself and allies by 30% for 10 seconds, while restoring her HP for 1% of the damage she deals. Infinite Ammo effect is applied during the duration of this buff (herself and allies). Allies nearby get the buff, but the HP restoring skill is only applied to herself.[/list]
[b]Ethan[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/4e80cf9df1a0abbea9812217b77a616b4ba8a060.png[/img]
[list][*] An inquisitor who eliminates evil and strives to do good. He has eliminated numerous villains, as if to prove his actions are worth more than words. His calm voice and handsome appearance have made him very popular. While he looks calm and gentle on the outside, he loses his cool if he makes a mistake or faces an unexpected situation. He has conflicting feelings towards Ismael, who has vampire blood despite being a hunter. He watches her closely, waiting for the moment she proves herself evil.
[*] Paired Effect: Increases the explosion damage for Failnaught's charged shot.
[*] Exclusive Skill: Barrier - In Zombie Scenario, he can use this skill to create a barrier in front of him. He creates a shield for himself and nearby allies, and slows the movement speed of monsters who pass through the barrier.[/list]
[b]Ismael / Ethan Common Applications[/b]
[list][*] Transcendence Class exclusive voices are applied.
[*] Paired Weapon: Failnaught
[*] +10% EXP/Points
[*] In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes.
[*] Adds 1 initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
[*] Displays your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
[*] Upon killing an enemy, leaves a unique mark at the target location.[/list]

[u][h3]Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (9/21 - 10/19)[/h3][/u]Get guaranteed 2 Transcendence Classes (Ismael and Ethan) based on how many Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders are used during the event!

[b]Conditions and Rewards[/b]
[list][*] Upon reaching 150 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use
[*] Upon reaching 300 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use
[*] Select one from Ismael + Black Rose Shuriken or Ethan + Inquisitor's Hourglass[/list]
[b]Black Rose Shuriken[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/23c2ebaf46a4b75d2dbb12f6b195560c9d4521c1.png[/img]

[b]Inquisitor's Hourglass[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b0403ed0ca6844f839cf8de7471a4e01975b1369.png[/img]

[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*] 1 Guaranteed Point given each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
[*] 3 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Class Premium Decoder.
[*] Selecting Ismael (Permanent) will automatically provide Black Rose Shuriken (Permanent).
[*] Selecting Ethan (Permanent) will automatically provide Inquisitor's Hourglass (Permanent).
[*] Guaranteed Giveaway rewards can be granted only once per account. [/list]


[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2]
[u][h3]Exchange Rate Updated[/h3][/u][list][*] The latest exchange rates have been reflected as of September 21, 2022. Please be advised.[/list][u][h3]Bug Fix[/h3][/u][list][*]Fixed the event duration of the event 'Ismael and Ethan Guaranteed Giveaway' ingame where it incorrectly showed 10.5 when it should have indicated 10.19.[/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: September 7th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/27e86a406a0c95555728b6c2989828974f99c2c6.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b]Content: Zombie Scenario Event Mode (9/7 - 9/21)[/b]
Ability Mode is here! Zombie Ability Scenario is different from other Scenarios thus far. Go experience the power now!

[b]Event: Zombie Scenario Event Mode Max Level Ability Event (9/7 - 9/21)[/b]
Go experience the new Zombie Scenario (Event Mode) and earn rewards during the event period!

[b]Event: Transcendence Weapon Failnaught Guaranteed Giveaway Event[/b]
Depending on the number of Transcendence Premium Decoders and Transcendence Decoders used during the event, you could receive a Failnaught (Permanent)![/list]
Check out the Details section below for more information.


[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]


[h2]New Content[/h2]

[u][h3]Zombie Scenario New Event Mode Guide (9/7 - 9/21)[/h3][/u]For details, please refer to the [Zombie Ability Scenario Preview].

[b]Ability[/b]
[list][*] Ability: A power that inflicts special damage on monsters, apart from weapons and character skills
[*] Abilities cannot inflict damage on structures.
[*] You can only have 1 Ability.
[*] Abilities change according to acquisition rates, but ability levels can always increase.
[*] Ability Points are earned in increments of 12 levels, from player Lv. 27.
 - Max Level for Abilities is 7.
 - You can also earn EXP from Ability attacks.[/list]
[b]Ability Types[/b]
[list][*] Blizzard: An ice storm surrounds the player. Inflicts damage on monsters within range.
[*] Meteor: A meteor falls around the player. Inflicts big damage on the enemy.
[*] Energy Round: Fires a piercing Energy Round straight ahead.
[*] Gaebolg: Attacking enemies leaves a mark, shortly followed by a spear of light that inflicts damage.
[*] Flame: Attacks will inflict fire damage. Killing a burning enemy will damage other enemies around them.
[*] Splash Ball: Shoots a sphere forward that penetrates enemies and ricochets on impact with walls.[/list]
[b]Maps for the Event[/b]
[list][*] Total of 2: Truth Uncovered (7-4), An Approaching Threat (8-1)[/list]

[u][h3]VIP System Improvement[/h3][/u]VIP System has been relocated to the Home screen, for easier access.

[b]VIP System page has been improved.[/b]
[list][*] Privileges at all ranks are now available for viewing.
[*] Tooltip feature has been added to enable players to see the information of reward items.
[*] Information required for Rank upgrades is now more accessible.[/list]
[b]VIP System Perk Renewal[/b]
[list][*] VIP Perk Enhanced: Supplied mileage increased + Zombie Scenario clear reward enhanced
[*] VIP Additional Perks
 - Additional distribution of Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon (100)
 - Additional distribution of Exploration Success Rate-Up 20%
 - Additional distribution of Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x3[/list]
[b]VIP System Weapon Catalog Renewal[/b]
[list][*] Available items on Transcendence Decoders updated, and rotation weapons added to VIP Weapon Pass
[*] Available items on Class Decoders updated, and rotation classes added to Class Pass distributed above Diamond Rank
[*] Unique Weapon Pass distributed above Platinum Rank now updated with the Unique Decoder's contents 
[*] Rare Weapon Pass distributed above Gold Rank now updated with the Rare Decoder's contents[/list]

[h3][u]Zombie Conquest (beta) Mode Update Information[/u][/h3]For details, please refer to the[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/3386162890792249687] [Zombie Conquest (beta) Update Preview][/url].

[b]Some items in the supplied weapon list per base for the Human Team will be changed.[/b]

[b]Added 2 Zombies[/b]
[list][*] Blotter Zombie is now available from the 2nd base.
[*] Aksha Zombie is now available from the 3rd base.[/list]
[b]Zombie Awakening Effect Change[/b]
[list][*] Light Zombie: Previous awakening effect removed. Conceal duration and cooldown decreased, damage and range during Conceal increased, stun and knockback during Conceal decreased
[*] Venom Guard: Increased range of damage inflicted on enemies nearby during Awakening[/list]
[b]Maps added and bases changed[/b]
[list][*] Assault and Dust maps will be added.
[*] Bases will now appear in fixed locations on Town Hall and Skyscraper maps.[/list]
[b]Safe Zone: Respawn Areas of both teams are set as Safe Zones.[/b]
[list][*] Players located inside the safe zones do not take damage, and they can attack outward.
[*] Players outside of the safe zone cannot attack inside.
[*] Safe zones can only be entered by that team's members. The opposing team cannot enter the safe zone.
[*] Humans can press B inside the Safe Zone to access the purchase menu.
 - If you're using supplied weapons, the weapon list will not change until you die.
 - If the base changes, players will be able to purchase weapons relevant to the next base in the safe zone.[/list]
[b]Waiting Room Team Integration: Players will be displayed in a single list in the waiting room instead of on their teams.[/b]
[list][*] Players will be assigned to A and B teams when the game begins. Players who join while the match is already in progress will join the team with less players. If both teams have the same number of players, they'll be placed randomly. 
[*] [Extra Room Settings > Separate Integrated Team] option will be added, and selecting this option will separate the A and B team members to play.[/list]
[b]Other Information[/b]
[list][*] End of Session related revision: information displayed when the session ends early will include more details.[/list]


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[u][h3]Zombie Scenario Event Mode Max Level Ability Event (9/7 - 9/21)[/h3][/u]Go experience the new Zombie Scenario (Event Mode) and earn rewards during the event period!

[b]How to Participate [/b]
[list][*] Reach Lv. 7 (Max Level) on Normal or higher in Ability once[/list]
[b]Reward Contents (You'll have a chance to get one of these items)[/b]
[list][*] Point Class Decoder x3/ Point Transcendence Decoder x3/ Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x2/ Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x2/ Exploration Success Rate-Up +20% x5\n Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon 200 x5/ VIP Free Pass (1 Day) x1[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*] Event rewards can be earned up to 2x a day.
[*] There are two relevant Zombie Scenario modes: Truth Uncovered (7-4), An Approaching Threat (8-1).
[*] Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players. (Event Mode default settings)
[*] At least 5 minutes of playtime is required to participate in the event.[/list]

[h3][u]Zombie Scenario Event Mode Special Reward Giveaway (9/7 - 9/21)[/u][/h3]You will receive rewards based on the total number of times you have reached Ability Lv. 7 (Max Level) during the event!

[b]Total / Rewards[/b]
[list][*] 6 times / Rare Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x2 + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x2
[*] 8 times / Rare Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x2 + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x2
[*] 10 times / Unique Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x3 + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x3
[*] 12 times / Unique Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x3 + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x3
[*] 14 times / Event Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x4 + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x4
[*] 16 times / Event Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x4 + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x4
[*] 18 times / Class Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x5 + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5
[*] 20 times / Class Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x5 + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5
[*] 22 times / Transcendence Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x10 + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x10
[*] 24 times / Transcendence Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x10 + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x10[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*] Can be claimed once per account.
[*] Reaching Ability Lv. 7 only counts up to 2x a day.
[*] There are two relevant Zombie Scenario modes: Truth Uncovered (7-4), An Approaching Threat (8-1).
[*] Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players. (Event Mode default setting)
[*] At least 5 minutes of playtime is required to participate in the event.
[*] The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list]

[u][h3]New and Returning Player Welcome Attendance Event (9/7 - Permanent) [/h3][/u]New and returning players get cumulative rewards by staying logged in for 10 minutes every day during the event.

[b]Login Days / Reward[/b]
[list][*] 1 Day: Select One from Point Transcendence Decoder x1 / Point Class Decoder x1 / 500 Mileage
[*] 2 Days: Select One from Point Transcendence Decoder x2 / Point Class Decoder x2 / 1,000 Mileage
[*] 3 Days: Select One from Point Transcendence Decoder x3 / Point Class Decoder x3 / 2,000 Mileage
[*] 4 Days: Select One from Point Transcendence Decoder x4 / Point Class Decoder x4 / 3,000 Mileage
[*] 5 Days: Select One from Point Transcendence Decoder x5 / Point Class Decoder x5 / 4,000 Mileage
[*] 6 Days: Select One from Point Transcendence Decoder x6 / Point Class Decoder x6 / 5,000 Mileage
[*] 7 Days: Point Transcendence Decoder x10 + Point Class Decoder x10 + VIP Free Pass (2 Day) all distributed[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*] Can only be obtained once per account.
[*] Returning players are those who have not logged in for 30 days or longer.[/list]

[h3][u]Mileage Auction Special Event (9/9 - 9/13) [/u][/h3]It's a 10,000 Mileage special event, available through the [Event] tab during the Mileage Auction period! Special items priced at 10,000 Mileage will appear periodically.

[b]Time[/b]
[list][*] Appears four times a day at a time between 16:00 and 17:00 (CEST)/ 21:00 and 22:00 (SEA)[/list]
[b]Special Items[/b]
[list][*] X-TRACKER
[*] Infinity Laser Fist
[*] Dual Beretta Gunslinger
[*] Barrett M95 White Tiger
[*] Dual Sword Phantom Slayer
[*] Negev NG-7 Ajax
[*] Trinity Grenade
[*] Psychic Harmonium
[*] Lightning Fury 
[*] Failnaught[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*] After the 10,000 Mileage auction is over, participants who haven't won will have their 10,000 Mileage refunded.
[*] 10,000 Mileage bids can be made 10 minutes after the special auction begins.
[*] Claim the contents by clicking Obtain after winning the auction.[/list]


[h2]Shop Update[/h2]

[u][h3]Transcendence Weapon "Failnaught" Promotion (9/7 - 10/5)[/h3][/u]The Failnaught can drop from the Transcendence Premium Decoder and Transcendence Decoder during the event.

[b]Failnaught Drop Rate[/b]
[list][*] Transcendence Premium Decoder: 3%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9ae7ae80146659b122e91f27dc2ed464032ef586.png[/img]
[*] Transcendence Decoder: 0.45%[/list]
[b]Failnaught[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0d1188089f47e94861b1086ef08f7e8e8bc13cc2.png[/img]
[list][*] Failnaught fires 250 holy arrows, automatically aiming at the closest enemies within range of the crosshairs when using the default firing mode. Hitting the same enemy with the default firing mode stacks a mark. Upon reaching 5 stacks, damage is transferred to nearby enemies and the stacks are reset. While charging up, the Hunter's Eye activates, allowing you to learn the location of nearby enemies and attack through obstacles. The default firing mode's auto-aim and stack effects, as well as the Hunter's Eye, will not be triggered in specific modes (Zombie/Human Scenario, Zombie Shelter, or Zombie Giant).[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*] All unused Transcendence Premium Decoders will be removed during maintenance on 10/5 (Wed).
[*] 500 mileage will be awarded in return for each Transcendence Premium Decoder removed in this manner.
[*] Transcendence Decoder is always available for sale.
[*] Transcendence Premium Decoder is available for sale until maintenance on 10/5 (Wed).
[*] Check for details in Decoder Rates on the web page after 9/7 (Wed) maintenance.[/list]

[h3][u]New Transcendence Weapon Failnaught Guaranteed Giveaway (9/7 - 10/5)[/u][/h3]Depending on the number of Transcendence Premium Decoders and Transcendence Decoders used during the event, you could receive a Failnaught (Permanent)!

[b]Conditions and Items[/b]
[list][*] You will receive a Failnaught (permanent) every time you reach 300 points.[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*] 6 Guaranteed Points are earned each time you use 1 Transcendence Premium Decoder.
[*] 1 Guaranteed Point is earned each time you use 1 Transcendence Decoder.[/list]

Humans can press B inside the Safe Zone to access the purchase menu.
If you're using supplied weapons, the weapon list will not change until you die.
If the base changes, players will be able to purchase weapons relevant to the next base in the safe zone.
Waiting Room Team Integration: Players will be displayed in a single list in the waiting room instead of on their teams.

Players will be assigned to A and B teams when the game begins. Players who join while the match is already in progress will join the team with less players. If both teams have the same number of players, they'll be placed randomly.
[Extra Room Settings > Separate Integrated Team] option will be added, and selecting this option will separate the A and B team members to play.
End of Session related revision: information displayed when the session ends early will include more details.
Reach Lv. 7 (Max Level) on Normal or higher in Ability once

Point Class Decoder x3/ Point Transcendence Decoder x3/ Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x2/ Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x2/ Exploration Success Rate-Up +20% x5
 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon 200 x5/ VIP Free Pass (1 Day) x1
Event rewards can be earned up to 2x a day.
There are two relevant Zombie Scenario modes: Truth Uncovered (7-4), An Approaching Threat (8-1).
Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players. (Event Mode default settings)
At least 5 minutes of playtime is required to participate in the event.
You will receive rewards based on the total number of times you have reached Ability Lv. 7 (Max Level) during the event!
6 times / Rare Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x2 + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x2
8 times / Rare Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x2 + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x2
10 times / Unique Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x3 + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x3
12 times / Unique Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x3 + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x3
14 times / Event Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x4 + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x4
16 times / Event Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x4 + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x4
18 times / Class Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x5 + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5
20 times / Class Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x5 + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5
22 times / Transcendence Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x10 + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x10
24 times / Transcendence Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x10 + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x10
Can be claimed once per account.
Reaching Ability Lv. 7 only counts up to 2x a day.
The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.
New and returning players get cumulative rewards by staying logged in for 10 minutes every day during the event.
1 Day: Select One from Point Transcendence Decoder x1 / Point Class Decoder x1 / 500 Mileage
2 Days: Select One from Point Transcendence Decoder x2 / Point Class Decoder x2 / 1,000 Mileage
3 Days: Select One from Point Transcendence Decoder x3 / Point Class Decoder x3 / 2,000 Mileage
4 Days: Select One from Point Transcendence Decoder x4 / Point Class Decoder x4 / 3,000 Mileage
5 Days: Select One from Point Transcendence Decoder x5 / Point Class Decoder x5 / 4,000 Mileage
6 Days: Select One from Point Transcendence Decoder x6 / Point Class Decoder x6 / 5,000 Mileage
7 Days: Point Transcendence Decoder x10 + Point Class Decoder x10 + VIP Free Pass (2 Day) all distributed
Can only be obtained once per account.
Returning players are those who have not logged in for 30 days or longer.
It's a 10,000 Mileage special event, available through the [Event] tab during the Mileage Auction period! Special items priced at 10,000 Mileage will appear periodically.
Appears four times a day at a time between 16:00 and 17:00 (CEST)/ 21:00 and 22:00 (SEA)
X-TRACKER
Infinity Laser Fist
Dual Beretta Gunslinger
Barrett M95 White Tiger
Dual Sword Phantom Slayer
Negev NG-7 Ajax
Trinity Grenade
Psychic Harmonium
Lightning Fury
Failnaught
After the 10,000 Mileage auction is over, participants who haven't won will have their 10,000 Mileage refunded.
10,000 Mileage bids can be made 10 minutes after the special auction begins.
Claim the contents by clicking Obtain after winning the auction.
The Failnaught can drop from the Transcendence Premium Decoder and Transcendence Decoder during the event.
Transcendence Premium Decoder: 3%
Transcendence Decoder: 0.45%

Failnaught fires 250 holy arrows, automatically aiming at the closest enemies within range of the crosshairs when using the default firing mode. Hitting the same enemy with the default firing mode stacks a mark. Upon reaching 5 stacks, damage is transferred to nearby enemies and the stacks are reset. While charging up, the Hunter's Eye activates, allowing you to learn the location of nearby enemies and attack through obstacles. The default firing mode's auto-aim and stack effects, as well as the Hunter's Eye, will not be triggered in specific modes (Zombie/Human Scenario, Zombie Shelter, or Zombie Giant).
All unused Transcendence Premium Decoders will be removed during maintenance on 10/5 (Wed).
500 mileage will be awarded in return for each Transcendence Premium Decoder removed in this manner.
Transcendence Decoder is always available for sale.
Transcendence Premium Decoder is available for sale until maintenance on 10/5 (Wed).
Check for details in Decoder Rates on the web page after 9/7 (Wed) maintenance.
Depending on the number of Transcendence Premium Decoders and Transcendence Decoders used during the event, you could receive a Failnaught (Permanent)!
You will receive a Failnaught (permanent) every time you reach 300 points.
6 Guaranteed Points are earned each time you use 1 Transcendence Premium Decoder.
1 Guaranteed Point is earned each time you use 1 Transcendence Decoder.

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: August 24th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d8fd533abd7ce235fdc4a58131b28624d63fae71.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b]Content: Class Auction House Opening[/b]
Recruit for perfection! It's the Class Auction update! Go trade for the class that you want at the Auction House now.

[b]Event: New Transcendence Class Promotion Event (8/24 - 9/21)[/b]
Immortal Eric and Smile Mary are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders! Go find them now. 

[b]Event: Play every day for rewards every day! (8/24 - 9/7)[/b]
Play every day, and earn plenty of rewards! 

[b]Event: TEAM'WAR'K 2GETHER (8/24 - 9/7)[/b]
Play Zombie Conquest (beta) during the TEAM'WAR'K 2GETHER! event again to collect TEAMWARK points and earn rewards![/list]
Check out the Details section below for more information.


[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]


[h2]New Content[/h2]

[u][h3]Class Auction House Opening (8/24 - 9/13)[/h3][/u]Recruit for perfection! It's the Class Auction update! Classes can be traded during the event via Auction.

[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*] Season exclusive classes and some of the recently released classes are ineligible for auction.
[*] Standard classes and seasonal classes cannot be traded.[/list]

[h2]New Events[/h2]

[u][h3]Event: Mileage Auction Event - Class Auction Included (8/24 - 9/13)[/h3][/u]You can access the auction via the Mileage Auction button at the bottom of the lobby during the event.

[b]Auction Feature / Content[/b]
[list][*] Item Rank
- Premium (All weapons except for premium are Normal Rank)
[*] Auction Time
- 1 hour for all items
[*] Number of Auction Listings
- 2 (Increases based on VIP rank)
[*] Regarding the Market Price of Items
- When listing an item, you can check the current Auction House market price (Lowest bid and direct purchase prices)
[*] Item Display
- Only items with the lowest bid or direct purchase price are displayed
[*] Auction Settings
- You can search by bid or direct purchase price, enhancement level, and weapon name.
[*] Sell-to-System Feature
- When an auction is unsuccessful, you'll have the opportunity to use the sell-to-system feature.
[*] Auction Hours
- 24 Hours (00:00.00 – 23:59.59) - When auction hours end, currently listed items will be canceled.[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*] The remaining time is shown in 5-minute increments for listed auction items.
[*] You can only bid on 1 item at a time.
[*] Regular auction items will be listed with a 30% fee included in the initial bidding price.
[*] If an item listed for auction is not sold, the item will be returned.
[*] Items listed for auction can be purchased immediately at the direct purchase price.
[*] If you list an item for auction, you cannot withdraw it until the auction's duration has ended.
[*] The item you listed may be shown on the bid page.
[*] When listing an item, you can easily check the actual amount you will receive under the Net Reward section.
[*] Some recently released weapons cannot be listed at auction.[/list]

[u][h3]Event: TEAM'WAR'K 2GETHER (8/24 - 9/7)[/h3][/u]Play the Zombie Conquest (beta) during the TEAMWARK TOGETHER! event again, and collect TEAMWARK points to earn rewards!

[b]How to Earn Points[/b]
[list][*] Earn 1 TEAMWARK point for each kill in the Zombie Conquest (beta) mode (up to 20 points per day) [/list]
[b]Reward[/b]
[list][*] 20 TEAM'WAR'K points: Unique Decoder x3
[*] 60 TEAM'WAR'K points: 10,000 Mileage Coupon + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x9
[*] 100 TEAM'WAR'K points: Event Decoder x3
[*] 140 TEAM'WAR'K points: Class Decoder x3
[*] 200 TEAM'WAR'K points: Transcendence Decoder x3[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*] You can earn up to 20 TEAMWARK points a day, and up to 200 during the event period.
[*] Only rooms with 4 or more players count toward these goals.
[*] The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list]

[u][h3]Play every day for rewards every day! (8/24 - 9/7)[/h3][/u]Don't forget to play every day during the event, and earn rewards!

[b]Conditions / Rewards[/b]
[list][*] Reach 60 minutes of playtime in any mode to earn an Event Reward Box (once daily) 
[*] Reach 30 Kill Points in Zombie mode to earn an Event Reward Box (once daily)
[*] Reach 100 Kill Points in Zombie scenario on Hard or higher to earn an Event Reward Box (once daily)[/list]
[b]Event Reward Box Content (You will have a chance to get one of the items below.)[/b]
[list][*] Class Decoder
[*] Class Decoder (x2)
[*] Rare Decoder
[*] Rare Decoder (x2)
[*] Rare Decoder (x3)
[*] Unique Decoder
[*] Unique Decoder (x2)
[*] Premium Unique Decoder
[*] Event Decoder
[*] Event Decoder (x2)
[*] Event Decoder (x3)[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*] Can only be claimed three times a day per account.
[*] Participation will only count in rooms with 3 or more players (includes Laboratory Mode, excludes Studio Mode).
[*] Laboratory Auto Hunt kills do not count for the event.
[*] At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario Mode missions.
[*] Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Evolution /  Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Conquest (beta)
[*] Excludes Zombie Scenario: Survival: Double Gate / Survival: Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*] All unused Event Reward Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 9/7 (Wed.)
[*] The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list]

[u][h3]Play every day to keep the rewards rolling! (8/24 - 9/7) [/h3][/u]Don't forget to play every day during the event to earn Event Reward Boxes! Round up as many as you can for more rewards!

[b]Conditions / Rewards[/b]
[list][*] 3 Boxes: Unique Decoder
[*] 6 Boxes: Rare Decoder x3
[*] 15 Boxes: 10,000 Mileage Coupon + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x5
[*] 21 Boxes: Event Decoder x3 + Rare Decoder x2
[*] 27 Boxes: Class Decoder x3 + Rare Decoder x5
[*] 33 Boxes: Transcendence Decoder x5 + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5
[*] 36 Boxes: Transcendence Decoder x5 + 10,000 Mileage Coupon[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*] Can only be obtained once per account.[/list]

[u][h3]New Transcendence Class Medal Giveaway (8/24 - Permanent)[/h3][/u]
When you own all items in the new Transcendence Classes set, you will receive the Transcendence Class medal.

[b]Conditions and Items[/b]
[list][*] Collect all four of Smile Mary, Immortal Eric, Mary's Cube, and Eric's Hero Helmet (Permanent) to earn the Psychic medal.[/list]
[b]Mary's Cube[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c140031b5703d395384278e798eddabd1b02821b.png[/img]

[b]Eric's Hero Helmet[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f4a835f0a083b11575d9ee7e50889e257709539b.png[/img]

[b]Psychic[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2f331846067c18349036fdb3b34404d82b654a88.png[/img]
[list][*] Honor Points: 10
[*] The Psychic medal can be obtained after the 8/24 (Wed) maintenance without event period limit.
[*] The medal can be obtained only once per account.[/list]

[u][h3]Login Supplies Event Guide (8/24 - 9/20)[/h3][/u]
[b]Login Reward[/b]
[list][*] Daily Weapons Supply
-Both Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (1 Day) & M3 Black Dragon (1 Day) provided + one of the Transcendence Enhancement or Part equipped Unique weapon (1 Day) randomly provided + all contents of Daily Attendance Reward Box provided
-Daily Attendance Reward Box : Damage Display (1 Day), Killer Display (1 Day), Penalty and Loss Invalidation x1, Rare Decoder x3[/list]
[b]Cumulative Rewards[/b]
[list][*] 5 Days: Dual Beretta Gunslinger (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*] 10 Days: Infinity Laser Fist (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*] 15 Days: Magnum Launcher (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*] 20 Days: Trinity Grenade (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*] 25 Days: Dread Nova (10 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*] Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
-Cumulative Attendance Reward Box contents: C4 Countdown Room Host (5 Days), Shorten Respawn Time (5 Days) Lucky Gunslinger (5 Days), Daily Mission Difficulty Change x15, Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon (7 Days)[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*] Attendance rewards will be provided directly as rewards instead of the Daily/Cumulative Attendance Reward Box items.
[*] Rewards can be claimed immediately after game login, and rewards are available until midnight every day.[/list]

[h2]Shop Update[/h2]

[u][h3]New Transcendence Class Promotion (8/24 - 9/21) [/h3][/u]Two new Transcendence Classes, Immortal Eric and Smile Mary, are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders.

[b]Immortal Eric[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2be6331296434b42ea9734483d7dee4da00e8535.png[/img]
[list][*] Background story: After a near-death experience during a zombie attack, his wounds healed up and he returned with an incredible new power. As his superhuman self-recovery rate and physical strength granted him with the resources to compete with the zombies, he willingly fought the undead on the front lines to help others. Fitting his nickname, Immortal, he returns alive every time there is a rumor that he had died. It is known that he is not part of any organizations or groups, but that he does work with Smile Mary.
[*] Paired Weapon: Death Eater
[*] Paired Effect: Special Attack ammo recharge rate increase
-Hyperbeam: Fire a beam that deals damage to enemies ahead of you. Knocks zombies back in Zombie modes.
[*] Area duration skill
-(Zombie Scenario) Passive: Passively restores HP and increases Defense
-(Zombie Scenario) Active: Maximizes the HP recovery and Defense increase effects on self and nearby allies
[*] Connection buff skill
-(Zombie Scenario) Playing with Smile Mary grants a chance to not take damage upon hit
[*] Add-On Feature
-(Zombie Scenario) <Ironclad> Add-On effect is applied by default, and stacking it will increase only the 10% Decreased Damage effect[/list]
[b]Smile Mary[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/edcdb8f9cb80746aaf8bd54550a8382e0bc69667.png[/img]
[list][*] Background story:  As the zombie invasion brought dangers to the everyday lives of the people, some of the general public began to awaken their special abilities. Mary is one of those, having the ability to control the aggression of zombies through psychokinesis, amplify the powers of allies, and control minds. Nobody approaches her as it is said that she could even read the minds of others, but there is a rumor that she sticks with Immortal Eric, another psychic.
[*] Paired Weapon: Death Eater
[*] Paired Effect: Special Attack max ammo increase
-Hyperbeam: Fire a beam that deals damage to enemies ahead of you. Knocks zombies back in Zombie modes.
[*] Area duration skill
-Passive: (Zombie Scenario) When you and your nearby allies are hit, this grants a chance to not take damage and instead increase damage for you and allies nearby
-Active: (Zombie Scenario) Maximizes the effects that grant a chance to not take damage and instead increase damage for you and allies nearby upon hit
[*] Connection buff skill
-(Zombie Scenario) Playing with Immortal Eric grants a chance to not take damage upon hit
[*] Add-On Feature
-(Zombie Scenario) <Deft Movement> Add-On effect is applied by default, and using the identical Add-On will stack.[/list]

[u][h3]New Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (8/24 - 9/21)[/h3][/u]Get guaranteed 2 new Transcendence Classes (Immortal Eric and Smile Mary) based on how many Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders are used during the event!

[b]Conditions and Rewards[/b]
[list][*] Upon reaching 150 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use
[*] Upon reaching 300 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use
[*] Select one from Immortal Eric + Eric's Hero Helmet or Smile Mary + Mary's Cube[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*] 1 Guaranteed Point given each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
[*] 3 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Class Premium Decoder.
[*] Selecting Immortal Eric will automatically provide Eric's Hero Helmet (Permanent).
[*] Selecting Smile Mary will automatically provide Mary's Cube (Permanent).
[*] Guaranteed Giveaway rewards can be granted only once per account. [/list]

[u][h3]Mileage Transfer Coupon Sale Event (8/24 - 11/2)[/h3][/u]Mileage Transfer Coupons will be sold at 50% off during the event period.

[b]Price Info[/b]
[list][*] 10,000 Mileage Transfer Coupon: 1.00 USD
[*] 50,000 Mileage Transfer Coupon: 5.00 USD
[*] 100,000 Mileage Transfer Coupon: 10.00 USD
[*] 200,000 Mileage Transfer Coupon: 20.00 USD[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*] The Mileage Transfer Coupon is the same as item as the (Old) Mileage Duffel Bag. (Name Change)[/list]

[u][h3]Shop New Items and Changes [/h3][/u]
[b]Items for sale changes[/b]
[list][*] Keith Icahn: 7.80 USD (Permanent) -> 45,000 Points (30 Days) 
[*] Spade: 7.80 USD (Permanent) -> 45,000 Points (30 Days)
[*] Blair + Silver Medal Luger: 8.69 USD (30 Days) -> 128,000 Points (30 Days)[/list]
[b]Mileage Shop Changes[/b]
[list][*] Limited purchase items and their amounts will be reset.
[*] Transcendence Classes from the Mileage Shop once per day.
[*] Unmentioned items will continue to be sold.[/list]

[u][h3]Decoder Item Update Information [/h3][/u]
[b]Relevant Classes[/b]
[list][*] Isabelle / Gerard / David Black / Alin[/list]
[b]4 removed from groups[/b]
[list][*] Premium Class Decoder
[*] Class Decoder[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*] Changes for each group are applied for durational weapon items as well.
[*] Check the Decoder Rate for more details.[/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: August 10th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/838a24981604219c685546cb5aea7dc7721cc786.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b]Content: New Zombie Conquest (beta) Mode Added[/b]
Compete as a team in the Zombie Conquest (beta) Update!

[b]Content: Zombie Conquest League Season 1[/b]
The first Zombie Conquest League is here! Don't miss out!

[b]Event: New Mode Release Celebration Event (8/10 - 8/24)[/b]
Win Zombie Conquest matches for rewards! 

[b]Event: TEAMWARK TOGETHER (8/10 - 8/24)[/b]
Play Zombie Conquest (beta) during the event to collect TEAMWARK points and earn rewards![/list]
Check out the Details section below for more information. 


[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]


[h2]New Content[/h2]

[u][h3]New Zombie Conquest (beta) Mode Release[/h3][/u]
[b]Zombie Conquest (beta)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/38cb21d6e474728a40d424e6f75b63fa346570de.jpg[/img]
[list][*] Mode Rules
- Humans earn points by capturing and holding bases, and zombies must prevent them from doing so. Each team will swap between playing as humans and zombies. The team that ends with a higher score wins.
- Humans capture bases by occupying them. Each base has a maximum amount of points that can be earned. If this maximum is reached, the target base will cycle to the next one, and more time is added to the round. Points will be based on how many bases out of the 3 have been captured by the end of the round.
- Base Disruption: Zombies enter bases to disrupt humans from capturing them.

[*] Human Rules
- Remember, getting hit by zombies hurts. If you get hurt too much, you die!
- Dead humans may revive to rejoin combat after a waiting period.
- For humans, weapon purchases will be restricted depending on base progression.
- All humans will begin combat with the weapons supplied at the first base.
- Once the second base is active, humans can decide whether they will use the unlocked weapons or keep the weapons they currently have.
- When the third base is active, a previously selected ability will be enhanced for humans.

[*] Zombie Rules
- For zombies, class selection will be restricted depending on base progression.
- You may only use normal zombies in the first base.
- Light Zombie, Stamper, and Banshee are available for use in the second base.
- Heavy Zombie, Voodoo Zombie, Rusty Wing, and Venom Guard are available for use in the third base.

[*] Awakening
- The Awakening gauge will charge as you play the game, and [V] will activate it.
- The Awakening gauge will charge over time and can be accelerated through combat and capturing bases.
- Awakening is available for both humans and zombies. Humans have a single, uniform effect, while zombies acquire different effects depending on the zombie class in use.

[*] Additional Info
- Teams will swap each round.
- If the difference in score becomes too large to overcome, the game may end early.

[*] Notice
- Press [TAB] in game to check current restrictions, selected abilities, and Awakening effects.[/list]

[h3][u]New Map Information[/u][/h3]
[b]Hacienda[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0f16689a7a86e2c156496fa25bfe071549e0a1a3.jpg[/img]
[list][*] A Latin-style mansion (Available in various modes including Zombie Mode, Conquest (beta), and Team Deathmatch)[/list]

[u][h3]Zombie Conquest League Season 1 (8/10 - 10/19) [/h3][/u]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*] You can check your league status under My Info.
[*] You can review the score and weapon information for the top 500 players in the Hall of Fame.
[*] League Ranks: Master > Diamond > Platinum > Gold > Silver > Bronze
- Master: top 1%
- Diamond: top 5%
- Platinum: top 10%
- Gold: top 25%
- Silver: top 55%
[*] Unlike the current League, Conquest League points will increase with wins and decrease with losses.
[*] Conquest League ranks will be determined by percentile instead of points.
[*] Increases and decreases in ranks are updated in real-time.
[*] Unlike the current League, Conquest League rewards are distributed at the end of the League. 
[*] Rewards will be determined based on your final rank when the League ends.
[*] Since this is a Trial League, points, ranks, and reward standards are subject to change and may be adjusted mid-League.[/list]
[b]Conquest League Rewards[/b]
[list][*] Master: Zombie Conquest Master Nameplate, 10,000 Mileage Coupon, Devastator (20 Days), Anemone (20 Days), Grade 6 Parts Reward Box x3 
[*] Diamond: Zombie Conquest Diamond Nameplate, 10,000 Mileage Coupon, Satellite Mine (20 Days), Mirage (20 Days), Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5, Achievement Point 5 Box x2
[*] Platinum: 5,000 Mileage Coupon, Eternity Laser Fist (20 Days), Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x10, Achievement Point 5 Box
[*] Gold: 5,000 Mileage Coupon, Mummy Stamper (20 Days), Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x5
[*] Silver: 1,000 Mileage Coupon, Chef Heavy Zombie (20 Days)[/list]


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[u][h3]New Mode Release Celebration Event (8/10 - 8/24)[/h3][/u]Win a match in the Zombie Conquest (beta)'s new map, Hacienda, for the first time during the event.

[b]Reward[/b]
[list][*] Guardian Spark x10
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/4a1e498447ea68d67620ce65a15c5c046d76c7c0.png[/img][/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*] Only rooms with 4 or more players count toward these goals.
[*] Rewards can be claimed once per account.
[*] All unused Guardian Sparks will be removed and replaced with 15 mileage each during maintenance on 9/7 (Wed).[/list]

[u][h3]TEAMWARK TOGETHER (8/10 - 8/24)[/h3][/u]Play the Zombie Conquest (beta) during the event and collect TEAMWARK points to earn rewards!

[b]How to Earn Points[/b]
[list][*] Earn 1 TEAMWARK point for each use of the Awakening skill in the Hacienda map (up to 20 points per day)
[*] Earn 5 TEAMWARK points for completing a match in the Hacienda Map with a family member (up to once per day)[/list]
[b]Rewards[/b]
[list][*] 20 TEAMWARK points: Unique Decoder x3
[*] 40 TEAMWARK points: Rare Decoder x10 + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x10
[*] 60 TEAMWARK points: 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x9
[*] 80 TEAMWARK points: 10,000 Mileage Coupon + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5
[*] 100 TEAMWARK points: Event Decoder x5 + Exploration Level Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*] 140 TEAMWARK points: Unique Premium Decoder x3
[*] 180 TEAMWARK points: Event Decoder x10
[*] 200 TEAMWARK points: Class Decoder x10
[*] 240 TEAMWARK points: Transcendence Decoder x10[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*] You can earn up to 20 TEAMWARK points a day.
[*] Only rooms of 4 or more players count toward these goals.
[*] The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list]

[u][h3]Part Mania Event (8/10 – 8/24)[/h3][/u]Complete missions during the event for parts! 

[b]Conditions[/b]
[list][*] Give 3 compliments after the session ends for Grade 2 Parts Reward Box x5 (up to 3 times a day)
[*] Win a Zombie Mode round as a human for Grade 2 Parts Reward Box x5 (up to 3 times a day)
[*] Clear a Zombie Scenario Mode on Normal or higher difficulty for Grade 3 Parts Reward Box x5 (up to 3 times a day)
[*] Reach 20 minutes of playtime for Grade 3 Parts Reward Box x5 (once a day)
[*] Get 1 Kill with Zombie Bomb in Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, or Zombie Conquest (beta) for Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x5 (once a day)[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*] Participation will only count in rooms with 3 or more players (includes Laboratory mode, excludes Studio Mode).
[*] At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario Mode missions.
[*] Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z 
[*] Excludes Zombie Scenario: Survival: Double Gate / Survival: Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*] Zombie Bomb mission can be accomplished in Zombie Conquest (beta) but cannot be accomplished in Zombie Classic mode.[/list]

[u][h3]Protector Medal Giveaway (8/10 - Permanent) [/h3][/u]Collect the items below to earn the new medal.

[b]Conditions / Rewards[/b]
[list][*] Obtain Sandalphon (Permanent) + Protector Wings (Permanent) - [Honor] Protector Medal
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/88e490a3b6e99b9ad79dbafc22fad49736e75647.png[/img][/list]

[u][h3]Master of Combining Medal Giveaway (8/10 - 8/24)[/h3][/u]Obtain the Master of Combining Medal during the event for a bonus reward.

[b]Conditions / Rewards[/b]
[list][*] Upon successfully combining 100 times, earn [Honor] Master of Combining Medal + Event Decoder x10
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/89143cacfe97355f20a541dbf4e311c8bfaf9f91.png[/img][/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*] [Honor] Master of Combining Medal can be obtained after 8/10 (Wed) maintenance without event period limit.
[*] The Event Decoder reward can only be claimed once per account and will only be awarded to the players who earned the relevant medal during the event.
[*] The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list]

[u][h3]Bonus Disassembly Event (8/10- 8/23)[/h3][/u]You can participate in the Bonus Disassembly Event by clicking the "Bonus Disassembly" button at the bottom of the Lobby screen. During the event, 10 players can select the weapons they want to disassemble. One player will receive extra mileage. Participants can get 500 mileage for each weapon they disassemble.

[b]Details[/b]
[list][*] Weekdays and Weekends 2:00 PM – 6:00 PM CEST
[*] Minimum Participation Mileage: 5,000
[*] Some items will be adjusted based on the weapon's rarity.
[*] Table ranks are in the order of highest value first.
[*] Weapon criteria are determined the day the Bonus Disassembly Event starts. If the weapon's rank changes, its value in the Bonus Disassembly Event will be updated.
[*]Bonus Disassembly Participation Level Limit Adjusted: Lv. 15[/list]
[b]Special Bonus Event[/b]
[list][*] To celebrate the release of the Sandalphon, we increased the chance to win Epic Weapons to be twice that of Transcendence Weapons during the event![/list]


[h2]Shop Update[/h2]

[u][h3]New Transcendence Decoder Group Addition Event (8/10 - Until Next Transcendence Promotion)[/h3][/u]The following weapons will be part of the new Rotation Group during the event.

[b]Rotation Group Weapons[/b]
[list][*] Ajax
[*] Trinity Grenade 
[*] Psychic Harmonium 
[*] Lightning Fury[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*] Check Decoder Rates for more details.
[*] The Rotation Group will no longer be part of the possible contents of the decoder once the event ends.
[*] The contents of the Rotation Group may change at any time.[/list]

[u][h3]Guaranteed Transcendence Rotation Group Giveaway Event (8/10 - Until Next Transcendence Weapon Promotion) [/h3][/u]Get a guaranteed weapon from the Rotation Group based on Transcendence Decoder usage during the event!

[b]Rotation Group Weapons[/b]
[list][*] Ajax / Trinity Grenade / Psychic Harmonium / Lightning Fury[/list]
[b]Conditions and Obtainable Items[/b]
[list][*] Each time you reach 300 points, you can choose 1 from the Rotation Group.[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*] 1 Guaranteed Point given each time you use 1 Transcendence Decoder.[/list]


[u][h3]Decoder Item Update Information (8/10 - Permanent) [/h3][/u]The list of decoders will be updated to the following.

[b]Affected Decoders[/b]
[list][*] Transcendence Decoder/Transcendence Premium Decoder/Event Decoder/Point Transcendence Decoder[/list]
[b]Changes within Transcendence Group 1[/b]
[list][*] X-Tracker added, M3 Black Dragon removed[/list]
[b]Changes within Transcendence Group 2[/b]
[list][*] M3 Black Dragon added, SG552 Lycanthrope removed[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*] Changes for each group are applied for durational weapon items as well.
[*] Class Decoder Rotation Event ends 8/24 (Wed)
[*] Check for details in Decoder Rates after 8/10 (Wed) maintenance.[/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: July 27th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e0044d418d6d1f430e2c3619be76f33f835348e6.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b]Content: New Maps[/b]
Play the Italy map in white and blue tones now!

[b]Content: Unlocked Weapon Enhancement Information[/b]
Infinity Laser Fist +5 & Eternity Laser Fist +5 Enhancement unlocked! Check it out today!

[b]Event: Mileage Auction Event - Surprise Extension! (7/27 - 8/9)[/b]
The Mileage Auction Event has been extended for 2 more weeks! Happy auctioning!

[b]Event: New Epic Throwable Weapon Sandalphon Promotion (7/27 - 9/7)[/b]
Get the weapon known as the Heavenly Relic from a different dimension now!

[b]Event: Guardian Spark Shop Opening Event (7/27 - 9/7)[/b]
Use the collected Guardian Sparks at the Guardian Spark Shop to obtain all kinds of items, such as Sandalphon and Gigantic Drill![/list]
Check out the Details section below for more information. 


[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]


[h2]New Content[/h2]

[u][h3]New Map Information[/h3][/u]
[b]Italy White Blue[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d576abef41219b6a47079f556c807bfea7c23054.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Italy in white and blue tones.[/list]

[u][h3]Unlocked Weapon Enhancement Information[/h3][/u]
[b]Infinity Laser Fist +5 and Eternity Laser Fist +5 Enhancement Unlocked[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/602875cac3cd0c17f256de61c6672b07b5c6a455.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e65d4b116042d61c91aae79a91820d1715799e1f.png[/img]
[list][*]DMG 3 Enhancement, RCOL 2 Enhancement[/list]
[b]SKULL-7, BALROG-VII, BALROG-VII BLUE[/b]
[list][*]DMG 5 Enhancement[/list]
[b]Zombie Z Mode Unlock Levels[/b]
[list][*]Infinity Laser Fist: 29 -> same as existing
[*]Eternity Laser Fist: 29 -> 30[/list]

[u][h3]Mission Chain Guide System Renewal Information (7/27 - 12/28)[/h3][/u]
[b]Mission Chain rewards consisting of 25 guides and 25 missions will be changed.[/b]
[list][*]You can only clear one stage (5 guides and 5 missions) a day of the Mission Chain.[/list]
[b]Per-Stage Completion Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Stage 1: Hunter-Killer X-90 (Permanent)
[*]Stage 2: Dual Sword Infernal Hunter (Permanent)
[*]Stage 3: Transcendence Yuri (Permanent)
[*]Stage 4: Claymore Mine MDS (Permanent)
[*]Stage 5: Python Desperado (Permanent)
[*]Mission Final Completion Rewards: Hunter-Killer X-12 (Permanent) + Complete the Guide Medal + Settlement Support Box[/list]
[b]Changes[/b]
[list][*]Stage 1 Mission 1 Interim Rewards
- CSO Guaranteed Weapon Box contents changed
- Warhammer Storm Giant +6 (5 Days) changed to AUG Guardian (5 Days)
[*]Stage 1 Mission 1 Clear Rewards
- D.Eagle Crimson Hunter (30 Days) changed to Python Desperado (30 Days)
[*]Stage 2 Mission 1 Interim Rewards
- Name change to Enhancement Item Box, and M950 (Permanent) added to contents
[*]Stage 2 Mission 1 Clear Rewards
- Vendetta (Permanent) changed to OICW (Permanent)
[*]Stage 2 Mission 5 Interim Rewards
- Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon (14 Days) changed to Ji Yoon Choi (Permanent)
[*]Stage 2 Mission 5 Final Rewards
- Ji Yoon Choi (Permanent) changed to Exploration Level EXP Coupon (x5)
[*]Updated to reflect the contents of the 2022 Q1 update guide
[*]Mission Chain Button display on the bottom of the home screen
[*]Navigation feature has been added to each mission, allowing players to automatically move to a location where they can engage in the mission
- Some navigation will now display Tooltips for supplemental information when the cursor is placed over the text[/list]

[u][h3]New Classic (Zombie) Firearms Changes[/h3][/u]
[b]New Classic (Zombie) Firearms added and deleted[/b]
[list][*]The following firearms within the New Classic weapon restrictions have been added/deleted.
[*]Added New Classic (Zombie) options based on New Classic options
- Awakening of the Zhu Bajie Minigun, BALROG-VII BLUE, Aeolis, CROW-7
[*]Deleted New Classic (Zombie) option firearms based on New Classic options
- Plasma Rifle MK-1, Mecha Dino MK-1, Bear Buster, Flame Jackhammer, J's dagger, Hammer Halloween, Halloween Dual Kriss, TAR-21 Halloween, PP-19 Bizon Splash, Elegant Double-Barreled Shotgun, Sawed-Off M79 Splash, Elegant Winchester M1887, JANUS-7, Coil Gun[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Weapon restriction options for New Classic (Zombie) will continue to be adjusted based on firearm balancing and supply.[/list]


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[u][h3]Event: Mileage Auction Event - Surprise Extension! (7/27 - 8/9)[/h3][/u]The Mileage Auction Event has been extended 2 more weeks until 8/9!

[b]Auction Feature / Content[/b]
[list][*]Item Rank
- Premium (All weapons except for premium are Normal Rank)
[*]Auction Time
- 1 hour for all items
[*]Number of Auction Listings
- 2 (+ Increases based on VIP rank)
[*]Regarding the Market Price of Items
- When listing an item, you can check the current Auction House market price (Lowest bid and direct purchase prices)
[*]Item Display
- Only items with the lowest bid or direct purchase price are displayed
[*]Auction Settings
- You can search by bid/direct purchase price, enhancement level, and weapon name.
[*]Sell-to-System Feature
- When an auction is unsuccessful, you have the opportunity to use the sell-to-system feature.
[*]Auction Hours
- 24 Hours (00:00.00 – 23:59.59) - When auction hours end, currently listed items will be canceled.[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]The remaining time is shown in 5-minute increments for listed auction items.
[*]You can only bid on 1 item at a time.
[*]Regular auction items will be listed with a 30% fee included in the initial bidding price.
[*]If an item listed for auction is not sold, the item will be returned.
[*]Items listed for auction can be purchased immediately at the direct purchase price.
[*]If you list an item for auction, you cannot withdraw it until the auction's duration has ended.
[*]The item you listed may be shown on the bid page.
[*]When listing an item, you can easily check the actual amount you will receive under the 'Net Reward' section.
[*]Some recently released weapons are ineligible to be listed at auction.[/list]

[u][h3]Mileage Auction Special Event (7/27 - 8/9)[/h3][/u]It's a 10,000 Mileage special event, available through the [Event] tab during the Mileage Auction period! Special items priced at 10,000 Mileage will appear periodically.

[b]Time[/b]
[list][*]Appears four times a day at a random time between 21:00 and 22:00 (CEST)[/list]
[b]Special Items[/b]
[list][*]Auction Weapon Raffle Ticket
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2151ce41d07788137c65f78a91cd267ac3246949.png[/img][/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]What is an Auction Weapon Raffle Ticket? 1 of the players holding this item will be selected in the raffle during the event, and they will obtain Death Eater (Permanent)!
[*]Upon obtaining the Auction Weapon Raffle Ticket, you'll also get Transcendence Decoder x5 and Transcendence Premium Decoder x1.
[*]Obtaining multiple Auction Weapon Raffle Tickets will increase your chance to win the raffle.
[*]All unused Transcendence Premium Decoders will be exchanged for 500 Mileage each during maintenance on 8/10.
[*]Raffle and Death Eater distribution will be held during maintenance on 8/10, and Auction Weapon Raffle Tickets will be removed.
[*]10,000 Mileage auction items will appear randomly during auction hours.
[*]After the 10,000 Mileage auction is over, participants who haven't won will have their 10,000 Mileage refunded.
[*]10,000 Mileage bids can be made 10 minutes after the special auction begins.[/list]

[u][h3]Surprise Reward Giveaway (7/27 - 8/10)[/h3][/u]CSNS has prepared a gift for our players battling in this summer heat! Make sure to login during the period to claim it!

[b]Reward[/b]
[list][*]1 of each type of Grade 6 Parts
[*]200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x20[/list]
[b]Target Players[/b]
[list][*]Limited to accounts created on and before 7/26/2022[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Each account can receive these items once.[/list]

[u][h3]Login Supplies Event (7/27 – 8/23)[/h3][/u]
[b]Login Reward by Day[/b]
[list][*]Daily Weapons Supply: 4 Transcendence Weapons (1 Day) + 1 Daily Attendance Reward Box[/list]
[b]Cumulative Login Reward[/b]
[list][*]5 Days: Dual Beretta Gunslinger (20 Days)
[*]10 Days: Infinity Laser Fist (20 Days)
[*]15 Days: Magnum Launcher (20 Days)
[*]20 Days: Trinity Grenade (20 Days)
[*]25 Days: Dread Nova (10 Days)[/list]
[b]Extra Cumulative Rewards Event[/b]
[list][*]Each time you receive cumulative rewards, you'll receive a Cumulative Attendance Reward Box.[/list]
[u][h3]Mosquito Medal Giveaway (7/27 - 9/7)[/h3][/u]Kill the summer mosquitoes during the event and earn the medal to receive bonus rewards.

[b]Maps where mosquitoes appear[/b]
[list][*]Mouse Hole, Survival: Double Gate, Survival: Trap, Survival: Lost City, Italy, Assault, Industrial 2, Origin[/list]
[b]Conditions / Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Kill 300 mosquitoes to obtain [Honor] Swatter + Transcendence Decoder x10[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Players who already possess the [Honor] Swatter medal cannot receive another one, but they will still receive the Transcendence Decoder reward.
[*]Bot modes are excluded.[/list]


[h2]Shop Update[/h2]

[u][h3]New Epic Throwable Weapon Sandalphon Promotion (7/27 - 9/7)[/h3][/u]During the event, Epic Decoders containing the new Epic throwable weapon, Sandalphon, will be sold in the shop!

[b]Sandalphon + Sandalphon Nameplate Drop Rate[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0c76fd2974179eba842dfa0ae3ceed5a7b94cd84.png[/img]
[list][*]Epic Decoder: 0.35%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0663a67dee570280a7941b04759a2fad6eef8b40.png[/img][/list]
[b]Sandalphon[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/36ba671029d23d30be514331838020f6b3801b60.png[/img]
[list][*]A weapon from a different dimension, known as the Heavenly Relic. Activate to protect the wielder and summon a heavenly being.[/list]
[b]Sandalphon Nameplate[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/85818cef173e39ec17eafe429c8809eaf71562cb.png[/img]
