notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5d5896121bd724255bde07899c14873a640448f3.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b]Content: Season 13: Space[/b]
The beautiful and miraculous arena of space unfolds before your very eyes!

[b]Content: League Season 9[/b]
New Nameplate items have been added to the Achievement Shop, so check them out now!

[b]Event: Laser Ripper Fragment Collection Event[/b]
Collect fragments during the event to earn a permanent La ser Ripper!

[b]Event: Class Rotation Group Appearance Event[/b]
A new rotation group has been added until the next class promotion, so get them while you can![/list]
Check out the Details section below for more information. 


[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]


[h2]New Content[/h2]

[u][h3]Season 13: Space[/h3][/u]For details, please refer to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/3349005834033478303]Season 13 Pass Preview[/url].

[b]Black Market Open Early[/b]
[list][*]New Items Added: CSN:S Mask, Armored Soldier Ganymede, Clockwork Chaser, Dilopho Blotter, Panoplo Venom Guard, Gran Bird Cannon (Gun Boost Part - Grade 5 + Vampiric Part - Grade 5 Equipped), Mecha Dino MK-4 (Gun Boost Part - Grade 5 + Vampiric Part - Grade 5 Equipped)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d7879aa2a6a36817d6358d9197ce764cdbbe8c17.png[/img][/list]
[b]Re-purchasing Past Season Passes Available[/b]
[list][*]A page where past season items can be purchased will be open to players who reach grade 100 on their Season Pass!
[*]The page opens with the player's previous progress of the past season, and they can purchase season grades from the page to obtain items.
[*]Previous Season Passes Reopened: Season 9, 10, 11
[*]The Black Market can be accessed from the [Missions] menu after reaching Rank 100.
[*]All Black Market Badges you've obtained will disappear when a new season begins.[/list]
[b]Season Reward Weapons[/b]
[list][*]Star Tail
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9dd804fcc3a0fd1e00c3d48edfac8f2223bf48b3.png[/img]
- A handgun that uses 50 energy cells as ammo to fire a laser in a straight line. Its special feature, Cosmos Spin, can slow enemies down.

[*]Starlight Sword
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b12dae5f775d7dc9d652735ccab4606e929f3a08.png[/img]
- A melee weapon created by harnessing technology about which little is understood. It is readily identifiable by its glowing blade. Its special feature, Energy Push, can push enemies away.

[*]Luna Cannon
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/23a5d8fcde58f34597ab464a4234b7b55a7919e7.png[/img]
- A shotgun that rapidly fires 45 rounds of 12 gauge shotgun ammo. Its special feature, Lunatic Bomb, fires an artificial moon straight ahead.[/list]
[b]Weapon Paints[/b]
[list][*]Moon Weapon Paint
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/8c4447151e479ebfe9723339c87a09ffa6a91184.png[/img]
- Eligible Weapons: Desert Eagle 50C, Papin, Petrol Boomer, THANATOS-9, Devastator[/list]
[b]Costume[/b]
[list][*]Astronaut Helmet (Head), Astronaut Backpack (Back), Mini Planets (Waist)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/57fe1d7e1c76dd2248189630c1f5508b3f6b58ac.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/4cad3487f75e550ce0f4fb1730f7ec842704ea9f.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/83c29e32186238a30e55147cb1faefdb7703a5e0.png[/img]
[/list]
[b]Spray[/b]
[list][*]SD Kai, SD Lynn, Milky Way Spray
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0eec2c49369b85cec6e76eed1160966a4f4e06a4.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5c0ecdb8778f1c4dbb77eaf1b2c8597ab68dd29d.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f38ab8d88053c92d80753858e02eaf97facaef1c.png[/img]
[/list]
[b]Nameplate[/b]
[list][*]Season Pass Nameplate (13)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/3dc8b5411df904633b90e52199fbb5f62ec6d2bb.png[/img][/list]
[b]Damage Font[/b]
[list][*]Season Pass Font
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/82d96781fd5994dccda18732be324c4fecc48aa0.png[/img][/list]
[b]Medal[/b]
[list][*]Season 13 Trailblazer Medal (Pass)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c236402f2e2b42b98dc8c4c7a16fd9a9528065f9.png[/img]
[*]Season 13 Conqueror Medal (Highest Rank Reached)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/18d0784c8c46ac480dab787a04ede0a26ff8239f.png[/img][/list]

[u][h3]League Season 9 (7/13 - 10/19)[/h3][/u]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Items have been added to the Achievement Shop.
- New Nameplate Items Added: Curve Nameplate, Dot Nameplate, Rainbow Nameplate, Slash Nameplate, Green Calligraphy Nameplate, Human Poster Nameplate, Human Poster Nameplate 2, Human Poster Nameplate 3, Human Poster Nameplate 4, Human Poster Nameplate 5, (Animated) Purple Particle Nameplate, (Animated) Blue Smoke Nameplate[/list]


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[u][h3]Mileage Auction Event (7/13 - 7/26)[/h3][/u]The Mileage Auction Event has been extended 2 more weeks until 7/26! See more details with the link below.
[list][*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/3349004388905008816][Update] Patch Notes: June 29th[/url] – Mileage Auction Event[/list]

[u][h3]Laser Ripper Supply Event (7/13 - 8/10)[/h3][/u]We're running a new Daily Login Event! Log in during the event and reach 30 minutes of playtime to earn Laser Ripper fragments. The more you log in, the better the rewards!

[b]Login Days / Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Days 1 & 2
- Stage 1 (Laser Ripper Fragment + 1 Point Transcendence/Class Decoder Each + 500 Mileage Coupon)
[*]Days 3 & 4
- Stage 2 (Laser Ripper Fragment x2 + 2 Point Transcendence/Class Decoders Each + 500 Mileage Coupon x2)
[*]Days 5 & 6
- Stage 3 (Laser Ripper Fragment x3 + 3 Point Transcendence/Class Decoders Each + 500 Mileage Coupon x3)
[*]Days 7 & 8
- Stage 4 (Laser Ripper Fragment x6 + 4 Point Transcendence/Class Decoders Each + 500 Mileage Coupon x4)
[*]Days 9 & 10
- Stage 5 (Laser Ripper Fragment x8 + 5 Point Transcendence/Class Decoders Each + 500 Mileage Coupon x5)
[*]Days 11 & 12
- Stage 6 (Laser Ripper Fragment x10 + 6 Point Transcendence/Class Decoders Each + 500 Mileage Coupon x6)[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Rewards for each day can only be claimed once per account.
[*]Laser Ripper fragments stack, and you can collect up to a maximum of 300.
[*]All Laser Ripper fragments will be removed during maintenance on 8/10.
[*]The event will end after you've claimed the last reward on day 12.[/list]

[u][h3]Laser Ripper Fragment Special Mission Event (7/13 - 8/10)[/h3][/u]Participate in special missions during the event to collect Laser Ripper fragments! You can earn up to 20 Laser Ripper fragments a day through special missions.

[b]Missions / Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Every 8 points earned with kills, assists, or human infections (excluding bots) in a Zombie Mode.
- Laser Ripper Fragment (Earn up to 16 Daily)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/047a179475b9d4041dbc0bc010aa43476e8cf8e9.png[/img]
[*]Every clear of a Zombie Scenario mode on Hard or higher after scoring 100 kill points.
- Laser Ripper Fragment x2 (Earn up to 16 Daily)
[*]Every 40 / 60 minutes of playtime.
- Laser Ripper Fragment x2 (Get up to 2 Daily)[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]How to Earn Kill Points
- Zombie Kill as a Human: 3 Points
- Zombie Assist as a Human: 1 Point
- Human Infection as Zombie: 3 Points (Excluding Bots)
- Human Infection Assist as Zombie: 0 Points
[*]Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero (Defense Mode included) / Zombie Darkness / Zombie Evolution / Zombie Z
[*]Excludes Zombie Scenario Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos maps.
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (includes Laboratory mode - Laboratory Auto Hunt kills don't count for the event, excludes Studio Mode).
[*]At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]Players that receive a Laser Ripper (Permanent) will no longer receive Laser Ripper fragments from that point on.[/list]

[u][h3]Laser Ripper Fragment Collection Event (7/13 - 8/10)[/h3][/u]Collect 300 Laser Ripper fragments during the event to receive a Laser Ripper (Permanent)!

[b]Total Cumulated / Rewards[/b]
[list][*]First Login: Laser Ripper (1 Day)
[*]10: Laser Ripper (15 Days) + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x5
[*]50: Ripper (Permanent) + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5 + Rare Decoder x10
[*]100: Slasher (Permanent) + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x5 + Unique Decoder x10
[*]150: Laser Minigun (Permanent) + Weapon Paint - Snake + Event Decoder x10
[*]200: Tornado (Permanent) + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5 + Class Decoder x10
[*]250: Cyclone (Permanent) + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5 + Transcendence Decoder x10
[*]300: Laser Ripper (Permanent) + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x3 + Transcendence Premium Decoder x3[/list]
[b]Laser Ripper[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c8812961341033c95353f03f127e243a112e6a68.png[/img]
[list][*]The Ripper has been upgraded with a laser cutter that can cleave through foes. This is equipped as a primary weapon and the knockback effect is applied only in Zombie (Classic, Mutant, Hero, Darkness, Zombie, Scenario) modes.[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Stage rewards can be obtained only once per account.
[*]All unused Transcendence Premium Decoders will be removed during maintenance on 8/10.
[*]500 mileage will be given for each Transcendence Premium Decoder removed.[/list]

[u][h3]Season Badge Giveaway Event (7/13 - 11/2)[/h3][/u]Season badges are given immediately based on the login time for daily missions during Season 13.

[b]Login Time / Season Badge[/b]
[list][*]30 min: x5
[*]60 min: x10
[*]120 min: x20[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Daily missions reset every day at midnight.
[*]You cannot use a difficulty change item on [Event] missions.[/list]

[u][h3]Zombie Scenario Golden Zombie Kill Event (7/13 - 11/2)[/h3][/u]Earn rewards by killing Golden Zombies when you play Zombie Scenario during Season 13.

[b]Total Kills[/b]
[list][*]1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 10 Golden Zombies[/list]
[b]Rewards (For Golden Zombies killed matching each of the Above-Listed Totals)[/b]
[list][*]Select 1 of Zombie Scenario Add-On Selection Box / Transcendence Weapon Selection Box / Guaranteed Transcendence Class Box / 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x4 / Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x10[/list]

[list][*]Select 1 from among: M4A1 Dark Knight, AK47 Paladin, Warhammer Storm Giant, Magnum Drill, Desert Eagle Crimson Hunter, SG552 Lycanthrope, Blade Runebreaker, Red Dragon Cannon, or Python Desperado[/list]
[b]Guaranteed Transcendence Class Box Contents (Permanent)[/b]
[list][*]Select 1 from among: Sonya Lycanthrope, Transcendence Blair, Transcendence Michaela, Transcendence Yuri, Transcendence Ji Yoon Choi, Elizabeth Crimson Hunter, Dorothy Dark Knight, Flora Paladin, Transcendence Fernando, or Rose Phoenix[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Add-On Selection Box Contents: 20 of Reinforced Attack, Extended Magazine, Tide Turner, Shadow Blade, Survival Instincts, Explosive Ammo, Free Market, Weakness Analysis, Titan's Will, Regeneration, Swiftfoot, and Capital Add-Ons.
[*]Hitting the Golden Zombie once counts as killing it once.
[*]Each reward is given only once per account.'
[*]Up to 3 can be defeated per day.
[*]Unused Guaranteed Transcendence Class Boxes and Transcendence Weapon Selection Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 11/2.
[*]The Golden Zombies have a chance to appear when playing for more than 3 minutes in rooms on Normal difficulty or higher.[/list]


[h2]Shop Update[/h2]

[u][h3]Class Rotation Group Appearance Event (7/13 - Until Next Class Promotion)[/h3][/u]The classes below will be part of the new Rotation Group for the Class Decoder during the event.

[b]Appearing Classes[/b]
[list][*]Boss David Black
[*]Special Agent Criss
[*]Leader Soi
[*]Super Soldier Jennifer[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Check the decoder rate notice for more details.
[*]The Rotation Group will be removed from the possible contents of the decoder once the event ends.
[*]The contents of the Rotation Group can change at any time.
[*]The Rotation Group is added to Class Decoders only during the event.[/list]

[u][h3]Guaranteed Class Rotation Group Giveaway Event (7/13 - Until Next Class Promotion)[/h3][/u]Select a guaranteed Class from the Rotation Group based on Class Decoder usage during the event!

[list][*]1 Guaranteed Point given each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
[*]The above classes don't receive exclusive costumes when drawn with a decoder.[/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: June 29th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/656375da4a60e514bf54c3e363422a026c527885.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b]Content: Studio – Zombie Classic Mode Added[/b]
You're now able to play Zombie Classic in Studio Mode!

[b]Content: New Maps[/b]
Venture into the Crime District and Shantytown that have become new hopes for humanity!

[b]Content: 3 New Medals for Zombie Scenario[/b]
3 new medals have been added to Zombie Scenario for you to earn!

[b]Promotion: New Transcendence Weapon Death Eater Promotion (6/29 - 8/10)[/b]
Hit multiple grouped-together enemies simultaneously and fire a Hyper Beam with alien technology. Grab your Death Eater today and get blasting![/list]
Check out the Details section below for more information. 


[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]


[h2]New Content[/h2]

[u][h3]Studio - Zombie Classic Mode Added[/h3][/u][b]Studio - Zombie Classic Mode Added[/b]
[list][*]Create a Zombie Classic Mode Map in Map Creation
[*]Zombie Classic now playable in Studio Mode[/list]

[u][h3]New Map Information[/h3][/u][b]Nostalgia[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/cd417628fff55eae2a5c3802c73aaac974bc6355.png[/img]
[list][*]The Crime District on the outskirts of the city's center and the Shantytown--once treated as dangerous slums--have become places of newfound hope for humanity. The only way to be free of the infected seems to be reaching the highest possible ground.
[*]You can try it out in Zombie modes (Zombie Classic, Zombie Mutant, Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, Zombie Darkness, Zombie Evolution, Zombie War Mode).[/list]

[u][h3]3 New Zombie Scenario Medals[/h3][/u][b]3 New Medals Added for Zombie Scenario[/b]
[list][*]Negotiator
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/59788d3b0253ec4483da5aea93e0c47614ac0d15.png[/img]
- Defeat Agent B in Zombie Scenario Season 7 - Truth Uncovered 100 times

[*]Season 7 Veteran Medals
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/3f0465f3b87540ea2dff255e1440014ea9004ee8.png[/img]
- Clear All of Zombie Scenario Season 7 (Total War/Rendezvous/Missed Connections/Truth Uncovered)

[*]Look Into My Eyes
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/dc15ef6ef708b31653c065345304110a5a4ae6c0.png[/img]
- Defeat Agent H in Zombie Scenario Season 8 - An Approaching Threat 100 times[/list]


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[u][h3]Ad Balloon Popping Event (6/29 - 7/13)[/h3][/u]Earn rewards based on how many ad balloons you pop during the event. (The number of times you attack a popped balloon is irrelevant; you receive credit for attacking it at least once.)

[b]Popped Balloons / Rewards[/b]
[list][*]5: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x10 + Season Badge x20
[*]10: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5 + Season Badge x30
[*]15: Unique Decoder x3+ 10,000 Mileage
[*]25: Event Decoder x3 + Season Badge x50
[*]35: Class Decoder x5 + 10,000 Mileage
[*]50: Transcendence Decoder x5 + Season Badge x100[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Each account can participate in up to five missions per day.
[*]Each account can only receive rewards once.
[*]Eligible Maps: Dust 2, Militia, Estate, Mouse Hole, Italy, Assault
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (includes Laboratory Mode).
[*]The player that delivers the last hit to a popped ad balloon will receive +10% EXP/Points.[/list]

[u][h3]Ad Balloon Medal Event (6/29 - 7/13)[/h3][/u]Become a stone-cold ad balloon killer! Pop 300 ad balloons to earn medals and more!

[b]Conditions[/b]
[list][*]Pop 300 Ad Balloons by delivering the final hit[/list]
[b]Reward[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/10288f74abbba5bd265b19db14037e2e60ce77f0.png[/img]
[list][*][Honor] Killer B Medal + Transcendence Decoder x10[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Players who already possess the [Honor] Killer B medal cannot receive another one, but they will still receive the Transcendence Decoder reward.
[*]Only the player that delivers the final hit that pops the balloon will add it to their total kill count (for the purpose of this achievement).[/list]

[u][h3]Transcendence Chest Giveaway (6/29 - 7/13)[/h3][/u]Play CSN:S with the revamped Transcendence Chests!

[b]Daily Conditions / Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Each Log-In (Once Daily)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b979c64683f71ee9e32b5e70f1281f188fcf89c0.png[/img]
- CSN:S Event Ticket
[*]Upon Reaching 10/20/40 Minutes of Playtime (3 Times Daily)
- CSN:S Event Ticket + Transcendence Chest
[*]Reach 20 points through kills, assists, or human infections (excluding bots) in a Zombie Mode (Once Daily).
- CSN:S Event Ticket + Rare Decoder x2
[*]Clear a Zombie Scenario mode on Hard or higher after scoring 100 Kill Points (Once Daily).
- CSN:S Event Ticket + Rare Decoder x2[/list]
[b]Cumulative Rewards Based on total Accumulated CSN:S Event Tickets[/b]
[list][*]5: Transcendence Chest x5
[*]15: Transcendence Chest x10
[*]30: Transcendence Chest x15
[*]50: Transcendence Chest x20
[*]70: Transcendence Chest x25[/list]
[b]Transcendence Chest Contents (You will receive one of the listed items, with a varying chance for each reward.)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ad7481bc04974de310e20073d961f702747a7363.png[/img]
[list][*]Magnum Launcher (Permanent)
[*]Trinity Grenade (Permanent) 
[*]X-TRACKER (Permanent) 
[*]Lightning Fury (Permanent) 
[*]Magnum Shooter (Permanent) 
[*]SKULL-T9 (Permanent) 
[*]+0 - +9 Weapons (Durational & Permanent)[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (includes Laboratory mode, excludes Studio Mode).
[*]At least 5 minutes of playtime is required to co mplete Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*]Excludes Zombie Scenario: Survival: Double Gate / Survival: Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*]Each account can only receive rewards once.
[*]You can obtain no more than 6 CSN:S Event Tickets per day.
[*]All unused CSN:S Event Tickets and Transcendence Chests will be removed during maintenance on 7/13/2022 (Wed).[/list]

[u][h3]Log Into CSNS Every Day & Earn Rewards! Event (6/29 – 7/13)[/h3][/u]Earn rewards based on the total number of days you log in!

[b]Missions / Login Rewards[/b]
[list][*]1 Day: Transcendence Decoder + Event Decoder + 10,000 Mileage
[*]2 Days: Class Decoder + 1,000 Mileage
[*]3 Days: Transcendence Decoder + Premium Class Decoder +10,000 Mileage
[*]4 Days: Event Decoder + 1,000 Mileage
[*]5 Days: Transcendence Decoder + Event Decoder + 10,000 Mileage
[*]6 Days: Event Decoder x2 + 1,000 Mileage
[*]7 Days: Transcendence Decoder + Transcendence Premium Decoder + 10,000 Mileage
[*]8 Days: Class Decoder + 1,000 Mileage
[*]9 Days: Transcendence Decoder + Class Decoder x2 + 10,000 Mileage
[*]10 Days: Event Decoder x3 + 1,000 Mileage
[*]11 Days: Transcendence Decoder + Event Decoder x3 + 10,000 Mileage
[*]12 Days: Class Decoder x5 + 1,000 Mileage
[*]13 Days: Transcendence Decoder x5 + Transcendence Premium Decoder + 10,000 Mileage
[*]14 Days: Class Decoder x3 + 1,000 Mileage
[*]15 Days: Transcendence Decoder + Event Decoder + 10,000 Mileage[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Rewards can only be obtained once per account.
[*]All unused Transcendence Premium Decoders will be removed during maintenance on 8/10/2022 (Wed).[/list]

[u][h3]Have More Fun With CSNS & Earn Rewards! Event (6/29 – 7/13)[/h3][/u]Earn rewards for each level by completing daily routine missions during the event.

[b]Earn each stage's rewards upon completing the daily routine missions during the event.[/b]
[list][*]Stage 0: Click 'Claim Reward' from the Login Supplies window - Receive 3,000 Mileage 
[*]Stage 1: Click the 'Missions' tab (Check Mission) - Receive 5,000 Points 
[*]Stage 2: Purchase Point Decoders from the Shop to receive Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x10 or Click 'Exploration' at the Bottom of the Lobby and Start an Exploration to receive Exploration Success Rate-Up +10% x5 
[*]Stage 3: Play Original / Zombie Scenario / Zombie Z / Zombie Classic / Zombie Hero / Zombie Evolution / Hide and Seek mode 1 time - Receive Rare Decoder x3
[*]Stage 4: Log In on Another Day - Receive Transcendence Decoder + Class Decoder[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Rewards must be claimed in order from stage 0 to 4. 
[*]You can fulfill Stage 2's conditions by completing either of the missions. 
[*]You can fulfill Stage 4's conditions without your log-ins having to be on two consecutive days.
[*]Completed stages (missions) are reset every day at midnight. 
[*]You can progress up through Stage 3 even on the last day of the event. 
[*]The rewards for each stage can only be obtained once per account.
[*]Minimum 3 People
[*]Can be Progressed in Studio and Laboratory Modes[/list]

[u][h3]Good-Bye Season 12 Double-Up Event (6/29 - 7/13)[/h3][/u][list][*]Earn double the amount of Season Badges from daily and weekly missions during the event.[/list]

[u][h3]Bonus Disassembly Event (6/29 - 7/13)[/h3][/u]Use the Bonus Disassembly System during the event to disassemble your weapons, and you might even get a few fully disassembled!

[b]Event Dates and Criteria[/b]
[list][*]Both Weekdays and Weekends 2:00 PM – 6:00 PM CEST
[*]Minimum Participation Mileage: 5,000[/list]

[u][h3]Mileage Auction Event (6/29 - 7/13)[/h3][/u]You can access the auction via the 'Mileage Auction' button at the bottom of the lobby during the event.

[b]Auction Items Added[/b]
[list][*]Miracle Prism Sword[/list]
[b]Auction Feature / Content[/b]
[list][*]Item Rank
- Premium (All weapons except for premium are Normal Rank)
[*]Auction Time
- 1 hour for all items
[*]Number of Auction Listings
- 2 (+ Increases based on VIP rank)
[*]Regarding the Market Price of Items
- When listing an item, you can check the current Auction House market price (Lowest bid and direct purchase prices)
[*]Item Display
- Only items with the lowest bid or direct purchase price are displayed
[*]Auction Settings
- You can search by bid/direct purchase price, enhancement level, and weapon name.
[*]Sell-to-System Feature
- When an auction is unsuccessful, you have the opportunity to use the sell-to-system feature.
[*]Auction Hours
- 24 Hours (00:00.00 – 23:59.59) - When auction hours end, currently listed items will be canceled.[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]The M3 Black Dragon will be removed from premium and replaced with the Miracle Prism Sword.
[*]The remaining time is shown in 5-minute increments for listed auction items.
[*]You can only bid on 1 item at a time.
[*]Regular auction items will be listed with a 30% fee included in the initial bidding price.
[*]If an item listed for auction is not sold, the item will be returned.
[*]Items listed for auction can be purchased immediately at the direct purchase price.
[*]If you list an item for auction, you cannot withdraw it until the auction's duration has ended.
[*]The item you listed may be shown on the bid page.
[*]When listing an item, you can easily check the actual amount you will receive under the 'Net Reward' section.
[*]Some recently released weapons are ineligible to be listed at auction.[/list]

[u][h3]Login Supplies Event (6/29 – 7/26)[/h3][/u]
[b]Login Reward by Day[/b]
[list][*]Daily Weapons Supply: 4 Transcendence Weapons (1 Day) + Daily Attendance Reward Box[/list]
[b]Cumulative Login Rewards[/b]
[list][*]5 Days: Dual Beretta Gunslinger (20 Days)
[*]10 Days: Infinity Laser Fist (20 Days)
[*]15 Days: Magnum Launcher (20 Days)
[*]20 Days: Trinity Grenade (20 Days)
[*]25 Days: Dread Nova (10 Days)[/list]
[b]Extra Cumulative Rewards Event[/b]
[list][*]Each time you receive cumulative rewards, you'll receive a Cumulative Attendance Reward Box.[/list]

[u][h3]Hero and Sidekick Weapons Return (6/29 – 7/27)[/h3][/u]Try out the returning Hero and Sidekick weapons during the event!

[b]Receive Returning Hero Weapons upon Logging In During the Event[/b]
[list][*]Login Rewards
- SVD Custom + Grenade Launcher (60 Days) 
- Quad Barrel Shotgun (60 Days)
- Dual Kriss Custom (60 Days)
- M134 Vulcan (60 Days)[/list]
[b]Earn Returning Sidekick Weapons Upon Successfully Killing (or Infecting) from the Round End Window in a Zombie Mode[/b]
[list][*]Conditions and Obtainable Items
- 5 Kills / Infections: Dual Desert Eagles (60 Days)
- 10 Kills / Infections: Dual Nata Knife (60 Days)
- 15 Kills / Infections: Dual MP7A1 (60 Days)
- 20 Kills / Infections: Poison Launcher (60 Days)
- 30 Kills / Infections: AR-47 60R (60 Days)[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*]Rewards can only be obtained once per account.
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (includes Laboratory mode, excludes Studio Mode).
[*]At least 5 minutes of playtime is required to complete missions.
[*]The 9 durational weapons provided can't have their durations extended further.[/list]


[h2]Shop Update[/h2]

[u][h3]New Transcendence Weapon Death Eater Promotion (6/29 - 8/10)[/h3][/u]The Death Eater can drop from the Transcendence Premium Decoder and Transcendence Decoder during the event.

[b]Death Eater Drop Rates[/b]
[list][*]Transcendence Premium Decoder: 3%
[*]Transcendence Decoder: 0.45%[/list]
[b]Death Eater[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/638ee27eb3869435758bd358c74c2de383b17d0c.png[/img]
[list][*]A shotgun developed with alien technology that can hit nearby targets simultaneously with its basic attacks. Its special attack, Hyper Beam, deals damage to enemies in front of the wielder.[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Unused Transcendence Premium Decoders will be removed during maintenance on the last day of the promotion. (Standard Transcendence Decoders will not be removed.)
[*]500 mileage will be awarded in return for each Transcendence Premium Decoder removed in this manner.[/list]

[u][h3]New Transcendence Weapon Death Eater Guaranteed Giveaway (6/29 - 8/10)[/h3][/u]Depending on the number of Transcendence Premium Decoders and Transcendence Decoders used during the event, you could receive a Death Eater (Permanent)!

[b]Conditions[/b]
[list][*]Each time you reach 300 Guaranteed Points[/list]
[b]Reward[/b]
[list][*]Death Eater (Permanent)[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]6 Guaranteed Points are earned each time you use 1 Transcendence Premium Decoder.
[*]1 Guaranteed Point is earned each time you use 1 Transcendence Decoder.[/list]

[u][h3]New Items Added[/h3][/u][b]Transcendence Decoder Supply Box 30 Days[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0a17f2c0ff571b6cfce5437a6302e42f58ea2c48.png[/img]
[list][*]This Supply Box grants 5 Transcendence Decoders per day for 30 days if you log in. Decoders will not be granted for the days not logged in.[/list]
[b]Class Decoder Supply Box 30 Days[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/eb89a2afe986158628693a1bdf160137c3d7a9b1.png[/img]
[list][*]This Supply Box grants 5 Class Decoders per day for 30 days if you log in. Decoders will not be granted for the days not logged in.[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]5 Transcendence/Class Decoders will be granted each day when logging in for 30 days after the first purchase (A distribution per day).
[*]The Box is automatically activated from the date of purchase without a separate use button.
[*]Decoders will not be granted for days that are not logged in within the 30 days, and the period cannot be extended.
[*]The maximum number of decoders that one can acquire after purchasing the item is 150.[/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: June 15th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0088b43058596f59994d8742d74088975a7f9da8.jpg[/img]

Additional Content & Events have been added!


[h2]New Content[/h2]

[u][h3]New Map Information[/h3][/u]
[b]Market[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/039fdf2f742a642d1fd048551afde67e16d26810.png[/img]
[list][*]Description: A modernized yet traditional market.
[*]Mode: Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Bot Deathmatch, Bot Team Deathmatch[/list]


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[u][h3]Cool Summer Rewards Event (6/15 – 6/29)[/h3][/u]CSNS is great in the summer! Play with your friends and earn rewards to fight back against the heat! Get rewards for reaching 30 minutes of playtime every day during the event.

[b]Day / Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Day 1: Select 1 Queen/Cyborg (3 Days) + 1,000 Mileage
[*]Day 2: Rare Decoder (x3) + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box (x3) + 1,000 Mileage
[*]Day 3: Rare Decoder (x3) + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box + 1,000 Mileage

[*]Day 5: Transcendence Decoder + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box (x2)
[*]Day 6: Rare Decoder (x10) + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box (x3) + 1,000 Mileage
[*]Day 7: Event Decoder + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon
[*]Day 8: Unique Decoder (x4) + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon (x2) 
[*]Day 9: Event Decoder (x2) + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box
[*]Day 10: Transcendence Decoder + Class Decoder (x3)
[*]Day 11: Transcendence Decoder + Premium Class Decoder

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9090a63499b72674c4e24e044299e4eda9f2a764.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b]Content: New Classic (Zombie) Weapon Restriction Options Added[/b]
New weapon restriction options will be added to New Classic (Zombie)!

[b]Content: Event Map[/b]
Kill the Nightmare: Teddy Terror boss zombie that spawns each round!

[b]Contest: Global Costume Design Contest Info[/b]
To celebrate the new Transcendence Class that will be released soon, a Global Costume Design Contest will be held!

[b]Promotion: Epic Weapon Void Avenger Promotion (6/2 - 6/29)[/b]
Get the Void Avenger from Epic Decoders and try to get the Supreme Sentinel, too![/list]
Check out the Details section below for more information. 


[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]


[h2]New Content[/h2]

[u][h3]New Classic (Zombie) Weapon Restriction Options Added[/h3][/u]
[b]New Classic (Zombie) Weapon Restrictions[/b]
[list][*]New weapon restrictions have been added to New Classic (Zombie). (The previous New Classic weapon restrictions can also be used.)
[*]The following firearms have been added to or removed from New Classic (Zombie) options based on the New Classic weapon restriction option. (No changes have been made to the previous New Classic weapon restriction list.)
[*]Weapon restriction options for New Classic (Zombie) will continue to be adjusted based on firearm balancing and supply.[/list]
[b]Added New Classic (Zombie) Options Based on New Classic Options[/b]
[list][*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/32f63583771bc05971f3aa78a907e890945a7bdf.png[/img][/list]
[b]Deleted New Classic (Zombie) Option Firearms based on New Classic Options[/b]
[list][*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/4064dea41078181b0c45bfec3f07b9be0a223173.png[/img][/list]
[b]Added the following weapons to the New Classic Options[/b]
[list][*]Elegant Hunting Dagger, PP-19 Bizon Splash, Sawed-Off M79 Splash, GROZA Splash, UTS-15 Splash, RPG-7 Splash, M200 Splash, Halloween PSG-1, Halloween TAR-21, Halloween Dual Kriss, Halloween MK48, Halloween AutoMag V, Halloween Hammer, Matchlock Pistol, Kingdom Bow, Kingdom Rifle[/list]

[u][h3]Event Map Information[/h3][/u]
[b]Nightmare: Teddy Terror Boss (6/2 - 6/15)[/b]
[list][*]Teddy Terror has a chance to spawn in Nightmare Round 6.[/list]


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[u][h3]Annihilated: Nightmare Key Giveaway (6/2 - 6/15)[/h3][/u]Receive keys every day and play on the Nightmare map!

[b]Annihilated: Nightmare Key[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/4a03938d9aabdc57ecc720a23b062992c901c27e.png[/img]
[list][*]Get on log in[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Get one a day per account[/list]

[u][h3]Nightmare Teddy Terror Play Event (6/2 - 6/15)[/h3][/u]Win various rewards by defeating Teddy Terror!

[b]Missions[/b]
[list][*]Defeat Teddy Terror on Hard Difficulty or higher
[*]Get additional rewards upon obtaining the Reward Box that drops by defeating the Teddy Terror boss[/list]
[b]Reward (You will get one of the items, with a different chance to receive each.)[/b]
[list][*]100 / 150 / 300 / 500 / 1,000 / 2,000 Mileage
[*]Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x5
[*]Jackpot Point Box
[*]Grade 5 Parts Reward Box
[*]Grade 4 Parts Reward Box
[*]Grade 3 Parts Reward Box
[*]Rare Decoder (x3)
[*]Unique Decoder (x2)[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Get rewards up to three times a day per account
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (excludes Studio Mode).
[*]Jackpot Point Box: 1,000 - 100,000 Points (Get based on unique chances)[/list]

[u][h3]Mission: Defeat Teddy Terror Every Day! (6/2 - 6/15)[/h3][/u]Get various rewards based on the total Nightmare Map clear count.

[b]Mission: Clear Annihilated - Nightmare Map (Participate up to twice a day)[/b]
[list][*]Total Clear Count / Reward (Get one based on unique chance)
- 2 Times: Unique Decoder
- 3 Times: Festive Nameplate (30 Days)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/14779678e42ce8c319c79312a01fd75701880927.png[/img]
- 5 Times: CSO Operative Box + Transcendence Weapon Selection Box
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/31e58a4d57d77010a544d632070ae628b8ec40d4.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/4d4346bf988d6481a255022d98ae13971518a3a7.png[/img]
- 10 Times: Event Decoder x10
- 13 Times: Old-Time Costume Box x3
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c9d7c57c8b1b3a2166c0af8f7e9fc323a1c9e8b6.png[/img]
- 20 Times: Class Decoder x5
- 24 Times: Transcendence Decoder x10[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Each reward can be obtained only once per account.
[*]Participate in up to two missions a day per account
[*]Any unused Transcendence Weapon Selection Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 7/13.
[*]All unused Old-Time Costume Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 6/15
[*]Event Decoders can be used up until midnight on the day they were obtained.[/list]

[u][h3]Dragon Boat Festival Event (6/2 – 6/15)[/h3][/u]
[b]Zongzi Grenade Giveaway[/b]
[list][*]Receive a Zongzi Grenade on first login[/list]
[b]Zongzi Grenade Kill Event[/b]
[list][*]Missions
- Get an Event Reward for getting 1 kill with a Zongzi Grenade during the event
- Random kill damage applied to Zongzi Grenades in Zombie Mode
[*]Reward (Get one at random)
- 100 Mileage Coupon
- 150 Mileage Coupon
- Zombie Damage Meter 7 Days
- Rare Decoder x3
- Rare Decoder x5
- Rare Decoder x10
- Grade 3 Parts Reward Box
- Grade 4 Parts Reward Box
- Grade 5 Parts Reward Box
- Class Decoder
- Unique Decoder
- VVIP Free Pass (1 Day)
- Event Decoder
- Nickname Change
- Reduced Respawn Time (30 Days)
[*]Notice
- Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (excludes Studio Mode).
- Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Evolution / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z
- Earn 10 rewards a day per account
- Event Reward Boxes are removed during maintenance after the event ends.[/list]

[u][h3]Login Supplies Event (6/2 - 6/28)[/h3][/u]
[b]Login Reward by Day[/b]
[list][*]Daily Weapons Supply: 4 Transcendence Weapons (1 Day) + Daily Attendance Reward Box[/list]
[b]Cumulative Login Reward[/b]
[list][*]5 Days: Dual Beretta Gunslinger (20 Days)
[*]10 Days: Infinity Laser Fist (20 Days)
[*]15 Days: Magnum Launcher (20 Days)
[*]20 Days: Trinity Grenade (20 Days)
[*]25 Days: Dread Nova (10 Days)[/list]
[b]Extra Cumulative Rewards Event[/b]
[list][*]Each time you receive cumulative rewards, you'll receive a Cumulative Attendance Reward Box.[/list]

[u][h3]Supreme Sentinel Crafting Event (6/2 - 6/29)[/h3][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e5699ee9717e1ed17bfe023755758a9659fef5da.png[/img]
Craft a Supreme Sentinel using the 3 crafting materials!

[b]Crafting Materials[/b]
[list][*]Material 1: Supreme Sentinel's Blueprints
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/753fcb55eec57113b52ce1f3f65d6d96145ac818.png[/img]
[*]Material 2: Void Judgment
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/729dd1c7936fbea0ea550ab9ef28b7e53ae92725.png[/img]
[*]Material 3: Overseer Technology
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b703420da54e9e41cb7b3041d8bd6ff2cb562931.png[/img][/list]
[b]How to Craft[/b]
[list][*]Use the Overseer Technology when all of the above items are in your inventory to craft a Supreme Sentinel (Permanent). 
[*]You can only get one of the Supreme Sentinel's Blueprints / Void Judgment / Overseer Technology / Supreme Sentinel (Permanent) regardless of how they are obtained. 
[*]Unused Supreme Sentinel's Blueprints / Void Judgment / Overseer Technology items are removed during the maintenance after the event ends. 
[*]If you do not own the Supreme Sentinel weapon and have the following, mileage replacement will be provided on 6/29.
- 6,000 mileage replacement with the collection of the Void Judgment.
- 900 mileage replacement with collection of the Overseer Technology.[/list]

[u][h3]Supreme Sentinel's Blueprints Collection Event (6/2 - 6/29)[/h3][/u]Get one Supreme Sentinel's Blueprints if you already own a Void Avenger (Permanent)!

[b]How to Get[/b]
[list][*]If you have a Void Avenger (Permanent) before the event starts 
- Get one Supreme Sentinel's Blueprints upon first log in after maintenance
[*]If you don't have a Void Avenger (Permanent) before the event, but get one from an Epic Decoder during the event
- Get one Supreme Sentinel's Blueprints upon first getting a Void Avenger (Permanent)[/list]

[list][*]Get one Void Judgment Material each time you earn 8 Kill Points from kills/assists/human infections in a Zombie mode. (Up to eight times a day)

[url=https://discord.gg/9w9bjyvRxE]CLICK HERE TO PARTICIPATE![/url]

[b]Subject: Create a costume that can be used by all classes[/b]

[*]Reward Distribution: 8/24 (Rewards excluding creations are sent on 8/24)[/list]

[list][*]What to Submit: Costume image (JPG or PNG file)
[*]How to Submit:
- 1. Read the Costume Contest warnings below.
- 2. Download the template and create your own costume.

[*]There is no participation limit to this contest, and while one participant may make multiple submissions, they will not get multiple awards.

[*]All legal responsibilities fall to the person who submitted the entry, should there be a dispute regarding the entry.

Additional Content & Events have been added!


[h2]New Content[/h2]

[h2]New Events[/h2]

[b]Missions / Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Use a Supply Box Once in Children's Estate or Castle Land
- Piling Gift Box x1
[*]Score a Kill/Infection in Zombie Mode
- Piling Gift Box x1
[*]Clear a Zombie Scenario mode on Hard or higher after scoring 100 Kill Points
- Piling Gift Box x2
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/07ba8a6a29234b7202be3b8ed3791325e9e511ac.png[/img][/list]
[b]Accumulated Boxes / Rewards[/b]
[list][*]10 Piling Gift Boxes: Unique Decoder x3 + Random Dice Spray (5 Days) x1
[*]20 Piling Gift Boxes: 5,000 Mileage Coupon + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x10
[*]30 Piling Gift Boxes: 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x9
[*]40 Piling Gift Boxes: 5,000 Mileage Coupon + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5
[*]50 Piling Gift Boxes: Event Decoder x5 + Exploration Level Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*]70 Piling Gift Boxes: Unique Premium Decoder x3
[*]90 Piling Gift Boxes: Class Decoder x5

[*]120 Piling Gift Boxes: Transcendence Decoder x10[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Supply Box use in Children's Estate or Castle Land missions can be done once a day
[*]Piling Gift Boxes are accumulated items and can't be used individually
[*]You can earn up to 10 Piling Gift Boxes a day
[*]Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero (Defense Mode included) / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*]Excludes Zombie Scenario Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos maps.
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (excludes Studio Mode, includes Laboratory Mode).
[*]Human player kills scored in auto play in Laboratory mode are excluded.
[*]All unused Piling Gift Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 6/2
[*]Event Decoders can be used up until midnight on the day they were obtained.[/list]

[h3]One More Time Daily Routines Event (5/18 - 6/2)[/h3]The daily routines event returns! Follow the daily routines in CSNS and claim your rewards!

[b]Missions / Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Stage 0: Click Claim Reward from the Login Supplies window.
- 100 Mileage
[*]Stage 1: Check Event by clicking on the Missions tab.
- 5,000 Points
[*]Stage 2: Purchase Point Decoders from the Shop.
- Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x3
[*]Stage 2: Proceed with Exploration by clicking Exploration at the bottom of the lobby.
- Exploration Success Rate-Up x1
[*]Stage 3: Play Original / Zombie Scenario / Zombie Z / Zombie Classic / Zombie Hero / Zombie Evolution / Hide and Seek Mode 1 time.
- Rare Decoder x3
[*]Stage 4: Log in next time.
- Unique Decoder x1[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]All Players May Participate
[*]Complete Stage 0 to proceed to Stage 1, and complete Stage 1 to proceed to Stage 2.
[*]You can progress normally from Stage 2 by completing either of the missions.
[*]You can claim the reward for Stage 4 without having to log in consecutively.
[*]Completed stages (missions) are reset every day at midnight.
[*]You can progress to Stage 3 by the maintenance date of 6/2.
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (excludes Studio, includes Laboratory).[/list]


[h2]Shop Update[/h2]

[h3]Transcendence Class Dragon Knight Kyrix, High Elf Natasha Promotion (5/18 - 6/15)[/h3]During the event, the drop rates of two transcendence classes (Dragon Knight Kyrix and High Elf Natasha) from Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders are four times higher.

[b]Dragon Knight Kyrix, High Elf Natasha Drop Rates[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0bc24d998eb5932b62efdb4b00e5a5dc8e7ec2f7.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e1d0d5192ac7acc1a6ecd5860644086ffc39a6a7.png[/img]
[list][*]Premium Class Decoder: 2% each
[*]Class Decoder: 0.5% each[/list]

[h3]Transcendence Class Dragon Knight Kyrix, High Elf Natasha Guaranteed Giveaway (5/18 - 6/15)[/h3]Get guaranteed 2 Transcendence Classes (Dragon Knight Kyrix, High Elf Natasha) based on how many Class Decoders and Class Premium Decoders are used during the event!

[b]Conditions / Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Upon reaching 150/300 Guaranteed Points
- Select either Dragon Knight Kyrix or High Elf Natasha
- Automatically receive Kyrix's Dragon Knight Shield or Natasha's Orb based on selected class
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f454f7b83666b5bc49ac92d59b86760af713f45b.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/341ec314aa5f7e80c706c2ec954de4de7476ceef.png[/img]
[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]1 Guaranteed Point given each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
[*]3 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Premium Class Decoder.
[*]Guaranteed Giveaway rewards can be granted only once per account.
[*]Get the [Honor] Otherworld Denizen medal by having Dragon Knight Kyrix, High Elf Natasha, Kyrix's Dragon Knight Shield, Natasha's Orb (Permanent) in your inventory.[/list]

[h3]Class/Premium Class Decoder Permanent Content Update (5/18 - Permanent)[/h3]

[b]Transcendence Class Pink Heart Shiho, Black Rose Miho, Queen, Cyborg, are permanently added.[/b]
[list][*]Premium Class Decoder: Group 1 added
[*]Class Decoder: Group 1 + Group 6 added[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Changed contents per group are applied to durational items in the same way.
[*]The above classes don't receive exclusive costumes when drawn with a decoder.[/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: May 4th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ed95384218dd36484dfef69741ac28dbedc8886f.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b]Content: Defense Mode Update[/b]
Protect the evolution suppressor from zombie attacks!

[b]Content: Zombie Mode Update[/b]
From added options to a Zombie Z update, check it out all now!

[b]Promotion: New Transcendence Weapon Whip Sword Promotion (5/4 - 6/29)[/b]
Check out the new Transcendence melee weapon made of linked sword segments in the form of a whip, increasing the weapon's attack speed and range!

[b]Event: Class Rotation Group Appearance Event (5/4 - 5/18)[/b]
Private Erica, Drill Instructor Gerard, Leader Soi, and Super Soldier Jennifer are added to the Class Decoder's new [Rotation Group] during the event only![/list]
Check out the Details section below for more information.
 

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]


[h2]New Content[/h2]

[u][h3]Defense Mode Update[/h3][/u]See [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/3189121526256586179][Defense Mode Preview][/url] for more details.

[b]New Zombie Hero Event Mode, Defense Mode, Released (5/4 - 6/2)[/b]
[list][*]An event mode where players must protect (Humans) or destroy (Zombies) the Evolution Suppressor that spawns in a random location.
- Human Victory Criteria: Protect the Evolution Suppressor
- Zombie Victory Criteria: Destroy the Evolution Suppressor or infect all Humans within the time limit[/list]
[b]Zombie Hero Defense Mode Map Added[/b]
[list][*]Defense Mode Italy
[*]Defense Mode Assault
[*]Defense Mode Dust
[*]Defense Mode Cantera
[*]Defense Mode Falls[/list]

[u][h3]Zombie Mode Update[/h3][/u]
[b]Weapon Restrictions - Cooldown Option Added[/b]
[list][*]The cooldown time rule from Competitive Match will be added as a weapon restriction option.
- Selectable Modes: Zombie / Zombie Original / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution[/list]
[b]Zombie Z Update[/b]
[list][*]Unlock Level Changes
- Hunter-Killer X-90: 24 → 25
- Starlight Rolling Shooter: 25 → 23
- Dual Sword Infernal Hunter: 25 → 24
- Gear-Bird Cannon Mk. 3: 18 → 20
- Gear-Bird Cannon Mk. 2: 9 → 11
- Gear-Bird Cannon Mk. 2: 1 → 3
- X-TRACKER: 25 → 24)
- Barrett M95 White Tiger: 33 → 32
- SCAR OZ-D: 20 → 21
- Tiamat MK-4: 21 → 22
- Psychic Sizer: 36 → 37
- M249 Phoenix: 22 → 21
- Blue Storm: 38 → 39[/list]


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[u][h3]Login Supplies Event (5/4 - 6/2)[/h3][/u]When you check-in for attendance during the event, you'll get daily and cumulative rewards.

[b]Login Reward by Day[/b]
[list][*]Daily Weapons Supply
- Contents: 4 Transcendence Weapons (1 Day) + 1 Daily Attendance Reward Box[/list]
[b]Cumulative Login Reward[/b]
[list][*]5 Days: Dual Beretta Gunslinger (20 Days)
[*]10 Days: Infinity Laser Fist (20 Days)
[*]15 Days: Magnum Launcher (20 Days)
[*]20 Days: Trinity Grenade (20 Days)
[*]25 Days: Dread Nova (10 Days)[/list]
[b]Extra Cumulative Rewards Event[/b]
[list][*]Each time you receive cumulative rewards, you'll receive a Cumulative Attendance Reward Box.[/list]

[u][h3]Spring Winds Bring Spring Flower Boxes (5/4 - 5/18)[/h3][/u]You can obtain Spring Boxes and Spring Flower Boxes by earning points during the event through completing missions.

[b]Missions and Points Earned[/b]
[list][*]Cumulative Login Time: 30 mins / 60 mins / 90 mins - Once Each
- 1 Point (3 Daily)
[*]Cumulative Playtime: 10 mins / 30 mins / 60 mins - Once Each
- 1 Point (3 Daily)
[*]Use a Decoder Once (Regardless of type)
- 1 Point
[*]Proceed with Exploration Once
- 1 Point
[*]Click "Get Login Supplies"
- 1 Point
[*]Use Crafting Once
- 1 Point
[*]Zombie Mode Play: 2 Kills / 6 Assists
- 1 Point (5 Daily)
[*]Play Zombie Scenario Mode on Hard or higher: Clear 1 Session
- 1 Point (5 Daily)[/list]
[b]Total Points and Rewards[/b]
[list][*]5 Points: Spring Box (4 Daily)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/86dcde4ccddc686912feab2d98254d76c12f40e6.png[/img]
[*]15 Points: Spring Flower Box (1 Daily)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/505d1fa6644d2977c561fcadae1d8cb5c862e84a.png[/img][/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Event resets every day at midnight (24:00).
[*]You can earn up to 20 points, 4 Spring Boxes, and 1 Spring Flower Box daily per account.
[*]All unused Spring and Spring Flower boxes will be removed during maintenance on 5/18 (Wed).
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (excludes Laboratory on auto and Studio Mode).
[*]Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero (Defense Mode included) / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*]Excludes Zombie Scenario Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos maps.
[*]At least 5 minutes of playtime is required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]All decoders including Point Decoders count towards the Use a Decoder mission.
[*]Weapon enhancement (All enhancement levels, success/failure) / part equipping / part combination / weapon paints / item disassembly are included for the Use Crafting mission.
[*]The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list]

[u][h3]New and Returning Player Welcome Event (5/4 - Permanent)[/h3][/u]Rewards are given to new and returning players upon logging in during the event.

[b]New User Package / Welcome Back Supply Box (Get All Content)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f2c127b464057271f3931a971aa200feb1099e7e.png[/img]
[list][*]Magnum Launcher (15 Days)
[*]X-TRACKER (15 Day)
[*]Trinity Grenade (15 Day)
[*]Infinity Laser Fist (15 Day)
[*]Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (15 Day)
[*]Dual Beretta Gunslinger (15 Day)
[*]Hunter Killer X-90 (15 Days)
[*](Grade 6 Gun Boost / Grade 6 Vampiric Equipped)
[*]Hunter Killer X-12 (15 Days)
[*](Grade 6 Gun Boost / Grade 6 Speed Up Equipped)[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Each account can receive these items once.
[*]New User Package and Welcome Back Supply Boxes will be used as soon as you obtain them.
[*]Returning players are those who have not logged in for 30 at least days.[/list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e2d02fc7e97113263baf576cc1a09bdac768af17.jpg[/img]

New Events have been added!


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[h3]Mileage Auction Event (4/27 – 5/10)[/h3]You can access the auction via the "Mileage Auction" button on the bottom of the lobby during the event.

[b]Auction Items Added[/b]
[list][*]X-TRACKER[/list]
[b]Auction Feature / Content[/b]
[list][*]Item Rank
- Premium (All weapons except for premium are Normal Rank)
[*]Auction Time
- 1 hour for all items
[*]Number of Auction Listings
- 2 (+ Increases based on VIP rank)
[*]Regarding the Market Price of Items
- When listing an item, you can check the current Auction House market price (Lowest bid and direct purchase prices)
[*]Item Display
- Only items with the lowest bid or direct purchase price are displayed
[*]Auction Settings
- You can search by bid/direct purchase price, enhancement level, and weapon name.
[*]Sell-to-System Feature
- When an auction is unsuccessful, you have the opportunity to use the sell-to-system feature.
[*]Auction Hours
- 24 Hours (00:00.00 – 23:59.59) - When auction hours end, currently listed items will be canceled.[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]The Thunder Ghost Walker will be removed from premium and replaced with the X-TRACKER.
[*]The remaining time is shown in 5-minute increments for listed auction items.
[*]You can only bid for 1 item at a time.
[*]Regular auction items will be listed with a 30% fee included in the initial bidding price.
[*]If an item listed on the auction is not sold, the item will be returned.
[*]Items listed on the auction can be purchased immediately at the direct purchase price.
[*]If you list an item at auction, you cannot cancel it until the auction time ends.
[*]The item you listed may be shown on the bid page.
[*]When listing an item, you can easily check the actual amount you will receive under the "Net reward" section.
[*]Some recently released weapons are ineligible to be listed at auction.[/list]

[h3]Mileage Auction Special Event (4/27 - 5/10)[/h3]It's a 10,000 Mileage special event through the [Event] tab during the Mileage Auction period! Special items that you can get for 10,000 Mileage will appear periodically.

[list][*]4/27 (Wed): 4:00 PM - 5:00 PM CEST
- SEA: 9:00 PM – 10:00 PM

- ET: 9:00 PM – 10:00 PM
[*]4/30 (Sat): 4:00 PM - 5:00 PM CEST
- SEA: 9:00 PM – 10:00 PM
[*]5/1 (Sun): 9:00 PM - 10:00 PM CEST
[*]5/2 (Mon): 3:00 AM - 4:00 AM CEST
- ET: 9:00 PM – 10:00 PM
[*]5/3 (Tue): 6:00 AM - 7:00 AM CEST
- PT: 9:00 PM – 10:00 PM
[*]5/4 (Wed): 4:00 PM - 5:00 PM CEST
- SEA: 9:00 PM – 10:00 PM
[*]5/5 (Thu): 9:00 PM - 10:00 PM CEST
[*]5/6 (Fri): 3:00 AM - 4:00 AM CEST
- ET: 9:00 PM – 10:00 PM
[*]5/7 (Sat): 4:00 PM - 5:00 PM CEST
- SEA: 9:00 PM – 10:00 PM
[*]5/8 (Sun): 9:00 PM - 10:00 PM CEST
[*]5/9 (Mon): 3:00 AM - 4:00 AM CEST
- ET: 9:00 PM – 10:00 PM
[*]5/10 (Tue): 6:00 AM - 7:00 AM CEST[/list]
[b]Special Items[/b]
[list][*]Auction Weapon Raffle Ticket + Decoder[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*][Auction Weapon Raffle Ticket + Decoder] Contents: Transcendence Decoder x5 + Transcendence Premium Decoder + Auction Weapon Raffle Ticket
[*]The winner of the Auction Raffle will receive the new Mirage Transcendence Weapon Whip Sword (permanent).
[*]Rewards will be distributed during maintenance on Wednesday, May 18th.

Introducing the changes to the laboratory, Competitive Match, and zombie modes with the March update!

[b]Transcendence Weapon Devastator Promotion (4/6 - 5/4)[/b]
A heavy machine gun that uses 50 caliber flame rounds. Check out its large ammo feed and insane firepower right now!

[b]Transcendence Class Promotion (4/6 - 5/4)[/b]
Get Anemone, a professional gamer of the VR platform game Chrono World, and Mirage, a virtual streamer and skilled hacker![/list]
Check out the Details section below for more information.


[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]


[h2]New Content[/h2]

[u][h3]Season 12: Amusement Park (4/6 - 7/13)[/h3][/u]We welcome you to the CSNS amusement park! For details, please refer to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/3193623230188546633][Season 12 Pass Preview][/url].

[b]Black Market Open Early[/b]
[list][*]New Items Added
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/db39798836d7afa7ffd31731abb9cf434d1b0c33.png[/img]
- CSO Earmuffs, Orc Warrior Deimos (5 Days), Dark Elf Witch Banshee (5 Days), Elemental Tracker Parts Box (Elemental Tracker 2 Days + Grade 5 Gun Boost / Grade 5 Speed Part Equipped)[/list]
[b]Re-purchasing Past Season Passes Available[/b]
[list][*]A page where past season items can be purchased will be open to players who reach grade 100 on their Season Pass!
[*]The page opens with the player's previous progress of the past season, and they can purchase season grades from the page to obtain items.
[*]Previous Season Opening with this Patch: Season 9[/list]
[b]Season Reward Weapons: For players who don't have enough weapons, starting from Season 12, a single Season Pass will provide 3 weapons from different categories as rewards.
[/b]
[list][*]Pierrot Chameleon Gun
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1659b59bb0aecb7e9777243f804c1042b9ea22ab.png[/img]
- A special pistol made by a pierrot who was inspired by a pet chameleon. The five streams of water that the weapon fires make it easy to hit the target.
[*]Pierrot Magic Bow
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9e8a51caa43dc7eaa7751a0e1ca1d4be3957b289.png[/img]
- The energy bolt recharges automatically.
[*]Pierrot Blessing Sword
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/8185a2f26085d20fe0017125a10e80dba4b0f607.png[/img]
- The blade glows crimson when Blessing Guard is ready to use.[/list]
[b]Nameplate[/b]
[list][*]Season Pass Nameplate (12)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0280b19f8ccbad78dfff497be4147f0e7505522e.png[/img][/list]
[b]Damage Font[/b]
[list][*]Season Pass Font (12)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ac2e6a6328eb51ee8a44b128eba711fb70231b7e.png[/img]
- Can be set from [Options] - [Multiplayer] - [Display Damage]
- Unavailable for certain modes, including Classic[/list]
[b]Medal[/b]
[list][*]Season 12 Trailblazer Medal (Pass)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c1928feb7f0560b6d2bd619ff7beeb82f6e301b7.png[/img]
[*]Season 12 Conqueror Medal (Highest Rank Reached)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/7df023c3731d21c5b9d19a07a1b7065895ba8087.png[/img][/list]

[u][h3]League Season 8 (4/6 - 6/29)[/h3][/u]
[b]Additional Notices[/b]
[list][*]Items have been added to the Achievement Shop.
- New Nameplate Item Added: Flustered Emoji Spray, Bleh Emoji Spray, Grin Emoji Spray, Sad Emoji Spray, Heart Emoji Spray, Laugh Emoji Spray, Angry Emoji Spray[/list]
[b]Changes to Zombie and Zombie Scenario League Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Gold Rank
- Dual Beretta Gunslinger (20 Days) → X-TRACKER (20 Days)[/list]

[u][h3]Zombie Mode Update[/h3][/u]For details, please refer to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/3193623230188554031][Zombie Update Preview][/url].




[h2]New Events[/h2]

[u][h3]Login Supplies Event (4/6 - 5/4)[/h3][/u]
[b]Daily Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Daily Weapons Supply
- Contents: 4 Transcendence Weapons (1 Day) & 1 Daily Attendance Reward Box[/list]
[b]Cumulative Login Reward[/b]
[list][*]5 Days: Dual Beretta Gunslinger (20 Days)
[*]10 Days: Infinity Laser Fist (20 Days)
[*]15 Days: Magnum Launcher (20 Days)
[*]20 Days: Trinity Grenade (20 Days)
[*]25 Days: Dread Nova (10 Days)[/list]
[b]Extra Cumulative Rewards Event[/b]
[list][*]Each time you receive cumulative rewards, you'll receive a Cumulative Attendance Reward Box.[/list]
[u][h3]Season Badge Giveaway Event (4/6 - 7/13)[/h3][/u]
[b]Earn season badges by completing login conditions for Daily Missions[/b]
[list][*]30 Minutes: Season Badge x5
[*]1 Hour: Season Badge x10
[*]2 Hours: Season Badge x20[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Missions reset every day at midnight.
[*]You cannot use the difficulty change item on the event mission.[/list]

[u][h3]Spring Seed Event (4/6 - 4/20)[/h3][/u]Grow the seed that you get upon your daily first login into a fruit to get all kinds of rewards!

[b]Item Conditions and Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Seed: First Login
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2413ef787ca7761c5db61307b9f5171cc5ce7b8d.png[/img]
- Rare Decoder x5
[*]Sprout: Reach 20 minutes of playtime for Zombie Original/Zombie Mutant/Zombie Hero/Zombie Z/Zombie Evolution/Zombie Scenario after getting a seed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/146a4fe48269d4c678e2443b86e7e292ea34dd9e.png[/img]
- Event Decoder
[*]Fruit: Reach 20 minutes of play time in Zombie Classic/Zombie Mutant/Zombie Hero/Zombie Z/Zombie Evolution/Zombie Scenario + one of the missions below: (1) 5 human player kills / 10 zombie player kills (excluding bots) or (2) clear 1 session of Zombie Scenario on Hard or higher.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f012d6a93f5a47709aa18c1618cf82078f998bdc.png[/img]
- Get Harvested Fruit + One of the Following Items Based on Their Chance: VVIP Free Pass (2 Days), Grade 2 Parts Reward Box x5, Grade 3 Parts Reward Box x3, Grade 4 Parts Reward Box, Grade 5 Parts Reward Box, Unique Decoder x2/x5/x10/x20, Unique Premium Decoder x2, Event Decoder x2/x5/x10/x20, Queen (15 Days/Permanent), Cyborg (15 Days/Permanent), Pink Heart Shiho (15 Days/Permanent), Black Rose Miho (15 Days/Permanent)[/list]
[b]Harvested Fruit[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/4249bb88c4a683e304d0186b3a4584087b29b181.png[/img]
[list][*]3 Total: Transcendence Decoder
[*]5 Total: Transcendence Decoder + Class Decoder
[*]7 Total: Transcendence Decoder x2 + Class Decoder x2
[*]9 Total: Premium Class Decoder x3 + Transcendence Decoder x2[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]The Seed, Sprout, and Fruit items can all be used by pressing the Use button.
[*]The Seed and Sprout items can't grow into their next stages upon use.
[*]The Seed, Sprout, and Fruit items are all automatically removed every day at 11:59:59 PM, and the event resets.
[*]Harvested Fruit items aren't removed.
[*]All Harvested Fruit items are removed during the maintenance on 4/20.
[*]Cumulative Harvested Fruit rewards are given once per account.
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with four or more players (includes normal Laboratory mode play, excludes Studio Mode).
[*]For Zombie Scenario Mode, participation will only count when you play at least 5 minutes.
[*]Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Original / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*]Excludes Zombie Scenario: Survival: Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*]The Event Decoder can be used until before midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list]

[u][h3]Zombie Scenario Golden Zombie Event (4/6 - 7/13)[/h3][/u]Get rewards based on the total number of defeated Golden Zombies!

[b]Kill Requirements[/b]
[list][*]Upon Defeating 1 / 2 / 3 / 5 / 7 / 10[/list]
[b]Obtainable Rewards (Select 1 of the following)[/b]
[list][*]Add-on Selection Box x1
[*]Transcendence Weapon Selection Box x1
[*]CSO Operative Box x1
[*]100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Hitting the Golden Zombie once will count as credit for a kill.
[*]Each reward can be obtained once per account.
[*]Up to 3 can be defeated per day.
[*]The Golden Zombies have a chance to appear when playing for more than 3 minutes in rooms on Normal difficulty or higher.[/list]


[h2]Shop Update[/h2]

[u][h3]Devastator Promotion (4/6 - 5/4)[/h3][/u]The Devastator will drop from Transcendence Premium Decoders and Transcendence Decoders!

[b]Devastator Drop Rate[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0870b3c2f492ac0b4ad073937105212e7bead497.png[/img]
[list][*]Transcendence Premium Decoder: 3%
[*]Transcendence Decoder: 0.45%[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]All unused Transcendence Premium Decoders will be removed on the last day of the promotion during maintenance, and you will get 500 Mileage per decoder. (Transcendence Decoders aren't removed)[/list]

[u][h3]Devastator Guaranteed Giveaway (4/6 - 5/4)[/h3][/u]Depending on the number of Transcendence Premium Decoders and Transcendence Decoders used, you may be guaranteed to receive the Devastator (Permanent)!

[b]Reward Thresholds[/b]
[list][*]When Reaching 300 Guaranteed Points[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]6 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Transcendence Premium Decoder.
[*]1 Guaranteed Point given each time you use 1 Transcendence Decoder.[/list]

[u][h3]Anemone/Mirage Class Promotion (4/6 - 5/4)[/h3][/u]Anemone/Mirage have 4 times the drop rate from Premium Class Decoders/Class Decoders.

[b]Anemone/Mirage Drop Rate[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f06c11e59af717ad7e72a67861475ff28d439b99.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/84c207a4cc96dcf231630ea97902b74698eb24d4.png[/img]
[list][*]Premium Class Decoder: 2% each
[*]Class Decoder: 0.5% each[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Unused Premium Class Decoders are removed at the end of the event, and are replaced with 50 Mileage each.[/list]

[u][h3]Anemone/Mirage Class Guaranteed Giveaway (4/6 - 5/4)[/h3][/u]Get a guaranteed Anemone/Mirage based on the amount of used Premium Class Decoders/Class Decoders!

[b]Reward Thresholds[/b]
[list][*]Reach 150 Guaranteed Points: Choose Anemone or Miracle
[*]Reach 300 Guaranteed Points: Choose Anemone or Miracle[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Get Anemone's Drone upon selecting Anemone and Mirage's VR HMD upon selecting Mirage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a6f6a779ad1343d761212e092587cb55c9b74c7a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/501aa2b8359e81570af1731700fb7db0d4dfbc62.png[/img]
[*]3 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Premium Class Decoder.
[*]1 Guaranteed Point given each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
[*]Rewards from each stage can only be claimed once per account.[/list]


[h2]Other Miscellaneous Changes[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Medals are distributed based on the final rank reached (Master, Diamond) at the end of Zombie League (Official) Season 7.
[*] Add-On and part rewards added for clearing Zombie Scenario mode.
- Previously, the opportunity to acquire add-ons could only be earned through battles with elite monsters, but with this patch, add-ons are added as a reward for final clearing the zombie scenario map, and differential rewards are made for each map difficulty.
[*] Elite Zombie Kill Rewards adjusted for Zombie Scenario.
- Added a reward element that randomly distributes 20 of the 12 popular add-ons with high preference.
[*] Fixes to Agent Ritsuka's Zombie Scenario instant kill or powerful attack class skills.
- Kill count goes up upon killing an Elite Zombie using Agent Ritsuka's "You Think I'm Joking?" skill.
- Damage dealt from Agent Ritsuka's failed "You Think I'm Joking?" skill is applied as a fixed value.
- Fixed issue of skills being activated even while a player is dead.
- Class description added and adjustments made.
[*] Fixed issue of certain objects sticking out in Hideout mode.
[*] Fixed issue of sounds not playing for additionally charging the jet pack when the Bear Fury Mk. 3 is charged.
[*] Fixed issue of a different Season Conqueror Medal effect displaying from the one that's been set by the player.
[*] Exchanged menu icon on the bottom of the lobby. (Text can be checked by hovering the cursor over.)
[*] The enhancement success rate displayed in the game is now the same as the actual algorithmic logic.
- Despite the enhancement success rate being calculated down to the second decimal point, the game has been omitting them. This has been changed to reflect the full value.
- An example of the above is when using 10,000 enhancement EXP, the game would show a 0% success rate, but the actual value was 0.n%, resulting in some success cases.
- The enhancement success rate formula is the same as the one that was made public below. 
- Enhancement Success Rate = Cumulative Material EXP / Required Enhancement EXP
[*]Hardware Acceleration has been added to the Video Options menu. Be sure to check it out for improved framerate and smoother gameplay![/olist]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: March 10th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9a89122f5e0eaf7d9d191d723f59c347adcf114a.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b]Content: Laboratory Mode Update[/b]
The Laboratory is a mode added for pre-release testing, so we hope many of you check it out!

[b]Content: Zombie Mode Update[/b]
Check out the new updates from Competitive Matches to Zombie Z!

[b]Content: New Studio Map[/b]
Check out the newly created sample map made to showcase mine-themed blocks!

[b]Event: Studio Mine Theme Contest[/b]
A new studio contest will take place with the mine-themed Studio block update! We hope many players can participate!

[b]Promotion: New Transcendence Classes Agent Ritsuka, Pop Star Alin (3/10 - 4/6)[/b]
Get the Class (Premium) Decoder with 4x rates right now![/list]
Check out the Details section below for more information.


[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

 
[h2]New Content[/h2]

[u][h3]Laboratory Mode Update[/h3][/u]See [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/5997111559682571634][Laboratory Mode Preview][/url] for more details.

[b]Laboratory Mode Added[/b]
[list][*]A Laboratory mode has been added for pre-release game testing. New features and balance changes that require testing will be applied here first, and will proceed to official updates based on player feedback.
[*]March Test Items: Zombie Hero Mode (Italy)
- The number of Host Zombies will increase based on the number of participating players. (Max 5) There is a chance for an additional Host Zombie to spawn if the Auto Zombie Balance option is active.
- Normal Zombie base HP is increased from 15,000 to 18,000.
- The knockback and stun resistance of Zombies are increased.[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Test items added to the Laboratory are subject to change.
[*]You can progress in events in the Laboratory, but you can't earn League Points / progress in missions / add to total stats for Info - Zombie Mode / obtain Accolades.[/list]

[u][h3]Zombie Mode Update[/h3][/u]
[b]Cooperative Match Update[/b]
[list][*]Cost by Rank Changed
- Epic: 15 - 20
- Transcendent: 9 - 14
- Unique: 5 - 8
- Rare: 3 - 4
- Advanced: 1 - 2
- Regular: 0
- Weapons with the same rank may have independent costs.[/list]
[b]Zombie Z Update[/b]
[list][*]Weapon Unlock Levels Changed (Previous Unlock Level → New Unlock Level)
- Psychic Harmonium: 32 → 33
- Thunder Force: 34 → 35
- Laevateinn: 34 → 35
- Negev NG-7 Ajax: 30 → 27
- Gran Bird Cannon: 27 → 29
- Vendetta: 8 → 9
- Hunter-Killer X-15: 10 → 11
- Star Chaser SR: 16 → 15
- Magnum Drill: 15 → 14
- M4A1 Dark Knight: 18 → 19
- M4A1 Shadow Knight: 18 → 19
- SCAR OZ-D: 19 → 20
[*]Mutation Changes
- Painful Memories: Decreased damage taken from 50% to 30%.
- Quick Change: "Increases damage of the first attack after swapping" boost effect increased from 800% to 500%.[/list]

[u][h3]New Studio Map Information[/h3][/u]
[b]New [Crystal Cave] Studio Map Released[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c8510c2c4c9807068d34b6150786ac814dc7f59a.png[/img]
[list][*]Description: A background created to display mine-themed blocks. This is a sample map with basic Zombie Escape devices placed.[/list]
[b]Studio Mine Theme Block Update[/b]
[list][*]The new mine-themed basic blocks and decorative blocks have been updated.[/list]


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[u][h3]Login Supplies Event (3/10 - 4/6)[/h3][/u]
[b]Daily Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Login Supplies
-Contents: 4 Transcendence Weapons (1 Day) + 1 Daily Attendance Reward Box[/list]
[b]Cumulative Rewards[/b]
[list][*]5 Days: Dual Beretta Gunslinger (20 Days)
[*]10 Days: Infinity Laser Fist (20 Days)
[*]15 Days: Magnum Launcher (20 Days)
[*]20 Days: Trinity Grenade (20 Days)
[*]25 Days: Gungnir (10 Days)[/list]
[b]Extra Cumulative Rewards Event[/b]
[list][*]Each time you receive cumulative rewards, you'll receive a Cumulative Attendance Reward Box.[/list]

[u][h3]A Sweet Reward Bundle for Completionists! (3/10 - 3/23)[/h3][/u]Simply play Zombie modes to get Mileage, Decoders, Reward Boxes! Complete the missions below during the event to get various rewards based on total cumulative points.

[b]Missions[/b]
[list][*]3 Points when finishing a round in Zombie Mode as a Human
[*]2 Points when finishing a round in Zombie Mode as a Zombie
[*]5 Points for clearing (completing) a session in Zombie Scenario mode on Very Hard[/list]
[b]Total Points - Obtainable Items[/b]
[list][*]40 Points: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x10
[*]100 Points: Unique Decoder x3
[*]200 Points: Event Decoder x3
[*]250 Points: Event Decoder x5
[*]350 Points: Unique Decoder x15
[*]430 Points: Unique Premium Decoder x3
[*]450 Points: Class Decoder x15
[*]520 Points: VVIP Free Pass (1 Day)
[*]560 Points: 20,000 Mileage + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x10[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Daily Max Obtainable Points: 40
[*]Eligible Zombie Modes: Zombie Hero, Zombie Z

[*]Participation will only count in rooms with four or more players (excludes Studio Mode).
[*]The Event Decoder can be used until before midnight on the day it is obtained.
[*]Laboratory Mode Included[/list]

[u][h3]Hello, Rookies! Check Out These Dailies! (3/10 - 3/23)[/h3][/u]Hello, Rookies! Complete these daily routines in CSNS to get rewards! Log in the next day after completing the past day's routine to get a unique decoder.

[b]Stage / Mission / Obtainable Items[/b]
[list][*]Stage 0: Click Claim Reward from the Login Supplies window - Get 100 Mileage
[*]Stage 1: Click the Missions tab (Check Event) - Get 5,000 Points
[*]Stage 2
- Purchase Point Decoder from the shop - Get Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x3
- Click on the Exploration tab - Get Exploration Success Rate-Up x1
[*]Stage 3: Play Original / Zombie Scenario / Zombie Z / Zombie Classic / Zombie Hero / Zombie Evolution / Hide and Seek 1 time - Get Rare Decoder x3
[*]Stage 4: Log in (next time) - Get Unique Decoder x1[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]This is an event that all players can participate in.
[*]Complete Stage 0 to proceed to Stage 1, and likewise complete Stage 1 to proceed to Stage 2.
[*]You can progress normally from Stage 2 by completing either of the missions.
[*]You can claim the reward for Stage 4 without having to log in consecutively.
[*]Completed stages (missions) are reset every day at midnight.
[*]You can progress until Stage 3 on the maintenance date of 3/23 (Wed).
[*]Laboratory Mode Included[/list]

[u][h3]Studio Mine Theme Contest (3/10 - 4/6)[/h3][/u]Show off your creative skills in this mine-themed Studio contest! Participate now to receive the 1st place prize!

[b]Event Schedule[/b]
[list][*]Application Period: 3/10 - 4/6
[*]Finalists Announced: 5/4
[*]Player Vote: 5/4 - 5/25 (All voting participants will receive 1,000 Mileage)
[*]Winners Announced: 6/2
[*]Medal and Trophy Theme Packs Sent Out: 6/2[/list]
[b]How to Participate[/b]
[list][*]Create an original, creative Studio map and leave a comment on the Event Submission page with the following information to participate: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/273110/discussions/0/5757294878572035122/](SUBMIT ENTRY HERE!)[/url]
- You must add the hashtag '#Mine' to the map title to be accepted.
- You can participate multiple times with multiple maps.
[*]You must include this information in your Event Entry Comment:
- Required: In-game Nickname (IGN), Map Name as it appears in the game, and STEAM ID!
- Optional: Additional information, such as a brief introduction of the map, etc.[/list]
[b]Evaluation Criteria[/b]
[list][*]Finalist selection: 20 finalists will be selected based on creativity, number of recommendations, number of cubes earned, diversity of blocks and scripts used, utilization of content, and relevance to the subject.
[*]The winners will be selected based on 50% player votes and 50% on CSNS Team’s internal score.
- Entries will be rated based on original aspects and setups, as well as creative use of options.
- Players may make multiple submissions and receive multiple rewards.[/list]
[b]Prizes[/b]
[list][*]1st Place: 300 Transcendence Decoders
[*]2nd Place: 200 Transcendence Decoders
[*]3rd Place: 70 Transcendence Decoders
[*]4th - 10th Place: 30 Transcendence Decoders
[*]11th - 20th Place: 20 Transcendence Decoders[/list]
[b]Additional Rewards[/b]
[list][*]All Prize Winners: Excellent Creator Medal + Trophy Theme Pack
[*]All Participants: Contest Participation Medal + 5,000 Mileage
[*]Rewards will only be given to maps with a play count of at least 10 and at least 3 recommendations
[*]If you already have the Excellent Creator Medal, another one will not be given[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]You must include the #Mine tag in the map title in order to have a valid contest entry.[/list]

[u][h3]Play Laboratory Mode Event (3/10 - 4/6)[/h3][/u]Reach 30 minutes of playtime in the Laboratory during the event to get 1 Transcendence Decoder.

[list][*]Reward is given only once per account.[/list]

[u][h3]Event End[/h3][/u][list][*]Guaranteed Transcendence Decoder Rotation Giveaway Event (- 3/23) End Notification[/list]


[h2]Shop Update[/h2]

[u][h3]New Transcendence Class Promotion (3/10 - 4/6)[/h3][/u]During the event, the drop rate of the two new transcendence classes (Agent Ritsuka and Pop Star Alin) from Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders is 4x higher.

[b]Decoder / Chance[/b]
[list][*]Premium Class Decoder / 2% each
[*]Class Decoder / 0.5% each[/list]
[b]Obtainable Items[/b]
[list][*]Agent Ritsuka
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/acba22b17f89f8b29cd7601cff5a59655fff39c5.png[/img]
- Born in Asia, Ritsuka wandered from one war zone to the next and grew up in the midst of battle. She is currently under the employ of Kronos to kidnap or murder those who dare to resist the company. After being placed under heavy scrutiny due to the failed kidnapping of Ji Yoon Choi, she hid her affiliation and personally engages in missions to ensure their success. * This class has changed to the CT team.
- Exclusive Skill: You Think I'm Joking? - The skill activates automatically upon encountering an elite monster in a Zombie Scenario for a chance to instantly kill elite monsters and increase Ritsuka's attack power upon activation.
- The Shadow Blade Add-On effect is applied on this character in Zombie Scenario mode. (Can be stacked with other Add-Ons and the effect increases)
[*]Pop Star Alin
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5b44c56ab3085b6dea1508d17a6404528c820170.png[/img]
- After making her escape with the help of the mercenaries, she couldn't risk revealing herself to the world. Even if she chose to go public, she could be marked for elimination by Kronos and the government agencies that work with them. That's why she chose to hide her identity and adopt the new persona of an idol. Idol by day and terrorist by night, she received a reinforcement request from Victor while out with Dominique to destroy another Kronos factory.
- Exclusive Skill: One, Two, Happiness! - Increases the Movement Speed of self and nearby allies within range. Creates a shield for allies and grants invincibility for self for a set duration.
- The Group Tactics Add-On effect is applied on this character in Zombie Scenario mode. (Can be stacked with other Add-Ons and the effect increases)
- A humming sound has been added when using the Psychic Sizer.[/list]

[u][h3]New Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (3/10 - 4/6)[/h3][/u]Get guaranteed 2 new Transcendence Classes (Agent Ritsuka, Pop Star Alin) based on how many Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders are used during the event!

[b]Decoder[/b]
[list][*]Upon Reaching 150 Guaranteed Points
[*]Upon Reaching 300 Guaranteed Points[/list]
[b]Obtainable Items[/b]
[list][*]Select Agent Ritsuka or Pop Star Alin
[*]Agent Sunglasses or Pink Crystal
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/edc166996ada0bb77c0f8cf2126e3c681ebeac98.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/98f653556bc53f959468a87d2af97582965a6e10.png[/img][/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]1 Guaranteed Point given each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
[*]3 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Class Premium Decoder.

[*]Guaranteed Giveaway rewards can be granted only once per account.[/list]

[u][h3]New Transcendence Class Medal Giveaway (3/10 - Permanent)[/h3][/u]When you own all items in the new Transcendence Classes set, you will receive the Transcendence Class medal.

We're going to perform a regular maintenance this Thursday, March 10th, 2022, at 3:00 A.M. CET. All servers during this period will be unavailable and we are anticipating the maintenance to conclude at around 8:30 A.M. CET. Please refer below for more details on the maintenance.

[*]SEA (UTC+7): 9:00 A.M. – 2:30 P.M.

[*]ET: 9th, 10:00 P.M. – 10th, 3:30 A.M.
[*]PT: 9th, 7:00 P.M. – 10th, 12:30 A.M.
[*][i][b]Note[/b]: Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.[/i][/list]

[list][*]Server Upkeep
[*]New Content & Events

- The CSN:S Team

The trail leads to an abandoned munitions factory. David tries to break in, but as Erica's pain flares up, they are forced to stop to rest. Unknown to them, Douglas has found them and orders a group of hunters to end them, once and for all.
