notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: January 26th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5ab27a334f0f650673be819d95db0988263f85a3.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b]Content: Competitive Match (Beta) Update[/b]
Competitive Matches have been updated!  Check it out!

[b]Content: Zombie Mode Update[/b]
Changes ranging from unlock levels to mutations! Check it out now!

[b]Content: Mission Chain System Guide Renewal[/b]
The Mission Chain System Guide has been renewed! Check it out now!

[b]Promotion: New Epic Weapon Promotion (1/26 - 3/10)[/b]
Get the Quantum Horizon, a piece of sealed super tech that has been unearthed and weaponized with quantum technology![/list]
Check out the Details section below for more information.


[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

 
[h2]New Content[/h2]

[u][h3]Competitive Match (Beta) Update[/h3][/u]
[b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/3108048497751528673]Preview of Competitive Match Changes[/url][/b]

[b]New Competitive Match Map - Freighter[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2685490c7a7711ab6b107a8218a6bf2b4cf74b48.png[/img]
[list][*]Available for play in various modes including Zombie mode (+ Competitive Match), Team Deathmatch, All-Star and more![/list]

[u][h3]Zombie Mode Update[/h3][/u]
[b]Unlock Level Changes[/b]
[list][*]Weapons: Previous Unlock Level → New Unlock Level
- Warhammer Storm Giant: 18 → 26
- Warhammer Blood Lord: 12 → 18
- Psychic Harmonium: 33 → 32
- Gear-Bird Cannon Mk. 1: 1 → 2
- Gear-Bird Cannon Mk. 2: 7 → 9
- Gear-Bird Cannon Mk. 3: 14 → 18
- Grand Bird Cannon: 21 →27
- Red Dragon Cannon: 19 → 17
- SG552 Cerberus: 20 → 18
- Gold Transcendence Red Dragon Cannon: 20 → 19
- Tomahawk Xmas Edition: 1 -> 3[/list]
[b]Mutation Changes[/b]
[list][*]Mutation / Changes
- Double Jump: Changed to a zombie exclusive mutation.
- Bomb Enhancement: Decreased Knockback per round. (+1.5% per round → +1%)
- Glass Cannon: Decreased damage taken (155% → 110%)
- Explosive Reaction: Increased damage required for bomb creation (Base 4,000, -50 per round → Base 5,000, +100 per round)
- Icarus: Increased cooldown (2 sec → 3 sec)
- Zombie Bomb Giveaway: Decreased bomb giveaway intervals (Zombie Bomb Giveaway time: 20 sec → 25 sec, Zombie Shock Bomb decrease rate per round: -0.8 sec → -0.5 sec)
- Contact Infection: Increased damage interval (0.4 sec→ 0.7 sec)[/list]

[u][h3]Mission Chain System Guide Renewal[/h3][/u]
[b]Changes[/b]
[list][*]Guide Updated
- Inventory - Total sets changed from 6 to 9
- Competitive Match Settings and Cost Related Content Added
- How to identify "Developer Map" added for "Play a Developer Map 1 time" under the Mission tab.
- Family Update Content Information Added (Family Storage / Family Member Activity and Chat Notifications / Login Rate)
[*]Player Settlement Support Box Contents Added to Final Reward[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Players who have completed missions in the past can progress in the event again with updated content to earn rewards once the Mission Chain period is over.[/list]


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[u][h3]Bonus Disassembly Event (1/26 - 1/30)[/h3][/u]Use the Bonus Disassembly System during the event to disassemble your weapons, and you might even get a few fully disassembled!

[b]Event Dates and Criteria[/b]
[list][*]Both Weekdays and Weekends 13:00 – 17:00 CET
[*]Minimum Participation Mileage: 5,000[/list]
[b]Added New Items for Disassembly[/b]
[list][*]Laevateinn
[*]Mecha Dino MK-4
[*]Mecha Dino MK-3
[*]Mecha Dino MK-2
[*]Mecha Dino MK-1
[*]SKULL-T9
[*]Quantum Horizon
[*]Psychic Sizer[/list]
[b]Special Bonus Event[/b]
[list][*]To celebrate the release of new Epic Weapons, we increased the chance to win Epic Weapons to be 2 times that for Transcendence Weapons during the event![/list]

[u][h3]New Year Lucky Pouch Login Event (1/26– 2/9)[/h3][/u]
[b]30 min Playtime Cumulative Rewards[/b]
[list][*]1 Day: Class Decoder x3
[*]3 Days: Class Decoder x7

[*]7 Days: Unique Premium Decoder x3

[u][h3]New Year Hot Time Reward Boost Event (1/26– 2/9)[/h3][/u]Earn additional rewards by playing certain modes during Hot Times during the event every day.

[b]Hot Time[/b]

[b]Conditions[/b]

[b]Login Days / Reward[/b]

[*]Cumulative Day 10: Exploration Success Rate-Up x1 + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x3

[*]Cumulative Day 12: Exploration Success Rate-Up x1 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x5
[*]Cumulative Day 13: 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x2 + 500 Mileage
[*]Cumulative Day 14: CSO Operative Selection Box x1 + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x10
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/8d2e288658080ac60b41622e027ad377e938a727.png[/img][/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]New User Package and Welcome Back Supply Boxes will be used as soon as you obtain them.[/list]

When you collect the characters E, P, I, and C during the event, you will receive the new Epic, the Quantum Horizon (Permanent).

[b]2022 Collection Missions[/b]
[list][*]Character / Requirement

- 0: First login during the event
- 2: Reach 10 days of 30 total minutes of login time during the event
- 2: Reach 400 minutes of playtime[/list][list][*]Black Tiger's Gift Box
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/91fdb114c8f7824c7cfb9466436cb20465a14f53.png[/img]
- Contents: Power Up Part - Grade 5 x5, Black Tiger Tattoo (Permanent), Zombie Damage Meter (7 Days), Barrett M95 White Tiger (7 Days), Spell Lance Scarlet Rose (7 Days), Lightning Fury (7 Days), Quantum Horizon (1 Day)[/list]Zombie Damage Meter

- Description: An item that displays the user's and rank 1 - 3 players' damage and rankings. You can turn it on/off with the [i] key.

It has a basic attack that causes quantum explosions and the special features [Quantum Disruptor], that is capable of homing into and attacking multiple enemies, and [Quantum Dive], which teleports the wielder to safety in moments of fatal danger.

[u][h3]Energy of Strength - Come get a tiger's energy! (1/26 - 3/10)[/h3][/u]Complete play missions to get Energy of Strength, which you can exchange for Epic Weapons, Epic Edition Weapons, and other items!

[b]How to Obtain Energy of Strength / Reward[/b]
[list][*]Every time you reach a total of 6 kill points with kills, assists, or human infections (excluding bots) in Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, and Zombie Evolution.

[u][h3]New Year Celebration Mileage Auction (1/31 - 2/8)[/h3][/u]You can access the auction via the "Mileage Auction" button on the bottom of the lobby during the event.

[list][b]Content: New Competitive Match (Beta)[/b]
Competitive Matches (Beta) have been updated to ensure fiercer and fairer battles!

[b]Content: Season 11: Mecha Dino[/b]
The Mecha Dinos are here from the world of mechanical dinosaurs! Meet them now through the Season Pass!

Get the Class (Premium) Decoder with 4x rates right now!

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

 
[h2]New Content[/h2]

[u][h3]New Competitive Match (Beta)[/h3][/u]See [New Competitive Match (Beta) Preview] for more details!

[b]1. New competitive rules will be added to zombie mode.[/b]
[list][*]Mode: Zombie Hero, Zombie Z Mode
[*]Competitive Match (Beta) Settings Added: Select "Competitive Match (Beta)" map from the map selection screen. - Click "Choose" after selecting a Competitive Match (Beta) map to display the info pop-up. - Set game as Competitive Match by confirming the info pop-up.
- All previous room settings will be ignored when setting up the room for a Competitive Match (Beta), and the settings can't be changed.[/list]
[b]2. Competitive Match (Beta) Rules[/b]
[list][*]Competitive Match (Beta) Room Settings
- 1. Max Players: 24
- 2. Win Objective: Zombie Z - Round 13 / Zombie Hero - Round 7
- 3. Round Length: 3 mins
- 4. Weapon Restriction: Cost Restriction
- 5. No Manner Level, No Death > Kill Rule Restrictions
- 6. Passwords Unavailable
- 7. Zombies Respawn
- 8. AI Added
- 9. Friendly Fire Disabled
- 10. Auto Zombie Balance
- 11. Map: When the game begins, one of the 6 maps below will be selected at random. (Italy, Assault, Abyss 2, Militia, Dust, Trade Port)
[*]Weapon Restrictions (Cost Restriction) Added
- All weapons have costs based on their rank, and 4 primary/secondary/melee/throwable weapons with a total cost of 25 or below can be used.
- When the cost of owned, not yet purchased, or not yet picked up weapons exceeds the 25 cost limit, the weapon can't be obtained.
[*]Certain Rule Changes
- Karma gain is doubled.
- Random human heroes don't appear in Competitive Match (Beta), and can be played only by using Karma.
- In Zombie Z mode, zombie heroes can appear at random after all zombies are unlocked.
- The amount of mutations based on Zombie Z levels are increased, and some mutations don't appear.[/list]
[b]3. New Competitive Match (Beta) Map - Trade Port[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2e2bd9a32bb781da3a71df997cba541ea413bc18.png[/img]
[list][*]Playable in zombie modes other than Competitive Match (Beta).[/list]


[u][h3]Season 11: Mecha Dino 12/29 - 4/6[/h3][/u]The 11th season for CSNS is all about Mecha Dinos and their world! See the [Season 11 Season Pass Preview] for more details!

Only normal fire is possible as the Transform System hasn't been applied yet, but upgrades to the magazine and barrel have been successful.

notes.title: [Coming Soon] New Season & New Game Mode
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c21ba56b642e4790b6a51755563070d2bc574d0b.jpg[/img]

[b]CSNS Fans![/b]

In 12 days, the last update for the year 2021 will feature the new Season 11 and a new game mode brought to you as “Competitive Match (Beta)!”

Get into the game ahead right now and enjoy the variety of seasonal in-game events while you wait for the big release prepped just for you for the end of this year!

Check out the recent [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/3113673641616366840][u]Patch Notes[/u][/url] to catch up on the latest contents and events and,
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/273110/CounterStrike_Nexon_Zombies][h1][u]PLAY NOW FOR FREE![/u][/h1][/url]

[h3][Brief Sneak Peek][/h3]
[b]> New Season 11: Mecha Dino![/b]
[list]The theme for the new season 11 is the world of mechanical dinosaurs - "Mecha Dino!”

From weapons to zombie skins, unique designs that are combined with dinosaur textures and machines will be ready for your excitement![/list]
[b]> New Game Mode: Competitive Match (Beta)![/b]
[list]A new competitive rule for Zombie Mode will arrive!

This new mode can be found in Zombie Hero and Zombie Z modes and you can expect a much fairer and tenser battle that will not go easy on you.

Competitive Match will rely much more importantly in how you utilize the weapons you have rather than having multiple strong weapons that you can simply sweep with.

This new game mode will depend more of one's skill which will determine the outcome of the game more than any other rule in CSNS![/list]
Ignite the fire within this winter with the coming new game mode, and don’t miss out on any of the seasonal Mecha Dino pass items! See you soon!

- The CSNS Team



[i]Join the Official CSNS Discord Community now at [url=https://discord.gg/csns][u]https://discord.gg/csns[/u]![/url][/i]

[u][h3]Find the Zombie Event (12/15– 12/29)[/h3][/u]You can participate via the Find the Zombie event button at the bottom of the Lobby screen during the event.

[b]How to Participate[/b]
[list][*]Click the Find the Zombie event button at the bottom of the lobby screen.
[*]Hit the zombies in the batch of 16 characters (12 zombies, 4 humans) using your bullets.
- How to Get Bullets: Through the Find the Zombie Bullet Giveaway
[*]Hit a zombie to increase the reward grade by 1 and be able to take an additional shot. Hit a human and the reward grade will decrease by 1 and the Find the Zombie in progress will be reset.
[*]The reward grade can increase up to a High Class Gold Box if you hit zombies consecutively through additional shots, and you can claim the current grade's reward by clicking "Surrender."

[list][*]The reward grade will be reset upon claiming the reward by clicking "Surrender."
[*]The grade can increase up to a High Class Gold Box and players can earn better rewards by consecutively hitting zombies.
[*]Items earned from reward boxes can't have their durations extended.
[*]Click on "Claim Reward" to receive reward items.
[*]Chance to Find a Zombie: Remaining Zombies / Remaining Slots (Example: If there are 10 zombies left and 14 slots left → 10/14, there is about 71% chance to find a zombie.)[/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: December 1st
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ed2fd24f004c33076a9c1fbac7487c3f88891124.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!
[list][b]Zombie Scenario Mode Update[/b]
Try the new Event Mode update and the new map Pursuit: Evelyn's Test B!

[b]Exploration System Improvement[/b]
Check out which of the Exploration System's rewards have been revamped!

[b]Family System Improvement[/b]
Check out the new Family System improvements, from achievements to storage!

[b]New Transcendence Class Promotion (12/1 - 12/29)[/b]
Meet the new Transcendence Classes, sibling survivors of the Lost City, Roy and Romy![/list]Check out the Details section below for more information.


[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]


[h2][New Content][/h2]

[u][h3]Zombie Scenario Mode Update[/h3][/u]
[b]Zombie Scenario New Event Mode Update (12/1 - 12/15)[/b]
[list][*]Random Transformation: End of Madness & Random Transformation: Truth Uncovered
[*]Information: Killing zombies on the event map during the event period grants a chance to drop gene orbs. Earning the orbs (4 types) fills the gauge, and once the orb gauge is full, press the T key to transform into a random monster.
- The 4 types of orbs have a chance to drop from all zombies.
- Earning an orb fills up one tick of the gauge and changes the color of the gauge to that of the orb.
- The more orbs of the same color you collect, the higher your chance of transforming into their respsective monster.\n- Red: Revanant. Green: Yeti. Blue: Dr. Rex. Yellow: Frozen Wrath
- Earning additional orbs after transforming grants a buff that lasts a particular period of time (once per 4 gene orbs).
- If you are having difficulty playing or don't like the selected monster, you can manually cancel the transformation by pressing the T key again.
- While transformed, you will transform back into a human upon death.
- Sitting down after transforming to a monster as certain classes can cause the bottom half of the body to be buried under ground.[/list]
[b]New Zombie Scenario Map - Pursuit: Evelyn's Test B[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ccfb304aca5033910307523e9bd59bbe507f390f.png[/img]



[u][h3]Exploration System Improvement[/h3][/u]
[b]Exploration System Rewards Revamped[/b]
[list][*]Rate for exploration start availability changed for each difficulty.
- The difficulty been reduced so the standard class level 1 can run easy difficulty.
[*]Base Reward and Success Reward Changes and Additions
- Base Reward, which is granted regardless of success, now gives a Scenario Add-On and Part.
- For Decoder-related contents (weapons/class) from Success Rewards, it has now been changed to grant unlimited items for a small chance.
[*]Added Exploration Success Rate-Up +10%p item.
- 10%p success rate is added, regardless of the selected difficulty.
- You can buy this item at the Shop with points. An informative pop-up will appear, when you press the Explore button from the Exploration System, and you currently have a Rate-Up item.
[*]Exploration Pileup Progress Event Open
- Points are distributed when you receive exploration rewards.[/list]

[u][h3]Family System Improvement[/h3][/u]
[b]Family Achievement Improvement[/b]
[list][*]Family Rewards Revamped: Changed rewards to fit the current state of the game.
[*]Family Achievement Added: With the addition of new Modes and Scenarios, 9 new achievements have been added.
[*]Quality-of-Life Improvements: You can now exclude the achievements you can't pursue when viewing the achievements, and total points are provided in order to see your overall progress.[/list]
[b]Family Storage Improvement[/b]
[list][*]When listing enhancements/parts weapon, the portion listed without the enhancements/parts information can now be used with the enhancements/parts information.
[*]The method of viewing weapon enhancement information and part information in storage (outlines, tooltip, etc.) is now displayed the same way as personal inventory.[/list]
[b]Other Information[/b]
[list][*]Added Login rate information of the past week to Family Search List and Main Page.
- This information changes in real-time and it marks your attendance if you log in at least one out of the seven days.
- This information is also available on Family Search, so it can help determine which Family members have actually been active in the past week.
[*]If inappropriate actions are detected in certain gaming environments related to Family Storage, level or count limits can be implemented to limit item listings/usage.
[*]It's been decided that one of the Family Emblems is inappropriate so it's been changed to a different image.[/list]


[h2][New Events][/h2]

[u][h3]Playtime Pileup Event (12/1 - 12/15)[/h3][/u]You can get rewards for completing the following missions during the event. You also get various rewards based on the total number of completions.

[b]Daily Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Event Conditions / Rewards
- Obtain 500 mileage upon reaching 30 minutes of playtime
- Obtain Unique Decoder x3 upon reaching 60 minutes of playtime[/list]
[b]Cumulative Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Event Conditions / Rewards
- Total Playtime one time: Special Agent Criss (2 Days) + Boss David Black (2 Days)
- Total Playtime three times: Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon (100) x5 + Enhanced Weapon Selection Box x1
- Total Playtime five times: Drill Instructor Gerard (30 Days) + Private Erica (30 Days)
- Total Playtime seven times: Zombie Scenario Add-On x20
- Total Playtime nine times: Hunter-Killer X-90 (Permanent)(Gun Boost Part - Grade 6 + Vampiric Part - Grade 6).
- Total Playtime eleven times: VVIP Free Pass (5 Days)
- Total Playtime thirteen times: Class Decoder x10[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Daily rewards can be obtained once a day per account.
[*]Cumulative reward can be obtained only once per account.
[*]You can earn the Cumulative reward upon reaching 30 minutes of playtime.
[*]Only rooms with 4+ players count toward the event.
[*]It counts in all modes, including Studio Mode.
[*]Enhanced Weapon Selection Box will be removed during maintenance on 12/15 (Wed.)[/list]

[u][h3]Mission Clear Event (12/1 - 12/15)[/h3][/u]You can get event rewards for completing the following missions during the event.

[b]Event Conditions / Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Complete Zombie Scenario Mode on Hard difficulty or higher 2 times for Event Decoder x1
[*]Transform into random monster once in the new Zombie Scenario Event Mode for Zombie Scenario Add-On Box x3
[*]Score 10 kills or assists in Zombie Modes (Zombie Original, Zombie Mutant, Zombie Hero, Zombie Evolution, Zombie Z) (excluding bots) for Event Decoder x1[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Only rooms with 4+ players count toward the event.
[*]Excludes Studio Mode and Zombie Scenario Survival: Double Gate, Survival: Lost City, Survival: Trap ,Survival: Groundwater, and Pursuit: Chaos maps
[*]Each reward is given only once a day per account.
[*]The Event Decoder can be used until before midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list]

[u][h3]Mission Clear Pileup Event (12/1 - 12/15)[/h3][/u]You will receive rewards based on the number of Event Decoders used over the duration of the event.

[b]Event Conditions / Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Event Decoder Total Usage Count
- 5 times: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5
- 10 times: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x10
- 14 times: Transcendence Decoder x10[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Each reward is given only once per account.[/list]

[u][h3]Exploration System Renewal Special Item Giveaway (12/1 - 12/15)[/h3][/u]You will receive a special item for trying exploration just once during the event.

[b]Special Item Contents[/b]
[list][*]Magnum Launcher (1 Days)
[*]Infinity Laser Fist (1 Day)
[*]Barrett M95 White Tiger (1 Day)
[*]Dual Beretta Gunslinger (1 Day)
[*]Trinity Grenade (1 Day)
[*]Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (1 Day)
[*]Hunter-Killer X-12 (Gun Boost Part - Grade 6 + Rage Down Part - Grade 6) (1 Day)
[*]Zombie Scenario Add-On Box x3[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]All of Special Item contents are given, and is limited to only once a day per account.
[*]Special Items are given immediately upon attempting to explore once, regardless of success or failure.[/list]

[u][h3]Exploration Pileup Event (12/1 - Permanent)[/h3][/u]You can earn permanent Transcendence Weapons based on the exploration completed total points for each difficulty.

[b]Conditions[/b]
[list][*]Each time reaching 100 points[/list]
[b]Obtainable Items (One of the following are given, based on their respective rates)[/b]
[list][*]Thunder Ghost Walker
[*]Dual Sword Phantom Slayer
[*]M249 Phoenix
[*]Barrett M95 White Tiger
[*]M3 Black Dragon
[*]AUG Guardian
[*]SG552 Lycanthrope
[*]Desert Eagle Crimson Hunter
[*]Magnum Drill
[*]Warhammer Storm Giant
[*]AK-47 Paladin
[*]M4A1 Dark Knight
[*]Ripper
[*]Gae Bolg
[*]Python Desperado
[*]Volcano
[*]Red Dragon Cannon
[*]Blade Runebreaker[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Point distributed when you receive rewards after completing Exploration.
[*]Receiving Easy Exploration rewards grants 1 point.
[*]Receiving Normal Exploration rewards grants 2 points.
[*]Receiving Hard Exploration rewards grants 4 points.
[*]You can earn up to 4 points in a day (regardless of difficulty).
[*]The list of obtainable items matches with the contents of Transcendence Group 1 and 2 in Transcendence Decoder.[/list]

[u][h3]Free Daily Rewards Event (12/1 – 12/29)[/h3][/u]
[b]Daily Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Daily Weapons Supply
- Contents: 4 Transcendence Weapons (1 Day) + 1 Daily Attendance Reward Box[/list]
[b]Cumulative Rewards[/b]
[list][*]5 Days: M3 Black Dragon (15 Days)
[*]10 Days: Barrett M95 White Tiger (15 Days)
[*]15 Days: Magnum Launcher (15 Days)
[*]20 Days: Dual Beretta Gunslinger (15 Days)
[*]25 Days: Dread Nova (5 Days)[/list]
[b]Extra Cumulative Rewards Event[/b]
[list][*]Each time you receive cumulative rewards, you'll receive a Cumulative Attendance Reward Box.[/list]

[u][h3]New Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (12/1 - 12/29)[/h3][/u]You will be guaranteed to receive the two new Transcendence Classes based on the number of Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders used during the event!

[b]Conditions and Obtainable Items[/b]
[list][*]Reach 150 / 300 guaranteed points and Select either Roy or Romy + Roy's Keepsake Hat or Romy's Survival Pack.[/list]
[b]Roy's Keepsake Hat[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1deb91f380a537d62125884f3f73cf083bc038ba.png[/img]
[list][*]A keepsake from his father. He never puts it on his own head, but he won't go on a mission without it.[/list]
[b]Romy's Survival Pack[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/406ba1824d4223d50a61db84fa71f328c27f02e2.png[/img]
[list][*]A pack containing everything essential to survival. The more experienced you get, the more things you need to carry.[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]1 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
[*]3 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Premium Class Decoder.
[*]If you receive Transcendence Class Roy (Permanent), his costume Roy's Keepsake Hat (Permanent) is automatically distributed.
[*]If you receive Transcendence Class Romy (Permanent), her costume Romy's Survival Pack (Permanent) is automatically distributed.
[*]Guaranteed Giveaway rewards can be granted only once per account.[/list]

[u][h3]New Transcendence Class Medal Giveaway (12/1 - Permanent)[/h3][/u]When you own all items in the new Transcendence Classes set, you will receive the Transcendence Class medal.

[b]Conditions and Obtainable Items[/b]
[list][*]You will receive [Honor] City Survivor when you have Roy, Romy, Roy's Keepsake Hat, and Romy's Survival Pack all in the inventory.[/list]
[b][Honor] City Survivor[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/3695d70de24566d69213084baf56eb2d17fb3673.png[/img]
[list][*]A medal given to those who have obtained Roy, Roy's Keepsake Hat, Romy, and Romy's Survival Pack.[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*][Honor] City Survivor Medal can be obtained after the 12/1 (Wed) maintenance without event period limit.
[*]The medal can be obtained only once per account.[/list]


[h2][Shop Update][/h2]

[u][h3]New Transcendence Classes, Roy & Romy Promotion (12/1 - 12/29)[/h3][/u]During the event, the drop rate of the two new transcendence classes from Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders is four times higher!

[b]Roy and Romy Drop Rates[/b]
[list][*]Premium Class Decoder: 2% each
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/57ed2c6f23a582b6f905813e8db6117246d95e70.png[/img]
[*]Class Decoder: 0.5% each[/list]
[b]Roy[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9b7db733b50d19815e7c33f95b48ddd7e735cfe3.png[/img]
[list][*]Romy's older brother. His fast thinking and survival skills come from his father, a former guard captain of Lost City, and were essential to the siblings' survival. He wanted to become a soldier himself, but he was hugely disappointed when the Lost City army fell apart. Nowadays, he wishes to just be a normal salaryman, but is forced to do mercenary work to make ends meet.
[*]Paired Effect: Area duration is increased when using Laevateinn's special feature.
[*]Exclusive Skill: Survival Book - Can use a skill that grants temporary invincibility to self and heals HP in Zombie Scenario.[/list]
[b]Romy[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/3f45785aa153fedaa2bb2dd1d81ed03f7c5a13eb.png[/img]
[list][*]A survivor of the Lost City, who lived with her older brother Roy. Even though she had to dedicate herself to school and housework after their parents passed away, she was still a cheerful, carefree girl. Following an explosion at a factory where her brother had been deployed, she armed herself and joined the battlefield. While she has no military experience, her soldier father trained her in marksmanship. Combined with survival instincts honed from living in the hell that is Lost City, Romy proves herself to be more than just some schoolgirl.
[*]Paired Effect: Area duration is increased when using Laevateinn's special feature.
[*]Exclusive Skill: Crisis Breakthrough - Can use a skill that grants temporary invincibility to self and does area of effect damage in Zombie Scenario.[/list]

[u][h3]Exploration Rate-Up Item Sale (12/1 - Permanent)[/h3][/u]The following items are sold at the Points Shop.

[b]Item Sold[/b]
[list][*]Exploration Success Rate-Up +10% / 5,000 Points
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e4b9539d69472506dba71f15b9e0968f63ca1aab.png[/img][/list]

[u][h3]Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon Vendor and Sale Currency Changes (12/1 - Until Announced Separately)[/h3][/u]
[b]Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon Vendor and Sale Currency Changes[/b][list][*]Now: Vendor - Shop / Sale Currency - Cash
[*]Changed: Vendor - Mileage Shop / Sale Currency - Mileage[/list]
[b]Item and Sale Price[/b]
[list][*]Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/fd37c08bd4286ffd9cfb74219490512849d17f95.png[/img]
- 7 Days: 9,000 Mileage
- 14 Days: 15,000 Mileage
- 30 Days: 30,000 Mileage[/list]

A medal given to those who have obtained Roy, Roy's Keepsake Hat, Romy, and Romy's Survival Pack.
Notice
[Honor] City Survivor Medal can be obtained after the 12/1 (Wed) maintenance without event period limit.
The medal can be obtained only once per account.
Shop Update
New Transcendence Classes, Roy & Romy Promotion (12/1 - 12/29)
During the event, the drop rate of the two new transcendence classes from Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders is four times higher!
Roy and Romy Drop Rates
Premium Class Decoder: 2% each
Class Decoder: 0.5% each
Roy

Romy's older brother. His fast thinking and survival skills come from his father, a former guard captain of Lost City, and were essential to the siblings' survival. He wanted to become a soldier himself, but he was hugely disappointed when the Lost City army fell apart. Nowadays, he wishes to just be a normal salaryman, but is forced to do mercenary work to make ends meet.
Paired Effect: Area duration is increased when using Laevateinn's special feature.
Exclusive Skill: Survival Book - Can use a skill that grants temporary invincibility to self and heals HP in Zombie Scenario.
Romy

A survivor of the Lost City, who lived with her older brother Roy. Even though she had to dedicate herself to school and housework after their parents passed away, she was still a cheerful, carefree girl. Following an explosion at a factory where her brother had been deployed, she armed herself and joined the battlefield. While she has no military experience, her soldier father trained her in marksmanship. Combined with survival instincts honed from living in the hell that is Lost City, Romy proves herself to be more than just some schoolgirl.
Paired Effect: Area duration is increased when using Laevateinn's special feature.
Exclusive Skill: Crisis Breakthrough - Can use a skill that grants temporary invincibility to self and does area of effect damage in Zombie Scenario.
Exploration Rate-Up Item Sale (12/1 - Permanent)
The following items are sold at the Points Shop.
Item Sold
Exploration Success Rate-Up +10% / 5,000 Points

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: November 17th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/6f8105a9ddb886339a882e3af2f2b687220e9a40.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!
[list][b]Content: Part Open Weapon Added[/b]
You can now equip a part on Plasma Gun and SKULL-1!

[b]Promotion: Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box Promotion (11/17 - 12/1)[/b]
For Black Friday, the Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box, which contains a total of 20 types of Transcendence Weapons including 2 Special Weapons, will be sold! Only Transcendence Weapons (Permanent) appear in the Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box, so don't miss out!

[b]Promotion: Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box 1+1 Promotion (11/17 - 12/1)[/b]
The '1+1 Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box', which gives an additional Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box, will be sold! Don't miss out![/list]Check out the Details section below for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]
 
[h2]New Content[/h2]

[h3]Part Open Weapon Added[/h3]
You can now equip a part on SKULL-1 and Plasma Gun.

[b]Part Open Weapon Added[/b]
[list][*]SKULL-1
[*]Plasma Gun[/list]
[b]Balance Adjustment[/b]
[list][*]SKULL-1's damage has increased in Zombie Scenario Mode.
[*]Plasma Gun's damage has increased in Zombie and Zombie Scenario Modes.[/list]
[b]Zombie Z Unlock Level Adjustments[/b]
[list][*]SKULL-1: Changed from level 1 to 14.
[*]Plasma Gun: Changed from level 1 to 14.[/list]


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[h3]1+1=11 Let's Play Together (11/17 – 12/1)[/h3]
If you earn a set amount of points during the event, you can earn rewards. New or returning players can collect the points more easily.

[b]Conditions[/b]
[list][*]New players or players that haven't logged-in for 30 days earn 10 points per 11 minutes of playtime.
[*]Players who have been playing the game regularly earn 5 points per 11 minutes of playtime[/list]
[b]Reward[/b]
[list][*]When you log in, you will receive a SKULL-1(15 Days) and a Plasma Gun (15 Days) equipped with parts.
[*]VIP Free Pass (3 Days) for reaching 100 points
[*]VVIP Free Pass (1 Day) for reaching 200 points
[*]Enhanced Weapon Selection Box x3 + Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon (200) x3 for reaching 300 points
[*]Transcendence Decoder x3 + Transcendence Enhanced Weapon Selection Box x3 for reaching 400 points[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]You can earn up to 30 points a day.
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with four or more players (includes Studio Mode).
[*]Any unused Transcendence Enhanced Weapon Selection Box and Enhanced Weapon Selection Box will be removed during maintenance on 12/1.[/list]

[h3]Special Mission Completion Event (11/17 - 12/1)[/h3]
Each day that you meet the conditions, you can receive various rewards such as a Transcendence Decoder.

[b]Event Condition and Rewards (Each condition can be met once per day)[/b]
[list][*]10 minutes of login time: 500 Mileage
[*]30 minutes of login time: Rare Decoder x5 + 2x EXP UP
[*]60 minutes of login time + complete 1 special mission: Event Decoder x1 + 1 Random Grade 4 Part
[*]90 minutes of login time + complete 1 special mission: Choose 1 from Season Badge x25, Unique Decoder x1, or 1500 mileage 
[*]120 minutes of login time + complete 1 special mission: Choose 1 from Season Badge x50 or Transcendence Decoder x1[/list]
[b]Special Mission (Can complete one of the following three missions per day)[/b]
[list][*]Score 10 Zombie kills or assists in Zombie Hero/Zombie Evolution/Zombie Z Modes (excluding bots and Studio Mode)
[*]Complete Zombie Scenario Mode on Hard difficulty or higher 2 times (excluding Double Gate, Lost City, Survival: Trap, and Survival: Groundwater)
[*]Complete Zombie Escape Mode 4 times (including Studio Mode)[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Participation will only count in rooms with four or more players
[*]Certain maps from Zombie Scenario are excluded from the conditions.
[*]2x EXP UP item grants extra EXP for 3 hours starting from the time you get it, and the item disappears at midnight on the next day, regardless of how much time was left.[/list]

[h3]1÷1=11 Divide to Multiply Auction Event (11/17 – 11/30 23:59)[/h3]
During the event, you can use the Auction House, where players trade weapons and parts with one another. The Dual Beretta Gunslinger has been added as an auction item.
[list][*]Auction House Availability 00:00 - 23:59
[*]Added Auction Item: Dual Beretta Gunslinger[/list]

[h3]1,000 Mileage Auction Event (11/17 - 11/30 23:59)[/h3]
During the auction period, the Dual Beretta Gunslinger will appear as a special item at a particular time every day.

[b]Special Item Appearance Times[/b]
[list][*]The item has a chance of appearing between the following hours
- 11/17 15:00 - 16:00 (SEA : 9PM ~ 10PM)
- 11/18 21:00 - 22:00
- 11/19 2:00 - 3:00 (ET : 9PM ~ 10PM)
- 11/20 15:00 - 16:00 (SEA : 9PM ~ 10PM)
- 11/21 21:00 - 22:00
- 11/22 2:00 - 3:00 (ET : 9PM ~ 10PM)
- 11/23 5:00 - 6:00 (PT : 9PM ~ 10PM)
- 11/24 15:00 - 16:00 (SEA : 9PM ~ 10PM)
- 11/25 21:00 - 22:00
- 11/26 2:00 - 3:00 (ET : 9PM ~ 10PM)
- 11/27 15:00 - 16:00 (SEA : 9PM ~ 10PM)
- 11/28 21:00 - 22:00
- 11/29 2:00 - 3:00 (ET : 9PM ~ 10PM)
- 11/30 5:00 - 6:00 (PT : 9PM ~ 10PM)[/list][b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]After the special auction ends, the 1,000 mileage used for bidding will be refunded to those who did not win.
[*]You only have 10 minutes to place your bids.[/list]

[h3]Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box Giveaway (11/17 - 12/1)[/h3]
You can receive a Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box x1 for reaching 11 total login days during the event. You can check the details of Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box at the Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box Promotion Announcement




[h2]Shop Update[/h2]

[h3]Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box Promotion (11/17 - 12/1)[/h3]
For Black Friday, the Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box, which contains a total of 20 types of Transcendence Weapons including 2 Special Weapons, will be sold. Only Transcendence Weapons (Permanent) appear in the Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box.

[b]Special Weapon Drop Rates:[/b]
[list][*]Negev NG-7 Ajax 3%
[*]Dual Beretta Gunslinger 3%[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]You can check the details on the items and probability from the announcement on our website.
[*]All unused Lucky Transcendence Weapon Boxes will be replaced by 1,000 Mileage each during maintenance.[/list]

[h3]Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box 1+1 Promotion (11/17 - 12/1)[/h3]
'1+1 Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box', which gives an additional Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box, will be sold. Limited to one purchase per account.



[h3]Zombie Starter Package Contents Update (11/7 - until next announcement)[/h3]
The contents of the Zombie Starter Package has changed. The Zombie Starter Package has temporary (7 days) weapons that are helpful in Zombie Mode.

[b]Zombie Starter Package Contents (7 Days)[/b]
[list][*]MP5 (Gun Boost Part - Grade 6 + Critical Part - Grade 6)
[*]Dual Infinity Final (Speed Up Part - Grade 6 + Critical Part - Grade 6)
[*]Vendetta +6 (Gun Boost Part - Grade 6 + Power Up Part - Grade 6)
[*]Broad Divine +5 (Gun Boost Part - Grade 6 + No Healing Part - Grade 6)
[*]Blade Runebreaker +6
[*]Hunter Killer X-90 +5 (Gun Boost Part - Grade 6 + Power Up Part - Grade 6)
[*]Python Desperado +6
[*]Dual Sword Phantom Slayer
[*]M3 Black Dragon
[*]Hunter Killer X-12 (Gun Boost Part - Grade 6 + Rage Down Part - Grade 6)
[*]Magnum Launcher[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Can only be purchased once every 7 days per account.
[*]Buying the same package again extends the period time left.
[*]You can't use Duration Extension Coupon on weapons obtained through Zombie Starter Package.[/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: November 3rd
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e267ec13f8bcbaaeab357ea5cd9643e9fcde6d87.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b]Content: Studio Mode Update[/b]
A Studio-version map of Zombie Escape! Experience escaping from the ruins riddled with deadly traps while being chased by zombies!

[b]Content: Zombie Escape Improvements[/b]
The fan favorite Zombie Escape returns with all-new improvements. Check It Out Now!
	
[b]Event: Studio Jungle Theme Contest[/b]
Our studio contest begins with the Studio Jungle Theme block update and Zombie Escape improvements! Please check the separate announcement. We hope you participate!

[b]Promotion: New Transcendence Weapon "Laevateinn" Release![/b]
This weapon holds 50 rounds of explosive ammo that explodes when it hits the target! Come check out this new Transcendence Weapon and all its special features![/list]
Check out the Details section below for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]
 
[h2]New Content[/h2]

[h3]Studio Mode Update[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a38ccc3c2f013871837e6540c87e4dcc18034f4f.png[/img]

[b] New Studio Zombie Escape Map [Ruins] Release![/b]
[list]
[*] A Studio-version map of the CSNS fan favorite Zombie Escape! Escape from the ruins riddled with deadly traps while being chased by zombies.
[*] Various trap devices exclusive to Studio Mode are placed in the map.[/list]
[b] Studio Block Update
[/b][list]
[*] New Jungle Theme decorations and device blocks have been added.
[/list]


[h3]Zombie Escape Improvements[/h3]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list][*] Weapon Balance Improvements
[list]
[*] Added weapon restriction options (Original, New Original, etc.)
[*] Invincibility functionality on some weapons restricted
[*] Melee weapon and grenade balance changes (stun and knockback restriction)
[*] Humans respawn with previous weapon
[/list]
[*] Increased Zombie Selection Pool
[list]
[*] Added Heavy Zombie, Stamper zombie, and Banshee zombie
[*] Added zombie skills
Zombies have their skill cooldowns reduced when they take hits.
[*] Zombie Limit Possible
[/list]
[*] Other Improvements
[list]
[*] Zombie balance improvements
Infected zombie's HP becomes 30000 and Armor becomes 8000.
[*] Added various effects to the Zombie Escape Progress feature.
[*] Human Sprint Gauge: By landing hits on zombies, humans can fill up their Sprint gauge.
When striking a zombie within one notch of the leading zombie (on the Zombie Escape progress bar), it will start to fill up the Sprint gauge even more quickly.
[*] Zombie Buff: Zombies' stun and knockback resistance grows stronger with the Zombie Buff.
[list][*] When the leading human and the leading zombie become 4 or more notches apart on the Zombie Escape progress bar, zombies gain a buff to stun and knockback resistance.
[*] When a zombie who's 7 or more notches behind the leading zombie (on the Zombie Escape progress bar) respawns, they respawn closer to the leading zombie.[/list][/list][/list]


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[h3]Bonus Disassembly Event (11/3 - 11/17)[/h3]

Use the Bonus Disassembly System during the event to disassemble your weapons, and you might even get a few fully disassembled!

[list]
[*] Event Dates and Criteria
[list][*] Both Weekdays and Weekends - 13:00 – 17:00 CET (SEA: 19:00 – 23:00)
[*] Minimum Participation Mileage: 5,000[/list]

[*] Added New Items for Disassembly
[list][*] SG552 Cerberus
[*] Failnaught[/list][/list]


[h3]Play Zombie Escape Mode Event (11/3 - 11/17)[/h3]
You will receive rewards for successfully completing all the Zombie Escape Mode missions during the event!

[list]
[*] Conditions
[list][*] Successfully escape in the new Studio Jungle Theme map.
[*] Complete the session in a successful escape in other Zombie Escape maps 2 times[/list]
[*] Reward
[list][*] Receive Add-On x20 + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x1[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] You can only make mission progress in rooms with four or more players (includes Studio Mode).
[*] Reward can be claimed once per account.[/list][/list]


[h3]New Transcendence Weapon Guaranteed Giveaway (11/3 - 11/17)[/h3]
Depending on the number of Transcendence Premium Decoders and Transcendence Decoders used during the event, you may be guaranteed to receive the Laevateinn!

[list]
[*] Conditions and Rewards
[list][*] You will receive a Laevateinn (Permanent) every time you reach 300 points.[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] 6 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Transcendence Premium Decoder.
[*] 1 Guaranteed Point given each time you use 1 Transcendence Decoder.[/list][/list]


[h3]Autumn Leaves Box Collection Event (11/3 – 11/17)[/h3]
Receive abundant gifts and per-stage special rewards from Autumn Leaves Box based on the playtime you reach during the event.

[list]
[*] Daily Conditions and Rewards
[list][*] You will receive one Autumn Leaves Box every time you accumulate 10 minutes of playtime each day (Max of 6 times per day for 60 minutes).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/66204810ccd2d9e6d41203bab07e655d283b36c8.png[/img]
[/list]
[*] Pileup Conditions and Rewards
You can receive per-stage special rewards based on the total playtime you accumulate during the event.
[list][*] Stage 1 (total playtime 180 minutes): One of all content in the Autumn Leaves Box
[*] Stage 2 (total playtime 300 minutes): Two of all content in the Autumn Leaves Box
[*] Stage 3 (total playtime 420 minutes): Autumn Leaves Nameplate (300 Days)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/74d17c79acf7c1fc0ea42bb65cf480b8c4ea3340.png[/img]
[*] Stage 4 (total playtime 600 minutes): Three of all content in the Autumn Leaves Box[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] Participation will only count in rooms with four or more players (includes Studio Mode).
[*] All unused Autumn Leaves Boxes will be removed during the event-ending maintenance.
[*] Rewards for each stage can only be claimed once per account
[/list][/list]


[h3]Free Daily Rewards Event (11/3 - 12/1)[/h3]

[list]
[*] Daily Rewards
[list][*] Daily Weapons Supply
[list][*] Contents: 3 Transcendence Weapons (1 Day) + 1 Daily Attendance Reward Box[/list][/list]
[*] Cumulative Rewards
[list][*] 5 Days: M3 Black Dragon (15 Days) 
[*] 10 Days: Barrett M95 White Tiger (15 Days) 
[*] 15 Days: Magnum Launcher (15 Days)
[*] 20 Days: Dual Beretta Gunslinger (15 Days)
[*] 25 Days: Dread Nova (5 Days)[/list] 
[*] Extra Cumulative Rewards Event
[list][*] Each time you receive cumulative rewards, you'll receive a Cumulative Attendance Reward Box.[/list][/list]


[h2]Shop Update[/h2]

[h3]New Transcendence Weapon Promotion (11/3 - 11/17)[/h3]

During the event, the drop rate of the new transcendence weapon, Laevateinn, from Transcendence Decoders and Transcendence Premium Decoders is three times higher!

[list]
[*] Decoder Drop Rates
[list][*] Transcendence Premium Decoders: Laevateinn 3%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9ae7ae80146659b122e91f27dc2ed464032ef586.png[/img]
[*] Transcendence Decoders: Laevateinn 0.45%[/list]

[*] Laevateinn
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d3651be67321ae24dfe290155a1477b568473cbf.png[/img]
[list][*] Type: Secondary Weapon
[*] Description: 
[list][*] A pistol that holds 50 rounds of 5.7mm explosive ammo that explodes when it hits the target. When you fire beyond a certain number of rounds, a special feature becomes available.
[*] Special Feature <Electric Area>: Right-clicking after the gauge is charged 25% removes the Slow debuff on self, deals a set amount of damage to enemies approaching the area, and pushes them back.
[*] Special Feature <Paralysis Area>: Right-clicking after the gauge is charged 100% removes the Slow debuff on self, disables the attacks/skills/movement of enemies within the area, and pushes them back. A set portion of the damage dealt is restored as HP. (Attack/skill/movement disabling and AoE HP leeching features do not work in certain modes).[/list][/list]

[*] Notice
[list][*] All unused Transcendence Premium Decoders will be removed on the day the promotion ends.
[*] 500 mileage will be given for each Transcendence Premium Decoder removed.
[*] Transcendence Decoders will not be removed.
[/list][/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: October 20th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1431b0d55339de904b6aac5693d745c170b32448.jpg[/img]

New Events have been added!


[h2]New Content[/h2]

[h3]Halloween Theme Map[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c6dfff427fbe64c2f336abdadcf405e8ba976f65.png[/img]
[list][*]Vertigo[/list]


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[h3]Random Rules Zombie Hero Event (10/20 – 11/3)[/h3]Enjoy Zombie Hero in a whole new way: the rules change every round!

[b]Event Details[/b][list][*] The round begins after the rules are announced, 3 seconds before each round.
[*] You can check the information about the current rules again by pressing the 'L' key.[/list]
[b]Featured Maps[/b]
[list][*] Italy / Assault / Vertigo[/list]

[h3]Halloween Pumpkin Grenade Giveaway (10/20 - 11/3)[/h3]You'll get a Pumpkin Grenade upon logging in, so enjoy it during this Halloween season!
[list][*] When you use the Pumpkin Grenade in Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, Zombie Evolution, or Zombie Scenario modes during the event period, extra damage will be randomly applied to its blast.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b9ecdc45b03f59926eb3282c23211a1ce6c6de3e.png[/img]
- Rates: 50% chance for Normal Damage, 40% chance for 2x Damage, and 10% chance for One-Hit-Kill Damage.[/list]

[h3]Halloween Baskets of Candy Collection Event (10/20 - 11/3)[/h3]During the event period, complete the daily missions below to get Halloween Baskets of Candy and receive rewards based on the number of Halloween Baskets of Candy you earn!

[b]How to Get Halloween Baskets of Candy[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/cdaa15271e3a2a3cde215f79739e012208121c17.png[/img]
[list][*] Each time you score 2 kills or 6 assists, or infect 2 humans, in Zombie Hero / Zombie Evolution / Zombie Z modes, you receive Halloween Basket of Candy x1 (max 40 a day, excludes bots).
- Complete the mission in Halloween Assault Map: Halloween Basket of Candy x2
- Complete the mission in Halloween Vertigo Map: Halloween Basket of Candy x2
- Complete the mission in other maps: Halloween Basket of Candy x1
[*] Each time you reach 10 minutes of in-game playtime, you'll receive Halloween Basket of Candy x1 (max 10 a day).
[*] Each time you earn a Zombie Mode Pumpkin Supply Box, you'll receive Halloween Basket of Candy x1 (max 5 a day per account).[/list]
[b]Rewards Based on the Total Number of Halloween Baskets of Candy Earned[/b][list][*] Earn 50 (1-day participation): Event Decoder x2
[*] Earn 100 (2-day participation): Event Decoder x3
[*] Earn 150 (3-day participation): Event Decoder x8
[*] Earn 200 (4-day participation): Transcendence Decoder x1
[*] Earn 250 (5-day participation): Transcendence Decoder x1
[*] Earn 350 (7-day participation): Halloween Nameplate (300 Days)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/4e1de79ea84ee4be1d98c57c9ee9cc135d171629.png[/img]
[*] Earn 500 (10-day participation): Transcendence Decoder x7 + Class Decoder x7[/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*] You can only earn a maximum 50 Halloween Baskets of Candy per day.
[*] Participation will only count in rooms with four or more players (excludes Studio Mode).
[*] All Halloween Baskets of Candy will be removed during the event-ending maintenance.[/list]

[h3]Catch Pumpkin Head! Event (10/20 - 11/3)[/h3]Log in during the event period to receive the Pumpkin Head costume and receive the rewards below by completing missions!

[b]Event Details[/b][list][*] Log in and receive the Pumpkin Head (15 Days) costume.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9a3e01251e70cd6961601e3afa5f02878505db4a.png[/img]
[*] When you enter a game equipped with the Pumpkin Head costume, you will receive rewards.
[*] When you infect humans who are wearing the Pumpkin Head costume, you will receive rewards (zombies do not count).[/list]
[b]Rewards (Chance to obtain one of the two)[/b][list][*] Halloween Font (1 Day)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/95d392bfcd5e975b1a4dad6d7410a7de85ccdd02.png[/img]
[*] Pumpkin Head Costume (1 Day)[/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*] Participation is limited to 5 times a day per account (Once from log-in, 4 times from event participation).
[*] The duration of the temporary rewards you receive increase when you receive additional ones.
[*] Available Modes: Zombie Z, Zombie Evolution, and Zombie Hero (excludes Studio Mode).[/list]

[h3]Ghost Haunt Event (10/20 - 11/3)[/h3]During the event period, the Little Blue Ghost appears outside of in-game modes-- in the waiting room, Lobby, and other screens. Catch it and claim your reward!

[b]Event Details[/b][list][*]Receive the reward by catching the Little Blue Ghost that appears outside of in-game modes-- in the waiting room, Lobby, and other screens.[/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: October 6th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/7df18408e8a424eddcc262e907a0c75b57b38a43.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!
[list][b]Content: New Zombie Scenario Season 7 Map[/b]
Check out this new mission held in a virtual training ground!

[b]Content: Class Change System[/b]
Check out the in-game class change system, how to change, and the eligible modes!
	
[b]Promotion: New Transcendence Weapon "Failnaught" Release![/b]
Get the holy arrow firing, Failnaught now!

[b]Promotion: New Transcendence Classes Ismael and Ethan Release![/b]
A noble vampire-human hybrid and a righteous inquisitor who eliminates evil. Get them and their paired weapon Failnaught today![/list]Check out the Details section below for more information.


[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]
 
[h2]New Content[/h2]

[h3]New Zombie Scenario Season 7 Map[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/53e5a54f48b3bb17c14297e33a5cd6b93614462d.png[/img]

[b]Pursuit: Evelyn's Test A[/b][list][*] Another challenging virtual combat simulation held for only the bravest combatants.[/list]

[h3]Class Change System[/h3]

[b]In-game Class Change[/b]
[list][*] Class changing is now available for start of the next round.[/list]
[b]How to Change[/b]
[list][*] Use designated key(H) during the round to bring up the class selection window.
[*] Select your new class then select "Change Class Next Round".
[*] Your new class will be applied at the start of the next round.[/list]
[b]Eligible Modes[/b]
[list][*] Zombie, Zombie Original, Zombie Mutant, Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, Zombie Evolution, Zombie Escape, Zombie Darkness modes
[*] Reviving as a human from a zombie using Karma won't apply the class changes because it is not the next round.
[*] Zombie Z additional mutation feature change - Only 1 additional mutation can be acquired from the initial buff class selection phase.
[*] Classes with EXP/Points bonuses will be calculated by each class's playtime.[/list]

[h3]New Transcendence Class Medal Distribution[/h3]

[b]Conditions (Requires Permanent Version)[/b]
[list][*] Ismael
[*] Ethan
[*] Black Rose Shuriken
[*] Inquisitor's Hourglass[/list]
[b]Obtainable Items[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/54b6200efd4430ab3b25adc9c6c872c509b53a4e.png[/img]
[list][*] [Honor] The Hunter and The Inquisitor: A medal given to those who have obtained Ismael, Black Rose Shuriken, Ethan, and Inquisitor's Hourglass.[/list]　
[b]Notice [/b][list][*] The medal can be obtained only once per account.[/list]


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[h3]Free Daily Rewards Event (10/6 - 11/3[/h3]

[b]Daily Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Daily Weapons Supply
- Contents: 3 Transcendence Weapons (1 Day) + 1 Daily Attendance Reward Box[/list]
 [b]Cumulative Rewards[/b]
[list][*] 5 Days: M3 Black Dragon (15 Days) 
[*] 10 Days: Barrett M95 White Tiger (15 Days) 
[*] 15 Days: Magnum Launcher (15 Days)
[*] 20 Days: Dual Beretta Gunslinger (15 Days)
[*] 25 Days: Dread Nova (5 Days)[/list]
[b]Extra Cumulative Rewards Event[/b]
[list][*] Each time you receive cumulative rewards, you'll receive a Cumulative Attendance Reward Box.[/list]

[h3]Fireworks Crafting Festival! (10/6 – 10/20)[/h3]Earn rewards by creating firework sets from the three materials earned during the event! It's a blast!

[b]How To Earn Materials[/b]
[list][*] Fuse: Earn 1 every time you reach 30/40/60 minutes of playtime (up to 3 a day)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2d01ae14e3bf8ba4d9fe1accde744ccb87e45ccd.png[/img]
[*] Spark: Earn 1 each time you clear one session of the new Zombie Scenario map on Hard or harder difficulty (up to 3 a day)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/772724f7d5dde53cdb55ce9d28cfe397dcc711d2.png[/img]
[*] Gunpowder: Earn 1 each time you score 5 zombie kills or 10 assists (excluding bots) in Zombie Z, Zombie Evolution, or Zombie Hero modes (up to 3 a day)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1929be63c9ba435d7db52de1399a3527ec7082ff.png[/img][/list] 
[b]Creating Fireworks Sets and Rewards[/b]
[list][*] 1 Fuse + 1 Spark + 1 Gunpowder = 1 Fireworks Set
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/974cd544459ce824db2762c179ef75299fc8afed.png[/img]
[*] Obtain 1 Fireworks Set: Rare Decoder x5
[*] Pileup 2 Firework Sets: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box (x2)
[*] Pileup 3 Firework Sets: Event Decoder (x2) + Add-On Box (x5)[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*] Once you obtain each of the three materials, regardless of order, they can be traded in for one Fireworks Set (Up to 3 a day).
[*] When you receive one Fireworks Set, each of the three material items are removed.
[*] All materials and Fireworks Sets are removed everyday at midnight (Fireworks Set pileup resets everyday at midnight).
[*] Participation will only count in rooms with four or more players (excludes Studio Mode).
[*] For Zombie Scenario Mode, participation will only count when you play for at least 5 minutes.
[*] The Event Decoder can be used until before midnight on the day obtained.[/list]

[h3]Gather Sky Lanterns and Get Rewards! (10/6 – 10/20)[/h3]Play every day during the event to gather Sky Lanterns for various rewards!

[b]Conditions and Rewards[/b]
[list][*] Reach 60 minutes of playtime each day to earn a Sky Lantern
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/89b2ae95c2ce216405598204e70541f45b78bf63.png[/img][/list]
[b]Pileup Conditions and Rewards[/b]
[list][*] 3 Sky Lanterns: Parts Weapon Selection Box
[*] 5 Sky Lanterns: Unique Decoder x5
[*] 7 Sky Lanterns: Night Sea Nameplate 300 Days
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/732fa2dfa14592b9327ed2a9ff064295e42500ca.png[/img]
[*]10 Sky Lanterns: Event Decoder x20 + 20,000 Mileage[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*] Only one Sky Lantern awarded per day.
[*] Sky Lanterns are removed on the day that the event ends.
[*] Participation will only count in rooms with four or more players (includes Studio Mode).
[*] Pileup rewards can be obtained only once per account.
[*] New additions to the Parts Weapon Selection Box:
- Flame Jackhammer / Hunter-Killer X-15 / Hunter-Killer X-90 / Hunter-Killer X-7 / Hunter-Killer X-45[/list]

[h3]New Transcendence Weapon Guaranteed Giveaway (10/6 - 11/3)[/h3]

[b]Conditions and Rewards[/b]
[list][*] You will receive a Failnaught (permanent) every time you reach 300 points.[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*] 6 Guaranteed Points are earned each time you use 1 Transcendence Premium Decoder.
[*] 1 Guaranteed Point is earned each time you use 1 Transcendence Decoder.[/list]

[h3]New Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (10/6 - 11/3)[/h3]

[b]Conditions and Obtainable Items[/b]
[list][*] Reach 150 Guaranteed Points: Choose Ismael or Ethan
[*] Reach 300 Guaranteed Points: Choose Ismael or Ethan
- Upon selecting Ismael, automatically get the permanent exclusive costume (Black Rose Shuriken)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a2a3c21c818cf9d03b81e642c3dca8b0940651de.png[/img]
- Upon selecting Ethan, automatically get an the permanent exclusive costume (Inquisitor's Hourglass)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ddb2ab98ce4b7d4c24efbd8fa865eff19cc448d6.png[/img][/list] 
[b]Notice[/b][list][*] 1 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
[*] 3 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Premium Class Decoder.
[*] Guaranteed Giveaway rewards can be granted only once per account.[/list]


[h2]Shop Update[/h2]

[h3]New Transcendence Weapon Promotion (10/6 - 11/3)[/h3]During the event, the drop rate of the new transcendence weapon, Failnaught, from Transcendence Decoders and Transcendence Premium Decoders is three times higher!

[b]Decoder Drop Rates[/b]
[list][*] Transcendence Premium Decoders: Failnaught 3%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9ae7ae80146659b122e91f27dc2ed464032ef586.png[/img]
[*] Transcendence Decoders: Failnaught 0.45%[/list]
[b]Failnaught[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5d46260c66fc4eeedd48032d78e5691009afb0f3.png[/img]
[list][*] Type: Rifle
[*] Description: Failnaught, which fires 150 holy arrows, automatically aims enemies within a certain range of the crosshairs when using the default firing mode. (Does not auto-aim if beyond the range.) Hitting the same enemy with the default firing mode stacks a mark, inflicting additional damage each time it stacks. Upon reaching 5 stacks, damage is transferred to nearby enemies and the stacks are reset. While charging up, the Hunter's Eye activates, allowing you to learn the location of enemies within a certain distance and attack through obstacles. The default firing mode's auto-aim and stack effects, as well as the Hunter's Eye, will not be triggered in specific modes (Zombie/Human Scenario, Zombie Shelter, or Zombie Giant).
[*] Taking a body hit with Failnaught's charged shot temporarily inhibits natural recovery.[/list]

[h3]New Transcendence Class Promotion (10/6 - 11/3)[/h3]During the event, the drop rate of the two new transcendence classes (Ismael and Ethan) from Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders is four times higher!

[b]Decoder Drop Rates[/b]
[list][*] Premium Class Decoder: Ismael and Ethan are each 2%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/3d03d89eb72626acb040c62df63c72a331d8b59f.png[/img]
[*] Class Decoder: Ismael and Ethan are each 0.5%[/list]
[b]Ismael[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2ea1cd4116e7eef4dda5e940f2c03f6e105ac469.png[/img]
[list][*] A human-vampire hybrid, born into a noble family, she has lived her life suffering from discrimination and neglect because of her mixed blood. Her pride as nobility has become a twisted defense mechanism that leads her to sneer at everything. While she appears human, her vampiric blood gives her great physical abilities. She is the sole survivor of her family. Her parents were executed by the inquisitors when the townsfolk sold them out. She has joined a hunter's guild who highly value her abilities, making a living killing those who could be her brothers or sisters.
[*] Paired Effect: The maximum amount of penetration for Failnaught's charged shot increases.
[*] Exclusive Skill: Feast of Blood - In Zombie Scenario, she can use this skill to increase the attack power of herself and allies by 30% for 10 seconds, while restoring her HP for 1% of the damage she deals. Infinite Ammo effect is applied during the duration of this buff (herself and allies). Allies within a certain distance get the buff, but the HP restoring skill is only applied to herself.[/list]
[b]Ethan[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1fc9bce6fcf7b6f6593b97069def10745a3d5f0b.png[/img]
[list][*] An inquisitor who eliminates evil and strives to do good. He has eliminated numerous villains, as if to prove actions are worth more than words. His calm voice and handsome appearance have made him very popular. While he looks calm and gentle on the outside, he loses his cool if he makes a mistake or faces an unexpected situation. He has troubled feelings towards Ismael, who has vampire blood despite being a hunter. He watches her closely, waiting for the moment she proves herself evil.
[*] Paired Effect: The explosion damage for Failnaught's charged shot increases.
[*] Exclusive Skill: Barrier - In Zombie Scenario, he can use this skill to create a barrier in front of him. He creates a shield for the himself and allies within certain distance, and slows the movement speed of monsters who pass through the barrier.[/list]
[b]Ismael / Ethan Common Applications[/b]
[list][*]Transcendence Class exclusive voices are applied.
[*]Paired Weapon: Failnaught
[*]+10% EXP/Points
[*]In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes.
[*]Adds 1 initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
[*]Displays your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
[*]Upon killing an enemy, leaves a unique mark at the target location.[/list]

notes.title: [Complete] Regular Maintenance: October 6th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9cb5778993db56529d92cc47da45330f536ed525.jpg[/img]

[i][b]2021-10-06 7:35 A.M. CEST Update:[/b][list][*] The regular maintenance for October 6th has been completed. Thank you for your patience throughout and you may now go enjoy the new transcendence classes as well as its pairing transcendence weapon![/list][/i]----------------------------------------------

[b]Attention Survivors,[/b]

We're going to perform a regular maintenance tomorrow, October 6th, 2021, at 4:00 A.M. CEST. All servers during this period will be unavailable and we are anticipating the maintenance to conclude at around 8:30 A.M. CEST. Please refer below for more details on the maintenance.


[h1][b]Time Frame[/b][/h1][list][*]Wednesday, October 6th, 2021
[*]SEA (UTC+7): 9:00 A.M. – 1:30 P.M.
[*]CEST: 4:00 A.M. – 8:30 A.M.
[*]ET: 5th, 10:00 P.M. – 6th, 2:30 A.M.
[*]PT: 5th, 7:00 P.M. – 11:30 P.M.[/list]
[i][b]Note[/b]: Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.[/i]


[h1][b]Maintenance Details[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Server Upkeep
[*]New Content & Events[/list]

Thank you for your understanding and support in advance.

The CSN:S Team

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: September 23rd
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/fdf073711ad9b85f9cfcd934ad18304c9c4dd2b2.jpg[/img]

New Events have been added!


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[h3]New Transcendence Weapon SG552 Cerberus Release Celebration - Sonya's Secret Box Giveaway (9/23 - 10/13)[/h3]You can earn Sonya's Secret Boxes when you meet the following event conditions during the event!

notes.content:

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: September 8th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9721224a9e4eb423f1d43ae7108e3a727a7e3712.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!
[list][b]Content: Season 10: Steampunk[/b]
Grab your gear and begin your journey to a steampunk world that lies on the border between fantasy and reality: a place where past and future coexist!

[b]Content: Zombie Update[/b]
From Zombie Z mode unlock level adjustments to mutation balance updates, check out all the changes now!
	
[b]Event: Full Moon Festival[/b]
Make fun memories with friends and get massive rewards with all the Moon Festival events![/list]Check out the Details section below for more information.


[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]
 
[h2]New Content[/h2]

[h3]Season 10: Steampunk[/h3]
[b]Season Information[/b][list][*] The tenth season's theme is steampunk! For details, please refer to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/2954912787241224481]Season 10 News Slides![/url][/list]
[b]Black Market Open Early[/b][list][*]Starting with Season 9, the Black Market will open early for players who reach Rank 100.
[*]When you reach Rank 100 on the Season Pass currently in progress, the Season Missions will end and missions you can get Black Market Badges from will start anew.
[*]New Item Added: CSN:S-Brand Hip Pack (Costume)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5ef27158549e85af0024d6f4815084730fb0ee22.png[/img]
- A CSN:S-brand hip pack. Can be equipped on the waist.
[*]You can access the Black Market from the Mission menu. Players who have not reached Rank 100 can use the Black Market only during the off-season period.
[*]All Black Market Badges you've obtained will disappear when a new season begins.

[*]Growing Weapon
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/470dbcbe7ce9aa93429addde91ec6c89cacffc8b.png[/img]
- Gear-Bird Cannon Mk. 1: A powerful cannon that blasts a certain area in front. (Season 10 Reward Weapon - Growing Weapon Stage 1)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/67feffbd0e331d246ce194da1fe59acaa0e3c533.png[/img]
- Gear-Bird Cannon Mk. 2: This powerful weapon can have the Gear-Bird on its muzzle transformed. Fire the cannon at the moment the transformation ends to make the Gear-Bird fly ahead of you, damaging and knocking back enemies in its path. (Season 10 Reward Weapon - Growing Weapon Stage 2)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/6a6af5587bb0acf832d6e16674709b9a4f197f84.png[/img]
- Gear-Bird Cannon Mk. 3: This powerful cannon discharges a huge blast of energy, which damages nearby enemies, when the Gear-Bird on its muzzle has finished transforming. Fire the cannon at that moment to make the Gear-Bird fly ahead of you, damaging and knocking back enemies in its path. (Season 10 Reward Weapon - Growing Weapon Stage 3)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2512f224871612ced5997c6ce0c96084c962f537.png[/img]
- Gran Bird Cannon: This powerful cannon discharges a huge blast of energy, which damages nearby enemies, when the Gran Bird on its muzzle has finished transforming. Fire the cannon at that moment to make the Gran Bird fly ahead of you, not only damaging and knocking back enemies in its path, but also leaving flames in its wake, dealing damage for a certain amount of time afterwards. (Season 10 Reward Weapon - Growing Weapon Stage 4)

[*]Zombie Costumes
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a40136297caaf20a537cb02a7f59bb197e81bed8.png[/img]
 - Armored Soldier Ganymede: Able to use Armored Soldier Ganymede. (Season 10 Reward Zombie Skin)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5b7966ad9ff3f3642af0a200e4c700c58ba4c976.png[/img]
- Clockwork Chaser: Able to use Clockwork Chaser. (Season 10 Reward Zombie Skin)

[*]Weapon Paints
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e9aa78af758d5fa4d5a212037b6cacc8d3f63f90.png[/img]
- Clockwork Weapon Paint (Glock 18C, SKULL-9, Shining Heart Rod, Ripper, and Lightning Fury)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/3e754399283bb2876e99a9eb562b80e76c10caa1.png[/img]
- Brass Weapon Paint (K3, BALROG-11, M950, SG552 Lycanthrope, and Blade Runebreaker)

[*]Costume
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/607e3830710dee9717dcb404ac1287d32b36593e.jpg[/img]
- Clockwork Peaked Cap, Gothic Mask, Large Gear Decoration, Steam Power Bank Backpack, Vacuum Tube Gas Lamp, and Automata Clock

[*]Spray
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a054c4427952e3decccf16bdc92154270ccb8067.jpg[/img]
- Armored Soldier Ganymede Spray, Clockwork Chaser Spray, Chibi Mirage Spray, Chibi Anemone Spray, and Steampunk Spray

[*]Medal
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e9cefc082beff84ffb50deb2300354be2e40af31.png[/img]
- Season 10 Trailblazer Medal (Pass)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e97f431a7f4f19efbd9954aa3601485b00d19144.png[/img]
- Season 10 Conqueror Medal (Highest Rank Reached)[/list]

[h3]Zombie Content Update[/h3]
[b]Zombie Z Mode Unlock Levels Adjusted[/b]

[b]Mutation Balance Updates[/b][list][*]Explosive Ammo: Lv. 1 explosion damage has been adjusted from 35% of weapon attack power to 20%; Lv. 2 explosion damage has been adjusted to 100% of weapon attack power.
[*]Contact Infection: Base range value was adjusted from 1.15 to 0.3 (radius); per-round range increase value was changed from 0.05 to 0.1.
[*]Penetrating Rounds: Armor penetration rate has been adjusted from 1.35 to 17.5.
[*]Claw Enhancement: Claw Enhancement mutation's Lv. 2 base range multiplier has been changed to 24; range multiplier for when using Claw Enhancement Mutation Boost has been changed to 60.
[*]Aggressive Investment: Additional dollar rewards obtained from infecting humans has been adjusted from 50% to 75%.
[*]Fetch: Lv. 2 Zombie Dog HP has been changed to 1,500.
[*]Notice:
- Explosive Ammo mutation's Lv. 2 base performance has been improved.
- Contact Infection mutation's damage radius now starts at a greatly reduced value. However, the radius increases as the rounds progress. The radius in the final round, round 17, is the same as before the update (= 2).
- The Penetrating Rounds mutation's armor piercing rate has been increased, allowing you to damage on zombies more effectively than before.
- With the Claw Enhancement mutation's adjustments, the basic attack range of zombies with this mutation has been slightly increased.
- With the Aggressive Investment mutation's adjustments, the bonus dollars the zombie with this mutation receives from the infected target has been increased to 75%.
- The HP of the Zombie Dog summoned by the Fetch Lv. 2 mutation has been increased by 50%.[/list]



[h2]New Events[/h2]

[h3]Free Daily Rewards Event (9/8 - 10/6)[/h3]
[b]Daily Rewards[/b][list][*]Daily Weapons Supply
- Contents: 3 Transcendence Weapons (1 Day) + 1 Daily Attendance Reward Box[/list]
[b]Cumulative Rewards[/b][list][*]5 Days: M3 Black Dragon (15 Days) 
[*]10 Days: Barrett M95 White Tiger (15 Days) 
[*]15 Days: Magnum Launcher (15 Days)
[*]20 Days: Dual Beretta Gunslinger (15 Days)
[*]25 Days: Dread Nova (5 Days)[/list]
[b]Extra Cumulative Rewards Event[/b][list][*]Each time you receive cumulative rewards, you'll receive a Cumulative Attendance Reward Box.[/list]

[h3]Season Badge Giveaway (9/8 - 12/1)[/h3]During the season, you will receive Season Badges when you meet the login time requirements under Daily Missions!

[b]Reward Obtained per Condition[/b][list][*]Upon reaching 30 minutes of login time: Season Badge x5
[*]Upon reaching 1 hour of login time: Season Badge x10
[*]Upon reaching 2 hours of login time: Season Badge x20[/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*]Missions reset every day at midnight.
[*]You cannot use a difficulty change item on event missions.[/list]

[h3]Zombie Scenario Golden Zombie Event (9/8 - 12/1)[/h3]
[b]Earn rewards by killing the Golden Zombie, which will appear randomly when you play Zombie Scenario during the event![/b][list][*]Hitting the Golden Zombie once will count as credit for a kill.[/list]
[b]Reward Given per Kill[/b][list][*]1 Kill: AK-47 Paladin
[*]2 Kills: M4A1 Dark Knight
[*]3 Kills: Lycanthrope
[*]5 Kills: Python Desperado
[*]7 Kills: Red Dragon Cannon
[*]10 Kills: Guardian[/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*]You can only get credit for 3 kills per day.
[*]Each reward is given only once per account.
[*]The Golden Zombies randomly appear after playing for more than 3 minutes in rooms at regular difficulty or higher.[/list]

[h3]Full Moon Festival! Golden Rice Cake Giveaway (9/8 - 9/23)[/h3]
[b]When you login during hot time (19:00 - 22:00) during the event, you will receive Golden Rice Cakes each time the moon phase changes.[/b]
[list][*]Phase 1 - Crescent Moon: 1 Golden Rice Cake given after 20 minutes of playtime
[*]Phase 2 - Half Moon: 3 Golden Rice Cakes given after 40 minutes of playtime
[*]Phase 3 - Full Moon: 5 Golden Rice Cakes given after 70 minutes of playtime[/list]
[b]Golden Rice Came Contents (1 given, with each reward having different rates)[/b][list][*]VVIP Free Pass (1 Day)
[*]Receive 9 Transcendence Weapons that are not regularly available from decoders (1-day versions)
- Magnum Launcher, Holy Sword Divine Order, Lightning Fury, Psychic Harmonium, X-TRACKER, Trinity Grenade, Dual Beretta Gunslinger, etc.
[*]16 Transcendence Classes (1-day versions)
- Axion, Aetheris, Medea, Kalael, Pink Heart Shiho, Black Rose Miho, Queen, Cyborg, etc.
[*]28 Add-ons (5 of each)[/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*]All unused Golden Rice Cakes will be removed during maintenance on the day the event ends.
[*]Participation will count in rooms with four or more players (excludes Studio Mode).[/list]

[h3]Moon Festival Rice Cake Grenade Kill Event (9/8 - 9/23)[/h3]
[b]Receive a Rice Cake Grenade by logging in during the event.[/b]

[b]When you use the Rice Cake Grenade in Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, Zombie Evolution, or Zombie Scenario modes during the event, kill damage will be randomly applied to its blast.
[/b][list][*]Random Damage Rates: 50% chance for normal damage, 40% chance for 2x damage, and 10% chance for one-hit-kill damage.

[*]The first time you kill a zombie with a Rice Cake Grenade each day, you'll get 1 Golden Rice Cake.
- Can make progress in rooms with four or more players (excludes Studio Mode).
- Can only be claimed once a day.[/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*]All unused Golden Rice Cakes will be removed during maintenance on the day the event ends.
[*]If the one-hit-kill damage triggers in Zombie Z, you get the same EXP as dealing normal damage.[/list]

[h3]Moon Festival Golden Rice Cake Pileup Event (9/8 - 9/23)[/h3]
[b]Event Details[/b][list][*]When you've accumulated a total of 100 Golden Rice Cakes during the event, you'll receive a Hunter-Killer X-7 (Permanent) with a Gun Boost Part - Grade 6 and Rage Down Part - Grade 6 applied.[/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*]Reward distribution is determined based on the total number of Golden Rice Cakes you've accumulated over the course of the event, even if you've used them.[/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: August 25th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/09277c946997b6fcec31dc007fc714c8f467f288.jpg[/img]

New Content and Events have been added!


[h2]New Content[/h2]

[h3]Information Accessibility and Player Quality-of-Life Improvements[/h3]Made improvements to areas that were inconvenient or lacking in information about the game. Also updated areas that can help players make the best use of the game’s features, as below. You can find details in the [Convenience Feature Updates and the Mission Chain System Preview].

[b]Hideout Improvements[/b][list][*]Hideout's base mode is changed to Zombie Z.
[*]Updates include adjustments to the Firing Range features, command help, expansion of the space next to the Firing Range, etc.[/list]
[b]Encyclopedia[/b][list][*] Various sorting filters, including Zombie Z unlock level, have been added.
[*]Information on parts, enhancement, ratings, etc. has been fleshed out.[/list]
[b]Event/Season Missions Unified Under the Missions Page[/b][list][*] Event details, which had previously been split between the Notifications page and the Missions page, have been unified under the Missions page.[/list]
[b]Mission Chain System - Tutorial Mission Added[/b][list][*]Added the Mission Chain system, consisting of 25 guides and 25 missions.
[*]You can only clear one Mission Chain stage (5 guides and 5 missions) per day.
[*]Per-Stage Completion Rewards
- Stage 1: Hunter-Killer X-90 (Permanent)
- Stage 2: Dual Sword Infernal Hunter (Permanent)
- Stage 3: Transcendence Yuri (Permanent)
- Stage 4: Claymore (Permanent)
- Stage 5: Python Desperado (Permanent)[/list]
[b]Mission Chain Final Completion Rewards[/b][list][*]Hunter-Killer X-12 (Permanent) + Complete the Guide Medal[/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*]The table above only shows the stage rewards and the final rewards. There are also interim rewards for checking out the guides, as well as rewards for completing the individual missions.[/list]
[b]Complete the Guide Medal[/b][list][*]Type: Medal
[*]Description: A token for those who have completed all the missions of the Mission Chain tutorial[/list]


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[h3]Random Weapon Zombie Hero Event (8/25 - 9/8)[/h3]During this event, you can play the Random Weapon Zombie Hero mode! Blast your foes with new weapons, popular weapons, and even +6 weapons! Test your luck!

[b]Featured Maps:[/b][list][*] Italy, Assault, and Dust[/list]
[b]New Weapons:[/b][list][*] Blazing Nova, Twin Shadow Axes, Astra, Satellite Mine, Blue Storm, Devastator, and Elemental Tracker[/list]
[b]Notice:[/b][list][*] When you're on the Zombie Team, your zombie class will be selected based on a set percentage chance for each class.
[*]When you're on the Human Team, each of your primary weapons, secondary weapons, melee weapons, and grenades will be selected based on a set percentage chance for each weapon/grenade.
[*]Base game rules are the same as those for Zombie Hero mode.
[*]The weapon list is provided by default, regardless of what each individual owns.
[*]Armor given will be fixed.
[*]When using a Supply Box (by pressing the E key), you will not enter the shop window. Instead, you will re-select another weapon, with the same percentage chances.
[*]Players cannot select human heroes in this event mode.[/list]

[h3]Burning Playtime Event (8/25 - 9/8)[/h3]During the event, based on the reward thresholds you meet each day, you can get earn for Stages 1-2, in that order.

[b]Conditions/Burning Rewards:[/b][list][*] 10 minutes of playtime: Stage 1
[*] 60 minutes of playtime: Stage 2[/list]
[b]Burning Rewards:[/b][list][*] Stage 1 (Select 1): Unique Decoder x1/Event Decoder x1/Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon (100) x1/3,000 mileage/Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x1
[*] Stage 2 (Select 1): Unique Decoder x2/Event Decoder x2/Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon (100) x2/4,000 mileage/Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x2[/list]
[b]Notice:[/b][list][*] Rewards can only be claimed once a day per account.
[*] Playtime only accumulates in rooms of 4 or more players.
[*] You can use the Event Decoder until before midnight on the day you obtain it.[/list]

[h3]Burning Login Event (8/25 - 9/8)[/h3]You can receive the following rewards based on the total number of days you log in during the event.

[b]Conditions/Cumulative Login Rewards (Select 1):[/b][list][*] 5 days and 10 days of cumulative logins, respectively: Transcendence Decoder x4/Class Decoder x5/Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon (200) x3/10,000 mileage/Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x6[/list]
[b]Notice:[/b][list][*] Can only be claimed once per account.
[*] Cumulative login rewards can be claimed a total of 2 times during the event period.[/list]

[h3]JANUS IS BACK Event (8/25 - 10/6)[/h3]During the event, you can enjoy the JANUS series weapons in Zombie/Zombie Scenario modes with their enhanced specs.

[b]Weapons Affected by Event (balance changes apply only during the event period):[/b][list][*] JANUS-3: Damage in both normal mode and Janus Mode is increased.
[*] JANUS-1, JANUS-5, JANUS-7, and JANUS-11: Damage in both normal mode and Janus Mode is increased. Janus Mode's activation conditions are eased.
[*] JANUS-9: Damage in both normal mode and Janus Mode is increased. Janus Mode range is increased.[/list]
[b]Zombie Z Level Adjustments[/b][list][*]Due to the balance changes, the Zombie Z unlock levels for the JANUS series weapons will be changed during the event. (Unlock level adjustments only apply during the event period.)
- JANUS-1: 1 -> 7
- JANUS-3: 1 -> 4
- JANUS-5: 1 -> 17
- JANUS-7: 1 -> 19
- JANUS-9: 1 -> 3
- JANUS-11: 1 -> 10[/list]
