Updates include adjustments to the Firing Range features, command help, expansion of the space next to the Firing Range, etc.
Various sorting filters, including Zombie Z unlock level, have been added.
Information on parts, enhancement, ratings, etc. has been fleshed out.
Event details, which had previously been split between the Notifications page and the Missions page, have been unified under the Missions page.
Added the Mission Chain system, consisting of 25 guides and 25 missions.
You can only clear one Mission Chain stage (5 guides and 5 missions) per day.
Stage 1: Hunter-Killer X-90 (Permanent)
Stage 2: Dual Sword Infernal Hunter (Permanent)
Stage 3: Transcendence Yuri (Permanent)
Stage 4: Claymore (Permanent)
Stage 5: Python Desperado (Permanent)
Hunter-Killer X-12 (Permanent) + Complete the Guide Medal
The table above only shows the stage rewards and the final rewards. There are also interim rewards for checking out the guides, as well as rewards for completing the individual missions.
Type: Medal
Description: A token for those who have completed all the missions of the Mission Chain tutorial
During this event, you can play the Random Weapon Zombie Hero mode! Blast your foes with new weapons, popular weapons, and even +6 weapons! Test your luck!
Italy, Assault, and Dust
Blazing Nova, Twin Shadow Axes, Astra, Satellite Mine, Blue Storm, Devastator, and Elemental Tracker
When you're on the Zombie Team, your zombie class will be selected based on a set percentage chance for each class.
When you're on the Human Team, each of your primary weapons, secondary weapons, melee weapons, and grenades will be selected based on a set percentage chance for each weapon/grenade.
Base game rules are the same as those for Zombie Hero mode.
The weapon list is provided by default, regardless of what each individual owns.
Armor given will be fixed.
When using a Supply Box (by pressing the E key), you will not enter the shop window. Instead, you will re-select another weapon, with the same percentage chances.
Players cannot select human heroes in this event mode.
During the event, based on the reward thresholds you meet each day, you can get earn for Stages 1-2, in that order.
10 minutes of playtime: Stage 1
60 minutes of playtime: Stage 2
Stage 1 (Select 1): Unique Decoder x1/Event Decoder x1/Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon (100) x1/3,000 mileage/Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x1
Stage 2 (Select 1): Unique Decoder x2/Event Decoder x2/Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon (100) x2/4,000 mileage/Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x2
Rewards can only be claimed once a day per account.
Playtime only accumulates in rooms of 4 or more players.
You can use the Event Decoder until before midnight on the day you obtain it.
You can receive the following rewards based on the total number of days you log in during the event.
5 days and 10 days of cumulative logins, respectively: Transcendence Decoder x4/Class Decoder x5/Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon (200) x3/10,000 mileage/Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x6
Can only be claimed once per account.
Cumulative login rewards can be claimed a total of 2 times during the event period.
During the event, you can enjoy the JANUS series weapons in Zombie/Zombie Scenario modes with their enhanced specs.

tags.balance_change: JANUS-3: Damage in both normal mode and Janus Mode is increased.

JANUS-9: Damage in both normal mode and Janus Mode is increased. Janus Mode range is increased.
Due to the balance changes, the Zombie Z unlock levels for the JANUS series weapons will be changed during the event. (Unlock level adjustments only apply during the event period.)

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: August 11th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5de839959ecc67f0b3a4ec67ed7e7324fefe1599.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!
[list][b]Content: New Zombie Scenario 7-4 Map[/b]
David and Erica learn the truth. Check out the next chapter of the story right now!

[b]Content: Studio Zombie Scenario Features[/b]
A mysterious benefactor drives Gerard to his limits. Track him down in Researcher's Log #7!
	
[b]Content: Zombie Z Season 2 Content Update[/b]
From mutation balancing to gameplay experience improvements — check out all the changes![/list]See the Details section below for more information.


[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]
 
[h2]New Content[/h2]

[u][h3]Zombie New Scenario 7-4 Map[/h3][/u][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/65697c7959978a96b439598e2c014daf0979f66a.png[/img]
[b]Pursuit: Truth Uncovered[/b]
[list][*] Information: David and Erica travel to the coordinates they found in the laboratory. When they arrive, they meet Gerard instead of Dr. Soi. Gerard tells them about the man behind Rex: Douglas, who was also behind Erica's abduction. After learning the truth, David and Erica find new resolve, even while Douglas' forces draw ever closer...

[*] For more details, see the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/2975177081638735896][Zombie Scenario Season 7-4 Preview][/url].[/list]

[u][h3]Studio Zombie Scenario Features[/h3][/u]
[b]Studio Zombie Scenario Update[/b][list][*] Play Mode rules added: Level Rules and Difficulty Rules
[*] Device added: Cutscene Camera device, Ranking Board features expanded
[*] For more details, see the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/2975177081638750640][Studio Zombie Scenario Update Preview][/url].[/list]
[b]Researcher's Log #7: The Search[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/052a5075e71378c0bd5458e7349649cd33a88444.png[/img]
[list][*] A mysterious figure with unknown motives approaches Gerard. Calling himself a friend, the figure drives Gerard to his limits... Track down this mystery man to learn his intentions and identity![/list]

[u][h3]Zombie Z Season 2 Content Update[/h3][/u]
[b]Mutation Balance Updates[/b]
[list][*] Rapid Reloader: Lowered the value added per round, so that the number of rounds it takes for auto-reload to trigger is now 17 rounds
[*] Gene Booster: Now guaranteed to get at Zombie Z Lv.30
[*] Endurance: Activation rate now increases when you upgrade Endurance to Lv. 2
[*] Incendiary Ammo: Increased the base damage of the fire that the Incendiary Ammo creates
[*] Contact Infection: Greatly reduced the base range, and removed the stun effect, for Contact Infection damage, but revised it so that it now increases in range as the round progresses.
[*] Drop Zone: Reduced the chance to make an enemy in the air fall
[*] Support Bombardment: Increased the chance for Support Bombardment to trigger
[*] Explosive Reaction: Reduced the increase, as the round progresses, in the damage required to create a Zombie Bomb
[*] Fireball: Increased the base damage; when Mutation Boost is activated, burst now fires 2 Fireballs
[*] Bomb Defense: Greatly increased the knockback resistance against Zombie Bomb; additionally, if you have the Bomb Defense mutation, it now reduces the screen shake from Zombie Bomb
[*] Supply Contamination: Increased the number of supply boxes you can infect
[*] Furiously Fast: Increased the remaining HP threshold for the mutation to activate, as the round progresses
[*] Poisonous Cloud: Increased the damage and duration, removed stun effect
[*] Darkness: Increased the skill gauge charge amount for Darkness Zombies
[*] Intellectual: Increased humans’ EXP rewards for zombie kills[/list]
[b]Mutation Distribution Method Changes[/b][list][*] Intellectual: Now given at Zombie Z Lv. 1 (if zombie revival restriction is applied)
[*] Specialist: Now given at Zombie Z Lv. 1 (if zombie infinite revival is applied)
[*] Fanatic: Now given at Zombie Z Lv. 20
[*] Gene Booster: Now guaranteed to be given at Zombie Z Lv.30[/list]
[b]Reinforced Challenge Reward + Rewards[/b][list][*]Increased the dollar, EXP, and Karma rewards from eliminating zombies with a weapon purchased through Challenge Reward +
- Kills: 20,000 dollars, 10,000 EXP, and 2x Karma
- Assists: 4,000 dollars, 1,500 EXP, and 2x Karma[/list]
[b]Revamp of “Automatically Improve Zombie” Balance settings[/b][list][*]Automatically Improve Zombie Balance settings will be applied by default. Details are as follows:
[*]For rooms with 30 or more players, the number of Host Zombies spawned will be 4
[*]If the Human Team wins, 1 additional Host Zombie will spawn in the next round
[*]When meeting the following conditions, 1 additional Host Zombie will be spawned:
- ① Human Team wins 2 times in a row
- ② Human Team's cumulative winning rounds are 4 rounds or more
- ③ Final round (The number of additional Host Zombies spawned will not exceed 2. Based on a 32-player room, the max Host Zombie count per round will be limited to 6.)[/list]
[b]Reduced Zombie Respawn Time[/b][list][*]In the event of a death after Detoxification Time, the respawn time has been reduced from 8 sec to 3 sec.[/list]
[b]Gameplay Experience Improvements[/b][list][*]Made improvements to the excessive effects when being hit by weapon attacks, alleviating the vision-blocking effects of being hit when you play as a zombie.
[*]Added the Z, X, and C keys as available options for the Zombie Mode skill bar.[/list]

[u][h3]Game Guide System Revamp Information[/h3][/u]
[b]Hideout Improvements[/b][list][*] Added Zombie Z and allowed freely testing mutations
[*] Added a weapon command guide[/list]
[b]Check latest trending weapon information[/b]


[u][h3]New Studio Zombie Scenario Map Event[/h3][/u]Researcher's Log #7: The Search is a tutorial-type sample map with expanded features for the existing Play Mode, allowing for Zombie Scenario presentation options such as levels and difficulty. When you meet the requirement below in this map, you will receive the following reward:

[b]Conditions[/b][list][*] Reach 10 minutes of playtime in Researcher's Log #7: The Search[/list]
[b]Rewards[/b][list][*] Unique Decoder x1[/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*] Can only be claimed once per account.[/list]


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[u][h3]Free Daily Rewards Event (8/11 - 9/8)[/h3][/u]
[b]Daily Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Daily Weapons Supply
- Contents: 3 Transcendence Weapons (1 Day) + 1 Daily Attendance Reward Box[/list]
[b]Cumulative Rewards[/b][list][*] 5 Days: M3 Black Dragon (15 Days) 
[*] 10 Days: Barrett M95 White Tiger (15 Days) 
[*] 15 Days: Magnum Launcher (15 Days)
[*] 20 Days: Dual Beretta Gunslinger (15 Days)
[*] 25 Days: Dread Nova (5 Days)[/list] 
[b]Extra Cumulative Rewards Event[/b][list][*] Each time you earn cumulative rewards, you'll receive a Cumulative Attendance Reward Box.[/list]

[u][h3]Hot Time Event (8/11 - 8/25)[/h3][/u]
[b]You get additional rewards when you play the eligible modes during Hot Time (19:00 - 22:00) every day.[/b][list][*] Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, and Zombie Evolution: EXP +50%
[*] Chance for Golden Zombie to Appear for Each Difficulty: +20%[/list]
[b]Conditions[/b][list][*] Hot Time: 19:00 - 22:00 CEST
[*] You can only participate in rooms with 4 or more players[/list]

[u][h3]New Zombie Scenario Map Event 1 (8/11 - 8/25)[/h3][/u]
[b]Rewards given for fulfilling all of the following conditions:[/b][list][*] Defuse the C4 placed by the boss in the new map
[*] Difficulty requirement: Hard or above
[*] Minimum playtime requirement: 5 minutes
[*] Only counted in rooms with 4 or more players[/list]
[b]Event Rewards[/b][list][*] Specific Add-On given, based on the day of the week, from Mon. - Sun.[/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*] C4 defusal counts only once per session (rewards are given upon clearing the session)
[*] Rewards can only be claimed 3 times per account every day[/list]

[u][h3]New Zombie Scenario Map Event 2 (8/11 - 8/25)[/h3][/u]
[b]Requirements:[/b][list][*] Clear your first session of the week in the new Zombie Scenario 7-4 map
[*] Difficulty requirement: Hard or above
[*] Minimum playtime: 5 minutes
[*] Only counted in rooms with 4 or more players[/list]
[b]Event Rewards:[/b][list][*] Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x4
[*] 28 Add-Ons (1 each)[/list]
[b]Notice:[/b][list][*] Available weekly reward claim count resets every Monday at 12:00 AM
[*] Can participate once a week per account[/list]

[u][h3]New Zombie Scenario Map Addition Celebration Event 3 - Play Event (8/11 - 8/25)[/h3][/u]
[b]Conditions[/b][list][*] 400 minutes or more of total event playtime
[*] 6 days or more of total event login days
[*] Note: The event is not restricted just to the new Zombie Scenario map.[/list]
[b]Rewards[/b][list][*] Transcendence Decoder x15 (for all players meeting conditions)[/list]
[b]Extra Event[/b][list][*]Additional rewards will be given through a raffle among players who met the conditions 
[*]3 winners, for each of the following weapons, will be selected by raffle:
- Epic Weapon Twin Shadow Axes (3 winners)
- Holy Sword Divine Order (3 winners)
- Lightning Fury (3 winners)
- Psychic Harmonium (3 winners)
- Dual Beretta Gunslinger (3 winners)[/list]
[b]Schedule[/b]	[list][*] Raffle result announcement and reward distribution: 9/8 (Wed.)[/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*] The higher your login days and playtime, the better your chances in the raffle become![/list]

[u][h3]Studio Zombie Scenario Features Celebration — Studio Event Ticket Giveaway (8/11 - 9/8)[/h3][/u]With the Studio Event Ticket, you can apply a limited event to a map you created. Participate in this Studio Event Ticket Giveaway, and seize a special opportunity to introduce your map to the community! Among players who write promotional posts for their maps, a total of 10 players will be selected through a raffle and receive rewards.

[b]Submission Requirements:[/b][list][*]1. Participate in the event by leaving a post on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/273110/discussions/0/3057367774854437404/]event discussion board[/url], with the title header [Promotion].
[*]2. In the post’s content, describe and introduce your map. You can write a brief summary, including the map’s creation date, eligible modes, and so on.
[*]3. Promoted maps that qualify, based on their quality and number of recommendations, will be entered into a raffle with 10 winners.[/list]
[b]Raffle Reward[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/782b24ded599c595e2267c4ffe9408de7a7739f6.png[/img][list][*] Dual Sword Phantom Slayer Event Ticket x1[/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*] The raffle rewards will be distributed during maintenance on Thursday, September 23rd
[*] Event Ticket: Studio Creators can use event tickets that can apply an event to one of their own map creations
- Players who play the event map will be entered into a raffle
- Players who submitted to the event may receive rewards, depending on a raffle and the number of tickets used
[*] All unused event tickets will be removed during maintenance on Wednesday, October 20th[/list]

[u][h3]Studio Zombie Scenario Contest (8/11 - 9/8)[/h3][/u][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9dec90da080a82a77078f359289224f66da0f7e9.jpg[/img]
Celebrate the new features of Studio Zombie Scenario by creating your own Studio Zombie Scenario map! Show off your creative skills and win up to 300 Transcendence Decoders, Medals, Trophies, and lots more! Let your imagination run wild, have fun, and don’t miss this chance!

[b]Event Schedule[/b][list][*] Application Period: 8/11 - 9/8
[*] Finalists Announced: 10/6
[*] Player Vote: 10/6 - 10/27 (All voting participants will receive 1,000 Mileage)
[*] Winners Announced: 11/3
[*] Medal and Trophy Theme Packs Sent Out: 11/3[/list]
[b]How to Participate:[/b][list][*]1. Create an original, creative Studio Zombie Scenario map and leave a comment on this event's Steam Announcement with the following information to participate: ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/273110/discussions/0/3057367774854432653/]SUBMIT ENTRY HERE![/url])
- You must add the hashtag '#StudioZS' to the map title to be accepted.
- You can participate multiple times with multiple maps.
[*]2. You must include this information in your Event Entry Comment:
- Required: In-game Nickname (IGN), Map Name as it appears in the game, and STEAM ID!
- Optional: Additional information, such as a brief introduction of the map, etc.[/list]
[b]Evaluation Criteria:[/b][list][*]1. One round of map review after the contest ends.
[*]2. We'll evaluate the maps internally, then select the finalists.
[*]3. The winners will be selected based 50% on player votes and 50% on CSNS Team’s internal score.
- Entries will be rated based on original aspects and setups, as well as creative use of options.
- Players may make multiple submissions and receive multiple rewards.[/list]
[b]Prizes:[/b][list][*]1st Place: 300 Transcendence Decoders
[*]2nd Place: 200 Transcendence Decoders
[*]3rd Place: 70 Transcendence Decoders
[*]4th - 10th Place: 30 Transcendence Decoders
[*]11th - 20th Place: 20 Transcendence Decoders[/list]
[b]Additional Rewards:[/b][list][*] All Prize Winners: Excellent Creator Medal + Trophy Theme Pack
[*] All Participants: Contest Participation Medal + 5,000 Mileage
[*] Rewards will only be given to maps with a play count of at least 10 and at least 3 recommendations
[*] If you already have the Excellent Creator Medal, another one will not be given[/list]

[u][h3]Long Weekend Login Event (8/20 - 8/25)[/h3][/u]When you log in on Friday, Saturday, and/or Sunday during the event, you can obtain a reward of your choice from the weekend daily rewards. If you log in for Friday, Saturday, and Sunday during the event, you can additionally receive a cumulative login reward.

[b]Weekend Daily Rewards (Select 1)[/b][list][*] Unique Decoder x1
[*] Event Decoder x1
[*] Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon (100) x1
[*] 3,000 Mileage
[*] Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x2[/list]
[b]Cumulative Login Rewards (Select 1)[/b][list][*] Transcendence Decoder x4
[*] Class Decoder x5
[*] Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon (200) x3
[*] 10,000 Mileage
[*] Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x6[/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*]All login rewards can be obtained once a day per account
[*]Weekend (Friday/Saturday/Sunday) daily rewards can only be claimed on that day
[*]Cumulative Login Reward Claim Period:
- 8/23 (Mon.) - 8/25 (Wed.) before maintenance[/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: July 28th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f470c583188970b044a307f4eff79bd82ae948eb.jpg[/img]

New Contents and Events have been added!


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[h3]Bonus Disassembly Event (7/28 - 8/11)[/h3]During the event, you can participate in the Bonus Disassembly Event by clicking the "Bonus Disassembly" button at the bottom of the Lobby screen. During the Bonus Disassembly Event,10 players can each put up the weapons they want to disassemble, and one player will get extra bonus mileage. Each participant can get 500 mileage for every weapon they disassemble.

[b]Details[/b][list][*]Both Weekdays and Weekends - 19:00 - 23:00 CEST
[*]Minimum Participation Mileage: 5,000
[*]Some items will be adjusted based on the weapon's rarity.
[*]Table's ranks are in the order of highest value first.
[*]Weapon criteria are determined on the day the Bonus Disassembly Event starts. If the weapon's rank changes, its value in the Bonus Disassembly Event will update for its adjusted value.[/list]
[b]Added new items for disassembly[/b][list][*]Twin Shadow Axes
[*]Astra
[*]Magnum Shooter
[*]Devastator
[*]Wind Tracker
[*]Fire Tracker
[*]Lighting Tracker
[*]Elemental Tracker
[*]Blue Storm
[*]Blazing Nova
[*]Satellite Mine[/list]
[b]Special Bonus Event[/b][list][*]To celebrate the release of the Twin Shadow Axes, we increased the chance to win Epic Weapons to be 2 times that for Transcendence Weapons during the event![/list]

[h3]Dark Fragment Collection Event (7/28 - 9/8)[/h3]Complete play missions to get Dark Fragments, which you can exchange for Epic Weapons, Epic Edition Weapons, and other items!

[b]How to Get Dark Fragments[/b] - You can only get up to 30 per day, regardless of which of the below methods you use. [list][*]Each time you score 2 kills or 6 assists, or infect 2 humans, in Zombie Hero/Zombie Z/Zombie Evolution modes, you will receive Dark Fragment x1 (max 20 a day, excludes bots).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ab1cd2b1dcf139fc2bf0b3c16ac8037cffa061ff.png[/img]
[*]Each time you upgrade a mutation in Zombie Z mode, you will receive Dark Fragment x1 (max 5 a day). 
[*]Each time you clear 1 session of Zombie Scenario mode on Hard or higher difficulty, you will receive Dark Fragment x3 (max 25 a day).
[*]When you reach 60 minutes of playtime, you will receive Dark Fragment x15 (max 15 a day).[/list]

Don't forget that, as noted in the Dark Fragment Shop Opening Event below, each item will give a certain number of fragments back as a rebate!

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: July 14th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0c8eed56017ef6d433e8a8b97d2aee5a6eea145e.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!
[list][b]Content: Zombie Z Season 2 Update[/b]
The evolution continues! Achieve greater power in Zombie Z!

[b]Content: Mileage Auction System Improvements[/b]
New options for people looking to buy weapons!
	
[b]Event: Get the New Weapon, Magnum Shooter (Permanent)[/b]
Collect Special Ammo and unlock the new weapon, Magnum Shooter (Permanent)!

[b]Promotion: New Transcendence Classes, Anemone & Mirage[/b]
One's a pro gamer, the other is an iconic virtual streamer (and hacker) from the VR platform Chrono World. Now available in Premium Class Decoders![/list]Check out the Details section below for more information.


[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]
 
[h2][New Contents][/h2]

[u][h3]Zombie Z Season 2 Update[/h3][/u]
[b]System Revamp[/b]
[list][*]Max level increased from 30 to 40!
[*]Zombies get greater dollar rewards for dealing damage and infecting targets.
[*]Boosted in-game rewards for playing as a zombie.
- Fixed an issue that prevented a zombie from getting dollar rewards for damage dealt immediately before being killed.[/list]
[b]Mutation Improvements[/b]
[list][*]Mutation Enhancement
- Certain mutations can now be enhanced to Lv. 2. Each player can have up to 5 Lv. 2 mutations.
- Press the P key to upgrade one random mutation to Lv. 2. The upgraded mutations will display in the HUD. Each upgrade costs in-game dollars.
- If you already have 5 Lv. 2 mutations, the newly upgraded mutation will randomly replace one of your existing Lv. 2 mutations.
[*]Mutation Boost System
- Mutation Boost lets you temporarily amplify the effects of a Lv. 2 mutation. Mutation Boost lasts for 5 seconds and has a 30 second cooldown.
[*]Added new mutations and improved existing mutations.
- [All] Early Adopter: Reduces all unlock levels by 1.
- [All] Discount Coupon: All purchase amounts in dollars are discounted by 10%.
- [Humans] Quick Change: Increases weapon swap speed.
- [Humans] Double Impact: Grants a low chance to apply damage one additional time.
- [Humans] Net Round: Grants a small chance for attacks to fire a net round.
- [Humans] Glass Cannon: Increases attack power, but also increases damage taken.
- [Humans] Busy Life: Increases attack power when you cannot use skills.
- [Humans] Emergency Escape: Escape into the air after taking what would have been a lethal blow.
- [Zombies] Mutant: Zombie gains an additional skill.
- [Zombies] Furiously Fast: Zombie becomes faster when its HP is low.
- [Zombies] Poisonous Cloud: Creates a cloud of lethal gas when a zombie dies.
- [Zombies] Aggressive Investment: Gain bonus dollars from infected targets.
- [Zombies] Hook Bomb: When a Zombie Bomb explodes, it pulls enemies in.
- [Zombies] Liberator: Increases your strength as you infect more humans.
- [Zombies] Fetch: Inflicting damage with a Zombie Bomb creates a zombie dog.
- [Zombies] Darkness: Allows rebirth as a Darkness Zombie.
- [Changed] Craftsmanship: Reduces skill cooldown.[/list]
[b]The zombies from Zombie 4: Darkness now appear in Zombie Z.[/b]

[b]Weapon purchase process and other gameplay improvements[/b]
[list][*]Added a recommended weapons page that shows recommended weapons for your level.
- This page appears where Bookmark used to be displayed in the purchase window.
[*]Check Weapon Recommendations system improvements
- Recommendations will be sorted and shown in the order of monthly purchase counts in Zombie Z mode, from high to low.
[*]Random Purchase improvements
- Challenge Reward + is added to Random Purchase. When you score kills with the weapon that is purchased, you will receive additional rewards.
- This bonus only applies to weapons purchased with Random Purchase (Challenging Reward +) early in the round. It ends when you swap weapons, if you get infected, or when the round ends.
[*]Advanced Random Purchase improvements
- Reduced the weapons pool for Advanced Random Purchase, increasing its usability.
[*]Added a checkbox to close the purchase window
- Added the option to toggle closing the purchase window pop-up on or off.
[*]HP bar display for attack target
- An HP bar will display for any enemy you hit directly and any enemy you target with your crosshair for 2 seconds or longer.[/list]

[u][h3]Mileage Auction System Improvement[/h3][/u][list][*]You can now place buy orders when you want to purchase a weapon
- Looking to Buy tab: Choose a weapon and list the price you want to buy it for.
- Eligible weapons: Regular auctionable items that haven't had any successful transactions in a while.
- Bidding: Potential sellers can browse bids in the Looking to Sell tab.
- The auction runs for 1 hour after the buy listing is posted. One seller is chosen from among those who offered to fulfill the bid and the transaction is completed.
- If the number of sellers exceeds a certain threshold within the 1 hour limit, the auction will end early.[/list]

[u][h3]New Transcendence Class Medal Distribution[/h3][/u]When you own all items in the new Transcendence Classes set, you will receive the Transcendence Class medal.

[b]Medal[/b]
[list][*][Honor] Twins
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5b0fb596f2991e4c9a98f28ddc2b39e2c5581aa8.png[/img][/list]
[b]How to Obtain This Medal (Requires Permanent Version)[/b]
[list][*]Anemone
[*]Mirage
[*]VR HMD
[*]Drone[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Each account can receive this reward only once.[/list]


[h2][New Events][/h2]

[u][h3]Free Daily Rewards Event (7/14 - 8/11)[/h3][/u]Join the battle every day to get rewards, get rewards for getting rewards, and get even more event rewards on top of that!

[b]Daily Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Daily Weapons Supply
- Contents: 2 Transcendence Weapons (1 Day) and 1 Daily Attendance Reward Box[/list]
[b]Cumulative Rewards[/b]
[list][*]5 Days: M3 Black Dragon (5 Days) 
[*]10 Days: M3 Black Dragon (10 Days) 
[*]15 Days: Magnum Launcher (5 Days)

[u][h3]New and Returning Counter-Strike Fans Welcome Event (7/14 - 8/11)[/h3][/u]New and returning players will receive the following items, based on how many days they log in during the event period!

[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Each account can receive this reward only once.

[u][h3]Special Ammo Collection Event (7/14 - 8/11)[/h3][/u]Collect Special Ammo during the event to unlock a permanent Magnum Shooter.

[b]Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Collect Special Ammo x0: Magnum Shooter (15 Days), granted upon login

[*]Collect Special Ammo x320: Event Decoder x20 + Transcendence Decoder x5
[*]Collect Special Ammo x400: Magnum Shooter (Permanent)

[*]Day 3: Special Ammo x3

[u][h3]Special Ammo Collection Event 2 (7/14 - 8/11)[/h3][/u]Participate in the following missions every day to collect Special Ammo!

[*]Each time you upgrade a mutation in Zombie Z mode, you receive Special Ammo x1 (max 5 a day).

[list][*]Participation will only be counted in rooms with four or more players (excludes Studio Mode).

[u][h3]Mileage Auction Event (7/21 - 8/3 23:59)[/h3][/u]The long-awaited Mileage Auction has finally returned! Access the auction with the Mileage Auction button at the bottom of the Lobby screen during the event period.

[b]New permanent auction item:[/b]
[list][*]Starlight Rolling Shooter
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b824dbfb8f698dcfb5f2f3e728db8d2992941c71.png[/img][/list]

[list][*]Remaining time is shown in 5-minute increments for listed auction items.

[*]Regular auction items will be listed with a 30% fee included in the initial bidding price.
[*]If an item listed on the auction is not sold, the item will be returned.
[*]Items listed on the auction can be purchased immediately at the direct purchase price.
[*]If you list an item at auction, you cannot cancel it until the auction time ends.
[*]The item you listed may be shown on the bid page.
[*]When listing an item, you can easily check the actual amount you will receive under the "Net reward" section.
[*]Some recently released weapons are ineligible to be listed at auction.[/list]


[h2][Shop Update][/h2]

[u][h3]New Transcendence Classes, Anemone & Mirage (7/14 - 8/11)[/h3][/u]Introducing Anemone and Mirage! Their rates are increased 4x during the promotion, so get them while it's getting hot!

[b]Anemone (TR)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/356ef3dc26fc8c531bad439b9e9c68e5ce0bbe57.png[/img]
[list][*]Anemone, a pro gamer on the VR platform Chrono World, is renowned in the world of competitive gaming for her skill. Unlike her older twin sister Mirage, she's both strong and sociable. She accompanies Mirage to protect her as her guardian, as Mirage learned that the developer behind Chrono World is acting on a suspicious conspiracy.
[*]Paired Weapon: Devastator
[*]Exclusive Skill: Troubleshooter - In Zombie Scenario, can use a skill that increases defense for herself and allies. If she or allies are hit while the skill is active, her attack power will be increased, up to 3 times.
[*]+10% EXP/Points
[*]In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes.
[*]Adds 1 initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
[*]Displays your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
[*]Upon killing an enemy, leaves a unique mark at the target location.[/list]
[b]Mirage (CT)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0e4b96bfb21b993b1939b4ca9473fa8e9858b57f.png[/img]
[list][*]A famous virtual streamer on the VR platform Chrono World, but in reality a skilled hacker. She projects a lively persona online, but is shy and timid offline. She stumbled upon and discovered suspicious records on Chrono World. Mirage is trying to escape enemies targeting her for the information, and trying to get in contact with the Aegis Institute.
[*]Paired Weapon: Satellite Mine
[*]Exclusive Skill: Defense Code - In Zombie Scenario, can use an active skill that temporarily protects herself and allies.
[*]+10% EXP/Points
[*]In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes.
[*]Adds 1 initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
[*]Displays your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
[*]Upon killing an enemy, leaves a unique mark at the target location.[/list]
[b]New Transcendence Class Rates[/b]
[list][*]From Class Decoders - Anemone: 0.5%/Mirage: 0.5% 
[*]From Premium Class Decoders - Anemone: 2.0%/Mirage: 2.0%[/list]
[b]Decoders Sold [/b]
[list][*]Class Decoders are on permanent sale. The following bundles are available at a discount:
- Class Decoder x10 (3% discount)
- Class Decoder x30 (5% discount)
[*]Premium Class Decoders are on sale from 7/14 until 8/11. The following bundles are available at a discount:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/6a3e4446b337d7c61aae04c6cbba707ff1af81ed.png[/img]

[*]Class Decoders are permanently on sale and will not be removed.[/list]

[u][h3]Anemone/Mirage Guaranteed Giveaway (7/14 - 8/11)[/h3][/u]Points are earned based on the number of Class/Premium Class Decoders used. Upon reaching the point milestone, you will automatically receive the class and its exclusive costume!

[b]Earn Guaranteed Points when you use Class and Premium Class Decoders during the event. [/b]

notes.title: [Notice] Regarding Restrictive Access in Certain Countries
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b6f7445dbfb588ce0bfa03b6731e7439cd7ae329.jpg[/img]

[b]Dear Survivors,[/b]

In order to comply with local regulations, CSNS players located in Belgium, Slovakia, and Netherlands will have certain restrictions to purchasable items and access to in-game systems as of June 30th, 2021. Please check below for more details to the countries that follow and its restrictions that will take into effect.

[h3][Countries & Restrictions That Follow][/h3]

[u][b]Belgium & Slovakia[/b][/u][list][*]Starting June 30th, 2021, players from Belgium and Slovakia will be unable to purchase Decoders from the Shop. (However, you may use the Decoders you have previously purchased stored in your Inventory.)
List of Decoders:
- Transcendence Premium Decoders
- Transcendence Decoders
- Premium Class Decoders
- Class Decoders
- Unique Premium Decoders
- Unique Decoders
- Epic Decoders
[*]The Bonus Disassembly System will be terminated for further use.[/list]
[u][b]Netherlands[/b][/u][list][*]The Mileage Auction System will be terminated for further use.[/list]
We apologize for the discontinuation for these 3 countries and hope for your kind understanding regarding the measures above due to compliance of each region’s regulations.

Thank you always for your love and support and please reach out to our [url=https://support-counterstrike.nexon.net/hc/en-us]CS Team[/url] if you have any further questions.

Best Regards,
The CSNS Team

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: June 16th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/6b298765e499143705c277b54382abddbf0a47a9.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!
[list][b]Content: New Studio Map[/b]
We invite you to a battle for survival between zombies and humans in a medieval fortress!

[b]Content: Studio Block Update[/b]
New Middle Ages-themed decorations and device blocks have been added to Studio and Hide and Seek!
	
[b]Content: Zombie Update[/b]
Check out Zombie Mode balance changes and updated Zombie Z Mode weapon unlock levels.

[b]Promotion: New Transcendence Weapon "Devastator"[/b]
This new Transcendence Weapon is a heavy machine gun that uses .50 incendiary ammo. Its back-mounted magazine allows it to unleash an immense amount of firepower. Get it from the Transcendence Premium Decoder today![/list]Check out the Details section below for more information.


[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]
 
[h2][New Contents][/h2]

[u][h3]New Studio Map Information[/h3][/u]
[b]Medieval Fort[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e4146d47c7415de1d7d2d4d4f46ab2d69315768d.png[/img] 
[list][*]A battle for survival between zombies and humans begins in this fortress from the Middle Ages. This map is a Studio Zombie Hero mode set in a Medieval Fort.[/list]

[u][h3]Studio Block Update[/h3][/u][b]New Middle Ages-themed decorations and device blocks have been added.[/b][list][*]You can find them in Studio and Hide and Seek.[/list]

[u][h3]Zombie Content Update[/h3][/u][b]1. Zombie Z Mode Unlock Level Adjustment[/b]
[list][*]Stun Rifle: 8 -> 10
[*]Stamper: 7 -> 8
[*]SKULL-5: 5 -> 3
[*]Ripper: 9 -> 8
[*]Tiamat MK-3: 8 -> 10
[*]Magnum Drill: 14 -> 13
[*]Poison Launcher: 8 -> 6
[*]Bear Fury Mk. 3: 24 -> 26
[*]Stinger: 24 -> 18
[*]Blistering Bolt Repeater: 26 -> 24
[*]M249 Phoenix: 21 -> 20
[*]Bouncer: 12 -> 10
[*]Blade Runebreaker: 18 -> 20
[*]Infinity Laser Fist: 22 -> 24
[*]Eternity Laser Fist: 22 -> 24
[*]Star Chaser SR: 18 -> 16
[*]Shining Heart Rod: 20 -> 18
[*]Starlight Rolling Shooter: 22 -> 24[/list]
[b]2. Zombie Mode Balance Changes[/b][list][*]When creating a Zombie Mode room, Remove Zombie Permanent Death is activated by default.
[*]Stat bonuses from Zombie limits have been adjusted.
[*]Individual Limit
  - 1 limit (HP and Armor: 0 / Damage Taken: 0 / Auto Recovery: 0)
  - 2 limits (HP and Armor: +1000 -> 0 / Damage Taken: 0 / Auto Recovery: +50 -> 0)
  - 3 limits (HP and Armor: +2000 -> +500 / Damage Taken: -3% -> 0 / Auto Recovery: +100 -> +50)
  - 4 limits (HP and Armor: +3000 -> +1,000 / Damage Taken: -10% -> -5% / Auto Recovery: +300 -> +100)
[*]Round Limit
  - When only Normal Zombies are available after using all zombies (HP and Armor: +3,000 -> +1,000 / Damage Taken: -10% -> -5% / Auto Recovery: +300 -> +100)
[*]In Zombie Z Mode, HP and Armor increases from the Zombie Limit is based on the player's level. (If you limit 4 zombies, it's +900 -> +300 at level 1 in Zombie Z Mode.)[/list]



[h2]New Events[/h2]

[u][h3]Transcendence Chest Giveaway (6/16 - 6/30)[/h3][/u]You can get daily/cumulative rewards for completing the following missions during the event!

[b]Daily Rewards (Can complete each only once a day)[/b][list][*]Reach 10 minutes of playtime: Transcendence Chest x1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ccd43b707d7645dc0ad51d6d4e95d5ddd05a57cd.jpg[/img]
[*]Reach 30 minutes of playtime: Transcendence Chest x1
[*]Reach 60 minutes of playtime: Transcendence Chest x1 + CSN:S Event Ticket x1 (once a day)

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: June 2nd
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1add221aa9ac372e3f511e3eacb150a0194ef419.jpg[/img]

New Content and Events have been added!


[h2]New Contents[/h2]

[h3]New Map Information[/h3]
[b]CSN:S Land[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e38d78967ed844c617eca6f5c5ee30d3b504480c.png[/img][list][*]This abandoned amusement park, on the outskirts of the city, serves as a training course for infiltration and defense.[/list]

[h3]4 More Enhancement Weapons Can Now Reach +5[/h3]
[b]These four customizable weapons can now reach +5:[/b][list][*]Flame Jackhammer (Shotgun)
[*]Rail Buster (Equipment)
[*]Tornado (Rifle)
[*]Hunter-Killer X-15 (Rifle)[/list]

[h3]THANATOS IS BACK Balance Reverted[/h3]Following the end of the THANATOS IS BACK event (4/22-5/20), the weapon balance has been reverted to its pre-event levels.

[b]Details of the Reversion[/b][list][*]Weapon of the Month effect reversion: Reverted weapon damage in Zombie/Zombie Scenario modes, which was increased during the event period.
[*]Zombie Z level reversion: Reverted the unlock level, which was increased as below during the event period.

[*]THANATOS-5: Lv. 20 -> Lv. 6
[*]THANATOS-7: Lv. 20 -> Lv. 18
[*]THANATOS-9: Lv. 20 -> Lv. 18
[*]THANATOS-11: Lv. 20 -> Lv. 6[/list]

[h3]Decoder Item Update Information[/h3]

  + Compound Bow
  + Star Chaser AR
  + Bouncer
  + Stun Rifle[/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*]The changes for each group also apply to durational weapon items.[/list]


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[h3]CSN:S Land Map Play Event 1 (6/2 - 6/16)[/h3]During this event, the supply boxes in Zombie Hero/Zombie Z/Zombie Evolution Modes will be changed to CSN:S Land Supply Boxes. Based on the total number of CSN:S Land Supply Boxes you use, you can earn various rewards.

[b]Every time you use 1 CSN:S Land Supply Box, you will accumulate 1 CSN:S Land Supply Box in your inventory. You can accumulate up to 10 a day.
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/efa2aa8be6d216d2c8ccd7fd5af8a6ccc5dfb59c.png[/img]

[b]CSN:S Land Supply Box Accumulation and Rewards:[/b][list][*]10 gift boxes: Enhanced Weapon Selection Box x1 + 3,000 mileage
[*]20 gift boxes: Unique Decoder x5
[*]30 gift boxes: Unique Premium Decoder x1
[*]40 gift boxes: Transcendence Decoder x3
[*]50 gift boxes: Event Decoder x10 + Rare Decoder x10
[*]60 gift boxes: Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon (100) x2
[*]70 gift boxes: Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon (200) x2
[*]80 gift boxes: Enhanced Weapon Selection Box x1 + 3,000 mileage
[*]90 gift boxes: Unique Decoder x5
[*]100 gift boxes: Unique Premium Decoder x1
[*]110 gift boxes: Transcendence Decoder x3
[*]120 gift boxes: Event Decoder x10 + Rare Decoder x10

[b]Mission Achievement Rewards[/b][list][*]CSN:S Land Supply Box x1

[h3]Lightning Fury Resale Event (6/2 - 6/16)[/h3]Lightning Fury and Blue Storm may appear as special items from the Transcendence Premium Decoder/Transcendence Decoder!

[*]Transcendence Decoders will not be removed.[/list]

[h3]Lightning Fury Guaranteed Giveaway (6/2 - 6/16)[/h3]Get Guaranteed Points when you use decoders during the event.

[b]Event Objectives[/b][list][*]Earn 6 Guaranteed Points each time you use 1 Transcendence Premium Decoder.
[*]Earn 1 Guaranteed Point each time you use 1 Transcendence Decoder.[/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: May 20th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/eb469470628f3c82204ab355b75b2077542468b5.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=Xr5SURj6AhY;full][/previewyoutube]
Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!
[list][b]Content: Season 9: Fantasy World[/b]
In CSN:S' ninth season, fantasy world we invite you to explore a fantasy world full of adventures!

[b]Content: League Season 5[/b]
The official league returns for a brand new season, Season 5!
	
[b]Content: Zombie Content Update[/b]
From the revamped Zombie Limit option to the updated Lobby UI, check out these new changes!

[b]Content: Inventory Improvement[/b]
The inventory system has been improved tooltips to extra information![/list]Check out the Details section below for details.



[h1]Details[/h1]

[h2]New Contents[/h2]

[u][h3]Season 9: Fantasy World[/h3][/u]In CSN:S' ninth season, fantasy world we invite you to explore a fantasy world full of adventures!

[b]1. Season Pass Changes[/b][list][*]Season Pass Reward Revamp
  - Starting with Season 9, Season Pass rewards have been revamped.
  - You'll now receive rewards for each rank of the Free Pass. For details, please refer to the reward table below.
  - You can now check the remaining uses and duration of reward items from the Season Pass reward screen.
[*]Black Market Early Access
  - Starting with Season 9, the Black Market will open early for players who reach Rank 100.
  - When you reach Rank 100 on the current Season Pass, the Season Missions will terminate, and you'll get access to new missions rewarding Black Market Badges.
  - You can access the Black Market from the [Mission] menu. Those who have not reached Rank 100 can only use the Black Market during the off-season.
  - All Black Market Badges you've obtained will vanish when a new season begins.[/list]
[b]2. Season Information[/b][list][*]A 'season' is a reward system that runs for a set period of time. Complete missions and events during a Season to earn Season Badges which raise your Season Rank. You'll receive rewards based on your rank throughout the season.[/list]
[b]3. Season Rank[/b][list][*]Season Ranks indicate how much progress players have made participating in missions and events in the game. You'll earn various rare rewards when you increase your Season Rank. Season Rank and Season Badges are specific to their respective season.[/list]
[b]4. Season Rewards[/b][list][*]Rewards are immediately distributed as you achieve new ranks each season.
[*]If you purchase a Season Pass, you'll get the Season Pass rewards in addition to the free rewards.
[*]Starting with the Season 9 Pass, season rewards will no longer be limited-time items.
[*]Growing Weapons: When you receive a weapon's new stage (from 1-4), you will get to keep the previous stage of the weapon.
  - 1. Wind Tracker: Season 9 Reward Weapon - Growing Weapon Stage 1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a73f78f8a53a0b5d362ba2042b851a40d87bd5a4.png[/img]
This rifle is enchanted with wind magic. While looking through the sniper scope, you can lock onto an enemy, then fire 2 guided wind missiles upon exiting the scope view.

  - 2. Fire Tracker: Season 9 Reward Weapon - Growing Weapon Stage 2 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/28e92ee4d1a9ce5872c14e429458395e499048f1.png[/img]
This rifle is enchanted with fire magic. While looking through the sniper scope, you can lock onto an enemy, then fire 4 guided flame missiles when you leave sniper mode.

  - 3. Lighting Tracker: Season 9 Reward Weapon - Growing Weapon Stage 3 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c034f842dc932684cd6a5e92e48fdf0886f21411.png[/img]
This rifle is enchanted with lightning magic. While looking through the sniper scope, you can lock onto an enemy, then fire 6 guided lightning missiles upon exiting the scope view.

  - 4. Elemental Tracker: Season 9 Reward Weapon - Growing Weapon Stage 4 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/7bfd9f17483da540c2297f5168bf329e9767a6a9.png[/img]
This rifle is enchanted with the magic of multiple elements. While looking through the sniper scope, you can lock onto an enemy, then fire 10 guided elemental missiles upon exiting the scope view. Press the Forward Arrow Key twice while holding down the Shift Key to change elements.

[*]Zombie Costumes
  - 1. Orc Warrior Deimos: Season 9 Reward Zombie Skin 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a21d38e457eba366f9c91f483b977f7f9c1e9a12.png[/img]
Allows you to change the appearance of your Deimos Zombie to that of an Orc Warrior.

  - 2. Dark Elf Witch Banshee: Season 9 Reward Zombie Skin 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5cc49339ba5506a31cf97ecf870dfd1d2da9bbbb.png[/img]
Allows you to change the appearance of your Banshee Zombie to that of a Dark Elf Witch.

[*]Weapon Paints
  - 1. Dragon Knight Weapon Paint (Desert Eagle Crimson Hunter, Rail Cannon, SG550 Commando, Warhammer Storm Giant, Air Buster) 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/eca55e8b6fd31e3e5a9c89e729de8e9fcb5c405a.png[/img]
The 5 Season 9 Reward Weapon Skins

  - 2. High Elf Weapon Paint (Desert Eagle, Hunter-Killer X-12, Broad Divine, Vendetta, Spell Lance Scarlet Rose) 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b6ad87a1b1a2d8841b126bd8ed66096cbc17b94b.png[/img]
The 5 Season 9 Reward Weapon Skins

[*]Costumes
  - 1. Dragon Knight Helmet, Seelie Tiara, Dragon Wings, Seelie Wings, Dragon Pet, and Forest Sprite

[u][h3]League Season 5[/h3][/u]
[b]1. League Season 5: The official league has reopened for Season 5.[/b]

[b]2. Changes (Compared to previous trial leagues)[/b][list][*]As we enter the new league period, the scores required to advance to each rank are changing.
  - Master: Top 100 players -> No Change
  - Diamond: 2700 -> 4000
  - Platinum: 1500 -> 2000
  - Gold: 750 -> 1000
  - Silver: 300 -> No Change
[*]The following previous league rewards were limited to the previous season, and will be removed. Achievement Point Box items will be added to the league rewards.
  - Zombie League Nameplate/Zombie League Spray
[*]Items have been added to the Achievement Shop.
  - 4 new nameplate items added: (Venom Sting Nameplate, Cluckin' Chicken Nameplate, (Animated) Pursuit Nameplate, and Violet Spot Nameplate)
[*]When handling individuals who have tied for league points, the first player to reach that point total will now take precedence. This may affect the overall rankings.
[*]It is no longer possible to get Zombie Scenario League Points from the following maps:
  - Double Gate, Lost City, Survival: Trap, and Survival: Groundwater
[*]Starting with the new official league, a "rest" period will be added after each league ends, as is currently the case with seasons.[/list]
[b]3. The League Fairness Monitoring System has been implemented[/b][list][*]A monitoring system has been implemented that checks in real-time for behaviors deemed atypical of normal gameplay. A penalty will be applied to obtaining Points and EXP (including League Points) for repeat offenders.
[*]You can now view your league status under My Info.
[*]You can now review the score and weapon loadouts for the top 500 players in the Hall of Fame.
[*]League Ranks: Master > Diamond > Platinum > Gold > Silver > Bronze
[*]* Master Rank can only be achieved through competition. You may drop down to Diamond Rank when competing within Master Rank.
[*]* There are no player count restrictions for obtaining League Points, however you will receive greater bonuses when playing with more people.
[*]* You cannot obtain League Points in private rooms with a password set.
[*]* You cannot obtain League Points if abnormal activity or cheating is detected, such as:
  - Inactivity and non-participation, as well as for killing or infecting inactive players.
  - Abnormal activity pertaining to Studio devices or map structures.[/list]
[b]4. Zombie League Rewards[/b][list][*]Master: Zombie League Master Zombification + Holy Sword Divine Order (20 Days) + Kalael (20 Days) + Medea (20 Days)
[*]Diamond: Achievement Point Box x2 + Lightning Fury (20 Days) + Private Erica (20 Days) + Female Student Light Zombie (20 Days)
[*]Platinum: Achievement Point Box x1 + Psychic Harmonium (20 Days) + Nurse Venom Sting (20 Days)
[*]Gold: Dual Beretta Gunslinger (20 Days) + Mummy Stamper (20 Days)
[*]Silver: VIP Free Pass (20 Days) + Chef Heavy Zombie (20 Days)
[*]Bronze: None
[*]Notice:
  - Zombie League Master Zombification: Changes the revival effect when you revive as a zombie in Zombie Mode. It is removed when the season ends or your rank drops.
  - The zombification is distributed to those of Master Rank, and is removed if your rank drops or the season ends.[/list]
[b]5. Zombie Scenario League Rewards[/b][list[[*]Master: Holy Sword Divine Order (20 Days) + Titan's Will Add-On x100 + Grade 6 Parts Reward Box x3
[*]Diamond: Achievement Point Box x2 + Lightning Fury (20 Days) + Weakness Analysis Add-On x75 + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5
[*]Platinum: Achievement Point Box x1 + Psychic Harmonium (20 Days) + Tide Turner Add-On x50 + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x10
[*]Gold: Dual Beretta Gunslinger (20 Days) + Reinforced Attack Add-On x20
[*]Silver: VIP Free Pass (20 Days) + Capital Add-On x20
[*]Bronze: None[/list]
[b]6. Achievement Shop: Added 4 new nameplate items as achievement products[/b][list][*]Venom Sting Nameplate: Customizes how your name appears in the match lobby.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/55c26e693e46b5595164e98dddc486472711fc7e.png[/img]

[u][h3]Zombie Content Update[/h3][/u]
[b]1. Zombie Limit option update[/b][list][*]New limit option added: Aside from Normal Zombies, each Zombie can be used only once per round per player. If only Normal Zombies are remain as available zombies, their HP, Armor, Defense, and HP Recovery will increase.
  - HP and Armor: +3000/Defense: +10%/HP Recovery: +300
[*]Individual zombie limit changed: Increased the max number of individual zombie limits to 4. If you set individual zombie limits, the HP, Armor, Defense, and HP Recovery of all zombies will increase in proportion to the maximum number of zombies.
  - 1 limit: HP and Armor: +0/Defense: +0/HP Recovery: +0
  - 2 limits: HP and Armor: +1000/Defense: +0/HP Recovery: +50
  - 3 limits: HP and Armor: +2000/Defense: +3%/HP Recovery: +100
  - 4 limits: HP and Armor: +3000/Defense: +5%/HP Recovery: +200[/list]
[b]2. Zombie Karma update[/b][list][*]Zombie Stage 2 Karma: Upon using Karma, immediately transforms into a hero zombie class and becomes invincible for 6 sec.
[*]Zombie Stage 3 Karma: Upon using Karma, die and then revive as human after 3 sec. Can only be used after virus detoxification. (If all zombies revive as humans, the round ends in a Human Team victory.)[/list]
[b]3. Zombie balance update (skill update)[/b][list][*]Normal Zombie: Damage taken during Berserk reduced from 150% → 140%
[*]Deimos: Shock cooldown increased from 12 sec -> 15 sec
[*]Metatron: Movement Speed increases by 10% while using Immortality
[*]Psycho: Smokescreen's damage reduction amount reduced from 75% → 65%; Smokescreen cooldown increased from 15 sec → 20 sec; duration per each Smokescreen increased from 1.5 sec → 2 sec
[*]Jiangshi: Invincibility duration reduced from 5 sec → 4sec; invincibility cooldown increased from 15 sec → 18 sec
[*]Aksha: Absorb cooldown reduced from 20 sec → 16 sec, Knockback Resistance slightly increased
[*]Chaser: Defense slightly increased
[*]Rusty Wing: Defense slightly decreased [/list]
[b]4. Zombie Z Content[/b][list][*]If the Zombie Limit is set to Normal Zombies only, the Adaptability mutation will not appear.
[*]Fixed mutation added: Adaptability will be fixed as the 26th mutation given. (If the Zombie Limit is set to Normal Zombies only, you will get a different mutation.)
[*]Mutation Changes
  - Contact Infection: Changed so that the damage inflicted is in proportion to the max HP of the targeted human player
  - Endurance: Changed the default activation rate from 1% → 1.5%
  - Armored Advance: Defense increase per round - 1.5% → 1%
  - Speedy Crouch: Default Movement Speed increase - 50 → 40; Movement Speed increase per round - 5 → 6[/list]
[b]5. Lobby UI change[/b][list][*]With the Zombie Limit change, the limit setting UI has been updated.
[*]The "Death>Kill Rule" option has been moved under Extra Room Settings.
[*]The "Remove Zombie Permanent Death" option has been moved under the room settings.[/list]

[u][h3]Inventory Improvement[/h3][/u]
[b]1. Inventory Information[/b][list][*]You can now see information pertaining to the remaining slots in your inventory.
[*]The slot information displayed will not include inventory information that the player cannot manage directly, such as for PC cafe or VIP pass.
[*]From the inventory's model view, can now toggle the UI on/off by right-clicking the mouse icon on the top right of the model view.
[*]* There may be instances where Default items do not take up inventory slots, depending on how they are distributed. There may also be cases where items are distributed on the system level but do not appear in the inventory. Thus, the actual number of slots available differ slightly from what is displayed.[/list]
[b]2. Disassembly Information[/b][list][*]When you disassemble items in the disassembly page, icons will show which inventories are affected.
[*]Icon information: Weapons, Parts, Craft, Classes, Costumes, and Items
[*]The number of items you can disassemble at once has been increased from 9 to 99.
[*]A filter feature that allows you to check per each inventory category will be provided on the right of Select Items for Disassembly.
[*]* However, since there are minimum disassembly requirements, you can only change to quantities designated for each item.
[*]You can also batch-apply with Ctrl + drag or Ctrl + double-click.[/list]
[b]3. Pop-Up Information[/b][list][*]Added a feature to display icons in the Item Acquired pop-up, so that you know which inventory you need to make space in. You can see which inventory it will apply towards when your inventory is full.[/list]

[u][h3]Season Pass Reward Renewal[/h3][/u]Starting from Season 9, the Season Pass rewards and distribution method have been revised!

[b]Season Pass Reward Distribution Changes[/b][list][*]Distribution method changed from Season Random Box -> guaranteed item (individual item)
[*]Distribution method changed from Grades 3-4 Parts Random Boxes -> guaranteed item (individual item) sorted in the order of high player preference
[*]Distribution method changed from Grade 5 Parts Random Box -> guaranteed item (individual item) sorted in the order of release date
[*]The Mileage Box is a fixed reward, kept the same as before.[/list]


[h2]Events[/h2]

[u][h3][Trial] League 4 Wrap-Up (5/20 - Permanent)[/h3][/u]We will give league medals to players who maintain Master/Diamond ranks at the time the [Trial] Zombie League Season 4 ends.

[b]Medals Available[/b][list][*]Master League: Awarded upon ending the [Trial] Zombie League Season 4 in Master Rank.
[*]Diamond League: Awarded upon ending [Trial] Zombie League Season 4 in Diamond Rank.[/list]

[u][h3]League Season 5 Participation Event (5/20 - 6/2)[/h3][/u]If you reach Silver Rank or higher during the league period, you will be eligible to win a raffle reward!

[b]Distribution Criteria[/b][list][*]Reward distributed via raffle between players who reached Silver Rank
[*]Reward distributed via raffle between players who reached Gold Rank[/list]
[b]Rewards[/b][list][*]Silver Rank Reward: 50,000 mileage (200 players)
[*]Gold Rank Reward: Transcendence Decoder x10 (100 players)[/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*]You cannot more than one raffle.
[*]All rewards are distributed during the maintenance on Wednesday, June 2nd.[/list]

[u][h3]Daily (Monday - Sunday) Login Enhanced Event (5/20 - 6/2)[/h3][/u]You will get a reward every time you reach 10, 40, and 60 minutes of playtime each day during the event.

[b]Rewards[/b][list][*]10 minutes: Event Reward Box x1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/6ed3741a2cb3d349549b33f9555f36fe7e26a095.png[/img]

[*]40 minutes: Event Reward Box x1
[*]60 minutes: Event Reward Box x1
[*](In Zombie Hero/Zombie Z/Zombie Evolution) score 5 zombie kills/human infections (excluding bots): Event Reward Box x1
[*]Clear a Zombie Scenario map on Normal or higher difficulty: Event Reward Box x1[/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*]You can participate in rooms with 4 or more players
[*]Time spent in Studio Mode does not count.
[*]Rewards can be obtained only once per account.
[*]Unused Event Reward Box items will be removed during maintenance on Wednesday, June 2nd.
[*]Event resets every day at midnight (24:00).[/list]

[u][h3]Weekend (Friday - Sunday) Login Enhanced Event (5/20 - 6/16)[/h3][/u]You will receive rewards when you meet each event condition on Friday-Sunday during the event!

[b]Conditions[/b][list][*]Upon logging in on Friday-Sunday, you'll receive your choice of reward (claiming is limited to once a day).
[*]Each week, when you log in on Friday-Sunday + reach 60 minutes of playtime, it is counted as 1 milestone completed. You will receive rewards based on the total number of millstone completions every week.
[*]Completion count resets each week.
  - Upon reaching 1 total completion for the week: Transcendence Decoder x1 + 1 of the 10 Season 9 paintable weapons (different chance to receive each weapon) 
  - Upon reaching 2 total completions for the week: Transcendence Decoder x1 + Dragon Knight Kyrix (3 Days)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e5e1342c95c4f78f1fcd803e65b4c78afa1999d9.png[/img]

  - Upon reaching 3 total completions for the week: Transcendence Decoder x2 + High Elf Natasha (3 Days)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/41f645b8fd6a976aa9c6cb6951f0082d74079b7d.png[/img][/list]
[b]Event Dates[/b][list][*]5/21 (Fri.) - 5/23 (Sun.): Week 1 weekend 
[*]5/28 (Fri.) - 5/30 (Sun.): Week 2 weekend 
[*]6/4 (Fri.) - 6/6 (Sun.): Week 3 weekend
[*]6/11 (Fri.) - 6/13 (Sun.): Week 4 weekend[/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*]Only rooms with four or more players contribute to this milestone.
[*]Studio Mode ganes contribute toward this milestone. 
[*]Rewards can be obtained only once per account.[/list]

[u][h3]Free Daily Rewards Event (5/20 - 6/16)[/h3][/u]Join the battle every day to get rewards, get rewards for obtaining rewards, and get even more event rewards on top of that!

[b]Daily Rewards[/b][list][*]Daily Weapons Supply
  - Contents: 2 Transcendence Weapons (1 Day) and 1 Daily Attendance Reward Box[/list]
[b]Cumulative Rewards[/b][list][*]5 Days: M3 Black Dragon (5 Days) 
[*]10 Days: M3 Black Dragon (10 Days) 
[*]15 Days: Magnum Launcher (5 Days)
[*]20 Days: Magnum Launcher (15 Days)
[*]25 Days: Gungnir (5 Days)[/list]
[b]Extra Cumulative Rewards Event[/b][list][*]Each time you earn cumulative rewards (at 5/10/15/20/25 days), you'll receive a Cumulative Attendance Reward Box.[/list]

[u][h3]Season Badge Giveaway (5/20 - 8/11)[/h3][/u]During the season, you will receive Season Badges when you meet the login time requirements under Daily Missions!

[b]Reward Obtained per Condition[/b][list][*]Upon reaching 30 minutes of login time: Season Badge x5
[*]Upon reaching 1 hour of login time: Season Badge x10
[*]Upon reaching 2 hours of login time: Season Badge x20[/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*]Mission resets every day at midnight.
[*]An existing event, where you would receive a total of 30 Season Badges a day at every 30 minutes of login time, is moved and run under the Daily Mission system.
[*]You cannot use the difficulty change item on the event mission.[/list]

[u][h3]Zombie Scenario Golden Zombie Kill Reward Update (5/20 - 8/11)[/h3][/u]You will receive rewards by killing the Golden Zombie, which appears randomly when you play Zombie Scenario during the event! (Hitting the Golden Zombie once counts as killing it once.)

[b]Reward Given per Kill[/b][list][*]1 Kill: AK-47 Paladin
[*]2 Kills: M4A1 Dark Knight
[*]3 Kills: Lycanthrope
[*]5 Kills: Python Desperado
[*]7 Kills: Red Dragon Cannon
[*]10 Kills: AUG Guardian[/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*]You can only get credit for 3 kills per day.
[*]Each reward is given only once per account.
[*]The Golden Zombies randomly appear after playing for more than 3 minutes in rooms at regular difficulty or higher.[/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: April 21st
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/dc3fa6b220d44444e64bf5c917891a44d61d82eb.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!
[list][b]Content: Daily Mission Revamp[/b]
Daily Missions have been simplified and the Black Market is now available during the off-season!

[b]Content: Additional Zombie Scenario Improvements[/b]
Zombie Scenario is back with even more improvements.
	
[b]Content: Abyss Difficulty in Zombie Scenario Maps[/b]
Introducing an even new level of difficulty: Abyss! Monsters are tougher, stronger, and faster. Are you up to the challenge?

[b]Promotion: New Transcendence Class Promotion (4/21 - 6/2)[/b]
Meet the 2 new classes now available from Class/Premium Class Decoders![/list]Check out the Details section below for details.



[h1]Expanded Info[/h1]
 
[h2]New Contents[/h2]

[u][h3]Daily Mission Revamp[/h3][/u]Daily Missions have been simplified and the Black Market is now available during the off-season! For more details, please refer to the Daily Mission Revamp Preview.

[b]There are now 3 types of Daily Missions.[/b][list][*]Instead of choosing from many missions, now you just need to complete the 3 set missions.
[*]Daily Missions won't reset until you've completed them.
[*]Completed Daily Missions reset every day at midnight.[/list]
[b]Significant changes have been made to the Reset Daily Mission items.[/b][list][*]This item has been renamed to Daily Mission Difficulty Change.
[*]Using a Daily Mission Difficulty Change allows you to change a mission to high, normal, or low difficulty.
[*]When you change a mission's difficulty, you'll keep any progress you've already made. Use this when the going gets tough![/list]
[b]The Black Market is open for business.[/b][list][*]Before each new season begins, the Black Market will be open.
[*]Get Black Market Badges from Daily Missions and use them to buy items.

[*]Black Market Badge
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/34ae41fa94bd08003dbb24f671b9ab27416f512f.png[/img]
  - Type: Item
  - Description: Collect these badges and exchange them for items from the Black Market.
  - All Black Market Badges will disappear when a new season starts.

[*]CSN:S Brand Backpack
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c23595142ef1a9cb079dfbacc5c99da57630b881.png[/img]
  - Type: Costume
  - Description: A CSN:S brand backpack. Can be equipped on the back.

[*]Black Market Items
  - Red Baron Weapon Paint (Permanent): Black Market Badge x300
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1362c3f79e90de84f5e60b30c6631904bf75a13b.png[/img]
  - CSN:S Brand Backpack: Black Market Badge x300
  - Spring Flower Nameplate (3 Days): Black Market Badge x90
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5faec65b72a08a28fa360fcb7a1f90fd124390ef.png[/img]
  - Spring Flower Font (1 Day): Black Market Badge x30
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/bda72203caacc3d55bd399b4d570bf406cfa4f63.png[/img]
  - Lusty Rose (5 Days): Black Market Badge x30
  - SAF Scout (5 Days): Black Market Badge x30
  - Dragon Tattoo (5 Days): Black Market Badge x30
  - Tiger Tattoo (5 Days): Black Market Badge x30
  - Daily Missions will award Season Badges during a season and Black Market Badges during the off-season![/list]

[u][h3]Additional Zombie Scenario Improvements 2[/h3][/u]
[b]New Add-Ons and Balance Changes[/b][list][*]New Add-Ons
  - Veteran's Help: When you equip this Add-On and drop a weapon on the ground on Very Hard or higher difficulty, the weapon will remain on the ground without disappearing. Only up to 1 weapon will remain.
  - Deft Movement: Grants a chance not to take damage when hit by an attack.
  - Abundant Returns: Obtain 1 additional Add-On after defeating elite monsters.
  - Healer: Whenever you heal yourself, nearby allies are also healed for a portion of the healing effect's value.
  - Revenger: Increases attack power each time an ally dies.
  - Group Tactics: Reduces damage taken for each nearby ally player.
  - Steel Physique: Increases maximum HP.

[*]Add-On Balance Changes
  - Ammo Reserves - Activation Rate: 5% → 7%
  - Reinforced Attack - Base Damage: 120 → 100
  - Quick Rejoining - Cooldown Reduction: 12% → 15%
  - Addict - Cooldown Reduction: 6 sec → 10 sec
  - Nouveau Riche - Base Dollar Obtained Increase: 150% → 200%
  - Trap Evasion - Activation Rate: 25% → 30%
  - Giant's Feet - Base Damage: 250 → 300

[*]Map Playlist Automatic Add-On Feature
  - When the map changes while you play a Map Playlist, your most recent Add-Ons will keep being used repeatedly until the Map Playlist ends. If you use up all of an Add-On in the middle of a Map Playlist, the other Add-Ons that you haven't used up will continue to be used.[/list]
[b]Elite Monster Balance Changes[/b][list][*]Monster Stat/Enhancement Effect Balance Adjustments
  - Attack Power Increase: Reduced the amount this increases the monster's attack power.
  - Spider Web: Weakened the movement speed reduction.[/list]

[u][h3]New Abyss Difficulty in Zombie Scenario[/h3][/u]
[b]New Zombie Scenario Difficulty Added[/b][list][*]Added the Abyss difficulty.
[*]Abyss is an even higher difficulty than the existing Inferno difficulty. Monsters will have greater attack power, HP, speed, etc.[/list]
[b]Information on Abyss Difficulty Map[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e29eccafdb7c522187a06e4f63c83a15a31addf9.png[/img]
[list][*]Abyss 1 - First Contact
[*]With the addition of Abyss, Inferno difficulty will be available in all existing maps. You can see what difficulties are available in map selection.
[*]We plan to regularly add Abyss difficulty to more maps in the future.[/list]
[b]Inferno Difficulty Expanded[/b][list][*]Inferno difficulty, which was previously provided only for a limited number of maps, has been added to be playable on all maps. [/list]

[u][h3]Zombie Mode Update[/h3][/u]
[b]Season 8 Content Changes[/b][list][*]Zombie Boost Items Removed
  - Power-ups will no longer appear when a zombie dies.
[*]Revenge Bonus System Changes
  - Previous: You receive bonus points upon taking revenge.
  - Updated: You receive bonus Karma upon taking revenge.[/list]
[b]Unlock Level Changes[/b][list][*]Rail Buster: 2 -> 3
[*]TURBULENT-1: 6 -> 5
[*]SKULL-3: 3 -> 2
[*]TURBULENT-9: 6 -> 5
[*]Ethereal: 2 -> 1
[*]SKULL-4: 8 -> 5
[*]Dual UZI: 6 -> 5
[*]Awakening of the Zhu Bajie Minigun: 3 -> 1
[*]SPAS-12: 3 -> 2
[*]Ripper: 10 -> 9
[*]Black Dragon Cannon: 14 -> 11
[*]Stun Rifle: 14 -> 9
[*]Desert Eagle Crimson Hunter: 16 -> 14
[*]Blade Runebreaker: 16 -> 18
[*]X-TRACKER: 20 -> 18
[*]SG552 Lycanthrope: 20 -> 18
[*]AUG Guardian: 20 -> 18
[*]Eternity Laser Fist: 24 -> 22
[*]M249 Phoenix: 24 -> 21
[*]Blotter: 22 -> 20[/list]

[u][h3]Transcendence Class Medal Giveaway (4/21 - Permanent)[/h3][/u]When you own all of the items below, you will receive the Transcendence Class Medal!

[b]Medal[/b][list][*][Honor] Otherworld Denizen
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/37351472ec9cfb152b33f1578593e51a43c30241.png[/img][/list]
[b]How to Obtain This Medal (Requires Permanent Version)[/b][list][*]Dragon Knight Kyrix
[*]High Elf Natasha
[*]Natasha's Orb
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/7111fddc59be164e0888706b305c1262e2cca7f7.png[/img]
[*]Kyrix's Dragon Knight Shield
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e46eaca4185a559e5a7a0bbe4c8abac1edbd1eb7.png[/img][/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*]Each account can receive this reward only once.[/list]


[h2]Events[/h2]

[u][h3]Class Preference Survey Event (4/21 - 5/5)[/h3][/u]We will hold a player preference survey regarding seasonal Transcendence Classes. A reward will be given to players who participate!

[b]Classes Targeted for Survey[/b][list][*]Transcendence Classes released in the past[/list]
[b]Reward[/b][list][*]Transcendence Decoder x1[/list]
[b]Survey Link[/b][list][*][url=https://forms.gle/YZvQogs9jTDMvYta7]https://forms.gle/YZvQogs9jTDMvYta7[/url][/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*]Survey participation and reward distribution is limited to once per account.
[*]Reward will be distributed during the maintenance on Thursday, May 6th.[/list]

[u][h3]Free Daily Rewards Event (4/21 - 5/19)[/h3][/u]Join the battle every day to get rewards, get rewards for getting rewards, and get even more event rewards on top of that!

[b]Daily Rewards[/b][list][*]Daily Weapons Supply
  - Contents: 2 Transcendence Weapons (1 Day) and 1 Daily Attendance Reward Box[/list]
[b]Cumulative Rewards[/b][list][*]5 Days: M3 Black Dragon (5 Days) 
[*]10 Days: M3 Black Dragon (10 Days) 
[*]15 Days: Magnum Launcher (5 Days)
[*]20 Days: Magnum Launcher (15 Days)
[*]25 Days: Gungnir (5 Days)[/list]
[b]Extra Cumulative Rewards Event[/b][list][*]Each time you get cumulative rewards (at 5/10/15/20/25 days), you'll receive a Cumulative Attendance Reward Box.[/list]

[u][h3]Off-Season Mission Rewards Event (4/21 - 5/19)[/h3][/u]Complete off-season Daily Mission during the event period and get rewards!

[b]Assignments[/b][list][*]For each day you clear 3 Daily Missions, you receive 1 Spring Flower Box.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/30b592485fcdc28751b5957064b5ef4d708022a4.png[/img]
[*]When you clear your first Daily Mission on weekends, you can choose one durational weapons and, in addition, obtain other functionality items.
  - Fridays: 4/23 and 4/30
  - Saturdays: 4/24 and 5/1
  - Sundays: 4/25 and 5/2[/list]
[b]Rewards[/b][list][*]Choose a 1-day weapon from the durational weapon list + receive all of the other items
[*]Reward can be obtained only once a day per account (Given only when you complete the Daily Mission for the first time)[/list]
[b]Notice:[/b][list][*]Unused Spring Flower Boxes will be removed with the patch on Wednesday, May 19th.
[*]Daily missions count only in rooms with 4 or more players.
[*]Rewards can be obtained only once per account.[/list]

[u][h3]Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (4/21 - 6/2)[/h3][/u]Earn Guaranteed Points when you use Class and Premium Class Decoders during the event.
[list][*]1 Guaranteed Point given each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
[*]3 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Premium Class Decoder.[/list]
[b]Rewards[/b][list][*]Upon reaching 150 points: Choose either Dragon Knight Kyrix or High Elf Natasha
[*]Upon reaching 300 points: Choose either Dragon Knight Kyrix or High Elf Natasha 
  - Upon selecting Dragon Knight Kyrix, automatically get an exclusive costume (permanent)
  - Upon selecting High Elf Natasha, automatically get an exclusive costume (permanent)[/list]
[b]Notice:[/b][list][*]The selection pop-up window displays as soon as you reach the required points.
[*]Rewards from each stage can only be claimed once per account.[/list]


[h2]Shop[/h2]

[u][h3]Transcendence Class Promotion (4/21 - 6/2)[/h3][/u]Get the 2 new classes from Class/Premium Class Decoders during the promotion! Each has a 4x drop rate!

[b]New Class Rates[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5159a8b279dc422bb7bb4308eec21abf947df32a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5508c188c09db344d83fa7580272e919b58343d3.png[/img]
[list][*]From Class Decoders - Dragon Knight Kyrix: 0.5%/High Elf Natasha: 0.5%
[*]From Premium Class Decoders - Dragon Knight Kyrix: 2.0%/High Elf Natasha: 2.0%[/list]
[b]Decoders Sold[/b][list][*]Class Decoders are on permanent sale. The following bundles are available at a discount:
  - Class Decoder x10 (3% discount)
  - Class Decoder x30 (5% discount)
[*]Premium Class Decoders are on sale from 4/21 until 6/2. The following bundles are available at a discount:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/fe922738070c97135efb99ba18ed248778fa2056.png[/img]
  - Premium Class Decoder x10 (3% discount)
  - Premium Class Decoder x30 (5% discount)
  - Premium Class Decoder x50 (10% discount)[/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*]These are classes paired with the Season 9 pass weapons.
[*]Premium Class Decoders will be sold in the Shop until maintenance on Wednesday, June 2nd.
[*]All unused Premium Class Decoders will be replaced with 50 mileage each and removed during the maintenance on Wednesday, June 2nd.
[*]Class Decoders are permanently on sale and will not be removed.[/list]


[h2]Others[/h2]
[list][*]Fixed the issue where both the Dreadnova and Dreadnova variant weapons could not directly damage zombies and other parts when using charging attacks through right-click.
[*]Fixed the problem where characters are getting stuck in the town hall map tractor
[*]Regarding Natasha Emotion: Fixed the unnatural motion as if the dance's third-person animation was a little trembling
[*]Fixed the issue where the health regeneration timers were reset for Mila and Lisa when recovering health with other health recovery means such as add-ons
[*]Fixed the issue where the scale value of the MISS indication (confirmed in the current zombie z steel skin mutation) was applied abnormally
[*]Fixed the problem that could cause a deadly crash if Kyrix's skill was activated when Brachyura or Mr.x boss died, and when there was a target that could inflict damage around it.[/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: April 7th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c9be7a350ab10a05dc7c1ffd6b84411fb218bfe8.jpg[/img]

New Events have been added!


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[h3]Spring Seed Event (4/7 - 4/21)[/h3]To celebrate spring 2021, we are running a fun and fruitful seed event! Check it out and get rewards!

[b]Seed Distribution[/b][list][*]You'll get a seed when you log in.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/dc72c557cef64a25bea00d4f43c3a0127baf8801.png[/img]
[*]After 30 minutes of playtime in Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, or Zombie Evolution, the seed will be replaced with a sprout.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1663ff2da149abb3c3940cc771fb37b4255a2604.png[/img]
[*]Once you have the sprout, complete one of the missions below and the sprout will be replaced with a fruit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ead9b4aee85513d4a6cdb1b67118a3d2ec9449d5.png[/img]
  - Score 25 zombie kills or 75 assists in Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, or Zombie Evolution
  - Clear 4 games of Zombie Scenario on Hard difficulty or higher[/list]

[b]Using the Event Items[/b][list][*]The seed, sprout, and fruit items can all be used by pressing the Use button.
[*]When you press the Use button, you will be asked if you are sure you want to use it.
[*]When you choose yes, you will receive a reward according to the item you used.
[*]The seed, sprout, and fruit give different rewards.[/list]

[b]Rewards[/b][list][*]Seed: Rare Decoder x5
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/bf53d8c148dfb1689a44d68d2c908776b9b648b9.png[/img]
[*]Sprout: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/8c5bbf8cd0ccaeae4603362f85c673ce229b6a86.png[/img]
[*]Fruit: Receive a VVIP Free Pass, Rare Decoder, Unique Decoder, Unique Premium Decoder, or Event Decoder. Each reward has a different drop rate.[/list]

[b]Extra Event[/b][list][*]Each time you use a fruit, you'll get 1 Harvested Fruit.
[*]Once you have 10 Harvested Fruits, you'll get a bonus reward.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d5271bf96b2f1e7b3d6db6cfcac4ce6bf83edb2d.png[/img][/list]
 
[b]Bonus Reward[/b][list][*]Transcendence Decoder x10
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/342e4efbb63e441b8d01e9b8dc4fb5a4784a7c42.png[/img][/list]

[b]Notice[/b][list][*]Participation will only be counted in rooms with four or more players (excludes Studio Mode).
[*]Zombie Scenario minimum playtime: 5 minutes
[*]The seed, sprout, and fruit items will be removed and the event will reset at midnight every day. Harvested Fruit will not be removed.
[*]All Harvested Fruit will be removed during the maintenance on 4/21 (Wed.).
[*]Does not count in the Zombie Scenario Survival: Double Gate, Survival: Lost City, or Survival: Trap maps.[/list]


[h3]Random Rules Zombie Hero Event (4/7 - 4/21)[/h3]During the event, experience Zombie Hero in a whole new way: the rules change every round!
[list][*]The rules will be announced 3 seconds before each round starts.
[*]You can see what rules are applied to the current round by pressing the L key.[/list]

[b]Featured Maps[/b][list][*]Random Rules Zombie Hero Assault / Italy / Dust[/list]

[b]New Random Rules[/b][list][*]I Am Legend: The last human standing revives as a powerful Hero once.
[*]Good Old Days: Humans are restricted to New Original weapons, and Zombies can only be Normal Zombies with restricted skills.
[*]Reliable Weapons: Increases attack power of Rare grade or below weapons.
[*]Burning Time: Using Deadly Shot gives infinite ammo.
[*]Furiously Fast: The Sprint skill grants increased attack power and can be reused.
[*]Skill Master: Using a human skill applies the effects of Sprint and Deadly Shot simultaneously.
[*]Biochemical Attack: Smokescreen Grenade damages zombies, and Psycho Zombie's skill damages humans.
[*]Social Behavior: When humans are gathered together, their attack power increases according to their number.[/list]

[b]Updated Random Rules[/b][list][*]Moon Bounce 
  - Previous: Low gravity mode. After jumping, you will float gently to the ground.
  - Changed: When you jump, you will have zero gravity and rise into the air.
[*]Shockwave
  - Previous: When landing after jumping, decreases movement speed of nearby humans.
  - Changed: When landing after jumping, decreases movement speed of nearby humans and restores the player's HP.
[*]Tunnel Vision
  - Previous: Have visibility reduced but attack power increased.
  - Changed: Suffer from reduced visibility but attack power and movement speed increased.
[*]Give 'em the Bird
  - Previous: Eating chicken increases attack power temporarily.
  - Changed: Eating chicken increases attack power temporarily and resets skills once.[/list]



[h2]Shop[/h2]

[h2]New Transcendence Throwable Weapon: "Satellite Mine" Promotion! (4/7 - 5/6)[/h2]The new Satellite Mine item is available as a rate-up item in Transcendence Premium Decoders and Transcendence Decoders during the promotion! Don't miss it!

[b]From Transcendence Premium Decoders:[/b][list][*]Satellite Mine - 3%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/624a2a9fa2c5220a08582b747f948f712924ef80.png[/img][/list]
 
[b]From Transcendence Decoders:[/b][list][*]Satellite Mine - 0.45%[/list]

[b]The following items are featured in the promotion:[/b][list][*]Transcendence Premium Decoder x1
[*]Transcendence Premium Decoder x5
[*]Transcendence Premium Decoder x10[/list]

[b]Notice:[/b][list][*]All Transcendence Premium Decoders will be removed during maintenance on 5/6 (Thur.).
[*]500 mileage will be given for each Transcendence Premium Decoder removed.
[*]Transcendence Decoders will not be removed.[/list]
