notes.title: [Complete] Emergency Maintenance: March 25th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9cb5778993db56529d92cc47da45330f536ed525.jpg[/img]

[i][b]2021-03-25 12:35 P.M. CET Update:[/b][list][*] The emergency maintenance for March 25th has been completed. Thank you for your patience throughout.[/list][/i]----------------------------------------

[b]Attention Survivors,[/b]

We apologize for the inconvenience but we are going to perform an emergency maintenance in a couple of minutes for a hotfix. All servers during this period will be unavailable and we will try to bring back the servers online as soon as possible. Please refer to the schedule below for more details and stay tuned for more updates.


[h1][b]Time Frame[/b][/h1][list][*]Thursday, March 25th, 2021
[*]SEA (UTC+7): 3:45 P.M. – 6:45 P.M.
[*]CET: 9:45 A.M. – 12:45 P.M.
[*]ET: 4:45 A.M. – 7:45 A.M.
[*]PT: 1:45 A.M. – 4:45 A.M.[/list]
[i][b]Note[/b]: Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.[/i]


[h1][b]Maintenance Details[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Hot Fix

Dear Survivors

Currently there is an issue in which the [Nameplate + Letter <C>] item is not appearing from the Epic Decoders since 10 A.M. CET yesterday March 24th, 2021. 

Players who used these Epic Decoders during this time will be redistributed as much as the amount used, and an additional 2 Unique Decoders will be distributed to all players of CSNS as a compensation for the ongoing emergency maintenance. [u][b](You are able to receive this compensation only if you log in by March 25th, 2021 today, 23:59.59 CET.)[/b][/u] 

We apologize for the inconvenience this may have caused, and thank you for your kind patience and understanding throughout. [/list]

Thank you for your understanding and support in advance.

The CSN:S Team

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: February 17th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c31ae6c26449d4a186d464fc64129a177bc3a791.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b]Content: Zombie Scenario 7-3 (Pursuit: Missed Connections)[/b]
Search the destroyed laboratory for clues! Check out this brand new story today.
	
[b]Content: Zombie Scenario Improvements[/b]
Zombie Scenario has been improved! Check it out today!
	
[b]Content: Zombie Content Update[/b]
From updates to mutations to changes to Zombie Z mode's unlock level, see all the updates coming to Zombie content!

[b]Promotion: 2021 New Epic Weapon Promotion (2/17 - 3/31)[/b]
During the event, Epic Decoders with the letter <C> as a possible reward will be sold in the shop![/list]

Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.



[h1]Expanded Info[/h1]
 
[h2]Content[/h2]

[u][h3]Zombie Scenario 7-3 - Pursuit: Missed Connections[/h3][/u]Ever since she escaped from the Panic Room, Erica has suffered from mysterious bouts of debilitating pain. Time passed in vain without being able to find the cause. One day, David Black receives a message from Soi out of the blue. Soi claims that there is information about Erica's condition and suggests that Black go to Rex Laboratory to search for a cure. When Black and Erica get there, however, the laboratory is in shambles after an attack. Now they must search the lab for any signs of Soi and a cure.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/3fb42c15dccc847efd406addf2b8864e0b552cbc.png[/img]
 

[u][h3]Zombie Scenario Improvements[/h3][/u]
[b]Introducing Elite Monsters[/b][list][*]When you play Zombie Scenario on Normal difficulty or higher, there is a chance for new elite monsters to appear.
[*]Elite monsters have more powerful stats than normal zombies, as well as enhancement effects. The higher the difficulty is when you encounter them, the more powerful their abilities become.
[*]If you clear the scenario after defeating an elite monster, you can get Add-On and Part items.[/list]

[b]Introducing the Add-On System[/b][list][*]New item type, Add-Ons, can be obtained by defeating elite monsters.
[*]Add-Ons are consumable items which, when used, apply their effects to the next Scenario Mode match. You can view your Add-On items in the mode-exclusive section of your inventory.
[*]You can equip Add-Ons in the lobby before playing Zombie Scenario Mode. When the match starts, 1 of each equipped Add-On will be consumed, and the Add-Ons' effects will be applied to that match.
[*]You can press the M key during the match to see the currently equipped Add-Ons.[/list]

[b]Other System Changes[/b][list][*]The Round Re-Challenge item no longer has a cooldown. Instead, there is now a limit on how many times it can be used per match based on difficulty. You can see how many uses you have left by pressing Tab during the match.
[*]Easy and Normal: No limit
[*]Hard: Up to 15 uses
[*]Very Hard: Up to 10 uses
[*]Hell: Up to 5 uses
[*]Inferno: Up to 3 uses
[*]In Zombie Scenario maps on Very Hard or above difficulty, when you discard a weapon, the weapon will now disappear immediately.
[*]You can view special conditions and rewars for each difficulty with the Difficulty Guide button in the Zombie Scenario Mode lobby.
[*]The number of parts you can get from the daily reward boxes have been doubled.
[*]Poor Reward Box: Part Grades 1-3 x2f
[*]Regular Reward Box: Part Grades 1-3 x6
[*]Intermediate Reward Box: Part Grades 1-3 x6 and Part Grades 2-5 x4
[*]Advanced Reward Box: Part Grades 1-3 x6, Part Grades 2-5 x4, and Part Grades 3-6 x4
[*]Removed the instant kill effect from the skills of some bosses.[/list]

[b]Get the details in the Zombie Scenario Improvement preview![/b]



[u][h3]Zombie Content Update[/h3][/u]
[b]Updated Mutation[/b][list][*]Hunter's Instinct: Slightly increases combat power against players marked as your target.[/list]

[u][h3]Gather the Light Fragments! Event (2/17 - 3/31)[/h3][/u]Complete play missions to get Light Fragments, which you can exchange for Epic Weapons, Epic Edition Weapons, and other items!

[b]How to Get Light Fragments - You can only get up to 30 per day, regardless of which of the below methods you use.[/b][list][*]Upon successfully scoring 2 kills or 6 assists in Zombie Hero/Z/Evolution modes, you will receive 1 Light Fragment (up to 25).

Get the message Soi left in the laboratory, defeat zombies and experiment subjects, and escape in one piece.

tags.feature: Search the destroyed laboratory for clues! Check out this brand new story today.
Zombie Scenario has been improved! Check it out today!
From updates to mutations to changes to Zombie Z mode's unlock level, see all the updates coming to Zombie content!
When you play Zombie Scenario on Normal difficulty or higher, there is a chance for new elite monsters to appear.
New item type, Add-Ons, can be obtained by defeating elite monsters.
Add-Ons are consumable items which, when used, apply their effects to the next Scenario Mode match. You can view your Add-On items in the mode-exclusive section of your inventory.
You can equip Add-Ons in the lobby before playing Zombie Scenario Mode. When the match starts, 1 of each equipped Add-On will be consumed, and the Add-Ons' effects will be applied to that match.
You can press the M key during the match to see the currently equipped Add-Ons.
The Round Re-Challenge item no longer has a cooldown. Instead, there is now a limit on how many times it can be used per match based on difficulty.

notes.content:

Instead of having another maintenance today to correct this, [u]we will recollect/withdraw the item 30 days later on March 17th through an unscheduled maintenance.[/u] We apologize for the confusion caused once again and thank you for your understanding in advance. - The CSNS Team[/list][/i]

[b]Dear Survivors,[/b]

First of all, thank you for your precious feedback on the 'Item Preference Survey Event!'

Regarding the reward, 'Christmas Damage Skin (30 Days),' we promised, we apologize for the delay; therefore, would like to additionally reward 5,000 Mileages to all those who participated in this questionnaire.

Thank you for your kind patience throughout, and we hope to see more of your enthusiasm on the next!

- The CSNS Team

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d68efd3f6c4c85058304f2ecf369fd8f8ab25cd6.jpg[/img] 

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b]Content: Season 8: Ice Kingdom Release[/b]
Introducing Season Pass items to remind you of the hard frozen land and fluttering snowflakes!
	
[b]Content: Zombie Update[/b]
Season 8 Zombie Mode has been newly updated! Check it out!
	
[b]Content: [Trial] Zombie League Season 3[/b]
Check out our latest changes, ranging from Zombie League Season 3 to the rewards.

[b]New Sale: Zombie Z Starter Package (Available Starting 1/27) [/b]
Introducing a new box filled with weapons to help you in Zombie Z Mode. Get it from the Shop![/list]

Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.



[h1]Expanded Info[/h1]
 
[h2]Contents[/h2]

[u][h3]Season 8: Ice Kingdom[/h3][/u]
[b]Season Information[/b][list][*]A season is a reward system that runs for a set period of time. Finish missions and events during a Season to earn Season Badges which raise your Season Rank. You'll receive rewards based on your rank throughout the season.[/list]
[b]Season Rank[/b][list][*]Season Rank shows how much progress players have made by participating in missions and events in the game. You can earn rare rewards that are only available for that season every time you raise your Season Rank. Season Rank and Season Badges are reset at the start of each season.[/list]
[b]Season Rewards[/b][list][*]Rewards are immediately given based on the ranks you reach each season.
[*]If you purchase a Season Pass, you'll get both the Season Pass rewards and the free rewards.
[*]Rewards unique to a specific season can only be earned during that season.[/list]
[b]Growing Weapon[/b][list][*]Bear Buster (Stage 1)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e0efa7667c5b3e2710cb21f86b150164c776644d.png[/img]
Fires blasts of breath from twin bear cub cannons. Landing enough breath attacks allows you to detonate a blast of compressed breath, knocking enemies back.

[*]Bear Fury Mk. 1 (Stage 2)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2828b492fbc3c2a337e5e69b53fe725aefe0a495.png[/img]
 Allows you to release a blast of compressed breath to charge.

[*]Bear Fury Mk. 2 (Stage 3)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2626f7ad43a253afdc5873eb1fe7ecbcfa6def65.png[/img]
Allows you to release a blast of compressed breath to charge.

[*]Bear Fury Mk. 3 (Stage 4)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0980aa546b6d0361ae0405fa346499be46311711.png[/img]
This weapon generates powerful snowstorms. It fires a powerful short-range snowstorm and activates an electric current that surrounds its user with powerful kinetic energy. After a certain number of shots, it builds up a charge to let you use the jet pack up to 2 times.

[*]When you receive each stage (stages 1-4) weapon, you will still keep the previous stage's weapon.[/list]
[b]Zombie Costumes[/b][list][*]Snowman Monster Aksha
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ed7da60d37fa5dddc3345e9b047b630ac235b4c6.png[/img]
Able to use Snowman Monster Aksha Zombie. This will change the appearance of your Aksha Zombie.

[*]Ice Queen Rusty Wing
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/58b96a155cc8837057aa6ee6b146d153dc9cf193.png[/img]
Able to use Ice Queen Rusty Wing. This will change the appearance of your Rusty Wing Zombie.[/list]
[b]Weapon Paints[/b][list][*]Snowflake Weapon Paint (FAMAS, AUG Guardian, Bouncer, Dual Sword Phantom Slayer, and Plasma Gun)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0d17044468a62bb048bb5ddb5d0947bf57bbecbf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/55d147cb5163765dcb8922de786e29cf3ec7064c.png[/img]
 [*]Cracked Weapon Paint (Holy Sword Divine Order, Pyton Desperado, Jackhammer, Hunter-Killer X-90, and MP5)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/50788e54d122e30783d60e8f03f028bdbbf28714.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/7c1b27c7489575d91259ad2283e62f5206ca9d8c.png[/img][/list]
[b]Costumes[/b][list][*]Ice Sword, Polar Bear Backpack, Ice Dragon Backpack, Snowman Sprite, Snowman Helmet, and Enchanted Snowflake.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/4c8c75d83020e4dff58d13f0f37d9dfee8e29c56.png[/img][/list]
[b]Sprays[/b][list][*]Ice Queen Rusty Wing, Snowman Monster Aksha, Snowman Leader Soi, Snowman Super Soldier Jennifer, and Ice Kingdom Venom Sting Sprays
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c353aff886a6461ff3268145f7977a4d279c5800.png[/img][/list]
[b]Medals[/b][list][*]Season 8 Trailblazer Medal (Pass)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/cbf4549a97efdc57e3c8b808e9c213d424b36921.png[/img]
[*]Season 8 Conqueror Medal (Highest Rank Reached)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5f713902579422b81ca7041a5fd536bd06b2bb0a.png[/img]

- Mileage Shop[/list]


[u][h3]Zombie Content Update[/h3][/u]For details, please refer to the Season 8 Zombie Mode Update Preview.

[b]Zombie Content Update[/b][list][*]Zombie Boost Items
- There are three zombie-exclusive power-ups that can appear when zombies die.
- Green: Increases maximum HP by 10%
- Blue: Reduces zombie skill cooldown by 10%
- Yellow: Increases Movement Speed by 5%
- Zombies drop 1 of the above power-ups upon death. Zombie players can pick up the power-up by approaching within 2m.
- You can have the effects of all 3 power-ups at once. The same power-up can be stacked up to 2 times.
- These effects last until the end of the round or death.
- These power-ups can be found in Zombie Hero and Zombie Z.

[*]Death Information Window and Revenge Bonus System
- Death Information Window Improvements: Upon death, a pop-up will display information about the player who killed you.
- Revenge Bonus System: Marks players who killed you this round and grants bonus points upon taking revenge.
- The Death Information Window and Revenge Bonus System can be found in Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, and Zombie Evolution.

[*]New Zombie Mutations
- Painful Memories: Marks the player that killed you and decreases the damage taken from that player by 50%.
- Supply Contamination: Press E to place 1 Zombie Bomb on a human team Supply Box. When a human approaches, the Zombie Bomb explodes and inflicts damage.

[*]Zombie Z Improvements
- In Zombie Z Mode, if you do not have the Specialist mutation by Lv. 30, your Lv. 30 mutation is guaranteed to be Specialist.[/list]

notes.title: [Notice] Auction House Improved!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b6f7445dbfb588ce0bfa03b6731e7439cd7ae329.jpg[/img]

[h1]Auction House Improvements![/h1]
[h3]Bringing a new level of convenience and security to the auction system![/h3]


[h2]Improved Search System[/h2]
[b]Weapon Paint Filter[/b][list][*] Now you can search for weapons with weapon paint applied.
[*] You can even filter for items with multiple weapon paints on them.[/list]

[h2]Recent Transaction History Display[/h2]
[b]Transaction Chart[/b][list][*] You can now view charts displaying recent transaction history.
[*] The chart can be seen from the Bid Auction and Auction Listing windows.
[*]* Chart displays a weapon's average auction price by day.[/list]

[h2]Price Limit Expansion System[/h2]
[b]Price Limits Automatically Expand[/b][list][*]Weapons that have no transactions after a certain amount of time will have their upper/lower price limit expanded.
  - This will help players who have weapons that they could not sell because the limit was too high or low.
  - Unique quality and lower weapons that have had no transactions for 2 days will have their upper/lower price limit expanded by 10%.
  - This price expansion can happen up to 3 times.
  - Once the weapon has had active transactions again, upper/lower price limits will be set again based on those prices.[/list]

We have more Auction House improvements planned for the future. And we're also optimizing how we set prices for enhancement weapons based on market prices. 


[h3]Additionally, the following weapons have been added to the Mileage Auction!
[/h3][list][*] Desert Eagle 50C Gold
[*] FG Launcher
[*] Flame Jackhammer
[*] Lightning AR-1
[*] Charger-5
[*] Charger-7
[*] Crow-11
[*] Turbulent-1
[*] Turbulent-3
[*] Turbulent-9
[*] Hunter Killer X-7
[*] Turbulent-11
[*] Vulcanus-9
[*] Claw Hammer[/list]

Happy Auctioning!

- The CSNS Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9f5ecad1efc0200b15e208703654bd057e52e5d0.jpg[/img]

Adieu 2020, a new zombie content update, and rich, year-end events have finally arrived! Get into the game now and prepare for Season 8 that's also coming in the first month of 2021! More detailed information regarding the new updates and events can be found below:[list][*][b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/2918861082705850968]CLICK HERE TO CHECK IT OUT NOW![/url][/b][/list]

[h2]Major Updates[/h2]
[h3]1. A New Variant Zombie, 'Draugr,' Added[/h3]A new zombie with excellent defense and movement skills using swords has been added![list][*]It is able to use its sword to neutralize damage, projectiles, and even reduce knockback and stiffness.

There are a number of other changes that have been made additionally with today's balance adjustments so be sure to check out the patch notes!

[h3]2. Adieu 2020, Daily Missions Clear Event[/h3]When you log in to the game or collect points through play, you will be rewarded with Transcendence Decoders and winning designs from each country that was held through the Summer 2020 Weapon Paint Design Contest! Join now and experience the excitement of Draugr today! Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio Fans! Thank you for your continuous love and support for CSNS throughout 2020.

- The CSNS Team

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: December 23rd
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/490038044bd7dc699500c1c0f29391d11de14bf2.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!

[list][b]Content: Added the New Zombie Draugr[/b]
A new zombie has been released in Zombie Evolution! With the power to switch between offense and defense, this zombie is perfect for breaking through the enemy line!
	
[b]Content: Zombie Evolution & Zombie Z Rebalance[/b]
A new change comes to zombie modes! Read on to learn how they've been rebalanced.
	
[b]Content: New Inferno Difficulty Map for Zombie Scenario[/b]
Total War has been updated with Inferno difficulty! We plan to add Inferno difficulty to more maps in the future, so have fun.

[b]Content: Medal System Improvement Part 2 Information[/b]
The Medal System has been further improved! 3 new medals have also been added, so be sure to check them out.

[b]Promotion: Transcendence Class Promotion (12/23 - 1/27)[/b]
New Transcendence Classes, Leader Soi and Super Soldier Jennifer, have been released! Get them from Class Decoders today![/list]

Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.



[h1]Expanded Info[/h1]
 
[h2]Contents[/h2]

[u][h3]New Zombie: Draugr[/h3][/u][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/017e1b1e64001c2a59feeda07cfe11a0e958d352.png[/img]
A new zombie exclusive to Zombie Evolution has been released! With the power to switch between offense and defense, this zombie is perfect for breaking through the enemy line!

[b]Introduction[/b][list][*]Draugr is a powerful mutant zombie class that uses a sword. It has a very long attack range, but slow attack speed. Hold right-click to charge up to 3 stages. Range and damage increase according to the charge stage.[/list]

[b]Skill[/b][list][*]Deflect: Block enemy projectiles with your sword. While using this skill, the effects of knockback and stun against you are reduced. Use the skill again to deactivate it. The gauge gradually drains while using the skill, and refills when not using it.

[*]Dimension Slash: Channel your focus and teleport forward, dealing damage to all humans in your path and pulling nearby humans in. Cannot move through obstacles.[/list]


[u][h3]Zombie Evolution & Zombie Z Rebalance[/h3][/u]A new change comes to zombie modes!

[b]Zombie Evolution Mode[/b][list][*]1. Human Skill Limit Change: After learning 2 skills, you can use virus to learn more skills. Doing so will replace the first skill you already learned with the new skill.

[*]2. Added Human Team Banshee skills.
  - Vampire Bats Skill: While the skill is in effect, vampire bats attack when you hit an enemy, inflicting additional damage and healing you for a portion of all damage dealt.
  - Banshee Buff: Marks Zombies in the direction you are facing in red.

[*]3. Increased the amount of virus required to use skills while you are Human from 2 to 3.

[*]4. Slightly increased the periodic virus gain when Humans survive.

[*]5. Adjusted Human skill balance.
  - Aksha: Reduced the cumulative damage required for the Discharge skill and increased the attack power boost to up to 250%.
  - Rusty Wing: Slightly increased the Glide skill's cooldown.
  - Deimos: Slightly reduced the Shock skill's cooldown.
  - Venom Guard: Reduced the Zombie Explosion skill's cooldown.

[*]6. Reduced the number of Virus Essences generated upon a zombie death from up to 6 to 5.

[*]7. Reduced the amount of virus obtained from Virus Essence when you are a zombie from 50 to 35.

[*]8. Increased the amount of virus obtained when a zombie kills a human from 120 to 150.

[*]9. Increased the virus level required to transform into a mutant zombie from 7 to 9.

[*]10. Increased the virus level consumed to transform into a mutant zombie from 6 to 9.

[*]11. Respawn time now increases even when dying from normal headshots, not just from Deadly Shot.

[*]12. Adjusted Brutus and Arachne balance.
  - Slightly increased Brutus defense.
  - Slightly increased Brutus HP.
  - Slightly reduced Arachne HP.
  - Slightly increased Arachne armor.
  - Reduced Arachne's Web Walk skill cooldown from 6 to 5 sec.[/list]

[b]Zombie Z Mode[/b][list][*]1. Mutation Changes
  - Contact Infection: Damages nearby humans every second. The damage increases every round.
  - Icarus: Has a 2-sec cooldown after using Glide.

[*]2. Zombie Z Mode Unlock Levels Adjusted
  - Changed the unlock level for some zombies and weapons.

[*]3. Additional Changes
  - Fixed the issue where you could attack while using Venom Guard's Self-Destruct skill.
  - Round settings can now be selected in 2-round increments with a minimum of 5 rounds and maximum of 17 rounds.[/list]


[u][h3]New Inferno Difficulty Map for Zombie Scenario[/h3][/u][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/3f215453bf479427d28a2912e78c506f884d0e68.jpg[/img]
A new Zombie Scenario Inferno difficulty map has been added! Play it now! 
[list][*]Featured Map: Pursue: Total War[/list]


[u][h3]Medal System Improvement Part 2[/h3][/u][list][*]1. Changed player count criteria for achieving medals.
  - Player count requirements, which were different per medal, are now 1 or more players by default.
  - Several medals, which require a higher player count due to the medal's nature, will stay the same. This information is mentioned in each medal's description.

[*]2. Added medal colors according to Honor Points.
  - Added medal colors for 1500-1999 points, as well as 2000-2999 points.
  - Medal colors can be checked under the Help button on the top right side of the Medals page.

[*]3. Added the option to not display medal stages.
  - Added the option to not display the stage for earned medals.
  - You can activate/deactivate this feature in the Display Medal section under the Medals page.

[*]4. Improved notation of obtainable Achievement Points/Honor Points.
  - Changed the notation for unobtained Achievement Points/Honor Points to look engraved.
  - Removed all Honor wording that was displayed before the medal names in the Medals page.

[*]5. Added the feature to check medal stages.
  - For medals that have medal stages, you can select each stage and check the achievement goals and rewards in advance.

[*]6. Added 3 new medals.
  - Welcome Medal: Reach 10 cumulative logins.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0773fc33fd6e7fd5e188951ff7a107d9e4a5b35c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e1ddb5682981f44e4ca33214c8e244a101a0264d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1366732e8562e6f7a901fef0dc8d57f92fe85f8a.png[/img]

[*]7. Added Achievement Shop items.
  - Kill Taunt
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/873d9fbde0535a88dc9bc3460aabcfa337a77dc5.png[/img]
(Animated) Giggling Kill Taunt. Shows a special image on the death recap of enemies you kill in Original and Deathmatch modes.
  - Zombification
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/bccb37dd16867fd1683c3912f8c4055310f6e143.png[/img]
Nine Lives Zombification. Changes the revival effect when you revive as a zombie in Zombie Mode.
  - Nameplate
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/fdc5a892dfc5e7b564d57d34df94adba4254348f.png[/img]
(Animated) Burning Nameplate. Customizes how your name appears by applying the Burning Nameplate.[/list]


[u][h3]Updates to the New/Welcome Back Supply Box[/h3][/u][list][*]The contents of the CSer Settlement Support Weapon Box, which is one of the New/Welcome Back Supply Box items, have been updated as below.

notes.title: [Notice] Regarding Compensation for Recent Events
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b6f7445dbfb588ce0bfa03b6731e7439cd7ae329.jpg[/img]

[b]Dear Survivors,[/b]

With regards to the recent events of November 26th's Unscheduled Maintenance and the Daily Missions Bug ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/2895214724134984858]REFERENCE[/url]), we would like to give you Compensation Rewards as an appreciation of your kind patience and understanding throughout this whole process. Details to the Compensation Plan are addressed below:


[h3]Compensation Regarding November 26th's Unscheduled Maintenance[/h3]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: November 25th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/8ae980e72a4d024dd0e3d1774746020ef6b381c4.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!

[list][b]Content: Scenario TX Update[/b]
This is a "shooting RPG" based on Studio Mode. Hunt monsters and obtain various items to grow stronger, all in an isometric view.
	
[b]Content: Medal System Improvement Information[/b]
The medal system has been improved. Please refer to the details below for changes to the medal page, stages, Achievement Shop, etc.
	
[b]Content: New "Inferno" Difficulty for Zombie Scenario[/b]
Zombie Scenario is now even harder! This time, you're up against the Inferno difficulty, which is even tougher than the existing Hell difficulty. Monsters will have greater attack power, HP, speed, etc.

[b]Balance Update Information[/b]
The balance of Zombie Z/Zombie Evolution has been updated. Please see below for details.

[b]Promotion: Magic Lance Scarlet Rose Promotion (11/25 - 12/23) [/b]
During the promotion, enjoy 3x drop rates for the Transcendence Weapons, Magic Lance Scarlet Rose and Barrett M95 White Tiger. Once the promotion is over, the Barrett M95 White Tiger will become permanently available.[/list]

Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.



[h1]Expanded Info[/h1]
 
[h2]Contents[/h2]

[u][h3]Studio - Scenario TX Update[/h3][/u]This is a "shooting RPG" based on Studio Mode. Hunt monsters and obtain various items to grow stronger, all in an isometric view.

[b]Details[/b][list][*] Items exclusive to Scenario TX, obtained from eliminating monsters, can be obtained permanently.
[*] Scenario TX supports individual saving per class. Enjoy various gameplay experiences with each class.
[*] Enjoy Scenario TX gameplay utilizing about 80 different skills!
[*] You can become even more powerful through the Scenario TX's Expert advancement system, exclusively for Lv. 30.[/list]

[b]Scenario TX Hunting Map Creation[/b][list][*] You can create hunting maps for Scenario TX with even just basic blocks, without separate devices.
[*] Anyone can freely play the hunting maps.
[*] Hunt monsters and obtain items in various hunting grounds created by the community![/list]

[b]Scenario TX Missions[/b][list][*] A new form of scenario where the official Scenario TX lore is applied, featuring boss monsters.
[*] Challenge Scenario TX missions with the Mission Points you collected from clearing hunting maps!
[*] Hunt boss monsters to obtain exclusive loot.[/list]


[u][h3]Medal System Improvement Information[/h3][/u]The medal system has been improved. Please refer to the details below for changes to the medal page, stages, Achievement Shop, etc.

[b]Medal Page[/b][list][*] You can view the medal page by selecting Medals under My Info.
[*] The search feature has been improved. You can now search by medal descriptions, not just medal names.
[*] You can easily check each medal's status through Medal Collection View and Medal Detail View.[/list]

[b]Medal Stage Expansion[/b][list][*] When you complete a stage 1 medal, you can challenge the game for the stage 2 medal.
[*] Upon winning a medal, you can gain Honor Points or Achievement Points.[/list]

[b]Achievement Shop[/b][list][*] The Achievement Shop is open. There, you can spend Achievement Points to purchase items.[/list]


[u][h3]New "Inferno" Difficulty for Zombie Scenario[/h3][/u]Zombie Scenario is now even harder! This time, you're up against the Inferno difficulty, which is even tougher than the existing Hell difficulty. Monsters will have greater attack power, HP, speed, etc.

[b]2 Zombie Scenario Maps with Difficulty Expanded to Inferno[/b][list][*] Pursuit: Ep. Carlito
[*] Track: Last Clue[/list]

[b]Notice[/b][list][*] Inferno Difficulty is only available on certain maps. Maps that can be played on Inferno difficulty are listed on the map selection screen.
[*] When you play with a Map Playlist, you can select Inferno difficulty only when all selected maps are playable on Inferno difficulty.
[*] We plan to regularly add Inferno difficulty to more maps in the future.[/list]


[u][h3]Zombie Z/Zombie Evolution Balance Update Information[/h3][/u]
[b]1. Zombie Karma Gain Increased[/b][list][*] The Karma zombies gain from killing humans has been doubled.
[*] The Karma zombies gain from killing humans while certain zombie skills are active has been tripled.[/list]

[b]2. Zombie Z Karma Sub-Effects Improved[/b][list][*] Mid-Point Before Reaching Karma Stage 1 Goal:
  - Zombies can select a zombie class 5 levels higher than your level.
[*] Mid-Point Before Reaching Karma Stage 2 Goal:
  - Zombies can select a zombie class 10 levels higher than your level.
[*] Mid-Point Before Reaching Karma Stage 3 Goal:
  - Zombies can select any class and can obtain all zombie mutations.[/list]

[b]3. Zombie Team Karma Main Per-Stage Effects Improved[/b][list][*] Zombie Team Stage 1 Karma Effect: Immune to status effects for 4 sec (ignore stuns and knockback).
[*] Zombie Team Stage 2 Karma Effect: Invincible for 6 sec (ignore damage, stuns, and knockback) and can move
[*] Zombie Team Stage 3 Karma Effect: Play as Zombie Hero, Invincible for 7 sec (ignore damage, stuns, and knockback)[/list]

[b]4. Zombie Z Mode Unlock Level Adjustment[/b][list][*] Item Unlock Level Adjustments[/list]

[b]5. Zombie Z Mode Hellhound and Trinity Grenade Purchase Price Changes[/b][list][*]1) Hellhound
  - The initial purchase of Hellhound (each round) will cost $15,000. It comes with the drone use gauge fully charged (4 drones).
  - Additionally purchased drones will arrive with the use gauge fully depleted.
  - If you do not meet the $15,000 requirement, you cannot re-purchase.
  - Human Team Karma Sub-Effects (Stage 0.5 and Stage 1.5) will be given without deducting funds, when you meet the purchase level requirements.
[*]2) Trinity Grenade
  - The initial purchase of Trinity Grenade (each round) will cost $7,500.
  - If you do not meet the $7,500 requirement, you cannot re-purchase.
  - Human Team Karma Sub-Effects (Stage 0.5 and Stage 1.5) will be given without deducting funds when you meet the purchase level requirements.[/list]

[b]6. Partial Changes to Zombie Evolution System[/b][list][*] Zombie respawn wait time has been reduced.
[*] Round switch wait time has been reduced to 5 sec.[/list]



[h2]Events[/h2]

[u][h3]Free Daily Rewards (11/25 - 12/23)[/h3][/u]The Free Daily Rewards list has been updated. Meet the event requirements for 20 days to get over 20,000 mileage in total!

[b]Conditions[/b][list][*] Log into the game and reach at least 10 minutes of playtime[/list]

[b]Rewards[/b][list][*] Daily Reward: 50 Mileage
[*] 3 Days: 2,000 Mileage
[*] 6 Days: 2,000 Mileage
[*] 9 Days: 3,000 Mileage
[*] 15 Days: 6,000 Mileage
[*] 20 Days: 8,000 Mileage[/list]


[u][h3]Special Item Giveaway (11/25 - 12/23)[/h3][/u]The following message will appear to players who reach 20 minutes of playtime during the event (must be in rooms with 4 or more players):

[list][*]"Special items will be given out in 10 minutes!"

[*]Special items will be awarded at the 20, 40, and 80-minute playtime marks each day. Upon receipt, they can be used immediately for 60 minutes.

[*]Special Items (1 selected at random)
  - Lightning Fury
  - Magnum Launcher
  - Holy Sword Divine Order
  - Psychic Harmonium
  - Infinity Laser Fist
  - X-TRACKER Tin
  - Dual Sword Phantom Slayer
  - Dual Beretta Gunslinger
  - Barrett M95 White Tiger
  - Trinity Grenade
  - Dual Sword Infernal Hunter
  - M3 Dragon

[*] Notice
  - The special item's expiration timer counts down even if you don't use it.[/list]


[u][h3]Daily 90-Min Transcendence Decoder Event (11/25 - 12/9)[/h3][/u]During the event, when you meet the following playtime conditions each day, you can receive daily/cumulative rewards!

[b]Daily Gameplay Conditions and Rewards[/b][list][*] Reach 30 minutes of playtime and earn 1 Play Point: 100 mileage
[*] Reach 60 minutes of playtime and earn 1 Play Point: 100 mileage
[*] Reach 90 minutes of playtime and earn 1 Play Point: Transcendence Decoder (x1)[/list]

[b]Cumulative Rewards[/b][list][*] Earn the Transcendence Decoder from the daily rewards a total of 3 times: Season Badge x100
[*] Earn the Transcendence Decoder from the daily rewards a total of 5 times: Season Badge x200
[*] Earn the Transcendence Decoder from the daily rewards a total of 7 times: Jiangshi Zombie (Permanent)
[*] Earn the Transcendence Decoder from the daily rewards a total of 10 times: M249 Phoenix (Permanent) + 20,000 mileage[/list]

[b]Notice[/b][list][*] Each reward can only be obtained once per account.
[*] Play Points (PVP): Kill 10 human players or 2 zombie players (excluding bots). Does not count in Studio Mode.
[*] Play Points (PVE): Clear 1 session in Scenario Mode. Counts in Studio Mode.
[*] Does not count in the Zombie Scenario Survival: Double Gate, Survival: Lost City, or Survival: Trap maps.
[*] Can make progress in PVP mode rooms with 8 or more players, and in Scenario mode rooms with 4 or more players.[/list]


[u][h3]Scenario TX Play Event (11/25 - 12/9)[/h3][/u]During the event, if you meet gameplay conditions in the new Scenario TX maps created by the development team, you will automatically be entered into a raffle pool!

[b]Submission Conditions and Rewards[/b][list][*] Among players who played Scenario TX Tutorial Map for at least 10 minutes, and recommended Sample Map 1 at least once, 10 random winners will receive Hunter Killer X-12 Event Ticket (x1).
[*] Among players who played Scenario TX Mission 01: Last Clue map for at least 10 minutes, and recommended Sample Map 2 at least once, 10 random winners will receive Hunter Killer X-12 Event Ticket (x1).
[*] Among players who played a Scenario TX Hunting Map: Dust/Platform/Village/Dark City for at least 10, and recommended that map at least once, 10 random winners will receive Hunter Killer X-12 Event Ticket (x1).[/list]

[b]Increasing Odds of Winning[/b][list][*] Use 10 Cheer Fragments to increase your odds of winning the reward![/list]

[b]Notice[/b][list][*] The raffle rewards will be distributed during maintenance on Wednesday, December 9th.
[*] 1 reward will be given per map. It is possible to win multiple times.
[*] All unused event tickets will be removed during maintenance on Wednesday, December 23rd.[/list]


[u][h3]Scenario TX New Map Play Event (11/25 - 12/9)[/h3][/u]When you play in the new Scenario TX maps (3 maps) and reach Class Lv. 3, you will receive rewards!

[b]Rewards[/b][list][*] Unique Decoder x1[/list]

[b]Notice[/b][list][*] You can earn this reward in any of the 3 new maps.
[*] Each account can receive this reward only once.[/list]


[u][h3][Trial] Zombie League Season 1 Player Feedback Event (11/25 - 12/9)[/h3][/u]Accounts that complete the "Player Feedback on [Trial] Zombie League Season 1" questionnaire during the event will receive an event reward.

[b]Survey Link[/b][list][*][url=https://forms.gle/R9hTZFMQCCsGgLNH8]https://forms.gle/R9hTZFMQCCsGgLNH8[/url][/list]

[b]Participation Reward[/b][list][*] Transcendence Decoder x1[/list]

[b]Notice[/b][list][*] Event participation counts only for participants who send in valid content.
[*] Inappropriate content, such as writing in special characters, gibberish, profanity, etc., will result in exclusion from event participation.
[*] Listing your game account incorrectly in the survey may lead to being left off the list of reward recipients.
[*] Rewards will be distributed during maintenance on Wednesday, December 23rd.
[*] Each account can receive this reward only once.[/list]


[u][h3][Trial] Zombie League Season 2 (11/25/2020 - 01/27/2021)[/h3][/u]
[b]League Rewards[/b][list][*] Master: Zombie League Master Zombification + Magnum Launcher (15 Days) + Kalael (15 Days) + Medea (15 Days)
[*] Diamond: Zombie League Diamond Spray + Dual Beretta Gunslinger (15 Days) + Female Student Light Zombie (15 Days)
[*] Platinum: Zombie League Nameplate + Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (15 Days) + Nurse Venom Sting (15 Days)
[*] Gold: Trinity Grenade (15 Days) + Mummy Stamper (15 Days)
[*] Silver: Infinity Laser Fist (15 Days) + Chef Heavy Zombie (15 Days)
[*] Bronze: N/A[/list]

[b]Changes[/b][list][*] The pertinent rank's point window now appears when you hover your mouse cursor over League Info > Reward per Rank.
[*] Hall of Fame > Top 500 players' ranks are now marked with font colors.
[*] Improved measures against abusing issues.[/list]

[b]Notice[/b][list][*] You can check your league status under My Info.
[*] You can review the score and weapon information for the top 500 players in the Hall of Fame.
[*] League Ranks: Master > Diamond > Platinum > Gold > Silver > Bronze
[*] You can advance in league ranks by earning League Points from playing zombie modes.
[*] You can earn League Points from zombie modes for only up to 2 hours each day.
[*] Zombie League Season 2 is a [Trial] season. Its rules, such as its progression period, rewards, etc., may be adjusted in the future.
[*] Season Pass and Zombie League Season are separate systems with different progression periods.
[*] Zombie League = Zombie Hero + Zombie Evolution + Zombie Z + Studio Zombie + Zombie (AI)
[*] Master Rank is the only rank you advance through competition.
[*] There are no player count restrictions in obtaining League Points, but you get higher bonuses for playing with more people.
[*] You cannot get League Points in private rooms with a password set.
[*] You cannot get League Points if abnormal activity or cheating is detected, such as:
[*] Cases of not participating in gameplay, or killing or infecting such players.
[*] Cases of abnormal activity, as it pertains to Studio devices or map structures.
[*]* We plan to keep making improvements to the League Points formula. Please keep an eye out for future announcements.[/list]


[u][h3][Trial] Zombie League Season 1 Wrap-Up Reward Distribution (11/25 - Permanent)[/h3][/u]We plan to give league medals to players who maintain Master/Diamond ranks at the time the [Trial] Zombie League Season 1 ends.

[b]Medals Available[/b][list][*] Master League: Awarded upon ending the [Trial] Zombie League Season 1 in Master Rank.
[*] Diamond League: Awarded upon ending [Trial] Zombie League Season 1 in Diamond Rank.[/list]


[u][h3]Zombie Scenario Difficulty Expansion Celebration Event (11/25 - 12/9)[/h3][/u]During the event, when you play the two Zombie Scenario maps, on the new "Inferno" difficulty, you'll receive a 3x EXP boost!

[b]Featured Maps[/b][list][*]Pursuit: Ep. Carlito
[*]Track: Last Clue[/list]

[b]Notice[/b][list][*] Applies only to rooms with 4 or more players.[/list]



[h2]Shop[/h2]

[u][h3]Magic Lance Scarlet Rose Promotion (11/25 - 12/23)[/h3][/u]During the promotion, enjoy 3x drop rates for the Transcendence Weapons, Magic Lance Scarlet Rose and Barrett M95 White Tiger. Once the promotion is over, the Barrett M95 White Tiger will become permanently available.

[b]Transcendence Weapon Drop Rates[/b][list][*]Transcendence Premium Decoder (3x Rate Up)
  - Magic Lance Scarlet Rose: 3.0 % (3x Rate Up)
  - Barrett M95 White Tiger: 3.0 % (3x Rate Up)
[*]Transcendence Decoder
  - Magic Lance Scarlet Rose: 0.45 % (3x Rate Up)
  - Barrett M95 White Tiger: 0.45 % (3x Rate Up)
[*]Check the rate details on the official homepage at http://www.csnzombies.com/.[/list]

[b]Notice[/b][list][*] After the promotion ends, drop rates for the Barrett M95 White Tiger will return to their default rates.
[*] The contents of the Decoder may change when the promotion ends.
[*] All unused Transcendence Premium Decoders will be removed during maintenance on 12/23. They will be replaced with 500 Mileage each. However, the Transcendence Decoders will not be removed.[/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: November 11th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/bd53d4adb6d6f1c252a8e32d4e8db8b14842db84.jpg[/img]

New events have been added.


[h2]Events[/h2]

[u][h3]Extreme Completion Treasure Challenge (11/11 - 11/25)[/h3][/u]Increase your score by clearing multi-boss battles during the event. Get your rewards upon reaching the threshold!

[b]How to Increase Your Score[/b][list][*]Clear a multi-boss battle on "Hell" difficulty: 6 points
[*]Clear a multi-boss battle on "Very Hard" difficulty: 4 points
[*]Clear a multi-boss battle on "Hard" difficulty: 2 points[/list]
[b]Threshold and Reward[/b][list][*]Threshold: Reach a score of 180
[*]Reward: Dual Sword Infernal Hunter (Permanent) + Leather Weapon Paint (x1)[/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*]Can only participate in rooms with 4 or more players, including you. You must have at least 10 minutes of playtime.
[*]Reward can only be obtained once per account. You can accumulate up to 18 points toward your score every day.[/list]


[h2]Shop[/h2]

[u][h3]Gungnir Returns! (11/11 - 12/9)[/h3][/u]During the promotion, the "Gungnir + Weapon Paint" and "Dark Star" will make a special appearance from Epic Decoders! In order to celebrate the re-sale of Gungnir, we plan to also give a Gungnir-exclusive weapon paint when you win a Gungnir (Permanent) from Epic Decoders!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/4667e28054e7e3fb3a4228fefbbec76aa9d11d21.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/3557fd7bff909d9fb05c59ec8ddedc7270b2f61f.png[/img]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: October 28th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/20fff6c089b850687ab088a0a333c45166d8acdb.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!

[list][b]Content: Difficulty System Revamp[/b]
The difficulty stages have been simplified from the previous 12 stages to 5 stages.

[b]Event: Free Daily Rewards Item Update (10/28 - 11/25)[/b]
The Free Daily Rewards list has been updated. As the 20-day cumulative special reward, you will receive Sigma Weapon Paint that can be applied to the Epic Weapon, Gungnir.
	
[b]Event: Halloween Celebration Events (10/28 - 11/11)[/b]
Various Halloween celebration events will be held.

[Candy Event] When you play Zombie Mode, you can receive Baskets of Candy. Collect 3 candies of the same color and exchange them for items. This time around, the Hopeful Chest includes a Gold Transcendence Red Dragon Cannon as a special item. Don't miss it!

[Halloween Ticket Collection Event] When you collect tickets by playing the game, you can receive the Halloween Damage Skin or the Mnemonic Weapon Paint, which is a weapon paint for Hunter-Killer X-90.

[Halloween Pumpkin Grenade Event] Deal random damage with the Pumpkin Grenade.
	
[b]Promotion: Season 7 New Transcendence Class Promotion (10/28 - 11/11)[/b]
You can get the new Transcendence Classes, "Boss David Black" and "Special Agent Criss", from decoders during the promotion. When you get Boss David Black, you can get Black's Sunglasses (Permanent). When you get Special Agent Criss, you can get Criss' Military Cap (Permanent).[/list]

Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.



[h1]Expanded Info[/h1]
 
[h2]Contents[/h2]

[u][h3]Difficulty System Revamp[/h3][/u]The old 12 difficulty stages have been simplified to 5 stages. With this change, VIP perks and scenario map clear rewards have also been updated. You can check the updated map clear rewards by pressing the Check Main Reward button in the Lobby.

[b]Difficulty Changes[/b][list][*] Old Difficulties: Easy 1-2, Regular, Hard 1-9
[*] New Difficulties: Easy, Normal, Hard, Very Hard, and Hell[/list]

[b]VIP Perk Changes[/b][list][*] Silver: Hard clear reward + Regular Reward Box 2 times
[*] Gold: Hard clear reward + Regular Reward Box 3 times
[*] Platinum: Very Hard clear reward + Intermediate Reward Box 3 times
[*] Diamond: Very Hard clear reward + Intermediate Reward Box 4 times
[*] VIP: Hell clear reward + Advanced Reward Box 5 times
[*] VVIP: Hell clear reward + Advanced Reward Box 7 times[/list]

[u][h3]Miscellaneous Fixes[/h3][/u][list][*] Fixed the bug where some images displayed in a different language
[*] Fixed the bug where new character images did not display on the message block
[*] Fixed the bug where the notice only displayed in English
[*] Fixed other minor bugs[/list] 


[h2]Events[/h2]

[u][h3]Halloween Celebration Candy Event (10/28 - 11/11)[/h3][/u]Obtain Baskets of Candy by playing Zombie Mode during the event. Open the Baskets of Candy to collect candy and get various rewards.

[b]Requirements[/b][list][*] 1 Basket of Candy given each time you reach 3 minutes of playtime in eligible modes during the event.
[*] You can obtain up to 30 Baskets of Candy a day.
[*] Eligible Modes: Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, Zombie Evolution, and Zombie Scenario[/list]

[b]How to Obtain and Use Candy[/b][list][*] Use the Basket of Candy to get 1 random Green, Pink, Blue, or Red Candy.
[*] Collect 3 of the same colored candy and use them to get rewards.[/list]

[b]Rewards[/b][list][*] Green Candy x3: 1,000 Mileage Coupon
[*] Pink Candy x3: Starlight Rolling Shooter (Permanent)
[*] Red Candy x3: Unique Decoder x1
[*] Blue Candy x3: Hopeful Chest x1[/list]

[b]Notice[/b][list][*] You can only participate in rooms with 4 or more players.
[*] You cannot participate in Studio Mode.
[*] You can obtain up to 30 Baskets of Candy a day.
[*] All Candy and Basket of Candy items will be removed during the maintenance on November 11th.[/list]


[u][h3]Halloween Ticket Collection Event (10/28 - 11/11)[/h3][/u]You can receive CSN:S Event Tickets when you complete certain missions during the event. You can receive various rewards by collecting tickets.

[b]Ticket Acquiring Conditions[/b][list][*] Daily login: 5 tickets
[*] Reach 30 minutes of login: 1 ticket (repeatable)
[*] Score 10 zombie kills in Random Rules Zombie Hero Halloween Assault: 15 tickets
[*] Score 10 zombie assists in Random Rules Zombie Hero Halloween Assault: 10 tickets
[*] Score 10 zombie kills in Random Rules Zombie Hero Italy: 15 tickets
[*] Score 10 zombie assists in Random Rules Zombie Hero Italy: 10 tickets
[*] Complete class Exploration 1 time: 5 tickets
[*] Complete class Exploration 2 times: 10 tickets[/list]

[b]Rewards for Total Number of Tickets Obtained[/b][list][*] Total 555 tickets: Halloween Damage Skin (30 Days)
[*] Total 999 tickets: Hunter-Killer X-90 + Mnemonic Weapon Paint x1[/list]

[b]Notice[/b][list][*] Conditions, except for the login time mission, can only be met once a day.
[*] You can only make progress in rooms with 4 or more players.
[*] All unused tickets will be removed during maintenance on November 11th.[/list]


[u][h3]Halloween Pumpkin Grenade Giveaway (10/28 - 11/11)[/h3][/u]Get a Pumpkin Grenade by logging in during the event. The Pumpkin Grenade deals random damage in featured modes.

[b]Eligible Modes[/b][list][*] Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, Zombie Evolution, and Zombie Scenario[/list]

[b]Damage Change[/b][list][*] Normal damage (50% chance)
[*] 2x damage (40% chance)
[*] Instant death (10% chance)[/list]

[b]Notice[/b][list][*] All grenades given will be removed during maintenance on 11/11.[/list]


[u][h3]Zombie Hero: Random Rules Event (10/28 - 11/11)[/h3][/u]In Random Rules maps for Zombie Hero mode, the rules of the game change every round. The rules will be displayed for 3 seconds prior to the beginning of the round, and you can check them at any time by pressing the L key during the match. To celebrate Halloween, a Halloween theme will be applied to the Assault map.

[b]Featured Maps[/b][list][*] Halloween Assault and Italy[/list]


[u][h3]Free Daily Rewards Event (10/28 - 11/25)[/h3][/u]The Free Daily Rewards list has been updated. When you reach 20 days of cumulative logins, you can get the "Sigma Weapon Paint", which can be applied to the Epic Weapon, Gungnir.

[b]Conditions[/b][list][*] Log into the game and reach 10 minutes of playtime[/list]

[b]Rewards[/b][list][*] Daily Reward: 50 Mileage
[*] 3 Days: 2,000 Mileage
[*] 6 Days: 2,000 Mileage
[*] 9 Days: 3,000 Mileage
[*] 15 Days: 6,000 Mileage
[*] 20 Days: Sigma Weapon Paint[/list]


[u][h3]Wait! Take This Special Weapon Event (10/28 - Permanent)[/h3][/u]You can receive rewards when you reach 20/40/80 minutes of playtime each day.

[b]Requirements[/b][list][*] Rewards granted after 20, 40, and 80 minutes of playtime each day.[/list]

[b]Rewards[/b][list][*] One of the following is given at random. It can be used for 60 minutes starting from the time you receive it.[/list][list][*] Lightning Fury
[*] Magnum Launcher
[*] Holy Sword Divine Order
[*] Psychic Harmonium
[*] Infinity Laser Fist
[*] X-TRACKER
[*] Dual Sword Phantom Slayer
[*] Dual Beretta Gunslinger
[*] Barrett M95 White Tiger
[*] Trinity Grenade
[*] Dual Sword Infernal Hunter
[*] M3 Black Dragon[/list]

[b]Notice[/b][list][*] Item expiration timers count down even if you don't use the weapon.
[*] Earning the same item a second time will extend its timer by 60 minutes.
[*] Only counts in rooms with 4 or more players.[/list] 



[h2]Shop[/h2]

[u][h3]Season 7 New Transcendence Class Promotion (10/28 - 11/11)[/h3][/u]You can get the new Transcendence Classes, "Boss David Black" and "Special Agent Criss", from decoders during the promotion. When you get Boss David Black, you can get Black's Sunglasses (Permanent). When you get Special Agent Criss, you can get Criss' Military Cap (Permanent).

[b]Rates (x4)[/b][list][*] Premium Class Decoder: 2.0%
[*] Class Decoder: 0.5%
[*] Check the rate details on the official homepage at http://www.csnzombies.com/[/list]

[b]Guaranteed Giveaway[/b][list][*]You can collect points each time you use a decoder. When you collect enough points, you can exchange them for a Transcendence Class.
  - 1 point every time you use 1 Class Decoder
  - 3 points every time you use 1 Premium Class Decoder
  - When you reach 150 points and 300 points, you can choose either Boss David Black or Special Agent Criss. Point rewards can only be earned once per account.[/list]

[b]Notice[/b][list][*] The contents of the Decoder will change when the promotion ends.
[*] Unused Premium Class Decoders will be exchanged for 50 Mileage each during maintenance on 11/11.
[*] Class Decoders will not be removed, but Boss David Black and Special Agent Criss will no longer appear after the promotion ends.[/list]


[u][h3]Season 7 New Transcendence Class Medal Giveaway (10/28 - Permanent)[/h3][/u]If you own all of the following items, you can obtain the medal. The medal can only be obtained once per account. 

[b]Medal Given[/b][list][*] [Honor] Secret Agent[/list]

[b]Items Required[/b][list][*] Boss David Black + Black's Sunglasses
[*] Special Agent Criss + Criss' Military Cap[/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: October 7th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/90170341aed9f970ac74b6f1909da004b4ef715b.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!

[list][b]Content: Season 7 Psychic Punk (10/7 - 12/23)[/b]
The new season, psychic punk, is here. You can find neon signs and futuristic accessories in Season 7. There are also many changes such as updates to the Karma system, skill changes, balance changes, and so on. Check them in the game now.
	
[b]Content: League System Revamp[/b]
The league system has been revamped and will run in seasons. The first season, Zombie League Season 1, will run until 11/25. This season will be a trial run and there may be changes made mid-season. We plan to run various league seasons besides Zombie League in the future.
	
[b]Content: Build Marker Release[/b]
We've added the Build Marker, which allows you to designate areas and easily edit them. To celebrate its release, we are giving away Build Marker, Build Minigun, and Build Scanner licenses for free when you play at least 30 minutes in Studio Creation Mode.

[b]Promotion: Negev NG-7 Ajax Promotion (10/7 - 11/25)[/b]
During the promotion, enjoy 3x drop rates for the Transcendence Weapons, Negev NG-7 Ajax and M3 Black Dragon. Once the promotion is over, M3 Black Dragon will become permanently available.[/list]

Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.


[b][h1]Expanded Info[/h1][/b]
[h1]Contents[/h1]
[b]Season 7: Psychic Punk (10/7 - 12/23)[/b]
The new season has arrived with the psychic punk theme. Feel the future in Season 7 with fancy neon signs, futuristic accessories, and retro style.
[list][*] Main Rewards
[list][*] Growing Weapon: Plasma Rifle MK-1, Plasma Rifle MK-2, Tiamat MK-3, and Tiamat MK-4
[*] Zombie Costumes: Android Light Zombie and Boombox Stamper
[*] Weapon Paints: Cyber Neon Weapon Paint and Psychedelic Weapon Paint
[*] Costume: Cyber Helmet, Combat Mask, Hover Board, Hover Wings, Cube Bot, and Pulse
[*] Sprays: Boss David Black Spray, Android Light Zombie Spray, Boombox Stamper Spray, Special Agent Criss Spray, and Psychic Punk CS Spray
[*] Medals: Season 7 Trailblazer Medal and Season 7 Conqueror Medal[/list][/list]

[b]Season 7: Zombie Contents[/b]
Various changes will be applied to Season 7 zombie contents.
[list][*] Karma System Update
[list][*] Both Human and Zombie Teams can now fill the Karma gauge.
[*] Zombie Team Karma Effects
[list][*] Zombie Team Stage 1 Karma Effect: Ignore stuns and knockback for 2.5 sec
[*] Zombie Team Stage 2 Karma Effect: Ignore damage, stuns, and knockback for 5 sec (cannot move)
[*] Zombie Team Stage 3 Karma Effect: Can play as a Hero Zombie[/list]
[*] Newly Added Sub-Effects per Each Karma Stage
[list][*] Between Stages 0 and 1: Can select a weapon/zombie 3 levels higher than your level, respectively
[*] Between Stages 1 and 2: Can select a weapon/zombie 6 levels higher than your level, respectively
[*] Between Stages 2 and 3: Can obtain all human/zombie mutations, respectively[/list][/list] 
[*] Zombie Z Balance Adjustments
[list][*] There will now be a cap for the EXP that can be obtained from taking damage as a zombie in Zombie Z mode, based on the distance between you and the human that damaged you.
[*] Lowered the unlock level for early-/mid-game weapons and zombies overall. (Raised for some weapons and zombies)[/list]
[*] Added new mutation and adjusted mutation balance 
[list][*] New Human Team Mutation
[list][*] Bomb Defense: Reduces the damage and knockback taken from Zombie Bombs[/list]
[*] Balance Adjustment
[list][*] Contact Infection: Changed so that infection occurs when you maintain contact for a short time, instead of infecting immediately upon making contact
[*] Endurance: Increased the proc rates and reduced the duration for the Endurance mutation.[/list][/list][/list]

[b]Zombie Evolution Content Update[/b]
Various changes are applied to Zombie Evolution mode.
[list][*] Changes
[list][*] Added Zombie Evolution medals
[*] Added Zombie Evolution daily and weekly missions
[*] Added Zombie Evolution Studio Mode, as well as 2 Studio maps (Dust+ and Assault+)
[*] The more zombies exist, the longer the respawn wait time becomes
[*] Extended the wait time between one round's end and the next round's start to 15 sec
[*] You can now open the results window (F key) while waiting between rounds
[*] Zombie vision (N key) now maintains its on/off status throughout a match
[*] The skill sound now plays in 1st person view when a human uses an additional skill[/list]
[*] Balance changes for humans' additional skills
[list][*] Reduced cooldown for Light Zombie and Ganymede skills: 18 sec -> 16 sec
[*] Reduced cooldown for Voodoo Zombie skill: 20 sec -> 18 sec
[*] Reduced cooldown for Stamper skill: 20 sec -> 16 sec
[*] Increased cooldown for Jiangshi Zombie skill: 28 sec -> 30 sec
[*] Reduced secondary weapon attack power granted by Jiangshi Zombie skill: 80% -> 60%
[*] Increased movement speed granted by Venom Sting skill: 5 -> 7
[*] Increased damage of Venom Sting's Shadow Attack skill: 800 -> 950
[*] Reduced Slot 4 equipment attack power granted by Blotter skill: 50% -> 10%
[*] Reduced cooldown for Rusty Wing skill: 22 sec -> 20 sec
[*] Reduced the wings' HP for Rusty Wing skill: 400 -> 100
[*] Increased cooldown for Psycho Zombie skill: 12 sec -> 13 sec
[*] Reduced the Zombie Countermeasure Vaccine toss interval for Psycho Zombie skill: 0.5 -> 0.4
[*] Increased cooldown for Deimos skill: 22 sec -> 24 sec
[*] Increased the duration of the zombie attack lock inflicted by Deimos skill: 3 sec -> 4 sec[/list]
[*] Mutant Zombie balance changes
[list][*] Reduced HP recovered while resting as Brutus and Arachne
[*] Slightly reduced defense for Brutus
[*] Slightly increased duration of Charge for Brutus
[*] Slightly increased cooldown of Charge for Brutus
[*] Slightly reduced the Zombie Hound summon cooldown for Brutus
[*] Reduced the Zombie Hound HP for Brutus
[*] Slightly reduced the Zombie Hound attack power for Brutus[/list]
[*] Zombie Balance Fix
[list][*] The movement speed and jump boost granted by Berserk is now the same for all virus levels[/list]
[*] Skill Changes
[list][*] Venom Guard: New skill "Zombie Explosion" and buff added
[*] Aksha: Discharge skill changed and buff added[/list][/list]

[b]League System Revamp[/b]
The league system is being completely revamped. Leagues now run in seasons. You can see the current league status under the profile screen.
[list][*] League Changes
[list][*] Leagues will run in seasons. These seasons are separate from the existing Season Pass.
[*] In the Hall of Fame, you can see the points and weapons of the top 500 players in the league.
[*] You can earn League Points to increase your league rank. League Points can be obtained when you play the featured modes in the league. Please beware that you will not get points if abnormal activity is detected during your gameplay.
[list][*] League Ranks: Master > Diamond > Platinum > Gold > Silver > Bronze
[*] Only the top 500 players can achieve the Master rank.
[*] The more people play together, the easier it is to earn League Points.[/list][/list] 
[*] League Season Operation Rules
[list][*] While the first league will be a Zombie League, we plan to feature various modes in the future.
[*]League duration may be different for each league, but they will be updated at about a 4-week interval by default.
[*]The points required to advance in league ranks may be changed in the future. [/list][/list]

[b][Trial] Zombie League Season 1 (10/7 - 11/25)[/b]
Zombie League Season 1 will be the first of the revamped leagues. Zombie League Season 1 will be a trial run. We ask for your understanding that its schedule or details may change.
[list][*] Zombie League Featured Modes: Zombie (AI), Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, Zombie Evolution, and Studio Zombie

[*] League Rewards
[list][*] Master Rank: Zombie League Master Zombification + Gungnir (15 Days) + Axion (15 Days) + Aetheris (15 Days)
[*] Diamond Rank: Zombie League Diamond Spray + Holy Sword Divine Order (15 Days) + Female Student Light Zombie (15 Days)
[*] Platinum Rank: Zombie League Nameplate + Dual Beretta Gunslinger (15 Days) + Nurse Venom Sting (15 Days)
[*] Gold Rank: Infinity Laser Fist (15 Days) + Mummy Stamper (15 Days)
[*] Silver Rank: Trinity Grenade (15 Days) + Chef Heavy Zombie (15 Days)[/list]
[*] Zombie League Master Zombification: Changes the special effect when you revive as a zombie in Zombie Mode. It will be removed if you drop out of Master rank or if the season ends.[/list]

[b]Studio Creation Mode Improvement Pt. 2[/b]
Various improvements have been made to Studio Creation Mode.
[list][*] Added Build Marker, a New Creation Tool
[list][*] You can create an area by designating the location for two markers. Left-click to place markers, and right-click to retrieve the markers.
[*] The area created can be filled or erased with the Build Rifle or the Build Minigun. You can only fill the area with blocks that are 1x1x1 in size and have a block cost of 0.
[*] If you use the Build Scanner, you can also copy the area you created and paste it into another location.[/list]
[*] Quick Menu Improvements
[list][*] Ghost Mode: Ghost Mode and Zero Gravity mode have been merged. The player becomes semitransparent, can pass through all objects, and becomes invincible.
[*] Speed Mode: Allows you to move faster than the default speed. It is also possible to adjust your movement speed.
[*] Camera Settings: Isometric view has been added. You can also zoom in/out with the mouse wheel.
[*] Show Device Tree View: You can see all device blocks currently placed in the Studio map in a single glance as a tree view.
[*] Player Settings: A menu that includes various creation convenience features has been added.[/list]
[*] Sounds Added: 30 new sound effects and 12 new music tracks have been added.[/list][/list]

[h1]Events[/h1]
[b]Find the Zombie Event (10/7 - 10/28)[/b]
There are 16 characters on the board, and 12 of them are zombies. Snipe the zombies to get rewards. Press "Find the Zombie" on the bottom of the Lobby screen to play.
[list][*] Bullet Giveaway
[list][*] For every 30 minutes of game login time every day during the event, you will receive 1 bullet. (There's no limit to how many you can obtain a day.)[/list]
[*] Detailed Rules
[list][*] When you guess where a zombie is, your reward grade goes up by 1, up to a total of 13. When you snipe a human, your reward grade goes down by 1. The higher grade you receive, the better rewards you will get.
[*] You can claim your reward by pressing Surrender or sniping all zombies, then pressing the Claim Reward button.
[*] To snipe a zombie, you need bullets. Bullets can be earned from events or purchased from the Shop.[/list][/list]

[b]BALROG IS BACK (10/7 - 11/25)[/b]
Various changes will be applied to the BALROG series weapons.
[list][*] Temporary Changes
[list][*] During the event, damage will be increased and Zombie Z unlock level will be decreased for BALROG Blue series weapons.[/list]
[*] Permanent Changes
[list][*] You can now equip parts on BALROG series weapons.
[*] List of Weapons Affected: BALROG-I Blue, BALROG-III Blue, BALROG-V Blue, BALROG-VII Blue, BALROG-IX Blue, BALROG-XI Blue, BALROG-I, BALROG-III, BALROG-V, and BALROG-VII[/list][/list]

[b]Golden Zombie Kill Rewards Update (10/7 - 12/23)[/b]
Rewards for killing the Golden Zombie, which appears randomly in Zombie Scenario, have been updated.
[list][*] Rewards per Kill (You can earn 3 kills a day)
[list][*] 1 Kill: AK-47 Paladin
[*] 2 Kills: M4A1 Dark Knight
[*] 3 Kills: SG552 Lycanthrope
[*] 5 Kills: Python Desperado
[*] 7 Kills: Red Dragon Cannon
[*] 10 Kills: AUG Guardian[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] The Golden Zombie has a chance to appear when you play at least 3 minutes on Normal difficulty or higher. Hitting it once counts as one kill.
[*] Kill rewards can be claimed once per account.[/list][/list]

[b]Season Badge Giveaway (10/7 - 12/23)[/b]
Earn Season Badges by staying logged in. You can receive up to 30 a day.
[list][*] Rewards 
[list][*] 30 minutes of login time: Season Badge x3
[*] 60 minutes of login time: Season Badge x3
[*] 90 minutes of login time: Season Badge x6
[*] 120 minutes of login time: Season Badge x6
[*] 150 minutes of login time: Season Badge x12[/list][/list]

[b]Triple Studio Build License Giveaway (10/7 - Permanent)[/b]
To celebrate the Build Marker's release, you will receive 3 Build License items when you reach 30 minutes of playtime in Studio Creation Mode.
[list][*] Rewards
[list][*] Build Minigun License
[*] Build Scanner License
[*] Build Marker License[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] The above licenses can be received once per account.
[*] You will only receive licenses that you don't already own.
[*] You can use the Build Marker if you have a VVIP Pass.[/list][/list]

[b]Wait! Take This Special Weapon Event (10/7 - 10/28)[/b]
You can receive rewards when you reach 20/40/80 minutes of playtime each day during the event.
[list][*] Requirements
[list][*] Rewards granted after 20, 40, and 80 minutes of play time each day during the event.[/list]
[*] Rewards
One of the following is given at random. It can be used for 60 minutes starting from the time you receive it.
[list][*] Lightning Fury
[*] Magnum Launcher
[*] Holy Sword Divine Order
[*] Psychic Harmonium
[*] Infinity Laser Fist
[*] X-TRACKER
[*] Dual Sword Phantom Slayer
[*] Dual Beretta Gunslinger
[*] Barrett M95 White Tiger
[*] Trinity Grenade
[*] Dual Sword Infernal Hunter
[*] M3 Black Dragon[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] Item expiration timers count down even if you don't use the weapon.
[*] Earning the same item a second time will extend its timer by 60 minutes.
[*] Only counts in rooms with 4 or more players.[/list][/list]

[b]Boss Rush to 10/28 Clear Reward Event (10/7 - 10/28)[/b]
Clear a Zombie Scenario map every day to get rewards.
[list][*] Rewards (Clear counts are reset daily)
[list][*] 1 Clear: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x1
[*] 2 Clears: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x2
[*] 3 Clears: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x3[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] Participation counts only when you play for at least 5 minutes in a room with 4 or more players on Normal or above difficulty.
[*] You can obtain up to 6 reward boxes per day, up to a total of 100 during the event period.[/list][/list]

[b]Boss Rush to 10/28 Event (10/7 - 10/28)[/b]
You can receive rewards based on the number of times you kill each season's boss in Zombie Scenario Mode during the event.
[list][*] Conditions and Rewards
Rewards are given for defeating each boss below 5 times and again at 10 times.
[list][*] Defeat boss Oberon in Season 1 Track: Dead End to receive Power Up Part - Grade 5 x1
[*] Defeat boss Dione in Season 2 Track: Poisonous Wound to receive Speed Up Part - Grade 5 x1
[*] Defeat boss Fallen Titan in Season 3 Track: First Contact to receive Vampiric Part - Grade 5 x1
[*] Defeat boss Frozen Wrath in Season 4 Track: Unexpected Encounter to receive Critical Part - Grade 5 x1
[*] Defeat boss Laser Wing in Season 5 Pursuit: Omen to receive Knife Reach Part - Grade 5 x1
[*] Defeat boss Mr. X in Season 6 Pursuit: Ep. Ji Yoon Choi to receive Health Up Part - Grade 5 x1
[*] Defeat boss Colossus in Season 7 Pursuit: Total War to receive Gun Boost Part - Grade 5 x1[/list]
[*] Notes
[list][*] Participation counts only when you play for at least 5 minutes in a room with 4 or more players on Hard 1 or above difficulty.
[*] Event rewards can be obtained only once per account.[/list][/list]

[b]Free Daily Rewards Event (10/7 - 10/28)[/b]
The Free Daily Rewards list has been updated. New/returning players will receive the same rewards as regular players.
[list][*] Conditions
[list][*] Log into the game and reach 10 minutes of playtime[/list]
[*] Rewards
[list][*] Daily Reward: 50 Mileage
[*] 3 Days: 2,000 Mileage
[*] 6 Days: 2,000 Mileage
[*] 9 Days: 3,000 Mileage
[*] 12 Days: 3,000 Mileage
[*] 15 Days: 5,000 Mileage[/list][/list]

[h1]Shop[/h1]
[b]Negev NG-7 Ajax Promotion (10/7 - 11/25)[/b]
During the promotion, enjoy 3x drop rates for the Transcendence Weapons, Negev NG-7 Ajax and M3 Black Dragon. Once the promotion is over, M3 Black Dragon will become permanently available.
[list][*] Transcendence Weapon Drop Rate
[list][*] Transcendence Premium Decoder (3x Rate Up)
[list][*] Negev NG-7 Ajax: 3.0 % (3x Rate Up)
[*] M3 Black Dragon: 3.0% (3x Rate Up)[/list]
[*] Transcendence Decoder
[list][*] Negev NG-7 Ajax: 0.45 % (3x Rate Up)
[*] M3 Black Dragon: 0.45 % (3x Rate Up)[/list]
[*] Check the rate details on the official homepage at http://www.csnzombies.com/.[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] After the promotion ends, drop rates for M3 Black Dragon will return to their default rates.
[*] The contents of the Decoder may change when the promotion ends.
[*] All unused Transcendence Premium Decoders will be removed during maintenance on 11/25. They will be replaced with 500 Mileage each. However, the Transcendence Decoders will not be removed.[/list][/list]

[b]Studio License Product Change (10/7 - Permanent)[/b]
Build Marker License will be added to the Shop. Also, Build Marker will be added to the Studio License package.

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: September 16th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e80b2e8d98d31ce3d8b1919f9351b96d1025d0c8.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!

[list][b]Event: Overcoming the Zombie Virus Event (9/16 - 10/7)[/b]
You can get Overcome Factor Points for playing the game in designated modes during the event. Collect points to gain various rewards.

[b]Event: Wait! Take This Special Weapon Event (9/16 - 10/7)[/b]
You can receive rewards when you reach 30/60/90 minutes of playtime each day during the event. The special weapon can be used for 60 minutes starting from the time you get it.

[b]Promotion: Miracle Prism Sword Promotion (9/16 - 10/7)[/b]
During the promotion, you can get the new Unique Weapon, Miracle Prism Sword. Its rates will be increased 5x during the promotion.[/list]

Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.


[u][h1]Expanded Info[/h1][/u]
[h1]Contents[/h1]
[b]Other Changes[/b]
[list][*] Fixed minor bugs[/list]

[h1]Events[/h1]
[b]Overcoming the Zombie Virus Event (9/16 - 10/7)[/b]
You can get Overcome Factor Points for playing the game in designated modes during the event. Collect points to gain various rewards.
[list][*] Event Rules
[list][*] You earn 1 Overcome Factor Point for each minute you play in one of the featured modes.
[*] The Overcome Factor Point is randomly distributed between 8 gauges, with each gauge having a different chance of receiving points. (Each gauge has a different chance to be selected.)
[*] Reward given when you accumulate 10 points in a gauge.[/list]
[*] Featured Modes
[list][*] Zombie Hero
[*] Zombie Z
[*] Zombie Evolution
[*] Zombie Scenario[/list]
[*] Gauge Types and Rewards
[list][*] Class Decoder (x1) Gauge
[*] Premium Class Decoder (x1) Gauge
[*] Transcendence Decoder (x1) Gauge
[*] Transcendence Premium Decoder (x1) Gauge
[*] Grade 5 Parts Reward Box (x1) Gauge
[*] Grade 4 Parts Reward Box (x1) Gauge
[*] VVIP Free Pass (1 Day) Gauge
[*] Parts Weapon Selection Box (x1) Gauge[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] You can earn at most 100 Overcome Factor Points a day (1,500 Overcome Factor Points during the event).
[*] When you reach a total of 1,500 points, you will receive one of each reward.
[*] Counts in rooms with 4 or more players.
[*] Also counts in Studio Mode.
[*] Unused Transcendence Premium Decoders and Premium Class Decoders will be removed during the maintenance on 10/7.[/list][/list]


[b]Wait! Take This Special Weapon Event (9/16 - 10/7)[/b]
You can receive rewards when you reach 30/60/90 minutes of playtime each day during the event.
[list][*] Requirements
[list][*] Rewards granted after 30, 60, and 90 minutes of play time each day during the event.[/list]
[*] Rewards
One of the following is given at random. It can be used for 60 minutes starting from the time you receive it.
[list][*] Lightning Fury
[*] Magnum Launcher
[*] Holy Sword Divine Order
[*] Psychic Harmonium
[*] Infinity Laser Fist
[*] X-TRACKER
[*] Dual Sword Phantom Slayer
[*] Dual Beretta Gunslinger
[*] Barrett M95 White Tiger
[*] Trinity Grenade
[*] Dual Sword Infernal Hunter
[*] M3 Black Dragon[/list]
[*]Notice
[list][*] Item expiration timers count down even if you don't use the weapon.
[*] Earning the same item a second time will extend its timer by 60 minutes.
[*] Only counts in rooms with 4 or more players.[/list][/list]

[h1]Shop[/h1]
[b]Miracle Prism Sword Promotion (9/16 - 10/7)[/b]
During the promotion, you can get the new Unique Weapon, Miracle Prism Sword. Its rates will be increased 5x during the promotion.
[list][*] Miracle Prism Sword Drop Rate
[list][*] Unique Premium Decoder: 5.0% (5x Rate Up)
[*] Unique Decoder: 1.0 % (5x Rate Up)
[*] Check the rate details on the official homepage at http://www.csnzombies.com/.[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] After the promotion ends, drop rates will return to their default rates.[/list][/list]

[i][b]2020-09-09 09:10 A.M. CEST Update:[/b][list][*] The scheduled Regular Maintenance for September 9th has been completed. Thank you for your patience throughout. You may enter the battlefields.[/list][/i]
------------------------------------------------------
