notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: September 2nd
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e80b2e8d98d31ce3d8b1919f9351b96d1025d0c8.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!

[list][b][*]Studio Creation Mode Improvement Pt. 1[/b]The map creator subscription system has been added to the game. UI related to map information, likes, and cheer has been improved. You can also recommend a studio map by pressing the F3 key, even during gameplay.

[b][*]Event: Random Weapon Zombie Evolution (9/2 - 9/16)[/b]During the event, Random Weapon Zombie Evolution will be available.

[b][*]Event: Mileage Auction Event (9/2 - 9/16)[/b]Buy and sell weapons and parts in the Mileage Auction House during the event!

[b][*]Event: Dual Sword Infernal Hunter Giveaway (9/2 - 9/16)[/b]Obtain points by scoring kills or assists in featured modes. Unlock a reward for every 10 points. If you kill the Golden Zombie in Zombie Scenario, you'll get 10 points at once!

[b][*]Promotion: Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box Promotion (9/2 - 10/7)[/b]During the promotion, you can get the Eternity Laser Fist, a variation of the Infinity Laser Fist, and the Dual Sword Phantom Slayer from a Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box. When you use 10 Lucky Transcendence Weapon Boxes, you can get 2 boxes for free.[/list]

Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.


[u][h1]Expanded Info[/h1][/u]
[h1]Contents[/h1]

[b]Off-Season Period[/b]
Season 6 has ended, and the next season has not started yet. Several changes applied during Season 6 have been reverted. Please look forward to our next season!

[b]Studio Creation Mode Improvement Pt. 1[/b]
Various improvements have been made to Studio Creation Mode.
[list][*] Subscription System Added
[list][*] Map User
[list][*] You can press the Subscribe button to subscribe to the map creator.
[*] You will also automatically subscribe when you press the Like, Bookmark, or Cheer buttons. This feature can be turned on or off in the Manage Subscription screen.[/list]
[*] Map Creator
[list][*] You can access the Manage Subscriptions menu under the Create tab.
[*] In the Manage Subscriptions menu, you can see your current subscribers and manage Subscription Notifications, as well as send notification messages to subscribers through Write Subscription Notification.
[*] After sending a notification to your subscribers, you must wait one week to send another.[/list][/list]
[*] Improved the Map Info window, as well as the Like and Cheer UI.
[*] You can press the F3 key to recommend a creator's map. You can use this feature even while you are playing in the map or in the results window after playing.[/list]

[b]Updates to the New/Welcome Back Supply Box[/b]
Updated the rewards for new/returning players.
[list][*] Supplies List
[list][*] Transcendence Fernando + Refined Holy Water Grenade (100 Days)
[*] Transcendence Blair + Dark Legacy Luger (100 Days)
[*] CSer Settlement Support Weapon Box x1[/list]
[*] CSer Settlement Support Weapon Box Contents
[list][*] Magnum Launcher (15 Days)
[*] Dual Beretta Gunslinger (15 Days)
[*] Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (30 Days)
[*] M3 Black Dragon (30 Days)
[*] Grade 5 Parts x16
[*] Parts Weapon Selection Box x10[/list][/list]

[b]Other Changes[/b]
[list][*] Fixed minor bugs[/list]


[h1]Events[/h1]
[b]Random Weapon Zombie Evolution (9/2 - 9/16)[/b]
During the event, Random Weapon Zombie Evolution will be available.
[list][*] Featured Maps
[list][*] Zombie Junk House, Italy, Abyss 2, Assault, Joseon Marketplace, Estate, and Dust[/list]
[*] Weapon Update
[list][*] SCAR OZ-D, Void Avenger, and Infernal Cannon[/list][/list]

[b]Mileage Auction Event (9/2 - 9/16)[/b]
Buy and sell weapons and parts in the Mileage Auction House during the event!
[list][*] Auction Period
[list][*] Each day between 12:00 and 23:59, from maintenance on 9/2 until 9/16[/list][/list]

[b]Evolution One More Time! (9/2 - 10/7)[/b]
Celebrate the release of Zombie Evolution by logging in to receive rewards.
[list][*] Requirements
[list][*] Reward given upon logging into the game during the event (once per account)[/list]
[*] Reward (Select 1 of the following)
[list][*] X-TRACKER (15 Days)
[*] Infinity Laser Fist (15 Days)
[*] Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (15 Days)
[*] Dual Beretta Gunslinger (15 Days)
[*] Barrett M95 White Tiger (15 Days)[/list][/list]

[b]Dual Sword Infernal Hunter Giveaway (9/2 - 9/16)[/b]
Earn points in featured modes to get rewards.
[list][*] Requirements
[list][*] You get 1 point when you score 1 kill or 1 assist in the featured modes below.
[*] Featured Modes: Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, Zombie Evolution, and Random Weapon Zombie Evolution[/list]
[*] Rewards
[list][*] Total 10 Points: X-TRACKER (7 Days)
[*] Total 20 Points: Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (7 Days)
[*] Total 30 Points: Dual Beretta Gunslinger (7 Days)
[*] Total 50 Points: Barrett M95 White Tiger (7 Days)
[*] Total 70 Points: Infinity Laser Fist (7 Days)
[*] Total 100 Points: Dual Sword Infernal Hunter (Permanent)[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] Each account can only receive rewards once.
[*] You can accrue up to 10 points a day.
[*] After you kill the Golden Zombie, you must end the match normally for it to count towards the event.
[*] You can only make progress in rooms with 8 or more players.
[*] You are unable to participate in Studio Mode.[/list][/list]

[b]Free Daily Rewards Event (9/2 - 10/7)[/b]
The Free Daily Rewards list has been updated.
[list][*] Regular Players
[list][*] Conditions
[list][*] Play the game for more than 10 minutes[/list]
[*] Rewards
[list][*] Daily Reward: 50 Mileage
[*] 3-Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x15
[*] 7-Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x20
[*] 15-Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x25
[*] 20-Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x7
[*] 25-Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x8[/list][/list]

[*] New and Returning Players
[list][*] Conditions
[list][*] Survivors who have not logged in for the past 30 days or have logged in for the very first time during the event must reach 10 minutes of play time[/list]
[*] Rewards
[list][*] Daily Reward: Daily Supplies x1
[*] 1-Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x5
[*] 3-Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x10
[*] 5-Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x15
[*] 7-Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5
[*] 15-Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x6[/list][/list][/list]

[h1]Shop[/h1]
[b]Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box Promotion (9/2 - 10/7)[/b]
During the promotion, you can get an Eternity Laser Fist, a variant of the Infinity Laser Fist, and a Dual Sword Phantom Slayer from a Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box. After the promotion ends, Dual Sword Phantom Slayer will be added as an item permanently available from the Transcendence Decoder.
[list][*] Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box Rates
[list][*] Eternity Laser Fist: 5% (5x Rate Up)
[*] Dual Sword Phantom Slayer: 3% (3x Rate Up)
[*] Check the rate details on the official homepage at http://www.csnzombies.com/.[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] All unused Lucky Transcendence Weapon Boxes will be replaced with 1,000 Mileage each during maintenance on 10/7.[/list][/list]

[b]Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box Bonus Giveaway (9/2 - 10/7)[/b]
Every time you open 10 Lucky Transcendence Weapon Boxes, you will receive 2 additional boxes.

[b]Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box First Purchase Discount Event (9/2 - 10/7)[/b]
A Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box can be purchased at a 50% discount one-time only. (The discount rate may change depending on the currency.)

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: August 5th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/011ad920c6adc879ddab40fba34902b7afef07d3.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!

[list][*][b]New Game Mode: Zombie Evolution[/b]
It's our first new game mode in a while. Experience the evolution of battle between humans and zombies in the newly added map, Zombie Junk House.

[*][b]Event: Zombie Evolution Launch Celebration[/b]
Complete daily missions during the event and get various rewards, such as Epic Decoders. We'll also hold events where you can get Transcendent Living Weapons and Special Weapons, so don't miss out.
	
[*][b]Event: Zombie Evolution Welcome Event (8/5 - 8/19)[/b]
New and returning players get an extra reward! Get a Zombie Evolution Reward Box, with various items in it, just by playing for 10 minutes. The Parts Weapon Selection Box that you can get as a gift has also been upgraded.

[*][b]Shop: Unique Magic Rod Weapons Rate-Up Promotion (8/5 - 8/19)[/b]
To celebrate the launch of Zombie Evolution, the rates for Shining Heart Rod and Starlight Rolling Shooter will be increased x3.[/list]

Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.


[u][h1]Expanded Info[/h1][/u]
[h1]Contents[/h1]

[b]New Zombie Evolution Mode Update[/b]
It's our first new game mode in a while! Join this endlessly evolving battle between humans and zombies, where the S Virus changes everything.
[list][*] Background
[list][*] Despite efforts to stop Kronos Inc.'s Super Soldier Project, experiments continued. The S Virus, a new pathogen based on the Z Virus, has been discovered.
[*] In small quantities, the S Virus lets humans use the powerful abilities of zombies without losing their intellect.
[*] Kronos has been creating powerful boss zombies using the new virus. Agents tried their best to prevent this, but the S Virus was leaked during this process.
[*] Now, a new battle between two sides using the S Virus unfolds.[/list]
[*] New Zombie Evolution Map
[list][*] Zombie Junk House[/list]
[*] Basic Rules
[list][*] Win Conditions
[list][*] Zombies: Infect all humans
[*] Humans: Survive until the round ends[/list]
[*] New Rule
[list][*] Zombies get infinite respawns. However, the respawn timer is increased if killed by Deadly Shot.
[*] You can use powerful abilities by collecting and using S Virus.[/list][/list]
[*] Obtaining the Virus
[list][*] Humans: Obtain S Virus when you score zombie kills or assists, or when you survive for a certain duration. The less humans remaining, the more you obtain.
[*] Zombies: Obtain virus when you infect humans, or when you score human kills or assists. You can also get virus from Virus Essence that other zombies leave when they die.[/list]
[*] Virus Stages
[list][*] Your virus stage is displayed in the center of the screen. Virus stage tops out at stage 10 and persists until the end of the match.[/list]
[*] Virus Effects
[list][*] Your basic stats increase with your virus stage. (You can see your current stats by pressing L.) When zombies reach a high virus stage, their respawn time is slightly increased.[/list]
[*] Virus Injection
If you reach a certain virus stage (stage 2 for humans, stage 7 for zombies), press V to inject the virus into your body. This consumes virus stages but gives you new abilities.
[list][*] Humans: Can inject up to 2 times to randomly obtain a zombie ability. This also grants a resistance to infection from zombies. The virus disappears from your body over time.
[*] Zombie: Injecting the virus will transform you into a powerful mutant zombie. There are 2 types of mutant zombies, chosen at random.
[list][*] Brutus: Has strong HP and Defense. Though it is slow, it is not knocked back or stunned by normal guns.
[*] Arachne: Has a skill that allows quick movement. It can attack humans with double-jump and use spider webs to move in unexpected ways.[/list][/list][/list]

[b]Updates to the New/Welcome Back Supply Box[/b]
Supplies for new and returning players have been updated. 
[list][*] Supply Contents
[list][*] Transcendence Fernando + Refined Holy Water Grenade (100 Days)
[*] Transcendence Blair + Dark Legacy Luger (100 Days)
[*] CSer Settlement Support Weapon Box x1
[list][*] Magnum Launcher (15 Days)
[*] Holy Sword Divine Order (15 Days)
[*] Dual Sword Infernal Hunter (30 Days)
[*] M3 Black Dragon (30 Days)
[*] Grade 5 Parts x16
[*] Parts Weapon Selection Box x10[/list][/list][/list]

[b]Parts Weapon Selection Box Update[/b]
Added items to the list of items that can be obtained from the Parts Weapon Selection Box. 
[list][*] Added Items
[list][*] Tornado
[*] Rail Cannon
[*] Rail Buster
[*] Flame Jackhammer
[*] Hunter-Killer X-45
[*] Hunter-Killer X-7
[*] Hunter-Killer X-15
[*] Hunter-Killer X-90[/list][/list]

[b]Other Changes[/b]
[list][*] Gun Deathmatch Improvements
[list][*] Display ally outlines
[*] Added bot option[/list]
[*] Original Bot Improvement
[list][*] Equipment can be purchased for bots[/list]
[*] Bot AI Improvement
[list][*] When you collide with a bot, you can push the bot away
[*] Expanded the classes and weapons used by bots[/list]
[*] Fixed minor bugs[/list]

[h1]Events[/h1]

[b]Zombie Evolution Launch Celebration (8/5 - 9/2)[/b]
Accomplish daily missions given during the event. Each day in which you complete a mission counts towards your rewards. Please note that the types of rewards are different in each event period and that the cumulative days are reset at the end of each period.
[list][*] Daily Mission
[list][*] Activate special skills in Zombie Evolution to reach mutation level 50 (Can achieve only once a day)
[*] Collect virus in-game and pressing the V key.[/list]
[*] Event Period Schedule and Rewards
[list][*] Round 1: 8/5 - 8/11
[list][*] Day 1: Select 1 from Reward A
[*] Day 2: Select 2 from Reward A
[*] Day 3: Select 3 from Reward A
[*] Day 4: Select 4 from Reward A
[*] Day 5: Select 3 from 16 Grade 5 Parts[/list][/list]
[list][*] Round 2: 8/12 - 8/18
[list][*] Day 1: Select 1 from Reward A
[*] Day 2: Select 2 from Reward A
[*] Day 3: Select 3 from Reward A
[*] Day 4: Select 4 from Reward A
[*] Day 5: Select 1 of the following weapons
[list][*] Epic Weapons: Gungnir (1 Day), Dread Nova (1 Day), or Heaven Splitter (1 Day)
[*] Transcendence Weapons: Hellhound (3 Days), Lightning Fury (3 Days), or Psychic Harmonium (3 Days)[/list][/list][/list]
[list][*] Round 3: 8/19 - 8/25

[*] Notice
[list][*] Rooms with 3 or more players will count toward event progress.
[*] Reward items from the Transcendence Chest have a random enhancement.
[*] All unused reward boxes will be removed during maintenance on 10/7 (Wed.)[/list][/list]

[b]Zombie Evolution Welcome Event (8/5 - 8/19)[/b]
When you reach 10 minutes of Zombie Evolution play time during the event, you can get the Zombie Evolution Reward Box.
[list][*] Zombie Evolution Reward Box Contents
[list][*] 6 Weapon Package (15 Days)
[*] 9 Weapon Package (15 Days)
[*] 1000 Mileage Coupon x5
[*] Rare Decoder x10
[*] Class Decoder x10
[*] Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (7 Days)
[*] Barrett M95 White Tiger (7 Days)
[*] Dual Beretta Gunslinger (7 Days)[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] Only new/returning accounts can participate. Rewards can be claimed once per account.
[*] You can only make progress in rooms with 3 or more players.
[*] Any unused Zombie Evolution Reward Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 9/16.[/list][/list]

[b]Transcendent Living Weapon Giveaway (8/5 - 9/2)[/b]
You can receive a Transcendent Living Weapon Box as a reward upon logging into the game during the event.
[list][*] Transcendent Living Weapon Box Contents
You may select one of the following weapons.
[list][*] X-TRACKER (Transcendent Living Weapon)
[*] Infinity Laser Fist (Transcendent Living Weapon)
[*] Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (Transcendent Living Weapon)
[*] Dual Beretta Gunslinger (Transcendent Living Weapon)

[*] Transcendent Living Weapon
[list][*] Transcendent Living Weapons have a base HP of 7. When you do not log into the game, it decreases by 1 point every day.[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] Any unused Transcendent Living Weapon Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 9/2.[/list][/list]

[b]Wait! Take This Special Weapon Event (8/5 - 9/2)[/b]
When you reach 20 minutes of play time during the event, the following message will display and you will get a special item.
[list][*] Special items will be given in 10 minutes!

[*] Special Item List
Each item has a difference chance of being selected.
[list][*] Lightning Fury

[*] X-TRACKER

[*] Trinity Grenade

[*] M3 Black Dragon[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] The special item can be obtained once every day.[/list][/list]

[b]Free Daily Rewards Event (8/5 - 9/2)[/b]
The Free Daily Rewards list has been updated.
[list][*] Regular Players
[list][*] Conditions

[list][*] Rewards

[h1]Shop[/h1]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: July 22th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e80b2e8d98d31ce3d8b1919f9351b96d1025d0c8.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!

[list][*][b]New Epic Weapon: Void Avenger[/b]
The first-ever Epic Secondary Weapon, "Void Avenger", is here! Use it to fire artificial singularities perfect for crowd control.
 
[*][b]Event: Epic Fragment Giveaway/Collecting Events (7/22 - 9/2)[/b]
Collect Epic Fragments to fill up the gauge and get various rewards, such as Parts and Transcendence Weapons. Get Epic Fragments by either using the Epic Decoder or from event rewards. If you fill the gauge to 100%, you'll unlock the Epic Weapon Void Avenger. Also, if you reach the bonus goal, you'll receive the "Infernal Cannon", a variation of the Volcano.
	
[*][b]Event: Hero and Sidekick Weapons Return (7/22 - 8/5)[/b]
You'll receive 30-day temporary Hero/Sidekick weapons for meeting certain requirements during the event.

[*][b]Shop: Epic Weapon Promotion (7/22 - 9/2)[/b]
Epic Decoders will be on sale from the Shop during the promotion. When you use an Epic Decoder, you'll have a chance to obtain the "Void Avenger", as well as Advanced Epic Fragment Box items.[/list]

Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.


[u][h1]Expanded Info[/h1][/u]
[h1]Events[/h1]

[b]Epic Fragment Collecting Event (7/22 - 9/2)[/b]
You can get the new Epic Weapon "Void Avenger" by collecting Epic Fragments during the event period and filling the gauge to 100%. Also, when you reach the bonus goal, you can get the "Infernal Cannon", a variation of the weapon Volcano.
[list][*] Reward According to Gauge Fill Progress
[list][*] 3% (80 Fragments): Grade 3 Parts Reward Box x5
[*] 5% (160 Fragments): Grade 3 Parts Reward Box x10
[*] 10% (320 Fragments): Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x10
[*] 20% (640 Fragments): Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5
[*] 40% (1,280 Fragments): Bronze Box x1
[*] 60% (1,920 Fragments): Silver Box x1
[*] 80% (2,560 Fragments): Gold Box x1
[*] 100% (3,200 Fragments): Epic Box x1
[*] Bonus (3,600 Fragments): Epic Swag Box x1[/list]
[*] Box Contents
[list][*] Bronze Box (Select): Thunder Ghost Walker / Infinity Laser Fist
[*] Silver Box (Select): Dual Sword Phantom Slayer/ Barrett M95 White Tiger
[*] Gold Box (Select): Dual Beretta Gunslinger / Trinity Grenade / X-TRACKER
[*] Epic Box: Void Avenger
[*] Epic Swag Box: Infernal Cannon (Permanent) + 16 types of Grade 6 Parts[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] Rewards can only be obtained once per account and are distributed immediately upon reaching each milestone.
[*] After reaching 100%, click the button to claim your reward.
[*] All unused Epic Boxes and Epic Swag Boxes will be automatically used and exchanged with items during maintenance on 9/2.
[*] Any unused Bronze/Silver/Gold Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 10/7.[/list][/list]

[b]Epic Fragment Giveaway (7/22 - 9/2)[/b]
You'll get Epic Fragments when you log in each day during the event. You can only get them once a day per account.
[list][*] Cumulative Day 1: Epic Fragment x1
[*] Cumulative Day 2: Epic Fragment x2
[*] Cumulative Day 3: Epic Fragment x3
[*] Cumulative Day 4: Epic Fragment x4
[*] Cumulative Day 5: Epic Fragment x5
[*] Cumulative Day 6: Epic Fragment x6
[*] Cumulative Day 7: Epic Fragment x7 (restarts from Day 1 rewards after you reach Day 7)[/list]

[b]Epic Fragment Box Giveaway (7/22 - 9/2)[/b]
You'll earn Epic Fragment Boxes, each of which contains 1-4 Epic Fragments, by meeting the requirements listed below.
[list][*] Requirements
[list][*] Log in between 00:00 - 23:59 to earn 3 Epic Fragment Boxes for every 30 minutes of playtime (up to a maximum of 150 minutes per day)
[*] Get 1 Epic Fragment Box each time you score a zombie kill in Zombie Z/Zombie Hero modes (up to 30 kills per day)
[*] Get 2 Epic Fragment Boxes each time you score a Golden Zombie kill in Zombie Scenario mode (up to 3 times per day)[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] Epic Fragment boxes can be obtained up to 43 per day, up to a total of 600 during the entire event period.
[*] Only rooms with 8 or more players count toward these goals.
[*] Any Epic Fragment Boxes that haven't been used by the maintenance on 9/2 will be replaced with 15 Mileage each.[/list][/list]

[b]Epic Fragment Final Giveaway (9/2 - 9/16)[/b]
Epic Fragments that haven't been used by the time the Epic Fragment Collecting Event has ended will be replaced with Mileage.
[list][*] Epic Fragment Count and Reward
[list][*] 100 - 299 Fragments: 1,500 Mileage
[*] 300 - 599 Fragments: 3,000 Mileage
[*] 600 - 1,199 Fragments: 6,000 Mileage
[*] 1,200 - 1,799 Fragments: 12,000 Mileage
[*] 1,800 - 2,399 Fragments: 18,000 Mileage
[*] 2,400 - 2,999 Fragments: 24,000 Mileage
[*] 3,000 - 3,499 Fragments: 30,000 Mileage
[*] 3,500+ Fragments: 35,000 Mileage[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] Rewards can be obtained from after the maintenance on 9/2 until the maintenance on 9/16.
[*] There are no rewards for less than 100 Fragments.[/list][/list]

[b]Hero and Sidekick Weapons Return (7/22 - 8/5)[/b]
You'll receive temporary Hero/Sidekick weapons for meeting certain requirements during the event.
[list][*] Login Rewards
You can receive the Hero weapons when you log into the game.
[list][*] SVD Custom + Grenade Launcher (30 Days)
[*] Quad Barrel Shotgun (30 Days)
[*] Dual Kriss Custom (30 Days)
[*] M134 Vulcan (30 Days)[/list]
[*] Playtime Rewards
You'll receive Sidekick weapons when you reach certain cumulative playtime milestones in Zombie Hero/Zombie Z modes.
[list][*] Reach 150 Minutes: Dual Desert Eagles (30 Days)
[*] Reach 300 Minutes: Dual Nata Knife (30 Days)
[*] Reach 450 Minutes: Dual MP7A1 (30 Days)
[*] Reach 600 Minutes: Poison Launcher (30 Days)
[*] Reach 750 Minutes: AK-47 60R (30 Days)[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] You can accumulate up to 150 minutes of playtime a day.
[*] Only rooms with 8 or more players count toward these goals. You can receive the reward only once per account.
[*] You cannot extend the duration of the temporary weapons you receive. They will be removed during maintenance on 9/2.[/list][/list]


[h1]Shop[/h1]

[b]Epic Weapon Promotion (7/22 - 9/2)[/b]
Get the new Epic Weapon "Void Avenger" from the Epic Decoder during the promotion period!
[list][*] Rates
[list][*] Epic Weapon Probability: 0.35%
[*] Check the rate details at http://www.csnstudio.com/.[/list]
[*] Obtain Epic Fragment Box (Premium) (Advanced Epic Fragment Box) Event
[list][*] Earn 2 Advanced Epic Fragment Boxes, each of which contains 2-10 Epic Fragments, when using the Epic Decoder.[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] All boxes and decoders that haven't been used by the maintenance on 9/2 will be replaced with Mileage.
[list][*] 30 Mileage for each Advanced Epic Fragment Box
[*] 100 Mileage for each Epic Decoder[/list][/list][/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: July 8th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e80b2e8d98d31ce3d8b1919f9351b96d1025d0c8.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!

[list][*][b]Content: Studio Map Tags[/b]
Descriptive tags can now be added to studio maps and easily searched. Categories for Studio map recommendations have also been refined, so you can quickly find the maps you're looking for.
 
[*][b]Event: Bingo Event (7/8 - 7/22)[/b]
During the event, you can get Bingo Tickets based on your playtime or by using mileage. You can receive various rewards as you gradually complete the bingo board using the Bingo Tickets.
 	
[*][b]Event: Weapon Paint Contest with Global CSers (7/8 - 8/19)[/b]
We will be holding a Weapon Paint Contest where the 1st place winner's entry will be implemented as an in-game item. Please check the separate announcement for detailed information and schedule.
 
[*][b]Shop: Global Weapon Paint Discount Promotion (7/8 - 8/19)[/b]

notes.title: [Notice] Dev’s Note Regarding VoP Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b6f7445dbfb588ce0bfa03b6731e7439cd7ae329.jpg[/img]


[b]Dear Precious CSNS Fans,[/b]


First of all, thank you all for participating in our Voice of Players Events.

This opportunity has allowed us to listen to our Fans much more closely hearing your raw, yet diverse, and heartfelt opinions about our game, and it was a very rich moment to understand what our Fans were really thirsting for in detail. Every single feedback you’ve sent us will be a valuable reference for us for future developments and operations, and amongst some of the questions/concerns you’ve sent, we’ll try to answer a handful of them that will be reflected soon in development in Q&A format below.

The answered below are from the questions/concerns raised from our 712 previous CSNS Fans through the VoP Event (4/15 – 5/12) that are considered to be reflected soon undergoing development.

[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Category[/th]
        [th]Weight[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Content[/td]
        [td]11%[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Weapon[/td]
        [td]5%[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Map[/td]
        [td]2%[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Studio[/td]
        [td]2%[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Game Operations[/td]
        [td]25%[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Community[/td]
        [td]9%[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Economics[/td]
        [td]11%[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Events[/td]
        [td]26%[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Balance[/td]
        [td]9%[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

Details to improvements regarding overall game balance, bugs, and events will be shared through our future patch notes. Once again, thank you all for your valuable comments, and we will continue to do our best to communicate with our CSNS Fans to bring you the most enjoyable Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio life.

As always, thank you for your love and support.

- The CSNS Team


[h1]----- Q & As -----[/h1]

[olist][*]Do you have any plans on a new mode, or bring back/remake the old?

  - A: One of the biggest advantages of CSNS is the variety of modes, but there was a lack of updates for each mode. Modes other than mainstream mode, such as Zombie Z, will be taken more into consideration for future updates with the great ideas you have provided us with. 


[*]Do you have any plans to improve the league system or competition within families etc. in the future?

  - A: Since competitive content is very important in FPS games, the development team is always thinking about good competitive content. Also, the development team is also aware of the league abuse that many people are pointing out and the need to reorganize the league system. We are struggling with various ways to solve these problems, and we will showcase it to you with good updates in the near future.


[*]I think it is necessary to improve weapons with relatively low utility value.

  - A: First of all, we plan to gradually expand the enhancement for brand weapons, and continue to release reinforced weapons afterwards and plan to complement weapons with relatively low utility value.


[*]AI mode needs to be expanded and improved.

  - A: First, in the case of Gun Deathmatch mode, AI application is being reviewed positively as development. We aim to apply AI to various modes in addition to Gun Deathmatch mode, but currently, we are looking for ways to solve the AI's typical problems, such as the roadblocks, from various angles.


[*]In studio mode, the 'block making function' has only the basic function, and has many restrictions.

  - A: There are features (build guns) that developers too need, such as creating large buildings at once or copying and pasting. We will actively develop related functions to shorten the time required for creation.


[*]I wish I could add pre-made buildings.

  - A: We are constantly updating blocks to create a colorful studio map. Various ideas given by our Fans, such as structure blocks, will also be updated in the future.


[*]Are there any ideas of modes that users have proposed that is possible for future development? 

  - A: We were really surprised by all the ideas of modes you came up with than we thought you would. One of them is the [Zombie Scenario Map, which clears a powerful zombie at the boss level as a challenge]. We are also reviewing it positively and we plan to try to reflect it by referring to it when updating the zombie scenario in the future. We will also use other ideas as a valuable base for planning future mode-related updates as well. Please feel free to raise various ideas through our official website discussion board at any time.


[*]Can we add various background sounds and effect sounds? (Ex: “They are coming” sound)

  - A: We will provide background and effect sounds that exist in normal game mode as well in studio mode.


[*]Do you have any plan to develop functions that can respond to unfriendly/malignant user behavior?

  - A: We know that you may have had a lot of inconveniences in playing the game due to various malignant users. The development team is also aware of this problem and is investigating carefully for a countermeasure. However, we would like to hear more details about these issues. It may be a bit troublesome, but we would appreciate it if you could provide more details to our operation team.


[*]I wish we had more variety of Medal updates. Do you have any plans to update this in the future?

  - A: Yes, we do. We are planning to release new medals related to modes or items that have been relatively lacking in updates, and further update existing medals as well.


[*]Is it possible to categorize browser blocks or decorations by category?

  - A: Till now the blocks were interspersed, so you may have been very uncomfortable with your creation process. We think it is a necessary function for all of our creative creators, and we will develop it in the near future as fast as possible as well.


[*]Many users want the manufacturing system. Do you have any plans to remake or restore this? I miss the good old days of making and playing with the weapons only through gameplay.

  - A: The manufacturing system, which was able to acquire unlimited weapons through a combination of designs, was not intuitive at the time, and received feedback that it was a difficult system for new/return users who lacked prior knowledge recognition. As a result, the weapon acquisition route remains only for direct sales, auctions, etc., based on the current decoder system. Unfortunately, it is difficult to recover the manufacturing system again. However, the key is understood as the provision of a path for nonpaying users to get unlimited weapons with effort, and in the future, we will solve this part where our players feel thirsty for weapons through various events that are easy for you to participate.


[*]The fps drop is getting worse with the launch of colorful weapons, and low-end computers are becoming difficult to play. I'm curious about the opinion of the development team regarding optimization.

  - A: In order to prevent the FPS drop as much as possible, especially in the studio, the MDL exposure method was changed, but there are still engine limitations to match the height of our users. We tried to optimize by planting nxlog, but the current situation is the best.


[*]We hope that the inflation of weapons does not occur when new weapons are released. Weapon balance enhancement is required.

  - A: In the past one year, the development team's internal standards have prevented the upward trend of balance, but there is no guarantee that weapon inflation does not occur due to factors such as sales pressure and consumer expectations. 

However, in order to allow users to use various weapons in the game, we have tried to release the Zombie Z mode, which unlocks available weapons depending on the level, and parts and enhancement system updates, and the recently run 'hero/sidekick weapon return event' and '11 brand weapon series temporary enhancement event.' But it is still undeniable that we cannot easily close the gap in weapon balance between paid and non-paying users.

We will continue to struggle and seek ways to reduce this gap in the future, and first of all, we plan to expand parts and enhancement weapons and rebalance old weapons in various ways.

We would like to ask for your interest in the 'SKULL IS BACK' event that’s starting from today, June 10th, and we will set up future plans in line with the feedback from our Fans.

Lastly, in the case of new weapons, we will ensure that more skillful weapons will be released as given in the comments. We ask for your continued love.[/olist]

Thank you.

- The CSNS Team

First of all, we plan to gradually expand the enhancement for brand weapons, and continue to release reinforced weapons afterwards and plan to complement weapons with relatively low utility value.

First, in the case of Gun Deathmatch mode, AI application is being reviewed positively as development. We aim to apply AI to various modes in addition to Gun Deathmatch mode, but currently, we are looking for ways to solve the AI's typical problems, such as the roadblocks, from various angles.

There are features (build guns) that developers too need, such as creating large buildings at once or copying and pasting. We will actively develop related functions to shorten the time required for creation.
We are constantly updating blocks to create a colorful studio map. Various ideas given by our Fans, such as structure blocks, will also be updated in the future.

One of them is the [Zombie Scenario Map, which clears a powerful zombie at the boss level as a challenge]. We are positively reviewing it and we plan to try to reflect it by referring to it when updating the zombie scenario in the future.
We will provide background and effect sounds that exist in normal game mode as well in studio mode.
The development team is also aware of this problem and is investigating carefully for a countermeasure.
We are planning to release new medals related to modes or items that have been relatively lacking in updates, and further update existing medals as well.
We think it is a necessary function for all of our creative creators, and we will develop it in the near future as fast as possible as well.

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: June 10th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a89a401b660d786d71ae63049242b5a6734f1bef.jpg[/img]


Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!
[list][b]Contents: Season 6, The Wizard of Oz (6/10 - 9/2)[/b]

The theme for Season 6 is the Wizard of Oz! Season levels have been increased to 100. Also, new content like the quest zombie, which is a random quest, has been added
 
[b]Contents: Weapon Paint Switching System[/b]

You can now apply 2 or more paints to a single weapon. Once you apply the paint, you can freely swap it on and off. With the switching system's implementation, the Paint Reset Blueprint item will no longer be sold.

[b]Shop: Premium Room Host Release 50% Off Promotion (6/10 - Until Separate Notice)[/b]

The Premium Room Host is a temporary item that grants all kinds of benefits. To celebrate its release, you can purchase it at 50% off!

[b]Shop: SKULL IS BACK Promotion (6/10 - 7/8)[/b]

The SKULL series has been selected as the first Weapon of the Month! During the promotion, you can purchase the SKULL series directly from the Shop, and these weapons have received tweaks as well. Also, the Blood Weapon Paint item will be sold at 50% off.[/list]

Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.


[u][h1]Expanded Info[/h1][/u]

[h1]Contents[/h1]

[b]Season 6, The Wizard of Oz (6/10 - 9/2)[/b]

The theme for Season 6 is the Wizard of Oz. You can increase your season level when you play during the season, and you will receive rewards according to your level. If you own the Season Pass, you can receive additional rewards.
[list][*] Zombie Content Changes
During the season, the following changes will be applied.
1. Venom Guard
[list][*] Self-Destruct skill's duration increased (5 seconds → 15 seconds)
[*] Self-Destruct skill's explosion range increased
[*] Self-Destruct skill's knockback effect increased[/list]

2. Heavy Zombie
[list][*] Trap skill's human binding duration reduced (7 seconds → 3 seconds)
[*] Trap skill's human detection range reduced
[*] Trap skill's human seeking speed increased
[*] Trap's transparency removed[/list]

3. SCAR-OZ Enhancement Effects Applied

[*] Season Changes
[list][*] Added new Season 6 items and increased the max level to 100
[*] Added the Season Pass reward preview feature
[*] Can purchase Season Badge items even if you do not purchase the Season Pass[/list][/list]


[b]New Feature: Quest Zombie (Random Quest)[/b]

After the game starts, you will receive a quest automatically when each team respawns.
[list][*] Eligible Modes: Zombie Z, Zombie Hero, and Bot Zombie

[*] Human Team
You will receive a mission to kill a specific zombie. When you complete the mission, you will receive 1 of the following effects randomly: attack power buff, movement speed buff, maximum HP buff, revive as human when dying as infected.

[*] Zombie Team
You will receive a mission to play as a specific zombie, and can select the quest zombie at #0 in the class selection screen. When you complete the mission, you will receive the following 3 effects: maximum HP buff, additional Armor, decreased stun and knockback effects.

[*] Notice
[list][*] You will receive bonus effects each time you complete a quest in your current round.
[*] For the Zombie Team, effects received from completing a quest will have different values per zombie.
[*] Regardless of the team, clearing the quest once is considered meeting the condition once. (Event Conditions)[/list][/list]


[b]Weapon Paint Switching System[/b]

You can now apply 2 or more paints to a single weapon. Once you apply the paint, you can freely change to and from it. With the switching system's implementation, the Paint Reset Blueprint item will no longer be sold.


[b]Other Changes[/b]
[list][*] You can now use the automatic removal feature for inactive accounts, under Family Management.
[*] The Premium Room Host item is now available.
[*] The Mileage Duffel Bag item has been revamped.
[*] Other minor bugs have been fixed.[/list]


[h1]Events[/h1]

[b]Random Quest Clear Event (6/10 - 6/24)[/b]

You can earn rewards based on the number of random quest zombies you clear during the event. You can find detailed information about quest zombies in the content notice. 
[list][*] Eligible Modes
[list][*] Zombie Z, Zombie Hero, and Bot Zombie[/list]

[*] Quest Achievement Rewards
You can earn rewards based on the daily quest clear count during the event. (Up to 10 times a day) Regardless of the Human/Zombie team, clearing the quest zombie once is considered meeting the condition once.
[list][*] Clear 1 time: Rare Decoder x2
[*] Clear 3 times: Rare Decoder x3
[*] Clear 7 times: Rare Decoder x5
[*] Clear 10 times: Unique Decoder x1[/list]

[*] Daily Achievement Rewards
When you clear the quest zombies 10 times in a single day, it will count as 1 day towards the total day count. You can get additional rewards based on total days. These rewards can only be obtained once.
[list][*] 5 Days Total: Keep Out Spray
[*] 10 Days Total: Run Away Spray[/list]

[*] Notice
[list][*] Quest achievement count resets at midnight each day.
[*] Only counts in rooms with 4 or more players. Does not count in Studio Mode.[/list][/list]


[b]Zombie Scenario Golden Zombie Event (6/10 - 9/2)[/b]

You can earn rewards based on the number of Golden Zombies you kill during the event. Golden Zombies randomly appear when you play Zombie Scenario.
[list][*] Rewards per Kills
[list][*] 1 Kills: AK-47 Paladin (Permanent)
[*] 2 Kills: AK-47 Paladin (Permanent)
[*] 3 Kills: AK-47 Paladin (Permanent)
[*] 5 Kills: AK-47 Paladin (Permanent)
[*] 10 Kills: AK-47 Paladin +6 (Permanent) - Ammo Count +3/Damage +3[/list]

[*] Notice
[list][*] Hitting the Golden Zombie once counts as killing it once.
[*] Kill count rewards can be obtained only once per account.
[*] The Golden Zombies randomly appear after playing for more than 3 minutes in rooms at regular difficulty or higher.[/list][/list]


[b]Season Badge Giveaway (6/10 - 9/2)[/b]

When you log in to the game during Season 6, you can get 3 Season Badges every 30 minutes. You can obtain them up to 4 times a day, for a total of 12.


[b]Free Daily Rewards Event (6/10 - 7/8)[/b]

The Free Daily Rewards list has been updated.
[list][*] Regular Players
[list][*] Conditions
[list][*] Play the game for more than 10 minutes[/list]

[*] Rewards
[list][*] Daily Reward: Season Badge x30
[*] 3-Day Cumulative Reward: Season Badge x50
[*] 7-Day Cumulative Reward: Season Badge x100
[*] 15-Day Cumulative Reward: Season Badge x150
[*] 20-Day Cumulative Reward: Season Badge x200
[*] 25-Day Cumulative Reward: Season Badge x300[/list][/list]

[*] New and Returning Players
[list][*] Conditions
[list][*] Survivors who have not logged in for the past 30 days or have logged in for the very first time during the event must reach 10 minutes of play time[/list]

[*] Rewards
[list][*] Daily Reward: Daily Supplies x1 (Parts Weapon Selection Box x1 + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x2)
[*] 1-Day Cumulative Reward: Season Badge x50
[*] 3-Day Cumulative Reward: Season Badge x100
[*] 5-Day Cumulative Reward: Season Badge x150
[*] 7-Day Cumulative Reward: Season Badge x200
[*] 15-Day Cumulative Reward: Season Badge x300[/list][/list][/list]


[h1]Shop[/h1]

[b]Premium Room Host Release 50% Off Promotion (6/10 - Until Separate Notice)[/b]

The Premium Room Host is a temporary item that grants all kinds of benefits. To celebrate its release, you can purchase it at 50% off! 
[list][*] Premium Room Host Benefits
[list][*] Can immediately kick players
[*] Cannot be kicked
[*] EXP +50%
[*] Medal EXP +50%[/list]

[*] Other Player Benefits
[list][*] EXP +10%
[*] Medal EXP +10%[/list]

[*] Notice
[list][*] Each account can only purchase once every 30 days.
[*] Some missions related to time do not get the Medal EXP bonus effects.[/list][/list]


[b]Weapon of the Month: SKULL IS BACK Promotion (6/10 - 7/8)[/b]

The SKULL series has been selected as the first Weapon of the Month! During the promotion, you can purchase the SKULL series directly from the Shop, and these weapons have received tweaks as well. Also, the Blood Weapon Paint item will be sold at 50% off.
[list][*] Weapon of the Month
During this period, the selected weapon damage is increased to 2x in Zombie and Zombie Scenario Modes. (Does not apply to SKULL-9.)
[list][*] SKULL-1
[*] SKULL-3
[*] SKULL-4
[*] SKULL-5[/list]

[*] Adjusted Zombie Z level and unlocked +4 enhancement
[list][*] SKULL-1: Level 1 (Same as before)
[*] SKULL-3: Changed from level 1 to 4
[*] SKULL-4: Changed from level 6 to 10
[*] SKULL-5: Changed from level 1 to 8
[*] SKULL-9: Level 6 (Same as before)[/list]

[*] Blood Weapon Paint item will be sold at 50% off during the event[/list]


[b]Mileage Duffel Bag Revamp (6/10 - Permanent)[/b]

The Mileage Duffel Bag item has been revamped to allow you to freely select the mileage amount up to the max value of the item.
[list][*] 10,000 Mileage Duffel Bag: You can freely send amounts up to 10,000 mileage.
[*] 50,000 Mileage Duffel Bag: You can freely send amounts up to 50,000 mileage.
[*] 100,000 Mileage Duffel Bag: You can freely send amounts up to 100,000 mileage.
[*] 200,000 Mileage Duffel Bag: You can freely send amounts up to 200,000 mileage.[/list]

notes.title: [Notice] Regarding Security Vaccine Program Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/dec6f53768fe95ef5dd1d1eda2708d1623babdee.jpg[/img]

[b]Dear Survivors,[/b]

There was an issue in which those who had ‘Windows Defender’ (or Microsoft Security Essentials) running in the back received a message from our NGS program that detects BlackCipher which eventually terminated the game that was being processed. [b]This issue has finally been fixed as ‘Windows Defender’ modified its measures, therefore require you to update your security vaccine program for smoother gameplay.[/b]

Thank you for your patience and understanding regarding.

The CSN:S Team

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: May 13th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e80b2e8d98d31ce3d8b1919f9351b96d1025d0c8.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!
[list][b]Content: Studio All-Star/Gun Deathmatch[/b]
You can now play All-Star, All-Star+, and Gun Deathmatch modes in Studio Mode. Added a new map, "Industrial Warehouse", where you can play these modes.

[b]Event: CSN:S Land Supply Box Event (5/13 - 5/27)[/b]
During the event, you can get CSN:S Land Supply Boxes in Zombie Hero and Zombie Z Modes. You will receive rewards based on the total number you collect.

[b]Event: Mileage Auction Event (5/13 - 5/20)[/b]
We're opening up the Mileage Auction, where you can trade weapons. There will also be a 1,000 Mileage Auction Event where special items show up at specific times.

[b]Shop: Transcendence Weapon Promotion x3 Rate Boost (5/13 - 6/10)[/b]
The new Transcendence Weapon, Psychic Harmonium, will be available during the promotion period. [/list]
Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.


[u][h1]Expanded Info[/h1][/u]
[h1]Contents[/h1]
[b]Studio Mode Update: All-Star Mode / All-Star+ Mode / Gun Deathmatch Mode[/b]
You can now play All-Star, All-Star+, and Gun Deathmatch modes in Studio Mode.
[list][*] All-Star/All-Star+ Modes
[list][*] Added new theme blocks that can be used in Studio Mode.
[*] You can choose Studio All-Star Mode and All-Star+ Mode when you create a room.
[list][*] Studio All-Star: Play by selecting the "Random transformation at spawn" game rule in the waiting room.
[*] Studio All-Star+: Play by selecting the "Random transformation at 3 kills" game rule in the waiting room.[/list][/list]
[*] Studio Gun Deathmatch Mode
[list][*] This mode allows for new rules.
[list][*] Melee weapon kill point (+1) activated
[*] Lv. 3+ player kill point (+1) added[/list][/list][/list]

[b]New Map Added[/b]
[list][*] Studio Sample Map, Industrial Warehouse
[list][*] Added Industrial Warehouse, a new map where you can play the Studio All-Star and Gun Deathmatch modes.[/list]
[*] CSN:S Land: Dust
[list][*] Added CSN:S Land: Dust map, a Dust-style map in the theme of an amusement park. You can play the same modes as the original Dust map.
[*] Available from 5/13 to 6/10.[/list][/list]

[b]Off-Season Period[/b]
Season 5 has ended, and the next season has not started yet. Several changes applied during Season 5 have been reverted. Please look forward to our next event!
[list][*] Removed season-related features
[*] Increased the Zombie Z level for Season 5 weapons and Blistering Bolt Repeater
[*] Reverted the balance for Banshee and Voodoo Zombie
[*] Removed the Random-1 mutation removal feature[/list]

[b]Other Changes[/b]
[list][*] Reverted the specs for the Old-Time Brand Weapon 11 series
[*] Expanded maximum inventory space
[*] Fixed many other minor bugs[/list]

[h1]Events[/h1]
[b]CSN:S Land Supply Box Event (5/13 - 5/27)[/b]
During the event, the shape of the supply box in Zombie Hero and Zombie Z Modes will be changed to a gift box image. Each time you use this box, you can get a CSN:S Land Supply Box. You'll receive rewards based on the total number of boxes you get.
[list][*] How to Get the CSN:S Land Supply Box
[list][*] Each time you use a supply box by pressing E in Zombie Hero and Zombie Z Modes, you can get 1 CSN:S Land Supply Box item. 
[*] In the CSN:S Land: Dust map, you can get 2 supply box items each time.[/list]
[*] Rewards for Total CSN:S Land Supply Boxes
[list][*] Collect 10 boxes: Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon (7 Days)
[*] Collect 20 boxes: Rare Decoder x10
[*] Collect 30 boxes: Unique Decoder x1
[*] Collect 40 boxes: Rare Decoder x20
[*] Collect 50 boxes: Unique Decoder x2
[*] Collect 60 boxes: Rare Decoder x30
[*] Collect 70 boxes: Unique Decoder x3
[*] Collect 80 boxes: Rare Decoder x40
[*] Collect 90 boxes: Unique Decoder x4
[*] Collect 100 boxes: Rare Decoder x50
[*] Collect 110 boxes: Transcendence Decoder x1[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] CSN:S Land Supply Boxes cannot be used on their own. You can only receive rewards based on the total number collected.
[*] You can only get up to 10 CSN:S Land Supply Boxes a day. All boxes will be removed during the maintenance on 5/27.
[*] Participation will be counted only when playing in Zombie Hero or Zombie Z rooms with eight or more players. You cannot participate in Studio Mode.[/list][/list]

[b]All-Star/Gun Deathmatch Mode Play Event (5/13 - 5/27)[/b]
To celebrate the addition of Studio All-Star and Studio Gun Deathmatch, you will receive more EXP.
[list][*] Conditions and Rewards
[list][*] You will get 3x EXP when you play All-Star and Gun Deathmatch modes. This will apply to both Studio and Normal Mode.[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] Only counts in rooms with 4 or more players.
[*] The event will also apply to creation maps (not samples).[/list][/list]

[b]Mileage Auction Event (5/13 - 5/20)[/b]
Buy and sell weapons in the Mileage Auction House during the event!
[list][*] Auction Period
[list][*] Each day between 12:00 and 23:59, from maintenance on 5/13 until 5/20 [/list][/list]

[b]1,000 Mileage Auction Event (5/13 - 5/20)[/b]
During the auction period, special items sold for 1,000 Mileage will appear at specific times.
[list][*] Special Item List
[list][*] M249 Phoenix
[*] Python Desperado
[*] AUG Guardian
[*] Red Dragon Cannon
[*] Blade Runebreaker[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] The auction's time zone is based on CEST (UTC +2), which is the server time.
[*] Special items will appear within 10 minutes of the top of each auction hour, with bidding open for 10 minutes.
[*] Those who did not win the auction will be refunded 1,000 Mileage when the auction closes.[/list][/list]

[b]Free Daily Rewards Event (5/13 - 6/10)[/b]
The Free Daily Rewards list has been updated.
[list][*]Regular Players
[list][*]Conditions
[list][*] Play the game for more than 10 minutes[/list]
[*] Rewards
[list][*] Daily Reward: 50 Mileage
[*] 3 Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box (x15)
[*] 7 Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box (x20)
[*] 15 Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box (x25)
[*] 20 Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box (x7)
[*] 25 Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box (x8)[/list][/list][/list]
[list][*] New and Returning Players
[list][*] Conditions
[list][*] Survivors who have not logged in for the past 30 days or have logged in for the very first time during the event must reach 10 minutes of play time[/list]
[*] Rewards
[list][*] Daily Reward: Parts Weapon Selection Box (x1)
[*] 3 Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box (x5)
[*] 7 Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box (x10)
[*] 15 Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box (x15)
[*] 20 Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box (x5)
[*] 25 Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box (x6)[/list][/list][/list]

[h1]Shop[/h1]
[b]Transcendence Weapon x3 Rate Boost (5/13 - 6/10)[/b]
You can obtain the new Transcendence Weapon, Psychic Harmonium, during the promotion period.
[list][*] Rates
[list][*] Transcendence Premium Decoder: 3%
[*] Transcendence Decoder: 0.45%
[*] Check the rate details on the official homepage at http://www.csnzombies.com/.[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] The contents of the Decoder may change when the promotion ends.
[*] All unused Transcendence Premium Decoders will be removed during maintenance on 6/10. They will be replaced with 500 Mileage each. However, the Transcendence Decoders will not be removed.[/list][/list]

[b]Shop Changes[/b]
[list][*] Weapon Package
[list][*] Sold from 5/13 to 6/10 (Can be purchased once)
[*] Sale duration extended for the +3, +6, and +9 Weapon Packages, and purchase count reset. Players who purchased them before 5/13 can purchase again during the period.[/list]
[*] Mileage Shop: Transcendence Class (1 Day)
[list][*] Sold from 5/13 to 6/10 (Can be purchased per day)
[*] Sale duration extended for the Transcendence Class (1 Day) items sold in the Mileage Shop.[/list]
[*] Shop Items Removed
[list][*] Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box[/list][/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: April 29th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e80b2e8d98d31ce3d8b1919f9351b96d1025d0c8.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!
[list][b]Event: Random Rules Zombie Hero Event (4/29 - 5/13)[/b]
Random Rules maps for Zombie Hero are now available! In these maps, the rules of the game change each round. You can receive all kinds of rewards when you meet the playtime and zombie kill conditions in Random Rules Zombie Hero Mode.
 
[b]Shop: Lucky Spring Transcendence Weapon Box Promotion (4/29 - 5/13)[/b]
Lucky Transcendence Weapon Boxes will be on sale during the promotion. You have a greater chance of obtaining the Barrett M95 White Tiger or the M3 Black Dragon than other Transcendence Weapons. Every time you use 10, you'll receive 2 as a gift![/list]
Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.


[u][h1]Expanded Info[/h1][/u]
[h1]Contents[/h1]
[b]Other Changes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed other minor bugs.[/list]

[h1]Events[/h1]
[b]Zombie Hero: Random Rules Event (4/29 - 5/13)[/b]
In Random Rules maps for the Zombie Hero mode, the rules of the game change every round. The rules will be displayed for 3 seconds prior to the beginning of the round, and you can check them at any time by pressing the L key during the match.
[list][*] Featured Maps
[list][*] Assault and Italy[/list]
[*] Changes
[list][*] 12 New Rules Have Been Added
[list][*] Bad Touch - All zombies become Venom Stings. Skill can be used repeatedly, and trigger automatically on death.
[*] Moon Bounce - Low gravity mode. After jumping, you will float gently to the ground.
[*] Bloody Bullets - Every time you reload, you lose HP and gain Attack Power.
[*] Special Delivery - If an enemy out of sight is hit by your throwing weapon, its Attack Power is greatly increased.
[*] Rule of Threes - Attack Power of your 3rd, 6th, and 9th melee attacks is greatly increased.
[*] Shocking - When a zombie lands from jumping, it causes a shockwave, decreasing movement speed of nearby humans.
[*] Chaotic - Killing a zombie allows you to use the Shop once.
[*] Tunnel Vision - Humans have their visibility reduced but Attack Power increased.
[*] In This Together - If a zombie takes damage, nearby zombies are healed for a portion of the damage.
[*] Rifleman - Attack Power of assault rifles is greatly increased.
[*] Steel Rain - Attack Power of machine guns is greatly increased.
[*] Bang for the Buck - The cheaper the price of primary and secondary weapons, the more overall Attack Power increases.[/list]
[*] Balance Adjustment
[list][*] Common Rule Adjustment: If a classic weapon buff and a weapon buff are applied at the same time, only the buff with better effects will be applied
[*] Improved 3 Existing Rules: We Are Venom, Counter Strike War Z, and Out With a Bang
[/list][/list][/list]

[b]Random Rules Zombie Hero Event (4/29 - 5/13)[/b]
Every day, you can receive rewards when you reach zombie kill and playtime goals on Random Rules maps in Zombie Hero mode.
[list][*] Conditions
[list][*] Score 10 zombie kills and reach 30 minutes of playtime every day. (You need to meet both conditions.)[/list]
[*]Rewards - The rewards change based on the total number of days you participate.
[list][*] 1 Day - Event Reward Box x1
[*] 2 Days - 1 random Rare Class (Permanent) (Total 37 classes)
[*] 3 Days - 1 random Unique Class (Permanent) (Total 6 classes)
[*] 4 days - Event Reward Box x2
[*] 5 Days - 2 random Rare Classes (Permanent)
[*] 6 Days - 2 random Unique Classes (Permanent)
[*] 7 Days - Event Reward Box x3
[*] 8 Days - 3 random Rare Classes (Permanent)
[*] 9 Days - 3 random Unique Classes (Permanent)
[*] 10 Days - Guaranteed Transcendence Class Box x1[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] You can obtain one of 72 weapons from the Event Reward Box, according to their rates. Some weapons can be obtained as +6 weapons.
[*] Rewards can be obtained only once per day. You can get up to 10 kills a day.
[*] You can only make progress in rooms with 8 or more players.
[*] Unused Event Reward Boxes will be removed on 5/13.[/list][/list]

[h1]Shop[/h1]
[b]Lucky Spring Transcendence Weapon Box Promotion (4/29 - 5/13)[/b]
Lucky Transcendence Weapon Boxes will be on sale during the promotion. You have a greater chance of obtaining the Barrett M95 White Tiger or the M3 Black Dragon than other Transcendence Weapons. Every time you use 10, you'll receive 2 as a gift!
[list][*] Lucky Spring Transcendence Weapon Box Event (4/29 - 5/13)
[list][*] Every time you use 10 Lucky Transcendence Weapon Boxes, you can get 2 additional ones.[/list]
[*] Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box Rates
[list][*] Barrett M95 White Tiger: 3.0%
[*] M3 Black Dragon: 3.0%
[*] Check the rate details on the official homepage at http://www.csnzombies.com/.[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] All unused Lucky Transcendence Weapon Boxes will be replaced with 1,000 Mileage each during maintenance on 5/13.[/list][/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: April 16th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e80b2e8d98d31ce3d8b1919f9351b96d1025d0c8.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!

[list][b]Content: Exploration System[/b]
We've added the brand-new Exploration system, where your classes bring back items even while you're logged out. Check it out by pressing the "Exploration" button at the bottom of the Lobby screen.
  
[b]Event: Old-Time Costume Box Event (4/16 - 4/29)[/b]
You can get an Old-Time Costume Box every time you reach playtime milestones during the event. You can also get additional rewards based on the total number of boxes you get.
 
[b]Event: Transcendence Erica and Gerard Release Event (4/16 - 4/29)[/b]
During the event, you can get rewards for playing Zombie Scenario maps where Erica and Gerard appear as NPCs.
 
[b]Event: Old-Time Brand Weapon 11 Event (4/16 - 5/13)[/b]
During the event, Brand 11 weapons will be stronger.

[b]Event: Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon Giveaway (4/16 - 4/29)[/b]
You will receive an Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon (14 Days) when you log in and reach 10 minutes of playtime during the event.
 
[b]Shop: Season 5 Transcendence Class Promotion (4/16 - 4/29)[/b]
The new Transcendence Classes, Private Erica and Drill Instructor Gerard, can be obtained from decoders during the promotion. You can get Erica's Beret (Permanent) if you get Private Erica, and you can get Gerard's Peaked Cap (Permanent) if you get Drill Instructor Gerard.[/list]

Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.


[u][h1]Expanded Info[/h1][/u]
[h1]Contents[/h1]
[b]New Content: Exploration System[/b]
The Exploration system is a new mode where your classes will bring back items even while you are logged out.
Check it out by pressing the "Exploration" button at the bottom of the Lobby screen.
[list][*] Exploration System Overview
[list][*] You can select and send 3 classes to an exploration area.
[*] The exploration success rate changes based on the area, the level, and the exploration levels of the classes.
[*] The duration changes based on difficulty. (Easy: 2 hours, Normal: 4 hours, and Hard: 8 hours)
[*] You'll receive the base reward when the exploration ends. If you complete the mission, you'll get an additional reward.
[*] Please be careful, as the reward will be reset if you do not claim it within 24 hours after completing the exploration.[/list]
[*] Starting Exploration
When you press the button in the Lobby, the "Exploration" window will appear. The Exploration window has 3 parts.
[list][*]Exploration Slots: 1 area will be provided by default. You can open up to 2 additional slots by using Exploration Slot Expansion Coupons, for a total of 3 slots.
[list][*] Exploration area information will be updated every day at midnight.[/list]
[*] Exploration Settings: You can select the difficulty for the currently selected area, and set the 3 classes to dispatch.
[list][*] You must fill all 3 class slots to depart. There are minimum and maximum success rates for each difficulty.
[*] When the exploration area changes, there is a chance to get the "Bonus Class" mark. If you send the Bonus Class, the exploration success rate increases.
[*] You can change the exploration area randomly by pressing the button on the top left. However, using this option will cost Mileage.
[*] To cancel an exploration that is already in progress, select the exploration area and press the X button on the top right. The assigned classes will not need to rest.[/list]
[*] Classes Owned: You can check the status of the classes you have.
[list][*] Each class has a different exploration level. Temporary classes cannot be used for exploration.
[*] Classes that complete an exploration once will need to rest. They cannot go on another exploration that day.
[*] Classes on exploration can be used in other game modes without restrictions.[/list][/list]
[*] Exploration Level Enhancement
In the Enhance screen, you can raise the exploration level of the classes you own.
[list][*] When enhancing, you can use classes, costumes, and sprays as material.
[*] Temporary items can also be used as material. You will receive the same rewards as you would from dismantling the item.[/list][/list]

[b]Other Changes[/b]
[list][*] Changed Quick Start to recommend the appropriate mode based on player patterns.
[*] Added a feature to restrict weapons in Continuous Maps.
[*] Added an option to hide the Studio creator.
[*] Fixed other minor bugs.[/list][/list]
 

[h1]Events[/h1]
[b]Old-Time Costume Box Event (4/16 - 4/29)[/b]
You can get an Old-Time Costume Box every time you reach playtime milestones during the event. You can also get additional rewards based on the total number of boxes you get.
[list][*] How to Get Old-Time Costume Boxes
[list][*] You can obtain 1 Old-Time Costume Box when you reach 11 minutes of playtime in any mode, excluding Studio Mode.
[*] You can obtain up to 11 rewards a day. You must be in a room with 4 or more players to make progress.[/list]
[*] Old-Time Costume Box Pileup Rewards
You can get additional rewards based on the number of boxes you get.
[list][*] 11: SKULL-11 (Permanent) + Weapon Paint (x1)
[*] 55: JANUS-11 (Permanent) + Weapon Paint (x1) and THANATOS-11 (Permanent) + Weapon Paint (x1)
[*] 99: TURBULENT-11 (Permanent) + Weapon Paint (x1), CROW-11 (Permanent) + Weapon Paint (x1), and BALROG-XI (Permanent) + Weapon Paint (x1)[/list]
[*] Old-Time Costume Box Rates
[list][*] Costume x1 (Permanent) - 91.5% (Includes 12 costumes)
[list][*] Cat Fish, Alice Bunny Ears, Dao Mask, Bazzi Mask, Polar Bear Head, Fierce Penguin, Indian Warbonnet, Indian shield, Dinosaur Head, Dinosaur Buddy, Pharaoh Mask, and Mummy Doll[/list]
[*] Unique Decoder x3 - 2%
[*] Class Decoder x3 - 2%
[*] Rare Decoder x15 - 4.5%[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] Unused Old-Time Costume Box items will be removed during maintenance on 4/29.[/list][/list]

[b]Transcendence Erica and Gerard Release Event (4/16 - 4/29)[/b]
During the event, you can get rewards for playing the designated Zombie Scenario maps.
[list][*] Featured Maps
[list][*] Track: Enemy Behind
[*] Track: Envy Mask[/list]
[*] Celebration Event 1
[list][*] When you clear a featured map, you can obtain 2 Old-Time Costume Boxes.
[*] Each account can only earn the reward once per map, up to 4 total.[/list] 
[*] Celebration Event 2
[list][*] If you play an event map as Private Erica or Drill Instructor Gerard, you can obtain 3 additional Old-Time Costume Boxes.
[*] Each account can only earn the reward once per map, up to 6 total.[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] You can only get the rewards in rooms with difficulty set to Hard 1 or higher, with 4 or more players. You must play at least 5 minutes.
[*] Rewards for Celebration Events 1 and 2 are counted separately. If you have a new Transcendence Class equipped, you can participate in both simultaneously. Can obtain up to 10 boxes total.[/list][/list]

[b]Zombie Scenario Annihilation Series Opening Celebration Event (4/16 - 4/29)[/b]
When you clear a featured map, you can obtain 2 Old-Time Costume Boxes.
[list][*] Featured Maps
[list][*] Annihilation: Nightmare
[*] Annihilation: Addiction
[*] Annihilation: Illusion
[*] Berserk: Scenario Paranoia
[*] Annihilation: Oblivion[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] You can only get the rewards in rooms with difficulty set to Hard 1 or higher, with 4 or more players. You must play at least 5 minutes.
[*] Rewards for Celebration Events 1 and 2 are counted separately. If you have a new Transcendence Class equipped, you can participate in both simultaneously. Can obtain up to 10 boxes total.[/list][/list]

[b]Old-Time Brand Weapon 11 Event (4/16 - 5/13)[/b]
During the event, the following weapons will become stronger.
[list][*] Weapons Affected
[list][*] SKULL-11, Balrog-XI, Janus-11, Thanatos-11, CROW-11, Tubulent-11[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] The increased stats are only during the event. They will not be applied in Zombie Z levels.[/list][/list][/list]

[b]Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon Giveaway (4/16 - 4/29)[/b]
You will receive an Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon (14 Days) when you log in and reach 10 minutes of playtime during the event.
[list][*] Notice
[list][*] Each account can only earn the reward once during the event.[/list][/list]

[b]Zombie Z Newbie Event (4/16 - 4/29)[/b]
You can earn reward weapons per stage by reaching the requirements of the play missions during the event period.
[list][*] Conditions
[list][*] Mission 1 - Login to the game once during the event period
[*] Mission 2 – Score 1 cumulative zombie kills in Zombie Z mode + Login to the game 2 times
[*] Mission 3 – Score 5 cumulative zombie kills in Zombie Z mode + Login to the game 5 times
[*] Mission 4 – Score 10 cumulative zombie kills in Zombie Z mode + Login to the game 8 times
[*] Mission 5 – Score 20 cumulative zombie kills in Zombie Z mode + Login to the game 10 times[/list]
[*] Rewards
[list][*] Mission 1 - M950 +8, Claymore Mine MDS, Arm Torch, Rail Cannon (Grade 5 Gun Boost + Grade 6 Speed Up), Volcano +6, XM1014 Automatic Shotgun (Grade 5 Gun Boost + Grade 6 Speed Up)
[*] Mission 2 – Plasma Gun +6, Vendetta +6
[*] Mission 3 - BALROG-XI (Grade 5 Gun Boost + Grade 6 Speed Up), Hunter Killer X-90 (Grade 5 Gun Boost + Grade 6 Rage Down)

[list][*] Select 1 from the 4 following weapons (Permanent): M950 +8, Plasma Gun +6, Vendetta +6, Volcano +6
[*] Select 1 from the 7 following weapons (Permanent): Claymore Mine MDS, Arm Torch, BOUNCER, BALROG-XI (Grade 5 Gun Boost + Grade 6 Speed Up), Rail Cannon (Grade 5 Gun Boost + Grade 6 Speed Up), Hunter Killer X-90 (Grade 5 Gun Boost + Grade 6 Rage Down), Broad Divine (Grade 5 Gun Boost + Grade 6 Heal Disruptor)[/list][/list]
[*] Notes
[list][*] The weapons given as rewards from Missions 1 - 4 will be removed during maintenance on April 29th.
[*] You are unable to participate in Studio Mode.

[b]1-Day Weapon Giveaway (4/16 - 4/29)[/b]
You will receive durational (1 Day) weapons on your first login each day during the event period. (Once per day per account.)

[*] M249 Phoenix

The Free Daily Rewards list has been updated.
[list][*] Regular Players
[list][*] Conditions
[list][*] Play the game for more than 10 minutes[/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: April 1st
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/43f2bb6621c3125876fdf16fd9ae3c2a9861bf1d.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!
[list][b]Contents: New Maps + Studio Mode's Kingdom Collaboration[/b] 
The new maps Joseon Marketplace and Researcher's Log Supplement #Joseon have been added. You can also now use the Season 5 theme, Joseon, in Studio. Obtain the Joseon theme for free by logging in during the giveaway period!
  
[b]Event: Spring Seed Event (4/1 - 4/16)[/b]
Get Seeds when you first log in each day during the event. Then, use the Seed to get an immediate reward, or grow it into a Sprout or Fruit for even better rewards!

[b]Event: New Map Event (4/1 - 4/16)[/b]
Get 3x EXP when you play the new Joseon Marketplace map during the event. You can also get additional rewards for reaching certain playtime milestones!

[b]Event: Season 5 Kingdom Theme Studio Contest (4/1 - 4/29)[/b]
Participate in the Season 5 Kingdom Theme Studio Contest! Create maps using the Kingdom theme for a chance at great rewards. Refer to the separate contest notice for details. Also, participate in the Theme Package Giveaway and Studio Creation Feedback Event, which are running alongside the contest!

[b]Shop: Transcendence Weapon Re-Sale Promotion (4/1 - 4/16)[/b]

notes.title: [Notice] Information on the Recent Bug
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/dec6f53768fe95ef5dd1d1eda2708d1623babdee.jpg[/img]

Hello, Survivors, who have showered CSNS with unceasing love, 

We would like to fill you in on the details of a recent bug and the actions we've taken to address it. Before we get into the details, we want to express our sincerest apologies for the inconvenience and disappointment the bug may have caused you.

[list][*][b]Bug Details[/b]
[list][*] We discovered a bug that allowed players to duplicate enhancement material parts.[/list]

[*] [b]Actions Taken So Far[/b]
[olist][*] Discovered the bug around 10:30 CET on 3/22.
[*] Performed an emergency maintenance at 15:00 that same day, blocking both further duplications from occurring and the usage of enhancement materials.
[*] Investigated players who exploited the duplication bug and the number of items they duplicated (found a confirmed total of 61 players).[/olist]
[*] [b]4/1 Maintenance Actions[/b]
[olist][*]After the 4/1 maintenance, you will be able to use enhancement materials again.
[*] As an apology for the inconvenience the bug may have caused you, we plan to give the following as compensation:
[list][*] Compensation Redemption: Log in between the end of maintenance on 4/1 (Wed) and midnight CEST on 4/14 (Wed)
[*] Compensation Items: Transcendence Decoder x3[/list]
[*] All materials wrongfully gained by the bug will be removed.
[*] If the materials were already used, EXP will be deducted from enhanced weapons based on the materials used. EXP deductions will be applied only to values changed after the maintenance on 3/18.
[*] Players who exploited the bug will be restricted from playing the game for up to 30 days, depending on the number of times they used the exploit.
[list][*] 2 times: Restricted from playing the game for 1 day
[*] 3 times: Restricted from playing the game for 7 days
[*] 4 or more times: Restricted from playing the game for 14 days[/list][/olist][/list]
We will do everything in our power to provide a stable, bug-free service in the future. We apologize once again for the inconvenience caused by the bug.

tags.bug: We discovered a bug that allowed players to duplicate enhancement material parts.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/43f2bb6621c3125876fdf16fd9ae3c2a9861bf1d.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!
[list][b]Mental Math Event (3/4 - 3/18)[/b]
You can earn random numbers by meeting the requirements in Zombie Hero or Zombie Z modes. Based on the numbers that you get, you can receive rewards like Mileage.

[b]Zombie Hero: Random Rules Event (3/4 - 3/18)[/b]
Random Rules maps for the Zombie Hero are now available! In these maps, the rules of the game change each round. When the Crash rule is triggered, two random rules will be applied for the duration of the round	

[b]Starlight Rolling Shooter Rate-Up Promotion (3/4 - 3/18)[/b]
During the promotion, the rates for the new Starlight Rolling Shooter weapon from Unique and Unique Premium Decoders will be increased x5![/list]
Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.


[u][h1]Expanded Info[/h1][/u]
[h1]Events[/h1]
[b]Mental Math Event (3/4 ~ 3/18)[/b]
You can earn random numbers by meeting the requirements in Zombie Hero or Zombie Z modes. Based on the numbers that you get, you can receive rewards like Mileage.
[list][*] How to Get Numbers
[list][*] You have a chance to get numbers by scoring kills, or assists on zombies, or humans in Zombie Hero, or Zombie Z modes.
[*] The numbers range from 1 - 10.
[*] The numbers you get are entered automatically into the equation shown below, in the order of A, B, and C. The equation is completed once when you collect 3 numbers.
[list][*] Equation: (A + B) x C[/list][/list]
