notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/ece767dd910f29148e711d79edcb740c473c6c5f.jpg[/img]

[b]Survivors,[/b]

We've just finished maintenance, so here's a breakdown of today's CSN:Z update!

[quote]
[h1][b]Updated Content[/b][/h1]

[h1]Overview of New Original & Standard Settings[/h1]
The weapon usage restrictions that have been used and managed per country are now unified as New Original.

The affected modes are identical to those in the current live version.


[h1]Level Adjustment for Zombie Z Black Dragon Cannon[/h1]
In Zombie Z mode, the Black Dragon Cannon level will be changed from existing level 28 to 20!


[h1]The New Team Deathmatch Map [Secret Storage] is Open![/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/64459581f4b44077dc707079ef88694984617b64.png[/img]
You've all been waiting a long time for a new map, right? Get hype for this new Team Deathmatch map!


[h1]Daily Rewards Have Been Updated! (June 12 – July 10)[/h1]
You're all familiar with the wonderful gifts from the Daily Rewards when you log in each day, right? Well, the Daily Rewards have gotten a makeover.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/7cb412747977d49b0d59af62c3b2e2ddfdb314dc.png[/img]
[b]How to Earn Rewards[/b]
[*]Reach 10 minutes of in-game play after logging in to receive your rewards.
[/list]
[b]Daily Rewards[/b]
[*]Event Decoder x1
[/list]
[b]Cumulative Rewards[/b]
[*]5 Days: Event Decoder x5
[*]7 Days: Event Decoder x7
[*]10 Days: Event Decoder x10
[*]15 Days: Event Decoder x15
[*]20 Days: Event Decoder x20
[/list]
Log in each day for 10 minutes of action, and claim yourself some Event Decoders while you're at it!


[h1]Conquer the Magnum Launcher & Dual Sword Phantom Slayer Event! (June 12 – June 26)[/h1]
You'll get a reward for reaching 30 minutes of play time each day during the event!

[b]Cumulative Rewards[/b]
[*]1 Day Total: Select 1 of the 4 Reward Weapons
[*]2 Days Total: Select 1 of the +5 Reward Weapons
[*]3 Days Total: Select 1 of the 6 Reward Weapons
[*]4 Days Total: Select 1 of either the Magnum Launcher (10 Days), or the Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (10 Days)
[*]5 Days Total: Select 1 of the 6 Reward Weapons
[*]6 Days Total: Select 1 of the 6 Reward Weapons
[*]7 Days Total: Select 1 of the 6 Reward Weapons
[*]8 Days Total: Select 1 of either the Magnum Launcher (10 Days), or the Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (10 Days)
[/list]
[b]Reward Weapons[/b]
[*]Blade Rune Breaker (10 Days)
[*]Magnum Drill (10 Days)
[*]SG552 Lycanthrope (10 Days)
[*]Guillotine (10 Days)
[*]Gae Bolg (10 Days)
[*]Desert Eagle Crimson Hunter (10 Days)
[*]Red Dragon Cannon (10 Days)
[*]Python Desperado (10 Days)
[*]M4A1 Dark Knight (10 Days)
[*]AK47 Paladin (10 Days)
[*]Black Dragon Cannon (10 Days)
[/list]
[b]Notes[/b]
[*]The time for this event only counts in rooms with eight or more players.
[*]Each account can complete this event only once.
[/list]
Make sure you don't miss out on this chance to rack up tons of free weapons!


[h1]Daily Decoder Package A/B Sales (June 12 – June 26)[/h1]
You've all shown us a lot of support by purchasing decoders.

We'd like to offer you a new way to get decoders, for a short time!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/25249eda331f62405316c25a2d58c58edd72fa13.png[/img]
[b]Daily Decoder Package A[/b]
[*]Get a Top 50 Decoder when you log in each day. (Up to a maximum of 7 times)
[*]Get 5 additional Top 50 Decoders when you log in all 7 days.
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/e543ad792a079d7492aa15b3d5d6e7bdfc619233.png[/img]
[b]Daily Decoder Package B[/b]
[*]Get 2 Top 50 Decoders when you log in each day. (Up to a maximum of 7 times)
[*]Get 10 additional Top 50 Decoders when you log in all 7 days.
[/list]
[b]YOU MUST KNOW[/b]
[*]These items can be purchased only once per account, and cannot be gifted!
[*]The effect will not stack with the Daily Decoder Package A/B item effect.
[*]Therefore, DO NOT PURCHASE THIS ITEM TWICE.
[/list]
Don't be shy about participating in this awesome event!
Rack up tons of additional decoders for free by simply logging in regularly!


[h1]Earn New Medals in Team Deathmatch Event (June 12 – June 26)[/h1]
New medals will be awarded to those who place in the Top 100 for kill counts in Team Deathmatch mode during the event.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/166d1badd692425203040628ca71a3761afbc23a.png[/img]
[b]Medal Available[/b]
[*]Medal Name: [Honor] TDM Event Killer
[*]Honor Points: 0 Points (May be changed later)
[/list]
[b]Checking Ranks in Real Time[/b]
[*]You can check your Rank by going into the game and clicking the Record Tab -> View Ranking -> Event buttons.
[/list]
[b]Notes[/b]
[*]The Top 100 list will be arranged based on cumulative scores prior to maintenance on 6/26 (Wed).
[*]Medals will be given after maintenance on 6/26 (Wed).
[*]Each account can participate only once, and it only counts in rooms with eight or more players.
[/list]

[h1]Season 2 Transcendence Weapon [Infinity Laser Fist] Sales Promotion! (June 12 – June 26)[/h1]
You've all waited long enough! The weapon you saw in GM Yuri's update video, the Season 2 Transcendence Weapon, is finally here!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/e2522ea044d9fc3eda869bfe53edf7fd39ac926b.png[/img]

[*]Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoder (3%)
[*]Top 50 Premium Decoder (0.45%)

Let's watch [Huxley]'s YouTube video for this new weapon here!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r0NW6T764Qk To help your chances of scoring an [Infinity Laser Fist], we're selling bigger bundles of items during the promotion.

[b]Notes[/b]
[*]All unused Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoders and Top 50 Premium Decoders will be removed during maintenance on 6/26 (Wed).
[*]Each removed Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoder will be replaced with 500 Mileage, and each Top 50 Premium Decoder will be replaced with 50 Mileage.
[*]Make sure to use them before time runs out!
[/list]

[h1]Season 2 Transcendence Weapon [Infinity Laser Fist] Guaranteed Giveaway! (June 12 – June 26)[/h1]
We've also prepared a guaranteed giveaway this time as for those who aren't fans of probability and still want their [Infinity Laser Fist]!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/e8f0084871898f1f1fe90b6d8a22a577b747d9e6.png[/img]
[b]How can I get it?[/b]
[*]You'll earn 6 Guaranteed Points for using a Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoder.
[*]You'll earn 1 Guaranteed Points for using a Top 50 Premium Decoder.
[*]You'll get the Season 2 Transcendence Weapon [Infinity Laser Fist] for reaching 300 Guaranteed Points!
[/list]
[b]Notes[/b]
[*]Don't forget that each account is able to receive the reward only once in this event!
[/list][/quote]

Please continue to enjoy the game so we can bring you bigger and better content!

See you all for the next patch!

Best regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [Notice] Here Are the New Items for Season 2!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/a7c91d360da13122706341ed3fd14c22b218d37e.jpg[/img]

[b]Survivors,[/b]

Season 2 is finally here!

As you all know, the Season system is a great way to earn more items.

[quote]
[h1]As a follow-up to the Windrider from the previous season, you'll be able to claim a weapon called the Stinger as the big item for Season 2.[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/24b828d51c8d4e96fc6966b184fa5ffe52957bed.png[/img]

It may resemble the Gae Bolg, but it's much more powerful.

As a matter of fact, it's a weapon designed to destroy the hearts of vampires from the medieval period. It fires 3 rounds of special stakes that cannot be removed once stuck.


[h1]There's also the Season 2 Spray![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/623d869ac2286763e5b8cbf6e7260023ae8f5e0a.png[/img]

The 3 sprays available in Season 2 are the [Black Anarchist Spray], [Sheriff Gerard Spray], and [Pioneer's Crest Spray].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/89bd3c5c8d892a61ba53a1f2c8b4549171fd19a0.png[/img]


[h1]There are 2 new Zombie Skins as well![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/edb99dcf728e4ec5ea524f38f731c2ea4d8f15a1.png[/img]

One is the [Scarecrow Blotter], and the other is the [Cowgirl Light Zombie]. Freakish indeed, but don't forget, this IS a zombie game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/2ef57007f55c5e994176b9d11deff4f7e36aa2cf.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/4eeea260139508dd97a1cef54ef6bf80c8a629d4.png[/img]


[h1]2 new classes with new appearances have been added, too![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/670ba135851699912a607439876b1bbd38460aef.png[/img]

Behold, [Anarchist David] and [Sheriff Gerard]! [Anarchist David] still manages to keep up his notoriety, despite having returned to the 20th century.

And now [Sheriff Gerard] finds himself with a sheriff's star and on the trail of David Black the anarchist.


[h1]We don't need to mention the newly added Season 2 Badges, right?[/h1]
These are the [Season Pass Medal] and the [Season Rank Achievement Medal]. You're sure to feel powerful once you earn these!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/9ae2ac23dbce01f754ca7990d805261b5bb502a2.png[/img]


[h1]Season 2 exclusive weapons and costumes have been updated.[/h1]
Costumes like the [Lantern], [Sheriff's Hat], [Leather Auxiliary Bag], [Anarchist's Hat], [Lasso], and [Tomahawk] have been added.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/5297c4da42fff0e13039649d123c82bb5072ed64.png[/img]

[h1]These fancy weapons from the Season 2 Pass rewards will take you right back to the days of the 20th century.[/h1]
Why don't you all chase down an anarchist yourself, after arming yourselves with weapons like the [Elegant Winchester M1887], [Elegant Double Barrel Shotgun], [Elegant Mosin-nagant], [Elegant Python], [Elegant Mauser C96], [Elegant Hunting Dagger], and the [Elegant Aeolis]?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/3c29e5f75922514b972bf1790351c1e4ae19b382.png[/img]

Don't miss out on the Season 2 Pass, filled with all sorts of awesome weapons, items, and costumes!
[/quote]

Most importantly, don't forget that you won't be able to get your hands on these items once Season 2 is over!

We'll be back with more information next time!

Best regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: May 29th
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/ece767dd910f29148e711d79edcb740c473c6c5f.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

We've just finished maintenance, so here's a breakdown of today's CSN:Z update!

[quote]
[h1][b]Updated Content[/b][/h1]

[h1]+6 Black Dragon Cannon Premium Enhancement Available![/h1]
The Premium Enhancement for the Black Dragon Cannon is here!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/cb4c50236e1c587b0aa94895fe28ea8cbd613a44.png[/img]

The Black Dragon Cannon is a cannon weapon that can knock down everyone within range, strong enough to make you think of a volcano erupting. It boats high portability thanks to its relatively short barrel. Activate long range firing with a right-click.

This means you'll be able to enhance the Damage and Magazine by 3. (Exclusive to +6, this weapon will fire long-range fireballs. Regular ammo will be used to fire.)


[h1]Parts Mileage Auction Event is Coming! (May 29 – June 12)[/h1]
Following the success of the previous Weapon Mileage Auction, another round of Mileage Auctions will be opened just for Parts.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/3b0a7a445b29223d6979950c3c809a29d7ebc665.png[/img]
[*]Auction Duration: 5/29 - 6/12
[*]Auction Time: 12:00 - 23:59 (CEST)
[/list]
We hope to see a lot of players participating, as this is an Auction where all Parts can be traded.


[h1]Hunter Killer X-45 Sale (May 29 – June 12)[/h1]
You can get the Hunter Killer X-45 from Top 50 Decoders and Top 50 Unlimited Decoders during the event.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/7bd8d28af85809266e8297cad3a6220f66e05a33.png[/img]

[*]Probability: 10 times the normal rates! Get yourselves a Hunter Killer X-45 no problem!
[*]Larger Decoder Bundles: Packages containing 30 of the Top 50 Unlimited Decoders will be added during the event! Furthermore, a package containing 50 of the Top 50 Decoders will also be added for sale!
[/list]

[h1]Hunter Killer X-45 Guaranteed Giveaway (May 29 – June 12)[/h1]
To assure each and every one of you will get the Hunter Killer X-45, we've prepared a Hunter Killer X-45 Guaranteed Giveaway!

You'll receive guaranteed points based on the number of Decoders you open during the event, and you'll receive a Hunter Killer X-45 (Permanent) when you reach 60 points.

[b]Earning Guaranteed Points[/b]
[*]Get 6 guaranteed points each time you use a Top 50 Unlimited Decoder.
[*]Get 1 guaranteed point each time you use a Top 50 Decoder.
[/list]
[b]Notes[/b]
[*]Reach 60 guaranteed points to receive a Hunter Killer X-45 (Permanent).
Each account can only participate once in this event.
[/list]

[h1]Grade 4 Parts Reward Box Giveaway! (May 29 – June 26)[/h1]
We've got more good news for fans of guaranteed points! 

Parts will be given when you earn enough guaranteed points during the event.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/b7547495fa9f39d6f7500b6b1e52319c51feb203.png[/img]

[b]Requirements[/b]
[*]Get 3 Grade 4 Parts Reward Boxes when you reach 30 guaranteed points
[/list]
[b]Notes[/b]
[*]Each account can only participate once in this event.
[/list]
Earn yourselves 3 Grade 4 Parts Reward Boxes by obtaining 30 guaranteed points, and while you're at it, collect a bit more for a Hunter Killer X-45 (Permanent) as well!


[h1]Black Dragon Cannon Guaranteed Giveaway! (May 29 – June 12)[/h1]
Here's how you can get the Black Dragon Cannon, and the method's exclusive to CSN:Z!
Remember, this is how you can receive a Black Dragon Cannon (not +6) guaranteed.

[b]Actions/Conditions[/b]
[*]You will receive a Black Dragon Cannon every time you reach 30 points.
[/list]
[b]Earning Guaranteed Points[/b]
[*]Get 6 guaranteed points each time you use a Top 50 Unlimited Decoder.
[*]Get 1 guaranteed point each time you use a Top 50 Decoder.
[/list]
You can get up to 7 Black Dragon Cannons this way.
At this rate, you'll be able to get a Black Dragon Cannon +6 in no time!


[h1]Sharing the Awesome Studio Maps from the Korea Event (May 29 – )[/h1]
We're hosting an event to share some of the awesome Studio Maps selected from the Korean branch of CSN:Z.

[u]Outstanding Studio Map, the 'Death Run'[/u]

[*]Creator: EnterShikari
[*]Map Name: [Zombie Escape] Death Run Zombie Escape
Try out this map created by a player just like any of you from Korea! Needless to say, we also encourage all of you to showcase many of your brilliant ideas for the Zombie Z map creation contest!
[/list]

[u]Let's watch CSN:Z Korean influencer [Ryohen]'s 'Death Run' play video on YouTube![/u]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=idFzya8YT_o

You all know that the rewards can only be earned once per account during the event, right?


[h1]Mileage Giveaway (May 29 – June 12)[/h1]
You'll be rewarded for reaching the requirements listed below during the event.

[b]Actions/Conditions[/b]
[*]Simply reach 30 minutes of game play each day!
[/list]
[b]Rewards[/b]
[*]30 Minutes on Day 1: 100 Mileage
[*]30 Minutes on Day 2, Cumulative: 200 Mileage
[*]30 Minutes on Day 3, Cumulative: 300 Mileage
[*]30 Minutes on Day 4, Cumulative: 500 Mileage
[*]30 Minutes on Day 5, Cumulative: 700 Mileage
[*]30 Minutes on Day 6, Cumulative: 900 Mileage
[*]30 Minutes on Day 7, Cumulative: 1200 Mileage
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/30626baebee5bd6943b30d5ff6d8f2b4280c3f8e.png[/img]

[b]Notes[/b]
[*]Once you've reached the requirements for 7 consecutive days, you can start over from Day 1.
[*]Game play only counts in rooms with 8 or more players.
[*]In theory, you could obtain up to 7800 Mileage if you participate as much as possible.
[/list][/quote]

We're receiving a lot of feedback about the game regarding the Season 2 update. We're doing our best to listen and apply your suggestions.

Please continue to enjoy the game so we can bring you bigger and better content!

See you all for the next patch!

Best regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: May 15th (Part 2)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/ece767dd910f29148e711d79edcb740c473c6c5f.jpg[/img]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/1608260391578447273]CSN:Z 2019 ZOMBIE Z STUDIO CONTEST![/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/1608260391578434193]Level System Revamp![/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791436292148/announcements/detail/1608260391578446454]Zombie Meta Change![/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/1608260391578445955]Item Usage Revamp![/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/1608260391578433627]My Info Revamp!![/url]
[/list]

[b]Survivors,[/b]

We've just finished maintenance, so here's a breakdown of today's CSN:Z update!

[quote]
[h1][b]Updated Events[/b][/h1]

[h1]Season 3 Free Daily Rewards Update! (May 15 – June 12)[/h1]
New monthly Free Daily Rewards have been added!

[b]How to Earn Rewards[/b]
[*]Reach 10 minutes of game play after logging in.
[/list]
[b]Rewards[/b]
[*]50 Mileage
[/list]
[b]Cumulative Rewards:[/b]
[*]5 Days: Grade 1 Parts Reward Box (x20)
[*]7 Days: Grade 1 Parts Reward Box (x30)
[*]10 Days: Grade 2 Parts Reward Box (x10)
[*]15 Days: Grade 2 Parts Reward Box (x20)
[*]20 Days: Grade 3 Parts Reward Box (x30)
[/list]

[h1]Mileage Weapon Auction Event (May 15 – May 29)[/h1]
The Mileage Auction Event that you've all been looking for is back. Players can trade weapons with each other through the auction during the event!

[b]Auction Period[/b]
[*]May 15 - May 29 (From 12:00 - 24:00, CEST)
[/list]
[b]Additional Auction Items[/b]
[*]All weapons released prior to November 2018
[*]Certain Transcendence Weapons are excluded
[/list]

[h1]10,000 Mileage Auction Event (May 15 – May 29)[/h1]
During the event, you can earn special items at special hours! Read the notice below very carefully, and be right on time to claim your goods!

[b]Special Items[/b]
[*]M3 Black Dragon
[*]M249 Phoenix
[*]Red Dragon Cannon
[*]Python Desperado
[/list]
[b]Weekday Auctions (4 times a day / Once per hour)[/b]
CEST
19:00 – 20:00
20:00 – 21:00
21:00 – 22:00
22:00 – 23:00 

[b]Weekend Auctions (6 times a day / Once per hour)[/b]
14:00 – 15:00
15:00 – 16:00
16:00 – 17:00
20:00 – 21:00
21:00 – 22:00
22:00 – 23:00

[b]Notes[/b]
[*]The special items will appear randomly during auction times.
[*]4 will be released on weekdays, and 6 on the weekends.
[*]The items will be released in a rotation, with 4 released during weekdays and 6 during weekends.
[*]This is the order the weekday items will be released in: M3 Black Dragon --> M249 Phoenix --> Red Dragon Cannon --> Python Desperado.
[*]And here's the order for the weekend releases: Red Dragon Cannon --> Python Desperado --> M3 Black Dragon --> M249 Phoenix --> Red Dragon Cannon --> Python Desperado.
[*]10,000 Mileage will be returned to players who did not win the special auction after it ends.
[*]The auction items will appear within 10 minutes of the top of each hour.
[*]Bidding will be open for only 10 minutes.
[/list]

[h1]Guillotine & Magnum Drill Giveaway (May 15 – May 29)[/h1]
You can earn Guillotine and Magnum Drill points based on how you play during the event.

[b]How can I collect Guillotine and Magnum Drill points, you ask?[/b]
[*]+3 Guillotine or Magnum Drill event points each time you score a kill in Zombie Hero or Zombie Z modes
[*]+2 Guillotine or Magnum Drill event points each time you score an assist in Zombie Hero or Zombie Z modes
[*]+2 Guillotine or Magnum Drill event points each time you score an infection in Zombie Hero or Zombie Z modes
[*]+10 Guillotine or Magnum Drill event points upon reaching 30, 60, and 90 minutes of in-game play. (Limited to once per day for each)
[/list]
[b]Rewards[/b]
[*]Each time you reach 50 Magnum Drill event points, they will be exchanged for a Magnum Drill
[*]Each time you reach 50 Guillotine event points, they will be exchanged for a Guillotine
[/list]
[b]Notes[/b]
[*]Only counts in rooms with 8 or more players.
[*]Event points you can earn for each weapon per day are limited to 50.
[*]Total event points you can earn for each weapon Guillotine and Magnum Drill during the event are limited to 350.
[*]That means, if you participate to the fullest, you can get up to 7 Guillotines and 7 Magnum Drills.
[/list]

[h1]2019 Studio Contest! (May 15 – June 26)[/h1]
The 2019 Studio Contest is here! Please check the separate announcement for details!

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/1608260391578447273]Click here for more information[/url]

We're giving out theme packages during the contest, so don't miss this chance and sign up! You could be the studio map creator of tomorrow!


[h1]Level Revamp Reward Giveaway! (May 15 – June 12)[/h1]
As you are surely aware, we've finally revamped the leveling system.
This change might be a bit confusing, so we've prepared a small gift to make it easier on you.

[b]Rewards[/b]
[*]Top 30 C and C Decoder x2
[*]Top 50 Decoder x2
[*]Random Durational Transcendence Weapon (7 Days / x3)
[*]Random Durational Transcendence Class (7 Days / x3)
[*]10,000 Mileage
[/list]
[b]How can I get the rewards, you ask?[/b]
[*]Play CSN:Z for 30 minutes or longer during the event.
[*]It's as simple as that! We'll give rewards to the players on accounts that were created prior to 05/15/2019 (before midnight on 05/14/2019).
[*]You all know that the rewards can only be earned once per account during the event, right?
[/list]
We hope you'll consider the level revamp a major effort of ours to give you all better rewards.

Click below if you have further questions regarding the level revamp!
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/1608260391578434193]Click![/url]


[h1]Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box Sales! (May 15 – May 29)[/h1]
The Lucky Transcendence Weapon Boxes will be on sale during the promotion! It's been quite a while since we last sold these, huh?

The Lucky Transcendence Weapon Boxes come in bundles of 1, 5, and 10.

[b]Contents (High-class)[/b]
[*]Dual Beretta Gunslinger 
[*]Dual Sword Phantom Slayer 
[*]Barrett M95 White Tiger
[*]M249 Phoenix 
[*]M3 Black Dragon
[*]AUG Guardian
[*]Python Desperado
[*]SG552 Lycanthrope
[*]Desert Eagle Crimson Hunter
[*]Warhammer Storm Giant
[*]M4A1 Dark Knight
[*]AK-47 Paladin
[/list]
[b]Contents (Premium: The remaining 10 excluding the Dual Beretta Gunslinger and Dual Sword Phantom Slayer)[/b]
[*]10 kinds of Transcendence Weapons (3 Days)
[*]10 kinds of Transcendence Weapons (7 Days)
[*]11 kinds of Transcendence Weapons (10 Days)
[/list]
[b]Notes[/b]
[*]All unused Lucky Transcendence Weapon Boxes will be removed during the maintenance on 6/12 (Wed), 2 weeks after the promotion ends. You knew that, right?
[*]The boxes will be replaced with 1000 mileage each.
[/list]
[/quote]

There's quite a lot of information here for this patch, but we hope you'll have a good idea of what's in store now!

See you all for the next patch!

Best regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: May 15th (Part 1)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/ece767dd910f29148e711d79edcb740c473c6c5f.jpg[/img]

[b]Survivors,[/b]

We've just finished maintenance, so here's a breakdown of today's CSN:Z update!

[quote]
[h1][b]Updated Content[/b][/h1]

[h1]A Whole New Season 2 is Starting! (May 15 – August 7)[/h1]
Continuing from the glorious challenges from Season 1, the new Season 2 is about to begin! You must be intensely curious about Season 2, right? Well, make sure to check out the preview video below if you want to know more about what's coming!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/fa4bea0a44f99c5213831232aa22900b8ea24c9b.jpg[/img]

[h1]💁🏼‍♀️ Check out GM Yuri covering about the massive update contents of Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies 2019 Season 2![/h1] [url=https://youtu.be/25-8qjIAXcI]Watch Now![/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/1754619776285992426]Season System Information[/url]
Enjoy all the news we have to share about Season 2!

[b]Season 2 Rewards[/b]
[*]Rewards are immediately given based on the ranks you reach each season.
[*]If you purchase a Season Pass, you'll get both the Season Pass rewards and the free rewards.
[*]Rewards unique to a specific season can only be earned during that season.
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/37c25681250c0b9ef83b9be103f67976157ce9ce.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/54153ab595e3c2883745bc036a253042bc6d6f40.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/35c6bef7f5cd4a7786b0372f3c52dd467ab18bbc.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/d0b65f32158038e0e24ae76b47c3c73bb3fbfefe.jpg[/img]

Additionally, you'll receive 3 badges every 30 minutes as part of the Season Event! These rewards may be obtained up to 4 times each day!

[b]We have some news about the 4th Zombie Meta Change, too![/b]

You can check the information by clicking below, since we made a separate preview for the Zombie Meta Change!

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/1608260391578446454]Click here for more information![/url]


[b]Karma System Added[/b]
While playing as a zombie, the Karma gauge will fill any time you take action against the humans.

And the Karma earned can be used when playing as a human!

There are rewards specific to each stage, and you can press F1 at the stage you want while playing as a human.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/b90a7894f54823d6d3bac37734e7f814a282b425.jpg[/img]


[b]Weapon Balance Adjustment[/b]
Purchase level for certain weapons in Zombie Z will be adjusted.


[b]Zombie Balance Fix[/b]
[*]HP will be adjusted based on the Zombie Z level.
[*]The experience quotas in Zombie Z will be adjusted.
[*]The movement speed for zombies in early rounds in Zombie Z mode will be adjusted.
[*]Zombie skill cooldown prior to virus detoxification will change from 50% reduction to 30% reduction.
[*]The skill range for Banshee Pulling and Deimos Shock skills will be reduced, and the cooldown will be increased.
[/list]

[h1]Shop Item Revamp! (May 15 – June 12)[/h1]
As we announced before, the shop items have finally been revamped! That means new items have been added, existing items have been changed, and the Mileage Shop is open for business!

[b]Points[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/2b7725305916e4a298d715ca73a9d2e4647ab311.jpg[/img]

[b]Mileage[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/2c8e46373607dd5470c22fc32a63cd04b578cc08.jpg[/img]

[b]Steam Cash (USD)[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/441d96ce4d8c594b6f7174018f53a5f37467b839.jpg[/img]
[/quote]

Now you know what to expect in the store, all right here! Just remember, the shop lineup can change at any time!

Best regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [Notice] Dev. Note - How Have You All Been? It's Been Awhile!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/a7c91d360da13122706341ed3fd14c22b218d37e.jpg[/img]

[url=http://www.csnzombies.com/fr/avis-note-des-developpeurs-comment-allez-vous-ca-faisait-longtemps/]French[/url]
[url=http://www.csnzombies.com/de/mitteilung-nachrichten-der-entwickler-wie-geht-es-euch-das-letzte-mal-ist-schon-etwas-her/]German[/url]
[url=http://www.csnzombies.com/ru/%D1%81%D0%BE%D0%BE%D0%B1%D1%89%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%B5-%D0%B7%D0%B0%D0%BC%D0%B5%D1%82%D0%BA%D0%B8-%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B7%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B1%D0%BE%D1%82%D1%87%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%B2-%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%BA/]Russian[/url]
[url=http://www.csnzombies.com/tr/duyuru-gelistirici-notu-nasilsiniz-uzun-zaman-oldu/]Turkish[/url]

[b]Survivors,[/b]

CSN:Z Dev Team sent a new letter for you guys AGAIN. Please see below!

[quote]
[h1]Q: It's been awhile indeed! Why don't you greet all of the CSN:Z players?[/h1]
A: Hello, survivors of CSN:Z! Some of you may already know, but this is Dev Y from Nexon Korea, in charge of CSN:Z development. Howdy!

[h1]Q: Last time, you told us about the season system updates after CSOGS. Is there anything you'd like to add regarding the season system?[/h1]
A: Firstly, I'd like to say a word of thanks to all of your support for season 1. I really appreciate it! All your comments and opinions play an incredibly important role in development.

We're putting a lot of effort into preparing for season 2, as we believe season 1 wasn't quite up to par. It was the first of its kind, after all.


[h1]Q: Season 2? What is that about?[/h1]
A: It's a bit difficult to give you the details, as it's in the core stages of development. But I can tell you that the background will be early 20th century western areas. Keep up the hype as we prepare!

[h1]Q: I see. There are rumors of a shop revamp, too.[/h1]
A: Where did you hear such a thing?

[h1]Q: The source cannot be disclosed.[/h1]
A: Hmm, must be a reliable source, because you're right. We're in the process of developing a new game shop that will allow Survivors to purchase useful CSN:Z items with several types of currencies. The details cannot be given out at this point, though. I hope you understand.

[h1]Q: We've also heard that you'll be hosting a Studio Map Contest. And that there will be an extraordinary prize.[/h1]
A: Ha ha ha, the prize hasn't been decided just yet. However, there indeed will be a Studio Map Contest. We thought of a competition between the maps you created yourselves and thought we'd give out rewards more realistically suited for the best designers.

[h1]Q: Any plans for new weapons?[/h1]
A: Already being created. A new transcendence weapon, that is. The only hint I can give you at this point is that it's quite similar in style with weapons that you've already seen. To give you a hint… Think of the similarities between Thanos and Winter Soldier from the Marvel Universe to get an idea of the weapon.

We're also thinking about an enhanced version of the Black Dragon Cannon as well! Hang on tight to find out what kind of awesome weapons we've prepared for you all.


[h1]Q: All right, thanks. Is there anything else you'd like to say to the CSN:Z community before we conclude?[/h1]
A: Every moment of development is a swamp of concerns. I constantly ask questions like 'Will the players enjoy this content?' or 'Will our efforts bring joy and satisfaction to our players?'

I'm aware of the negative reviews that have been left recently. I'm also aware of the criticisms saying that the game is P2W. Although there are moments when a difficult decision has to be made against our will, I plan to set a development direction from now on to bring player friendly updates so that as many players can get settled into the game as possible.

Please keep supporting us!


[h1]Q: Thanks for your time.[/h1]
A: I'll see you all next time with a fresh set of news! Thanks as always, y'all!
[/quote]

Do you have any questions on this or want to tell something to 'Dev Y?'
Leave us a comment!

Kind Regards,
The CSN:Z Team


[quote]
[h1][b]Spanish version:[/b][/h1]
[/quote]
[quote]
[h1][Notificación] Nota del desarrollador: ¿Qué tal va todo? Ya hace tiempo desde nuestra última notificación.[/h1]

[h1]P: ¡Sí que hace tiempo desde la última notificación! ¿Quieres saludar a todos los jugadores de CSN:Z?[/h1]
R: ¡Hola, sobrevivientes de CSN:Z! Algunos de ustedes quizás ya lo sepan, pero les habla el desarrollador Y de Nexon Korea, encargado del desarrollo de CSN:Z. ¡Un saludo a todos!

[h1]P: La última vez, nos contaste sobre las actualizaciones del sistema de temporadas tras el CSOGS. ¿Te gustaría comentar algo más sobre el sistema de temporadas?[/h1]
R: En primer lugar, me gustaría agradecerles a todos por el apoyo recibido en la Temporada 1. ¡Muchas gracias! Todos sus comentarios y opiniones juegan un papel verdaderamente importante en el proceso de desarrollo.

Estamos trabajando muy duro para prepararnos para la Temporada 2, ya que creemos que la Temporada 1 no fue tan buena como esperábamos. Después de todo, fue la primera.


[h1]P: ¿De qué se trata la Temporada 2? ¿Puedes darnos algún adelanto?[/h1]
R: Es complicado entrar en detalles, ya que se encuentra en plena fase de desarrollo. Pero puedo contarte que estará ambientada en el lejano Oeste a principios del siglo XX. ¡Mantengan las expectativas bien altas mientras terminamos con los preparativos!

[h1]P: Ya veo. Existen rumores de que también habrá una renovación de la tienda.[/h1]
R: ¿Dónde escuchaste eso?

[h1]P: No puedo revelarte mi fuente.[/h1]
R: Entonces tu fuente debe de ser confiable, porque es verdad. Estamos en pleno proceso de desarrollo de una nueva tienda del juego que les permitirá a los sobrevivientes comprar los artículos de CSN:Z que necesiten con distintos tipos de monedas. Pero no puedo darte más detalles ahora mismo. Espero que lo entiendas.

[h1]P: También nos enteramos de que serás el presentador de un concurso de mapas de estudio. Y que el premio será increíble.[/h1]
R: Jajaja, todavía no decidimos cuál será el premio. Pero sí, organizaremos un concurso de mapas de estudio. Pensamos hacer una competencia con los mapas que crearon los jugadores y otorgarles recompensas más acordes a los mejores diseñadores.

[h1]P: ¿Planean crear nuevas armas?[/h1]
R: Ya la estamos creando. Hablo de una nueva arma de trascendencia. El único adelanto que puedo darte ahora mismo es que tiene un estilo bastante similar al de las armas que ya conocen. Para darte una pista... Piensa en las similitudes entre Thanos y el Soldado de Invierno del Universo Marvel y podrás darte una idea de cómo será el arma.

¡También pensamos lanzar una versión mejorada del Cañón Dragón Negro! Estén atentos, ya que pronto daremos a conocer las armas increíbles que hemos creado.


[h1]P: De acuerdo, gracias. ¿Te gustaría decirle algo más a la comunidad de CSN:Z antes de terminar?[/h1]
R: Durante el proceso de desarrollo, nos surgen muchas inquietudes. Constantemente me pregunto: «¿Les gustará este contenido a los jugadores?» o «¿Nuestro esfuerzo será suficiente para que nuestros jugadores se diviertan y estén satisfechos?».

Soy consciente de las reseñas negativas que hemos recibido últimamente. También soy consciente de las críticas que dicen que este es un juego P2W. Si bien a veces tenemos que tomar decisiones difíciles aunque no queramos, mi intención es fijar una dirección del desarrollo, desde ahora en adelante, que se base en lanzar actualizaciones que mejoren la experiencia del usuario. De esta manera, más jugadores podrán adaptarse mejor al juego.

¡Por eso les pedimos que sigan apoyándonos!


[h1]P: Gracias por tu tiempo.[/h1]
R: ¡Nos vemos la próxima vez con muchas más novedades! Como siempre, gracias a todos.
[/quote]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: April 30th
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/ece767dd910f29148e711d79edcb740c473c6c5f.jpg[/img]

[b]Survivors,[/b]

We've just finished maintenance, so here's a breakdown of today's CSN:Z update!


[h1][b]Updated Events[/b][/h1]
[quote]
[h1]Event Reward Box Giveaway (April 30 – May 15)[/h1]
You will receive event rewards for reaching play time goals during the event!

[b]How to Get[/b]
[*]Every time you reach 20 / 40 / 60 / 80 / 100 minutes of play time, you'll be awarded 1 event reward box.
[/list]
[b]Event Reward Box Contents (You'll get a random selection from the prizes shown below!)[/b]
[*]1 / 2 / 5 / 10 Bingo Tickets
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/f2b4703d36064678cc0fbb946b832124bb1ce040.png[/img]
[b]Notes[/b]
[*]It's possible to obtain a total of 15 x 5 = 75 boxes.
[*]In theory, it's possible to obtain up to 99 tickets if you participate as much as possible.
[*]Play time only counts in rooms with 4 or more players, and all unused event reward boxes will be removed during maintenance on 5/15!
[/list]

[h1]Mileage Bingo Ticket Sales Event (April 30 – May 15)[/h1]
You can purchase Bingo Tickets at the Mileage Shop during the event!

[b]How can you purchase and use them?[/b]
[*]You can participate in Bingo by using 1 ticket to reveal a random space.
[*]You can purchase 1 / 50 / 100 Bingo Tickets.
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/84a1814a62b4be22e8f495596912cb5293f89eb7.png[/img]
[b]Notes[/b]
[*]1 Bingo Ticket is consumed for revealing a random space, or for resetting the Bingo board.
[*]All unused Bingo Tickets will be removed during the maintenance on 5/15!
[/list]

[h1]Mileage Bingo Event! (April 30 – May 15)[/h1]
You'll receive rewards if you clear the Mileage Bingo during the event! Curious about the prize?

[b]Reward Items[/b]
[*]Barrett M95 White Tiger (Permanent)
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/3c839ea03fc4e4c493853f8aca8926d1b69f038d.png[/img]
Clear the Mileage Bingo and claim yourself a Barrett M95 White Tiger (Permanent) for free!


[h1]Mileage Bingo Extra Giveaway (May 15 – May 29)[/h1]
You'll receive rewards based on the stages cleared before the maintenance on 5/15 for the Mileage Bingo! (The rewards per stage will be given out for 2 weeks after the end of the event on 5/15)

[b]Stages Cleared and Rewards[/b]
[*]Clear 10 - 14 Bingo Boards: Barrett M95 White Tiger (7 Days)
[*]Clear 15 - 19 Bingo Boards: Barrett M95 White Tiger (15 Days)
[*]Clear 20 - 24 Bingo Boards: Barrett M95 White Tiger (30 Days)
[/list]

Let's watch im.Baron's Barrett M95 White Tiger video!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X0G3hNyv4Yk

[h1]Bonus Disassembly Event (April 30 – May 15)[/h1]
Use the Bonus Disassembly System during the event to disassemble your weapons, and you might even get a few fully disassembled!

[b]Notes[/b]
[*]Weekdays/Weekends: 18:00 - 24:00 (CEST)
[*]Minimum Participation Mileage: 5,000 Mileage
[/list]
[b]New Weapons to Disassemble[/b]
[*]Dual Sword Infernal Hunter
[*]Gungnir
[*]7 Trans Gears
[*]Hunter-Killer X-7
[*]Thunder Ghost Walker
[/list]
The weapons listed above will be added!
 

[h1]Play the Random Zombie Hero Event 1 (April 30 – May 15)[/h1]
During the event, you can play Random Weapon Zombie Hero!

[b]Featured Maps[/b]
[*]Italy, Assault, Militia, Dust, Origin, Abyss 2
[/list]

[h1]Play the Random Zombie Hero Event 2 (April 30 – May 15)[/h1]
You'll get a reward for Zombie kills in the Random Weapon Zombie Hero mode during the event!

[b]Rewards[/b]
[*]100 Mileage per kill
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/0118a31ee75d849bc8157a0d2f48152105d092d5.png[/img]
[b]Notes[/b]
[*]You can receive the rewards up to 5 times per day.
[*]The number of rewards received will reset each day.
[*]You can participate only in rooms with eight or more players!
[/list]
[/quote]

Once again, we want to thank you all for your continued support of CSN:Z.
We hope you enjoy these updates, and we can't wait for you to see what we've got in store!

Ah by the way...
[*]We've fixed ranking bug today, finally. (Sigh) ːsteamfacepalmː
[/list]
We are terribly sorry for your inconvenience so far!!!

Best regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: April 17th
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/ece767dd910f29148e711d79edcb740c473c6c5f.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

We've made it midway through April! How are you keeping up with your plans for the month? Let's see how our plans for CSN:Z's April patch suit you!

[h1][b]Team Deathmatch Renewed![/b][/h1]

We've renewed TDM mode upon our development plan! Here's a simple description of the changes!

[b]Faction Balance Renewed[/b]
[*]Applied auto-team balance function.
[*]This will distribute players automatically upon a number of players and your level.
[*]This will also change your spawning point if you have been killed a couple of times or your death count reaches a certain point.
[/list]
[b]Playing Function Improved[/b]
[*]When you are hit by someone, your HUD will show differently.
[*]You will see your friendly team member's outline from now on. (You can turn this function on/off)
[*]If you are being killed continuously or your death count reaches a certain point, your invincibility time will be extended when spawning.
[*]Damage of some of the weapons have been adjusted in the original mode/TDM.
[/list]
More details will​ follow next week.

[quote]
[h1][b]Updated Events[/b][/h1]

[h1]Daily Reward Revamp (April 17 - May 15)[/h1]

The Daily Rewards have been revamped! The cumulative rewards have changed to be more practical.

[b]How to Get[/b]
[*]Reach 10 minutes of in-game play time after logging in.
[/list]
[b]Reward Details[/b]
[*]Top 50 Event Decoder
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/7cb412747977d49b0d59af62c3b2e2ddfdb314dc.png[/img]
[b]Cumulative Rewards[/b]
[*]5 days: Top 50 Event Decoder x5
[*]7 days: Top 50 Event Decoder x7
[*]10 days: Top 50 Event Decoder x10
[*]15 days: Top 50 Event Decoder x15
[*]20 days: Top 50 Event Decoder x20
[/list]
With the new Daily Reward system, get decoders and cumulative rewards!

[h1]Extended! Limited Time: 4 Parts Weapons Sold in the Shop (April 17 – May 15)[/h1]

We decided to extend the sale of the 4 Parts Weapons in the Shop until 5/15! They're only available during the event.

[b]Weapon Names[/b]
[*]THANATOS-9
[*]Broad Divine
[*]ATTACK M950
[*]AIR BUSTER
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/87eefa58939366aa478c1d34c55e9a05e4ae4b88.png[/img]
Purchase these weapons soon, before they expire and disappear from the shop!

[h1]Season 1 Transcendence Class Sale Promotion! (April 17 - April 30)[/h1]

Lucky Transcendence Class Boxes will be on sale for the entire promotion! You can only buy them during the promotion, though, so don't miss out!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/cb328cfac0fd3909ae8b87b1d0c4e871d9cf7dcf.png[/img]
[b]Item Sold[/b]
[*]Lucky Transcendence Class Box (x1/x10/x30/x100)
[/list]
[b]Contents: High-Class Items[/b]
[*]Axion
[*]Aetheris
[*]Dorothy Dark Knight
[*]Flora Paladin
[*]Transcendence Ji Yoon Choi
[*]Transcendence Yuri
[*]Sonya Lycanthrope
[*]Elizabeth Crimson Hunter
[*]Transcendence Michaela
[*]Transcendence Blair
[*]Rose Phoenix
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/0511f7501e3a9cf0d9d03911aa376f94a102acf4.png[/img]

[b]Contents: Premium Items[/b]
[*]10 Transcendence Classes (3 Days)
[*]10 Transcendence Classes (5 Days)
[*]10 Transcendence Classes (7 Days)
[/list]
[b]Notes[/b]
[*]All unused Lucky Transcendence Class Boxes will be removed during the 4/30 maintenance.
[*]The boxes will be replaced with 50 mileage each.
[*]Unlike before, there is no Guaranteed Transcendence Class Box.
[*]The 30-pack and 100-pack sets will be sold at a discount.
[/list]

Let's Watch Huxley's review video on YouTube!

[b][u]Axion[/u][/b]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Hrlsc54n8Bg

[b][u]Aetheris[/u][/b]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q13CGNM9Atk

Here's the voice of Axion and Aetheris!

[b][u]Axion[/u][/b]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZPND9Q9pPKU

[b][u]Aetheris[/u][/b]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NrhCQjRiHPU

[h1]Season 1 Transcendence Class Costume Guaranteed Giveaway Event (April 17 - April 30)[/h1]

You will get Season 1 Transcendence Class Costume item(s) based on how many Lucky Transcendence Class Boxes you use during the event.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/530bb89f296cbce5cf04cfc2fa56e7232f0d014e.png[/img]

[b]Requirements[/b]
[*]Use 50 Lucky Transcendence Class Boxes: Axion's Battle Helmet (Permanent)
[*]Use 100 Lucky Transcendence Class Boxes: Aetheris' Beacon (Permanent)
[/list]
[b]Notes[/b]
[*]When you've used the required number of boxes, you'll immediately get the corresponding costume.
[*]Each account can only receive each reward once.
[/list]
[h1]New Overseer Medal Released! (From April 17)[/h1]
A new medal is coming! We know you've been waiting for it, so look forward to this one!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/7f4577cf8ed5bb42a681a31d39916311103eb8c2.png[/img]

[b]Conditions[/b]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: April 3rd
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/ece767dd910f29148e711d79edcb740c473c6c5f.jpg[/img]

[b]Survivors,[/b]

Are you having an exciting April? Hopefully these patch notes for 4/3 will make it even better!

[quote]
[h1][b]Updated Events[/b][/h1]

[h1]The Thunder Ghost Walker is here! (April 3 - May 1)[/h1]
The long-awaited Thunder Ghost Walker has finally arrived! This is a single-shot pistol equipped with an optical invisibility system and .50 BMG special ammunition. If you use the Conceal skill while wielding the Thunder Ghost Walker, your Movement Speed will also get a big boost.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/be30018843fe1ff59493ed53402896f7ac68714a.png[/img]

Have a look at the review video for the Thunder Ghost Walker if you haven't yet. Special thanks to [Huxley], who created the video!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dP9-88Y6pLo
[b]How to Get[/b]
[*]Get this awesome new weapon from Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoders and Top 50 Premium Decoders!
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/238f3ff4045d1b5791eb95d96a86637c90c58a8e.png[/img]
[b]Notes[/b]
[*]All Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoders and Top 50 Premium Decoders sold during the promotion will be removed during maintenance on Wednesday, May 1st.
[*]Each unused Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoder will be replaced with 500 Mileage.
[*]Each unused Top 50 Premium Decoder will be replaced with 50 Mileage.
[/list]
The Thunder Ghost Walker becomes even more powerful when used with the Conceal skill, making it a must-have weapon!


[h1]Thunder Ghost Walker Guaranteed Giveaway! (April 3 - May 1)[/h1]
We are offering a guaranteed Thunder Ghost Walker for everyone interested in giving this powerful weapon a try!

[b]Conditions[/b]
[*]Use 210 Top 50 Premium Decoders, OR
[*] Use 35 Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoders, and we'll give you your very own Thunder Ghost Walker.
[/list]
When you've used enough, you'll get the item immediately. Keep in mind that each account can only receive this reward once!


[h1]Find the Zombie Event! (April 3 - April 17)[/h1]
During the event, click the Find the Zombie tab at the bottom of the screen to participate!

There are 16 characters (12 Zombies, 4 Humans) in total, and you can progress through the event by hitting zombies with bullets.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/7aee85381338ed0a5d46c780200cdd468d4d3b04.png[/img]

[b]How to Get Bullets[/b]
[*]You can get bullets by playing the game for 15 minutes or longer.
[*]You can also purchase them from the Shop, in bundles of 1, 10, 30, or 50.
[/list]
[b]How to Progress[/b]
[*]The more zombies you hit, the higher your reward rank grows. You also earn more shots.
[*]When you hit a human, your reward rank goes down, and the game ends.
[*]When you select Surrender, the game ends and you get your current rewards.
[*]Every time you receive your rewards, the event scoreboard will reset.
[*]You can participate in the event as long as you have bullets, either earned from play time or bought from the Shop.
[/list]
[b]What Are the Rewards?[/b]
[*]Class 1 - Class 4 Bronze Box (Contains one random item)
[*]Class 1 - Class 4 Silver Box (Contains one random item)
[*]Class 1 - Class 4 Gold Box (Contains one random item)
[*]High Class Gold Box (Contains ALL items)
[/list]
[b]Reward List[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/484ac3711b83803aad6c0656ab790d3931156c99.png[/img]
[b]Notes[/b]
[*]You can obtain up to 10 bullets a day from play time.
[*]Over the course of the event, you can earn up to 150 bullets.
[*]Play time can only be earned in rooms with 8 or more players!
[/list]

[h1]Information on Parts Error Compensation[/h1]
Recently, we confirmed an issue where certain part effects were not applied, due to a code error in the service. 

We apologize for any inconveniences this may have caused. We have fixed the error in today's maintenance.
[*]We will also give a 5000 Mileage Coupon as a login reward to all players who may have been inconvenienced. (Excludes new accounts created after 4/2 23:59:59)
[/list]
Once again, we apologize to all players affected by this issue. We will do our best to minimize such issues in the future.
[/quote]

We want to thank you all for your continued support of CSN:Z.
We hope you enjoy these updates, and we can't wait for you to see what we've got in store!

Best regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: March 20th
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/ece767dd910f29148e711d79edcb740c473c6c5f.jpg[/img]

[b]Survivors,[/b]

You may notice a bit of a shift underway in our messaging, but not to worry. We're making a few tweaks and changes to the way we present our announcements, in the hope of cutting out redundant information and delivering our message in a straightforward, easy-to-understand manner.

[quote]
[h1][b]Updated Events[/b][/h1]

[h1]Daily Reward Renewal (March 20 – April 17)[/h1]
Going forward, the Reward List will be updated on a monthly basis!

[b]How to Earn Rewards[/b]
[*]Reach 10 minutes of in-game play time after logging in.
[/list]
[b]Daily Rewards[/b]
[*]50 Mileage
[/list]
[b]Cumulative Rewards[/b]
[*]5 Days: Dual Beretta Gunslinger (7 Days)
[*]7 Days: Magnum Launcher (7 Days)
[*]10 Days: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box (x1)
[*]15 Days: Grade 6 Parts Reward Box (x1)
[/list]

[h1]Gunsmith's Toolbox Giveaway! (March 20 – April 3)[/h1]
Each day you log in and play for at least 30 minutes while this event is running, you'll receive a Gunsmith's Toolbox. (Rewards will be given immediately, and will change based on the number of Toolboxes already present in your inventory.)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/e58ef1c0e1ff4b591503d07d0238ecf275870b03.png[/img]

[b]REWARD[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/db490ca2965a777befbfdb90eac2c025eab1ace7.png[/img]
[b]Notes[/b]
[*]You can obtain only 1 Gunsmith's Toolbox per day.
[*]All Gunsmith's Toolboxes will be removed during the maintenance on 4/3 (Wed).
[*]Play time can only be accumulated in rooms with 8 or more players.
[/list]

[h1]Weapon Exchange Coupon Giveaway! (March 20 – April 3)[/h1]
While this event is running, you'll receive Event Reward Boxes containing Weapon Exchange Coupons each time you hit an in-game play time milestone. Play more to get more - it's that simple!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/18a6002ae42e308f79ac55edd9ebbb58eb95ca22.png[/img]

[b]What are Weapon Exchange Coupons?[/b]
[*]These coupons are your tickets to free weapons! Whenever you hit 100 coupons, you can redeem them for one of 4 different parts weapons sold in the shop!
[/list]
[b]Which weapons can you choose from?[/b]
[*]THANATOS-9
[*]Broad Divine
[*]Attack M950
[*]Air Buster
[/list]
[b]How to Earn Rewards[/b]
[*]Reach 20/40/60/80/100 minutes of play time.
[*]You'll receive an Event Reward Box for every 20 minutes you play (up to 100 minutes per day). 
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/224ee482e9bc2d53d2d768a42dc489e21c3e7efd.png[/img]

[b]What kinds of items are in the Event Rewards Boxes?[/b]
[*]100 Mileage
[*]500 Mileage
[*]2,000 Mileage
[*]Weapon Exchange Coupon x5
[*]Weapon Exchange Coupon x10
[*]Weapon Exchange Coupon x20
[*]Weapon Exchange Coupon x50
[*]Top 50 Decoder x2
[/list]
[b]Notes[/b]
[*]You can obtain up to 5 Event Reward Boxes per day, per account. That's a total of 75 boxes if you earn the maximum each day the event is running!
[*]Play time can only be accumulated in rooms with 8 or more players.
[*]All Weapon Exchange Coupons and unused Event Reward Boxes will be removed during the maintenance on 4/3 (Wed).
[/list]

[h1]Hunter Killer X-7 Promotion! (March 20 – April 3)[/h1]
For this special promotion, the Hunter-Killer X-7 will be added to the Top 50 Unlimited Decoders and Top 50 Decoders for a limited time.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/beb7920aeb80b9abd0481eb55f6e61ac6eb6a9b4.png[/img]

Let's watch Huxley's Hunter Killer X-7 review on YouTube!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yn8bHS0BQl0

If you've had your eye on the Hunter Killer X-7, or just feel the allure of a new weapon calling to you, now's the time to strike, since your chances of getting it will be higher than normal throughout the promotional period!


[h1]Hunter Killer X-7 Guaranteed Giveaway Promotion! (March 20 – April 3)[/h1]
If you weren't able to snag a Hunter Killer X-7 even with the higher rates, don't fret just yet! We've got a Hunter Killer X-7 Guaranteed Giveaway here to make sure you don't go away empty-handed.

[b]Conditions and Rewards[/b]
[*]Use 60 Top 50 Decoders, OR use 10 Top 50 Unlimited Decoders.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/8432ae29aac7cb0859533886e3c69468c99283e1.png[/img]

[b]Notes[/b]
[*]When you've used the required number of Top 50 Decoders or Top 50 Unlimited Decoders, you'll immediately be given a Hunter-Killer X-7. This reward can be redeemed only once per account.
[/list]

[h1]Limited Time: 4 Parts Weapons Sold Directly in the Shop (March 20 - April 17)[/h1]
During this promotion, we'll be selling 4 Parts Weapons directly in the shop. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/87eefa58939366aa478c1d34c55e9a05e4ae4b88.png[/img]

[b]Weapons on Offer[/b]
[*]THANATOS-9
[*]Broad Divine
[*]Attack M950
[*]Air Buster
[/list]

[h1]Gun Boost Part Guaranteed Giveaway (March 20 - April 3)[/h1]
During this promotion, if you use a set number of Decoders, we'll give you your very own Grade 4 Gun Boost.

[b]Conditions and Rewards[/b]
[*]Use 30 Top 50 Decoders, OR use 5 Top 50 Unlimited Decoders.
[/list]
[b]Notes[/b]
[*]When you've used the required number of Top 50 Decoders or Top 50 Unlimited Decoders, you'll immediately be given a Grade 4 Gun Boost.
[*]This reward can be redeemed only once per account.
[/list]

[h1]Weapon restriction: new weapons on the list![/h1]
As you expected, below weapons will not be used in the standard mode.
[*]Python Desperado
[*]Dual Sword Phantom Slayer
[*]Dual Beretta Gunslinger

[*]Star Chaser SR

[*]Savery
[*]Triple-barreled shotgun
[*]Bouncer

[/quote]

Once again, we want to thank you all for your continued support of CSN:Z.
We hope you enjoy these updates, and we can't wait for you to see what we've got in store!

Best regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [Update] Introducing the Windrider! (Final Reward of Season Pass)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/a5acd9751c78c1f0c6646ea16d1da5053f8b4a37.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

The Windrider is a pistol gifted to the protectors of the wind goddess. This automatic weapon takes 30 rounds of .44 Magnum special ammunition. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/83f0e6ca40fcd1d859abcdaae8343ec38d69ff21.png[/img]

Crafted for the most noble of souls, those skilled in martial arts will get the most from its ability to take down targets swiftly at any distance.

Check out a review of this impressive new weapon from our Youtuber friend Huxley!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TWmdnXj5jmQ
Since the Windrider functions like a smaller Dual Beretta Gunslinger, it's ideal for players without that particular weapon, or afficionados of mini weapons.

You can earn your very own Windrider and other great perks by purchasing a Season Pass. You can also earn one by reaching the max level!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/ad5e55abec51e1dfbd870d4d770a90aa76b1182e.png[/img]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/1754619776285992426]Click here[/url] to learn more about the Season System!

Kind Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: March 6th

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/ece767dd910f29148e711d79edcb740c473c6c5f.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

[*]Mileage Duffel Bag Sales Promotion.
[/list]

[h1][b]Updated Events[/b][/h1]
[quote]
[h1]Mileage Auction House Event (March 6 – March 20)[/h1]

The Auction House Event is here, and sooner than you probably expected, too! How much Mileage have you been saving up? 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/3b0a7a445b29223d6979950c3c809a29d7ebc665.png[/img]

[b]Auction Items Added[/b]
[*]Arm Torch 
[*]Claymore MD5

Opportunity is knocking! Here's your chance to turn all the Mileage you've collected into awesome weapons! This event runs for a limited time, though, so be sure you don't miss out!

[h1]Mileage Duffel Bag Sales Promotion (March 6 – March 20)[/h1]

In the past, you had to go through the rather tedious process of making multiple purchases if you wanted to buy a Mileage Duffel Bag, used to send Mileage to your friends. In order to streamline this process, we've created an event where we'll be selling the Mileage Duffel Bags in bundles.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/e14206041828532f1e94b3147985c4350f080e1b.png[/img]

We've set it up so you'll get a greater discount if you purchase 10 Mileage Duffel Bags at once rather than purchasing single Mileage Duffel Bags 10 times, so if buying in bulk is your thing, it's your lucky day![/quote]

We may not have too much new to show off this time, but we want you to know that we're working diligently to bring you the things you've been hoping for in our next patch. Maybe there's even some Thunder on the horizon...

Once again, we want to thank you all for your continued support for CSN:Z.
We hope you enjoy these updates, and we can't wait for you to see what we've got in store!

Best regards,
The CSN:Z Team

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/ece767dd910f29148e711d79edcb740c473c6c5f.jpg[/img]

[b]Survivors,[/b]

We had relatively short maintenance today because we only had to tune our servers and machines, and we are testing new Turkish dedicated servers as well.

There are a couple of things we’d like you to know today...

[quote]
[h1]Top 50 Unlimited/Premium Decoders have been replaced with mileage today.[/h1]
As we mentioned earlier, we have injected mileage to replace your unused Top 50 Unlimited/Premium Decoders today. We hope you already had a chance to use your decoders!

[h1]Added new coupon code in the client.[/h1]
We have added a new coupon code into the system today. This code will be sent by Facebook Chatbot Message in a day or two. If you have totally no idea what the Facebook Chatbot Message and coupon are, please feel free to check the posts below.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/1738856542166060410]Facebook Messenger Chatbot has finally launched![/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/1754619776291128018]How to Use Your Chatbot Exclusive Coupon?[/url]
[/list]

[h1]Minor bug fixes.[/h1]
We fixed a couple of string issues and bugs. We have received some bug reports, such as the Weekly Mission login issue and a light zombie bug. We are fixing it on the developer side and will soon release a new bug fix..[/quote]

notes.title: [Notice] Dev. Note - Hello and Welcome to 2019!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/a7c91d360da13122706341ed3fd14c22b218d37e.jpg[/img]
[url=http://www.csnzombies.com/de/mitteilung-hinweis-der-entwickler-hallo-und-willkommen-2019/]German[/url]
[url=http://www.csnzombies.com/fr/avis-note-des-developpeurs-bonjour-et-bienvenue-en-2019/]French[/url]
[url=http://www.csnzombies.com/tr/duyuru-gelistirici-notu-merhaba-ve-2019a-hos-geldiniz/]Turkish[/url]
[url=http://www.csnzombies.com/ru/%D1%81%D0%BE%D0%BE%D0%B1%D1%89%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%B5-%D0%B7%D0%B0%D0%BC%D0%B5%D1%82%D0%BA%D0%B8-%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B7%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B1%D0%BE%D1%82%D1%87%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%B2-%D0%B4%D0%BE%D0%B1/]Russian[/url]


[b]Survivors,[/b]

CSN:Z Dev Team sent a letter for you guys. Please see below!

[quote]
[h1]Q: Please say a quick hello and introduce yourself to the CSN:Z community.[/h1]

A: Hello, survivors of CSN:Z! This is "Dev Y" from Nexon Korea, in charge of game development. It's nice to meet you like this. I really wanted to do this more often, and this is a long overdue greeting, since we've been so busy.


[h1]Q: We've been hearing since CSOGS that you're working on a new Season System. Could you please give us a brief overview of the Season System?[/h1]

A: Sure! The Season System is brand-new content for 2019 which will cycle every 3 months, with its first season from 2/20 to 5/15. You can earn Free Pass rewards for the rank you achieve during each season, and you can get even more rewards if you purchase the Season Pass. What's important to note is that, rewards specific to a season cannot be obtained from other seasons.

The main idea is that it's a system where you can earn a variety of rare rewards like weapons, classes, and costumes by completing daily or weekly missions, along with events that we've prepared for you!


[h1]Q: Great. I've also heard you've got more in store, such as Epic Weapons?[/h1]

A: That's correct. We're working hard to introduce them to you by next week. We're preparing the new Epic Weapon Gungnir. You can use it to annihilate zombies with a variety of modes such as the lightning-type for melee, firing-mode for ranged, and the ultimate ability, Javelin Throw.

Don't forget that the new Epic Weapon Gungnir can be obtained from Epic Decoders and Epic Reward Boxes. We've put a lot of effort into it, so we hope you enjoy this new Epic Weapon!


[h1]Q: On top of that, we heard that the new Zombie Scenario Season 7-2 is being released. What is that about?[/h1]

A: The new boss, Megalodon, will make its appearance. Like we revealed earlier, it's a boss that looks similar to a shark. You'd better steel yourself, as it is a very powerful boss.


[h1]Q: There are rumors that Enzo and Lucia might be in danger.[/h1]

A: That's correct. After reaching the destination, they encounter situations like being attacked by a mysterious poison, or almost getting barbecued from a fire attack. You'd better pay attention to the appearance of the mysterious man and woman.


[h1]Q: By mysterious man and woman, do you mean there are new classes?[/h1]

A: Ha ha, I can't reveal too much... We encourage you to play the game and discover it yourself.


[h1]Q: All right, thanks. You've told us quite a lot so far. Do you have anything else to tell the CSN:Z community?[/h1]

A: It's almost been 5 years since we started servicing CSN:Z, and so much has happened since then. We can't thank all of you who continue to play CSN:Z enough. The dev team promises try our hardest to create much more enjoyable contents and game play to ensure that your experience is as fun as possible.

We hope that you continue to love and support all of CSN:Z, including the new contents being released this time, like the Season System, the Epic Weapon Gungnir, and the Zombie Scenario 7-2!


[h1]Q: Thanks for your time.[/h1]

A: No problem! I hope we have more opportunities like this in the future to speak to the players![/quote]

Do you have any questions on this or want to tell something to 'Dev Y?'
Leave us a comment!

Kind Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/ece767dd910f29148e711d79edcb740c473c6c5f.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

Here’s a brief summary of what’s coming at you in this week’s update.

[h1][b]Updated Content[/b][/h1]
[*]Last Stand Mode
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/6ac71fbacf8cfdf15506b840caad484cbb912684.png[/img]

[h1][b]Updated Items[/b][/h1]
[*]Rose Phoenix
[*]Bingo Ticket
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/db6dee30fb4ea8c5ce5f5170ab9c2247a97b6053.png[/img]

[h1][b]Updated Maps[/b][/h1]
[*]Last Stand: Cantera
[*]Last Stand: Desktop
[/list]
[quote][h1][b]Updated Events[/b][/h1]

[h1]Play the Last Stand Mode Event (January 16 – January 30)[/h1]

During this event, you'll be able to play the Zombie Hero Last Stand Mode!
[*]2 new exclusive maps are being added (Cantera & Desktop)!
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/6f1bc26af9f164f4dfd453abd47ed4ef640fb5bb.png[/img]

Last Stand Mode is a brand-new addition to our many game types. We hope you'll have a blast with it!

[h1]Mileage Bingo Giveaway Event (January 30 – February 13)[/h1]

Listen up, survivors! From 1/16 to 1/30, you'll have a shot at the Mileage Bingo! Give it your best shot and see if you can clear the Mileage Bingo and meet the conditions to claim bonus prizes above and beyond those you get from the Bingo itself. Read on to find out more.

Keep in mind that you can only receive these bonus prizes from after the maintenance on 1/30 until the maintenance on 2/13, so keep an eye on your calendar!

Requirements and Rewards (Rewards given between the maintenance on 1/30 and the maintenance on 2/13)
[*]Open 10 - 14 Bingo Boards: M3 Black Dragon (5 Days), Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (5 Days)
[*]Open 15 - 19 Bingo Boards: Transcendence Rose Phoenix (7 Days)
[*]Open 20 - 24 Bingo Boards: Transcendence Rose Phoenix (30 Days)
[/list]
Play the Mileage Bingo, back by popular demand, and get your hands on a bevy of bonus items!

[h1]Purchase Items, get Bingo Tickets! (January 16 – January 30)[/h1]

When you make a purchase totaling over certain thresholds during this event, we'll throw in bonus Bingo Tickets on the house!

[b]Reward Thresholds[/b]
[*]USD $9.99: 10 bonus Bingo Tickets
[*]USD $29.99: 40 bonus Bingo Tickets
[*]USD $49.99: 100 bonus Bingo Tickets
[*]USD $149.99: 150 bonus Bingo Tickets
[*]USD $199.99: 200 bonus Bingo Tickets
[/list]
[b]Note: The rewards above are given out cumulatively, so, for example, if you were to spend USD $199.99, you would receive 500 bonus Bingo Tickets.[/b]

Please note that these rewards can be claimed only once per account! Moreover, the spending thresholds are based on US Dollars, so the exact amount will vary based on your country's exchange rate, or the exchange rate of the amount you're paying for.

[h1]Event Reward Box Giveaway Promotion (January 16 – January 30)[/h1]

Event reward boxes will be given to those who fulfill the requirements while the event is running.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/06c1471855754d562222d69846c5301848effa40.png[/img]

[b]Requirements[/b]
[*]Upon reaching 20 min/40 min/60 min/80 min/100 min of in-game play DT
[*]1 'Event Reward Box' given upon fulfilling each of the requirements
[/list]
[b]Event Reward Box Contents[/b]
[*]2 Bingo Tickets (90%)
[*]5 Bingo Tickets (7%)
[*]10 Bingo Tickets (3%)
[/list]
[h1]M249 Phoenix Resale Promotion! (January 16 – January 30)[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/ff529f2ed5b2a1074ec23b86147097c018473d57.png[/img]

The M249 Phoenix made its debut last year, and we're finally making it available once again! If you don't have the M249 Phoenix yet, don't miss your chance, as it'll only be available for 2 weeks!

[b]NOTES[/b]
[*]This time around, the M249 Phoenix can be found in both the Top 50 Unlimited Decoders and the Top 50 Decoders.
[*]Don't miss the chance to lay claim to your own M249 Phoenix - get it now, while you can!
[/list]
[h1]Mileage Bingo Event (January 16 – January 30)[/h1]

If you clear all of the Mileage Bingo while the event is running, you'll earn a reward.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/c362096aee98b7f5525fc4f7924001175363c23c.png[/img]

[b]Rewards[/b]
[*]Bingo All-Clear Guaranteed Selection Reward Box 
[*]Select a reward from the 8 Transcendence Classes, including Transcendence Rose.
[*]It will function much the same as the Guaranteed Transcendence Class rewards.
[*]Transcendence Rose, Transcendence Michaela, Transcendence Ji Yoon Choi, Transcendence Yuri, Dorothy, Flora, Sonya, and Elizabeth will be available.
[*]A bonus costume will be given if you select Transcendence Rose (subject to checking your inventory).
[/list]
[b]Additions to Bingo Ticket Items[/b]
[*]You can purchase Bingo Tickets from the Mileage Shop.
[*]You can participate in Bingo by using 1 ticket to reveal a random space.
[/list]
[b]Bingo Ticket Requirements[/b]
[*]Reveal 1 Random Space: 1 Ticket
[*]Reset Bingo Board: 1 Ticket
[/list]
[b]Bingo Rewards[/b]
[*]Refer to the 'Bingo Rewards List' from the patch list for a more comprehensive listing of potential rewards.
[/list]
[b]Retrieval of Mileage Bingo Tickets[/b]
[*]All unspent Bingo Tickets will be removed during the maintenance on 1/30 (Wed).
[*]All unopened Guaranteed Class Reward Boxes will be removed during the maintenance on 2/13 (Wed). Players will be given 500 Mileage for each unopened box removed at this time.
[*]The Guaranteed Reward Boxes can be used until 2/13 (Wed), and the bonus costume given upon selecting Transcendence Rose from these boxes will also be available until that time.[/quote]
Once again, we want to thank you all for your continued support for CSN:Z.
We hope you enjoy these updates, and we can't wait for you to see what we've got in store!

Best regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/ece767dd910f29148e711d79edcb740c473c6c5f.jpg[/img]

[b]Survivors,[/b]

[*]Mileage Auction

[/list]
[quote][h1][b]Updated Events[/b][/h1]

[h1]CSOGS Weapon Paint Giveaway Promotion! (January 2 – January 30)[/h1]

You'll earn a CSOGS Weapon Paint for each of the conditions below in Zombie Z mode during the event!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/b44178c861e5739864b568cc383a93e113628a27.png[/img]

[b]REQUIREMENTS[/b]
[*]Get 30 kills in Zombie Z mode using Magnum Launcher
[*]Get 30 kills in Zombie Z mode using Dual Sword Phantom Slayer
[*]Get 30 kills in Zombie Z mode using Dual Beretta Gunslinger
[/list]
[b]NOTES[/b]
[*]You can participate in this event only in rooms with eight or more players.
[*]You can participate in this event using both temporary and permanent weapons.
[*]Each account can only receive the reward once.
[*]All unused Weapon Paints will be removed during maintenance on January 30th.
[/list]
Don't miss this once-in-a-year chance to get your CSOGS Weapon Paint!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/20c715d2dacb7e7050c672d1893093623afb9f67.png[/img]
[h1]New Year's Gold Weapons! (January 2 – February 13)[/h1]

We are giving away permanent Gold Weapons every 2 days through the Daily Reward during the event period! That means 14 Gold Weapons are going out! Each time you get a kill in the Zombie Z mode with one of the 14 weapons, you'll be given a piece of a Magnum Launcher (30 Days)!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/9bb27c3b6afceb01a38846545b993992061710c9.png[/img]

[b]NOTES[/b]
[*]The 14 types of Gold Weapons will be listed as unlock targets for each level in Zombie Z mode, keeping balance in mind!
[*]You'll be given a Magnum Launcher (30 Days) if you collect all 14 of the Magnum Launcher pieces during the event period!
[*]You can participate in this event only in rooms with eight or more players.
[*]All Magnum Launcher pieces will be removed during maintenance on Wednesday, January 30th!
[/list]
For those of you who do not have the Magnum Launcher yet, we suggest you get the Gold Weapons first, then get the Magnum Launcher by collecting the pieces using those Gold Weapons, and finish up by participating in the CSOGS Weapon Paint Giveaway Promotion!

[h1]Mileage Auction House Opening in 2019! (January 2 – January 16)[/h1]

We are opening up the Mileage Auction House for the first time in 2019! You know that means players will be able to trade weapons through auctions during the event period, right?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/3b0a7a445b29223d6979950c3c809a29d7ebc665.png[/img]

There are some changes to the Mileage Auction House this time! Please read the changes below carefully!

[b]NOTES[/b]
[*]System Sale Feature Added (Related to Red Dragon Cannon Gold)
[*]Red Dragon Cannon Gold auctions (1 during weekdays, 2 during weekends and holidays)
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/8814c2d76d0c4e61cb6e1f279fdc62eab22ce577.png[/img]
[*]The Red Dragon Cannon Gold Auction will happen between 21:00 - 22:00 on weekdays, and 15:00 - 17:00 on weekends! (CET)
[*]At the end of the auction, the highest bidder walks away with a brand new gun!
[/list]
Don't miss out on your chance to win the Red Dragon Cannon Gold from the system!
Each account can only purchase once!

[h1]Trinity Grenade Promotion! (January 2 - January 16)[/h1]

The Trinity Grenade is finally here! 

You can obtain the Trinity Grenade from the Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoder or the Top 50 Premium Decoder during the event period.

The Trinity Grenade attaches to the point it lands on, and crushes enemies by activating the Motion Detection System while staying invisible!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/ef9f4e19d7973af05849b596d73388820b80ac3d.png[/img]

The 2 types of Decoders sold during the promotion will be removed during maintenance on Wednesday, January 30th. All unused Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoders will be exchanged for 500 mileage each, and all unused Top 50 Premium Decoders will be exchanged for 50 mileage each!

[h1]Transcendence Chest will be removed on the next maintenance day.[/h1]

The title tells everything. Transcendence chest will be removed on the next maintenance day so please use your unused items before it expires.
[/quote]

Thank you all for all those who enjoyed CSN:Z in 2018, and we promise to bring you only the best in 2019 as well!

Once again, we want to thank you all for your continued support for CSN:Z.
We hope you enjoy these updates, and we can't wait for you to see what we've got in store!

Best Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.content:
