Survivors,

Here’s a brief summary of what’s coming at you in this week’s update.

[h1][b]Updated Content[/b][/h1]
[*]Part System Updated
[*]Hide-out 2 Mode Revamp
[*]Quick Start 2nd Revamp
[*]New Supply Item for New and Returning Players - VIP Pass 7 Days
[*]New Notification and Notice Pop-Ups
[/list]
[h1][b]Updated Items[/b][/h1]
[*]Barrett M95 White Tiger (from Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/3c839ea03fc4e4c493853f8aca8926d1b69f038d.png[/img]
[/list]
[h1][b]Updated Maps[/b][/h1]
[*]Hide-out 2 (Zombie Scenario)
[/list]
[quote]
[h1][b]Updated Events[/b][/h1]

[h1]Play the Killer Parts Event and Earn Free Mileage and Top 50 Decoders! (December 5 – December 19)[/h1]

Get the following rewards for scoring Zombie kills using weapons with parts attached in Zombie Z mode.

[b]REWARDS[/b]
[*]2,000 Mileage for a total of 25 kills
[*]10 Top 50 Decoders for a total of 40 kills
[/list]
[b]What Part Weapons do I have to use to kill Zombies?[/b]
[*]Hunter Killer X-12
[*]Hunter Killer X-15
[*]Hunter Killer X-90
[*]TURBULENT-1
[*]MG3
[*]Dual Infinity Final
[*]CROW-1
[*]M950
[*]Attack M950
[*]SKULL-9
[*]CHARGER-7
[*]BALROG-XI
[*]THANATOS-7
[*]Broad Divine
[/list]
[b]NOTES[/b]
[*]The rewards will be given immediately once you reach the kill totals.
[*]Total Kills will be shown every time you score a kill.
[*]Kills only count in rooms with 8 or more players.
[/list]
Don't miss this fantastic chance to obtain free Mileage and Decoders!

[h1]Barrett M95 WHITE TIGER Promotion! (December 5 – December 19)[/h1]

The long-awaited Barrett M95 WHITE TIGER is finally here! The M95 WHITE TIGER features very special feedback, where every tenth hit summons a WHITE TIGER projectile. You won't believe your eyes the first time you see that!

Let's take a look at a demonstration video of the M95 WHITE TIGER in action, prepared by im.Baron, a YouTube influencer!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X0G3hNyv4Yk&t=54s

You can obtain the permanent M95 WHITE TIGER from the Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/2d428dec04a884c5154974b5a2c3bf42cf5617a3.png[/img]

It's also possible to obtain other Top 7 weapons besides the M95 WHITE TIGER from the Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box.
[*]RED DRAGON CANNON
[*]PYTHON DESPERADO
[*]MAGNUM DRILL
[*]BLADE RUNEBREAKER
[*]GUILLOTINE
[*]GÁE BOLG
[*]SG552 LYCANTHROPE
[/list]
[b]NOTES[/b]
[*]From Top 8 to Top 25, these 18 weapons are all permanent weapons.
All unused boxes will be removed during the maintenance on December 19th, 2 weeks after the promotion ends.
[*]When the boxes get removed, they will each be replaced with 1,000 mileage.
[/list]
[h1]Transcendent Living Weapon Giveaway Promotion! (December 5 – December 19)[/h1]

You'll be rewarded with the items below for logging in during the event!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/e354bba286b39d2167193a59f3e4bb7594a409f2.png[/img]

[b]REWARDS[/b]
[*]Transcendent Living Weapon Box (a.k.a. Transcendent Life Weapon Box)
[/list]
Well, what kind of items are inside the Transcendent Living Weapon Box?
[*]PYTHON DESPERADO
[*]AUG GUARDIAN
[*]RED DRAGON CANNON
[*]+6 MAGNUM DRILL
[*]+6 BLADE RUNEBREAKER
[*]+6 GUILLOTINE
[*]+6 GÁE BOLG
[/list]
You can choose the weapon you want from your own Transcendent Living Weapon Box.

[b]NOTES[/b]
[*]Each account can only participate once in this event!
[*]All unused Transcendent Living Weapon Boxes will be removed during the maintenance on December 19th!
[/list]
[h1]Transcendent Living Weapon Extension Event! (December 5 – January 30)[/h1]

How can you extend the expiration of the weapon you obtained from the Transcendent Living Weapon Giveaway Promotion? (a.k.a. Transcendent Life Weapon, too)

The Living Weapon will not disappear if you log in every day. That's because the duration is extended by 1 day every time you log in.

However, you can extend it even further through the methods below.

[b]REWARDS[/b]

The duration of the Transcendent Living Weapon will be extended as follows for getting zombie kills in Zombie Hero or Zombie Z modes using the Transcendent Living Weapon.
[*]10 Total Kills: 1 Day Extension
[*]20 Total Kills: 1 Day Extension
[*]30 Total Kills: 1 Day Extension
[/list]
The Living Weapons have a duration cap of 15 days, but you can keep the duration extended for a full two months simply by logging in every day!

This event is only active when playing in rooms with 8 or more players, and it isn't possible to extend the expiration after January 30th.

Remember all of this to keep your Living Weapon alive!

[h1]Do NOT purchase CSN:Z DLC until we tell you otherwise![/h1]

Currently, CSN:Z is not officially selling any DLC. No matter how you are able to purchase DLC, that's not an intended sale on our end! 

You might have noticed when you visited the CSN:Z DLC page, but we do not sell DLC. We are sorry to inform you that we cannot provide support for any DLC purchases made after September 4th, 2018, when CSN:Z DLC was removed from the shop.

We're working on new DLC, and we will let you know when it is released. Please do NOT purchase CSN:Z DLC until then![/quote]

Once again, we want to thank you all for your continued support for CSN:Z.
We hope you enjoy these updates, and we can't wait for you to see what we've got in store!

Best Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

Survivors,

Here’s a brief summary of what’s coming at you in this week’s update.

[h1][b]Updated Content[/b][/h1]
[*]Re-opening Hidden Mode (Classic weapons restricted)
[*]Adding FUN mode to Quick Start  (November 21 – December 5)
[/list]
[h1][b]Updated Items[/b][/h1]
[*]Transcendence Chest (Sets of 1, 10+2, 50+15)
[*]Hunter Killer X-12
[/list]
[h1][b]Updated Maps[/b][/h1]
[*]Random Weapon Zombie Hero Revive
[/list]
[quote][h1][b]Updated Events[/b][/h1]

[h1]Black Friday Sales Promotion (November 21 – December 5)[/h1]

Transcendence Chests will be on sale during the promotion! The boxes come in sets of 1, 10, or 50, but we'll give you 2 extra boxes if you purchase 10, and 15 extra if you purchase 50!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/334030492b1c7f036ee5886531b5e56ba9277984.png[/img]

[b]What's so special about Transcendence Chest?[/b]
[*]You'll get 15 Mileage every time you open a Transcendence Chest.
[*]All unused boxes will automatically be opened during maintenance when their sale ends on 12/5 (Wed).
[*]A total of 19 types of Premium Enhanced Weapons are being added.
[*]As a special bonus, the Magnum Launcher and the Dual Sword Phantom Slayer will be added to the highest group.
[/list]
[h1]Hunter Killer X-12 Rate-Up Promotion! (November 21 – December 5)[/h1]

During this promotion, your chances of getting the Hunter Killer X-12 from Top 50 Unlimited Decoders is a full 10 TIMES the normal rate!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/3c71ebed8422a958cb47ad21651c421848f603f4.png[/img]

Also, if you use 90 Top 50 Decoders or 15 Top 50 Unlimited Decoders, you'll instantly earn the Hunter Killer X-12!

It doesn't matter how you decide to get your Hunter Killer X-12! Just get it and show off its firepower!

[h1]Receive Free Top 50 Decoders! Play the Random Zombie Hero Event! (November 21 – December 5)[/h1]

You'll get a reward for Zombie Kills in the Random Weapon Zombie Hero mode! Every time you score 5 kills, you'll receive a Top 50 Decoder!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/509a0a2e63939c02dd42e78b3ca57598b43e595d.png[/img]

This event resets every midnight (CET), and you only get credit towards it in rooms of 6 or more players. You can get up to 5 free Top 50 Decoders this way every day, just by scoring a total of 25 kills!

[h1]Remember the CSOGS! We're giving away a CSOGS spray! (November 21 – December 5)[/h1]

CSOGS is starting soon! As we announced before, all the preparations for hosting the CSOGS are complete.

We're giving away a CSOGS 2018 spray to mark the coming of our very first CSOGS! (We've held the CSOWC in the past, but this is the first time hosting the CSOGS!)

[b]How can you get your spray?[/b]

Type "[u]Congratulations for the first CSOGS[/u]" in the channel during the event (remember, it's case sensitive!) and a marvelous CSOGS 2018 spray will be yours!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/8fb869e354d0d487085b9b9f21b14af05190e076.png[/img]

Don't forget that you can only type this once per day! And you can only participate once per account![/quote]

Once again, we want to thank you all for your continued support for CSN:Z.
We hope you enjoy these updates, and we can't wait for you to see what we've got in store!

Best Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

[h1]Holy Sword Divine Order Sales Promotion (November 7 – December 5)[/h1]

During this event, your chances of getting the Holy Sword Divine Order weapon from Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoder and Top 50 Premium Decoders are increased!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/a24e2c44eb1612e714f7885d9826925584d8ae2f.png[/img]

Surely you know this, but the Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoder has a higher chance than the Top 50 Premium Decoder!

During the maintenance on December 19, 2 weeks after the promotion ends, all unused Top 50 Premium Decoders and Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoders will be removed. All unused Top 50 Premium Decoders will be converted to 50 Mileage each, and Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoders will be converted to 500 Mileage each.

[h1]Get Tokens, Get Rewards! Special Event for Steam CSN:Z Players! (November 7 – December 5)[/h1]

CSN:Z players got new events and contents a little slower compared to CSO in other countries, but this event is for Steam CSN:Z players first!

During this event, you can collect tokens from many different activities and trade them for awesome rewards!

[b]How can I get tokens?[/b]

You’ve got three different ways to get those sweet, sweet tokens!

[*]Method 1: Get 1 token every time you achieve 3/6/9 Zombie Kills in Zombie Hero and Zombie Z modes!
[*]Method 2: Get 1 token for 30 minutes of game time!
[*]Method 3: Get 1 token for every Zombie Scenario Total War clear at Normal or higher difficulty.
[/list]
[b]How many tokens can I get across the whole event?[/b]
[*]You can get a total of 84 during the event.
[/list]
[b]How many tokens do I need for rewards?[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/69fe9ccafecdbbebdb0b1ad005257280ee601b33.png[/img]

[*]Level 1 Event Reward = 4 tokens
[*]Level 2 Event Reward = 12 tokens
[*]Level 3 Event Reward = 32 tokens
[*]Level 4 Event Reward = 36 tokens
[*]Level 5 Event Reward = 44 tokens
[*]Level 6 Event Reward = 56 tokens
[*]Level 7 Event Reward = 60 tokens
[*]Level 8 Event Reward = 68 tokens
[*]Level 9 Event Reward = 80 tokens
[*]Level 10 Event Reward = 84 tokens
[/list]
[b]What can I get from each of the reward levels?[/b]
[*]Level 1 Event Reward = Event Rewards Box x1
[*]Level 2 Event Reward = Event Rewards Box x2
[*]Level 3 Event Reward = Event Rewards Box x3
[*]Level 4 Event Reward = Choose one: Guillotine, Ripper, Gáe Bolg. (Selective)
[*]Level 5 Event Reward = Event Rewards Box x4
[*]Level 6 Event Reward = Event Rewards Box x5
[*]Level 7 Event Reward = Choose one: Python Desperado, Stun Rifle, Red Dragon Cannon. (Selective)
[*]Level 8 Event Reward = Event Rewards Box x6
[*]Level 9 Event Reward = Event Rewards Box x7
[*]Level 10 Event Reward = Guaranteed +6 M4A1 Dark Knight / +6 AK47 Paladin Exchange Coupons + Level 7 Reward.
[/list]
[b]What kind of items are in the Event Reward Box?[/b]
[*]Red Dragon Cannon
[*]Python Desperado
[*]Stun Rifle
[*]Star Chaser AR
[*]Dual Sword Phantom Slayer
[*]AUG Guardian
[*]Hunter Killer X-15
[*]Hunter Killer X-90
[*]Bouncer
[/list]
The above items come in 1 Day/7 Days/14 Days/Permanent variations from the Event Reward Box. 

When you earn tokens, you’ll be notified immediately of how you earned them and how many you have received. You can only earn up to 4 tokens per day. All earning methods only work in rooms of 4 or more people, and method 3 (Zombie Scenario) only counts if you play longer than 3 minutes.

All you have to do is play the game normally, and watch the tokens roll in! We hope to see lots of players taking advantage of this chance to earn rare and transcendence weapons!

[h1]Counter-Strike Online Global Showcase Participant Selection[/h1]

The participant selection for CSOGS has concluded! All participants have either been contacted or will be contacted very soon.

Thank you all for participating, and we hope to see you again at the CSOGS venue!

[h1]Mileage Shop Notice[/h1]

You can purchase package items using Mileage through the Mileage Shop located at the bottom of the Lobby.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/75ca6243e1be98486c88b5e41bc6582ddd9ebe53.png[/img]
[/quote]
What kind of content update awaits for next time? (Perhaps... The return of Hidden Mode or Fun Mode?)

We'll keep doing our best to provide you the best gaming experience possible!

See you next update!

Best Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/ece767dd910f29148e711d79edcb740c473c6c5f.jpg[/img]
Survivors,

[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/fc2a08e1e6d6a79174d57d558bb2a06acc96189e.jpg[/img]

[quote][h1][b]Updated Events[/b][/h1]

[h1]New Transcendence Class Sales Promotion (October 24 - November 21)[/h1]

For the duration of this promotion, we'll be including special items in the Top 30 C and C Decoder!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/e8c14a790fc4660d54ff5b616b4a6a7eee50bb5e.png[/img]

[*]Transcendence Fernando
[*]Transcendence Blair
[/list]
During the maintenance on 11/21 when the promotion ends, the new classes Transcendence Fernando and Transcendence Blair will be removed from the Decoder. 

[h1]Mileage Auction Event (October 24 – November 7)[/h1]

The secret's out!

The Mileage Auction House will finally re-open! We kept it very hush-hush these past months and remained tight-lipped about when it would open, but...the time is now, and it's finally here!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/3b0a7a445b29223d6979950c3c809a29d7ebc665.png[/img]

This time, the following weapons will be added to the Mileage Auction House:

[*]Star Chaser SR
[*]Stun Rifle
[/list]
We hope the Mileage Auction House will help you to get the weapon you've always wanted and fulfill your zombie-slaying dreams!

[h1]Trick or Treat! Treat Yourselves with Pumpkin Heads and Little Ghosts! (October 24 – November 21)[/h1]

Halloween is just around the corner, and we've put together a little something to help all of you survivors celebrate with flair!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/2da439dacf1205b7cec13cdc3d7454976db91eb6.png[/img]

After the patch on 10/24, type 'Trick or Treat' (remember, it’s case-sensitive!) in the chat window to receive Pumpkin Head and Little Ghost items! Don't miss out on your chance for some cool holiday freebies, as you can only participate once per account!

[h1]CSOGS (Counter-Strike Online Global Showcase) Recruitment![/h1]

The CSOWC, a festival for players across the world who enjoy CSN:Z (or CSO) will take place in Seoul, Korea on December 9th. Last year, we informed you with a separate notice, but we figured, why not let everyone know in our patch notes? Instead of taking the form of a competition, this year's CSOWC will have more of a feeling of celebration, and participation will be open to all who love playing CSN:Z/CSO.

We're currently accepting applications to participate in the CSO:GS. Lots of players have applied so far, but if you haven't, don't delay: the registration period ends in about a week!

After many passionate internal discussions, we've decided to lower the requirements for applicants. We said we wanted the CSO:GS to feel like a celebration of all things CSN:Z/CSO, and that means bringing players on board united by their love of the game rather than just their win rate. We encourage everyone to apply - your chances may be better than you think!

[b]Influencer Recruitment Criteria (1 Chosen)[/b]
[*]Must have hosted a YouTube channel, Twitch stream, or similar video [*]content, with CSN:Z as the the primary game for at least a year
[*]Basic ability to communicate in English
[*]A big plus if you're capable of livestreaming in English
[*]Must have a valid passport or visa permitting travel to Korea
[*]Must be over 18 years old
[*]https://g00.gl/forms/1mlsSdvNjOTzIDLV2 (Registration for Influencers, please change number '00' to letter 'oo' after 'g' in the address. Steam blocked Google's link address so we have to change it to number '00')
[/list]
[b]Player Recruitment Criteria (2 Chosen)[/b]
[*][strike]The character on your personal account must be level 72 or higher.[/strike] Your level is no longer an obstacle! If you know CSN:Z well enough to play well, go ahead and apply!
[*]We do count it a big plus if you've got the CSN:Z chops to take on challengers from around the world, of course
[*]Also a big plus if you have an active presence in the CSN:Z community or on the forums
[*]Basic ability to communicate in English
[*]Must have a valid passport or visa permitting travel to Korea
[*]Must be over 18 years old
[*]https://g00.gl/forms/BaptCFVOfjrWttPB2 (Registration for users, please change number '00' to letter 'oo' after 'g' in the address. Steam blocked Google's link address so we have to change it to number '00')
[/list]
We'll contact all chosen participants via mail separately. Everyone selected to join the CSO:GS will enjoy cool perks, such as:

[*]Getting to meet CSN:Zs developers
[*]A visit to Nexon's headquarters
[*]Travel costs and lodging compensated for participating in CSOGS
...and more!
[/list]
We greatly appreciate the support of everyone who can participate, since we have lots of great events being planned.[/quote]

Once again, we want to thank you all for your continued support for CSN:Z.
We hope you enjoy these updates, and we can't wait for you to see what we've got in store!

Best Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

Survivors,

Here’s a brief summary of what’s coming at you in this week’s update.
Let's see what we’ve got in store!

[h1][b]Updated Content[/b][/h1]
[*]Decoder Items Updated
[/list]
[h1][b]Updated Items[/b][/h1]
[*]Hunter Killer X-90 (from Top 50 Decoders)
[*]New Classes: Mila and Lisa (from Top 30 C and C Decoders)
[/list]
[h1][b]Updated Maps[/b][/h1]
[*]Studio Escape Map (Bell's Lab #03)
[*]Lighthouse (Farero)
[*]Mirage (Mirage)
[/list]
[h1][b]Updated Events[/b][/h1]
[quote]
[h1]'Defeat the Zombie' Reboot Map Event (September 27 - October 10)[/h1]

You'll earn a reward upon clearing all 3 Zombie Scenario Reboot Maps on difficulty levels Hard-1 to Hard-6 (18 stages in total).

[*]Last Clue (Hard-1 - Hard-6)
[*]Omen (Hard-1 - Hard-6)
[*]Panic Room (Hard-1 - Hard-6)
[/list]
You'll be rewarded with 5 Top 50 Decoders every time you clear each map. If you clear all 3 maps, you can receive a total of 15 Top 50 Decoders.

You can only participate in this event in rooms with 4 or more players, and participation is limited to once per account, with a minimum playtime of 5 minutes.

[h1]Hunter-Killer X-90 Sale Promotion (September 27 - October 10)[/h1]

For the duration of this promotion, when you use a Top 50 Unlimited Decoder or a Top 50 Decoder, you'll have 10 TIMES the chance of winning the Hunter-Killer X90!

[h1]Hunter Killer X-90 Guaranteed Giveaway Promotion (September 27 - October 10)[/h1]

For the duration of this promotion, If you open 15 Top 50 Unlimited Decoders or 90 Top 50 Decoders, we'll give you your very own Hunter Killer X-90!

Keep in mind, though, that each account can only receive this reward once!

[h1]Play the New Bell's Lab Map Event (September 27 - October 10)[/h1]

For the duration of this event, those who can clear the studio escape map created by the devs will be rewarded! A Top 30 Brand Decoder Supply Box (10 days) is waiting for everyone who can successfully escape the lab.

Although there is no player limit, keep in mind that you can only claim the reward from this event once per account.

[h1]2 New Character Rate-Up Promotion (September 27 - October 24)[/h1]

For the duration of this promotion, your chances of getting one of the two new Class Characters from Top 30 C and C Decoders is a full 10 TIMES the normal rate!
[*]Mila
[*]Lisa
[/list]
These two new items will be removed from the Top 30 C and C Decoders during the 10/24 maintenance, when the offer ends.

Don't miss this fantastic chance to obtain both new class characters, available for a limited time only!

[h1]2 New Class Characters Giveaway Promotion (September 27 - October 10)[/h1]

Either Mila or Lisa will be rewarded if you use a 30 Top 30 C and C Decoders, with whichever one you didn't get obtainable if you use an additional 30. (Ex: If you received Mila after using 30 decoders, you'll get Lisa if you use 30 more).

Do you already have both Mila and Lisa? Not to worry! You can get either of them as a reward again!

You’ll also have a chance to score the M32 Venom at 10 TIMES the normal rate, so don’t miss out!

[h1]Play the New Map Event (September 27 - October 10)[/h1]

For the duration of this event, you'll receive 2 times the EXP and game points for playing the following maps:
[*]Lighthouse
[*]Mirage
[/list]
[h1]Straight Talk with CSN:Z[/h1]

We here with CSN:Z are always doing our best to ensure that you have an enjoyable environment for playing. We do, however, want you to be aware that how you experience the game on your end is influenced by many geographical, technological, and infrastructural conditions outside our ability to control.

We completed the migration process to AWS from the former IDC environment (and its many troubles), which should guarantee a greater degree of stability. While it does cost more than before, we felt the migration was worth it to give you a better gaming experience.

Redd, a huge fan of the game, posted a thread in the Discussion section before. (https://steamcommunity.com/app/273110/discussions/0/3338745825891944954/)

The thread listed various pieces of content we had not added. Using this thread as a reference, we've added the following content:
[*]Turbulent-1
[*]Turbulent-11
[*]Korean 707th Special Missions Battalion, aka the 707th Commando (30 Days)
[*]Red Beret Condottiere (7 Days – Points item)
[/list]
We like hearing what you think about the game, so feel free to let us know about what kind of content you'd like to see added, or things you'd like to see that aren't in the game. Ideas and constructive criticism are always welcome in the Discussion section.[/quote]

Once again, we want to thank you all for your continued support for CSN:Z. We hope you enjoy these updates, and we can't wait for you to see what we've got in store!

Best Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [Notice] Apologies Regarding the League Reset
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/a7c91d360da13122706341ed3fd14c22b218d37e.jpg[/img]

[b]Survivors,[/b]

We’ve identified the cause for a bug which players have been frequently reporting, involving League points being dropped during every maintenance.

The issue was caused by a changed setting value when we switched to Microsoft Azure from a local IDC.

We offer our sincerest apologies to anyone affected by this issue. 

This bug will be fixed during the maintenance scheduled for 9/19 (Wed).

At the same time, we plan to host the following event to compensate you for this issue.


[h1][b]Event Duration[/b][/h1]
After maintenance on 9/19/2018 - Before maintenance on 10/10/2018.

[h1][b]Event Details[/b][/h1]
Give 30 Top 50 Decoders to users who log in during the event duration. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/a257f25c927d67ff7d3e21c85581223163892cc7.png[/img]
[h1][b]Note[/b][/h1]
In order to prevent abuse, we will not be giving the decoders to any newly-created accounts between 9/13 when this notice is posted and 10/10 when maintenance begins. You can receive this reward only once per account.


We deeply regret not being able to identify the cause and fix this bug sooner, and CSN:Z team apologizes again for any frustrations cause by this issues. We will respond faster and more aggressively to address problems like this in the future.

Kind regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: August 29th
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/e88b4e95f1535e8dc9b908118187c14da6c45f7b.jpg[/img]
 
[b]Survivors,[/b]

Here’s a brief summary of what’s coming at you in this week’s update.

[quote][h1][b]Updated Content[/b][/h1][/quote]
[*]Gun Deathmatch Renewal
[*]Enhanced Papin Premium
[*]Improved Mileage Information Display (UI)
[*]Deactivated the D3D Option
[*]Improved the Reporting System
[*]Added Weapon Bookmark UI to the Game
[*]Deactivated Mileage Bingo
[/list]
[quote][h1][b]Updated Maps[/b][/h1][/quote]
[*]Studio Escape Map (Researcher Log #4)
[*]Zombie Scenario 7-1
[/list]
[quote][h1][b]Updated Items[/b][/h1][/quote]
[*]M3 Black Dragon (Can be obtained from Lucky Transcendence Weapon Boxes)
[*]Lucky Transcendence Weapon Boxes
[*]Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box (50% Off!) – This item can be purchased only once per player.
[/list]
[quote][h1][b]Updated Events[/b][/h1]

[h1]Daily Rewards Renewal - Season 3 (August 29 – September 26)[/h1]

We've revamped the Daily Rewards on offer. Check out the new Daily Rewards and Cumulative Rewards you can earn!
[*]Daily Reward: 50 Mileage
[*]3 Days: Star Chaser AR (5 Days)
[*]7 Days: AUG Guardian (5 Days)
[*]10 Days: 3x Top 50 Decoders
[*]15 Days: VVIP Pass (3 Days)
[/list]

[h1]Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box Promotion (August 29 - September 12)[/h1]

Lucky Transcendence Weapon Boxes will be on sale for the duration of the promotion. Lucky Transcendence Weapon Boxes only contain Transcendence Weapons, and this time, we've got a weapon making its debut!
[*]M3 Black Dragon
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/59b8a7ceddd998c344a0cec8b8ceb9f743ec7a56.png[/img]

But that's not all. Like we said, these boxes contain only Transcendence Weapons. So...what else might you find in this box?
[*]Red Dragon Cannon
[*]Magnum Drill
[*]Lycanthrope
[*]Guillotine
[*]Gáe Bolg
[*]Bouncer
[*]Blade Runebreaker
[/list]
Alongside these great weapons, you might pull the M3 Black Dragon in either permanent or limited-duration forms! We figured you'd appreciate the heads-up.

The Lucky Transcendence Weapon Boxes sold during the promotional period but still unused will be removed during the 9/26 maintenance, with 1,000 mileage rewarded as compensation for each unused box.


[h1]Zombie Scenario 7-1 Challenge Event (August 29 - September 12)[/h1]

We've got plenty of rewards in store if you clear the new Zombie Scenario map during the event period! Which map is that, you ask? New map 7-1, of course! We've listed the rewards you can earn below.
[*]Hard-9: 5x Top 50 Decoders
[*]Hard-8: 4x Top 50 Decoders
[*]Hard-7: 3x Top 50 Decoders
[*]Hard-6: 2x Top 50 Decoders
[*]Hard-5: 1x Top 50 Decoder
[*]Hard-4: 15x Top 30 Brand Decoders
[*]Hard-3: 10x Top 30 Brand Decoders
[*]Hard-2: 8x Top 30 Brand Decoders
[*]Hard-1: 5x Top 30 Brand Decoders
[/list]
You can receive the reward for each difficulty only once, and wins will only be counted if you play in a room with 4 or more players for at least 5 minutes of play time. We're look forward to seeing how well you can tackle the challenge!


[h1][b]Mileage Event Rally![/b][/h1]

As we were running our Mileage Auction, one thing became clear: you all wished you had more Mileage. Well, we've heard you loud and clear, and we've got more Mileage events coming at you!

[h1]Mileage Giveaway Event (August 29 - September 12)[/h1]

You'll receive Mileage each day for meeting your in-game DT.
[*]20 Minutes DT: 50 Mileage
[*]40 Minutes DT: 100 Mileage 
[*]60 Minutes DT: 150 Mileage
[*]80 Minutes DT: 200 Mileage
[*]100 Minutes DT: [strike]5000[/strike] 500 Mileage
[/list]
You can only participate in this event in rooms with more than 4 people, and the rewards can be received a maximum of once per day. 


[h1]Mileage Lottery Ticket Giveaway Event (August 29 – September 12)[/h1]

You'll receive Mileage for meeting your in-game DT.
[*]120 Minutes DT: Mileage Lottery Ticket
[/list]
You can receive a Mileage Lottery Ticket during the hours of 06:00 – 02:00 (CEST) each day. You can only receive this reward in rooms with more than 4 people, and it can only be claimed once per day, per account.

Any unused lottery tickets will expire and be removed automatically 24 hours after they've obtained, so use them up when you get them!


[h1]Mileage Lottery Ticket Raffle Event (August 29 – September 12)[/h1]

You can receive Mileage from the raffle only if you received a Lottery Ticket from the event above.
[*]Starting at 03:00 (CEST) everyday, the winners of the Mileage Lottery Ticket Raffle will be announced at 5 minute intervals in the system chat window.
[*]10 winners will be selected to instantly win 10,000 Mileage!
[/list]
As usual, the raffle will be determined randomly by the system.

[b]Raffle Start Time[/b]
[*]Moscow - 04:00 (MSK)
[*]Istanbul - 04:00 (TRT)
[*]Europe - 03:00 (CEST)
[*]New York - 21:00 (EDT)
[*]São Paulo - 22:00 (BRT)
[*]Los Angeles - 18:00 (PDT)
[/list]
Those of you with Mileage Lottery Tickets would be wise to show up on time so you can win big![/quote]

This is what we've got for you for this update! Once again, thank you for your continued support of CSN:Z.

We hope you enjoy these updates, and we can't wait for you to see what we've got in store for you!


Best Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

[/list]

[/list]
[h1][b]Updated Events[/b][/h1]

[h1][u]Lotus Leaf Rice Grenade Giveaway Event (August 16 - August 29)[/u][/h1]
You’ll be given special Lotus Leaf Rice Grenades when you log in during the event. All of your Lotus Leaf Rice Grenades will vanish during the 8/29 maintenance, so use ‘em while you got ‘em!


[h1][u]Lotus Leaf Rice Grenade Throwing Event (August 16 – August 29)[/u][/h1]Killing zombies with your Lotus Leaf Rice Grenades in Zombie Mode or Zombie Hero Mode during the event will score you rewards!
Once a day, you can earn 500 mileage for these special grenade kills.


[h1][u]New Transcendent Class Promotion! (August 16 - August 29)[/u][/h1]
Special items will be added to the Top 30 C and C Decoder during the promotion, and you’ll have a much higher chance to draw Transcendent Michaela!

[b]Special Items[/b]
[*]Transcendent Michaela
[*]Dorothy Dark Knight
[*]Transcendent Yuri
[/list]
[i][b]Note[/b]: The Transcendent Class will no longer be available after the maintenance on 8/29 (Wed) when the sale ends. However, the Top 30 C and C Decoder will still be available in the shop.[/i]


[h1][u]Find the Zombie Event!  (August 16 – August 29)[/u][/h1]
Look for the Zombie tab at the bottom right of your screen during the event, which will allow you to join the hunt!
[*]Click the Find the Zombie Event button at the bottom of the game lobby to participate in the event.
[*]There are 16 characters (12 Zombies, 4 Humans) in total, and all you have to do is shoot zombies without hitting any humans.
[*]You’ll earn bullets to use for the event every 15 minutes of regular game time.
[*]You can also purchase more bullets in the shop!
[*]Your reward rank rises and you can get more shots whenever you hit zombies. But if you hit a human, the game ends and you get the rewards for your current rank. 
[*]Once you claim your reward, you’ll be listed on the event scoreboard.
[*]You can participate in the event as much as you want, regardless of rewards claimed, by earning bullets from being logged in or buying them in the shop!
[/list]
You must be wondering about the rewards, of course, so here they are!
[*]Class 1 Bronze Box / Class 2 Bronze Box / Class 3 Bronze Box / Class 4 Bronze Box
[*]Class 1 Silver Box / Class 2 Silver Box / Class 3 Silver Box / Class 4 Silver Box
[*]Class 1 Gold Box / Class 2 Gold Box / Class 3 Gold Box / Class 4 Gold Box
[*]High Class Gold Box
[/list]
You can earn up to 15 bullets by being logged in every day, meaning a total of 225 bullets if you participate in all 15 days of the event. You’ll be counted for the event in rooms with more than 4 people. 


[h1][u]Free Decoder Event!!! (August 16 - August 29)[/u][/h1]
You’ll get your very own Top 30 Brand Decoder or Top 50 Decoder if you meet the requirement below!
[*]Reach 30 minutes of play time.[/list]
5 Top 30 Brand Decoders will be given during the weekdays and 1 Top 50 Decoder will be given on the weekend as rewards.

You can only participate once per day, and you’ll only be counted for participation in rooms with more than 4 people.

Once again, thank you for your continued support of CSN:Z.
We hope you enjoy these updates, and we can't wait for you to see what we've got in store!


Best Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: July 4th
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/e88b4e95f1535e8dc9b908118187c14da6c45f7b.jpg[/img]

[b]Survivors,[/b]
Here’s a brief summary of what’s coming at you in this week’s update.
Happy Independence Day to all our American CSN:Z players!
Let's see what we’ve got in store!

[h1][b]Updated Content[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Inventory / Shop / Decoder revamp
[*]Quick Start Room Display's logic changed
[*]2018 3rd Mileage Auction Event (July 18th)
[*]Bonus Disassembly system
[*]Top 30 Brand Decoder Item Renewal
[*]Updated Mileage Bingo All Clear Reward to Top 50 Decoder items
[*]Removed unused Lucky Rare Weapon Boxes
[*]Restored Room Number Display Function
[*]Increased Zombie Bomb Damage
[*]Fixed Room List Filter Bug
[*]Changed random weapon Zombie Hero spec (Zombie selections are now Random)[/list]

[h1][b]Updated Maps[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Studio – Space Theme Template Map (3 types)
[*]Studio – Space Theme Developer Map (1 type: Space Station)[/list]

[h1][b]Updated Items[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Magnum Launcher
[*]Studio Space Theme Package[/list]

[h1][b]Updated Events[/b][/h1]
[u][h1]Daily Rewards Renewal – Season 3 (July 4 to August 1)[/h1][/u]
Revamped the Daily Rewards on offer. Check out the new Daily Rewards and Cumulative Rewards you can earn!
[list][*][b]Daily Reward[/b]
        - 50 Mileage
[*][b]Cumulative Rewards[/b]
        - 3 Days: Stun Rifle (3 Days)
        - 7 Days: Red Dragon Cannon (3 Days)
        - 10 Days: Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (1 Day)
        - 15 Days: 3x Top 50 Unlimited Decoders[/list]

[u][h1]Premium Decoder Promotion (July 4 to August 1)[/h1][/u]
While this event is running, we’ll be selling Top 50 Premium Decoders and Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoders, and you’ll have a greater chance to win the hot new item, the Magnum Launcher, from both types of decoders.

During the maintenance on 8/1 (4 weeks later), any remaining unused Top 50 Premium Decoders and Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoders will be replaced with Mileage (50 and 500 Mileage, respectively) and deleted.


[u][h1]Space Theme Package Giveaway Event (July 4 to July 18)[/h1][/u]
We're giving away the Space Theme Package (Permanent) when you log in for the first time during the event period! Wow, that sure is easy, isn’t it? And there’s nothing better than something free!


[u][h1]Developer Map Play Event (July 4 to July 18)[/h1][/u]
If you play the ‘Team Deathmatch: Space Station’ game mode/map (made by the developers) during this event and fulfill the requirements below, you’ll earn bonus items.
[list][*]Score 100 Kills: 1x Top 50 Brand Decoder
[*]Score 200 Kills: 1x Top 50 Brand Decoder
[*]Score 300 Kills: 1x Top 50 Brand Decoder[/list]
The event resets each day at 11:59pm (CEST) and ends on July 17 11:59am (CEST). If you keep playing and earning the rewards every day, you can earn a total of 42 Top 50 Decoders over the 14 days of the event.


[u][h1]Transcendence Weapon Giveaway Event (July 4 to August 1)[/h1][/u]
There’s a first time for everything, and that includes this event! We’re not only giving away timed-duration Transcendence weapons during the event, we’ll throw in the permanent version when you reach a set amount of playtime!
[list][*]When you log in during the event, we’ll give you 3 Transcendence weapons with 100 Day durations. (SG552 Lycanthrope / Crimson Hunter / Warhammer Storm Giant)
[*]When you’ve played 300 minutes in Zombie Hero mode (Total DT Time: 300 minutes), you’ll receive a permanent version of the SG552 Lycanthrope.
[*]When you’ve played 300 MORE minutes in Zombie Hero mode (Total DT Time: 600 minutes), you’ll receive a permanent version of the Crimson Hunter.
[*]When you’ve played 300 MORE minutes (again!) in Zombie Hero mode (Total DT Time: 900 minutes), you’ll receive a permanent version of the Warhammer Storm Giant.
Each account can earn the rewards from this event only once. You can accumulate up to 120 minutes of playtime per day, but playtime will only be counted for rooms with 8 or more players.[/list]


[u][h1]Transcendence Weapon Buff Event (July 4 to August 1)[/h1][/u]
During the Transcendence Weapon Giveaway Event, we’ll also be giving buffs to the SG552 Lycanthrope, Crimson Hunter, and Warhammer Storm Giant weapons you might have obtained as Weapons of the Month.

If you’ve obtained a SG552 Lycanthrope, Crimson Hunter, or Warhammer Storm Giant weapon that isn’t enhanced via Weapon of the Month , those weapons will become +1.5 weapons during the event! 

It’s time to break your limits and have even more fun in CSN:Z with enhanced Transcendence weapons!


[u][h1]Bonus Disassembly Event (July 4 to July 18)[/h1][/u]
The Bonus Disassembly Event will also be active while these events are running! This one can be a little tricky to explain, so click the button below to see the details about the Bonus Disassembly Event.
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/1685918319409636323]Click here for more info![/url]


[u][h1]Zombie Scenario Challenge Event (July 4 to July 18)[/h1][/u]
We’ve got plenty of rewards in store if you clear Poisonous Wound, a new Zombie Scenario Map, with a difficulty of 1 or higher!
[list][*]Hard-9: 5x Top 50 Decoders
[*]Hard-8: 4x Top 50 Decoders
[*]Hard-7: 3x Top 50 Decoders
[*]Hard-6: 2x Top 50 Decoders
[*]Hard-5: 1x Top 50 Decoder
[*]Hard-4: 15x Top 30 Brand Decoders
[*]Hard-3: 10x Top 30 Brand Decoders
[*]Hard-2: 8x Top 30 Brand Decoders
[*]Hard-1: 5x Top 30 Brand Decoders[/list]
You can receive the reward for each difficulty only once, and wins will only be counted if you play in a room with 4 or more players for at least 5 minutes of play time. And remember, you can discard weapons, so keep that in mind.


[u][h1]Reduced Multi-Language Service[/h1][/u]
As mentioned in a separate announcement, from today’s maintenance going forward, we will only provide CSN:Z in 6 languages. These languages are:
[list][*]English / German / French / Spanish / Russian / Turkish[/list]


Thank you for all your continued support of CSN:Z.
We hope you enjoy these updates, and next time, we’ll be back with something even better!

Best Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: June 20th
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/e88b4e95f1535e8dc9b908118187c14da6c45f7b.jpg[/img]

[b]Survivors,[/b]
Here's a brief summary of what's coming at you in this week's update.
Let's take a look at what's new!


[h1][b]Updated Content[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Gun Deathmatch Renewal
[*]New Zombie Skins
[*]New Events[/list]


[h1][b]Gun Deathmatch Renewal[/b][/h1]
Gun Deathmatch has been renewed! 
Play 'Gun Deathmatch' in two new maps, 'Warehouse' and 'Ice World!'

[u][b]Rare Weapon Renewal Event: June 20 – July 4[/b][/u]
During the event, you will receive Rare Weapons when playing on Gun Deathmatch mode's Ice World and Warehouse maps! 

[u][b]Playtime Event: June 20 – July 4[/b][/u]
During the event, we will give you 1x Top 50 Decoder for playing Gun Deathmatch mode for 30 minutes, 1x Top 50 Decoder for 60 minutes, and 1x Top 30 C and C Decoder for playing for 90 minutes! You only receive these playtime rewards from this event once per day.


[h1][b]New Zombie Skins[/b][/h1]
New Zombie Skins are coming your way! We also plan to hold an event where you’ll have a higher chance to get these new zombie skins for the duration of the promotion.

[u][b]Sales Promotion: June 20 – July 4[/b][/u]
While the sales promotion is happening, you’ll have a higher chance to receive the new zombie skins from Top 30 C and C Decoders! The two new skins are:
[list][*]Female Student Zombie Skin
[*]Stamper Skin[/list]
[u][b]Guaranteed Event: June 20 – July 4[/b][/u]
We’re planning to give away Stamper Skin to all players who use 50 or more Top 30 C and C Decoders! If you already received the Stamper Skin and win another through this promotion, don’t worry – you can disassemble this Stamper Skin to receive 500 Mileage!


[h1][b]Supreme Decoder Mileage Exchange![/b][/h1]
After our last event that let you exchange Mileage Decoders for Mileage, many players asked us when we’d let them exchange their Supreme Decoders in the same way.

We’ve heard you loud and clear, so we’re also planning an event where you can exchange Supreme Decoders for Mileage.

For the exchange, we will grant you 20 Mileage for each Supreme Decoder remaining in your inventory.

This exchange will happen automatically the first time you log into CSN:Z after the 6/20 maintenance. Upon logging in, you should see the acquisition pop-up window informing you of the mileage you’ve received in exchange for your decoders.

As an example, if you have 10 unused Supreme Decoders in your inventory, you will receive 200 Mileage.

This is what we have in store for you this week, but stay sharp, because there’s more on the way. We hope you enjoy the events, and that you’re looking forward to what we’ve got in store!


Best Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: June 7th: Part 2
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/e88b4e95f1535e8dc9b908118187c14da6c45f7b.jpg[/img]

[b]Survivors,[/b]

You have arrived at the SECOND part of this week's patch notes. If you haven't seen the FIRST part yet, click 'here' to catch up on all the news!

[quote]
[h1][b]Studio Soccer Mode Update[/b][/h1]
You can now create Soccer Mode maps in Studio Mode. The Rules are identical to those of the previously existing Soccer Mode. This mode has a maximum of 24 participants.

We added 3 new NPCs: Soccer Coach, Male NPC (Uniformed), and Female NPC (Ji Yoon Choi Uniform version). We also added 2 new soccer-themed Monster NPCs. Hooligan A is a melee attacker, while Hooligan B is a ranged attacker.

To improve Studio Soccer Mode, we also added 6 new sound effects, such as the sound of a ball bouncing off metal bars.

Play Studio Soccer Mode in special Soccer-exclusive maps like Cage and Field!


[h1][b]Updated Top 50 Decoder Item & Weapon Content[/b][/h1]
As we mentioned in the first patch notes, we've updated the items and weapons available from Top 50 Decoders. We felt this revamp was necessary, as many new weapons have been released since the Decoders' rewards were last updated.

The following weapons have been added to the Top 7:[list]
[*]Red Dragon Cannon
[*]Blade Runebreaker
[*]Bunker Buster LTD
[/list]
The following weapons have been removed from the Top 7:[list]
[*]M4A1 Dark Knight
[*]AK47 Paladin
[*]Ripper
[/list]
The following weapons have been removed from the Top 25:[list]
[*]Papin
[*]Crossbow
[*]BALROG-XI
[/list]
The following weapons have been removed from the Top 50:[list]
[*]Dart Pistol
[*]Brick Piece V2
[*]Ethereal
[/list]
Please see below for the updated Top 50 Weapon list.

[h1][b]Big Changes to the Matching System![/b][/h1]

The way you find and start games has changed significantly with today's patch.

We'd like to tell you a little bit about how we came to make this change, and what we took into account as we considered how to do it.

The matching system was developed last year with these goals and purposes in mind:
[list]
[*]To allow players to play matches with others of similar skill levels, giving them fewer one-sided experiences and more exciting, evenly matched games.
[*]To provide a fast, convenient UI that lets players join games easily and improves the accessibility needed to get a game started.[/list]

After the patch we did see many players' enjoyment of the game improved through use of the Matching System. However, we found that the playerbase was too split up, due to the fact that games created via the Matching System were treated as separate from Custom Games.

For many CSN:Z players, Studio and Custom Games form the majority of their play, so players using the Matching System had limited options when choosing a room.

With this patch we decided to fix the issues listed above while staying true to the system's original purpose.

[h1]Unifying the Split Playerbase[/h1]
In order to solve this issue, we removed Matching System integration from all regular games, and integrated it fully with Custom Games. Our decision was based on a belief that players will enjoy their time with the game more if allowed the greatest freedom to play with the broadest possible pool of players, as represented by the players of Custom Games.

[h1]Maintain the Convenience of Finding Games[/h1]
In order to maintain the ease of finding and starting a game, which was the best aspect of the original Matching System, we added a Quick Start function that is similar to the one currently employed in Matching. With this function you can select the modes you're interested in playing and select an automatically recommended room to quickly join a game.

[h1]Improved the Room Information UI functionality for conveniently starting games and checking information[/h1]
Previously, Studio Maps only displayed the map name as the room title, and that title couldn't be changed. Now, players will be able to set the room name as they see fit. 

We also added a room title search function and a Studio/Regular Map filter so you can more easily check room information. Additionally, we added a feature that displays the rooms with games that started a short time ago in green, enabling players to find them more easily.

But wait...there's more! Before, you had to create and enter a room in order to change the settings. Now, you can configure the basic settings for the room as you create it. This should reduce the likelihood that players will skip over a room due to viewing only the default settings displayed as the room's creator configures it.

[h1]Improved the steps to join a game[/h1]
Before, players who remained on standby in the map information or class selection screens hindered the players who wanted to start the game from actually playing. In order to minimize this issue, we've improved the flow of this process.

We removed the part that requires players to enter input on the map information screen. We also added a time limit on the studio entrance and class selection screens so that the game will begin automatically after a set time. 

Players who remain on standby after that will be automatically kicked from the room. Our intent in this is to make the time you spend with the game more meaningful.

We hope that the convenience-focused features in this update help you to enjoy and engage with our game as a member of the community.

Thank you again for your continued love and support of CSN:Z.

Well, that just about wraps things up for this week's update!
We're already busy getting the next batch of awesome updates ready.

As always, we hope you continue to enjoy playing CSN:Z. Stay tuned for the next patch!


Best Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

tags.feature: You can now create Soccer Mode maps in Studio Mode. The Rules are identical to those of the previously existing Soccer Mode. This mode has a maximum of 24 participants.

We added 3 new NPCs: Soccer Coach, Male NPC (Uniformed), and Female NPC (Ji Yoon Choi Uniform version). We also added 2 new soccer-themed Monster NPCs. Hooligan A is a melee attacker, while Hooligan B is a ranged attacker.
To improve Studio Soccer Mode, we also added 6 new sound effects, such as the sound of a ball bouncing off metal bars.
Play Studio Soccer Mode in special Soccer-exclusive maps like Cage and Field!

The following weapons have been added to the Top 7:[list]
[*]Red Dragon Cannon
[*]Blade Runebreaker
[*]Bunker Buster LTD
[/list]

The following weapons have been removed from the Top 7:[list]
[*]M4A1 Dark Knight
[*]AK47 Paladin
[*]Ripper
[/list]

The following weapons have been removed from the Top 25:[list]
[*]Papin
[*]Crossbow
[*]BALROG-XI
[/list]

The following weapons have been removed from the Top 50:[list]
[*]Dart Pistol
[*]Brick Piece V2
[*]Ethereal
[/list]

In order to solve this issue, we removed Matching System integration from all regular games, and integrated it fully with Custom Games. Our decision was based on a belief that players will enjoy their time with the game more if allowed the greatest freedom to play with the broadest possible pool of players, as represented by the players of Custom Games.

In order to maintain the ease of finding and starting a game, which was the best aspect of the original Matching System, we added a Quick Start function that is similar to the one currently employed in Matching. With this function you can select the modes you're interested in playing and select an automatically recommended room to quickly join a game.
Previously, Studio Maps only displayed the map name as the room title, and that title couldn't be changed. Now, players will be able to set the room name as they see fit.

We also added a room title search function and a Studio/Regular Map filter so you can more easily check room information. Additionally, we added a feature that displays the rooms with games that started a short time ago in green, enabling players to find them more easily.

Before, you had to create and enter a room in order to change the settings. Now, you can configure the basic settings for the room as you create it. This should reduce the likelihood that players will skip over a room due to viewing only the default settings displayed as the room's creator configures it.

We removed the part that requires players to enter input on the map information screen. We also added a time limit on the studio entrance and class selection screens so that the game will begin automatically after a set time.
Players who remain on standby after that will be automatically kicked from the room. Our intent in this is to make the time you spend with the game more meaningful.

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: June 7th: Part 1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/e88b4e95f1535e8dc9b908118187c14da6c45f7b.jpg[/img]

[b]Survivors,[/b]

Here’s a brief summary of what’s coming at you in this week’s update.
Let’s take a look at what’s new!

[quote]
[h1][b]Updated Content[/b][/h1]

Whoa! There are so many updates this week, it's hard to know where to start! Let's go over all the additions, tweaks, and improvements!
[list]
[*]Improved Sting Finger's Tentacle skill
[*]Updated Studio Soccer Mode
[*]Added Studio Destruction Mode
[*]Added Studio Gamble Blocks
[*]Added Studio Bot Zombie Mode
[*]Added Studio Team Deathmatch Mode
[*]Rules revamped for Zombie Hero Mode
[*]Updated Top 50 Decoder Item Content
[*]Third-Person-View setting now defaults to "Off"
[*]Improved the Votekick system
[*]Revamped the votekick system that had previously been decided by majority vote
[*]Added Vertical Synchronization options to Video tab
[*]Improved the game start flow
[*]Improved automatic matching
[*]Fixed the game start flow's user interface
[*]Added Ranked Mode
[*]Updated Top 50 Decoder Item & Weapon Content
[*]The rewards available through the use of Top 50 Decoders have been updated, with CSN:Z's most influential weapons now offered as potential prizes. Check out the new Top 50 list right here!
[*]Changed the FPS default value and max value
[*]CSN:Z now supports 144Hz! If your display supports it, check it out now!
[*]Disallowed enhancement of limited-duration weapons
[*]Started the Dedi server distribution task in the NA region
[*]Added Ping display logic to the Custom Room List
[*]Added 10 min Play Time to Daily Supply and improved the UI
[/list]
So many things are changing that it might feel a little crazy for a while. We hope you'll continue to enjoy the game as we roll out our bounty of improvements.


[h1][b]Updated Maps[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Added Assault Map (Destruction & Zombie Hero Modes)
[*]Added Dust 1 Map (Destruction & Zombie AI Modes)
[*]Added Gambling device Tutorial Map (Game Company)
[*]Added Gun Deathmatch (Warehouse, Ice World)
[*]Added Grass Field Template Map (Studio Soccer Mode)
[*]Added Cage Map (Studio Soccer Mode)
[/list]

[h1][b]Updated Items[/b][/h1]

Lucky Rare Weapon Boxes have been added to the shop, with a chance to obtain the following items:
[list]
[*]Arm Torch (12%)
[*]Rockbreaker (12%)
[*]Claymore (12%)
[*]Star Chaser SR (12%)
[*]Venom Sprayer (12%)
[*]One of the Top 7 Weapons (Blade Runebreaker, Magnum Drill, SG552 Lycanthrope, Bouncer, Red Dragon Cannon, Warhammer Storm Giant, Bunker Buster LTD = 40%)
[/list]
Don't miss out on your chance to nab these Lucky Rare Boxes, on sale only until 7/4! Any boxes remaining unopened as of the 7/4 maintenance will be replaced with 1000 Mileage each.

[i]Note: Each Lucky Rare Weapon Box will only grant one of the weapons listed, not all of them.[/i]


[h1][b]Updated Events[/b][/h1]

[h1]Daily Rewards Renewal (June 7 to July 4)[/h1]
Revamped the Daily Rewards on offer. Check out the new Daily Reward and Cumulative Rewards you can earn!

[h1]Studio Destruction Mode Assault Play Event (June 7 to June 20)[/h1]
Earn event reward boxes by playing the Zombie Hero Assault map in Studio Destruction Mode for 30 minutes / 60 minutes / 90 minutes during the event period!

[b]What's inside the event reward box?[/b][list]
[*]30x Item Duration Extension Coupons (42%)
[*]RPG-7 (50 days) (15%)
[*]Sawed-Off M79 (50 days) (15%)
[*]AT4CS (50 days) (10%)
[*]M32 MGL (50 days) (10%)
[*]Bunker Buster LTD (3 days) (7%)
[*]1x Top 50 Decoder (1%)
[/list]
[i]Note: The event resets each day, and the duration of the Bunker Buster LTD cannot be extended. DT is accumulated for this event only in rooms where 4 or more players are playing. Any unused event reward boxes will be removed during the 6/20 maintenance.[/i]

[h1]Soccer Theme Package Distribution Event (June 7 to July 4)[/h1]
We're giving away Soccer Theme Packages (Permanent) when you log in for the first time during the event period, so make sure you don't miss out!

[h1]Studio Bot Zombie Dust Map Scavenger Hunt Event (June 7 to June 20)[/h1]
When you kill zombie bots in the Studio Zombie Mode map, you'll randomly be awarded 1 Top 50 Decoder!

Enjoy the Zombie AI's Dust 1 map in Destruction Mode! You have a 1% chance obtain a Top 50 Decoder whenever you kill a zombie bot!

Rewards for this event will only be given in rooms where 4 or more players are playing. You can receive a maximum of 1 Decoder per day from this event - up to 13 Top 50 Decoders if you participate in this event each day!

[h1]Studio Gamble Tutorial Event (June 7 to June 20)[/h1]
If you clear the Studio Gamble Tutorial during the event, you'll earn 100 Mileage as a reward!

[h1]Operation – Destruction of Studio mode (June 7 to June 20)[/h1]
We're giving away Grenade weapons (3 days) when you first log in to play Studio Mode – Destruction Mode during the event period. Each account can only obtain the weapon once - the weapons you can obtain are listed below:
[list]
[*]RPG-7 (3 days) (10%)
[*]M79 (3 days) (10%)
[*]AT4CS (3 days) (10%)
[*]M32 MGL (3 days)
[/list]
[b]We're planning to exchange your old Mileage Decoders with Mileage! (We can't tell you exactly how long this promotion will last, but it will be fairly brief)[/b]

We'll be removing the old Mileage Decoders from your inventory and crediting you 10 mileage for each decoder removed.

The exchange prompt will happen when you first log in after the 6/7 maintenance!
When you enter the game, you'll see a pop-up window informing you about the exchange offer.
As an example, if you had 10 Mileage Decoders in your inventory, they would be removed, and you would receive 100 Mileage.

Any Mileage Decoders that are not replaced via this promotion will be removed at the end of this event.

"What about Supreme Decoders?", you may be asking. We're discussing internally whether we can replace Supreme Decoders with a similar exchange process!

There are so many patch notes this week that a single post cannot contain them! Please click 'Here' to continue on to part 2 of the epic Patch Notes saga.


Best Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / April 25, 2018
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/e88b4e95f1535e8dc9b908118187c14da6c45f7b.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

Here’s a brief summary of this week’s update.
Let’s see what’s new!

[h1][b]User Information Migration: Finalized! (April 25 to June 6)[/b][/h1]

As we’re sure you’re aware, today was the end of the user information migration (April 25, 2018). If you successfully migrated your information, please accept our sincerest thanks.

If you selected 'Yes' to the migration and logged in during the event period, you’ll be able to choose one of the following gifts:

[*]M4A1 Dark Knight (Permanent)
[*]AK47 Paladin (Permanent)
...and 40x Top 50 Decoders.
[/list]
[i]Note: You can select only one weapon. You cannot obtain both weapons through this event.[/i]

On top of that, if you selected 'Yes’ AND logged 600 or more minutes of playtime during the event period, you’ll also receive the following gifts:
[*]10x Top 50 Decoders
[/list]
Keep in mind that, as we announced before, new accounts created between March 14 and April 25 will not be eligible to receive these decoders. However, they can still earn 30x Top 50 Decoders if they reach level 30 during the event period.

[h1][b]Mileage Reward Box Event (April 25 to May 9)[/b][/h1]

When you connect to the game during peak hours, you’ll receive a random mileage box! Peak hours are 19:00 CEST and 00:00 CEST. Yes, that’s twice per day! You’ll also be counted in for the event as long as you log in within 3 minutes of the limit. (For example, if you connect to the game 18:57 or 19:03 CEST, you are eligible for the reward!)

This means you can get up to 14 mileage boxes during the event period! Your unopened mileage boxes will be removed during maintenance on May 9 though, so DON’T forget to open them up right away!
 
[h1][b]New Rare Weapon Chance! (April 25 to May 9)[/b][/h1]

During the event period, you will have an 8x chance to get the new rare Stun Rifle weapon from Top 50 Unlimited Decoders and Top 50 Decoders.

[i]Note: This weapon will not be added to the Bingo System.[/i]

[h1][b]Gun Deathmatch Event (April 25 to May 9)[/b][/h1]

When you complete the following missions, you will receive special rewards:

[b]MISSIONS AND REWARDS[/b]
[*]Get 200 kills: Top 30 Brand Decoder
[*]Get 400 kills: 1x Top 50 Decoder
[*]Get 600 kills: 1x Top 30 C and C Decoder
[/list]
[i]Note: This event is only in effect when at least 4 players are in the same room. Rewards are given once per account during this event period.[/i]

Well, that just about wraps things up for this week's update!
We are already busily getting the next batch of awesome updates ready.

As always, we hope you continue to enjoy playing CSN:Z. Stay tuned for the next patch!

Kind Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [NOTICE] Additional Information about the Migration and Migration Event.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/fe7fc31424eed4009608daa7d64526d26aae357b.jpg[/img]

Survivors, 

We have an important update for you.

We've noticed a huge jump in new accounts being created since we announced the migration. We're very concerned these accounts are being made to abuse the migration rewards, and right now, there are so many that it could seriously hurt the in-game economy. 

[u]For that reason, we regret to announce that we will not be giving decoders to new accounts created between March 14th and April 25th.[/u]

However, these accounts can still obtain 10x Top 50 Decoders if they meet the 600-minutes-of-playtime requirement. They can also still obtain a transcendence weapon, like stated in our previous notice.

[h1][i]As well as, these newly created accounts can still obtain 30x Top 50 Decoders if they reach at level 30 during the event period. (April 25 to June 6)[/i][/h1]

We hope this measure will keep the game fair and fun for everyone.

Kind regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / April 11, 2018
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/e88b4e95f1535e8dc9b908118187c14da6c45f7b.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

Here’s a brief summary of this week’s update.
Let’s see what’s new!

[h1][b]User Information Migration: Hurrrrrrrry![/b][/h1]

As you know, the user information migration ends on April 25, 2018. If you agreed and chose ‘Yes’ for migration, you will receive some very special rewards after the migration period ends.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/1655510866879925331]Want to know more about the event and rewards? Please click here.[/url]

[h1][b]Random Weapon Zombie Hero Mode (April 11 to April 25)[/b][/h1]

We are releasing a new mode called ‘Random Weapon Zombie Hero Mode’ after the maintenance on April 11, 2018. We are pleased to bring new content to Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies players. Be sure to check out the new ‘Random Weapon Zombie Hero Mode’ in both the Italy and Assault maps!

You will receive 3 times the amount of EXP and points when you play Random Weapon Zombie Hero in either the Italy or Assault maps during the event period.
 
[h1][b]Easter May Be Over, But We Can Have A Post-Easter Celebration! (April 11 to April 25)[/b][/h1]

Complete the mission below during the event period to immediately receive a reward.

[b]MISSIONS AND REWARDS[/b]
[*]Play at least 10 minutes, and you will receive 1x Easter Egg per day.
[*]Once you have a total of 7 Easter Eggs, you will receive a Permanent Battle Jackhammer.
[/list]
[b]CONDITIONS[/b]
[*]Play with at least 4 players in the same room.
[*]The Battle Jackhammer will be given only once per account.
[/list]
[h1][b]New Transcendence Classes Are Coming! (April 11 to April 25)[/b][/h1]

The long-awaited new transcendence classes are coming! Meet Sonya Lycanthrope and Elizabeth Crimson Hunter!

You can obtain these new transcendence classes from Top 30 C and C Decoders via chance from April 11 to April 25.

During the event period, your chances of winning the new transcendence class characters will be 8 times higher than normal!

[b]MISSIONS AND REWARDS[/b]
[*]If you use 20x Top 30 C and C Decoder, you will receive a Crimson Bat Wing Headband as a reward.
[*]If you use 40x Top 30 C and C Decoder, you will receive a Lycanthrope Wolf Tail as a reward.
[/list]

[h1][b]And...[/b][/h1]

Enhancement parts for the Newcomen and Bendita have been released today.
We have also updated NGS today and now have better protection from hacking and abuse.

Well, that just about wraps things up for this week's update!
We are already busily getting the next batch of awesome updates ready.

As always, we hope you continue to enjoy playing CSN:Z. Stay tuned for the next patch!

Kind Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [NOTICE] Additional Information Regarding Game Service Migration.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/fe7fc31424eed4009608daa7d64526d26aae357b.jpg[/img]
Survivors,

As previously stated, service for Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies, currently maintained by Nexon Europe, will migrate to Nexon Korea during March and April of this year.

To ensure a seamless play experience, we are providing some important details concerning the transition of user information during the migration process from Nexon Europe to Nexon Korea.

[h1][b]Additional information concerning your user information migration.[/b][/h1]

If you DO NOT select ‘Yes’ by the end of the migration period (April 25th 2018 CEST), your user information currently saved to our database (purchasing records, scores, battle records, etc.) will be PERMANENTLY DELETED on April 25th 2018 (CEST). Please select ‘Yes’ to ensure your information is migrated to the new service.

Rest assured, the in-game environment—such as ping, network speed, and infrastructure—will remain the same after the migration, and we will do our best to continuously improve the in-game environment, as always.

[h1][b]The User Information Migration event reward has changed.[/b][/h1]

You may remember the announcement that you’ll receive a M4A1 Dark Knight (100 days) and a AK47 Paladin (100 days) for selecting ‘Yes’ and logging in to the game during the event period.

Well, we have decided to give you an even better reward instead!

Instead of two 100-day weapons, if you select 'Yes' and log in to the game during the event period, you will be able to choose one of the following gifts:
[*]M4A1 Dark Knight ([strike]100 days[/strike] Permanent)
[*]AK47 Paladin ([strike]100 days[/strike] Permanent)
[*]40x Top 50 Decoders.
[/list]
[i]Note: You can select only one weapon. You cannot obtain both weapons through this event.[/i]

If you selected 'Yes’ AND log 600 or more minutes of playtime during the event period, you will also receive the following gifts:
[*]10x Top 50 Decoders.
[*][strike]Blade Runebreaker (100 days)[/strike]
[/list]
Who knows! This may be your first and last chance to actually choose a transcendence weapon, so we really hope you don’t miss this opportunity.

We sincerely hope that you will enjoy Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies with all the new improvements coming alongside this user information migration!

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / March 28, 2018
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/e88b4e95f1535e8dc9b908118187c14da6c45f7b.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

Here’s a brief summary of this week’s update.
Let’s see what’s new!

[h1][b]Zombie Shelter - City of the Dead: Hell Gate release. (March 28 to April 11)[/b][/h1]

Zombie Shelter – City of the Dead: Hell Gate is going to be released on March 28. There is no place to hide. Prepare for survival.
 
[h1][b]New Item release. (March 28 to April 11)[/b][/h1]
[*]Battle Python. (Event weapon)
[*]Star Chaser SR. (From Top 50 Decoder)
[*]FNP-45. (Event weapon)
[*]Battle FNP-45. (Event weapon)
[/list]
[h1][b]Team Death Match Event. (March 28 to April 11)[/b][/h1]

If you complete the mission below, you will receive your reward immediately.

[b]MISSIONS[/b]
[*]Achieve 200 Kills: 5x Top 30 Brand Decoder.
[*]Achieve 400 Kills: 1x Top 50 Decoder.
[*]Achieve 600 Kills: 1x Top 30 C and C Decoder.
[/list]
[b]CONDITIONS[/b]
[*]Play with at least 4 or more players in the same room.
[*]This event will can be completed only once per account.
[/list]
[h1][b]Zombie Shelter – City of the Dead: Hell Gate Event (March 28 to April 11)[/b][/h1]

If you complete mission below, you will receive Battle Python (Permanent) as your reward.

[b]MISSIONS[/b]
[*]Survive 100 days in the City of the Dead: Hell Gate map.
[/list]
[b]CONDITIONS[/b]
[*]Play with at least 4 or more players in the same room.
[*]Your surviving days will be accumulated and you can participate in this event only once during the event period.
[/list]
[h1][b]New Rare Weapon Promotion. (March 28 to April 11)[/b][/h1]

Star Chaser (SR) will have 8 times higher chance rate from Top 50 Decoder during the event period.

[b]DETAILS[/b]
[*]Top 50 Decoder (1.2%)
[*]Top 50 Unlimited Decoder (8%)
[i]Note: This event will not apply to the Bingo system.[/i]
[/list]
[h1][b]User information migration is continuing through 25th of April! (March 28 to April 25)[/b][/h1]

As you know, we are currently operating the ‘User information migration’ event and you are able to see that pop-up window when you login to the game.

Nexon Europe will cease CSN:Z game service but Nexon Korea will take the responsibility and try to provide better game service. At this point, we would like to remind everyone to migrate their account in order to continue playing CSN:Z.

[u]Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies will not close the game service.[/u] If you select ‘Yes’ in the pop-up window, you will enjoy Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies continuously.

For this reason, agreeing to move your user information to Nexon Korea is very important. We are going to have a special event for the users who agree to user information migration.

If you disagree with the user information migration, you will not be able to play CSN:Z after April 25 2018. For your better understanding, we have prepared a special announcement. 

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/1656635407217403792]Please click here for more information.[/url]

Well, that just about wraps things up for this week's update!
We are already busily getting the next batch of awesome updates ready.

As always, we hope you continue to enjoy playing CSN:Z. Stay tuned for the next patch!

Kind Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

[u]Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies will not close the game service.[/u] If you select ‘Yes’ in the pop-up window, you will enjoy Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies continuously.

For this reason, agreeing to move your user information to Nexon Korea is very important. We are going to have a special event for the users who agree to user information migration.

If you disagree with the user information migration, you will not be able to play CSN:Z after April 25 2018. For your better understanding, we have prepared a special announcement.

Kind Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / March 14, 2018
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/e88b4e95f1535e8dc9b908118187c14da6c45f7b.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

Here’s a brief summary of this week’s update.
Let’s see what’s new!

[h1][b]Map release. (March 14 to March 28)[/b][/h1]
[*]Italy EX.
[*]Dust EX.
[*]Zombie Shelter – City of the dead: Hell gate.
 [/list]
[h1][b]New Item release. (March 14 to March 28)[/b][/h1]
[*]TURBULENT-9. (Purchasable from in-game shop)
[*]Chef Heavy Zombie Skin. (From Top 30 C & C Decoder)
[*]Nurse Sting Finger Skin. (From Top 30 C & C Decoder)
[/list]
[h1][b]New Bot Zombie map release event. (March 14 to March 28)[/b][/h1]

Play new Zombie mode during the event period, players will receive double the amount of EXP.
[*]MAPS
[*]Italy EX
[*]Dust EX
[/list]
[h1][b]Bot Zombie Treasure hunting event. (March 14 to March 28)[/b][/h1]

When a player kills Zombie in the Italy EX and Dust EX, players will receive 1 Top 50 Decoder by chance.
[*]MAPS
[*]Italy EX
[*]Dust EX
[/list]
[b]CONDITIONS[/b]
[*]Play with at least 4 or more players in the same room.
[*]A maximum of 1 decoder can be acquired per day.
[*]If players participate in this event every day, they could potentially receive 15 Top 50 decoders.
[/list]
[h1][b]New Zombie Skin promotion. (March 14 to March 28)[/b][/h1]

Players can receive the new class skins from a Top 30 C & C Decoder (New Zombie skins) and the possibility to receive this skin is 20 times higher than normal.

[b]NEW ZOMBIE SKINS[/b]
[*]Chef Heavy Zombie Skin.
[*]Nurse Sting Finger Skin.
[/list]
[h1][b]Free Time Event. (March 14 to March 28) - It was bugged so we added it again.[/b][/h1]

Players are able to play with the Top 50 weapons during the event time in the specified time period.

[b]TIME PERIOD[/b]
[*]17:00 ~ 02:00 Central European Time. (CET)
[/list]
[i]Note: These free items cannot be disassembled.[/i]

[h1][b]Weekday Peak Time Event. (March 14 to April 11)[/b][/h1]

Players are able to receive free Top 30 brand decoders when they login to the game during the event period in the specified peak time.

[b]PEAK TIME[/b]
[*]19:00 CET. (If you connect to the game from 18:57 to 19:03, you are eligible to receive the reward.)
[*]00:00 CET. (If you connect to the game from 23:57 to 00:03, you are eligible to receive the reward.)
[/list]
[b]REWARD[/b]
[*]10x Top 30 Brand Decoder.
[/list]
[h1][b]Weekend Peak Time Event. (March 14 to April 11)[/b][/h1]

Players are able to receive free Top 30 brand decoders or Top 50 Decoders when they login to the game during the event period in the specified peak time.

[b]PEAK TIME[/b]
[*]19:00 CET. (If you connect to the game from 18:57 to 19:03, you are eligible to receive the reward.)
[*]00:00 CET. (If you connect to the game from 23:57 to 00:03, you are eligible to receive the reward.)
[/list]
[b]REWARD[/b]
[*]1st and 2nd week: 5x Top 50 Decoder.
[*]3rd and 4th week: 5x Top 30 C & C Decoder.
[/list]
[h1][b]Good-bye, Anti-cheat tool ‘Xigncode’[/b][/h1]

This tool has been protecting CSN:Z from many outside threats. However, it’s time to say good bye to this tool. We are making a better effort to protect your information and your game environment from any outside attempts to compromise the service.
 
[h1][b]User information migration is going to start from today. (March 14 to April 25)[/b][/h1]

From today, you will see ‘User information migration’ window when you login to the game. Nexon Europe will cease CSN:Z game service but Nexon Korea will take the responsibility and try to provide better game service.

For this reason, agreeing to move your user information to Nexon Korea is very important. We are going to have a special event for the users who agree to user information migration.

If you disagree with the user information migration, you will not be able to play CSN:Z from April 25 2018. For your better understanding, we have prepared a special announcement.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/1656635407217403792]Please click here for more information.[/url]

Well, that just about wraps things up for this week's update!
We are already busily getting the next batch of awesome updates ready.

As always, we hope you continue to enjoy playing CSN:Z. Stay tuned for the next patch!

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / March 7, 2018
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/e88b4e95f1535e8dc9b908118187c14da6c45f7b.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

Here’s a brief summary of this week’s update.
Let’s see what’s new!

[h1][b]Free Time Event: We apologize.[/b][/h1]

We are terribly sorry for the inconvenience that this may caused you and we appreciate your deepest understanding as we continue to improve your gaming experience.

Therefore, we are going to fix this by March 14th and we are going to have compensation event from today.

[h1][b]Compensation event for event bug.[/b][/h1]

As stated above, we have a compensation event with our sincere apologies.

[b]DATE[/b]
[*]From March 7th to March 14th, before maintenance.
[/list]
[b]CONDITION[/b]
[*]Login to the game.
[*]Play CSN:Z for 10 minutes at least.
[*]Reward will be delivered to your account only once per account. (You can receive max 2 Top 50 Decoders during the whole compensation event period.)
[/list]
[b]REWARD[/b]
[*]2x Top 50 Decoders.
[/list]
[i]Note: Reward will be given to your account only once during the event period.[/i]

We hope this will help you feel better. After some silly mistakes, we are going to improve your gaming experience.

[h1][b]We will remove Xigncode Anti-cheat system.[/b][/h1]

We decided to remove Xigncode program from our Anti-cheat pool. Therefore, we are going to remove it from our client on the next maintenance day.(March 14)

This anti-cheat program helped us a lot since we launched CSN:Z on Steam however, there’s fact that t created some technical difficulties for specific players in specific regions.

We hope it will help your gaming experience on CSN:Z.

[h1][b]New Patch update is on schedule.[/b][/h1]

We are testing new content and an update is on the way.

Unfortunately, we have not had a proper update for the last couple of weeks due to internal issues on the development side. These issues are now being resolved, and it is time to bring you new content in the next update.

We are pleased to present you with the better content and game service on the next maintenance day. (March 14)

Well, that just about wraps things up for this week's update!
We're already busily getting the next batch of awesome updates ready.

As always, we hope you continue to enjoy playing CSN:Z. Stay tuned for the next patch!

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team
