notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / April 12, 2017
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Weekly-Patch_EN-1029x346.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

Your wait is over! We have been preparing quite a bit of content for this week. We know that you have been eager to learn about something new on CSN:Z. For those eagerly awaiting people, today is the day. Let’s check out the full update notes now.

[h1][b]Now Available: Blade Runebreaker.[/b][/h1]

Blade Runebreaker is our new melee weapon. The Blade Runebreaker can be obtained from the new decoders.

A blade that bears a mysterious, ancient power that provide sharpness and strength. The power can be amplified and has the ability to emit a powerful analyzer.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_01.png[/img]

You can take full advantage of this weapon's high damage, high stun power, and the longest melee range attack.

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]You can acquire this weapon from April 12th to May 10th.
[/list]
[b]HOW[/b]
[*]Through newly introduced decoders. (Please see below)
[/list]

[h1][b]New Top 50 Unlimited / Premium Decoder is now available.[/b][/h1]

This is it.

We are proud to introduce the new Top 50 Premium Unlimited decoder today. This decoder is guaranteed to have the best item with permanent period of time. You can get the [Blade Runebreaker] item through this.

As far as we know, this is the only way you can get the [Blade Runebreaker] at the moment.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_02.png[/img]

We released Top 50 Premium Decoder at the same time. You can get the [Blade Runebreaker] through this decoder, but it isn't going to be a permanent item.

This is not the only advantage you can get, and there is something more!

Now, please enjoy our new transcendence weapon through this decoders.

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]You can purchase these decoders from April 12th to May 10th.
[*]This item will be removed on May 24.
[/list]
[h1][b]Do you want new female characters?[/b][/h1]

Today, we are bringing in new female characters. They are very intelligent and look so charming! We didn’t know which one you'd prefer, so we brought them both.

[b]DETAIL[/b]
[*][u]ALICE (Limited Edition) with Rabbit Ears set:[/u] This uniform is worn by Alice when she infiltrated Kronos Company’s rival top executive house as a maid. She has completed the mission without any problems due to her understanding of high society culture. If you play with this character you will receive an extra bonus of 20% EXP and 25% of points. Rabbit Ears are also included in this set item.
[/list]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_03.png[/img]
[*][u]MICHAELA (Limited Edition):[/u] Pirates longed for the days of the appearance of iron-free girl vaguely. This dress is made from a pirate flag. Enjoy wearing it. Playing with this character will give the user an extra bonus of 25% EXP and 20% Points.
[/list]
[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]You can purchase these lovely characters from April 12th to April 26th.
[/list]

[h1][b]Zombie Evolution Event.[/b][/h1]
[*]During the event period, Zombie’s evolution speed is faster and faster! (Max 5 times faster than usual)
[/list]
[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]Starting from April 12th to April 19th.
[/list]
[b]HOW[/b]
[*]This event will be activated under the following circumstances: At least 4 or more players in the same room.
[/list]
[b]DETAIL[/b]
[*]April 12: Moving speed (x3 times)
[*]April 13: HP Recovery (x3 times)
[*]April 14: Jump ability (x3 times)
[*]April 15: DEF (x3 times)
[*]April 16: Headshot Defense (x3 times)
[*]April 17: Special ability (x3 times)
[*]April 18: All ability (x5 times)
[/list]
[h1][b]Life Weapon Box giveaway Event.[/b][/h1]

During the event period, you have to play at a certain time and then you can get a reward.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_04.png[/img]

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]Starting from April 12th to April 26th.
[/list]
[b]HOW[/b]
[*]You can get Life Weapon Box when you first log in to the game.
[*]Your life weapon has 15 life(s) and it will be initialized when the time comes. (00:00)
[*]If you are not logged in to the game until midnight (00:00), your life will be deducted by -1.
[*]If you are logged in to the game until midnight (00:00), your life will be increased by +3 and it will be applied only once per day.
[*]If your life goes down to 0 (zero), your item will be gone.
[*]Your life weapon can be seen in the ‘Life Weapon’ tab.
[*]Unused Life Weapon Boxes will be removed on April 26th during the maintenance time.
[/list]
[h1][b]Weapon upgrade event.[/b][/h1]

Your long, long, long time waiting is over. We have seen many requests for this event and therefore we have added it for a time. Event rules are simple and pretty similar to the previous one.

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]Starting from April 12th to April 26th.
[/list]
[b]HOW[/b]
[*]During the event period, you can upgrade your event weapon (permanent) when you reach a certain kill count. (Primary weapon = 5,000 kills / Secondary weapon = 3,000 kills)
[*]If you play in the room with at least 4 or more players, your event weapon can be upgraded upon the result of kill point calculation.
[/list]
[b]EVENT WEAPONS[/b]
[*]Katana --> Dual Katana
[*]Crossbow --> Crossbow advance
[*]Tactical Knife --> Double Tactical Knife --> Triple Tactical Knife
[*]Dual Infinity --> Dual Infinity Custom --> Dual Infinity Final
[*]SPAS-12 --> SPAS-12 Deluxe --> SPAS-12 Superior
[*]Gilboa Garbine --> Gilboa Viper
[/list]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_05.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Easter Event.[/b][/h1]

Let’s play CSN:Z and get a reward and free decoders!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_06.png[/img]

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]Starting from April 12th to April 26th.
[/list]
[b]HOW[/b]
[*]When you log in to the game = 1 x Top 30 Brand Decoder.
[*]When you play CSN:Z for at least 60 minutes = Rabbit Skull Spray (30 days).
[*]When you play CSN:Z for at least 100 minutes = Alice Rabbit Ears (30 days).
[*]When you play CSN:Z for at least 150 minutes = 1 x Rabbit Box.
[*]When you play CSN:Z for at least 300 minutes = P90 Lapin (Permanent).
[/list]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_05.png[/img]

[i]Note: Unused Rabbit box will be removed on April 26th, at 8 a.m. (CEST) when we start weekly maintenance.

This event will be applied only once per account.[/i]

[h1][b]Improved Top 50 Unlimited/Top 50 Decoder![/b][/h1]

We have added a new weapon into the Top 50 unlimited and Top 50 decoder! From today to May 10th, you can get a new weapon called ‘Rail Buster’.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_07-02.png[/img]

This rail gun can launch an accelerated projectile with electromagnetic energy. The finished charge will give maximum power.

Remember, this weapon will only be obtainable from the Top 50 unlimited/Top 50 Decoder.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_07-01.png[/img]

Okay, this is pretty much everything for this week and we will get back to you with more content next time.

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

[*]You can purchase these decoders from April 12th to May 10th.

[b]DETAIL[/b]
[*][u]ALICE (Limited Edition) with Rabbit Ears set:[/u] This uniform is worn by Alice when she infiltrated Kronos Company’s rival top executive house as a maid. She has completed the mission without any problems due to her understanding of high society culture. If you play with this character you will receive an extra bonus of 20% EXP and 25% of points. Rabbit Ears are also included in this set item.
[/list]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_03.png[/img]
[*][u]MICHAELA (Limited Edition):[/u] Pirates longed for the days of the appearance of iron-free girl vaguely. This dress is made from a pirate flag. Enjoy wearing it. Playing with this character will give the user an extra bonus of 25% EXP and 20% Points.
[/list]
[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]You can purchase these lovely characters from April 12th to April 26th.
[/list]

[h1][b]Zombie Evolution Event.[/b][/h1]
[*]During the event period, Zombie’s evolution speed is faster and faster! (Max 5 times faster than usual)
[/list]
[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]Starting from April 12th to April 19th.
[/list]
[b]HOW[/b]
[*]This event will be activated under the following circumstances: At least 4 or more players in the same room.
[/list]
[b]DETAIL[/b]
[*]April 12: Moving speed (x3 times)
[*]April 13: HP Recovery (x3 times)
[*]April 14: Jump ability (x3 times)
[*]April 15: DEF (x3 times)
[*]April 16: Headshot Defense (x3 times)
[*]April 17: Special ability (x3 times)
[*]April 18: All ability (x5 times)
[/list]
[h1][b]Life Weapon Box giveaway Event.[/b][/h1]

During the event period, you have to play at a certain time and then you can get a reward.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_04.png[/img]

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]Starting from April 12th to April 26th.
[/list]
[b]HOW[/b]
[*]You can get Life Weapon Box when you first log in to the game.
[*]Your life weapon has 15 life(s) and it will be initialized when the time comes. (00:00)
[*]If you are not logged in to the game until midnight (00:00), your life will be deducted by -1.
[*]If you are logged in to the game until midnight (00:00), your life will be increased by +3 and it will be applied only once per day.
[*]If your life goes down to 0 (zero), your item will be gone.
[*]Your life weapon can be seen in the ‘Life Weapon’ tab.
[*]Unused Life Weapon Boxes will be removed on April 26th during the maintenance time.
[/list]
[h1][b]Weapon upgrade event.[/b][/h1]

Your long, long, long time waiting is over. We have seen many requests for this event and therefore we have added it for a time. Event rules are simple and pretty similar to the previous one.

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]Starting from April 12th to April 26th.
[/list]
[b]HOW[/b]
[*]During the event period, you can upgrade your event weapon (permanent) when you reach a certain kill count. (Primary weapon = 5,000 kills / Secondary weapon = 3,000 kills)
[*]If you play in the room with at least 4 or more players, your event weapon can be upgraded upon the result of kill point calculation.
[/list]
[b]EVENT WEAPONS[/b]
[*]Katana --> Dual Katana
[*]Crossbow --> Crossbow advance
[*]Tactical Knife --> Double Tactical Knife --> Triple Tactical Knife
[*]Dual Infinity --> Dual Infinity Custom --> Dual Infinity Final
[*]SPAS-12 --> SPAS-12 Deluxe --> SPAS-12 Superior
[*]Gilboa Garbine --> Gilboa Viper
[/list]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_05.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Easter Event.[/b][/h1]

Let’s play CSN:Z and get a reward and free decoders!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_06.png[/img]

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]Starting from April 12th to April 26th.
[/list]
[b]HOW[/b]
[*]When you log in to the game = 1 x Top 30 Brand Decoder.
[*]When you play CSN:Z for at least 60 minutes = Rabbit Skull Spray (30 days).
[*]When you play CSN:Z for at least 100 minutes = Alice Rabbit Ears (30 days).
[*]When you play CSN:Z for at least 150 minutes = 1 x Rabbit Box.
[*]When you play CSN:Z for at least 300 minutes = P90 Lapin (Permanent).
[/list]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_05.png[/img]

[i]Note: Unused Rabbit box will be removed on April 26th, at 8 a.m. (CEST) when we start weekly maintenance.

This event will be applied only once per account.[/i]

[h1][b]Improved Top 50 Unlimited/Top 50 Decoder![/b][/h1]

We have added a new weapon into the Top 50 unlimited and Top 50 decoder! From today to May 10th, you can get a new weapon called ‘Rail Buster’.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_07-02.png[/img]

This rail gun can launch an accelerated projectile with electromagnetic energy. The finished charge will give maximum power.

Remember, this weapon will only be obtainable from the Top 50 unlimited/Top 50 Decoder.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_07-01.png[/img]

Okay, this is pretty much everything for this week and we will get back to you with more content next time.

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / March 8, 2017
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Weekly-Patch_EN-1029x346.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

Let’s check out the full update notes:

[h1][b]Permanent Characters Are Now Available![/b][/h1]

We are listening your opinions!

We have newly updated permanent characters in our in-game shop! Let’s meet our new permanent characters!

David Black, Gerard, Alin, Ling Ling, and Dominique are waiting for you!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0308_01.png[/img]

[h1][b]Play Time Event! What Will Your Reward Be?[/b][/h1]

Starting from today, you are eligible to get a reward for this event. How to participate in this event? Just play Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies from 19:00 to 24:00 (CET)! Based upon your play time, rewards will be delivered to you automatically!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0308_02.png[/img]

[*]30 minutes of play time: Top 30 Brand Decoder x 1
[*]60 minutes of play time: Top 30 Brand Decoder x 2
[*]90 minutes of play time: Top 30 Brand Decoder x 3
[*]120 minutes of play time: Top 30 Brand Decoder x 4
[*]150 minutes of play time: Top 50 Decoder x 1
[/list]
Oops, this event will be finished by March 29th.

A Free decoder chance is waiting for you!

[h1][b]Improved Top 50 And Top 50 Unlimited Decoder.[/b][/h1]

We have added a new weapon called ‘Tornado’ into Top 50 and Top 50 unlimited decoders.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0308_03.png[/img]

Tornado is a futuristic assault rifle that can fire 70 rounds of laser beams. The emitted laser will deal more damage over time. The technology that this weapon uses is unknown.

This weapon has 3 modes, the second and third modes will activate automatically when the weapon is fired for long enough.
If the user stops shooting for too long, the weapon will switch back to the first mode.
The longer the weapon is fired, the more damage it will deal.

Bottom line… what are you waiting for?

[h1][b]Enjoy Double? Triple? No… 8x Chance Event![/b][/h1]

The celebration is just beginning.

Starting from today to April 12th, you will have 8x the chance to get a ‘Tornado’ weapon from the decoder.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/17.03.08_CSS-501_694x120_EN.jpg[/img]

8 times, yes 8 times higher chance to get ‘Tornado’ through our decoder.

[h1][b]SD Light Zombie Boss Event Map.[/b][/h1]

From today to April 12th, a new Zombie boss will appear in the 6th stage of Nightmare map.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0308_05.png[/img]

She is a Zombie, but she is cute and more elegant than before.

Please welcome cute SD style Light Zombie in the Nightmare map

[h1][b]Mileage Auction Has Closed.[/b][/h1]

As we announced previously, the mileage auction system has closed today. However we are going to bring back this system soon.

We would want to say good-bye for now because we will see this updated feature again in the near future.

We will fix some bugs in the system and will get back to you soon.

[h1][b]For Those Who Lost Their Items Or Mileages While Auctioning.[/b][/h1]

Today, we have injected your lost mileage and item into your account. Please check this out. We checked all player's game log and we found someone had an error. Therefore we injected your lost item and mileage.

[h1][b]Do You Have Mileage Decoder Yet?[/b][/h1]

Like we said in the past, the mileage decoder opening function will be removed in the near future.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0308_06.png[/img]

Please use them before it expires.

Okay, this is pretty much everything for this week and we will get back to you with better content next time.

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / February 22, 2017
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Weekly-Patch_EN-1029x346.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

Let’s check out the full update notes:

[h1][b]New Perfect Pick Recipe Sets[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/0222_Banner_01.png[/img]

A New Perfect Pick Recipe is coming! You can find it in our in-game shop.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/233463050427313476]Click here for more information[/url]

[h1][b]Mileage Auction System? Wow! But Lack Of Mileage…[/b][/h1]

Please worry not. We heard you and were thinking about some sort of mileage giveaway event before February ends.

Therefore there’ll be the ‘Random Mileage Giveaway’ event!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/170125_CSS-474_694x120_EN.jpg[/img]

Starting today after the maintenance, you can get a free mileage randomly when you connect to the game from 16:00 to 18:00 (CET). You will not be able to receive your free mileage afterwards!

This event will close on March 8. before the maintenance.

If you leave a good review for our game on our Steam page, we will prepare another free giveaway event!

So please leave a positive review!

[h1][b]Good-Bye: Starter Pack DLC On Steam[/b][/h1]

We have removed the Starter Pack DLC on Steam. It has been showing pretty good performance for all beginners of Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies for a long time. However, that DLC is getting older and older, so we decided to remove it.

But don’t worry!

We are currently discussing about creating a new help box for beginners with the developer and we will implement it sooner or later.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/starter_en.jpg[/img]

Now it’s time to say ‘Goodbye for good, old friend‘.

Bye bye Starter Pack DLC!

[h1][b]Anti-Cheat Module Updated[/b][/h1]

As you know many players were blocked by our old anti-cheat system. We are updating this system so you won’t face any problems with it in the future.

We will keep listening your opinions and suggestions, so please show your constant and continuous support for Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies!

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / February 15, 2017.
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Weekly-Patch_EN-1029x346.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

Let’s check out the full update notes:

[h1][b]Weapon Paint: Lace[/b][/h1]

This weapon paint item is only for Dual Infinity final. If you already have Dual infinity final and want to paint it with this weapon paint, now is the perfect time to purchase.

[h1][b]Dual Infinity Final + Weapon Paint: Lace[/b][/h1]

Do you enjoy our sneak-in weapon item package? We’ve discounted its price almost -50% for a week, however it’s time to get back on track. Please wait for our sneak-in discount event next time!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/0215_05_DIFWL.png[/img]

[h1][b]Anti-Cheat Program updated.[/b][/h1]

We have updated the latest anti-cheat program on the last maintenance day and it has caught many cheaters and abusers so far. For a sound gaming environment, we will continue to do our best.

[h1][b]Bug Fix[/b][/h1]

We have fixed multiple bugs in-game. For example, we’ve changed item name (Black Dragon Cannon, etc.), wrong text strings, and incorrect numbers. If you find something wrong or something awkward, please report it to our active GMs.

CSN:Z Team will try to do our best!

I hope this helps you to play Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies!

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

Survivors,

Let’s check out the full update notes:

[h1][b]Weapon Paint: Lace[/b][/h1]

This weapon paint item is only for Dual Infinity final. If you already have Dual infinity final and want to paint it with this weapon paint, now is the perfect time to purchase.

[h1][b]Dual Infinity Final + Weapon Paint: Lace[/b][/h1]

Do you enjoy our sneak-in weapon item package? We’ve discounted its price almost -50% for a week, however it’s time to get back on track. Please wait for our sneak-in discount event next time!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/0215_05_DIFWL.png[/img]

[h1][b]Anti-Cheat Program updated.[/b][/h1]

We have updated the latest anti-cheat program on the last maintenance day and it has caught many cheaters and abusers so far. For a sound gaming environment, we will continue to do our best.

[h1][b]Bug Fix[/b][/h1]

We have fixed multiple bugs in-game. For example, we’ve changed item name (Black Dragon Cannon, etc.), wrong text strings, and incorrect numbers. If you find something wrong or something awkward, please report it to our active GMs.

CSN:Z Team will try to do our best!

I hope this helps you to play Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies!

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Introducing New Decoders.
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Now-available_EN-1029x346.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

We are bringing new decoders! You can see our new decoders from our shop right away. We designed this item for your better enjoyment. Please see what we have added today!

[h1][b]Top 50 Unlimited Decoder.[/b][/h1]

This is a totally innovative decoder. You can get a [u]PERMANENT[/u] weapon through this decoder! This decoder generates [u]PERMANENT weapons only.[/u] In addition, the most sought after weapons are all available in this decoder.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/0215_01_Top50UNLMTD.png[/img]

[b]WHAT’S INSIDE?[/b]

Magnum Drill, Warhammer Storm Giant, SG552 Lycanthrope, M4A1 Dark Knight, AK-47 Paladin, Reaper, Desert Eagle Crimson Hunter, AWP Elven Ranger, Gae Bolg, Guillotine, Black Dragon Cannon, Crossbow Advance, Air Buster, and more!

Our GM tested this item. They bought 30 decoders and opened them all. The result was totally shock and awe. I don’t want to say everything. It’s your turn to find out.

[h1][b]Top 50 Decoder.[/b][/h1]

If you don’t want to have a permanent weapon from Top 50 Unlimited Decoder, this would be a great alternative choice for you! It’s way cheaper than Top 50 Unlimited Decoder, but you can get a taste of the same weapons found in Top 50 Unlimited Decoder. In addition, if you are really lucky, you are able to get a permanent weapon by chance.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/0215_02_Top50.png[/img]

[b]WHAT’S INSIDE?[/b]

Magnum Drill, Warhammer Storm Giant, SG552 Lycanthrope, M4A1 Dark Knight, AK-47 Paladin, Reaper, Desert Eagle Crimson Hunter, AWP Elven Ranger, Gae Bolg, Guillotine, Black Dragon Cannon, Crossbow Advance, Air Buster and more!

I hope this helps you to understand our patch for today!

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / February 8, 2017.
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Weekly-Patch_EN-1029x346.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

Let’s check out the full update notes:

[h1][b]Mileage Auction System.[/b][/h1]

Your wait is over. After a long discussion with the developer, we are bringing this to you much earlier than we expected!

This is just the beginning.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/0215_04_MileageAuction-1.png[/img]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/233461781530771180]Click here for more information.[/url]

[h1][b]Introducing New Decoders.[/b][/h1]

It is so much fun to surprise you. I am proud to introduce our new decoders.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/0215_07_Brand.png[/img]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/233461781530771306]Click here for more information.[/url]

[h1][b]Dual Infinity Final (Permanent) + Weapon Paint: Lace[/b][/h1]

Well, it's time to have new weapon paint color and the permanent weapon! Dual Infinity Final (Permanent) is now available. Let's check this out!

We set the discount rate which is nearly -50% per package so you will have significant advantage through this package item. (1 WEEK EXCLUSIVE!)

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/0215_05_DIFWL.png[/img]

[h1][b]Crazy Zombie Hero Event![/b][/h1]

From today until March 8th, you can enjoy Crazy Zombie Hero Event. In this event, humans can acquire an item and use it. Your primary / secondary weapon’s ammo will be automatically re-supplied as well. As a zombie, skill recharging time (cool-time) will be reduced and zombie bomb will be automatically re-supplied.

[h1][b]Exciting Zombie Scenario Event![/b][/h1]

Like Crazy Zombie Hero event, Exciting Zombie Scenario Event will be held from today until March 8th. In the exciting revenge map, you can get a high-class weapon and your movement speed will also be increased. There will be 3 summoned bonus monsters and each one of the monsters have 5 random weapons.

I hope it helps you to play Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies!

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: A decoder will be removed from the game.
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/EN-Notice.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]A decoder will be removed from the game.[/b][/h1]

Survivors,

At the end of 2016 we hosted a "Good-bye" sale for the Supreme Decoders. We're no longer going to see them in CSN:Z.

However, with the New Year we also decided it's time for us to innovate the in-game formula and so we're also removing Mileage Decoders from the game altogether.

We know it comes as a surprise, but we do love surprises a lot!

You probably wonder what's going to happen now. How are we supposed to complete our Bingo Boards without Mileage?

Worry not, Survivors: with the Mileage Decoders going, something new and special is taking its place! Something that will potentially also address other in-game matters indirectly!

Mileage Decoder will be removed from the game on February 8th after the maintenance. After maintenance, you can open your purchased/stored Mileage Decoders but you are unable to buy Mileage Decoders anymore.

We will not close the Mileage opening function before the end of July 2017 and you will be informed again in a later stage about the date for the closing of the Mileage opening function.

We hope this helps and let us know if you have any questions on this.

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / February 1, 2017.
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Weekly-Patch_EN.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

Let’s check out the full update notes:

[h1][b]Zombie Balloon Event.[/b][/h1]

This good old event is back! From today to February 15th, you can get a reward upon your contribution for destroying Zombie Balloon in game!

[b]HOW[/b]
[*]If you destroy Zombie Balloon, EXP/Points buff will be applied when the match finished.
[*]If you participate in the Zombie Balloon event more than 10 times, you will receive a random amount of Item Duration Extender coupons.
[*]The Zombie Balloon will be appeared in the Italy, Assault, Militia, Estate, Dust, Dust 2 and Mouse Hole map.
[*]If you assault the Zombie Balloon at least once, it will be counted as participation.
[*]If you get the item duration extender through this event, it will be given to you only once per day and you can participate in this event every day!
[*]Your Zombie Balloon result will be initialized at 24:00 every day.
[*]Only the last shooter of the Zombie Balloon will have buff effect applied.
[*]Buff can be accumulated for 3 times max in the same match so you can get a max 300% buff effect.
[*]Please make sure your inventory has space otherwise your item will not be properly injected.
[*]In the Bot original / Bot death match / Bot team death match / Bot Zombie / Original League mode / Zombie Team League mode, there will be no Zombie Balloon event.
[/list]
[h1][b]A decoder will be removed from the game.[/b][/h1]

After careful consideration, we decided to remove all decoders from the game.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/233461147651800072]Click here for more information.[/url]

I hope this helps you to play Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies!

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Free decoder giveaway event in Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/EN-Special-1029x346.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Free Decoder Giveaway Event![/b][/h1]

Another free decoder giveaway event is coming! It’s simple to participate in, earn quick rewards, and valuable rewards as well. Those three steps are perfectly matched in this event. Therefore, I strongly recommend you participate! Don’t miss out!

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From January 18th to February 1st.
[/list]
[b]REWARD[/b]
[*]When you connect to the game: Heart Grenade.
[*]Play 60 minutes: 7 x B-Box.
[*]Play 90 minutes: 5 x Mileage Decoders.
[/list]

[b]HOW[/b]
[*]This event will be applied only once per account.
[*]You must play CSN:Z with at least 4 or more players in the same room.
[*]Please secure your inventory before participating in an event otherwise your item may not be properly injected in case of insufficient inventory spaces.
[*]Heart grenade will be available to use by February 15 before the maintenance.
[/list]
[h1][b]Weekend with CSN:Z![/b][/h1]

This weekend, we are going to give you 100% more EXP and Points for the duration of the event!

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From January 21st to January 22nd.
[/list]
[b]TIME[/b]
[*]CET: 15:00 – 16:00
[*]EST: 09:00 – 10:00
[*]PST: 06:00 – 07:00
[/list]
[b]REWARD[/b]
[*]100% more EXP and Points.
[/list]
[b]HOW[/b]
[*]Just connect to the game and play CSN:Z!
[/list]
Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Free X-MAS Gift giveaway event! Take Your Free Items!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_SP_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Free X-MAS Gift Package![/b][/h1]

Seasons greeting! There’s a proverb in the old CSN:Z town. Close your mouth, and take this free item! Yes, it’s time for a giveaway!

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From December 21st to December 28th.
[/list]
[b]REWARD[/b]
[*]Snowman Mask (30 days)
[*]Christmas Stocking (30 days)
[*]Christmas Hat Set (30 days)
[*]Christmas Spray (30 days)
[/list]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/1221_Free_XMAS_GIFT_PKG.png[/img]
[b]HOW[/b]
[*]You can get Snowman Mask (30 days) and Christmas Stocking (30 days) when you connect to the game during the event period.
[*]You can get Christmas Hat Set (30 days) and Christmas Spray (30 days) when you play CSN:Z for more than 30 minutes.
[/list]
[b]DETAIL[/b]
[*]You have to play with 4 or more players in the same room.
[*]If you abuse this event in any way, you will be suspended.
[*]Please secure your inventory space, otherwise your reward will not be delivered properly.
[/list]
[h1][b]We Alone Are The Brave Ones![/b][/h1]

Don’t worry. Even if you are playing CSN:Z on the night of the Christmas Eve, you are not alone. There are people in CSN:Z. So please come to CSN:Z and make your Christmas Eve great with your single comrades.

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From December 25 (00:00 – 23:59, CET)
[/list]
[b]REWARDS[/b]
[*]Lone Combatant medal.
[/list]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/1221_Lone_Combatant.png[/img]

[b]HOW[/b]
[*]Connect to CSN:Z and play CSN:Z for at least 1 hour.
[/list]
[i]Note: If you already have this medal, you will not get the same medal through this event.[/i]

[h1][b]Renewed Transcendence Decoder.[/b][/h1]

From today, we are going to sell renewed Transcendence decoder which consists of almost every transcendence weapons inside the decoder.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/en.jpg[/img]

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From December 21st to January 11th.
[/list]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/1221_30x_TD.png[/img]

[b]DETAIL[/b]

For a limited time, we will add more transcendence weapons. This means there is a possibility for you to randomly receive one of the weapons below.

[*]Warhammer Storm Giant
[*]Crimson Hunter
[*]Dark Knight
[*]Paladin
[*]Lycanthrope
[*]Magnum Drill
[/list]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/1221_TW.png[/img]

I hope you can get every transcendence weapon through this rare opportunity.

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: X-MAS Exclusive! Free level up promotion event.
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_SP_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Attention! Get your free promotion coupon![/b][/h1]

Sometimes you will have difficulty when you are trying to level up your character. It can be frustrating spending so much time on this game when at some times your level is not so quickly upgraded. Therefore we decided to bring you this event.

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From December 14th to December 28th.
[/list]
[b]REWARD[/b]
[*]+1 Level up coupon.
[/list]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/1214_02_LevelUp1.png[/img]

[b]HOW[/b]
[*]If you clear a total of 70 daily missions during the event time, you will get a reward.
[*]Unused level up coupons will be removed on January 11th, after the maintenance.
[*]The level up coupon will make your level +1 but your EXP will stay the same. (For example, if you are currently 10% at level 10, you will become 10% at level 11.)
[*]This event will be applied only once per account.
[*]Abuse of this event will result in punishment.
[*]If you are already reached the highest level, it will not affect you level.
[*]Only daily missions can be counted. Other missions will not be counted toward the event.
[/list]
Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Transcendence Piece Event, Login Event, And New Snow Base Map!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_SP_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

What will come in this week? Let’s check this out![/b][/h1]

[h1][b]Transcendence Piece Event Is Finally Coming Back![/b][/h1]

Well, well, well… finally the time has come. Yes, we are going to have year-end Transcendence piece event. I think this will be the last opportunity to get your transcendence weapon in this year.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/1207_TR_Weapons.png[/img]

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From December 7th to December 21st.
[/list]

[b]HOW CAN I GET TRANSCENDENCE PIECES?[/b]
[*]During the event period, a transcendence piece will appear at random from Mileage Decoders.
[*]During the event period, you will get 1 transcendence piece when you log in to the game. (Only once per day.)
[*]During the event period, you will get 1 transcendence piece every 30 minutes. (Max 4 pieces per day.)
[/list]
[b]HOW TO USE TRANSCENDENCE PIECES?[/b]
[*]If you get more than 888 transcendence pieces, you can select M4A1 Dark Knight or AK47 Paladin when you use transcendence pieces.
[/list]
[b]WAIT! WHAT ARE THE TRANSCENDENCE WEAPONS?[/b]
[*]Super strong power is being applied for the AK47 and M4A1.
[*]If you get this item in your inventory, additional EXP will be applied.
[/list]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/1207_TR_Weapons2.png[/img]

[b]ANYTHING ELSE THAT I MUST KNOW?[/b]
[*]After the event period, all transcendence pieces will be removed.
[*]Please secure enough inventory spaces for smooth item injection.
[*]After the event period, remaining transcendence pieces will be replaced with the other items based upon your remaining transcendence pieces amount. (Please see below table)
[*]Even if you have more than 800 transcendence pieces, you will get a same reward items as those who have 800 transcendence pieces.
[/list]
[table]
[tr]
[th][h1][i]Number of Transcendence Piece(s)[/i][/h1][/th]
[th][h1][i]Replaceable items[/i][/h1][/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]1 - 100[/td]
[td]50 x Item duration extender coupon + 1 x 72 day-Permanent Durable + 1 x Random S-Grade Blueprint.[/td][/tr]
[tr]
[td]101 - 200[/td]
[td]150 x Item duration extender coupon + 2 x 72 day-Permanent Durable + 2 x Random S-Grade Blueprint.[/td][/tr]
[tr]
[td]201 - 300[/td]
[td]250 x Item duration extender coupon + 3 x 72 day-Permanent Durable + 3 x Random S-Grade Blueprint.[/td][/tr]
[tr]
[td]301 - 400[/td]
[td]350 x Item duration extender coupon + 4 x 72 day-Permanent Durable + 4 x Random S-Grade Blueprint.[/td][/tr]
[tr]
[td]401 - 500[/td]
[td]450 x Item duration extender coupon + 5 x 72 day-Permanent Durable + 5 x Random S-Grade Blueprint.[/td][/tr]
[tr]
[td]501 - 600[/td]
[td]550 x Item duration extender coupon + 6 x 72 day-Permanent Durable + 6 x Random S-Grade Blueprint.[/td][/tr]
[tr]
[td]601 - 700[/td]
[td]650 x Item duration extender coupon + 7 x 72 day-Permanent Durable + 7 x Random S-Grade Blueprint.[/td][/tr]
[tr]
[td]701 - 800[/td]
[td]750 x Item duration extender coupon + 8 x 72 day-Permanent Durable + 8 x Random S-Grade Blueprint.[/td][/tr]
[tr]
[td]More than 801[/td]
[td]888 x Item duration extender coupon + 10 x 72 day-Permanent Durable + 10 x Random S-Grade Blueprint and 1 x Random Perfect Enhancement Material.[/td][/tr]
[/table]

[h1][b]Login Event Is Back With Lots Of Reward! Free Decoders Are Waiting For You![/b][/h1]

We acknowledged that you have been waiting for this type of event for a long time. The wait is finally over now! Please enjoy!

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From December 7th to January 4th.
[/list]
[b]HOW[/b]
[*]During the event period, you will get a reward upon your accumulated login count.
[/list]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/2.png[/img]

[b]REWARD[/b]
[*]Day 1 – 3 x Normal Enhancement Box.
[*]Day 2 – 3 x Large Medical Box.
[*]Day 3 – 1 x Max 30 days Durable.
[*]Day 4 – 1 x EXP/Point coupon. (Lv. 1)
[*]Day 5 – 2 x Item Duration Extender Coupon.
[*]Day 6 – 1 x Special Enhancement Box.
[*]Day 7 – 10 x Event Mileage Decoders.
[/list]
[b]PLUS[/b]

When you get 7 accumulated logins, you will get a bonus items.

[*]7 days – 15 x Event Mileage Decoders. (No Mileage), 1 x Lv1 Mileage Coupon, 1 x B-Grade Random Blueprint, and 3 x Item Duration Extender Coupon.
[*]14 days - 30 x Event Mileage Decoders. (No Mileage), 15 x Mileage Decoders, 1 x Lv1 Mileage Coupon, 1 x A-Grade Random Blueprint, and 5 x Item Duration Extender Coupon.
[*]21 days - 45 x Event Mileage Decoders. (No Mileage), 20 x Mileage Decoders, 1 x Lv2 Mileage Coupon, 1 x A-Grade Random Blueprint, and 10 x Item Duration Extender Coupon.
[/list]
[i]Note: Rewards will be injected automatically.[/i]

[h1][b]New Map: Snow Base![/b][/h1]

Missing a snow covered map in the winter season would be a shame. So here’s the snow covered map where you can fight with your enemies!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/1207_SnowBase.png[/img]

This is a seasonal map, as such this map will be removed a month later.

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From December 7th to January 11th.
[/list]
Please enjoy our prepared event for December and we hope you have great time with Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies!

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: New Dedicated South American And Turkish Server. (BR/PT/TR)
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_N_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]New Dedicated South American And Turkish Server[/b][/h1]

Survivors,

We have been listening to your opinion for a long time and we acknowledge that some of our South American and Turkish players are experiencing lags and frame dropping issues these days.

After careful consideration, we made a decision to launch a high-end dedicated server for smoother gaming and to accommodating the fast growing number of South American and Turkish players.

[b][u]WHAT’S SO SPECIAL ABOUT THIS DEDICATED SERVER?[/u][/b]

If you are into gaming on your computer in the South America or Turkey region, then you have probably dealt with the frustration of trying to play Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies on a slow connection. Few things in life are more frustrating than playing one of your favorite games poorly as a result of a bad connection, lag, or other connectivity issues.

As such, we decided to launch our new dedicated server for you.

This dedicated server allows you to have a dedicated, reliable connection that you can use outside of your home internet connection for gaming without lag or connectivity problems.

[b][u]WHEN WILL THE DEDICATED SERVER BE AVAILABLE?[/u][/b]

It will be available on December 7.

[b][u]PLAY COUNTER-STRIKE NEXON: ZOMBIES, MUCH FASTER THAN BEFORE.[/u][/b]

We are going to closely manage this dedicated server at first, which will allow us to check South American and Turkish player’s network environment and the ongoing connectivity issue.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/273110/discussions/0/152390648075393879/]Visit Forum.[/url]

Here’s the thing that you should know:
[*]This dedicated server will provide 3-months of servicing period.
[*]Connection speed will vary upon your connected area or region.
[*]We will make a post in the discussion section where you can leave a comment for the dedicated server.
: Your Steam account.
: Connected area or region. Ex) Vila Birigui, Rondonópolis, Brazil
: Average FPS.
: Average Ping.
: Broadband or Wireless. Ex) 100 bps Wired Fiber Cable connection.
: Comment. Ex) When the match finished, frame dropped significantly.
[*]Your feedback and comments will be so helpful in improving your ongoing connectivity issue.
[/list]
During this testing period, your feedback would be helpful for us to provide higher quality service.

Hope to see you in a game more often.

Kind regards,
CSN:Z Team

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_N_1029x346_ES_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Nuevos Servidores Dedicados En Sudamérica Y Turquía.[/b][/h1]

Sobrevivientes:

Hemos estado escuchando sus opiniones desde hace mucho tiempo y reconocimos que algunos de nuestros jugadores sudamericanos y turcos están experimentando retrasos y pérdida de frames últimamente.

Después de considerarlo cuidadosamente, hemos tomado la decisión de poner en marcha un servidor dedicado de alta gama para hacer que el juego sea más rápido y acomodar al gran número de jugadores sudamericanos y turcos que va en crecimiento.

[b][u]¿QUÉ TIENE DE ESPECIAL ESTE SERVIDOR DEDICADO?[/u][/b]

Si estás en juego en tu computadora en la región de Sur América o Turquía, entonces es probable que hayas tenido que lidiar con la frustración de tratar de jugar Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies en una conexión lenta. Pocas cosas en la vida son más frustrantes que jugar uno de tus juegos favoritos con deficiencias a causa de una mala conexión, retraso (lag) u otros problemas de conectividad.

Por lo tanto, decidimos lanzar nuestro nuevo servidor dedicado para ti.

Este servidor dedicado te permite tener una conexión dedicada y fiable que se puede utilizar fuera de tu conexión a Internet en casa para jugar sin problemas de lag o de conectividad.

[b][u]¿CUÁNDO ESTARÁ DISPONIBLE EL SERVIDOR DEDICADO?[/u][/b]

Estará disponible el 7 de Diciembre.

[b][u]JUEGA COUNTER STRIKE NEXON: ZOMBIS MUCHO MÁS RÁPIDO QUE ANTES.[/u][/b]

Vamos a manejar de cerca estos servidores dedicados en un principio, lo que nos permitirá comprobar el entorno de red de los jugadores de Sudamérica y de Turquía, y los problemas de conectividad que estén en curso.
Aquí está la cosa que debes saber:

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/273110/discussions/0/152390648075393879/]Visit Forum.[/url]

[*]Este servidor dedicado proporcionará 3 meses de periodo de servicio.
[*]La velocidad de conexión puede variar dependiendo del área conectada o tu región.
[*]Haremos un post en la sección de discusión donde se puede dejar un comentario sobre el servidor dedicado.
: Tu cuenta de Steam.
: Área conectada o región. Ej.) Vila Birigui, Rondonópolis, Brasil
: FPS promedio.
: Promedio de ping.
: Banda ancha o inalámbrica. Ej.) 100 bps Conexión por cable Cable de Fibra.
: Comentario. Ej.) Cuando la partida terminó, los frames se redujeron significativamente.
[*]Tus opiniones y comentarios serán útiles para mejorar los problemas de conectividad en curso.
[/list]
Durante este período de prueba, su opinión sería de gran ayuda para nosotros, ya que podremos proporcionar un servicio de mayor calidad.

Esperamos verlos en el juego más a menudo.

Saludos cordiales,
El equipo de CSN:Z

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_N_1029x346_BR_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Novo Servidor Dedicado: América Do Sul E Turquia[/b][/h1]

Sobreviventes,

Temos ouvido a opinião de vocês por bastante tempo e percebemos que alguns dos nossos jogadores sul-americanos e turcos estão sofrendo com problemas como lag e perda de frames.

Depois de pensarmos bastante, decidimos lançar um servidor dedicado de primeira linha para melhorar a jogabilidade e atender o crescente número de jogadores da América do Sul e da Turquia.

[b][u]POR QUE ESSE SERVIDOR DEDICADO É TÃO ESPECIAL?[/u][/b]

Se você joga de um computador na América do Sul ou na Turquia, provavelmente já ficou frustrado tentando jogar Counter Strike Nexon: Zombies com uma conexão lenta. Poucas coisas na vida são mais frustrantes que jogar mal um dos seus jogos favoritos por causa de uma conexão ruim, lag ou outros problemas de conectividade.

Por isso, decidimos lançar o servidor dedicado para vocês.

O servidor dedicado oferece uma conexão confiável que você possa usar para jogar sem lag ou problemas de conexão.

[b][u]QUANDO O SERVIDOR DEDICADO ESTARÁ DISPONÍVEL?[/u][/b]

Ele estará disponível no dia 7 de dezembro.

[b][u]JOGUE COUNTER-STRIKE NEXON: ZOMBIES, MUITO MAIS RÁPIDO QUE ANTES[/u][/b]

Nós vamos gerenciar de perto este servidor dedicado, o que nos permitirá verificar a rede dos jogadores sul-americanos e turcos e os problemas de conexão recorrentes.
Informações que você deve saber:

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/273110/discussions/0/152390648075393879/]Visit Forum.[/url]

[*]O servidor dedicado terá um período de serviço de 3 meses.
[*]A velocidade da conexão vai variar de acordo com sua região ou área de conexão.
[*]Criaremos um tópico na seção de discussões onde você poderá comentar sobre o servidor dedicado.
: Sua conta Steam
: Região ou área de conexão. Ex: Vila Birigui, Rondonópolis, Brasil
: FPS médio
: Ping médio
: Banda Larga ou Wireless. Ex: 100bps, conexão por fibra ótica cabeada
: Comentário. Ex: Quando a partida terminou, houve perda de frames.
[*]Seu feedback e comentários serão muito úteis para nos ajudar a melhorar o problema de conexão.
Durante este período de testes, seu feedback vai nos ajudar a oferecer um serviço de melhor qualidade.
[/list]
Esperamos ver você no jogo mais vezes!

Atenciosamente,
Equipe CSN:Z

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_N_1029x346_TR_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Yeni Güney Amerika Ve Türkiye Sunucuları.[/b][/h1]

Askerler,

Bir süredir Güney Amerikalı ve Türk oyuncularımızın gecikme, frame düşüşü gibi sorunlar yaşadıklarına dair şikayetler almaktaydık.

Detaylı bir incelemeden sonra daha iyi bir oyun tecrübesi sunabilmek ve büyüyen Güney Amerika ve Türk oyuncu topluluğumuzun ihtiyaçlarına cevap verebilmek adına bu sunucuları açmaya karar verdik.

[b][u]PEKİ BU SUNUCULAR NEDEN ÖZEL?[/u][/b]

Eğer Güney Amerika veya Türkiye bölgelerinden Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies oynamaya çalışıyorsanız muhtemelen bağlantı hızınızdan şikayet ediyorsunuzdur. Hayatta, sevdiğiniz oyunu oynarken kötü bağlantı, gecikme veya diğer bağlantı sorunları yüzünden kötü sonuçlar almanız kadar sinir bozucu bir şey yoktur.

Bu nedenle sizler için yeni sunucularımızı aktif etmeye karar verdik.

Bu özel sunucular, daha hızlı ve güvenli bir bağlantı sunar. Evinizden başka bağlantıları kullanarak da herhangi bir gecikme ve bağlantı sorunu yaşamadan oynayabilirsiniz.

[b][u]BU ÖZEL SUNUCULAR NE ZAMAN AKTİF OLACAK?[/u][/b]

Sunucular 7 Aralık 'da aktif edilecektir.

[b][u]HİÇ OLMADIĞI KADAR HIZLI COUNTER-STRIKE NEXON: ZOMBIES TECRÜBESİ.[/u][/b]

Bu özel sunucuları öncelikle yakından takip edeceğizve bu sayede Güney Amerikalı ve Türk oyuncuların bağlantı durumlarını ve devam eden bağlantı sorunlarını kontrol edebileceğiz. İşte bilmeniz gerekenler:

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/273110/discussions/0/152390648075393879/]Visit Forum.[/url]

[*]Özel sunucular 3 aylık dönemler halinde hizmet verecektir.
[*]Bağlantı hızınız bağlandığınız bölgeye göre değişiklik gösterebilir.
[*]Sunucular hakkında yorum yapabilmeniz için tartışmalar sekmesinde konu ile ilgili bir başlık açacağız.
: Steam hesabınız.
: Bağlantı bölgesi. Örn) Beşiktaş, İstanbul, Türkiye
: Ortalama FPS.
: Ortalama Ping.
: Kablolu veya kablosuz. Örn) 100 bps Fiber bağlantı.
: Yorum. Örn) Maç sona erdiği zaman frame inanılmaz düşüyor.
[*]Yorumlarınız ve fikirleriniz devam eden bağlantı sorunlarını çözebilmemiz için çok faydalı olacaktır.
[/list]
Bu test dönemi süresince görüşleriniz sizlere daha iyi bir hizmet sunabilmemiz açısından oldukça önemli.

Oyunda daha sık görüşmek üzere.

Saygılar,
CSN:Z Ekibi

[b][u]QUANDO O SERVIDOR DEDICADO ESTARÁ DISPONÍVEL?[/u][/b]

Ele estará disponível no dia 7 de dezembro.

[b][u]JOGUE COUNTER-STRIKE NEXON: ZOMBIES, MUITO MAIS RÁPIDO QUE ANTES[/u][/b]

Nós vamos gerenciar de perto este servidor dedicado, o que nos permitirá verificar a rede dos jogadores sul-americanos e turcos e os problemas de conexão recorrentes.
Informações que você deve saber:

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/273110/discussions/0/152390648075393879/]Visit Forum.[/url]

[*]O servidor dedicado terá um período de serviço de 3 meses.
[*]A velocidade da conexão vai variar de acordo com sua região ou área de conexão.
[*]Criaremos um tópico na seção de discussões onde você poderá comentar sobre o servidor dedicado.
: Sua conta Steam
: Região ou área de conexão. Ex: Vila Birigui, Rondonópolis, Brasil
: FPS médio
: Ping médio
: Banda Larga ou Wireless. Ex: 100bps, conexão por fibra ótica cabeada
: Comentário. Ex: Quando a partida terminou, houve perda de frames.
[*]Seu feedback e comentários serão muito úteis para nos ajudar a melhorar o problema de conexão.
Durante este período de testes, seu feedback vai nos ajudar a oferecer um serviço de melhor qualidade.
[/list]
Esperamos ver você no jogo mais vezes!

Atenciosamente,
Equipe CSN:Z

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_N_1029x346_TR_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Yeni Güney Amerika Ve Türkiye Sunucuları.[/b][/h1]

Askerler,

Bir süredir Güney Amerikalı ve Türk oyuncularımızın gecikme, frame düşüşü gibi sorunlar yaşadıklarına dair şikayetler almaktaydık.

Detaylı bir incelemeden sonra daha iyi bir oyun tecrübesi sunabilmek ve büyüyen Güney Amerika ve Türk oyuncu topluluğumuzun ihtiyaçlarına cevap verebilmek adına bu sunucuları açmaya karar verdik.

[b][u]PEKİ BU SUNUCULAR NEDEN ÖZEL?[/u][/b]

Eğer Güney Amerika veya Türkiye bölgelerinden Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies oynamaya çalışıyorsanız muhtemelen bağlantı hızınızdan şikayet ediyorsunuzdur. Hayatta, sevdiğiniz oyunu oynarken kötü bağlantı, gecikme veya diğer bağlantı sorunları yüzünden kötü sonuçlar almanız kadar sinir bozucu bir şey yoktur.

Bu nedenle sizler için yeni sunucularımızı aktif etmeye karar verdik.

Bu özel sunucular, daha hızlı ve güvenli bir bağlantı sunar. Evinizden başka bağlantıları kullanarak da herhangi bir gecikme ve bağlantı sorunu yaşamadan oynayabilirsiniz.

[b][u]BU ÖZEL SUNUCULAR NE ZAMAN AKTİF OLACAK?[/u][/b]

Sunucular 7 Aralık 'da aktif edilecektir.

[b][u]HİÇ OLMADIĞI KADAR HIZLI COUNTER-STRIKE NEXON: ZOMBIES TECRÜBESİ.[/u][/b]

Bu özel sunucuları öncelikle yakından takip edeceğizve bu sayede Güney Amerikalı ve Türk oyuncuların bağlantı durumlarını ve devam eden bağlantı sorunlarını kontrol edebileceğiz. İşte bilmeniz gerekenler:

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/273110/discussions/0/152390648075393879/]Visit Forum.[/url]

[*]Özel sunucular 3 aylık dönemler halinde hizmet verecektir.
[*]Bağlantı hızınız bağlandığınız bölgeye göre değişiklik gösterebilir.
[*]Sunucular hakkında yorum yapabilmeniz için tartışmalar sekmesinde konu ile ilgili bir başlık açacağız.
: Steam hesabınız.
: Bağlantı bölgesi. Örn) Beşiktaş, İstanbul, Türkiye
: Ortalama FPS.
: Ortalama Ping.
: Kablolu veya kablosuz. Örn) 100 bps Fiber bağlantı.
: Yorum. Örn) Maç sona erdiği zaman frame inanılmaz düşüyor.
[*]Yorumlarınız ve fikirleriniz devam eden bağlantı sorunlarını çözebilmemiz için çok faydalı olacaktır.
[/list]
Bu test dönemi süresince görüşleriniz sizlere daha iyi bir hizmet sunabilmemiz açısından oldukça önemli.

Oyunda daha sık görüşmek üzere.

Saygılar,
CSN:Z Ekibi

notes.title: New Perfect Pick Recipe Set: HK-121 & CROW-9.
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_NAV_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Perfect Pick Recipe: HK-121[/b][/h1]

HK-121 is a general-purpose machine gun in Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies. Introduced in 2010, this is a Germany GPMG fed with 120 rounds of 7.62 NATO. It is equipped with a low power lens scope for middle range engagement. It has an upgraded variant that can be obtained through Upgrade Event.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/1109_HK121_CHA.png[/img]

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From November 9 to November 23.
[/list]
This weapon can be upgraded to HK-121 Custom. Do you want to upgrade this weapon? Read this!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/338162230919064976]How to upgrade my HK-121 to HK-121 Custom version?[/url]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/1109_HKCUS.png[/img]

[h1][b]Perfect Pick Recipe: CROW-9[/b][/h1]

A special gauntlet served as the melee weapon with a strong destructive power. Secondary mode centered in the middle of the gauge CROW Reload System operation during attacks by right-clicking produces knocking them back during the attack of the zombies with a powerful destructive force to the front.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/1109_CROW9_CHA.png[/img]

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From November 9 to November 23.
[/list]
Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/1109_CameraGun.png[/img]

[b]REWARD[/b]
[*]Lightning HMG-1 (a.k.a “Camera Gun”)
[/list]
[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]November 9 to November 23.
[/list]
[b]DETAIL[/b]
[*]During the event, you can reset your event only once.
[*]When you reset your event, your Bingo plate will be reset and Bingo clear reward will be changed to “Lightning HMG-1”.
[*]During the event period, clearing reward will be changed per day for free during the event period.
[/list]
[h1][b]Secure The Weapon For Fighting Against Zombies![/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/1109_HK121_3D_CUSTOM.png[/img]

[b]REWARD[/b]
[*]HK-121 Custom (Permanent)
[/list]
[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]November 9 to November 23.
[/list]
[b]HOW[/b]
[*]Earn 5,000 kill points through HK-121.
[/list]

[*]Only HK-121 original version holders can participate in this event.
[*]If you do not have enough space in your item inventory, items will not be properly delivered.

[*]November 9 to December 7.

[b]HOW[/b]

Let’s play in the new Zombie Scenario revenge map. There will be adjusted rules and regulations. Enjoy unstoppable ammunition and improved movement speed there!

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From October 26th to November 9th.
[/list]
[b]WHAT[/b]
[*]You can play this in the specific map. (Revenge)
[*]Players movement speed has been improved and unlimited ammunition will be provided.

[*]5 weapons will be dropped randomly for each bonus monster.
[*]The same weapon can be dropped at the same time.
[*]A dropped weapon will be available in the event map only.
[*]In the exciting map, you will not acquire a Zombie evolution, a mission, a miniature medal, an accumulation stats, or league point.
[/list]
Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / October 26, 2016.
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_WPN_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

Let’s check out the full update notes:

[h1][b]Vulcanus-3 Perfect Pick Recipe.[/b][/h1]

You know about this item already. We removed this item in order to have a sound gaming environment last week. You will see this item as a perfect pick recipe today.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/527312139202218533]Click here for more information.[/url]

[h1][b]Lusty ‘Rose’ Skin. (Zombie Skin)[/b][/h1]

A new zombie skin has arrived. She has her own dark soul inside. Let’s see what she looks like.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/LustyRoseSkin.png[/img]

[h1][b]New Map: Rest[/b][/h1]

Rest is a map designed and released exclusive to Zombie 3: Origin but is also available in other Zombie Mods. This map takes place in an ancient graveyard with tombs.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/zm_rest_01.png[/img]

[h1][b]30% Discount Coupon For Costume Box Items.[/b][/h1]

It’s time to make up your characters! Add some tails and put some hats on your head.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/30_Discoount_Coupon.png[/img]

[h1][b]Exciting Zombie Scenario (Revenge)[/b][/h1]

Let’s play in the new Zombie Scenario revenge map. There will be adjusted rules and regulations. Enjoy unstoppable ammunition and improved movement speed there!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/527312139202218397]Click here for more information.[/url]

[h1][b]Injecting Removed Vulcanus-3.[/b][/h1]

As you know, today is the day we will inject your Vulcanus-3 back that was removed from your inventory last week. We are giving it back to your account. After today’s maintenance, you will see your removed Vulcanus-3 in your storage. Thanks for your understanding.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/1026_Vulacnus-3_PPR_02.png[/img]

[h1][b]Bug Fix[/b][/h1]

There’s a matchmaking/quick launch button in the lobby (greener one) it hadn’t been working for some tme. Last week, we have fixed this button and it now works.

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_WPN_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

Let’s check out the full update notes:

[h1][b]Coin Event[/b][/h1]

We only have one update for this week. That’s the coin event. Maybe you can say “Coin Event? Is it updated?” Yes, the old coin event is gone and a new coin event is on its way.

[b]REWARD[/b]
[*]10 x Supreme Decoders (3 Players)
[*]50 x Mileage Decoders (5 Players)
[*]30 x Mileage Decoders (10 Players)
[*]3 x Costume Box Season 2 (20 Players)
[*]1 x Perfect Enhancement Box (20 Players)
[/list]
[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From October 19th to November 2nd.
[/list]

[h1][b]Regarding Vulcanus-3 weapon.[/b][/h1]

As you can see in the past announcement, we have been doing the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/577976654999850450]'Trick or Treat'[/url] event for a while. notes.title: Old And Classic Weapon Remastered And The Other Events.
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_SP_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Remastered Classic Weapons.[/b][/h1]

Some of the players are underestimating our old classic weapons. Our top-notch gunsmith has remastered some good, classic weapons.

[b]WHAT[/b]
[*]AK-47: Damage is increased in Zombie Mode and Zombie Scenario.
[*]M4A1: Damage is increased in Zombie Mode and Zombie Scenario.
[*]AWP: Damage is increased in Zombie Mode and Zombie Scenario.
[*]XM1014: Damage is increased in Zombie Mode and Zombie Scenario.
[/list]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/1012_02_CWP.png[/img]

[h1][b]100,000 Zombie Kills Event.[/b][/h1]

In the past, we have had a similar event, but that event was not only for you, but also for every member of the Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies. This time, you make your own achievement!

[b]REWARDS[/b]
[*]30 x Item Duration Extender Coupon
[*]Rewards will be injected automatically when your zombie kill count reaches 100,000.
[/list]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/1012_03_IDE.png[/img]

[b]GOAL[/b]
[*]Kill 100,000 Zombies by yourself.
[/list]
[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From October 12th to November 2nd.
[/list]
[h1][b]Zombie DNA Update.[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1_en.jpg[/img]

We have still another update for Zombies. We have added and removed a couple of skills and abilities from Zombies. Let’s check this out now!

[u]Banshee Zombie[/u]
[*]Rigidity and knockback resistance have been slightly increased.
[*]The moving speed has been slightly decreased.
[*]Pulling skill changes:
[*]This skill changes Banshee zombie's status to damaged immunity status.
[*]The skill makes the bat fly straight and passes allies.
[*]When the character aims at the target, this skill pulls all enemies around the target.
[*]According to the evolution level, the skill speed and skill range are increased.
[/list]
[u]Psycho Zombie[/u]
[*]The skill is changed to 'smoke screen.'
[*]Smoke screen skill changes:
[*]The skill effect is changed and smoke screen duration time has been reduced.
[*]The zombie's damage rate from humans will be reduced when the zombie is in the smoke screen.
[*]When skill is over, the Psycho Zombie's HP recovers as much as the amount of absorbed damage in the smoke screen.
[*]When the character uses smoke screen on the same location again, the higher damage reduction rate will be applied.
[*]According to the evolution level, the skill's damage reduction rate and smoke screen area will be applied differently.
[/list]
[u]Host zombie spawn rule changes[/u]
[*]Before the game starts, it will inform the character that he/she will change to a host zombie in the game.
[*]The character can change to a host zombie whenever he/she wants by pressing the E key. The character will not change to a host zombie right away when the game starts.
[*]When the character doesn't change to host zombie, it will change by force.
[*]Even if the host zombie infects another host (human status), it will not be counted in the points.
[/list]
[u]Charging condition changes[/u]
[*]The maximum charging rate that can be obtained by zombie kill is reduced to +40% from +100%. (+10% increases every 1 kill)
[*]When there is a human around, the rising rate of maximum charging rate is increased from +60% to +120%.
[*]The charging rate whenever a human joins the group is increased to +10% from +5%.
[/list]
[u]Primary weapon[/u]
[*]Four kinds of hero weapon damages are increased.
[*]4 kinds of sidekick weapon damages are increased.
[/list]
[u]Secondary weapon[/u]
[*]The damage of secondary weapon 1 for hero / sidekick is increased.
[/list]
[i]Note: Some of the old weapon's zombie targeting damage will be increased to balance the human vs zombie.[/i]

[u]Zombie assist score and ribbon[/u]
[*]When a zombie failed to infect a human but helped other zombies, this will give the zombie +1 assist point and a ribbon.
[*]Tis but a Zombie Bomb ribbon: The human gets infected within 4 sec. due to zombie bomb x 15 times (Give +1 assist point whenever the character achieves 1 time).
[*]Tanker Ribbon : Gets 3,000 damage from human x30 (Give +1 assist point whenever the character achieves 1 time).
[/list]
[h1][b]GP Decoder Event.[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/1005_02_IMD.png[/img]

The beloved GP Decoder event is back! You can purchase GP Decoder from the shop with your GP.

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From October 12th to October 19th.
[/list]
[b]WHAT[/b]
[*]You can acquire GP decoders by exchanging your GP.
[/list]
[b]HOW[/b]
[*]Level 15 – 29: 1 GP decoder with 5,000 GP per day.
[*]Level 30 – 49: 1 GP decoder with 10,000 GP per day.
[*]Level 50 or higher: 1 GP decoder with 15,000 GP per day.
[*]For example, if you are level 50 or higher, 3 GP decoders with 30,000 GP per day in total.
[/list]
Purchase GP decoders will disappear after certain period, so you’d best use any in your inventory before they expire.

Kind regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Blood on your weapons! + New Zombie Escape Map + SKULL Weapon series released!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_NAV_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Blood on your weapons![/b][/h1]

Finally, it’s time to wrap your weapon! We decided to release the ‘Blood’ weapon paint starting today.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/0921_Blood_On_Your_Weapons-2.png[/img]

[b]WHAT[/b]
[*]Player can paint the selected weapons with Blood paint.
[*]SKULL-1, SKULL-3, SKULL-5 can be painted with this item.
[/list]
[h1][b]SKULL-1 Perfect Pick Recipe Set.[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/0921_SKULL-1_PPR_SET.png[/img]

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From September 21st to October 5th.
[/list]

[h1][b]SKULL-3 Perfect Pick Recipe Set.[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/0921_SKULL-3_PPR_SET.png[/img]

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From September 21st to October 5th.
[/list]
[h1][i]Note: Currently, SKULL-3 Perfect Pick Recipe's image in game shop shows 'Blood' covered image but it is SKULL-3 Perfect Pick Recipe without 'Blood' weapon paint. Please be careful when you purchase this item.[/i][/h1]

[h1][b]SKULL-1 Perfect Pick Recipe Set + Blood Weapon Paint.[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/0921_SKULL-1_PPRBLOOD_SET.png[/img]

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From September 21st to October 5th.
[/list]
[b]ELEMENTS[/b]
[*]10 x SKULL-1 Perfect Pick Recipe Set + 1 x Blood Weapon Paint.
[/list]

[h1][b]SKULL-3 Perfect Pick Recipe Set + Blood Weapon Paint.[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/0921_SKULL-3_PPRBLOOD_SET.png[/img]

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From September 21st to October 5.th
[/list]
[b]ELEMENTS[/b]
[*]10 x SKULL-3 Perfect Pick Recipe Set + 1 x Blood Weapon Paint.
[/list]
[h1][b]New Zombie Escape Map.[/b][/h1]

After the zombie virus outbreak, a group of survivors composed of civilians, soldiers, and cops await for a signal in a secluded warehouse in the forest. After confirmation of an extraction team heading to their location, they must proceed to the outskirts of the forest in order to meet the rescue team. However, unwelcome visitors are waiting.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/Rhizome_Grey_Frame-768x461.png[/img]

[b]OBJECTIVE[/b]
[*]Humans: Head to the rendezvous point at the outskirts of the forest within the time limit.
[*]Zombies: Infect all the humans, or get to the extraction point before them.
[/list]
[b]TIPS[/b]
[*]Strafing and Russian walk skills are really recommended to pass some areas quickly, especially the mill part.
[*]AWP-Z is also highly recommended to pass the big waterfall part quickly.
[*]There are several paths leading to the Osprey. Make sure to defend them all to avoid being ambushed by zombies.
[/list]
Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / September 21, 2016.
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_WPN_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

Let’s check out the full update notes:

[h1][b]Division Zombie Hero Event.[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/Division_Italy.png[/img]

What is the Division Zombie Hero? You will want to know what will come today.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/580226264166860571]Click here for more information.[/url]

[h1][b]New Zombie Escape Map.[/b][/h1]

Let’s see the new battlefield. Check your foxholes and barricades in the new map.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/Rhizome_Grey_Frame-768x461.png[/img]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/580226264166860797]Click here for more information.[/url]

[h1][b]Blood on your weapons![/b][/h1]

Your wait is over. We are finally releasing a new weapon paint item today and it is called ‘Blood’.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/0921_Blood_On_Your_Weapons-2.png[/img]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/580226264166860797]Click here for more information.[/url]

[h1][b]SKULL weapon series released with ‘Blood’ weapon skin.[/b][/h1]

Various SKULL weapon series have released today. Check each set of items and prepare for the next battle with Zombies.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/0921_4WPNS.png[/img]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/580226264166860797]Click here for more information.[/url]

[h1][b]BUG FIX[/b][/h1]

As you know, we had an issue with a Joker piece from Supreme Decoder. It has now been solved. From now on, you can use your Joker piece freely again.

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_WPN_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

Let’s check out the full update notes:

[h1][b]Division Zombie Hero Event.[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/Division_Italy.png[/img]

What is the Division Zombie Hero? You will want to know what will come today.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/580226264166860571]Click here for more information.[/url]

[h1][b]New Zombie Escape Map.[/b][/h1]

Let’s see the new battlefield. Check your foxholes and barricades in the new map.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/Rhizome_Grey_Frame-768x461.png[/img]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/580226264166860797]Click here for more information.[/url]

[h1][b]Blood on your weapons![/b][/h1]

Your wait is over. We are finally releasing a new weapon paint item today and it is called ‘Blood’.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/0921_Blood_On_Your_Weapons-2.png[/img]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/580226264166860797]Click here for more information.[/url]

[h1][b]SKULL weapon series released with ‘Blood’ weapon skin.[/b][/h1]

Various SKULL weapon series have released today. Check each set of items and prepare for the next battle with Zombies.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/0921_4WPNS.png[/img]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/580226264166860797]Click here for more information.[/url]

[h1][b]BUG FIX[/b][/h1]

As you know, we had an issue with a Joker piece from Supreme Decoder. It has now been solved. From now on, you can use your Joker piece freely again.

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Division Zombie Hero!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_SP_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Division Zombie Hero Event.[/b][/h1]

What is the Division Zombie Hero? You will want to know what will come today.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/Division_Italy.png[/img]

[b]OBJECTIVE[/b]
[*]Human: Survive the zombie attack for the remaining time limit or eliminate all zombies.
[*]Zombie: Infect all remaining humans into zombies.
[/list]
[b]WHAT[/b]
[*]Added ‘Division Italy’ map.
[*] A zombie killed by humans will be resurrected immediately in the place they died and the dead zombie will be divided into two other schizonts.
[*]Players will be divided into bot and player and the divided bot will attack humans like Bot Zombies.
[*]A max of 20 players can play at the same time.
[/list]
[b]TIPS[/b]
[*]At the start, the humans can choose a hero.
[*]Zombies start with their own schizont.
[*]Upon death, you and your schizont divide into two other schizonts.
[*]Can divide up to 2 times, and will die permanently upon its 3rd time.
[*]In the event mode, evolution, stats, medals, and accolades do not get counted.
[/list]
[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From September 21st to October 12th.
[/list]
Kind regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weapon Upgrade Event!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_SP_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]How Do You Get The Weapon For The Upgrade Event?[/b][/h1]

You can upgrade three weapons during this event period. However, you will likely have many questions about the event even if you've played it before. Please read carefully to check how you can do this without a problem.

[b]WEAPONS[/b]

[*]Infinity Silver
[*]Dual Infinity
[*]Kriss Super V
[/list]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/0831_WPUGEVNT.png[/img]

[b]HOW TO GET THE WEAPON?[/b]

[*][b]Infinity Silver:[/b] As you can see, we are giving you a free Infinity Silver for the upgrading event from August 24th to September 14th. It’s free! You can freely upgrade this weapon!
[*][b]Dual Infinity:[/b] You can purchase this weapon August 31st to September 14th as a perfect pick recipe set! Let’s check out the in-game shop!
[*][b]Kriss Super V:[/b] You can get this weapon from Mileage Decoders.
[/list]
[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From August 31st to September 14th.
[/list]

[b]HOW[/b]
[*]You must play with at least 4 or more players in the same room.
[*]You need 5000 kill points to upgrade Primary Weapons, while only 3000 kill points are needed for Secondary Weapons.
[*][b]Infinity Silver:[/b] In Scenario mode (Human/Zombie), it can be upgraded to Infinity Red by scoring 3000 kills.
[*][b]Infinity Silver:[/b] In Zombie modes (Original/Mutant/Hero/Darkness), it can be upgraded to Infinity Black by scoring 300 kills.
[/list]


Please do not miss this chance and play Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies with free Infinity Silver at least!

Kind regards,
CSN:Z Team
