This is a set of special anti-zombie light rifles, allowing you to hold 2 guns at the same time. It provides 48 rounds of incredible fire power on zombies. Its specialized ammo has been developed through the government funding for improved damage on zombies.
2. Mileage Decoder Growth Box (10 days)
When the item is in your possession, then 5 Mileage Decoders are given to you each day.
You will also receive a +500% increase in EXP and GP received in your matches for 10 days. This surely is the fastest way of leveling up ever.
BINGO EXCLUSIVE WEAPONS!

The stubby appearance of the Coil Machine Gun may remind you of the Avalanche, but the Coil Machine Gun is categorized as machine a gun. The magazine comes with 100 rounds and the gun fires at 600 rounds per minute. With a full load, it comes in at a staggering 9kg. The rounds fired from the Coil Machine Gun will create an electrical field upon a hit, and will deal AoE damage and apply shock to the enemies.
This is a new pistol which uses special 'holy' bullets. Appearance-wise, it looks similar to the Anaconda.
However, it uses the special 'holy' bullets, which explode on impact to damage any nearby zombies. It can also damage your opponent over time.
Want it? Just Name It! The Alphabet Event.
The event will run from 14.04.16 until 27.04.16. Hurry up and collect all the available weapons!
Get yourself the 7 new Battle series weapons: Battle Hunting Dagger, Battle Galil, Battle Famas, Battle BB95, Battle Glock 18C, Battle USP45, and Battle MP5 by collecting letters.
Wait, what? Permanent weapons for letters?

notes.title: Zombie Scenario new difficulty and reward system!
notes.content:
This is something you’ve all been waiting for. More Zombie Scenario changes in your favor.
Check out the expanded range of difficulties and acquirable rewards below.

First thing’s first. The difficulty settings have been expanded and now you can choose from Easy 1 to Hard 9. Depending on the difficulty, the given EXP and Points vary.

[img]http://csoimage.nexoneu.com/csnz/game/promotion/etc/9.png[/img]

Once a scenario is cleared, a "Daily Reward Box" is given out. 
The box can be upgraded if a higher difficulty is cleared without using the box.

The higher the difficulty, the better the rewards.

[img]http://csoimage.nexoneu.com/csnz/game/promotion/etc/10.png[/img]

The rank-dependent rewards are removed and stage-difficulty-dependent rewards are now implemented instead. If the stage was cleared too fast, then a reward of lower difficulty can be given out.

If a higher difficulty than the box's difficulty is cleared, then the Daily Reward Box is upgraded.

[img]http://csoimage.nexoneu.com/csnz/game/promotion/etc/11.jpg[/img]

The best reward for each difficulty can be checked from the loading screen.
If the Daily Reward Box has been used, it can be acquired again after midnight.

Easy 1 for the newest of players.
For those who wanted to solo-clear the scenarios without being bothered, the new Easy 1 difficulty will suit their needs!

[img]http://csoimage.nexoneu.com/csnz/game/promotion/etc/12.jpg[/img]

Obstacles on this setting will have only 150 HP and the item cooldown and revival time is set on a short timer.

It is made so that it is easier to clear, but the rewards will not be as good as higher difficulties.

Want to push your gear and skills to the limit?
For those who are ready and fully equipped.
For those who want the best of rewards.
Choose [b]Hard 9[/b] difficulty

[img]http://csoimage.nexoneu.com/csnz/game/promotion/etc/13.jpg[/img]

The item cooldown and revival time is set on a long timer in Hard difficulty.
There is a cooldown timer on the Round Retry Item.
From a certain hard difficulty and higher, a "Champion Zombie" will appear.
Rewards befitting of such insane difficulty is prepared, so put yourselves up to the challenge!

[h1][b]Some of the important added features:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]The EXP/Money gain is now fixed to be triggered on-hit, instead of on-kill.
[*]Depending on the difficulty, the ranking EXP given out may vary.
[*]The Hitbox for some bosses has been fixed.
[*]Upon Round Retry, it will no longer start over from the beginning but continue off from where you've last died.[/list]
(* Does not apply to certain Defense mode games.)

[h1][b]New Daily Missions[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csoimage.nexoneu.com/csnz/game/promotion/etc/14.png[/img]

Many players requested new missions to be added and we will deliver. You will find 7 new daily missions that gives you more ways to receive rewards every day. They are focused on Zombie Shelter, Hide and Seek, Zombie Hero, Zombie Mutant.

Can you fly with your zombie for at least 3 seconds?

notes.title: [Update] Leviathan! Salamander is Back!
notes.content:
Have you been enjoying the Transcendence Decoders released last month? With your support, Transcendence Decoders are getting popular these days. However, the sale of Transcendence Decoders will end soon. If you want to buy more, please go to the in-game shop right now before they are disappear!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1960-3.png[/img]

If you want to know more about Transcendence Decoders, please[url=http://www.csnzombies.com/transcendence-decoder-the-next-big-thing-is-here/] click here.[/url]

I hope that you enjoyed the freebie update released last week. We, Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies Team, will do our best to ensure that you have fun.

Let us introduce the items that have been previously released.
Those are Leviathan and Salamander.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/Re_item_icons-1.png[/img]
  
These weapons are perfect arch-rivals to each other, also famous for their opposing characters.

Let's take a detailed look at them...

[h1][b]Leviathan[/b][/h1]

This weapon decreases the movement of enemies by shooting liquid gas, using the rapid-cooling device on the back.

As seen in the stat table, this is more like a supporting weapon rather than one used for direct attacks, as its goal is to freeze enemies. It might look like a vacuum cleaner at first glance.
 
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/smoke-0282.png[/img]

Since it is specialized in attacks that freeze the enemy, its attack is less powerful, unfortunately.

This is why it wields a special ability in zombie mode. If you use it against zombies, the freezing effect is more powerful than that of THANATOS-11. Even though zombies want to run toward you, their bodies will stiffen up, not able to move an inch if hit by Leviathan. Well, if you're playing as a zombie, you might become furious.

However, no matter how powerful the freeze, its damage to zombies is small, and is therefore not recommended to fight one-on-one. If you're playing with many users, you can get the most from Leviathan by massacring zombies after distracting them.

The damage to enemies is weak, but the speed of consecutive attacks is quick.

[h1][b]Salamander[/b][/h1]

This weapon was really popular when first released in Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies. It shoots raging flames, not allowing zombies to come closer. If attacked, enemies are burnt and get sustaining damage. (HP decreases by 20 per second)

It has a gas tank on the left, which needs to be filled before shooting.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/Salamander.png[/img] 

See the tank?

One magazine can have 100 shots, allowing you to shoot for a long time like a machine gun. However, it takes more time to load the magazine compared to other guns, increasing your risk of being hit.

Knock-back is normal. As it can have many shots like a machine gun, you might think it will send enemies back by attacking. But there is little knock-back if you shoot one by one. However, as it discharges flames against many zombies, dealing them sustaining and splash damage all at once makes it a superb weapon.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/s04_image02.jpg[/img]

This update introduces the battle between fire and water. What is your choice?

Do you want to freeze enemies with Leviathan? Or want to wield flames from Hell with Salamander? 

Check back next week for the next update!
Bye! See you again next week!

notes.title: [Update] This is no April Fool's Day joke! Freebie events instead of item sale events!
notes.content:
Sometimes, change can be a really good thing. This time around, we are unveiling a freebie event without a new item sale.

This is not the regular April Fool's Day joke that you expect every year. Keep reading for more details.

[h1][b]You will receive a reward when you complete a special mission 10 times![/b][/h1]

It's easy to participate. However, it's not easy to achieve! If you complete a special mission 10 times from 30th March 09:00 CEST to 14th April 09:00 CEST, you will receive MK3A1 (Permanent)!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1-1.png[/img] 

This weapon is also known as "Jackhammer". This 12 gauge shotgun is known as an innovative weapon when unleashed. This guns has 10 bullets in total. It weighs 4.57 kg when it's loaded so it's a bit heavy.

While you might feel the attacking speed is slow, you will be happy to see that the re-loading speed is faster compared to other automatic shotguns. Jackhammer fires 6 bullets at once! Take a shot at getting this permanent weapon!

[h1][b]April Fool's Day Spray Event[/b][/h1]

We can't forget about April Fool's Day Event! It's our special gift prepared for you to celebrate April Fool's Day.
Access Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies and obtain 3 sets of spray!

From 30th March, 09:00 CEST to 14th April, 24:00 CEST, the April Fool’s Day Spray Event will be carried out.

How do you get these weapons? It's simple!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/2-2.png[/img]
[list] 
[*]During the event, you will receive the AT4CS Spray (30 days) for the first time you log in.
[*]During the event, you will receive the Lightning AR-2 Spray (30 days) when you access the game for 3 consecutive days.
[*]During the event, you will receive the E-Key Spray (30 days) when you access the game for 5 consecutive days.
[/list]
It's that simple. However, there's something that you should be aware of...

Rewards will be distributed immediately. It is possible to win the rewards only 1 time during the event period.
If you have no free space in your inventory, you can't receive the event items!
So please be sure to make space in your inventory to receive the rewards.

This event is too good to miss, and it would be a shame if we couldn't reward you due to a full inventory. Have fun!

[h1][b]April Fool's Big Head (Big Head or SD) Event![/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/3-3.png[/img] 
If you clear [New Zombie Shelter] during the event period, we will reward you with ‘Soi's SD Zombie Maker (1 day)’!

[table]
[tr]
[th][img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/4-3.png[/img][/th]
[th][u]Soi's SD Zombie Maker[/u]
The bot, zombie, and boss monster's heads will get bigger in Bot Original, Bot Team Death, Bot Zombie, Zombie Scenario, and New Zombie Shelter modes.[/th]
[/tr]
[/table]

You can participate in this event when there are 4 or more players in the room and you can create a Big Head room through Soi's SD Zombie Maker.

Soi's SD Zombie Maker will last for 24 hrs and it will be removed when the event ends. This doesn't get saved, so you should use it right away when you obtain it.

If there is no space in your inventory, you cannot receive the event reward. So please leave a space in your inventory before participating the event.

From 30th March, 09:00 CEST to 14th April, 24:00 CEST, the April Fool’s Big Head Event will be carried out!

Now, we have prepared a full update with real events. We hope to get a lot of support from you. It's spring time already, so take care and we'll chat again with another patch next week!

Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies is always with you.

See you next time!
Bye!

notes.title: [UPDATE] Transcendence Decoder – The Next Big Thing Is Here!
notes.content:
Let’s start off with saying: Finally! Transcendence Decoder is available and it’s the best thing that happened to the survivors since the discovery of the gunpowder. But 23.03.2016 is truly a historical date and a really bad day for the undead.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/en.jpg[/img]

Will it really help with the Zombie problem? They are like sand on a desert: countless and it can get very irritating when trying to get rid of them. They even have their own Scenario! Not to mention their DNA has mutated and Daily Zombie Sweep is never enough to keep them away.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1957-1-1.png[/img]

Please welcome the youngest offspring in Decoders’ Family and your new best friend: Transcendence Decoder. Be fast to get familiar with it as it’s going to leave the party on 14.04.2016, and nobody know if it’s ever going to come back.

Get one or better a pack of Transcendence Decoders in the Item Shop immediately! Open it and become the owner of one of the rewards from the long list below:

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1957-2-1.png[/img]

Brand new top quality 4 weapons: AWP Elven Ranger, Warhammer Storm Giant, Petrol Boomer or Air Burster. They come only in permanent versions!

[h1][b]AWP Elven Ranger[/b][/h1]

It belongs to Buff weapon series, considered to be some of the best weapons in the game.

This sniper rifle has 20 shots with special bullet called .338 Lapua Magnum and it is very effective for zombies.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1957-3-1.png[/img]

[h1][b]Some special advantages of this weapon:[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*]You can charge the power and attack when you maintain the zoom mode.
[*]When you hit a target, the crosshair marker will show up, this helps improve accuracy even further
[*]Unlimited spare magazine in zombie scenario mode
[*]The sprint duration increases by 1sec in zombie hero
[*]All players' armours are upgraded automatically to 5 LV in zombie scenario.

notes.content:
Dear Survivors,

After the maintenance on the 23rd of March, the Golden Weapon Event will be introduced. It seems like I wasn't being clear enough by giving out the name of an event. So we'll go step by step to find out what this Golden Weapon Event is all about!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1959-1.png[/img]

[h1][b]Golden Weapon Event[/b][/h1]

There are many stories surrounding these Golden Weapons. Some may be true, some may be not. But the most eye-catching feature about the Golden Weapon would be its golden appearance. Well, and there are added features such as extended magazines on the WA2000 and the HK23E, or additional bonus stats on the M4.

Then which of the Golden Weapons have the most merit of all Golden Weapons?

I'd say it is Winchester M1887, HK23E, Thompson, and the M14 EBR. These weapons have sufficient firepower along with good rate of fire (some may not), making them one of the most beloved weapons by the users.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1959-2.png[/img]

And those weapons are also included in this event!

[h1][b]So, when can we start?[/b][/h1]

It's useless if you don't know when you can get these weapons, right? So I'll tell you little bit about when the event will begin.

The Golden Weapon Event will start on the Easter weekend, from 00:00 (CET) of March 25th, and end on the midnight of March 28th. Don't miss your chance to acquire your own Golden Weapon from Friday to Monday, total of 4 days of weekend, on this awesome event we prepared!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1959-3.png[/img]

[h1][b]How do you get these weapons?[/b][/h1]

notes.title: [Update] Transcendence Decoder release!
notes.content:
Dear Survivors,

The past week has been a tough one. Since we had to release both Zombie DNA and Teddy Nightmare DLC. However, it makes us very happy to see your never-ending support and love for the new content. 

Last week, there was a chance to purchase Mileage Decoders with GP. Have you had your chance to enjoy the event? We, Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies, promise to bring more content and events that you can enjoy in return for the love and support you've given us.

Now then, shall we take a look at what we have in store for you all?

[h1][b]The Transcendence Decoders are now available![/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1957-1.png[/img] 

The highly anticipated Transcendence Decoders are now available. The Transcendence Decoder, which was released from Korea and Hong Kong to Japan, will give out rare items at a higher chance. It looks like a Mileage Decoder, but the items that can be obtained just cannot be compared.

The Transcendence Decoder even surpasses the Supreme Decoder.

What can you acquire from the Transcendence Decoder? The list will go on if we had to name all rare items, but we'll name a couple as an example:

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1957-2.png[/img]

Can't you just imagine the item pool from those two items?

AWP ELVEN RANGER has a buff effect that is triggered as long as it's in possession, just like the M4A1 DARK KNIGHT AND AK47 PALADIN. Should we take a look at it?

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1957-3.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Sprint duration increased by 1 second in Zombie Hero mode
[*]Automatic upgrade to tier 5 armor for all users in the room in Zombie Scenario mode
[*]200% additional game EXP
[*]50% additional game EXP for other users that played with you
[/list]

4% lighter weight and 12% faster rate of fire compared to a normal AWP. Isn't that great? Shall we take a look at Warhammer Storm Giant?

Warhammer Storm Giant does not have buff effects, but it does have special features that does not exist in any other melee weapons. The exclusive features are draw attack and combination attack. Draw attack allows you to attack with the Warhammer Storm Giant as it is being taken out, and combination attack allows you to knock back your opponent with an additional attack by clicking the right mouse button at the right timing during draw attack.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1957-4.png[/img]

These two features synergize each other very well, and if they are mastered, then Warhammer Storm Giant will surpass any other melee weapons out in the field.

It definitely lives up to its name. We've brought over all the good things that existed on the THANATOS-9, the damage against enemies have been upgraded, and it will fire just as fast as the THANATOS-9.

All these weapons will be available through Transcendence Decoder. You can get yours after the maintenance on Wednesday, 23rd of March. After the maintenance on 14th of April, Transcendence Decoders will no longer be available! So don't miss out on this chance to acquire rare weapons!

If you wish you find out more on the complete list of weapons that can be acquired through the Transcendence Decoder, please click here!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/618490373956468189]Click here for more info about Transcendence Decoder.[/url]

notes.content:
Dear Survivors,

The past week has been a tough one. Since we had to release both Zombie DNA and Teddy Nightmare DLC. However, it makes us very happy to see your never-ending support and love for the new content. 

Last week, there was a chance to purchase Mileage Decoders with GP. Have you had your chance to enjoy the event? We, Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies, promise to bring more content and events that you can enjoy in return for the love and support you've given us.

Now then, shall we take a look at what we have in store for you all?

The Transcendence Decoder even surpasses the Supreme Decoder.

What can you acquire from the Transcendence Decoder? The list will go on if we had to name all rare items, but we'll name a couple as an example:

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1957-2.png[/img]

Draw attack allows you to attack with the Warhammer Storm Giant as it is being taken out, and combination attack allows you to knock back your opponent with an additional attack by clicking the right mouse button at the right timing during draw attack.

notes.title: [UPDATE] Zombie DNA & Teddy Nightmare!
notes.content:
Survivors,

Time flies, and I am back yet again to bring you news of another big update! Read on for all of the details...

[h1][b]WHAT IS ZOMBIE DNA?[/b][/h1]

 [img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1_en.jpg[/img]

Gene modification has been a hot topic in the scientific community. Would there be unforeseen side effects? What would be the consequences? A lot of questions, indeed, but we already know the benefits.

Then, why don’t we modify Zombie’s DNA? Maybe we are able to upgrade our Zombies to attack humans with powerful skills and abilities? Zombie DNA is finally on stage and now it’s your time to experience this.

The DNA system is where you can activate certain sequences of DNA with the points you're given in order to customize your zombie according to your needs.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/638755483468052749]CLICK HERE FOR MORE INFO.[/url]

[h1][b]TEDDY NIGHTMARE DLC[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/2-1.png[/img]

Starting today, you are able to purchase the Teddy Nightmare DLC. Teddy Nightmare DLC is separated into 15 and 30 day items. Both packages have two valuable items such as the Teddy Nightmare Mode Key and Mileage Decoder Supply Box. 

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/3-2.png[/img]   

Only Teddy Nightmare Mode Key holder can create a room and play with the other users. It means that you don’t need a key to play Teddy Nightmare mode, so long as a valid key holder invites you to their room.

Usually, only key holders would get the many advantages, but we won’t stop there. For more information, click on one of the links below:

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/638755483471731914]CLICK HERE FOR MORE INFO.[/url]

[h1][b]GP MILEAGE DECODER EVENT[/b][/h1]

Surely you have heard that the most popular cash item in Counter Strike Nexon: Zombies is the Mileage Decoder...

Well, starting after the maintenance on 16th March, you can purchase the Mileage Decoder with GP (game points)! 

Of course, there are few of rules: 

   • Level 15-29 players can purchase 1 Mileage Decoder for 5,000 GP
   • Level 30-49 players can purchase 1 Mileage Decoder for 10,000 GP
   • Level 50 and above players can purchase 1 Mileage Decoder for 15,000 GP

Even better, level 50 and above players can purchase all 3 Mileage Decoders listed above (total cost=30,000 GP).

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/4-2.png[/img]

This event will end on 30th of March before the maintenance.

[h1][b]WEAPON OF THE MONTH[/b][/h1]

Zombies are getting stronger and stronger every day. To cope with the dangerous situations, Aegis Institute has recently announced a weapon that has been properly modified and mechanized. It looks similar to the original one, but once you use it, you will never forget this weapon.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/6.jpg[/img] 

The Weapon of the Month is specially re-developed by Aegis institute to have superior blocking power against Zombie attacks. Aegis Institute has concrete plans to release a weapon every month.

The [Weapon of the Month] will be used as the default weapons that everyone has, and will be injected directly into their inventories.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/7.jpg[/img]

Do you want to know what the [Weapon of the Month] will be? Check your weapon purchasing screen!
 
To have superior firepower against Zombies, Aegis institute does really hard work continuously. Keep your Zombies out from your area with the re-developed [Weapon of the Month!]

[h1][b]RULER OF DARKNESS 50% DISCOUNT EVENT[/b][/h1]

Your wait is over! Starting from after the maintenance on 16th March, you are able to purchase this set. The Ruler of Darkness, a.k.a ‘Shadow Conqueror’ consist of two zombies, Spin Diver and Night Stalker.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/8_en.png[/img]

Since last September, these two Zombies have been showing outrageous outcomes in the world of Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies. You can find them at competitive prices now. Don’t miss out!

[h1][b]NPS UPDATE[/b][/h1]

Maybe some of you have already realized what this is. When you close this game correctly, a pop-up window shows a kind of survey for you to fill out. Your feedback will provide us with valuable insight!

[h1][b]NEW ANTI-HACK CODE IMPLEMENTED[/b][/h1]

We have collected known hacks and abusing tools for the last couple of weeks and implemented a prevention today. We constantly do our best to prevent hackers and abusers from getting in our way of a good game. Fair play, right? That’s one value that is very important to us.

Okay, this is pretty much everything that I’ve prepared for this week’s update. I love this game very much because I can feel that I and my fellow players are doing something together. I think I used this expression many times. But, I have to say it once again:

Check back for more.

I will come back to you with surprising news next week, so be sure to check our updates regularly.

See you later!

notes.title: [UPDATE] This Is Not The End… Teddy Nightmare Comes To The Stage!
notes.content:
Dear Survivors,

We have been walking side by side on a road of adventure and we have been fighting many battles against countless enemies. Now it is time to take a jump into a whole new concept of zombie threats. Sounds like another bad dream? You are not far from correct, as its name is ‘Teddy Nightmare’.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/TD_NM_01.png[/img]
[i]Hello, Survivors! We haven’t met before...[/i]

This suspiciously-huggable Teddy awaits to be challenged by survivors who purchase the key in the Teddy Nightmare DLC package.

In the available DLC packages, there is a key allowing you to open gates of Teddy Nightmare mode, plus a unique Mileage Decoder Supply Box. You can freely select a 15 or 30 day DLC version of this set.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/TD_NM_02.png[/img]

The Mileage Decoder Supply Box will give its owner 1x Mileage Decoder every day, upon logging into the game. You can continue to use it for 15 days or 30 days, depending on which pack you have chosen and accumulate Mileage Decoders.

Only Teddy Nightmare mode key holders can create Teddy Nightmare mode rooms, but any other survivor can join the challenge without the need of the key.

[img]http://csoimage.nexoneu.com/csnz/game/promotion/etc/TD_NM_xxjpg.jpg[/img]
The room creator and other players have an equal chance of getting one of the great items below after defeating the horrific but fluffy bear boss.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/TD_NM_04.png[/img]
2,000/5,000/10,000 GP (One of the point items will be given randomly to the players as a result.)

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/TD_NM_05.png[/img]
Enhancement Materials for your Weapon Enhancement. You can enhance your weapon to its Enhancement Attributes Value up to 8 by using this material. (10/50/100 items will be given to the players as a result.)

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/TD_NM_06.png[/img]
This item is useful to boost the chances of success in manufacturing, especially for lower-tier combat blueprints.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/TD_NM_07.png[/img]
This item is used when manufacturing a weapon. It can return the weapon recipe or durability item if it fails to manufacture.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/TD_NM_08.png[/img]
The famous Mileage Decoder. You will receive 3x Mileage Decoders if you draw this reward after the match. Please do not disappoint yourself even if your score wasn’t good enough to get this reward.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/TD_NM_09.png[/img]
If you use these kits to enhance your weapon, you will have a 100% successful chance on enhancing that attribute by 1 level. (Random parts will be given as a result.)

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/TD_NM_10.png[/img]
Anti-Enhancement Material is used to reset your Weapon's Enhancement Attributes value. By using this, the specific stats will be reverted to 0, regardless of status. (Random parts will be given as a result.)

Keep in mind that like any dream, it will come to an end. Do not miss this opportunity!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/TD_NM_11.png[/img]


[url=http://www.csnzombies.com/fr/mise-a-jour-ce-nest-pas-fini-le-nounours-cauchemar-arrive-sur-le-devant-de-la-scene/]FRENCH[/url]
[url=http://www.csnzombies.com/de/update-das-ist-noch-nicht-das-ende-teddy-nightmare-betritt-die-buehne/]DEUTSCH[/url]
[url=http://www.csnzombies.com/pl/aktualizacja-to-jeszcze-nie-koniec-niedzwiedz-koszmaru-wchodzi-na-scene/]POLISH[/url]
[url=http://www.csnzombies.com/ru/%D0%BE%D0%B1%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%BB%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%B5-%D1%8D%D1%82%D0%BE-%D0%B5%D1%89%D1%91-%D0%BD%D0%B5-%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%B5%D1%86-%D0%BD%D0%B0-%D1%81%D1%86%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%83-%D0%B2/]RUSSIAN[/url]

notes.title: [UPDATE] This Is Not The End… Teddy Nightmare Comes To The Stage!
notes.content:
Dear Survivors,

We have been walking side by side on a road of adventure and we have been fighting many battles against countless enemies. Now it is time to take a jump into a whole new concept of zombie threats. Sounds like another bad dream? You are not far from correct, as its name is ‘Teddy Nightmare’.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/TD_NM_01.png[/img]
[i]Hello, Survivors! We haven’t met before...[/i]

This suspiciously-huggable Teddy awaits to be challenged by survivors who purchase the key in the Teddy Nightmare DLC package.

In the available DLC packages, there is a key allowing you to open gates of Teddy Nightmare mode, plus a unique Mileage Decoder Supply Box. You can freely select a 15 or 30 day DLC version of this set.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/TD_NM_02.png[/img]

The Mileage Decoder Supply Box will give its owner 1x Mileage Decoder every day, upon logging into the game. You can continue to use it for 15 days or 30 days, depending on which pack you have chosen and accumulate Mileage Decoders.

Only Teddy Nightmare mode key holders can create Teddy Nightmare mode rooms, but any other survivor can join the challenge without the need of the key.

[img]http://csoimage.nexoneu.com/csnz/game/promotion/etc/TD_NM_xxjpg.jpg[/img]
The room creator and other players have an equal chance of getting one of the great items below after defeating the horrific but fluffy bear boss.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/TD_NM_04.png[/img]
2,000/5,000/10,000 GP (One of the point items will be given randomly to the players as a result.)

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/TD_NM_05.png[/img]
Enhancement Materials for your Weapon Enhancement. You can enhance your weapon to its Enhancement Attributes Value up to 8 by using this material. (10/50/100 items will be given to the players as a result.)

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/TD_NM_06.png[/img]
This item is useful to boost the chances of success in manufacturing, especially for lower-tier combat blueprints.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/TD_NM_07.png[/img]
This item is used when manufacturing a weapon. It can return the weapon recipe or durability item if it fails to manufacture.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/TD_NM_08.png[/img]
The famous Mileage Decoder. You will receive 3x Mileage Decoders if you draw this reward after the match. Please do not disappoint yourself even if your score wasn’t good enough to get this reward.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/TD_NM_09.png[/img]
If you use these kits to enhance your weapon, you will have a 100% successful chance on enhancing that attribute by 1 level. (Random parts will be given as a result.)

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/TD_NM_10.png[/img]
Anti-Enhancement Material is used to reset your Weapon's Enhancement Attributes value. By using this, the specific stats will be reverted to 0, regardless of status. (Random parts will be given as a result.)

Keep in mind that like any dream, it will come to an end. Do not miss this opportunity!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/TD_NM_11.png[/img]


[url=http://www.csnzombies.com/fr/mise-a-jour-ce-nest-pas-fini-le-nounours-cauchemar-arrive-sur-le-devant-de-la-scene/]FRENCH[/url]

notes.title: [UPDATE] NEW UPGRADES! ZOMBIE DNA!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/banner-1-1029x346.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]What Is DNA System?[/b][/h1]

DNA system is where you can activate certain sequences of the DNA with the points you're given in order to 'customize' your zombie according to your needs.

[h1][b]Zombie DNA System[/b][/h1]

Zombie info will be created in your inventory.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1.jpg[/img]

The existing zombie evolution tree in my info has been moved to the newly created Zombie Info tab. 9 points are given out, and the certain DNA will be activated upon logging in.

[h1][b]How To Use Zombie DNA[/b][/h1]

The activated DNA can be reset by pressing the "Reset DNA" button, and all the points will be refunded. There is no cost to reset, and can be done whenever you desire.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/2.jpg[/img]

Place your cursor on top of a DNA and right-click to activate it.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/3-1.png[/img]

An already activated DNA can be inactivated by left-clicking it.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/4-1.png[/img]

[h1][b]Apply Zombie DNA[/b][/h1]

The activated DNA is applied on all zombies.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/5.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Zombie DNA List[/b][/h1]

[table]
[tr]
[th][img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0316/Zbehn_00_on.png[/img][/th]
[th][h1]Zombie Health Boost[/h1][/th]
[th]The base health is greatly increased.[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]

[td][h1]Infection Boost[/h1][/td]
[td]Upon infecting a human, portion of your HP is recovered.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0316/Zbehn_02_on.png[/img][/td]
[td][h1]Danger Boost[/h1][/td]
[td]The HP recovery rate is increased while resting, once your HP falls below 1000.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0316/Zbehn_03_on.png[/img][/td]
[td][h1]Host Boost[/h1][/td]
[td]HP is increased when you're chosen as the Host[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0316/Zbehn_04_on.png[/img][/td]
[td][h1]Reinforced Host Boost[/h1][/td]
[td]HP is increased when you're chosen as the Reinforced Host[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0316/Zbehn_05_on.png[/img][/td]
[td][h1]Moving Boost[/h1][/td]
[td]HP will be recovered by a fixed amount if you do not get damaged while moving.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0316/Zbehn_06_on.png[/img][/td]
[td][h1]Resting Boost[/h1][/td]
[td]HP recovery rate is increased while resting.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0316/Zbehn_07_on.png[/img][/td]
[td][h1]Defense Boost[/h1][/td]
[td]Your defense increases once your HP falls below 1000.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0316/Zbehn_08_on.png[/img][/td]
[td][h1]Rigor Boost[/h1][/td]
[td]The duration of rigidity effect is decreased.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]

[tr]

[/tr]

[td][img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0316/Zbehn_18_on.png[/img][/td]
[td][h1]Rage production[/h1][/td]
[td]Rage production rate is increased.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[url=http://www.csnzombies.com/it/dna-zombie-aggiornamenti/]ITALIAN[/url]
[url=http://www.csnzombies.com/tr/guencelleme-zombi-dna-sistemi/]TURKISH[/url]
[url=http://www.csnzombies.com/es/adn-zombi-actualizacion/]SPANISH[/url]
[url=http://www.csnzombies.com/pt-br/dna-zumbi/]PORTUGUESE[/url]

Kind Regards, 
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [UPDATE] 2nd March 2016.
notes.content:
[img]http://csoimage.nexoneu.com/csnz/game/promotion/etc/ScreenShots_917.png[/img]

Survivors,

It is time for me to tell you what goodies are in-store for you this week. Let’s check this out together.

New to CSN:Z? Read this!

[h1][b]NEW USER PACKAGE - NOW AVAILABLE![/b][/h1]

A unique offer prepared for all new players and CSN:Z beginners.
It contains 11 absolutely necessary starting items all together in 1 bundle.

Get it and try out famous weapons series: 
[b]BALROG-XI[/b] - an auto shotgun with its charging system to put down even the biggest beasts
[b]JANUS-7[/b] - heavy machinegun that can deal damage to multiple enemies with lightning bolts after transformation
[b]SKULL-1[/b] - out of options? this little cannon does improved damage to zombies, so you can live another day

Weapons didn't help and your wounds are too severe to progress? Answer:

[h1][b]NEW USER PACKAGE[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1.png[/img]
[b]10x Small[/b] and [b]10x Large Medical kits[/b] will get you to your full health with a press of a button.

Even if that fails, [b]Battle Revivals[/b] and [b]Round Re-challanges[/b] will wake you up from the dead. Don't worry you won't turn into a zombie.

You are alive and equipped with great weapons, but NEW USER PACKAGE will assist you playing side by side with experienced survivors, as it contains [b]Upgrades to Armour[/b], [b]Attack[/b] and boost to [b]Level Up[/b] faster.

Too good to be true? Well, you are a new guy, and we need more brave recruits - so yeah, you're welcome!

Here's the summary of 11 featured items from the NEW USER PACKAGE: 

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/2_en-1.png[/img]

Its value is almost 10 times of its price, that's why you can only purchase this package only 1 time per account. Otherwise it would be cheating!

[h1][b]WORLD WAR 2 SET ITEM SALES (PERFECT PICK RECIPE)[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/3.png[/img]

If you purchase 1x World War II Perfect Pick Recipe series, you will get 2x FREE Mileage Decoders as a bonus, and if you purchase 10x World War II Perfect Pick Recipe series, you will get 10x FREE Mileage Decoders as a bonus. This is a perfect chance to have classic weapons and bonus items at a competitive price!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/4_en.png[/img]

[h1][b]50% DAILY EXP BOOST EVENT[/b][/h1]
Another EXP event? My answer is ‘Yes’. Of course, I know that some of you might find EXP events to be boring... I even find that to be the case sometimes, but this is such a good bonus! Read on for more details.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/5_en.png[/img]

This event will be held from 02.03.2016 to 16.03.2016 and twice per day. From 01:00 to 06:00 CET and 16:00 to 21:00 CET, you will experience 50% more EXP. Check the table below for North America Pacific times!

[img]http://csoimage.nexoneu.com/csnz/game/promotion/etc/ScreenShots_915.png[/img]

I’ve heard many of you discussing uncomfortable bugs while playing our game. It is totally understandable. Currently, we are working on fixing many clumsy things, so you will have good news soon. Keep your eyes peeled for future updates.

This is all for this week! We have prepared many things for you but I can’t tell you at the moment. We keep checking and developing many things, and I look forward to the day where I can introduce these new contents to you.

See you next week!

-----------------------------

Please follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z! 

Facebook (English): https://www.facebook.com/CSNZ.Official/ 
VK: http://vk.com/public78659129 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/CSN_Z

notes.title: [UPDATE] NEW ROCKET LAUNCHER!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2016/0211.jpg[/img]
An assault rifle is very effective for individual combat but sometimes you may feel that assault rifle is not good enough to take your enemy down. That’s true. Sometimes you need to pour your firepower at your enemy. Then my recommendation is going to be RPG-7.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0211/1.png[/img]

The RPG-7 (Rocket Propelled Grenade-7) is a rocket launcher purchasable in equipment slot but serves as primary weapon. RPG-7 is a Soviet Union light, versatile anti-tank rocket propelled grenade launcher. It boasts a potent destructive power with a large area of effect, making it an ideal weapon to use against multiple or tough targets, but can also damage the operator if used in close quarters. The user can aim through the iron sights to get an accurate firing.

Through this weapon, you will expect below advantages:
[h1]
● Massive damage. (In original mode, without flak vest, it gives +100 damage to the body)
● Short reload time
● Fire accurately when using the iron sight
● Can kill multiple targets at once
[/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0211/2.png[/img]

When you fire this weapon, you can zoom in your sight. However, you should know that a round is going up when you fired but if you zoomed in and fired the round, a round is not going up. That is strange, right?

With this set, the player can get the RPG-7 for sure from Craft using the Perfect Recipe item, but the durability will determine the period of the weapon.


Showing great fire power will help you to blow out your stress. Are you ready to fight now? Let’s roll with this new rocket launcher today!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0211/3.png[/img]

[h1][b]VALENTINE DAY’S ITEM GIVEAWAY[/b][/h1]
Love is not always comes at first sight. However, our item giveaway event comes at here for celebrating your love. Starting from 11th February after the maintenance, you will get two new Valentine day items for free. (1 time only)


[h1][b]HEART BOMB[/b][/h1]
This special grenade is given for free to all players who logged in during the Valentine's Day event. It shares the same performance as the normal HE Grenade.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0211/4.png[/img]

[h1][b]LOVE SPRAY[/b][/h1]
A love spray. You can use 'Love Spray' while playing the game. This item can only be used during the event only.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0211/5.png[/img]

Please follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

Facebook (English): https://www.facebook.com/CSNZ.Official/
VK: http://vk.com/public78659129
Twitter: https://twitter.com/CSN_Z

notes.title: [UPDATE] NEW CLASS! WALTER & CARLITO
notes.content:
We’ve been working hard behind-the-scenes to bring you this awesome update. Now it’s time to welcome our new mercenaries. Please welcome, Walter and Carlito!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0203/1.png[/img]

[h1][b]Walter[/b][/h1]
Walter is a mercenary who belongs to Aegis Institute. He is a former member of the Special Forces. Although not much is known about him, his operation performance is rated as the best.

[h1]
●	You can use [Dance] emotion with this class.
●	5% point and EXP bonus will be applied when using this class.
●	Once you purchase Walter, you will have 1x FREE Costume Box Season 1 as a present! (bonus only from 03.02.2016 to 17.02.2016)
●	Urgent Event: Once you purchase Walter or Carlito, we will give you 1x FREE MILEAGE DECODER as a bonus item![/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0203/2.png[/img]

[h1][b]Carlito[/b][/h1]

Carlito is a mercenary from the Vanguard Troop. He is the best among the veteran members. He lost his right eye during the escape from the collapsing Vanguard Lab due to a zombie plague incident.

[h1]
●	You can use [Dance] emotion with this class.
●	5% point and EXP bonus will be applied when using this class.
●	Once you purchase Carlito, you will have 1x FREE Costume Box Season 1 as a present! (bonus only from 03.02.2016 to 17.02.2016)
●	Urgent Event: Once you purchase Walter or Carlito, we will give you 1x FREE MILEAGE DECODER as a bonus item![/h1]

You can purchase Walter and Carlito from the 3rd of February after the maintenance. Purchase this class and enjoy your battle with this dancing class. (Emotion will activate with the following key combo: J + 5.) 

Please notice that currently there's a slight issue with displaying the emotion menu. We're going to fix that on 17.02.2016 patch. Untill then, as a compensation, you will receive 1x Mileage Decoder when you purchase one of those characters. 
Once again: please use "key combo: J + 5." to activate the dance move.

Please follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

VK: http://vk.com/public78659129 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/CSN_Z

notes.title: [UPDATE] Upgrade to Dual Katana and Crossbow Advance!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2016/0127.jpg[/img]
Surviving in a land infested by zombies is not about finding a good hiding spot, staying there for as long as possible, and limiting food consumption. At some point Survivors have to become hunters and all they need to stay alive is a good hunting weapon.

There has been no better occasion to become a permanent owner of a serious Hunter’s set than now. Perfect for close combat, the Katana can now be upgraded to the dual blades version. You can also improve the Crossbow to become even more of a lethal ranged weapon.

[h1][b]WEAPON UPGRADE EVENT![/b][/h1]
Starting from 27th of January until 11th of February, you are able to upgrade those 2 weapons to more powerful versions. As a result of a successful upgrade, you will receive a completely new and improved Permanent weapon.
Note: your previous weapon will still be available in your inventory unchanged.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0127/1.png[/img]

[b]How to upgrade these weapons?[/b] Acquire a default Katana or Crossbow and enter a room with at least 4 players. Collect 2016 kill points for Katana and 2016 for Crossbow and your weapon will become upgraded. You can check your progress of upgrading in the in-game chat notifications.

The kill points are counted as follows:
[list]
[*]1 Bot Kill = 1 Kill Point
[*]1 Human Player Kill = 5 Kill Points
[*]1 Zombie Player Kill = 15 Kill Points
[/list]

[h1][b]Dual Katana[/b][/h1]
Wield two sharp Katanas and strike down anyone who stands in your way. The two-handed slash, a special attack skill, can deal lethal damage on a single opponent.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0127/2.png[/img]

[i]*Katana can be acquired by using a Perfect Pick Recipe set, which will guarantee successfully crafting a Katana or with enough crafting materials and a bit of luck.[/i]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0127/3.png[/img]


[h1][b]Crossbow Advance[/b][/h1]
A crossbow that uses 50-foot bolts features a fast rate of fire, high accuracy, and the advantage of a quiet firing sound. The flight speed of the bolt has a time difference after shooting, which is slower than bullets. The upgraded Crossbow boasts an improved structure and more enhanced performance.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0127/4.png[/img]

[i]*The crossbow can be acquired randomly only by opening Mileage Decoders. From 27.01.2016 to 11.02.2016, the probability to receive a crossbow from the Mileage Decoder is doubled![/i]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0127/5.png[/img]


The weapon upgrade event has officially started! Happy hunting, Survivors!


Please follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

Facebook (English): https://www.facebook.com/CSNZ.Official/
VK: http://vk.com/public78659129
Twitter: https://twitter.com/CSN_Z

notes.title: [UPDATE] New item released! - Camera Gun
notes.content:
[b]MILEAGE DECODER: Camera Gun[/b]
Some of you may have already heard, but we want everyone to be in on this special treat. A new item has been released! You can obtain this item from the Mileage Decoder.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2016/lightning_hmg.png[/img]

This machine gun built by a gunsmith was inspired by an ordinary camera… but it is anything but ordinary! It is chambered with 150 rounds of 5.56mm NATO and has high attack power. With this MG, you will have high accuracy, a high rate of fire, medium magazine size, and short reload time for a machine gun.

Enjoy!
CSNZ Team

notes.title: [UPDATE] New Medals and Weapons upgrade event!
notes.content:
X-Mas is finally over and New Year’s Day finished too. There were many things that we enjoyed during past holidays but now people don’t know what will come next. However, CSN:Z team has prepared something that you are able to enjoy in the land of Zombies.

[b]WEAPON UPGRADE EVENT![/b]
Starting from 13th January until 27th January, you are able to upgrade your weapon upon your calculated kill points through every matches that you play with more than 4 players in the same room.

After successful upgrade, as a result you will receive a completely new improved permanent weapon. On top of that your previous default weapon model will still be available in your inventory unchanged.

Please see below table for detail information about the weapon and sales method.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0113/2.png[/img]

For example, you buy Spas-12 Perfect Recipe and then upgrade the weapon to Spas Deluxe and then upgrade it to Spas-12 Superior. So in other words the basic weapon you get from Recipes/crafting but upgrading it is event.

[b]NEW MEDAL ITEMS[/b]
Medal is always showing courage, honor, valor and braveness. A true warrior needs to get at least one of those in the below medal list. Check this out and see how you can get one of those in the list. Total 19 new medals are waiting for your selection.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2016/0113/medal_list.jpg[/img]


Stop by CSN:Z daily to check newly updated medals and weapons with your friends!

Please follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.title: [UPDATE] Red Weapon Series Collection
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/1222/en.jpg[/img]
Do you remember the very rare red versions of classic Counter-Strike weapons? We have not forgotten about them and they are back now! All of them are available as permanent weapons only on Xmas gift promotions!

They are red-colored limited production versions of default weapons. Aside from their very seductive looks, some of them have their damage increased compared to the original counterparts.

[b]Starting from 22nd December and only until 6th January[/b], during the exclusive Xmas event, you can acquire them permanently for your arsenal.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1222/1.png[/img]

[h1][b]How to become owner of these fine weapons[/b][/h1]
It’s simple: every time you use 30x Mileage Decoders, as a special Xmas bonus you will be given an option to choose one of the unique red weapons. You can repeat that as many times as you want, to earn whole red weapons series set. It doesn’t matter if you bought Mileage Decoders, had them for free from events, or you kept them stocked from previous giveaways – each use counts towards receiving the rewards! 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1222/2.png[/img]

Don’t miss out on this event and the chance to collect all of those red weapons: Desert Eagle, Glock 18, USP 45, XM1014, M4A1, AK47, Scout, AWP, and M249. 

[h1]Don't also forget that you only have until 6th January to obtain the M4A1 Dark Knight and AK-47 Paladin by collecting ‘Transcendence Pieces’.[/h1]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2fpccdHcFNA
The Transcendence Pieces can be obtained through Mileage Decoders. Whenever you open a Mileage Decoder, you have a chance of receiving a random amount of pieces of transcendence.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/w1.png[/img]

Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z! 

Facebook (English): https://www.facebook.com/CSNZ.Official/ 
VK: http://vk.com/public78659129 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/CSN_Z

notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/1218/en.jpg[/img]
The Nightmare is almost over and that means you can get ready to celebrate the upcoming Xmas period. 

The zombies surely won’t become any nicer to survivors, but the CSN:Z team has prepared something to add a bit of the winter holidays atmosphere to the land of the undead.

[h1][b]FREE CHRISTMAS WEAPONS DAILY[/b][/h1]
[b]Starting from 18th December until 6th January[/b], log in every day to CSN:Z to receive one of the unique Christmas weapons gifts.

Each of the weapons will be given out randomly from a list presented below and for a period of 14 days.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1218/X2.png[/img]

A lever action shotgun that fires 8 rounds of 12 gauge ammo. Flip-cocking allows for quickly terminating hostile targets. A special decoration is added to celebrate Christmas.

[h1][b]MG36 Christmas edition[/b][/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1218/X3.png[/img]

[h1][b]M95 Christmas edition[/b][/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1218/X4.png[/img]

A bullpup single-shot sniper rifle firing 5 rounds of 50 cal. Its design combines the power of 50 cal rounds and sniping accuracy. A special decoration has been added to celebrate Christmas.

[h1][b]M134 Christmas edition[/b][/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1218/X5.png[/img]

This minigun, which fires 200 rounds of 7.62mm, may be limited in power but its incredible rate of fire is enough to overcome this weakness. A special decoration has been added to celebrate Christmas.

[h1][b]MG3 Christmas edition[/b][/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1218/X6.png[/img]

Its superior firepower and high ammo capacity makes it the core of a strong offensive but slow speed and low accuracy are its weaknesses. A special decoration has been added to celebrate Christmas.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1218/X7.png[/img]

Tis the season for the Tomahawk with twinkling lights brightening up this weapon on the darkest of nights, and Rudolph antlers to subdue the enemy, Xmas style. The winter is warmer now!

Can be pushed through oncoming zombie hoards in Zombie and Zombie Scenario modes.

Stop by CSN:Z daily to celebrate the season with irresponsibly decorated high caliber firearms!

notes.title: [UPDATE] Annihilated: Addiction #2
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/1214_nightmare/en_15.jpg[/img]
You wake up from the horrible nightmare. Those fears from your past… were so real… fortunately, it was just a bad dream. Wasn’t it? You now feel even more tired and have a terrible headache... Like somebody poisoned you... You’re about to pass out, but you hope you won’t dream about anything…

From 14th to 18th of December, each day CSN:Z will bring a new location in which you will have to fight once again the enemies you have previously defeated. 

[h1]Welcome to Night 2 of the “Enter the Nightmare” expansion.[/h1]

Annihilated: Addiction is the second nightmare challenge. You will visit the chemical power plant were you will have to fight with Zombie Scenario #2 bosses.

[b]Round 1: Juggernaut[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/15-1.png[/img]

[b]Round 2: Siege Type Deimos[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/15-2.png[/img]

[b]Round 3: Dione[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/15-3.png[/img]
				
[b]Round 4: Revenant[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/15-4.png[/img]

[b]Round 5: Angra[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/15-5.png[/img]

Your target is to eliminate the Boss Zombies that appears in each round. If you succeed to destroy the last enemy, every player will obtain 2 random rewards from Zombie Scenario: Season 2.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/15-6.png[/img]

Players must evacuate towards the power plant entrance after defeating Angra.

To enter the 'Annihilation: Addiction’ map, a room host needs to acquire an [b]Addiction Key.[/b]

A key from which the energies of powerful zombies can be felt. It feels as if you'll experience a long nightmare tonight if you hold this key. 

The key can be dropped after Zombie Scenario mode is cleared. Its duration is 1 day only.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/15-7.png[/img]

The room host must have the key, so to open 1 room you will need 1 key. Players other than the host do not need a key to join the room.

If you already have a key, you can acquire more, but the number of keys does not increase – its duration will increase.

From 15th of December CSN:Z introduces premium tattoos in the Item Shop.

Those tattoos, aside from being cosmetic items, have additional effects in-game giving players Experience and Game Points bonus.


[h1][b]Tiger Tattoo[/b][/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/15-8.png[/img]

A tattoo in the shape of a tiger. Equip it in your Inventory and a tiger tattoo will be seen on your hands as viewed from a 1st person perspective.

When the Tiger Tattoo is equipped, you will receive an additional 5% EXP and Points.

[h1][b]Dragon Tattoo[/b][/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/15-9.png[/img]

A tattoo in the shape of a dragon. Equip it in your Inventory and a dragon tattoo will be seen on your hands as viewed from a 1st person perspective.

When the Dragon Tattoo is equipped, you will receive an additional 5% EXP and Points. 

Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z! 

Facebook (English): https://www.facebook.com/CSNZ.Official/ 
VK: http://vk.com/public78659129 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/CSN_Z

notes.title: [UPDATE] M4A1 Dark Knight and AK-47 Paladin!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/1214_nightmare/en_weapon.jpg[/img]

They are here! The “Enter the Nightmare” expansion brings 2 of the most awaited weapons. 

[h1][b]Starting from 14th December, only until 6th January, you can obtain the M4A1 Dark Knight and AK-47 Paladin by collecting ‘Transcendence Pieces’.[/b][/h1]

https://youtu.be/2fpccdHcFNA

The Transcendence Pieces can be obtained through Mileage Decoders. Whenever you open a Mileage Decoder, you have a chance of receiving a random amount of pieces of transcendence.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/w1.png[/img]

Until 6th January, every day you log in, you will receive 5 Transcendence Pieces for free. On top of that, for every 30 minutes spent playing the game, you will receive an additional piece, up to 4 times a day.

Once you have collected 888 of those pieces you can exchange them for either the M4A1 Dark Knight or AK-47 Paladin. You can start the exchange for the weapon by pressing the 'Use' button.

Each of those special weapons come with a unique buff effects whenever you have them in your inventory. 

[b]If you have the following weapons in your inventory, the effects mentioned below will be applied.[/b]


[h1][b]M4A1 Dark Night[/b][/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/w2.png[/img]

An assault rifle that uses 50 rounds of .50 caliber special ammo. It can apply high knockback against zombies, and increase penetration with its 2nd mode to eliminate multiple enemies. If you have the following weapon in your inventory the effects mentioned below will be applied:
[h1]
•	Increases the duration of Deadly Shot in Zombie Hero by 1 second.
•	Firepower is increased 5 levels at the start of the round for all players in Zombie Scenario mode (max level does not increase).
•	+200% EXP to the owner.
•	+50% EXP to the other players in the room. 
[/h1]


[h1][b]AK-47 Paladin[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/w3.png[/img]

An assault rifle that uses 50 rounds of 50 caliber special rounds. It can apply high push-back against zombies, and fire in powerful semi-automatic 2nd mode. If you have the following weapon in your inventory the effects mentioned below will be applied:
[h1]
•	Start Zombie Hero mode with +20% morale
•	Automatic health upgrade by 5 levels in all Zombie Scenario rooms (max level does not increase).
•	+200% EXP to the owner.
•	+50% EXP to the other players in the room.
[/h1]

•	The buff mark will be indicated for rooms where you can receive it. 
•	The same buffs cannot be stacked, so your bonus game EXP can be 200% max, not more, even if you possess both the M4A1 Dark Knight and AK-47 Paladin. 
•	The EXP buff effect can be checked from the game result screen ‘Team/Family Bonus’. 


[h1]Special Skills of the M4A1 Dark Knight and AK-47 Paladin[/h1]
The M4A1 Dark Knight and AK-47 Paladin have unlimited Spare magazines in Zombie Scenario Modes.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/w4.jpg[/img]

If you successfully hit your target with the M4A1 Dark knight or AK-47 Paladin, you will see a notification on the crosshair.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/w5.jpg[/img]

Pieces can only be obtained during the event period, and upon the end of the event, the remaining pieces will be automatically exchanged for items depending on the amount of pieces left:

[b]Pieces 1-100[/b] = Extension Coupon x35 + (Blueprint [S] + 72 Day-Permanent Durable) x1
[b]Pieces 101-200[/b] = Extension Coupon x130 + (Blueprint [S] + 72 Day-Permanent Durable) x1
[b]Pieces 201-300[/b] = Extension Coupon x200 + (Blueprint [S] + 72 Day-Permanent Durable) x3
[b]Pieces 301-400[/b] = Extension Coupon x 300 + (Blueprint [S] + 72 Day-Permanent Durable) x3
[b]Pieces 401-500[/b] = Extension Coupon x 350 + (Blueprint [S] + 72 Day-Permanent Durable) x5
[b]Pieces 501-600[/b] = Extension Coupon x 450 + (Blueprint [S] + 72 Day-Permanent Durable) x5
[b]Pieces 601-700[/b] = Extension Coupon x 550 + (Blueprint [S] + 72 Day-Permanent Durable) x7
[b]Pieces 701-800[/b] = Extension Coupon x 650 + (Blueprint [S] + 72 Day-Permanent Durable) x7
[b]More than 801 pieces[/b] = Extension Coupon x 700 + (Blueprint [S] + 72 Day-Permanent Durable) x10 + 1x Perfect Enhancement material. 

Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

[h1][b]Starting from 14th December, only until 6th January, you can obtain the M4A1 Dark Knight and AK-47 Paladin by collecting ‘Transcendence Pieces’.[/b][/h1]

https://youtu.be/2fpccdHcFNA

The Transcendence Pieces can be obtained through Mileage Decoders. Whenever you open a Mileage Decoder, you have a chance of receiving a random amount of pieces of transcendence.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/w1.png[/img]

Until 6th January, every day you log in, you will receive 5 Transcendence Pieces for free. On top of that, for every 30 minutes spent playing the game, you will receive an additional piece, up to 4 times a day.

Once you have collected 888 of those pieces you can exchange them for either the M4A1 Dark Knight or AK-47 Paladin. You can start the exchange for the weapon by pressing the 'Use' button.

Each of those special weapons come with a unique buff effects whenever you have them in your inventory. 

[b]If you have the following weapons in your inventory, the effects mentioned below will be applied.[/b]


[h1][b]M4A1 Dark Night[/b][/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/w2.png[/img]

An assault rifle that uses 50 rounds of .50 caliber special ammo. It can apply high knockback against zombies, and increase penetration with its 2nd mode to eliminate multiple enemies. If you have the following weapon in your inventory the effects mentioned below will be applied:
[h1]
•	Increases the duration of Deadly Shot in Zombie Hero by 1 second.
•	Firepower is increased 5 levels at the start of the round for all players in Zombie Scenario mode (max level does not increase).
•	+200% EXP to the owner.
•	+50% EXP to the other players in the room. 
[/h1]


[h1][b]AK-47 Paladin[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/w3.png[/img]

An assault rifle that uses 50 rounds of 50 caliber special rounds. It can apply high push-back against zombies, and fire in powerful semi-automatic 2nd mode. If you have the following weapon in your inventory the effects mentioned below will be applied:
[h1]
•	Start Zombie Hero mode with +20% morale
•	Automatic health upgrade by 5 levels in all Zombie Scenario rooms (max level does not increase).
•	+200% EXP to the owner.
•	+50% EXP to the other players in the room.
[/h1]

•	The buff mark will be indicated for rooms where you can receive it. 
•	The same buffs cannot be stacked, so your bonus game EXP can be 200% max, not more, even if you possess both the M4A1 Dark Knight and AK-47 Paladin. 
•	The EXP buff effect can be checked from the game result screen ‘Team/Family Bonus’. 


[h1]Special Skills of the M4A1 Dark Knight and AK-47 Paladin[/h1]
The M4A1 Dark Knight and AK-47 Paladin have unlimited Spare magazines in Zombie Scenario Modes.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/w4.jpg[/img]

If you successfully hit your target with the M4A1 Dark knight or AK-47 Paladin, you will see a notification on the crosshair.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/w5.jpg[/img]

Pieces can only be obtained during the event period, and upon the end of the event, the remaining pieces will be automatically exchanged for items depending on the amount of pieces left:

[b]Pieces 1-100[/b] = Extension Coupon x35 + (Blueprint [S] + 72 Day-Permanent Durable) x1
[b]Pieces 101-200[/b] = Extension Coupon x130 + (Blueprint [S] + 72 Day-Permanent Durable) x1
[b]Pieces 201-300[/b] = Extension Coupon x200 + (Blueprint [S] + 72 Day-Permanent Durable) x3
[b]Pieces 301-400[/b] = Extension Coupon x 300 + (Blueprint [S] + 72 Day-Permanent Durable) x3
[b]Pieces 401-500[/b] = Extension Coupon x 350 + (Blueprint [S] + 72 Day-Permanent Durable) x5
[b]Pieces 501-600[/b] = Extension Coupon x 450 + (Blueprint [S] + 72 Day-Permanent Durable) x5
[b]Pieces 601-700[/b] = Extension Coupon x 550 + (Blueprint [S] + 72 Day-Permanent Durable) x7
[b]Pieces 701-800[/b] = Extension Coupon x 650 + (Blueprint [S] + 72 Day-Permanent Durable) x7
[b]More than 801 pieces[/b] = Extension Coupon x 700 + (Blueprint [S] + 72 Day-Permanent Durable) x10 + 1x Perfect Enhancement material.

notes.title: [UPDATE] Annihilated: Nightmare #1
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/over_1.jpg[/img]

You fought bravely, defeating all the threats on your way to revel secrets of Zombie Scenarios. A hero like you deserves a proper rest, a good sleep to heal the wounds. You manage to fall asleep, but in the land of the undead dreams become your worst nightmares.

[b]From 14th to 18th of December[/b], each day CSN:Z will bring a new location in which you will have to fight once again the enemies you have previously defeated. 

[h1][b]Welcome to Night 1 of the “Enter the Nightmare” expansion.[/b][/h1]

Annihilated: A nightmare challenge awaits in the Lost City for those who dare to face Zombie Scenario #1 bosses.

Your target is to eliminate the Boss Zombies that appear in each round. If you succeed to destroy the last enemy, every player will obtain 2 random rewards from Zombie Scenario: Season 1.


[b]Round 1: Juggernaut[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/14-1.png[/img]

[b]Round 2: Siege Type Deimos[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/14-2.png[/img]

[b]Round 3: Phobos[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/14-3.png[/img]
				
[b]Round 4: Siege Type Phobos[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/14-4.png[/img]

[b]Round 5: Oberon[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/14-5.png[/img]	


[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/14-6.png[/img]

To enter the 'Annihilation: Nightmare' map, a room host needs to acquire a [b]Nightmare Key[/b].

A key from which the energies of powerful zombies can be felt. It feels as if you'll experience a long nightmare tonight if you hold this key. 

The key can be dropped after Zombie Scenario mode is cleared. Its duration is 1 day only.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1214_nightmare/14-7.png[/img]

The room host must have the key, so to open 1 room you will need 1 key. Players other than the host do not need a key to join the room.

If you already have a key, you can acquire more, but the number of keys does not increase – its duration will increase. 

Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.title: [NEW] Weapon paints + Extra Mileage Decoders
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/1209/en.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Customize your weapons with paint![/b][/h1]
Isn't it boring to see the same weapons over and over again? With new paint blueprints available in the CSN:Z Shop starting on 09.12.2015, you can transform the 4 most well-known default weapons into an unique new model.

If you’re a fan of Counter-Strike’s original weapons or you just prefer classic gameplay modes, you will definitely enjoy the new weapon customization feature. 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1209/1.png[/img]

[h1][b]How to Paint[/b][/h1]
There are only few simple steps you need to follow in order to turn your old weapon into a new colorful model.

Buy one of the paint blueprints available in the Shop:

[b]Red Lightning Paint[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1209/2.png[/img]
[b]Blue Lightning Paint[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1209/3.png[/img]	
[b]Erica Paint[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1209/4.png[/img]
[b]Hawk Paint[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1209/5.png[/img]

Next: Navigate to the Crafting menu, then select the “Weapon Paint” tab. 

Choose one of the default weapons and the paint blueprint you want the Master Gunsmith to use for you. 
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1209/6.jpg[/img]

You never have to worry about the outcome because weapon painting cannot fail.

You can change it to different styles of paint, or if you want, the weapon can be reverted to its original state by removing the paint job with the Reset Blueprint. 
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1209/7.jpg[/img]

Please remember that paint won't affect the gun's performance, it is a purely cosmetic feature. 
Enjoy the new weapon customization system and expect some more paint blueprints to become available in the Shop.


For those who care more about weapons’ stats and battlefield performance, we have prepared yet another Mileage Decoder extended promotion.

[b]Starting from 10.12.2015 through 21.12.2015[/b], all Mileage Decoder bundles will come with extra units.

Check below to see how many additional Mileage Decoders you will receive as a bonus:

[h1]10x Mileage Decoders + 3x Bonus Mileage Decoders[/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1209/8.png[/img]

[h1]30x Mileage Decoders + 10x Bonus Mileage Decoders[/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1209/9.png[/img]

[h1]100x Mileage Decoders + 30x Bonus Mileage Decoders[/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1209/10.png[/img]

Make sure not to miss out the last Decoder sale of the year! 

Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.title: [NEW] Season 5, Map 3: Another Side of Truth
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/menu6_over.png[/img]

[b]Zombie Scenario Season 5 - Pursue: Revenge[/b]
It’s the Day 6 of Tales of the Undead and the last part of our story is revealed. More mysteries, more weapons and more promotions are awaiting!

[h1]“The person responsible... I'll never forgive it!"[/h1] – Jennifer

[b]Storyline[/b]: Jennifer, who was grieving over the death of Jack, hears a voice through the radio. In order to find out the truth behind Jack’s mysterious last words, she sets out to find the owner of the voice she heard on the radio… Just who is it on the other side of the radio? Why did it send Jack to her? And what is this another truth it speaks of?

•	Be careful of the fast currents. It can get you into dire danger if engulfed in it. 
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/30-1.jpg[/img]

•	In order to safely track the owner of the voice, take advantage the the safe zones.
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/30-2.jpg[/img]

•	Hordes of zombies summoned along with the fast water currents make it even more dangerous. 
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/30-3.jpg[/img]

•	Be careful of high falls, since it will deal significant amount of damage. 
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/30-4.jpg[/img]

[h1]“So you were here... muahaha. Things won't go according to your plan.”[/h1] – Cronobotics
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/30-5.png[/img]

You have to face a new enemy. Heavily armoured semi-robotic monster, inflicting damage with minigun and missiles launcher, that are attached to his hands.

Join the final chapter of Tales of the Undead in Zombie Scenario 5, find out the identity of the unknown force and the truth behind Jack's change.


Together with final map to Season 5 of Zombie Scenario, there are 3 new weapons that can be found in Mileage Decoder.


[h1][b]Eruptor[/b][/h1]
A single-shot prototype cannon type musket that blows an area away in one concentrated blast. It’s Effective in close range, especially against multiple targets.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/30-6.png[/img]

[h1][b]Hécate II[/b][/h1]
An anti-material sniper rifle which uses 7 rounds of .50 caliber bullets. The highly efficient muzzle break decreases recoil drastically after each shot.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/30-7.png[/img]

[h1][b]M1911 A1[/b][/h1]
An M1911A1 fires 8 rounds of .45 ACP and is one of the most famous American pistols. This sidearm proved its worth in World War II and is still in use to date.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/30-8.png[/img]


[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/30-9.png[/img]

[b]Supreme Decoder fans should also be aware of the fact that from 1st of December through 4th of December, Reaper will be available with double the probability![/b]
