Jennifer, who realized that there was yet another force at play, set out to find the force that may potentially be a threat. While she was on her way to the suspicious lab, Jennifer came into contact with a familiar zombie, and recovers her lost… no, her unwanted memories.

Now it is time to join the second mysterious installment of Zombie Scenario 5. Jennifer sets out on a mission to find the killer of her informant, Laser Wing. While exploring a suspicious laboratory she will encounter a familiar zombie, and begin to uncover memories she thought were long buried. 
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/29-2.jpg[/img]

In order to obtain more info, you must install a radar satellite receiver.
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/29-3.png[/img]

[b]A monster that knows Jennifer appears:[/b]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/29-4.png[/img]

You must cope with lots of obstacles leveraging many gears.
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/29-5.jpg[/img]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/29-6.jpg[/img]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/29-7.jpg[/img]

[b]Reveal the identity of Jack in ‘Revenge’![/b]

Having introduced a huge range of new modes revamped and Zombie Scenario Season 5 this week, we have introduced a variety of weapons and have decided to ratchet up the action with a fresh range of weapons.

Two new weapons, Fire Vulcan and P90 Lapin, are now set into the mileage decoder to show off both their appearance and power, as well as a long list of variants that are more enjoyable for all users.

[h1][b]Fire Vulcan[/b][/h1]
Compared to any other shotgun, Fire Vulcan has a very high magazine size, high rate of fire and low recoil. And for a shotgun, it can be used at a far range. This fire vulcan spews out 40 rounds of 12 gauge ammo at an extreme rate of fire that exceeds the limits of normal shotguns. In addition, it has a long barrel that gives it superior accuracy.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/29-8.png[/img]

[h1][b]P90 LAPIN[/b][/h1]
P90 Lapin holds 50 5.7mm rounds for each magazine. It holds 20 more bullets than other submachine gun which reduces the risk of reloading bullets in the middle of a heated battle. It also has 1% higher accuracy and lower recoil. The gun comes in pink and is decorated with rabbit-themed accessories to celebrate the year of the rabbit. How lovely!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/29-9.png[/img]


[h1]From 29.11 until 06.12, the probability to receive those weapons from a Decoder are doubled![/h1]

notes.title: [NEW] Sudden Death
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/menu4_over.png[/img]

[h1]New Fun mode: Sudden Death[/h1]
Half the journey is getting there! And another new game type is dropped today; Sudden Death, an intense, fast paced elimination mode – with a twist. One gun will spawn in the center of the map, meaning players will need lightning-fast reactions to outsmart the opposition, grab the weapon and be the last man standing.

[b]Objective[/b]
The objective of Sudden Death is to be the last one standing, after eliminating all others. 
The game will be divided into 8 maps/rounds. 

Upon the start of each round, a pistol will be spawned in the center of the map. 
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/28-2.jpg[/img]

Sometimes, it’s not the best option to go for the pistol right away. You might become the target. Spawned weapons are only one clip loaded, use your weapon wisely.
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/28-3.jpg[/img]

Bonus points will be acquired after defeating everyone else and be the last one standing. You’ll be moved to the next room upon failing to survive in the current room.
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/28-4.jpg[/img]

Check the icon next to the timer to see how many people remain in the current map. 
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/28-5.jpg[/img]

If the outcome is not reached in the room within 1 minute, then the pre-installed C4 will explode, killing everyone in the room. 

One point is achieved whenever a player kills another. In addition, the last player will be given bonus points for his/her survival. Use tactics and your wits in order to survive to the end in these fast-paced battles!

[b]New mode is waiting for survivors to join and new pieces of weapons are given to them to trace back all enjoyable contents in CSN:Z[/b]

[h1][b]Lightning Rail[/b][/h1]
Lightning Rail shots a strong bullet by electrically-accelerated energy and is optimized weapon for Zombie scenario especially for obstacles and bosses. Compared to Thunderbolt? You can evaluate it now! 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/28-6.png[/img]

[h1][b]UMP45 Snake[/b][/h1]
As you can guess it from the name, UMP45 Snake is decorated version of UMP45. UMP45 Snake shares the same attribute with original UMP45 but it contains special sounds and animations. This version features a white tiger design to celebrate the year of the snake
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/28-7.png[/img]

[h1]From 28.11 until 5.12, the probability to receive those weapons from a Decoder are doubled![/h1]

notes.title: [NEW] Zombie Hide and Seek & Black Friday sales!
notes.content:
[h1][b][NEW] Zombie Hide and Seek & Black Friday sales![/b][/h1]

[b]Zombie says: „Hide!”[/b]

We’re into day 3 of Tales of the Undead and zombies even though they are dead are having a lot of fun. Together with new game mode you will notice comeback of 6 characters from Mileage Decoders. We’re also celebrating Black Friday with big sales – don’t miss out!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/27-1.png[/img]

[h1][b]Black Friday -40% discount coupons and DLC is now on sales[/b][/h1]

If you waited to see the biggest sales this year in CSN:Z, this is that moment. On 27th of November we’re giving out 27 Discount Coupons that will reduce by 40% prices on any item or bundle of items. Be aware however that this sale is just 3 days long, so make the best of it before Discount Coupons expire.

[b]What is Zombie Hide and Seek?[/b]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/27-2.jpg[/img]

Zombie Hide and Seek is a new mode for up to 20 players, which zombies and humans, can enjoy together. 

The human faction needs to find out the real zombie amongst the fakes ones and the zombies must make their way to escape zone by tricking the human players. 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/27-3.jpg[/img]
   
[b]Humans[/b]: Starts with 200 HP, and when killing a fake zombie, 100 HP is subtracted.
There will not be any change in HP upon killing a real zombie.  

[b]Zombies[/b]: Zombie will die after 3 attacks from humans. 
Zombies are able to move faster by pressing shift, however it will consume HP. Additionally they can use Smokescreen and Poke skills. 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/27-4.jpg[/img]

An unfortunate light zombie who jumped instead of taking a ballet pose
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/27-5.jpg[/img]

[b]How to play Zombie Hide and Seek[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/27-6.png[/img]
Select FUN mode, then select either [b]Greesia[/b] or [b]OutCity[/b]

[b]Fever Time[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/27-7.jpg[/img]
When the game starts, Fever Time is triggered at random intervals.
Make sure to copy the action that is given.

[b]Action System[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/27-8.jpg[/img]
- The Fever Time action is automatically chosen upon the start of the game. 
- Pretend to be a fake zombie with various actions with numbered keys 1-4.

[b]Action keyboard shortcut[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/27-9.jpg[/img]
- A shortcut is supported so that the real zombies can act like a fake zombie. An appropriate action needs to be taken when the Fever Time strikes. 

[b]Escape Zone[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/27-10.jpg[/img]
Zombie team wins if they reach the escape zone within the time limit or survive until all players in the human team are dead. Zombie team consists of bot zombies, to cause confusion among humans.

[b]Special Zombie[/b]

When playing Zombie Hide and Seek, The Lusty Rose can be selected at random! Lusty Rose does not consume HP while sprinting, and it is faster than light zombie. 

[b]More characters available for hire![/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/27-11.png[/img]
Ling Ling, Isabella, Alin, Gerrard, David Black, Dominique are back again. Check their descriptions to see what bonuses you can get when using some of those characters.

notes.title: [NEW] Premium Weapons, Game Point Weapons
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/1125/en.jpg[/img]

[b]The new, the changed, and the removed[/b]
The latest expansion changes a lot in gameplay content as well as to events and items. Check the details below to see what you should expect. 

[h1][b]TMP Dragon[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/w1.png[/img]

This sub-machine gun fires 30 rounds of 9mm ammo is useful for fast and quiet attacks with its equipped suppressor. However, its 9mm rounds may not damage armored opponents well. It's been decorated with a dragon theme in honour of the year of the dragon.

[h1][b]MP7A1 Unicorn[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/w2.png[/img]

MP7A1 Unicorn is a submachine gun that uses 20 rounds of 4.6mm. It has a very fast fire rate and is decorated with a horse design.

[b]From 25.11 until 2.12, the probability to receive those weapons from a Decoder are doubled![/b]


[b]Zombie Shelter Survival Weapons available for Game Points![/b]

[h1][b]Machete[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/w3.png[/img]

A knife used to carve a path in the jungle. You can use it for logging wood. It is thick and boasts a durable, strong power.

[h1][b]Crowbar[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/w4.png[/img]

A tool used to pull nails. Surprisingly, its hardness makes it a powerful weapon.

[h1][b]Claw Hammer[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/w5.png[/img]

Hammer is used for construction but isn't too shabby for combat.

All these weapons can be used outside of Zombie Shelter mode. You can also repurchase them as many times as you want, even making them permanent after reaching 999+ days of duration.

[h1][b]New events:[/b][/h1]
All daily missions will now grant Blueprints or Daily Random Rewards, depending on what a player chooses. 
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/w6.png[/img]
On top of Blueprints players will be able to receive daily Mileage Decoders, as a reward for their playtime.

If you reach one 1 hour of playing time you will receive 1 Free Mileage Decoder. Another Decoder will be given for 2nd hour and 3rd one for 3rd hour. To receive your reward you must be playing in a room of at least 4 players.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/w7.png[/img]

Decoder itself has also some further changes. We have removed all characters from it, as they were very hard to get and we plan to move them into Item Shop, so they can be used by more players.

Those characters are: Ling Ling, Isabella, Alin, Gerrard, David Black, Dominique.

Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z! 

Facebook (English): https://www.facebook.com/CSNZ.Official/
VK: http://vk.com/public78659129 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/CSN_Z

notes.title: [NEW] Tales of the Undead expansion released!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/menu1_over.png[/img]

[h1]Rebuilding: Fun modes, Zombie Giant, Gun Deathmatch, and Zombie Scenario #1[/h1]

Today, the first chapter of the [b]Tales of the Undead[/b] is revealed. There are many new plots awaiting survivors and each day will bring a story of its own. Read through to understand how the land of zombies is evolving.

[b]Fun modes renewal[/b]
Killing zombies can be enjoyable at times, but there’s a special place in CSN:Z filled with pure entertainment: the Fun modes.
		
[h1][b]Hidden[/b][/h1][img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/1-1.png[/img]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/1-2.png[/img]

In the renewed mode, humans must survive against the invisible enemy, “Hidden” and a new enemy “Traitor”. The Traitor will be chosen randomly and will be disguised as a human.

There can only be 1 Traitor at a time, but they can appear more frequently with an increasing number of players in a match.
Hidden and Traitor players can tell each other apart from all the humans, but humans cannot differentiate Traitors from other humans. Trick them into thinking that you’re one of them, and backstab them when they least expect it.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/1-3.jpg[/img]

Fortunately for humans, their odds of survival can be increased with supply crates that are randomly spawned in the map. Resupply your ammo through these crates, and receive buffs that will aid you in your battle against the Hidden. The buff will increase your movement speed, health, or attack. It can even reveal the Hidden on your radar.

The ever-strong Hidden and the Traitors are watching your every movement from somewhere in the Hidden City!
	
[h1][b]Item battle[/b]	[/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/1-4.png[/img]

The renewed Item Battle mainly consists of Team Deathmatch type of games, and the outcome of the battle will depend on how well each team uses the items that appear in the map.

Each item box has a unique appearance, so players can choose the items to their needs. And the list of items players have can be sorted. 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/1-5.jpg[/img]

While the player possesses 2 items, the items can be used in fast combination by pressing the E key twice in succession.

It is also easier to strategize what to use against your opponents, as you can see icons of the currently equipped items of other players.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/1-6.jpg[/img]

There are plenty of deadly skills to use, and some of the most powerful weapons that can be acquired only after breaking a barrier surrounding it.
	
[h1][b]Zombie Giant[/b][/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/1-7.png[/img]
[b]Angra[/b], which appears in the Zombie Scenario as a boss, is now available as a new zombie boss.

Angra is a powerful zombie which can dominate from the sky above. It can release toxic gas onto the battlefield, and expanding the area of it by blowing strong winds with its wings after the initial gas release. 

It can also remove the weapons of its enemies with shockwaves and then attack defenceless foes with deadly tentacles.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/1-8.jpg[/img]

[b]RAH-66 Comanche[/b] is a new playable character for the Human team which can be controlled through third-person view in Zombie Giant mode. 

When the humans’ supply gauge is at its max, players will enter into either a standard TX300 or the new Comanche at random by pressing ‘E’. 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/1-9.png[/img]
		
[h1][b]Gun Deathmatch[/b][/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/1-10.png[/img]
Gun Deathmatch extends its map list with new ‘Parking Lot’ and ‘Bunny Yard’.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1125_undead/1-11.png[/img]

Furthermore, players will be able to experience Gun Deathmatch with rare high-end weapons instead of just the more classic ones.

[h1][b]Zombie Scenario #1[/b][/h1]
We have modified Zombie Scenario Season 1, so that new players can complete the maps faster. Now it should take only 1/4th of time previously needed. 

This has been done with lowering the number of rounds for each of starting maps down to 5. We reduced freeze time, and the animation of opening doors is quicker!

We only increased requirements for medals from 100 to 400 playthroughs. But don’t worry if you had your medal already, you won’t lose it.

Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z! 

Facebook (English): https://www.facebook.com/CSNZ.Official/
VK: http://vk.com/public78659129 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/CSN_Z

tags.feature: In the renewed mode, humans must survive against the invisible enemy, “Hidden” and a new enemy “Traitor”.
There can only be 1 Traitor at a time, but they can appear more frequently with an increasing number of players in a match.
Fortunately for humans, their odds of survival can be increased with supply crates that are randomly spawned in the map.
Resupply your ammo through these crates, and receive buffs that will aid you in your battle against the Hidden.
The buff will increase your movement speed, health, or attack.
The renewed Item Battle mainly consists of Team Deathmatch type of games, and the outcome of the battle will depend on how well each team uses the items that appear in the map.
Each item box has a unique appearance, so players can choose the items to their needs.
And the list of items players have can be sorted.
While the player possesses 2 items, the items can be used in fast combination by pressing the E key twice in succession.
It is also easier to strategize what to use against your opponents, as you can see icons of the currently equipped items of other players.
There are plenty of deadly skills to use, and some of the most powerful weapons that can be acquired only after breaking a barrier surrounding it.
Angra, which appears in the Zombie Scenario as a boss, is now available as a new zombie boss.
Angra is a powerful zombie which can dominate from the sky above.
It can release toxic gas onto the battlefield, and expanding the area of it by blowing strong winds with its wings after the initial gas release.
It can also remove the weapons of its enemies with shockwaves and then attack defenceless foes with deadly tentacles.
RAH-66 Comanche is a new playable character for the Human team which can be controlled through third-person view in Zombie Giant mode.
When the humans’ supply gauge is at its max, players will enter into either a standard TX300 or the new Comanche at random by pressing ‘E’.
Gun Deathmatch extends its map list with new ‘Parking Lot’ and ‘Bunny Yard’.
Furthermore, players will be able to experience Gun Deathmatch with rare high-end weapons instead of just the more classic ones.

Now it should take only 1/4th of time previously needed.
This has been done with lowering the number of rounds for each of starting maps down to 5.
We reduced freeze time, and the animation of opening doors is quicker!
We only increased requirements for medals from 100 to 400 playthroughs.

notes.title: [New] Terrorists: Raven and Michaela
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1111/banner.jpg[/img]

In a world that has experienced a Zombie Apocalypse, where everyone and everything wants to kill you, it’s not easy to tell who you can trust. Maybe it’s worth calling a truce with Terrorists if they can help you to destroy the common enemy. The two latest outlaws definitely know how to deal with threats and they can do so with style! 

Starting on [b]11th November[/b], there are two new terrorist characters available in the Shop: [b]Raven and Michaela.[/b]

[h1][b]RAVEN[/b][/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1111/1.png[/img]
Known for his acts of terror on the sea and his expertise as an assassin, he became entrapped while conducting a special mission on behalf of the government. No rescue attempt was made by the government, however, and he became a pirate with money as his only motivation.
Raven belongs to a unique emotion class and can perform two special emotions: [b]“Taunt 2” [/b]and [b] “Shadow Boxing".[/b]

[h1][b]MICHAELA[/b][/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1111/2.png[/img]
A pirate who is wanted by the navy, she is rumored to be the sole daughter of a man who is the owner of a large fleet of ships. The moment that you become enamored by her great beauty, the angel of death will appear before you.
Michaela belongs to a unique emotion class and can perform two special emotions:[b] “Taunt 2”[/b] and [b] “Surrender”.[/b]

Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.title: [NEW] Oz's Trio DLC is now Available!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/1028/en.jpg[/img]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/1.png[/img]

One of the most well-known tales, [b]The Wonderful Wizard of Oz[/b], and its lessons can easily be converted to the land of zombies. A true hero should have a strong heart and courage to fight the endless enemies, use their brains so as to come up with tactics against the toughest of bosses and not get overpowered by zombies, and most importantly, a true hero must have a good team to challenge the impossible. 

However, CSN:Z is no fairy tale and happy endings depend strictly on battlefield experience and firepower. We introduce a new set of unique DLC weapons that will help you come back home safely. 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/2.png[/img]

[h1]This set includes Tin Man’s Machine Gun, Cowardly Lion’s Pistol, and Scarecrow’s Pickaxe.

[b]Now it's available with 10% release Discount.[/b][/h1]
[url=store.steampowered.com/app/404240]You can purchase the Wizard of Oz DLC here[/url]

When you use the whole set, you will receive the following bonuses:
[h1][list]
[*]Tin Man’s Machine Gun: maximum round increases to 200 (40 rounds/magazine).
[*]Cowardly Lion’s Pistol: rate of fire is increased.
[*]Scarecrow’s Pickaxe: speed and damage are substantially increased.
[/list][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/3.png[/img]
 
A machine gun that uses 5 magazines. It aims to dissipate the long reload time of the previous version.
[h1][list]
[*]If 2 variants of Oz weapons are used together, then the maximum magazine capacity increases to 30 rounds.
[*]If 3 variants of Oz weapons are used together, then the maximum magazine capacity increases to 40.
[/list][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/4.png[/img]
A modified Glock 18 which uses a 9mm round. The magazine has been modified to hold 25 rounds, from the original 20, and it boasts of great firepower in close range with its automatic fire.
[h1][list]
[*]If 2 variants of Oz weapons are used together, then the 1st and 2nd attack’s rate of fire is increased.
[*]If 3 variants of Oz weapons are used together, then the 1st and 2nd attack’s rate of fire is substantially increased.
[/list][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/5.png[/img]
 
A pickaxe in a shape of a scarecrow. Can be modified with a shorter blade to allow 2 kinds of attack, a downward and a sideways swing.
[h1][list]
[*]If 2 variants of Oz weapons are used together, then the 1st attack’s attack speed and 2nd attack’s damage is increased.
[*]If 3 variants of Oz weapons are used together, then the 1st attack’s attack speed and 2nd attack’s damage is substantially increased. 
[/list][/h1]


To redeem your Wizard of Oz DLC, visit the Item Shop menu in Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies and locate the [Enter Code] button. 
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/6.jpg[/img]

Click the [Enter Code] button, and enter your DLC Code for the Wizard of Oz in the displayed window.
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/7.jpg[/img]

Please note that your DLC Code is case sensitive and must be entered exactly as it appears. 

[b]If you are having difficulty entering your code, please attempt the following:
Make sure you are entering the entire DLC Code, which will be 30 characters long.[/b]
[list]
[*]Copy\paste may result in errors, please enter the DLC Code manually.
[*]DLC Codes are case-sensitive and must be entered exactly as they appear. ‘abcde’ is different from ‘ABCDE’.
[*]Once you have entered your DLC Code, please allow the game enough time to process it. This may take 5-10 seconds.
[*]Once your DLC Code has been successfully redeemed, check the ‘Storage’ tab of your inventory for your rewards. Players who already own the [*]DLC Packages may have their bonus items awarded directly to their inventory and not to the ‘Storage’ tab.
[/list]

Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.title: Halloween! Sales and Events!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/1028/en_halloween.jpg[/img]
Halloween is always a special period on Steam. Spooky creatures are seen everywhere and things are getting strangely cheap. CSN:Z has prepared all that and more. No tricks, we promise!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/2-1.png[/img]

CSN:Z has prepared a survivor’s treat that will scare off even the deadliest of Zombies, the [b]VULCANUS-7[/b].

The VULCANUS-7 is a machine gun developed by Aegis Laboratory which uses 120 rounds of 7.62mm NATO. It is equipped with the VULCANUS Parts System which automatically transforms after a set amount of time, which allows the use of a grenade launcher or adds 3 extra barrels to the weapon.

Only from [b]28.10.2015 to 04.11.2015[/b], you can immediately craft the VULCANUS-7 by acquiring the special Perfect Pick Recipe: VULCANUS-7 Set. 
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/2-2.png[/img]

Buy a bundle of 10x to increase your chances to receive a permanent version or get closer to 999 days, when you can turn the weapon into a permanent version regardless of luck. 

[h1][b]Halloween Event[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/2-3.jpg[/img]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/2-4.jpg[/img]

What makes Halloween unique is that anybody can wear anything that day and not be considered weird. Although distinctive clothing usually might get you shot at in-game, during Halloween the sight of a team wearing cat costumes can distract any opposing team. So if you want to change your looks, join our event! Starting from 28.10.2015 to 04.11.2015, you can receive 3 Costume Boxes from our Shop each day, for free! 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/2-5.jpg[/img]
[list]
You will receive 1 Costume Box every time you accomplish the following:
 [*] Log in during the event
 [*] Play for 1 hour
 [*] Play for 2 hours
[/list]

[h1][b]Halloween Sales[/b][/h1]
If you’re looking for some special Halloween sales offers, worry not, CSN:Z got you covered!

All characters that were previously sold will be available once again in the Shop at exceptionally good prices! If you haven’t had the chance to buy them yet, now is your best chance!

[h1]Natasha + Jennifer (Set)[/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/2-6.png[/img]
[h1]Ji Yoon Choi + Ritsuka (Set)[/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/2-7.png[/img]
[h1]Yuri + Criss (Set)[/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/2-8.png[/img]
[h1]Erica + Mei (Set) [/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/2-9.png[/img]
[h1]Lucia and Enzo[/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/2-10.png[/img]
Additionally new DLC is released soon and it’s on sale! Buy the latest Wizard of Oz Set with a 10% discount.

Previous DLCs will be available from 29.10.15 with a huge 40% discount! Get the Dragon Set and Journey to the West for the lowest price yet!

[h1][b]XignCode Replacing HackShield[/b][/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/2-11.png[/img]

We have some news for all the survivors that try illegal ways to win in the game. 

Our old HackShield defender is being replaced with new anti-hack tool: XignCode. This is another step towards eliminating any threats to fair play rules.

Let us know on the forums what you think about the change and if you have any issues with the new system. 

[h1][b]Removal of "Bloody Blade"[/b][/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/1028/2-12.png[/img]

After hearing the many opinions from our community and monitoring the results of zombie vs humans encounters, we decided that it’s time to remove the Bloody Blade skill from the game. 

Zombies are going to be harder to kill starting this Halloween. 

Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

VK: http://vk.com/public78659129 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/CSN_Z

notes.title: 1st Anniversary of Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/273110/extras/cake.png?t=1444208953[/img]

Dear Survivors. It's been precisely 1 year since we officially released Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies on Steam.

We released multiple expansions and expanded into many new territories. We will continue our work to bring even more content each month and try our chances in new countries.

If you'd like to meet our team in-game, feel free to join GM event Today at 4PM CEST: 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0116/en.jpg[/img]

Server: Europe 
Channel: Europe 03 

The exact room name and number will be announced on the forums before the event starts.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/273110/extras/Image_53.png?t=1443189382[/img]

We've prepared 5x Anniversary discount coupons that you can use for purchasing Mileage Decoders and Enhancement Packs. 
They are now available and will last through 13th of October.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/273110/extras/discount.png?t=1444210794[/img]

During our Today's maintenance we worked on two big updates that you might not see in the game, but are even more important than usual updates and that took priority over new items in the game.

1.We've added strongly updated nexon game security system and prepared a client for completely new anti-hack system that will replace HackShield this month. (more information to come soon). 

2.Additionally we've built a new system that will prevent any future DDoS attacks. We will now run internal tests and it should be active next week. 

As this took all of our resources and we couldn't risk any client complications, please expect new in-game content already next Wednesday.

We'd also like to thank all the players for their support and feedback we receive each day!

Best Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Thanatos-9 Recipe and 2 New weapons in Mileage Decoder!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0930/en.jpg[/img]
This update brings the melee version of the famous weapon in the form of a scythe– THANATOS-9. Mileage Decoders now have 2 additional weapons: Drill Gun and Lightning HZ-1. Both with an increased probability for only a week! 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0930/1.png[/img]

[h1][b]THANATOS–9[/b][/h1]
This is a giant anti-zombie melee weapon in the shape of a scythe. It is equipped with the Thanatos Blade System, allowing it to divide into multiple blades and stab the enemy several times in quick succession. 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0930/2.png[/img]

[b]Only from 30.09.2015 to 07.10.2015[/b], you can easily craft the THANATOS-9 by acquiring the special Perfect Recipe. Buy a bundle of 10x to increase your chances to receive a permanent version or get closer to 999 days, when you can turn the weapon into a permanent version regardless of luck.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0930/3.png[/img]



[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0930/4.png[/img]
[h1][b]Lightning HZ-1[/b][/h1]
An assault rifle made with heavy zombies in mind; it even has the quirky shape of a heavy zombie. It uses 35 rounds of special ammo, and its fast movement and high damage characterize the weapon.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0930/5.png[/img]



[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0930/6.png[/img]

[h1][b]Drill Gun[/b][/h1]
This industrial equipment has been heavily modified to launch drill bits as dangerous projectiles. The penetration of the fired drill bits are excellent, and the weapon is very mobile. 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0930/7.png[/img]

Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.title: Thanatos-7 Recipe and 2 New weapons in Mileage Decoder!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0923/en.jpg[/img]

Aegis Institute named their most powerful weapon after Death from Greek Mythology – [b]Thanatos.[/b]

This was due to the weapon being constructed specifically to bring an ultimate end to the hordes of undead. Unlike regular weapons, it has an inbuilt special system that transforms it to its second form, giving the tactical advantage you might need when surrounded by undead. 

This update brings another version of the famous weapon – [b]THANATOS-7[/b]. Furthermore, Mileage Decoders now have 2 additional weapons: [b]Newcomer[/b] and [b]Lightning LZ-1[/b]. 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0923/1.png[/img]
[h1][b]THANATOS-7[/b][/h1]
This is an anti-zombie machine gun fed with 120 rounds of 7.62mm NATO.

It is equipped with the Thanatos Blade System which can deal continuously high damage to multiple targets inside the blades' radius. 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0923/2.png[/img]

[b]Only from 23.09.2015 to 30.09.2015[/b], you can easily craft the THANATOS-7 by acquiring the special Perfect Recipe. Buy a bundle of 10x to increase your chances to receive a permanent version or get closer to 999 days, when you can turn the weapon into a permanent version regardless of luck.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0923/4.png[/img]


[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0923/5.png[/img]

[h1][b]Newcomen[/b][/h1]
A submachine gun that fires 4.6mm rounds with 30 round capacity. It can use the power of a steam engine to unload all 30 bullets at once to be unmatched in firepower.

[b]From 23.09.2015 to 30.09.2015[/b], the Newcomer will be available in Decoders with double the probability.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0923/6.png[/img]


[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0923/8.png[/img]

[h1][b]Lightning LZ-1[/b][/h1]
An assault rifle designed with a Light Zombie motif. Cute little light zombies are attached to it. It fires 30 rounds of special ammo and has high speed and accuracy.

[b]From 23.09.2015 to 30.09.2015[/b], the Lightning LZ-1 will be available in Decoders with double the probability. 

Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.title: Blueprints revamp and New Classes!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/2_en.jpg[/img]
Decoders, Supreme Decoders, Perfect Recipes, Supreme Perfect Recipes-- Do any survivors remember the original, good old Blueprints? Well, we do, and we thought we should give them the attention they deserve! 

[h1][b]Blueprints Revamp[/b][/h1]
New Blueprint Bundles will be available from 16.09.2015 at extremely competitive prices. Just as an example: the smallest pack of Blueprints will include 3x Blueprints set at a price lower than the current price for 1x Blueprint set! Check the Shop tomorrow to see just how good of a deal they are! 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/2_1.jpg[/img]

Old things need to improve and new things have to emerge. With that motto in mind, we give you 2 new classes to choose from: 

[h1][b]New! Asian Red Army[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/2_2.png[/img]
Allows you to use an Asian Red Army Faction terrorist character. You will receive an additional 15% EXP and Points. In addition, you will receive a bonus of 400,000 Points upon purchase of this character. 

[h1][b]New! Special Assault Team[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/2_3.png[/img]

Allows you to use a SAT counter-terrorist character. You will receive an additional 15% EXP and Points. In addition, you will receive a bonus of 400,000 Points upon purchase of this character.

[h1][b]Medals! Honor Missions[/b][/h1]
The “All for Users” update wasn’t and won’t be the only featured update that was based purely on community demands. We heard you again, and new medals have been prepared for CSN:Z. 

[b]Rage Controller[/b] - A medal given to those who did not succumb to their rage and defeated Frozen Wrath.
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/2_4.png[/img]

[b]Diet Controller[/b] - A medal given to those who defeated Gluttony, he who eats just about anything.
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/2_5.png[/img]

[b]The Great Detective[/b] - A medal given to those who revealed the schemes of the Super Soldier Project.
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/2_6.png[/img]

[b]Madness Ender[/b] - A medal given to those who managed to stop Doctor Rex.
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/2_7.png[/img]

All the new features will be available from 16.09.2015 after the maintenance has been completed. 

Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.title: Thanatos-5 Recipe and New weapons in Mileage Decoder!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/1_en.jpg[/img]
Welcome, survivors, to the latest CSN:Z update that will be available tomorrow after the maintenace! It is the time for us to unlock the door to ultimate weaponry that everyone has been eager to land their hands on. The perfect recipe for annihilating zombies.

[h1]The THANATOS Series, by Aegis Institute, is finally here![/h1]

And it didn’t come alone. The CSN:Z arsenal has been extended with playful weapons: the latest Brick Piece model and a completely new dart pistol. Both available in Mileage Decoders that you can get plenty of by completing Daily Missions! 

[h1][b]New! THANATOS–5[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/1_1.png[/img]

This is an anti-zombie assault rifle fed with 30 rounds of 5.56mm NATO. It is equipped with the Thanatos Blade System, which uses a special grenade launcher to deal high damage by launching multiple blade fragments upon explosion.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/1_2.png[/img]

Starting on 16.09.2015, and only for a limited time, you can simply craft and become the owner of THANATOS-5 by acquiring the THANATOS-5 – Perfect Recipe Set. It holds all of the necessary materials: Grade-6 Crafting Blueprint, 72 Day-Permanent Durable, Points, and the Perfect Recipe that will create the THANATOS-5 with 100% success rate!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/1_3.png[/img]

[h1][b]New! Brick Piece M777[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/1_4.png[/img]

A shotgun made of block-like modules that can be disassembled and put together. Only made in small quantities. Depending on the situation, it can be used as an auto-shotgun or be recombined as an artillery.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/1_5.png[/img]


[h1][b]New! Dart Pistol[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/1_6.png[/img]

Pistol made to fire 5 special darts. It may seem like a regular toy gun, but it has a hidden feature which will shock opponents, causing targets to suffer damage over time after being hit.

[b]Both weapons will have the probability doubled for just 1 week![/b]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/1_7.png[/img]

[h1][b]Event! More Free Decoders from Daily Missions[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0916/1_8.png[/img]

There’s nothing better for a Mercenary or a humble Hero than a good reward after completing a tough mission. Sure, medals give plenty of honor and they’re a nice, shiny addition to your blood-covered outfit. 

But fortunately, the CSN:Z team knows that there is no medal out there that will keep you safe. Starting on 16.09.2015, Blueprint rewards for each Daily Mission have been changed to Mileage Decoders. 

That means an incredible [b]20x Free Decoders each day[/b] for everyone to grab! 

Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.title: [NEW] Night Stalker and Spin Diver zombies
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0902/en.jpg[/img]

It’s back to school in many countries again and It looks like Zombies’ vacations are over too. The Undead have two new Pupils in their rank: Spin Diver and Night Stalker.

You now hire and play those unique Premium Zombies in Zombie Darkness mode. 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0902/1.png[/img]

[h1][b]NEW! - Night Stalker zombie[/b][/h1]

This zombie has high defence and good mobility. When it's running, it defends its body from bullets impact, which makes him really hard to stop. It can jump twice and attack the enemy with very rapid movement. 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0902/2.jpg[/img]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0902/3.png[/img]

[h1][b]NEW! - Spin Diver zombie[/b][/h1]

This Zombie is specialized in getting quickly into narrow places. Its defence and moving speed might be low, but it can move quickly on flat ground by rolling its body. It can jump and decrease its size when flying. 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0902/4.jpg[/img]

After purchasing Zombies in the Item Shop, both of them will be available in the in game menu.

notes.title: [New] Value Pack, Characters, Free Supreme Decoders
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0826/en.jpg[/img]

[b]Supreme Decoders[/b] have been in high demand by survivors. But since they will only be available until 16th of September, we want to give everyone the chance to have as many of them as needed. Here’s what CSN:Z has prepared in order to help you stay within your zombie apocalypse budget. 

[h1]NEW! - Value Pack containing everything you need.[/h1]

From 26.08.15 until 16.09.15, in the Item Shop you can find a special package that contains 4x Supreme Decoders, 10x Mileage Decoders, 10x Special Enhancement Materials, 5x Costume Boxes, Double UP Coupon for 30 days, and SKULL-7 for 30 days. If you need any of the items from any of the boxes, they are definitely cheaper in bulk compared to buying separately... Not to mention the Double UP Coupon is a bonus that is not purchasable anywhere else. 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0826/1.png[/img]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0826/1_1.png[/img]

Log into the game from 26.08.15 to 29.08.15 to receive a 1 time only -30% Discount Coupon that you can use to purchase the Value Pack and make even bigger savings!
[b]All coupons will only be valid until 30.08.15, so make sure you don’t miss out on this chance.[/b]

[h1]EVENT! – FREE Daily Mission Supreme Decoder![/h1]
For those who enjoy the fact that almost all premium content in CSN:Z can be obtainable with no external funding, we’ve prepared a pleasant surprise.

[b]Daily Missions are going to become so much more rewarding with FREE Bonus Supreme Decoders![/b]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0826/2.png[/img]

From 26.07.15 until 16.09.15, completing 5 Daily Missions will award a Bonus Supreme Decoder. Players can earn up to 2 Bonus Decoders each day, with the event repeating each day for the duration of the event.

Please note that CSN:Z uses CEST for its events, and each day resets Bonus Decoder progress at Midnight CEST. 
The time zone where you reside may differ from CEST by a large amount. For our USA players in the Eastern Time Zone, each day resets event progress at noon.

[h1]NEW! - Naval Fleet CT characters that know how to exterminate enemies as well as they dance![/h1]

Enzo

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0826/3.png[/img]

A counter-terrorist member of the Garcia Naval Fleet, Enzo belongs to a unique emotion class and can perform two special emotions ‘Strength Boasting’ and ‘Dance’.

Lucia

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0826/4.png[/img]

The Garcia Naval Fleet's counter-terrorist team leader. Lucia belongs to a unique emotion class and can perform two special emotions ‘Hand Kiss’ and ‘Dance’.

Whether you are enlisting Enzo, Lucia, or both as PERMANENT additions to your roster of characters in CSN:Z don’t hesitate for too long! This rare offer may be gone before you know it.

notes.title: Revamped Weapon Showcase: Upgraded Edition
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/banner.jpg[/img]

The Revamped Weapon Showcase continues with a special episode.
The ongoing events allow Survivors to upgrade their weapons into powerful destroyers, so let's take a closer look at them!

[h1][b]Dual Infinity Final[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/Dual1.jpg[/img]

Few sidearms can compete with the Dual Infinity, and the 'Final' version is one of the most preferred guns by Zombie hunters. Their secondary fire mode sacrifices accuracy for rate of fire, which makes them perfect at repelling undeads who get too close.
To balance their value, they're extremely hard to get as they force you to get the 'Dual Infinity Custom' first.
The Dual Infinity Final inflict more damage and shoot faster in semi-automatic mode, while in full-auto they're less accurate due to higher recoil.
Moreover, they look awesome: one is pure gold and the other one ruby red.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/Dual2.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]M134 Predator[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/M134_1.jpg[/img]

The standard M134 is an iconic weapon on its own, but it has some limitations: your movement is slowed, your accuracy is not great, and you can't shoot immediately since the barrels need to spin first.
While there's nothing much to be done about the first two limitations, the M134 'Predator' aims specifically at fixing the third point, allowing the user to manually spin the barrels so that he or she can shoot at will, and immediately unleash a rain of lead upon spotting undead hordes.

Do not let BlindFire know about the M134 Predator! Henry kept it a secret for a reason.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/M134_2.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Triple Barrel Shotgun[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/T-barrel1.jpg[/img]

Do you know what's better than a two-barreled shotgun?
Exactly: a three-barreled one!
Sure, it kicks like a horse and reloading it takes time, but this weapon is perfectly suited for keeping isolated Zombies at bay while dealing high damage to them. The idea is to wait for an undead to get close and then send it all the way back to that wall on the other side of the map with a point-blank shot.
You can even fire with all barrels at once using the secondary fire mode for higher damage, but less knockback power.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/T-barrel2.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Dual Kriss Super-V[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/Dual_super1.jpg[/img]

Based on the Vector, the Kriss is a reliable SMG: lightweight with low recoil and high damage thanks to the .45 ACP ammunition. Because of this, acquiring enough experience with using one of them will allow you to wield two at the same time like a true veteran!
You will be a little less accurate for obvious reasons, but who cares? You'll have a larger magazine to compensate for that and you'll look awesome, which is always a plus.
Spray 'n Pray!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/Dual_super2.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]SL-8 Custom[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/SL8_1.jpg[/img]

When modifying a weapon, there are some obvious choices to make: grab a larger magazine, put a suppressor on, find a better crosshair, and craft special ammunitions for increased damage. 
These features define the pure concept of 'customization' for any kind of weapon and the SL-8 Custom possesses all of the above, which makes it an even better middle-ranged sniper rifle.
Is there anything more to add? Yes: it's fully automatic.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/SL8_2.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Master Combat Knife[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/Knipe1.jpg[/img]

Legend says that this blade is somehow related to a mythical god of some sort and could be a kind of ritual knife for sacrifices...
We don't know if that's true, but this is for sure: the longer blade of the Master Combat Knife allows for both slicing and stabbing to inflict higher damage from a safer distance. However, it's preferable to avoid direct contact with a melee weapon when pegged against a gun-wielding opponent, and aim for the back instead. Especially in cases like this one, the result is a quick and deadly backstab.
If being sneaky is not possible, just keep running and aim for the head as you would do with a firearm.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/Knipe2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Revamped Weapon Showcase: Upgraded Edition
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/banner.jpg[/img]

The Revamped Weapon Showcase continues with a special episode.
The ongoing events allow Survivors to upgrade their weapons into powerful destroyers, so let's take a closer look at them!

[h1][b]Dual Infinity Final[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/Dual1.jpg[/img]

Few sidearms can compete with the Dual Infinity, and the 'Final' version is one of the most preferred guns by Zombie hunters. Their secondary fire mode sacrifices accuracy for rate of fire, which makes them perfect at repelling undeads who get too close.
To balance their value, they're extremely hard to get as they force you to get the 'Dual Infinity Custom' first.
The Dual Infinity Final inflict more damage and shoot faster in semi-automatic mode, while in full-auto they're less accurate due to higher recoil.
Moreover, they look awesome: one is pure gold and the other one ruby red.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/Dual2.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]M134 Predator[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/M134_1.jpg[/img]

The standard M134 is an iconic weapon on its own, but it has some limitations: your movement is slowed, your accuracy is not great, and you can't shoot immediately since the barrels need to spin first.
While there's nothing much to be done about the first two limitations, the M134 'Predator' aims specifically at fixing the third point, allowing the user to manually spin the barrels so that he or she can shoot at will, and immediately unleash a rain of lead upon spotting undead hordes.

Do not let BlindFire know about the M134 Predator! Henry kept it a secret for a reason.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/M134_2.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Triple Barrel Shotgun[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/T-barrel1.jpg[/img]

Do you know what's better than a two-barreled shotgun?
Exactly: a three-barreled one!
Sure, it kicks like a horse and reloading it takes time, but this weapon is perfectly suited for keeping isolated Zombies at bay while dealing high damage to them. The idea is to wait for an undead to get close and then send it all the way back to that wall on the other side of the map with a point-blank shot.
You can even fire with all barrels at once using the secondary fire mode for higher damage, but less knockback power.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/T-barrel2.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Dual Kriss Super-V[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/Dual_super1.jpg[/img]

Based on the Vector, the Kriss is a reliable SMG: lightweight with low recoil and high damage thanks to the .45 ACP ammunition. Because of this, acquiring enough experience with using one of them will allow you to wield two at the same time like a true veteran!
You will be a little less accurate for obvious reasons, but who cares? You'll have a larger magazine to compensate for that and you'll look awesome, which is always a plus.
Spray 'n Pray!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/Dual_super2.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]SL-8 Custom[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/SL8_1.jpg[/img]

When modifying a weapon, there are some obvious choices to make: grab a larger magazine, put a suppressor on, find a better crosshair, and craft special ammunitions for increased damage. 
These features define the pure concept of 'customization' for any kind of weapon and the SL-8 Custom possesses all of the above, which makes it an even better middle-ranged sniper rifle.
Is there anything more to add? Yes: it's fully automatic.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/SL8_2.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Master Combat Knife[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/Knipe1.jpg[/img]

Legend says that this blade is somehow related to a mythical god of some sort and could be a kind of ritual knife for sacrifices...
We don't know if that's true, but this is for sure: the longer blade of the Master Combat Knife allows for both slicing and stabbing to inflict higher damage from a safer distance. However, it's preferable to avoid direct contact with a melee weapon when pegged against a gun-wielding opponent, and aim for the back instead. Especially in cases like this one, the result is a quick and deadly backstab.
If being sneaky is not possible, just keep running and aim for the head as you would do with a firearm.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0824/Knipe2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: [NEW] Perfect Enhancing Unboxed!
notes.content:
All survivors are constantly after newer, bigger, and more powerful weapons. But there is a group of zombie hunters that prefer more old school weaponry. Not everyone wants to change their well-worn in battle M60, to a futuristic Blaster, or their retro Winchester to a shooting umbrella. 

There’s an old, wise individual in CSN:Z that highly respects that choice. He goes by the name of “Henry” and he can ensure that your classic weapons keep up with the competition using a serious [b]enhancing[/b] procedure. 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0820/1_en.jpg[/img]

[h1]He can improve some weapons’ stats up to EIGHT levels (+8) from stock (0).[/h1]
The ones that can be upgraded will have a wrench icon on the upper right-hand side of the weapon’s image.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0820/2.png[/img]

Acquire the new Enhancement Boxes from 20.08.2015 and bring them to Henry to see some amazing results.

[b]Enhancement Box (Perfect Enhancement)[/b] contains 10x Special Enhancement Material and 3x Perfect Enhancement Material. Perfect Enhancement Material guarantees a 100% success rate, and you can randomly acquire 3x of those from the box. 

Perfect Enhancement Material will increase the exact weapon statistic that is mentioned in its description. That will allow you to specifically tailor the weapon to your needs whether you want to have an extremely accurate weapon or you want to focus purely on firepower.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0820/3_en.jpg[/img]


[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0820/4.png[/img]

[b]Enhancement Box (Anti-Elemental)[/b] contains 50x Special Enhancement 
Material and 2x Anti-Enhancement Material. Anti-Enhancement Material can reset the exact corresponding statistic, and you can randomly acquire 2x Anti-Enhancement Material.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0820/5_en.jpg[/img]

After enhancing some of the weapons in the Crafting menu to +6 (Master Edition) and +8 (Expert Edition), their appearance will change. 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0820/6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: [Update] New Era of Decoder SUPREME!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0817/supreme.jpg[/img]

You surely noticed all the recent updates: Zombie Rework, Zombie Darkness, Free new Zombies, Zombie War. There was so much Focus on Zombies one might think CSN:Z wants the Undead to win over the Humans - permanently.

This time we brought together with Heroine and Humans brand new skills, the most devastating tool a survivor can have: Supreme Decoders.

Unique type of Decoder in a form available only in CSN:Z and only[b] from 17.08.2015 until 16.09.2015.[/b]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/2_1.jpg[/img]

[h1]You open Supreme Decoders from the same Decoder menu in the game. But the results are far superior to what you got used to.[/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/2_2.jpg[/img]
Each time you open Supreme Decoder you have 85% chances to win any of BALROG, SKULL, JANUS, Maverick series, or Salamander, M32 MGL, AT4CS, Leviathan. Any of these weapons will be 70 Days versions.

Any other weapon or item you can see on the Supreme Decoder list you have the remaining 15% chances to win! However they only come in 1 supreme version: Permanently only! And the list includes: Thunderbolt, Lightning weapons, Crossbow, golden weapons series, 6 characters and so many more!

And by many more we mean some latest weapons in CSN:Z

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/2_3.png[/img]

[h1]Black Dragon Cannon – Permanent[/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/2_4.png[/img]

[h1]Ripper aka Power Chainsaw - Permanent[/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/2_5.png[/img]
[h1]Gae Bolg aka Speargun - Permanent[/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/2_6.png[/img]
[h1]Guillotine Permanent[/h1]

With all the many permanent weapons you can now simply acquire you might find yourself in a unfortunate situation where you draw a permanent weapon which you already have. Fortunately In that case instead of receiving a 2nd one you will receive a 500 Days item extension! 2 of those and you can make any weapon permanent!

We are aware this will cause an unprecedented number of weapons in players hands that needs upgrading. Therefore we decided to make it easier for everybody to get to their +8 stats and make from now on all Anti-Enhancements materials purchasable by Game Points only.

[h1]You’ll need 20.000 Points for 10 Anti-Enhancements and 50.000 Points for 30x Anti-Enhancements.[/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/2_7_en.png[/img]

Please also take notice that Supreme Decoders are separate items from Mileage Decoders and they don’t give any mileage points upon opening.

notes.title: [UPDATE] Zombie Rework Update
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/rework_en.jpg[/img]
What is the Zombie Rework?

Since updating so many contents for Zombies, there were lots of change requests from users regarding Zombie modes.

We listened to the users (you all!!) and below are the things that have been most recently updated.
Adding double grenades for Zombies. Two powerful weapons can be chosen for Heroes and Heroines. Yes, you can finally be a Heroine, too! Or be a Sidekick and help the Hero or Heroine. A Sidekick also can be equipped with some powerful weapons.

You can also restrict the Zombie selection. The freedom to balance Zombie matches is now in your hands. You can also choose what kind of Zombie you want to be when you revive.

And the all-time most requested skills that users have asked for has been added: Bloody Blade and Deadly Shot. Now Humans can deal fatal damage to Zombies for 5 seconds to have more room to escape or annihilate them all.

There are many other changes in this patch, so please check the list below for details:

[h1][Zombie Rework update][/h1]

[b]1. New feature[/b]
- You can now play as Heroine in Zombie Hero mode, if you possess and have selected a female character.
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_6.jpg[/img]

[b]2. New items[/b]
- Double zombie grenade: double shock, one after another. It causes shock upon contact.
- 2 heroic weapons are added: M134 Vulcan and Dual Kriss Custom.
- You can now select or cancel heroic weapons.
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_7.jpg[/img]

[b]3. Sidekick[/b]
- In support of Heroes and Heroines, random players will be chosen as Sidekicks.
- Hidden weapons from the Supply Boxes can now be acquired upon being selected as a Sidekick.

4. Supply Box function change
- Ammo supplies, night vision goggles, and grenades available in Supply Boxes.
- Weapon buy now available again through Supply Boxes. (Cannot acquire hidden weapons anymore.)

[b]5. Zombie Selection[/b]
- You can choose to become a different type of zombie upon revival.
- You can edit the zombie selection sequence in [Edit Buy Menu] from [My Info]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_8_en.jpg[/img]

6. Option to restrict classes of zombies
- You can now restrict classes of zombies in the game options.
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_9_en.png[/img]

notes.title: [UPDATE] All for Users Update
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/update_en.jpg[/img]

The CSN:Z team has decided to update the game based on the feedback of users.

One of the most impressive updates is the ‘Vote Kick Renewal’. Many users kept talking about ‘Vote Kick’, calling it ‘abusive’ and ‘misused’. Thankfully, as a result of the renewal, those users consider the game to be headed in the right direction – one might call the approach ‘democratic’.

Another remarkable update is the separation of the chat windows into two division. We heard user complaints about system messages always covering player chats. Well that is no longer an issue.

One thing also to be highlighted is the Inventory arranging/search function. This is what we should have done at the beginning of service, admittedly. And now you can re-arrange your inventory as you wish. It is more convenient and more comfortable.

There are many other changes in this patch, so please check the list below for details:

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_1.jpg[/img]

[h1][All for Users Update][/h1]
[b]1. Vote Kick Renewal[/b]
- The Vote Kick system has been renewed so that it cannot be abused and misused, and is headed in the right direction.
- You can use the vote kick only 5 times per day.
- The one being subjected to a vote kick will have a moment to convey his defense against the kick before the vote commences.
- The vote kick item can only be used in a room with 3 or more players.
- Once the vote begins, players can either say Yes (F3), No (F4), or Withdraw (ESC). Withdrawing will not be considered as a valid vote.
- In order to carry out the vote kick, a certain percentage of the players in the room must vote, either ‘yes’ or ‘no’, and in order to kick the person out from the room, a majority of the voting players must have said ‘yes’.
- The Vote Kick item can only be used by a player who has been in the room for more than 3 minutes.
- After using a Vote Kick, regardless of the result, the item can be reused after 1 minute.
- You have to be at least level 20 to be able to purchase the Vote Kick item

[b]2. Zombie War in the zombie rankings[/b]
- Zombie War is now included in the Zombie League rankings.
- Upon playing in Zombie War mode, Zombie League ranking points can be earned.

[b]3. Division in chat window[/b]
- Normal messages and system messages are now separated.
- Now players can chat with ease in the new chat layout.
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_2_en.jpg[/img]

[b]4. Inventory arrange/search function renewed[/b]
- Inventory renewed so that owned items can be seen and checked more easily.
- Item categorization is further divided so that items can be better organized.
- Newly acquired items will be labeled “new” on the top of its icon to ease its finding in the Inventory.
- Function added so that items can be arranged by name, date acquired, or category.
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_3_en.png[/img]

[b]5. Expanded Blacklist[/b]
- Increased to 150 from the previous 30.

[b]6. Number of times allowed to receive special missions increased (again)[/b]
- Increased the count to re-receive special missions.
- Before: Premium Item 5 times.
- After: Standard 2 times/ Premium Item 7 times (total 9 times).

[b]7. Weapon crafting cost and time required reduced[/b]
- Crafting time reduced to 0.75 from 1.00 seconds.
- Crafting cost reduced 20%. (For unlimited crafting, reduced to 12800 from 16000).

[b]8. Demo renewed[/b]
- Now players are able to record videos other than the Demo. Recording options can be found under Options.
- For a proper playback of the videos, MP2 (MPEG-1 Layer 2) and MPEG1 codecs must be installed.
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_4_en.png[/img]

[b]9. Item auto-equip fixed (Costumes)[/b]
- Costumes now can be automatically equipped, if there aren’t any costumes currently equipped. If a costume is currently equipped, then newly acquired costume will not be automatically equipped.

[b]10. Human Scenario Buy menu renewed.[/b]
- UI changed, Favorites tab added.
- Buy menu now can be seen even when dead.

[b]11. Issue where game options could not be saved is fixed[/b]
- Temporary bug where game options could not be saved is now fixed.

[b]12. Minigun sound bug fix[/b]
- Fixed an issue where the sound of the spinning barrel of the M134 would be constantly played when a player was spectating another player also using the M134.

[b]13. Dismantling Blueprints/Durables[/b]
- Blueprints/Durables can now be dismantled.
- If the mentioned items are dismantled, 2 lower-tiered items can be acquired.
- If you wish to change the category of the current Blueprint, it can be demolished and then crafted into another one.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0817/1_5_en.png[/img]

notes.title: [Maintenance] [COMPLETED] 12.08.2015 - "Mileage Compensation"
notes.content:
Dear Survivors,

We're going to perform a server maintenance on 12.08.2015 from 07:00am to 10:00am CEST (10:00pm - 01:00am Pacific Time).

During the maintenance we will patch the servers and provide compensation for the Mileage issues everyone experienced lately:

[h1][b]- All users will get back DOUBLE the Mileage they lost while the bug was affecting Decoders and Bingo Board.[/b][/h1]

This means that if you lost 1000 Mileage, you'll get 2000 Mileage back tomorrow!

If you lost 4000 Mileage, you'll get back 8000.
This ensures all users get well compensated and proportionally to their loss, a result which was our top priority to achieve.

- Additionally we're extending the 'Chances to Win Increased' Event to 9:00am CEST of 13th August 2015 (12:00am Pacific Time): 
an extra 24h to take advantage of the 3x and 4x increased chance of getting, respectively, Powerful Weapons and Characters from Decoders! 

Once again, we want to apologyze for the inconveniences caused by the technical issues we encountered and we want to thank all of you for the feedback and support you provided us.

Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Chances to win characters and powerful weapons from decoders increased!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0807/en.jpg[/img]

Have you been hearing people complain about the warm weather, and thought “I could handle way more”? Well, CSN:Z keeps cranking up the temperature. The hottest promotion has come To CSN:Z and it offers highly increased chances to win all characters and some of the best weapons that you can get from Decoders.

Ever wanted to get that Thunderbolt everybody is talking about or were you after a unique character? Check the event details below:


You can simply see the event is running by the golden tag and a x3 or x4 sign next to those items from within the Decoder menu.

[b]From 07.08 until 12.08 probability to receive powerful weapons from Decoder are increased by x3 times![/b]

List of weapons available in the event:
[h1]Volcano, Thunderbolt, Dragon Claw, Cyclone, Crossbow, Tempest and Aeolis.[/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0807/1.png[/img]

[b]From 07.08 until 12.08 all characters from Decoder has x4 the probability to be drawn from the Decoder[/b]

List of characters available in the event:
[h1]Ling Ling, Isabella, Alin, Dominique, Gerrard, David Black[/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0807/2.png[/img]

And what’s the best way to get a lot of Decoders and even more weapons? Check out our ongoing sales with free Decoders as a bonus! It’s way cheaper than buying Blueprints and Decoders separately.

[h1]SALE! – Free Decoder Bundles when purchasing Crafting Bundles[/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0729/1.png[/img]

From 29th July to 26th August, grabbing Crafting Bundles from the Shop will be truly rewarding! Purchasing Crafting Bundles also awards FREE Decoder Bundles!

• Buy 1x Crafting Bundle, get 1x Decoder FREE
• Buy 10x Crafting Bundle, get 10x Decoders FREE
• Buy 30x Crafting Bundle, get 30x Decoders FREE

Take advantage of increased probability event and Crafting Bundles promotion to get a hold of the most wanted items available in CSN:Z !

notes.title: DLC Special Offer! Get bonus Classes ‘Spade’ and ‘Keith Icahn’ for PERMANENT!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0715/en.jpg[/img]
Eagle-eyed players may have noticed some rather unfamiliar faces showcasing the latest additions to CSN:Z, wielding the Dragon Set and Journey to the West DLC Pack weapons.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0715/journey_5.png[/img]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0715/dragon.png[/img]

That is Spade and Keith Icahn, two Classes in CSN:Z who have kept a low profile! It has been a long while since they made an appearance.

[h1]Players who pick up the Journey to the West or Dragon Set DLC Packs for CSN:Z can enlist their services PERMANETLY![/h1]

From 29th July purchasing the latest CSN:Z DLC Packs includes a truly rare offer!
[list]
[*] Receive male Terrorist Class Spade for PERMANENT when purchasing and activating a Journey to the West DLC Pack.
[*] Receive male Counter-Terrorist Class Keith Icahn for PERMANENT when purchasing and activating the Dragon Set DLC Pack. 
[/list]
Players who purchase both DLC Packs can get both of these skilled combatants for PERMANENT!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0715/4.png[/img]

If you’ve already purchased one, or both, DLC packs featured in this event you will still receive Spade and\or Keith Icahn as CSN:Z Team manually issues these rewards to eligible player accounts.

If you are having difficulty entering your code, please attempt the following;
[list]
[*] Make sure you are entering the entire DLC Code, which will be 30 characters long.
[*] Copy\Paste may result in errors, please enter the DLC Code manually.
[*] DLC Codes are case-sensitive and must be entered exactly as they appear. ‘abcde’ is different from ‘ABCDE’.
[*] Once you have entered your DLC Code, please allow the game enough time to process it. This may take 5-10 seconds.
[*] Once your DLC Code has been successfully redeemed, check the ‘Storage’ tab of your inventory for your rewards. Players who already own the DLC Packages may have their bonus items awarded directly to their inventory and not to the ‘Storage’ tab. [/list]
