notes.title: [EVENTS] Return of Fan Favorites! PERMANENT Weapon Upgrades, Free Mission Decoders, Coupons, and MORE
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0729/en.jpg[/img]
Summer may be starting to wind down, but Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies isn’t about to let it go without a fight! CSN:Z opened its undead doors to whole new regions of the globe, unleashed days of Darkness updates, and is spreading its Zombie infection deeper into Steam with our latest DLC packages… but it’s time to break out the big guns!

More free Decoders! Special offers in the Shop! GET THOSE WEAPON UPGRADES, PRONTO! Summer is still heating up with these CSN:Z Fan Favorites and more in our latest events.
Quick Rundown:
[list][*] Buying Crafting Bundles awards FREE Bonus Decoders! From 29th July to 26th August.
[*]New Discount Coupons for Special Enhancement and Crafting Bundles.
[*]Mission Bonus Decoders are back! Rack up Rewards and Mileage from 29.07.15 to 26.08.15 
[*]Weapon Upgrades are back! Earn free PERMANENT Upgrades from 29.07.15 to 26.08.15 
[/list]
[h1][b]SALE! – Free Decoder Bundles when purchasing Crafting Bundles[/b][/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0729/1.png[/img]
From 29th July to 26th August, grabbing Crafting Bundles from the Shop will be truly rewarding! Purchasing Crafting Bundles also awards FREE Decoder Bundles! 
[list][*]Buy 1x Crafting Bundle, get 1x Decoder FREE
[*]Buy 10x Crafting Bundle, get 10x Decoders FREE
[*]Buy 30x Crafting Bundle, get 30x Decoders FREE [/list]

All Grades of Crafting Bundles are included with this Sale, making it a great time to Craft yourself new weapons and unlock some rewards with Decoder!
Please note - When gifting Crafting Bundles to other players during this sale, the player who sent the gift receives the Free Decoders and not the recipient of the gift.

[h1][b]SALE! – New Discount Coupons, Crafting Bundles and Special Enhancementl[/b][/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0729/2.png[/img]
Getting FREE Bundles of Decoders with Crafting Bundle purchases is a pretty good offer, but perhaps it can be a little sweeter still! All players will receive new Discount Coupons to make shopping for Crafting Bundles and Special Enhancement Materials an even better deal!
[list][*] 10x Discount Coupons for -20% any Crafting Bundle Purchase
[*]10x Discount Coupons for -20% any Special Enhancement Material Purchase [/list]
Mark your calendars, because these coupons will only last until 12th August!

[h1][b]EVENT! – FREE Daily Mission Bonus Decoders, up to 10x per Day[/b][/h1]
Daily Missions are going to become much more rewarding with the return of FREE Bonus Decoders!
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0610/1.png[/img]
From 29.07.15 to 26.08.15 completing Daily Missions will also award a Bonus Decoder. Players can earn up to 10 Bonus Decoders each day, with the event repeating each day for the duration of the event. That’s a lot of FREE Decoders waiting for you!

Please note that CSN:Z uses CEST for its events, and each day resets Bonus Decoder progress at Midnight CEST. 
The time zone where you reside may differ from CEST by a large amount. For our USA players in the Eastern Time Zone, each day resets event progress at noon. 

[h1][b]EVENT! – Weapon Upgrade Event is back! Earn FREE PERMANENT Upgrades[/b][/h1]
As one of the most popular events in CSN:Z,  it would have been a shame if Weapon Upgrades didn’t drop in on such an exciting summer! In addition, it is only fair that players from the newly added South America, North Africa, and Middle East regions get a fair crack at earning those FREE PERMANENT Upgraded weapons!

From 29.07.15 to 26.08.15 scoring kills with Upgradeable Weapons can earn players their Upgraded variants for PERMANENT duration for FREE! Scoring kills awards points towards completing a weapon’s upgrade, and each weapon has a different amount of points required.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0729/4_en.png[/img]

[b]How to begin a Weapon Upgrade during the event:[/b]

M134 Minigun -> This weapon can be crafted from Grade-1 Blueprints 
Dual Infinity -> This weapon can be crafted from Grade-2 Blueprints
Combat Knife -> This weapon can be crafted from Grade-3 Blueprints
Kriss Super V -> This weapon can be crafted from Grade-4 Blueprints
Double Barrel Shotgun -> This weapon can be crafted from Grade-5 Blueprints
SL8 -> This weapon can be crafted from Grade-5 Blueprints

All those weapons can also be acquired from Decoders. Luckily for all survivors, you get Free Decoder Bundles when purchasing Crafting Bundles. That means higher chances to get the weapons you need for permanent upgrades! 

Please note that Weapon Upgrades can only be obtained during the event. If you have unfinished progress towards a weapon when the event ends, you will not receive the Permanent Upgraded variant of the weapon.
Please check following rules that apply to this event:

*Kill points can vary depending on game mode. Example: point can be acquired from Zombie PvP modes (15 Zombie kills, 5 Human kills) and Zombie Scenario(1 Zombie kill), etc.
*Weapon upgrade is available for both temporary and permanent items.
*If your inventory does not contain any of the listed weapons, weapon upgrade won't start.
*Kill points can be obtained only in a room with more than 4 users

notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/Darkness/01st_season4_map4.jpg[/img]

Your greatest Zombie Scenario fight awaits! Log in today to see if you can defeat the FINAL map of CSN:Z’s latest Zombie Scenario expansion. [u][b]It’s also a great time to get your 10x FREE Decoders from our latest daily login event![/b][/u]


[i]Click for [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/fr.html]Français[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/de.html]Deutsch[/url] ,[url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/it.html]Italiano[/url] ,[url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/pl.html]Polski[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/tr.html]Türkçe[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/ru.html]Pусский[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/br.html]Português[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/es.html]Español[/url].[/i]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0701_2.jpg[/img]

Did Gerrard and Jim, Leader of the Red Lizard Mercenaries, ever think agreeing to locate some research samples would take them on a path straight towards such a sinister villain? Dr. Rex and his Super Soldier Project are the source of the Zombies, and the reason for so many ruined lives. However, this monster has long since been lost to the Darkness, and this leaves our heroes only one option.

There’s no turning back now! Someone must put a stop to Dr. Rex, or else the world may forever be lost in Darkness.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0701_3.jpg[/img]

It will hurt if you rush into this battle blindly, as Dr. Rex has some aces left up his sleeve and you will need to truly be prepared for a fight. Not only will your team need to coordinate and cooperate to advance through this latest map’s challenges, but some big foes are standing between you and Dr. Rex.

Dr. Rex has an army of the undead, powerful Super Soldiers, and towering monsters at his disposal—no, he will not go quietly. 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0701_4.png[/img]

Veterans of Zombie Scenario may recognize some of his attacks, Dr. Rex ‘reflecting’ some of his most devastating creations in this showdown, but don’t let your guard down. Keep your distance from Dr. Rex, a man consumed by Darkness shows no mercy and may kill you instantly!

Are you prepared to reveal what has been at the root of such horrifying Darkness? Dr. Rex is waiting for you…

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0701_5.jpg[/img]

notes.title: [UPDATE] Zombie Shelter Map HELLRIDE is now available!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/Darkness/30th_shelter.jpg[/img]

All aboard! Zombie Shelter has just gotten a new Co-Op map with new challenges for your squad to try and survive. [u][b]Log in today to get a turn on the train car and get your 10x FREE Decoders![/b][/u]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0625_1.jpg[/img]

[i]Click for [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/fr.html]Français[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/de.html]Deutsch[/url] ,[url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/it.html]Italiano[/url] ,[url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/pl.html]Polski[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/tr.html]Türkçe[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/ru.html]Pусский[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/br.html]Português[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/es.html]Español[/url].[/i]


Zombie Shelter not only puts your survival skills to the test, it also requires a team of survivors to really flex their carpentry skills! Each day offers a limited window of time to gather resources and explore further away from the team’s shelter, but when night arrives Humans must work together to keep their shelter from succumbing to the undead. 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0630_2.jpg[/img]

To stay alive, up to 4 team members need to construct additions and improvements to their Shelter using resources collected throughout the map.

Get resources, build watch towers, kill Zombies, defeat bosses, race traincars… hold on a second, what was that last one?

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0630_3.jpg[/img]

[b]HELLRIDE is the first map in Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies to include vehicles! [/b]In the map are 2 traincars that players can operate, allowing for much faster movement throughout the map. Just as teams must work together to survive each day of Zombie Shelter, remember to take turns! 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0630_4.png[/img]

When in a traincar, press the [E] key to operate it. While operating a traincar tap the forward or backward movement keys (default: [W] and [S] keys.) to accelerate forwards, reduce speed, or switch down to reverse gear.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0630_5.png[/img]

Teamwork is also required for making the most of the traincars, such as clearing obstacles off the tracks and controlling which paths are taken using the rail’s switches. 

[h1][b]Zombie Shelter Tips[/b][/h1]
Of course, it doesn’t hurt to understand some important tips about making the most of Zombie Shelter!

[b]--Share Resources:[/b] Wood and Iron collected is stored on your character, but don’t go hoarding it. Put Wood and Iron in the Shelter’s storage of resources so other team members can get to work on constructing needed buildings.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0630_6.jpg[/img]

[b]--Build it Big:[/b] Press the[noparse] [B] [/noparse]key in-game to see what is available to construct. There’s a large variety of choices to help your team survive each day of Zombie Shelter. It’s important to know that some construction options have dependencies, and you may have to start small before the very big choices are possible.

[b]--Use Your Skills:[/b] Press the [N] key in-game to apply skill points towards a variety of different talents. Surviving more days means more skill points, so do not forget to put your skills to use!

[b]--Mind the Meter:[/b] Home is where the heart is, but it’s also immediately vital to your survival! At the bottom of your screen is a meter that depletes when traveling away from your Shelter. 


[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0630_7.jpg[/img]

All aboard! Zombie Shelter has just gotten a new Co-Op map with new challenges for your squad to try and survive. [u][b]Log in today to get a turn on the train car and get your 10x FREE Decoders![/b][/u]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0625_1.jpg[/img]

[i]Click for [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/fr.html]Français[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/de.html]Deutsch[/url] ,[url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/it.html]Italiano[/url] ,[url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/pl.html]Polski[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/tr.html]Türkçe[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/ru.html]Pусский[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/br.html]Português[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/es.html]Español[/url].[/i]


Zombie Shelter not only puts your survival skills to the test, it also requires a team of survivors to really flex their carpentry skills! Each day offers a limited window of time to gather resources and explore further away from the team’s shelter, but when night arrives Humans must work together to keep their shelter from succumbing to the undead. 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0630_2.jpg[/img]

To stay alive, up to 4 team members need to construct additions and improvements to their Shelter using resources collected throughout the map.

Get resources, build watch towers, kill Zombies, defeat bosses, race traincars… hold on a second, what was that last one?

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0630_3.jpg[/img]

[b]HELLRIDE is the first map in Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies to include vehicles! [/b]In the map are 2 traincars that players can operate, allowing for much faster movement throughout the map. Just as teams must work together to survive each day of Zombie Shelter, remember to take turns! 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0630_4.png[/img]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0630_5.png[/img]

Teamwork is also required for making the most of the traincars, such as clearing obstacles off the tracks and controlling which paths are taken using the rail’s switches.

Of course, it doesn’t hurt to understand some important tips about making the most of Zombie Shelter!

[b]--Share Resources:[/b] Wood and Iron collected is stored on your character, but don’t go hoarding it. Put Wood and Iron in the Shelter’s storage of resources so other team members can get to work on constructing needed buildings.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0630_6.jpg[/img]

[b]--Build it Big:[/b] Press the[noparse] [B] [/noparse]key in-game to see what is available to construct. There’s a large variety of choices to help your team survive each day of Zombie Shelter. It’s important to know that some construction options have dependencies, and you may have to start small before the very big choices are possible.

[b]--Use Your Skills:[/b] Press the [N] key in-game to apply skill points towards a variety of different talents. Surviving more days means more skill points, so do not forget to put your skills to use!

[b]--Mind the Meter:[/b] Home is where the heart is, but it’s also immediately vital to your survival! At the bottom of your screen is a meter that depletes when traveling away from your Shelter. 


[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0630_7.jpg[/img]

If it depletes fully, your HP will begin to drop until either you get back to the Shelter or die on your feet! [b][u]If your vision begins to go dark, it’s a warning you need to get back to the Shelter ASAP. [/u][/b]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0630_8.jpg[/img]

Don’t get too caught up in the fun of dueling traincars in HELLRIDE, as Zombie Shelter is both about daily surviving and surviving the worst of which Zombies can throw at a team of Humans…

notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/Darkness/29th_season4_map3.jpg[/img]

The incredible battle through Darkness continues with the next Zombie Scenario Season 4 map! [u][b]Log in today to take on map 3 of CSN:Z’s latest Zombie Scenario expansion, and also get your 10x FREE Decoders from our latest event![/b][/u]

[i]Click for [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/fr.html]Français[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/de.html]Deutsch[/url] ,[url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/it.html]Italiano[/url] ,[url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/pl.html]Polski[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/tr.html]Türkçe[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/ru.html]Pусский[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/br.html]Português[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/es.html]Español[/url].[/i]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0629_2.jpg[/img]

Whoever Gerrard and Jim, Leader of the Red Lizard Mercenaries, are tracking down is no ordinary fiend. This much is true even if the monster has managed to keep their identity in the dark. As battle torn and weary as these mercenary teams may be, they have come too far to stop now.

Who could imagine that the dangers awaiting these Zombie-battling mercenaries grow even larger and greater? And, possibly, they may encounter revelations even more twisted...

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0629_3.jpg[/img]

Zombie Scenario is not about fair fights, so no one should be surprised that a true challenge waits at the end. With Map 3 of Zombie Scenario Season 4, it is the first time the boss battle is teaming up against the Humans!

Your eyes are not playing tricks on you. [u][b]Players must face off against two towering super soldiers, Neid and Zavist.[/b][/u] Both Neid and Zavist must be defeated, and do not pretend that they will not team up against Humans who are foolish enough to reach them and put their incredible size and strength to use in the fight. Goodness, those are some huge swords…

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0629_4.png[/img]

Those who have lasted this long while venturing so deep into the Darkness are brave souls. A commendable effort for uncovering the evil which lurks this far, but the journey to defeat it is not over yet.

notes.title: [UPDATE] Zombie Darkness mode is now available!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/Darkness/zombie_darkness.jpg[/img]

Zombie VS Human PvP combat is about to take a dark turn! The latest mode Zombie Darkness is now available. [u][b]Log in to try it out and get your 10x FREE Decoders from our latest event![/b][/u]

[i]Click for [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/fr.html]Français[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/de.html]Deutsch[/url] ,[url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/it.html]Italiano[/url] ,[url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/pl.html]Polski[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/tr.html]Türkçe[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/ru.html]Pусский[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/br.html]Português[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/es.html]Español[/url].[/i]

In Zombie Darkness, new grotesque classes of Zombies are waiting to spread the undead infection to you and your currently-living team mates. However, don’t suit up for battle thinking all your strategies and tricks you’ve been refining will work as well in these new arenas. 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0628_2.png[/img]

Normally, a strong camping strategy can outlast the undead. In Zombie Darkness, each map transitions from daylight to twilight, and under the cover of darkness, the Zombies gain a powerful advantage. Both all new Zombie classes and Human players will have new tricks to learn, making Zombie Darkness a new challenge for both long time survivors and newcomers alike!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0628_3.jpg[/img]

Staying alive is not just the goal of Zombie Darkness as a Human, but also the means of putting unique skills to work against the undead. During each match, Adrenaline builds over time which can be used for Human abilities unique to Zombie Darkness.

Sprinting is an effective strategy for making the trek across more open areas of the map, and a well placed Kick can quickly tell a Zombie to back off. However, the skill of Concentrated Fire is vital in Zombie Darkness and what separates the survivors from the leaders. 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0628_4.jpg[/img]

Build the Adrenaline gauge high enough, and Concentrated Fire will not only deal far higher damage to a Zombie but will put them down for good.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0628_5.jpg[/img]

Humans have new ways of keeping the Darkness at bay, but they’ll need it to take on the nightmarish creations they’ll find in that Darkness…

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0628_6.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]NORMAL ZOMBIE[/b][/h1] – As the name implies, these Zombies are a staple of Zombie Darkness. Sprinting is great for ambushing unsuspecting Human enemies, but it is their wall climbing ability which can turn the tide in favor of the living dead. The Humans will be trying to hide high out of reach, so don’t let them get too comfortable.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0628_7.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]LIGHT ZOMBIE[/b][/h1] – Less hearty than other classes, the Light Zombie does not excel at defense but makes up for this with the ability to leap high distances. When leaping between buildings cannot get the job done, the invisibility skill can help get the drop on distracted Humans. 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0628_8.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]HEAVY ZOMBIE[/b][/h1] – Speed? Mobility? Subtlety? These are not ways the Heavy Zombie class rolls. Unleash a powerful slam to the ground to get Humans shaking in their boots, or harden against incoming fire to withstand even greater amounts of damage.

Could Humans possibly withstand even more undead terror as nightfall approaches?... 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0628_9.png[/img]

Are you afraid of the Darkness? CSN:Z’s latest in Zombie PVP mode may test if you can keep your composure as night approaches, but everyone is still being drawn deeper into the void…


[b]Let us know what you think in the comments and CSN:Z Forums.[/b] Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

LIGHT ZOMBIE – Less hearty than other classes, the Light Zombie does not excel at defense but makes up for this with the ability to leap high distances.
HEAVY ZOMBIE – Speed? Mobility? Subtlety? These are not ways the Heavy Zombie class rolls.

notes.title: [UPDATE] Zombie Files mode is now available!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/Darkness/Zombie_files.jpg[/img]

If you’re brave enough, try our new Zombie Files mode in CSN:Z and learn how the Zombie outbreak began. On top of our new mode, log in to get your 10x FREE Decoders from our latest event!

[i]Click for [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/fr.html]Français[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/de.html]Deutsch[/url] ,[url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/it.html]Italiano[/url] ,[url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/pl.html]Polski[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/tr.html]Türkçe[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/ru.html]Pусский[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/br.html]Português[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/es.html]Español[/url].[/i]

Not everyone is a mercenary, soldier, or gun toting professional in an outbreak of the undead. Senior Researcher Soi is far more familiar with a pipette than a pistol, but she rose to the occasion and survived!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0626_2.jpg[/img]

…But, how did Senior Researcher Soi survive? How did the outbreak begin? To find out, you must uncover what is within the Zombie Files…

[h1][b]SPRINTING, STAMINA, SURVIVAL[/b][/h1]

Zombie Files provides a much different challenge than what you may be used to in existing modes like Zombie Scenario or Zombie Hero. Being a single player mode, there won’t be any team mates to watch your back but a group of players can join a match to indirectly compete for fastest map completion.

Another important difference is Stamina, which governs the actions Senior Researcher Soi can perform. Sprinting will come in handy, but getting winded trying to escape may prevent you from attacking any zombies until your Stamina refills!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0626_3.jpg[/img]

Use your wits to survive in the Zombie Files. The body count may just end up adding your own to the pile!

[h1][b]HELPFUL SURVIVAL TIPS[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Find throwable items to lure Zombies away from your path before proceeding further, they’ll follow the sound of the object landing!
[*]Sprinting may let you escape, but keeping quiet may prevent the Zombies from ever giving chase to begin with.
[*]Grab a breather when you can. Stamina recharges, but takes a moment of time to refill completely.
[*]Finding weapons is a staple of any Zombie outbreak, but just like a Zombie outbreak it is vital to conserve ammo! You’ll have to find another gun if the one you have runs out of ammo.
[/list]

[h1][b]ESCAPING ZOMBIES AND EXECUTING ZOMBIES[/b][/h1]

Should your best efforts flop, it may become a life or death struggle with the Zombies. Always try to keep your distance or else Zombies may grab you and steadily drain your HP! Repeatedly press the [E] key to ESCAPE and quickly put space between yourself and the undead.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0626_4.jpg[/img]

However, there is value for getting in close when a Zombie is on the verge of defeat. Get in close and press the [E] key to instantly finish off the walking corpse!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0626_5.jpg[/img]


The secrets of the Zombie Files can be revealed to you, but only if you can survive to the bitter end. Don’t worry! It’s not like humanity’s fate is resting in the hands of one researcher caught in the epicenter of a Zombie infection outbreak, right?

…Right? 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0626_6.png[/img]

notes.title: [UPDATE] Zombie Giant mode is now available!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/1_en.png[/img]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/menu1.png[/img]

Today uncovers the first horrifying secret of the Darkness, and it is truly a GIANT one. [u][b]Log in today to not only try out CSN:Z’s brand new mode ZOMBIE GIANT, but also to get your 10x FREE Decoders from our latest event![/b][/u]


[i]Click for [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/fr.html]Français[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/de.html]Deutsch[/url] ,[url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/it.html]Italiano[/url] ,[url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/pl.html]Polski[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/tr.html]Türkçe[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/ru.html]Pусский[/url]
[url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/br.html]Português[/url] [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/es.html]Español[/url].[/i]


[h1][b]Mode Review:[/b][/h1]
In CSN:Z’s latest game mode, Humans take on Zombies in exciting combat to either survive another day or succumb to the terrors of the undead. This may all seem familiar to our experienced players, but Zombie Giant is anything but.

A Human player is randomly selected to join the Zombie team, but as a towering terrifying Zombie Boss! Suddenly, joining the undead doesn’t seem so bad. 

Humans will need to work as a team to take down the massive beast that used to be their comrade, but then another is selected to unleash some damage...

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0624_1.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Zombie Team:[/b][/h1]
There are 3 Zombie Bosses that the player may become when selected to join the Zombie Team: Dione, Revenant, or Fallen Titan. They’re all great for destroying puny Humans, but make sure to put their unique skills to work for you.

Four skills are available, but the final fourth skill is only available if you’re a proper Zombie Giant and take out enough Human enemies to Evolve during combat.

[h1][b]Human Team:[/b][/h1]
Odds do not seem to be in the Human’s favor, but when are they ever? Don’t give up hope just yet! For scoring kills on the Zombie Giants, or doing your part to help, Humans are awarded Support Points that can be used to level the playing field.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0624_2.png[/img]

For starters, you’re not alone in this fight! Bot characters will help Humans chip away at the Zombie Giant. This is a good start, but the Humans will need more.
A few Support Points can be spent to restock for another skirmish, and building a larger stockpile of Support Points can put some military-grade weaponry in the map to work for you… but if you get truly wealthy with Support Points?

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0624_4.jpg[/img]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0624_3.png[/img]

Let’s just say it will be a hell of a fight.

notes.title: [UPDATE] Zombie Giant mode is now available!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/1_en.png[/img]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/menu1.png[/img]

Today uncovers the first horrifying secret of the Darkness, and it is truly a GIANT one. [u][b]Log in today to not only try out CSN:Z’s brand new mode ZOMBIE GIANT, but also to get your 10x FREE Decoders from our latest event![/b][/u]


[i]Click for [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/fr.html]Français[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/de.html]Deutsch[/url] ,[url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/it.html]Italiano[/url] ,[url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/pl.html]Polski[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/tr.html]Türkçe[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/ru.html]Pусский[/url]
[url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/br.html]Português[/url] [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/es.html]Español[/url].[/i]


[h1][b]Mode Review:[/b][/h1]
In CSN:Z’s latest game mode, Humans take on Zombies in exciting combat to either survive another day or succumb to the terrors of the undead. This may all seem familiar to our experienced players, but Zombie Giant is anything but.

A Human player is randomly selected to join the Zombie team, but as a towering terrifying Zombie Boss! Suddenly, joining the undead doesn’t seem so bad. 

Humans will need to work as a team to take down the massive beast that used to be their comrade, but then another is selected to unleash some damage...

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0624_1.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Zombie Team:[/b][/h1]
There are 3 Zombie Bosses that the player may become when selected to join the Zombie Team: Dione, Revenant, or Fallen Titan. They’re all great for destroying puny Humans, but make sure to put their unique skills to work for you.

Four skills are available, but the final fourth skill is only available if you’re a proper Zombie Giant and take out enough Human enemies to Evolve during combat.

[h1][b]Human Team:[/b][/h1]
Odds do not seem to be in the Human’s favor, but when are they ever? Don’t give up hope just yet! For scoring kills on the Zombie Giants, or doing your part to help, Humans are awarded Support Points that can be used to level the playing field.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0624_2.png[/img]

For starters, you’re not alone in this fight! Bot characters will help Humans chip away at the Zombie Giant. This is a good start, but the Humans will need more.
A few Support Points can be spent to restock for another skirmish, and building a larger stockpile of Support Points can put some military-grade weaponry in the map to work for you… but if you get truly wealthy with Support Points?

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0624_4.jpg[/img]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0624_3.png[/img]

Let’s just say it will be a hell of a fight.

It’s good to be bad! Log in to CSN:Z today and serve up some GIANT sized mayhem.

notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/banner_en_spreading.jpg[/img]

The Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies team is proud to announce some big additions in our latest update... continent-sized additions to be specific!

[i]Click for [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/fr2.html]Français[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/de2.html]Deutsch[/url] ,[url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/it2.html]Italiano[/url] ,[url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/pl2.html]Polski[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/tr2.html]Türkçe[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/ru2.html]Pусский[/url]
[url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/br2.html]Português[/url] [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/es2.html]Español[/url].[/i]


[h1][b]Quick rundown:[/b][/h1]
[b]-- CSN:Z now offers language support for Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese.
-- Regions of South America and MENA are now officially supported by CSN:Z.
-- 10x Free Decoders at login each day through 1st July.
-- New rewards in Decoder with increased probability event from 24th June through 7th of July
-- Decoders from Battlefield Supply on days 4 and 7 and new daily rewards. [/b]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/lang1.png[/img]

Whether shooting Zombies with friends, shooting friends that are Zombies, or enjoying all the rest which CSN:Z has to offer, it can make a world of difference being able to do so in your preferred language.

[u][b]To help make CSN:Z a great experience for even more of our players, we have added Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese language options.[/b] 

[/u]Whether you want to use these new languages, or switch to any of the other languages CSN:Z supports, you can do this through the Interface page of the Steam Settings window.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/lang2.jpg[/img]

The CSN:Z Team is proud to announce that even more countries around the globe can join in on the Zombie mayhem. It just wouldn’t feel like a proper Zombie outbreak if the infection didn’t start hopping to new continents! [u][b]Starting 24.06, the new regions 

being officially supported can access CSN:Z and get started playing.[/b][/u]

[h1][b]South American regions CSN:Z has been opened to:[/b][/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/lang2.png[/img]

[h1][b]MENA regions CSN:Z has been opened to;[/b][/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/lang3.png[/img]

What better way is there to welcome these new regions to CSN:Z than with FREE Decoders?

[h1][b]Each day from 24th June through 1st July, receive 10x Decoders for FREE instantly when logging in to CSN:Z. Log in every day of the event to get 10x bundle of FREE Decoders![/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/0625_1.jpg[/img]

Remember that every Decoder activated also awards a random sum of Mileage. Spend the Mileage you’ve accumulated on your Bingo Board to unlock even MORE rewards.

Please note that the event is set to Central Europe Summer Time (CEST), please check the difference between your region’s time zone and CEST when making sure you log in to get every reward.

…And what better to go with tons of FREE Decoders than new Decoder rewards?

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/lang3.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Avalanche[/b][/u] – This is more than just a futuristic looking machine gun! Switch between the Avalanche’s different firing modes to land more precise controlled shots or live up to the weapon’s name with an Avalanche of lead.

[u][b]Blaster[/b][/u] – With its large capacity 45 round magazine, the Blaster rifle can sling some serious amounts of lead at a target before needing to reload. The CSN:Z Team will understand if you still choose to reload after firing only a few shots just to watch the Blaster load and unload each magazine.

Take advantage of increased probability event to get a hold of the brand new Avalanche and Blaster!

[u][b]From 24th of June through 7th of July both weapons will have double the chances to be drawn from Decoder.[/b][/u]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/lang4.png[/img]

You can see the event is running by the golden tag and a x2 sign next to those items from within the Decoder menu.

[h1][b]LOG IN![/b][/h1] – Free Decoders from Battlefield Supply and new weapon sets.
[b]From 24th of June, redeeming your daily Battlefield Supply reward will get you free Decoders. On the 4th  reward day, the prize is 1x Decoder. On the 7th reward day, the prize is 2x Decoders.  [/b]
Additionally each other day you will receive limited duration, high ROF weapons: MG3, MG36, MK48, M134, M2.
This will surely help any survivor to fight of new hordes of Zombies that came along with latest content expansion.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/lang5.jpg[/img]

In case you were wondering what is this new Coupon system in the Item Shop, we can tell you we  have prepared something special for CSN:Z, that will become active very soon. Stay tuned for more information revealed in following weeks.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0624/lang6.png[/img]


[b]Let us know what you think in the comments and CSN:Z Forums. [/b]Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.title: NEW! – Salamander and Sten MK2 PERFECT PICKS!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0511/en_recipes.jpg[/img]

Whether you need some new firepower, or just need straight up FIRE, you better check out the new Perfect Pick Recipe bundles available in CSN:Z!

[h1][b]SALAMANDER[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/weapon1.png[/img]

Do you need Zombies engulfed in flames? The Salamander can take care of that and whatever else you need set on fire in an instant.

[h1][b]STEN MK2[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/weapon2.png[/img]

This sub machinegun may not look like much beyond a gun barrel and a trigger, but it is an important piece of military history. Light and minimal construction helped arm numerous troops during World War II, and it will help you stay light on your feet while evading Zombies in CSN:Z.


Crafting with a Perfect Pick Recipe will guarantee the outcome is the Recipe’s weapon, helping you get your hands on the latest additions to crafting faster!
Don’t hesitate for too long on these deals!  These Perfect Pick Recipe Sets will only be available from the Shop for a limited time.

For further news and details about the changes made with this latest release, please see our Steam Announcement for the latest Maintenance;

http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/130946540513680120

During the maintenance we will patch the servers. 

Regards,
CSN:Z Team

[h1][b]FREE DECODERS![/b][/h1]
That alone is a great statement, but we recommend reading further to learn more about the FREE Decoders, as well as the other events waiting for you in the latest CSN:Z update.

[i]Click for [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/fr1.html]Français[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/de1.html]Deutsch[/url] ,[url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/it1.html]Italiano[/url] ,[url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/pl1.html]Polski[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/tr1.html]Türkçe[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/ru1.html]Pусский[/url] .[/i]


[h1][b]Quick rundown![/b][/h1]
[b]-- Finishing Daily Missions awards Decoders, up to 10 per day!
-- 5x FREE Decoders for logging in on Saturday, or Sunday, or both!
-- Full set of [S] Blueprints for racking up Fight Yard kills!
-- 50% bonus for both EXP and Points on the weekend![/b]

Want to learn more about Fight Yard and other changes to CSN:Z?
We have you covered! Click the link below to learn more.

http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/130945904547299268

[h1][b]EVENT! – Daily Mission Big Bonus for FREE DECODERS![/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/event1.png[/img]

[b]From 30th April through 10th June, completing Daily Missions awards the player with a nice big bonus of FREE Decoders![/b]

Completing a Daily Mission awards the player a bonus 1x Decoder, with a maximum of 10x Decoders per day. This event can be repeated every day, meaning a little time helping out  survivors such as Commander Victor and Signalman Felix can earn you 10x FREE Decoders each day of the event!

Please note that this event only applies to Daily Missions.

[h1][b]LOGIN REWARD! – Drop in for FREE Decoders every weekend![/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/event2_en.png[/img]

…no, seriously! It’s that easy!
[b]Starting 2nd May and continuing through 7th June, log in to CSN:Z on the weekend and receive 5x Free Decoders. The login reward of 5x Decoders can be received on both Saturday and Sunday of each weekend during the event.[/b]

Each of these FREE Decoders is another chance you might get the brand new PERMANENT weapons added to Decoder, Papin, and Savery!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/event3.png[/img]

Mark your calendars and set your alarms to stop by CSN:Z on the following days!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/event4_en.png[/img]

[h1][b]EVENT! – Fight in Fight Yard for [S] Blueprints![/b][/h1]

[b]From 30.04 to 10.06, racking up kills in the brand new Fight Yard mode will be more than just gratifying when they lead to a big [S] Blueprint Reward.[/b] As if anyone needs more reason to frag their friends!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/event5.png[/img]

[b]During the event period, earn a total of 100 kills to receive a full set of [S] Blueprints (6 total, Grades 1 through 6)[/b]. Remember that [S] Blueprints have a 100% chance of successful crafting, so be sure to Synthesize yourself some 72 Day-Permanent Durables if you haven’t been doing so already!

Please note that the 100 kills do not have to be earned in a single day. This event reward can only be earned once during the event period.

[h1][b]EVENT! – 50% Bonus EXP and Points every weekend, twice each day![/b][/h1]

CSN:Z is offering even more reasons to drop in each weekend to try out those FREE Decoder rewards.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/event6_en.jpg[/img]

[b]From 02.05 to 07.06, each weekend will have 50% Bonus EXP and Points for matches completed during the following times:
18:00 – 22:00 CEST
02:00 - 06:00 CEST[/b]
Please note these times are for Central European Summer Time (CEST). For our USA players, 50% Bonus EXP/Points can be earned between 9AM-1PM and 5PM-9PM Pacific Time Zone.

notes.title: NEW! Classic CS Action with Fight Yard, Decoder Events, and MORE! (1/2)
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0430/patch.jpg[/img]

The latest Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies update lets players return to the Original CS arena of CT vs TR fights to the death within Fight Yard.

As Fight Yard maps require players to invent new ways of thinking fast on their feet, there are new weapons coming to Decoder that (mostly) take inspiration from some great inventors from history!

[i]Click for [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/fr2.html]Français[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/de2.html]Deutsch[/url] ,[url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/it2.html]Italiano[/url] ,[url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/pl2.html]Polski[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/tr2.html]Türkçe[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/ru2.html]Pусский[/url] .[/i]


[h1][b]Quick rundown![/b][/h1]
[b]-- Fight Yard has arrived in CSN:Z. 
-- Decoder is getting a steamy update of weapons. 
-- Changes have been made to improve usability of CSN:Z.[/b]

Some players may be very curious about the EVENTS we’re offering!
Such players may want to click the following link!

http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/130945904547440375
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/patch1.png[/img]

In the Original Counter-Strike, the option for a strict Team Deathmatch was not possible, requiring players think up creative ways where killing the enemy could be the focus of a map. Such creativity lead CS fans to create [b]Fight Yard[/b], also known as FY Maps!

Round-based annihilation gets a challenging twist where your possible arsenal is laid out for any team member to grab in those first precious seconds, and no Buy Zone to load up on armor and equipment. Grab your gun, take down the enemy team, and survive until the next round with the gun you already grabbed to get the upper hand!

There are two CQC maps available for Fight Yard:

[h1][b]NEW! – Ice World Map[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/patch2_en.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]UPDATED! – Gallery Map[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/patch3_en.jpg[/img]

Players may be familiar already with Gallery, but Ice World is a must have for any Fight Yard selection! And what better way to combat an icy battlefield than with…


[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/patch4_en.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]NEW! – Savery[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/patch5.png[/img]

Steam power helps cycle rounds through this sniper rifle for a very fast rate of fire, and its unique revolver styled cylinder allows the player to reload quickly as well!

[h1][b]NEW! Papin[/b][/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/patch6.png[/img]

When it’s time for fisticuffs, make sure to bring along your pair of steam powered armored fists that can unleash red hot blades after building up enough steam pressure.

The latest CSN:Z update also addresses the following issues to help make the game more enjoyable for our global audience.

[h1][b]UPDATED! – Mute BOT Radio Messages[/b][/h1]

Players can now choose to mute the radio messages sent out by computer controlled players in BOT modes of CSN:Z. This option can be found in the Advanced Multiplayer Options menu.

[img] http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0429/patch7_en.png[/img]

[h1][b]UPDATED! – Language Auto-Detection[/b][/h1]

CSN:Z will now automatically set its language to what your Steam is set to. If your Steam language is set to one not supported by CSN:Z, CSN:Z will fall back to English as a default.

[h1][b]UPDATED! – Option for Mouse Acceleration[/b][/h1]

An option for changing how CSN:Z checks for Mouse Acceleration is available in the ‘Mouse’ page of the Options menu with the latest content update.

[h1][b]UPDATED! – Numeric Keypad Support for Buy Menu[/b][/h1]

The numeric keypad will now work with CSN:Z’s Buy menus in-game as optional shortcuts for menu navigation with the latest content update.

[h1][b]UPDATED! – Curse Filter Corrected[/b][/h1]

In our previous content update, the curse filter had been changed to restrict a much larger range of words than intended. We have corrected the curse filter in this latest update.


[b]Let us know what you think in the comments and CSN:Z Forums.[/b] Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z! 

Facebook (English): https://www.facebook.com/en.CSNZ 
Facebook (Polish): https://www.facebook.com/pl.CSNZ 
VK: http://vk.com/public78659129 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/CSN_Z

notes.title: EVENTS! – No Fooling! Earn 30x FREE Decoders and More (2/2)
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/en2.jpg[/img]

The latest update to CSN:Z is bringing in a huge amount of events... HUGE.


[h1][b]Quick rundown![/b][/h1]
-- Battlefield Supply awards Decoders on days 3 and 7.
-- Log in for a free, one-time bundle of Decoders.
-- Log in for a free, one-time bonus of Bingo Mileage.
-- Our Seed event lets you earn varied tiers of prizes by clocking gametime.
-- Enjoy daily boosts of EXP in two blocks of time each day.
-- Trial Weapons are back for Zombie Scenario! Try out 2 free high powered guns for zombie slaying.
-- Don’t look too foolish with our 1st of April events!


[h1][b]LOG IN! – Free Decoders from Battlefield Supply[/b][/h1]
[b]From 1st through 30th April[/b], redeeming your daily Battlefield Supply reward will get you free Decoders! On the 3rd reward day, the prize is 1x Decoder. On the 7th reward day, the prize is 2x Decoders.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/en2-1.jpg[/img]


[h1][b]LOG IN! – Free one-time gift of Decoders[/b][/h1]
[b]From 1st through 30th April[/b], CSN:Z is giving every player that logs in a FREE package of 30x Decoders! This is a system loaded with great prizes, and we want every player of CSN:Z to enjoy trying it out, on the house.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/2-2.jpg[/img]

Please note that this reward is a one-time gift awarded on the first login made during the event period.


[h1][b]LOG IN! – Free one-time gift of Bingo Mileage[/b][/h1]
[b]From 1st through 30th April[/b], CSN:Z is giving every player that logs in a coupon for 200 free Bingo Mileage! When playing Bingo, Mileage is used to perform the different available actions on your board such as resetting the rewards selection or changing what range of Bingo numbers may be selected.

Please note that this reward is a one-time gift awarded on the first login made during the event period.


[h1][b]PLAY! – Grow your rewards with CSN:Z’s Seed Event[/b][/h1]
[b]From 1st through 15th April[/b], log in each day to receive a Seed. The rewards it offers aren’t very nourishing, but playing matches of CSN:Z will help it grow into some much more fulfilling prizes!

Play for 60 minutes to grow the Seed into a Sapling, and play for another 90 minutes to earn a Fruit item. Spring gardening can be hard work, but when there are Crafting Blueprints in Saplings and Decoders in those Fruit items, it can be worth the effort!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/2-3.png[/img]

The Seed Event can be repeated each day. Seed, Sapling, and Fruit items will be removed from your inventory at midnight CEST (Noon for US eastern time zone) if you have not yet redeemed the items for prizes.


[h1][b]PLAY! – Daily EXP +50% Boost[/b][/h1]
[b]From 1st through 30th April[/b], enjoy a bonus +50% to EXP earned from finished matches, twice each day! 
The +50% EXP bonus is active during 18:00 – 20:00 CEST and 02:00 – 06:00 CEST (1PM – 5PM and 9PM – 1AM US eastern time zone).

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/2-4.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]PLAY! – New Trial Weapons for Zombie Scenario[/b][/h1]
[b]From 1st through 30th April[/b], your inventory will have some high powered Zombie killing weaponry for free! These Trial Weapons can be used in specific maps of Zombie Scenario mode throughout the event period without any Crafting or time limits.

[b]--Zombie Scenario Map “Angra Nest” gets the SKULL-5[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/2-6.jpg[/img]
[b]--Zombie Scenario Map “Panic Room” gets the SUKLL-6[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/2-7.jpg[/img]

These are the final maps of Chapter 2 and Chapter 3, so you may need to rely on the firepower of these Trial Weapons to survive! Good luck.


[h1][b]EVENT! – Reversed Map Item[/b][/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/2-8.jpg[/img]
[b]Only on 1st April[/b], players will receive a special Map Reversing item that will create some new challenges in the following Original maps by reversing the CT and TR spawn areas:
-- Dust 2
-- Inferno
-- Nuke
-- Train

However, the zones where CT and TR players buy their guns and equipment are NOT reversed. The heat is on to not only complete your team’s objective, but to hustle across the map and buy your guns and gear before the round is over!


[h1][b]LOG IN! – Free Fake Sprays[/b][/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/2-9.jpg[/img]
[b]From 1st through 5th April[/b], log in each day to receive a free 30Day Fake Spray.
-- Lighting SMG-1
-- Gold SL8
-- AT4CS
-- Terrorist
-- Counter-Terrorist

Leave your mark with these Sprays and see if you can fool your fellow CSN:Z players!


Let us know what you think in the comments and CSN:Z Forums. Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.title: NEW CONTENT – Decoders, Cleaner Crafting, and MORE! (1/2)
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/en1.jpg[/img]
There is a lot of great stuff from the latest Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies update, but some of our players might be very excited just by seeing ‘Decoder’!

Relax, breathe, and read on to learn all about what you will find in the latest CSN:Z update.

[i]Click for [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/fr1.html]Français[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/de1.html]Deutsch[/url] ,[url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/it1.html]Italiano[/url] ,[url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/pl1.html]Polski[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/tr1.html]Türkçe[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/ru1.html]Pусский[/url] .[/i]

[h1][b]Quick rundown![/b][/h1]
-- Decoder is here and there are a lot of new weapons and items to be won from it.
-- Bingo is paired with Decoder to make sure you’re always on a path to earning great prizes.
-- Crafting and Synthesize menus have been improved to make the process simpler.
-- Full Turkish language support for CSN:Z.
-- D3D can be selected in video options for users who prefer it. 

[h1][b]NEW! – DECODER[/b][/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/1-1.jpg[/img]

A Decoder can unlock some great weapons and items, ones that you will not find anywhere else, and there are plenty of new goodies to be had! It is as simple as using the Decoder to find out what reward was encrypted within it.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/en1-2.jpg[/img]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/new_character.png[/img]

[h1][b]‘But Nexon, we wanted C-BOX!’[/b][/h1]

Our fans from Counter-Strike Online will feel right at home with our Decoder system. The process has been rebalanced but with goals of making the process both simpler and more fun for our players. A major part of this design is matching the new Bingo system with Decoders.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/en1-3.jpg[/img]

Decoder use racks up ‘Mileage’ that can be used in CSN:Z’s new Bingo board for collecting Bingo numbers. As you collect numbers on your Bingo board, completing vertical, horizontal, and diagonal lines will unlock rewards with a full board completion awarding a grand prize!

[b]Please note that Mileage may be earned from other various CSN:Z functions and features in future updates to the game.[/b]

There are a lot of new items to be found in Decoders... a lot. Keep checking back with CSN:Z to learn about when the rewards could be changing!


If only there were an incredible amount of events and free rewards for our players to celebrate the arrival of Decoders…
[b]If only learning about such events and rewards were as easy as clicking on a link in this page. If only![/b]
http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/129817471115947393

[h1][b]UPDATED! – Improved Crafting and Supply Menus[/b][/h1]
Crafting and Synthesis are a vital combination for getting your hands on new weapons in CSN:Z. With these menus being so important, they both have been given an update to streamline both Crafting and Synthesis.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/en1-4.jpg[/img]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/en1-5.jpg[/img]

The major details of these changes:
[b]•Menus now auto-fill your needed and best-choice materials with one click.
•The odds of success are now displayed.
•Using the Repeat option will no longer require interaction to accept each result.[/b]

We hope these changes make the Craft menus faster for our existing players, and easier to understand for newcomers just joining CSN:Z!

[h1][b]NEW! – Turkish Language Support[/b][/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/1-6.jpg[/img]

[b]With the 1st April update[/b], Turkish is now a fully supported language in CSN:Z!

You can choose this language, or any of the other languages CSN:Z supports, from the Language page of the Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies Properties window.

[h1][b]UPDATED! - D3D Video Settings Available[/b][/h1]
Thank you for sharing your feedback with us! The 1st April update adds ‘D3D’ back as a renderer option in CSN:Z for those who prefer it over ‘OpenGL’.

Please note that after choosing D3D, the CSN:Z game will need to be closed and restarted in order for it to switch to the D3D renderer.

[h1][b]‘But Nexon, we wanted C-BOX!’[/b][/h1]

Our fans from Counter-Strike Online will feel right at home with our Decoder system. The process has been rebalanced but with goals of making the process both simpler and more fun for our players. A major part of this design is matching the new Bingo system with Decoders.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/en1-3.jpg[/img]

Decoder use racks up ‘Mileage’ that can be used in CSN:Z’s new Bingo board for collecting Bingo numbers. As you collect numbers on your Bingo board, completing vertical, horizontal, and diagonal lines will unlock rewards with a full board completion awarding a grand prize!

[b]Please note that Mileage may be earned from other various CSN:Z functions and features in future updates to the game.[/b]

There are a lot of new items to be found in Decoders... a lot. Keep checking back with CSN:Z to learn about when the rewards could be changing!


If only there were an incredible amount of events and free rewards for our players to celebrate the arrival of Decoders…
[b]If only learning about such events and rewards were as easy as clicking on a link in this page. If only![/b]
http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/129817471115947393

[h1][b]UPDATED! – Improved Crafting and Supply Menus[/b][/h1]
Crafting and Synthesis are a vital combination for getting your hands on new weapons in CSN:Z. With these menus being so important, they both have been given an update to streamline both Crafting and Synthesis.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/en1-4.jpg[/img]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/en1-5.jpg[/img]

The major details of these changes:
[b]•Menus now auto-fill your needed and best-choice materials with one click.
•The odds of success are now displayed.
•Using the Repeat option will no longer require interaction to accept each result.[/b]

We hope these changes make the Craft menus faster for our existing players, and easier to understand for newcomers just joining CSN:Z!

[h1][b]NEW! – Turkish Language Support[/b][/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/1-6.jpg[/img]

[b]With the 1st April update[/b], Turkish is now a fully supported language in CSN:Z!

You can choose this language, or any of the other languages CSN:Z supports, from the Language page of the Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies Properties window.

[h1][b]UPDATED! - D3D Video Settings Available[/b][/h1]
Thank you for sharing your feedback with us! The 1st April update adds ‘D3D’ back as a renderer option in CSN:Z for those who prefer it over ‘OpenGL’.

Please note that after choosing D3D, the CSN:Z game will need to be closed and restarted in order for it to switch to the D3D renderer.

notes.title: NEW GUNS – M1 Garand and M32 MGL
notes.content:
There is a Zombie War going on, time to bring out some heavy hitting weaponry! (As if anyone needs an excuse to have fun with a grenade launcher.)

Check out the two latest weapons added to CSN:Z. If you really want to get your hands on these weapons NOW, the Perfect Pick Recipe Bundles in the Shop are what you’re looking for.

[h1]M1 Garand[/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0312/Pic01.jpg[/img]
This rifle is both historic and capable of dealing a whole lot of damage despite its age. Make those shots count as it only holds 8 rounds per clip and can only be reloaded once all rounds have been fired!
 
[h1]M32 MGL[/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0312/Pic02.jpg[/img]
Since when is subtlety needed in a Zombie War, or a Zombie Scenario? This grenade launcher uses a revolving cylinder to let its operator unleash repeated explosive attacks against enemies living and living-dead. You can also right-click when using the M32 MGL to land longer, more precise shots.


If a powerful rifle or raining down grenades is your style of fighting, visit the Shop to get Perfect Pick Recipe Bundles for either or both of the latest CSN:Z weapons! 

Let us know what you think in the comments and CSN:Z Forums. Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.title: NEW CONTENT – Prepare for WAR!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0226/en.jpg[/img]
Until now, the battle between Human and Zombie has been a chaotic fray of hot lead and decaying flesh. It was not clear who could be trusted when your best friend in the foxhole could turn on you in the next round of combat.

It is time that this gruesome fight between Living and Living-Dead break out into a full blown WAR.

[h1]NEW! – Zombie War[/h1]

Fans of Zombie PvP action will need to bring their best into the latest mode for Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies. In Zombie War, set teams are formed instead of randomized selection picking who will begin combat as a Zombie, letting you and your team play at your most fearsome and competitive!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/1.jpg[/img]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/2.jpg[/img]

When the round begins, the Human team is able to move through the map and secure the best places to dig in and defend. While Humans put their best strategies in motion, the Zombies are nowhere to be found… until the timer counts down to Zero. Once the timer reaches zero the Zombie team spawns into the map and the Zombie War begins! Once half of the rounds are completed, teams switch sides between Human and Zombie for the remainder of the match.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/3.jpg[/img]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/4.jpg[/img]

Forming set teams is not the only difference. Both Zombies and Humans stay dead for each round, and in the final 30 seconds of the round each side gets a boost to make those final moments count! Good luck hiding out the entire round when Zombies can see through walls in those final moments.

Don’t hold back! This is the time to bring your best strategies and team mates together for a real WAR!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/5.jpg[/img]

[h1]EVENT! – Rewards of WAR[/h1]

What does a good Zombie War need besides bodies to fill the front lines? Weapons, lots of weapons! Playing in the all new Zombie War mode will earn you free Crafting Bundles to make sure your armory is fully stocked.

[b]From 26th February to 12th March, play 30 minutes of Zombie War and receive the following Crafting Bundle:[/b]
-- 3x Random [A] Blueprint
-- 3x 24-30 Day Durable
-- 19,200 Points

[b]If you play an additional 30 minutes in that same day, you will receive an additional Crafting Bundle containing the following:[/b]
-- 1x Random [S] Blueprint
-- 1x 24-30 Day Durable
-- 6,400 Points

[I]Both sets of rewards can be earned once per day. A Zombie War match must have 4 or more players in order for its time to count towards the event.[/I]

[h1]NEW! – New Weapons, New Perfect Pick Recipe Bundles[/h1]

To help get pumped for war, there’s two new weapons for you to Craft and bring to the battlefield!

[b]M60E4 Maverick[/b] (Machinegun)

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/6.png[/img]

[b]Mauser C96[/b] (Pistol)

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/7.png[/img]

Following the 26th February Update, you can get your hands on these brand new weapons. If you’re looking to get your hands on these new weapons NOW check out the latest Perfect Pick Recipe Bundles in the shop featuring these two new armaments! Using the weapon’s Perfect Pick Recipe and its matching Crafting materials will guarantee the outcome of Crafting is the Recipe’s weapon!


Let us know what you think in the comments and CSN:Z Forums. Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.title: Read All About PvP 2.0!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0226/2_en.jpg  [/img]

Let us be clear and direct: this update is not touching gun stats! Save your pitchforks for another time, please.

We are making improvements to how PvP modes of Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies show combat info, and also how accomplishments made in-game can be showcased. These changes are designed to make the fun of shooting your Zombie and Non-Zombie friends a more rewarding experience!

[h1]NEW! – Assists[/h1]

Have you ever emptied magazines to pick away at an enemy’s health, only for someone to get a lucky shot and score the kill? With the PvP 2.0 update, the game will now identify when a kill had assistance!
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/8.jpg[/img]

Assists will help everyone know who has been pulling their weight on the team. But, simply ‘knowing’ may not be enough for some, which will be helped by…

[h1]NEW! – Valor[/h1]

Earn recognition for your hard work in matches with the new Valor system! Each Valor to be unlocked is tied to combat and objectives performed in CSN:Z game modes. While Missions and Medals cover a broad range of goals, Valor is all about the BATTLES you have waged.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/9.jpg[/img]

What must be done to earn Valor is hidden, but we trust our players are clever enough to get the hang of it quickly! At least, concerning combat before PvP 2.0, and not the new additions of…

[h1]UPDATED! – Action Report[/h1]

Headshots? Revenge kills? We hope everyone remembers those, but PvP 2.0 is expanding on these staples of combat!
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/14.png[/img] 

With the PvP 2.0 update, a much more diverse range of combat accomplishments are being recognized. Scoring the first kill of a match deserves recognition, but picking on the worst of the enemy team member gets recognition (for better or worse) in PvP 2.0. 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/13.png[/img]

There are plenty more, including those incredible kill streaks, but you’ll have to get in game to find them! After adding all this new content it’d be great if players knew more about…

[h1]NEW! – MVP Report[/h1]

CSN:Z now showcases the top performers for the game mode’s objectives, helping highlight players and their efforts. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/iYb2UUt.jpg[/img]

We hope this will both help players feel pride about their skill for being MVP, and make everyone else a little jealous of not being MVP. And should that jealousy turn into some well-deserved in-game payback, you will want to know all about the pain you inflicted with…

[h1]UPDATED! – Combat Info[/h1]

When respawning, CSN:Z can tell you some essential info about the kills you scored during your last life or round. This information is being expanded and will provide more detail with the PvP 2.0 update.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/07Rs49X.jpg[/img]

Changes are being made to both help the information be clearer, but also to provide more juicy details. Enjoy knowing not just which weapon dealt the killing blows on your enemies, but which body parts of your own the enemy was attacking the hardest! 



With the PvP 2.0 update, The CSN:Z Team hopes you will get more excitement out of every kill scored and greater reward with each objective completed. 

Let us know what you think in the comments and CSN:Z Forums. Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.title: Valentine’s Day Events – 12.02 Update
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0212/en.jpg[/img]

Sure, it may not have the gift-giving power of Christmas or the costumes of Halloween, but the power of LOVE is an incredible force! And nothing says ‘love’ to your sweetheart like bonding over Zombie slaying action in CSN:Z.

[h1]NEW GUNS AND PERFECT PICK RECIPE BUNDLES[/h1]

Hit the Crafting menu and the Item Shop to get your hands on the latest weapons added to CSN:Z!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0212/1.jpg[/img]

• [b]MP40[/b] – Found in the Submachine Gun Category when Crafted
• [b]Leviathan[/b] – Found in the Equipment Category when Crafted

Pick up a Perfect Pick Recipe Bundle for the MP40 and Leviathan in the Item Shop to guarantee the Crafting outcome is one of the newest CSN:Z weapons. [b]Hurry, these Perfect Pick Recipe Bundles won’t be around forever![/b]

[h1]VALENTINE’S DAY EVENTS[/h1]

Starting 12th February and ending 26th February, CSN:Z is running events to help you celebrate this Valentine’s Day with guns, explosions, and the undead.

[b]PLAY AND SPRAY[/b]

--Log in, and receive a 10 Day Left Heart Spray. This can be earned once during the event period (12.02 to 26.02).
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0212/2.jpg[/img]

--Play in matches for 1 hour and receive a Right Heart Spray. This can be earned once during the event period (12.02 to 26.02).
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0212/3.jpg[/img]

--Play in matches for at least 1 hour, for 7 days, and receive the Full Heart Spray PERMANENTLY! To earn this PERMANENT reward, you must complete all 7 days and progress will only count in rooms with 4 or more players.
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0212/4.jpg[/img]

[b]BLAST OF LOVE[/b]

Just log in to CSN:Z, and receive a Heart Grenade for 10 Days! This can be earned once during the event period (12.02 to 26.02).
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0212/5.jpg[/img]

[I](Nexon Europe is not responsible for any ruined relationships which resulted from using Zombies to try and celebrate Valentine’s Day in lieu of taking the time to write and give a card.)[/I]

notes.title: Report #13: Hellfire
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0130/2.jpg[/img]

This is the story behind Counter Strike Nexon: Zombies 
Expose the truth behind the mysterious appearance of zombies and the outbreak of the Z-Virus in the CS world. 
Make sure to follow all of the reports we publish in order to get to the bottom of the story. 
************** 
[h1]Report #13: Hellfire[/h1]

After severe combat in a sandstorm, Victor learned the origin of the unknown enemies. He heard through a Comanche Recording Device that the enemies were from the Vanguard Company. However, Victor knew that engaging against a munitions corporation would be a suicidal act... So, his troops escaped the combat zone, re-equipped themselves, and started their journey to request back up. After destroying a Comanche, the 3rd Squad tried to break through to the occupied city to join the main troops.

But rumor has it that there is a parent company behind them.
They are involved in a lot of illegal activities, like funding terrorists.
They have been upgraded with top technology. As a result, their vitality and firepower have been increased substantially. It seems as though Dr. Rex left the Vanguard Company right after he finished his job.
