notes.title: FEBRUARY IS ENHANCED – Check out the latest in CSN:Z!
notes.content:
Keep an eye on CSN:Z in the next few days, you're going to LOVE what we have lined up!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0129/en.jpg[/img]

[h1]EXPANSION OF ENHANCEMENT[/h1]

Before the 29th January update, the highest a weapon could be enhanced was +5. After the update, players can reach +8 with the latest changes made to CSN:Z’s Enhancement System!
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0129/1.jpg[/img]

[b]Use the all new Special Enhancement Material to get both better chances of Enhancement success and the ability to apply Enhancements from +6 to +8! [/b]
In addition, should failure occur with the Special Enhancement Material, you can collect leftover parts to earn yourself the all new Perfect Enhancement Material! This rare Enhancement Material grants both 100% success rate and knowing exactly which attribute will be improved.

Now is the best time to start enhancing your inventory of weapons, especially with the lineup of events that will be available!

[h1]ENHANCEMENT GIVEAWAY EVENTS[/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0129/2.jpg[/img]
This is an Enhanced month for CSN:Z!  We’re giving away plenty of Enhancement Materials and Enhanceable Weapons to every player with the following events:

 • [b]Daily Reward Giveaway[/b]
From 29th January to 26th February, receive 5x Normal Enhancement Materials and 2x Special Enhancement Materials every day when logging in.
• [b]Free Weapon Giveaway[/b]
From 29th January to 26th February, receive a free 3 Day Enhanceable Weapon after being in-game for 30, 60, and then 90 minutes. The weapon awarded is random, but will always be a weapon you can enhance.
• [b]50x Special Enhancement Materials via Battlefield Supply[/b]
From 29th January to 26th February, lucky players may win 50x Special Enhancement Materials from Battlefield Supply’s Random Reward. Make sure to collect your reward every day!

[h1]NEW CLASSES[/h1]

[b]Criss and Yuri are joining CSN:Z’s battle against the living dead! [/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0129/3.jpg[/img]

These new female classes can be purchased separately, or in a combined bundle from the Item Shop, but only for a limited time! 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0129/4.jpg[/img]

[b]20% OFF CRAFTING IN THE ITEM SHOP[/b]
Was your New Year’s resolution to spend your money smarter in 2015? Or are you looking to say ‘I love you’ with Crafting Bundles on Valentine’s Day? Whatever the reason, visit the Item Shop from 29th January and grab Crafting Materials at 20% off!

Remember to save even bigger by grabbing the 30x purchase option and get both the 30x price break and the 20% discount! 

[h1]INTRODUCING: THE ALL NEW COSTUME BOX[/h1]

The 29th January update is adding something new to the Item Shop: the Costume Box. 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0129/5.jpg[/img]
[b]Each Costume Box will award one of 26 possible Costume items for PERMANENT duration.[/b] Grab a few of these new boxes and see what cool Costume sets there are to collect!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0129/6.jpg[/img]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0129/7.jpg[/img]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0129/8.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW GUNS AND PERFECT PICK RECIPE BUNDLES[/h1]

Some new firepower is joining the CSN:Z fray with the 29th January Update! [b]Visit Henry in the Crafting menu to get yourself the all new SPAS-12 Maverick Shotgun and Mosin-Nagant Sniper Rifle to further expand your Zombie-Slaying options.[/b]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0129/10.jpg[/img]
To help players get their hands on these latest and greatest weapons in CSN:Z, new Perfect Pick Recipe bundles have been added to the Item Shop for the SPAS-12 Maverick Shotgun and Mosin-Nagant Sniper Rifle. 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0129/9.jpg[/img]
[b]Perfect Pick Recipes will guarantee the outcome of the weapon is a specific choice when matched with the right materials, and these Perfect Pick Recipe Bundles have everything you need to craft these new guns immediately![/b]

[h1]CHECK OUT THE NEW CSN:Z GUIDANCE[/h1]

There’s a lot in CSN:Z, and with the 29th January update we’re taking steps to get players better acquainted with some of the best modes of play. A Guidance System has been added to help educate new players about how gameplay functions in CSN:Z.
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0129/11.jpg[/img]

Of course we’re not going to stop the Zombie Killing pros from trying it, either! After all, it’s always good to brush up on the fundamentals.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0129/12.jpg[/img]

[h1]DAILY 4 HOUR DOUBLE-EXPERIENCE BOOST[/h1]

[b]From 29th January to 26th February, completed matches will award DOUBLE EXP between 18:00 and 22:00 CET (12:00 and 16:00 CET Eastern for USA players).[/b] Take advantage of the bonus EXP to rank up and get your rebalanced rank rewards! Read more about these rewards in our prior update: http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/135439363750494898

notes.title: Reach 999+ Days = GET PERMANENT WEAPON
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0113/1.jpg[/img]                    [img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0113/2.jpg[/img]

[h1]Now everyone can get every [b]WEAPON PERMANENT[/b] way easier.[/h1]
If any of your weapon reaches 999+ days duration, you can convert it to [b]PERMANENT[/b] with one click.

The latest 8th January update to CSN:Z has added a new way to get your hands the weapons you love for PERMANENT. The Item Extension system has been improved to allow weapons with longer durations to be converted to Permanent with no items or cost required!

Now every time you craft a weapon can get you closer to that PERMANENT status! No crafting attempt is wasted. And while trying you can still receive permanent weapon instantly!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0113/3.jpg[/img]
 
If there is an item in your inventory with 999 or more days of duration, notice the ‘Extend’ button has changed for the weapon as it appears in your inventory. Click it, and you can set it as PERMANENT instantly!

[h1][b]Perfect Pick Recipe Promotion[/b][/h1]

How does Henry turn Blueprints and Durables into weaponry? That Gunsmith isn’t sharing his secrets, but now you can getting your hands on the newest weaponry in CSN:Z instantly!
   
Introducing the [b]“Perfect Pick Recipe”[/b], a Crafting material that will guarantee the outcome of crafting be a specific weapon if included with its needed components. You can find this Recipe in the shop, included in Crafting bundles that contain all components needed to craft one of the new CSN:Z weapons!

For the 8th January Update, the following Perfect Pick Recipe bundles can be found in the shop:

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0113/4.jpg[/img] [img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0113/5.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]•MG42[/b][/h1]
Does it belong in a museum? Not when the dead keep rising! This weapon made its mark on history during World War II and an incredible rate of fire may just keep you alive against hundreds of Zombies barreling down on you.

[h1][b]•AT4CS[/b][/h1]
Even the odds against the Bosses of Zombie Scenario mode with some incredible firepower! Of course, the CSN:Z Team won’t judge you for wanting to have a rocket launcher just-because. 

Perfect Pick Recipe bundles for the MG42 and AT4CS will not be around forever! Visit the shop to pick up a bundle today to get your hands on these great offers while they are still available.

notes.title: [PART 2/2] ALL ZOMBIES PERMANENTLY FREE
notes.content:
[h1]ICE BREAKER[/h1]

From 8th to 29th January, those freezing winter temperatures may yield some incredible prizes in CSN:Z, including all new classes for PERMANENT.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/7.jpg[/img]
Every day, you’ll be given a block of ice with a reward inside. How well you can break open the ice will improve the value of the rewards waiting for you.

[b]Stage 1[/b]
Play for 30 minutes or more first and you may be awarded a Lv. 3 EXP Coupon or a Lv. 3 Point Coupon, or instead the Ice Block may upgrade to Stage 2…

[b]Stage 2[/b]
Play for 30 minutes or more first and you may be awarded 3x Crafting Bundles (Blueprint [A], 3x 24-30 Durables, and 19,200 Points), or the Ice Block may be upgraded to Stage 3…

[b]Stage 3[/b]
Your Ice Block has taken a lot of damage! Use it immediately and earn one of the following rewards:
• 3x Crafting Bundles ( Blueprint [S], 3x 24-30 Durables, and 19,200 Points)
• PERMANENT Male Class Keith Ichan
• PERMANENT Male Class Spade.

Make sure to log in every day to get your Stage 1 Ice Block to try and earn those top quality Crafting materials or PERMANENT Keith Ichan and Spade Male Classes!
(NOTE: Ice Blocks are removed from your inventory each day at 00:00 CET \ 18:00 US Eastern). 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/8.jpg[/img]

[h1]MAKE DURATION WEAPONS PERMANENT[/h1]

The 8th January update is not just for the undead. The CSN:Z Team is introducing a new way to increase your collection of PERMANENT weapons.
When a limited duration weapon has 999 or more days of duration in your Inventory, you can then set it as PERMANENT with the push of a button. It is then forever your weapon in CSN:Z!

Every day added to your favorite weapon, whether through Crafting or Item Extension Coupons, takes you closer to its PERMANENT status!

[h1]FREE POWERFUL GUNS IN ZOMBIE SCENARIO, SEASON 3[/h1]

What’s always great to hear when staring down a few thousand Zombies?
FREE GUNS !

Starting 8th January and ending 29th January, three Zombie Scenario maps of Season 3 have some incredible firepower unlocked for free. 

Check out the new Free Trial Weapons!

[b]-       First Contact : BALROG-VII (Machinegun)[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/12.jpg[/img]

[b]-       Enemy Behind : JANUS- 11 (Shotgun)[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/13.jpg[/img]

[b]-       Panic Room : SKULL-6 (Machinegun)[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/14.jpg[/img]

There’s no Crafting, points purchase, or cash purchase required to play with these guns. They are already in your inventory on 8th January!

The weapons will only work in their respective Zombie Scenario map, and you must have enough Dollars earned in the match to select them from the Buy menu in-game.

[h1]INTRODUCING: JANUS-3[/h1]

What’s better than a Tommy Gun?
A Tommy Gun equipped with the JANUS Transformation System that can unleash an unlimited ammo barrage during its transformation!
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/16.jpg[/img]

The JANUS series is being expanded with CSN:Z’s 8th January update, and is one of the possible weapons to be crafted from the Grade-3 Blueprint.

[h1]UPDATED BATTLEFIELD SUPPLY REWARDS[/h1]

You’ll find new rewards waiting for you in the Battlefield Supply, remember to redeem your reward every day to earn yourself a 20 Day 

UTS-15 Shotgun for the 6th reward and 20 Day Dual Infinity Pistols for the 7th rewards.
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/10_en.jpg[/img]

In addition, there’s some new high value Random Rewards to be had every time you redeem your Battlefield Supply Reward, including:
•[b]M4A1 RED PERMANENT[/b]
•Blueprint [S]
•5x 72 Day-Permanent Durables
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/11.jpg[/img]


Let us know how you’re enjoying the latest update to CSN:Z on the Steam Forums, Facebook, and Twitter!
https://www.facebook.com/en.CSNZ
https://www.facebook.com/pl.CSNZ
https://twitter.com/CSN_Z

notes.title: [PART 1/2] ALL ZOMBIES PERMANENTLY FREE
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0108/en.jpg[/img]

[h1]5 NEW PLAYABLE ZOMBIE CLASSES[/h1]

It’s a new year, and that means it’s time to bring some new fear to the hearts of the living... five flavors of fear in fact!

[b]PSYCHO [/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/4_1.jpg[/img]
What is worse than a hoard of attacking Zombies? Not seeing them coming. A well placed Smokescreen from the Psycho Zombie can really throw off the living. 

[b]VENOM STING [/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/1.jpg[/img]
 Agility and precision come together with this Zombie menace. Float like a butterfly, sting like a bee. An undead bee?

[b]VENOM GUARD[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/2.jpg[/img]
For the Zombie enthusiast who truly wants to soak up the lead: excelling at enduring attacks and healing after barrages of gunfire.

[b]BANSHEE[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/3.jpg[/img]
Some of her devilish tricks can disrupt even the best Human encampment. Pull foolish targets away from safety, or disguise yourself as a Human to score some truly humiliating kills.

[b]STAMPER[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/4.jpg[/img]
When a guy brings an Iron Maiden to a gun fight and you know he’s serious about pain. Plant the Stamper’s Iron Maiden to disrupt enemies, block gunfire, and even help reach new heights.

[h1]ZOMBIES, FREE FOR ALL[/h1]

The latest CSN:Z update is making some huge changes to the war between the living and the living-dead. 
Starting 8th January, all Zombie Classes are becoming default items for all CSN:Z players. Players no longer need to purchase their preferred Zombie combatants, as they are now permanent in every player’s inventory!
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/5.jpg[/img]

In addition, a large number of PvP Zombie items are also set as default for all CSN:Z Players.
•Hammer, Nata Knife, and Flame Grenade weapons.
•Superior DNA, Persistent Survival, and Bomb Expert items.

And, yes, this includes the five Zombie classes new to the frontlines with our 8th January update!

[h1]INTRODUCING: THE PERFECT PICK RECIPE[/h1]

New weaponry is coming to the warzones of CSN:Z, and with the new Perfect Pick Recipe for Crafting you can get your hands on the latest and greatest armaments against living or dead foes alike!

The 8th January update for CSN:Z is adding new Crafting Bundles to the Item Shop. These bundles include the Perfect Pick Recipe in addition to all the Materials and Points needed to turn a Blueprint into a weapon.  Using the Perfect Pick Recipe while crafting will guarantee that only the recipe’s specific weapon will be crafted. Visit the Item Shop to get these bundles for the new MG42 and AT4CS!
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/9.jpg[/img]

[h1]BOOST TO MISSION REWARDS[/h1]

CSN:Z’s update for 8th January is giving a needed boost to the Random Rewards possible from the Missions menu. Daily, Special, and Weekly Missions now offer better quality Blueprints when choosing a Random Reward as the mission prize.

[h1]RANK UP REWARD REBALANCE[/h1]

The 8th January update is also working to improve how your efforts are rewarded for the EXP earned slaying Zombies and Humans alike. 

Not only are newcomers to CSN:Z getting better rewards for making new accounts, but all of the rank rewards are getting attention!
You earn these rewards by opening the Level Up Box from your Inventory. Each Level Up Box contains rewards, and the next rank’s Level Up Box for you to work towards.

Among the rewards are more crafting materials, male classes found in the Item Shop, and items to help you stay alive in Zombie Scenario. There are other rewards to be had, including the occasional JANUS\BALROG\SKULL weapons for certain ranks!

[h1]CRAFTING OUTCOME REBALANCE[/h1]

Henry and the CSN:Z Team have kept a close eye on Crafting at the end of 2014. Players may recall details about high-powered weapon series getting attention in their Crafting frequency for our 2014 Xmas updates!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/15.jpg[/img]

There’s been more work behind the scenes for our 8th January update. While we can’t divulge the secrets of the process (Henry may be taking that to his grave…) please stop by the Craft menu to check out our work towards getting the right weapons in your zombie-slaying hands.

Need a refresher? Check our Henry’s Crafting Essentials Guide:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=353139785

Let us know how you’re enjoying the latest update to CSN:Z on the Steam Forums, Facebook, and Twitter!
https://www.facebook.com/en.CSNZ
https://www.facebook.com/pl.CSNZ
https://twitter.com/CSN_Z

notes.title: Merry CSN:Z Giveaways – SKULL Series PERMANENT and festive Xmas Series Weapons!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2014/1212/Dec2014SKULL.jpg[/img]

The Christmas season has many traditions with both the prospect of surprise gifts and obnoxious decorations amongst them. Starting on 20th December, CSN:Z will do its part to celebrate such time honored traditions, but without the deceivingly wrapped socks or suspicious holiday fruitcake.

[h1]PERMANENT SKULL-SERIES WEAPON GIVEAWAY[/h1]

[b]Starting on 20th December and ending 7th January[/b], each day between 14:00 CET and 22:00 CET, there will be players randomly selected to receive PERMANENT SKULL series weapons for free! (That’s 08:00 to 16:00 EST for our USA players.)

All of our current SKULL Series weapons will be given away repeatedly during the event (1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 11). 

[img]http://s17.postimg.org/oyk86tr3j/image.png[/img]

While the event is active, 9 players will each be awarded a single random SKULL Series weapon for PERMANENT, repeated every 2 hours. Hundreds of players will get their hands on these Zombie slaying weapons!

Winners of weapons will be stated in game as they are selected via text announcements made by the game server in the chat log.

[h1]FREE CHRISTMAS WEAPONS DAILY[/h1]

Seeing as skulls are not common Christmas decorations, The CSN:Z Team needed to compensate with some large caliber festive firearm decorating. 

[img]http://s18.postimg.org/kvw3esn09/image.png[/img]

[b]From 20th December through 7th January[/b], CSN:Z will be awarding players a Christmas weapon each day. By being logged in at 18:00, 20:00, and 22:00 CET (That’s 09:00, 11:00, and 13:00 EST for our USA players.), you will receive one of the following weapons randomly: 

-- Christmas M95 
-- Christmas MG3 
-- Christmas M134 
-- Christmas MG36 
-- Christmas Winchester 
-- Christmas Spray

Xmas items awarded are for 1 Day duration, but you can receive more prizes at the awarding times every day of the event! Keep playing CSN:Z from 20th December through 7th January to keep your stocking stuffed with these special Xmas series items.

Make sure to follow CSN:Z on Steam, Facebook, and Twitter for the latest updates.
https://www.facebook.com/en.CSNZ
https://twitter.com/CSN_Z

notes.title: Merry CSN:Z
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2014/1216/en.jpg[/img]

Merry Christmas, CSN:Z! New PERMANENT Female Classes, Free PERMANENT SKULL Series Weapons, 50% Off Sale, and More!

Have you been logging in every day for your free Blueprint [S] and crafting materials? How many weapons have you upgraded to earn your free PERMANENT upgraded variant? The whole CSN:Z Team hopes you’ve been enjoying our big events for the end of 2014, but there’s still more for December!

[h1]NEW PERMANENT FEMALE CLASSES[/h1]
[img]http://s21.postimg.org/t8nl2jwhj/image.png[/img]

[img]http://s30.postimg.org/ackfbhtk1/image.png[/img]

CSN:Z is getting some new dangerous combatants for December: Ritsuka is joining forces with the Terrorists, and Ji Yoon Choi is enlisting with the Counter-Terrorists.

Starting 16th December, these two skilled warriors are available for PERMANENT durations in the Item Shop for a cash purchase.
You can purchase them individually or get both Ritsuka and Ji Yoon Choi in a combined bundle. These classes will not be available forever, so get them while you can! 

[h1]50% OFF FOR THE HOLIDAYS[/h1]
Starting 16th December and ending 31st December, take advantage of 50% off select cash items in the Item Shop! Gift your friends in CSN:Z with crafting bundles for some seasonal generosity, or just grab some for yourself with any Steam Wallet Cards you get in your Christmas stocking this year. It’s a great time to stock up on those 30x Crafting Bundles to build a merry arsenal.
NOTE: 50% off sale does not apply to classes Ritsuka, Ji Yoon Choi, or the bundle containing these classes.

[h1]PERMANENT SKULL-SERIES WEAPON GIVEAWAY[/h1]
Some CSN:Z players are going to be very lucky this holiday season…

Starting on 20th December and ending 7th January, each day between 14:00 CET and 22:00 CET, there will be players randomly selected to receive PERMANENT SKULL series weapons for free! (That’s 08:00 to 16:00 EST for our USA players.)

Every 2 hours during the event’s active time, 9 players will each be awarded a single random SKULL series weapon for PERMANENT. Hundreds of lucky players will get a free PERMANENT SKULL series weapon just for playing CSN:Z this holiday season!

[img]http://s17.postimg.org/oyk86tr3j/image.png[/img]

Santa isn’t the only one bringing goodies and gifts this December, and his presents won’t be half as good for killing Zombies. Make sure to drop by every day of the event for the best chances to be selected!

[h1]FREE CHRISTMAS WEAPONS DAILY[/h1]
Hanging Christmas lights can be dangerous, especially if the conditions are icy! Play it safe and decorate guns with CSN:Z instead.

From 20th December through 7th January, CSN:Z will be awarding players a Christmas weapon each day. By being logged in at 18:00, 20:00, and 22:00 CET, you will receive one of the following weapons randomly:

-- Christmas M95
-- Christmas MG3
-- Christmas M134
-- Christmas MG36
-- Christmas Winchester
-- Christmas Spray

[img]http://s18.postimg.org/kvw3esn09/image.png[/img]

For our USA players, these times are 12:00, 14:00, and 16:00 EST.

Stop by CSN:Z daily to celebrate the season with irresponsibly decorated high caliber firearms!

[h1]Xmas Crafter Booster! – 6x more likely to get BALROG, JANUS and SKULL Weapons![/h1]
Did you ask for a BALROG-XI, JANUS-7, or SKULL-9 from Santa this year? Probably should have left the milk and cookies out for Henry instead. He’s hitting the workbench hard this holiday season to get even more BALROG, JANUS, and SKULL weapons in your hands for Christmas! 

From 16th December you will far more likely receive BALROG, JANUS and SKULL weapons from crafting. During this event, the odds of crafting one of these powerful weapons will be SIX TIMES more likely! 
[img]http://s13.postimg.org/m6frvjbpj/image.png[/img]

notes.title: Permanent Weapon Upgrades, New Classes, and More!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2014/1128/en.jpg[/img]

Avoid the crowds this holiday shopping weekend and score some amazing deals in Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies! Of course, this isn’t just a weekend to take advantage of retail stores, online games, and Gabe Newell offering incredible discounts. For our players in the USA, this weekend is also a time to give thanks.

What better way to give thanks than with new guns, new features, and some great events for scoring free rewards?

[h1]PERMANENT UPGRADEABLE WEAPONS [/h1]
[From 27th November to 30th December]

Blueprints can now craft new weapons, and these weapons can be upgraded into even more powerful versions. After all, why stop at Double Barrels when you can upgrade to Triple Barrels? That’s just science.
By scoring kills with below, you can upgrade them into new and improved versions.

The following are the points required to complete each upgrade:
-[b]Minigun[/b]: 3,000 kill points will upgrade to a Minigun Predator
-[b]Combat Knife[/b]: 1,000 kill points will upgrade to a Master Combat Knife
-[b]Kriss Super V[/b]: 2,000 kill points will upgrade to a Double Kriss Super V
-[b]Double Barrel[/b]: 1,000 kill points will upgrade to a Triple Barrel
-[b]SL8[/b]: 2,000 kill points will upgrade to an SL8 Custom
-[b]Dual Infinity[/b]: 2,000 kill points will upgrade to a Dual Infinity Custom 
-[b]Dual Infinity Custom[/b]: 3,000 kill points will upgrade to a Dual Infinity Final

Please observe the following rules and details concerning weapon upgrading:
-Zombie Modes (Original, Mutant, Hero) award 15 for killing a Zombie, and 5 for killing a Human.
-Zombie Scenario awards 1 point for each kill.


[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/14.jpg[/img]

…But it’s not just an upgrade. [u]If you complete an upgrade on a weapon you’ve crafted, that weapon will become permanent![/u] As it’s always been in CSN:Z, this means you can put those free crafting materials you earn towards these new permanent weapons.

[h1]BLACK FRIDAY SALE – 70% OFF CASH ITEMS[/h1]

Now is the time to stock up on Crafting bundles and Classes from [b]27th November through 4th December[/b] with [u]70% off of select Cash Items[/u].
Remember, you can pick up Crafting bundles in 10x and 30x amounts that offer even further savings over buying bundles individually.

[h1]DAILY FREE [S] CLASS BLUEPRINT[/h1]

…But it’s not just a free permanent upgrade. We’re giving away [S] Class Blueprints every day from[b] 27th November through 14th December[/b]. Drop in to CSN:Z every day to collect the top tier of Blueprints available in the game and try to get yourself the new upgradeable weapons!

[h1]CRAFT YOUR WAY TO FREE UPGRADABLE WEAPONS[/h1]

…But can there still be even more to these upgradable weapons?
Yes! From [b]27th November to 30th December[/b], successfully performing 7 Craftings with [S] Blueprints will immediately award you a 10 Day upgradable weapon of your choice. 

This event can be repeated, making it even easier to get yourself some PERMANENT upgraded weapons throughout this holiday season!

[h1]NEW CLASSES + 300,000 POINTS BUNDLES[/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/3.jpg[/img]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/4.jpg[/img]
There are some new faces on the battlefield with CSN:Z’s latest update: Vigilante for TR, and Thunder Squad for CT.

Picking up these new classes from the Item Shop doesn’t just allow you to use a new look while fighting over hostages, these classes also offer a 10% bonus to EXP and Points rewards for using them in matches. On top of this 10% bonus, a whopping 300,000 Points is bundled with the purchased class to let the owner of these new warriors grab some Medical Kits, too!

[h1]SERIOUS SCENARIO SLAUGHTER! – Free Balrog, Janus, and SKULL Weapons for Zombie Scenario maps[/h1]
It’s nearly the holidays, so take a load off in CSN:Z! At least it will be a vacation for you because the Zombies won’t know what hit them with our latest event.

From [b]27th November through 30th December[/b], you can use some of the best Zombie slaying weapons in the game for specific Zombie Scenario maps at no cost and as much as you want.

Season 2, Poisonous Wound – BALROG-IX (Melee) 
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/2.jpg [/img]
Season 2, Decoy – SKULL-5 (Rifle) 
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/10.jpg[/img]
Season 2, Angra Nest – JANUS-7 (Machine Gun)
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/11.jpg[/img]

Each weapon can only be used in its respective Zombie Scenario map, and these weapons will be removed 30th December.

[h1]BIG HEADS, EASY TARGETS[/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/13.jpg[/img]

Big Headed Zombies! From 27.11 to 15.12, log into the game and receive Soi's Big Head Solution (3D) item. When you have this item and create a Zombie Scenario mode room, all Zombies, including bosses, will appear with large heads.

Aiming has never been so easy!

[h1]CHECK OUT THESE NEW ITEMS[/h1]

You’ll also encounter some new items in CSN:Z with this latest update to help you have a great time while filling zombies with lead.
--Special Mission Reset: if you end up assigned a Special Mission that you’re not fond of, use this item to receive a new Special Mission instantly! You can find this in the Item Shop for Points.
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/5.jpg[/img]
-- Item Extension Coupon: add days of duration to items already in your inventory to help keep your favorite guns around longer. This new item is obtained by disassembling items in the Craft menu.
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/6.jpg[/img]
--Detailed Damage Display: with this item in your inventory, both damage dealt and received will be outlined in detail on your HUD during gameplay.  You can find this in the Item Shop for Points.
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/7.jpg[/img]
--Nickname Change: whether your friends all want to use themed names, or you’re having second thoughts about “pwnMSTR1337”, a Nickname Change item allows you to assign a new name to your character. You can find this item in the Item Shop for Cash.
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/8.jpg[/img]

[h1]BIGTIME BATTLEFIELD SUPPLY[/h1]

notes.title: Permanent Weapon Upgrades, New Classes, and More!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2014/1128/en.jpg[/img]

Avoid the crowds this holiday shopping weekend and score some amazing deals in Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies! Of course, this isn’t just a weekend to take advantage of retail stores, online games, and Gabe Newell offering incredible discounts. For our players in the USA, this weekend is also a time to give thanks.

What better way to give thanks than with new guns, new features, and some great events for scoring free rewards?

[h1]PERMANENT UPGRADEABLE WEAPONS [/h1]
[From 27th November to 30th December]

Blueprints can now craft new weapons, and these weapons can be upgraded into even more powerful versions. After all, why stop at Double Barrels when you can upgrade to Triple Barrels? That’s just science.
By scoring kills with below, you can upgrade them into new and improved versions.

The following are the points required to complete each upgrade:
-[b]Minigun[/b]: 3,000 kill points will upgrade to a Minigun Predator
-[b]Combat Knife[/b]: 1,000 kill points will upgrade to a Master Combat Knife
-[b]Kriss Super V[/b]: 2,000 kill points will upgrade to a Double Kriss Super V
-[b]Double Barrel[/b]: 1,000 kill points will upgrade to a Triple Barrel
-[b]SL8[/b]: 2,000 kill points will upgrade to an SL8 Custom
-[b]Dual Infinity[/b]: 2,000 kill points will upgrade to a Dual Infinity Custom 
-[b]Dual Infinity Custom[/b]: 3,000 kill points will upgrade to a Dual Infinity Final

Please observe the following rules and details concerning weapon upgrading:
-Zombie Modes (Original, Mutant, Hero) award 15 for killing a Zombie, and 5 for killing a Human.
-Zombie Scenario awards 1 point for each kill.


[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/14.jpg[/img]

…But it’s not just an upgrade. [u]If you complete an upgrade on a weapon you’ve crafted, that weapon will become permanent![/u] As it’s always been in CSN:Z, this means you can put those free crafting materials you earn towards these new permanent weapons.

[h1]BLACK FRIDAY SALE – 70% OFF CASH ITEMS[/h1]

Now is the time to stock up on Crafting bundles and Classes from [b]27th November through 4th December[/b] with [u]70% off of select Cash Items[/u].
Remember, you can pick up Crafting bundles in 10x and 30x amounts that offer even further savings over buying bundles individually.

[h1]DAILY FREE [S] CLASS BLUEPRINT[/h1]

…But it’s not just a free permanent upgrade. We’re giving away [S] Class Blueprints every day from[b] 27th November through 14th December[/b]. Drop in to CSN:Z every day to collect the top tier of Blueprints available in the game and try to get yourself the new upgradeable weapons!

[h1]CRAFT YOUR WAY TO FREE UPGRADABLE WEAPONS[/h1]

…But can there still be even more to these upgradable weapons?
Yes! From [b]27th November to 30th December[/b], successfully performing 7 Craftings with [S] Blueprints will immediately award you a 10 Day upgradable weapon of your choice. 

This event can be repeated, making it even easier to get yourself some PERMANENT upgraded weapons throughout this holiday season!

[h1]NEW CLASSES + 300,000 POINTS BUNDLES[/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/3.jpg[/img]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/4.jpg[/img]
There are some new faces on the battlefield with CSN:Z’s latest update: Vigilante for TR, and Thunder Squad for CT.

Picking up these new classes from the Item Shop doesn’t just allow you to use a new look while fighting over hostages, these classes also offer a 10% bonus to EXP and Points rewards for using them in matches. On top of this 10% bonus, a whopping 300,000 Points is bundled with the purchased class to let the owner of these new warriors grab some Medical Kits, too!

[h1]SERIOUS SCENARIO SLAUGHTER! – Free Balrog, Janus, and SKULL Weapons for Zombie Scenario maps[/h1]
It’s nearly the holidays, so take a load off in CSN:Z! At least it will be a vacation for you because the Zombies won’t know what hit them with our latest event.

From [b]27th November through 30th December[/b], you can use some of the best Zombie slaying weapons in the game for specific Zombie Scenario maps at no cost and as much as you want.

Season 2, Poisonous Wound – BALROG-IX (Melee) 
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/2.jpg [/img]
Season 2, Decoy – SKULL-5 (Rifle) 
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/10.jpg[/img]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/11.jpg[/img]

Each weapon can only be used in its respective Zombie Scenario map, and these weapons will be removed 30th December.

[h1]BIG HEADS, EASY TARGETS[/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/13.jpg[/img]

Big Headed Zombies! From 27.11 to 15.12, log into the game and receive Soi's Big Head Solution (3D) item. When you have this item and create a Zombie Scenario mode room, all Zombies, including bosses, will appear with large heads.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/5.jpg[/img]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/6.jpg[/img]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/7.jpg[/img]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/8.jpg[/img]

--The MG3 Machine Gun for 90 Days
-- …and the badass [b]AWP RED[/b] Sniper Rifle for PERMANENT duration!
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/12.jpg[/img]
Every day of collecting your Battlefield Supply Reward is another chance you could get some great loot this holiday season!

[h1]GROZA ENHANCEABLE![/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/9.jpg[/img]
Starting 27th November, you can now apply Enhancements to the Groza rifle when it is in your inventory.  Pick up bundles of Normal Enhancement Material from the Item Shop for Points and try boosting the Groza’s stats if you craft it!

notes.title: Welcome packages for new players
notes.content:
Dear Survivors,
We are happy to welcome all of the new players to Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies.
Every new user who logs into the game after 27th November will receive the following items to get prepared for the battle and go through Zombie Scenario with less difficulties.

[h1]50 Round Retry[/h1]
-	If you've failed a mission during Scenario Mode, press the R key to start the round again with all members at their optimum state.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/notice/1.jpg[/img]

[h1]50 Battle Revival[/h1]
-	Press the R key when you die in Scenario Mode and you will respawn.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/notice/2.jpg[/img]

[h1]100 Large Medical Kit[/h1]
-	Press the number 6 on your keyboard during Scenario Mode and your HP will be restored to 100%.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/notice/3.jpg[/img]

[h1]100 Small Medical Kit[/h1]
-	Press the number 5 key during Scenario Mode and your HP will be restored by 30%.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/notice/4.jpg[/img]
Another piece of good news is that players from Turkey will be able to join CSN:Z from 22th of December!
We are happy to provide great game experience to all of our fans!

notes.title: PATCH NOTES - 11-27 Content Update
notes.content:
In addition to new content added to Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies for the end of year holidays, changes have been made to address feedback and problems reported by the CSN:Z Community.


Design Changes: 
•If you leave a Family, now only 2 days are required before being able to join a new Family (instead of 2 weeks).
•Upgrading a Zombie Class now only requires 5 skills to be raised to at least Level 5 first.
•Rankings for new players have been rebalanced, with less EXP required per rank through Lv. 10.
--NOTE: This design change may result in your rank level being higher following the update.
•Recipe slots have been removed from the Crafting menu as the CSN:Z Team makes further changes to improve Crafting.

Bug Fixes: 
•Added support for 1366x768 and 1360x768 game resolutions during gameplay.
•Set CSN:Z window to a borderless mode when game is launched on smaller sized windows desktops.
•Corrected incorrect name of Zombie Scenario boss from “Seize” to “Siege”.
•Corrected reward notifications for certain Scenario maps stating the wrong map completed.

Other Details: 
•Made general improvements to text through game for all supported languages.

notes.title: Want free Permanent Guns? Just Name It!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2014/1117/en.jpg[/img]

Feeling a little sluggish as the days get shorter, the temperature drops, and all that extra Halloween candy is bogging you down?
[h1]Bet some free permanent guns and crafting materials would perk you right up![/h1]

Not to worry, CSN:Z is going to make it easy. Take a break from the autumn chill to get yourself the 4 new Battle series weapons [b](Glock 18C, FAMAS, Galil, and Hunting Dagger)[/b] and top grade crafting materials [b]( [S] Grade-2 Blueprint, [S] Grade-3 Blueprint, and 72-Permanent Durable)![/b]

Playing in our Just Name It! event is as easy as, well, playing! Collect letters to complete the names of the prizes as you play Original, Zombie Scenario, or any of the game modes in CSN:Z. Letters are awarded to you randomly as you score PvE or PvP kills in any mode.

Redeem all of the needed letters to complete the name of the prize and it’s yours to keep. Some prizes will use the same letters, or will require more than one of the same letter, requiring you to collect more than one of some letters to complete the whole list of prizes.

“Com’on Nexon! I don’t like RNG; it’s out to get me!”
Don’t you fret! In addition to the letters, Joker Pieces are included in this event can help tip the odds in your favor. A Joker Piece can be used in place of any letter to help you complete a prize’s name.
[b]Joker Pieces[/b] can be obtained in the same way as letters, or by logging in on at least 10 of the days during this event to receive 5 Joker Pieces instantly! Don’t forget to stop by CSN:Z every day to get those 5 Joker Pieces.

Make sure to take a break from the cold to collect those letters, as the Just Name It! event is only lasting from [b]November 20th through December 3rd.[/b] We recommend extra socks and hot cocoa for staying cozy as you mow down Zombies with your new permanent Battle series weapons.

But hey, that November chill has been affecting The CSN:Z Team, too! Removing discounts is a lot of work, and it's too cold for changing prices. [h1][b]We're extending our -50% sale in the Cash Shop all the way to November 27th[/b], keeping the discounts on both Crafting bundles and Classes around a little longer. Stock up and bundle up![/h1]

Joker Pieces can be obtained in the same way as letters, or by logging in on at least 10 of the days during this event to receive 5 Joker Pieces instantly!

notes.title: CSN:Z New Zombies, 50% Sale and events!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2014/1105/en.jpg[/img]

It seems like only yesterday we officially launched Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies, because really, we’re just getting started! Fans of CSN:Z have been voicing their wishes, loud and clear, on our forums, Facebook, and Twitter. We've worked to address some of those reports and requests in our latest update, in addition to expanding on our exclusive Zombie classes and ways to earn guns through new events!

[h1]BIG CASH SHOP SAVINGS[/h1]
After a great first month, it's about time we celebrated with some discounts on the Crafting and Class items available in our Shop!
At least, we see it as good enough a reason to get some big sales up for everyone to enjoy.

From November 5th through November 19th, pick up Crafting bundles in the shop at 50% off! We're also offering a whopping 75% off of the Chinese Devils and National Liberation CT and TR classes, which both include 200,000 points when purchased!

[h1]NEW ZOMBIE CLASSES[/h1]
Some truly fearsome creatures are joining the ranks of the undead with the latest update. Meet Deimos and Ganymede.

[h1]VOTE-TO-KICK[/h1]
With the Vote-To-Kick item, players can now employ a little more control over troublesome players during gameplay.

Vote-To-Kick can be purchased for Points in the Item Shop. We'll post a Guide that covers all the details of how Vote Kicking works in the CSN:Z Community Hub. Check it out to learn more!

[h1]COSTUME CLOCK IN EVENT[/h1] 
We’re bringing back the Clock In Event. It’s as easy as logging in, but with a new prize! 5th - 19th November

The Costume Box may contain a Costume item (Pumpkin Head, Ghost Back, Angel Halo, Angel Wings, Devil Horn, Devil Wings, or Devil Tail [at 3 Days or Permanent]), or a random amount of points (2,000 – 10,000 Points).

Awards are issued at login, at the 1 hour mark, and at the 2 hour mark. All time counts towards the event, whether you’re playing in a match or organizing your Buy Menu Favorites!

[h1]BATTLEFIELD SUPPLY[/h1] 
With the latest update, Battlefield Supply has been updated to offer a full arsenal of weaponry! Just log in each day, click the “Receive Reward” button, and earn free items. 5th November - 3rd December

What would we do without zombies in CSN:Z? All the maps of Season 2 Zombie Scenario will be unlocked after the 5th November.

Hurry up and pick your favorite map in the exciting zombie quests of Zombie Scenario!

notes.title: CSN:Z Update: Ver. 1.1- 05.11.2014
notes.content:
Dear Survivors,

We are going to perform a maintenance and client patching on 05.11.2014 from 05:00 – 07:00 CET.

An update to CSN:Z will include following changes:

[b]Additional content:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added two new Zombies: Deimos and Ganymede. They will be also available in Zombie Enhancement menu.
[*]Added Vote-To-Kick item.
[*]Halloween items event enabled.
[*]Added Cannon Shoot (Only for Football Mode)
[/list]

[b]Changes in design:[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed items given in battlefield supply.
[*]Battlefield supply window will now pop-up after launching the game instead of Announcement window.
[*]All the maps of Season 2 Zombie Scenario will be unlocked
[*]Walls and barricades can be destroyed more easily on Easy and Normal difficulty
[*]Adjusted requirements to clear Zombie Scenario maps: Lost City and Trap
[*]Made "Quick entry" and go back arrow more visible in the game main menu.
[*]Crafting: Items are now sorted.
[*]Crafting: Right mouse button works now like left button double click
[*]Removed Jennifer and Natasha from the shop
[/list]
Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*]Achievement system fixed
[*]Localization fixes
[/list]

Known issue:
Mission: "Kill Zombies in First Contact (0/1000)" should be “Kill the Fallen Titan once”

Regards, 
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Clock In for Free Items every Day! - Oct 22nd to Nov 5th
notes.content:
How does earning rewards just for spending time in CSN:Z sound? Save the effort and challenge for the opponents you take on in CSN:Z this time around with our latest event!

Rewards are automatically awarded to your account just for spending enough time in CSN:Z. Did you spend your time in Zombie Scenario? Maybe some Original mode maps? Or maybe sat down to customize your Buy menus from your My Info menu? All time spent while logged in to CSN:Z counts towards each prize tier in this event!

[b]30 min Tier: Stamina Drug (L) x2 + Light Zombie (2 days)
1 hour Tier: Round Retry x3 + Excellent Genes (3 days)
2 hour Tier: Respawn x3 + MG3 (3 days)[/b]

[h1]Log in to CSN:Z every day as you can re-earn all the reward tiers once per day until November 5th.[/h1]

notes.title: 10,000 Concurrent Users and Weekend Events
notes.content:
Survivors,

Exactly one week ago, we were enjoying a record of 8,000 concurrent users playing CSN:Z online together! We broke another record of [b]10,000 CSN:Z users[/b] playing at the same time on Steam. That's just the high in a single day. You will meet tens of thousands different players fighting off zombies every day and night! 

[h1]We want to celebrate this achievement together with you. That's why every survivor that logs in during the weekend will be rewarded with a special Crafting Package. Get into the game and [b]receive 3x Random Grade Blueprints [A], 3x Durables, and 19,200 Points![/b](Once per account.)[/h1]

Some free crafting materials on the house isn't enough to celebrate how fast CSN:Z is growing!

[h1]From Friday, 17th October (18:00 CEST) till Monday, 20th October (09:00 CEST), you can enjoy a big [b]200% bonus for EXP and Points[/b] in every match you complete.[/h1]

We are also already running another event until next Friday!

notes.title: [Maintenance] 16.10.2014, COMPLETED! Servers are Open
notes.content:
We are going to perform a short maintenance on 16.10.2014 from 06:00 – 07:00 CEST. 

An update to CSN:Z is being released today to help address player reported issues and some further polish to the overall game.
We hope this resolves problems that players have been facing and improves the experience overall for everyone. Make sure to stop by the discussion forums to let us know how things are shaping up when you get a chance to play following the update!

Design Changes: 
•Increased the minimum possible damage to walls and obstructions in Zombie Scenario to improve how much time is required to pass blockades.
•Gifting in Shop has been re-enabled.
• Automatic selection of High-performance GPU on systems where multiple graphic cards are available

Bug Fixes: 
•Gifting to a player who is offline now fully processes.
•Applied fixes to properly enable Steam Achievement activation.
•Applied fixes to address potential crashing issues in Zombie Scenario.
•MP7A1 Extended Mag, SCAR 5.56 Limited , and XM-8 Carbine Limited can now be disassembled.
•Applied fixes to address lobby window displaying at incorrect resolutions.
•Improved Hackshield compatibility to address false-positive kicking.

Other Details: 
•Improved various text issues across all supported languages to address phrasing and display issues.
• Corrected Family Point Message 

-> upcoming next updates (not a final list):
- Full support for Norwegian Krone and Canadian Dollar
- Reconfiguration of Crafting Point Mechanics (need more time for testing and analysis) 
- Further improvements to Russian Servers
- Reported bug fixes

Regards, 
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: The Competitive Edge – Matchmaking Server
notes.content:
Let’s be honest, there’s an elephant in the room that needs addressing. And, no, CSN:Z is not introducing a pachyderm themed addition but then again there are some truly unique styles of play in FUN mode...

Counter-strike has a deep history with competitive FPS gaming, and while CSN:Z offers everything from the original CS to Zombie Escaping there’s a feature not getting put through its paces.

[h1]Time to get introduced to Matchmaking Server![/h1]

How you’ll play in the Matchmaking Server is a little different than the usual, but not by a whole lot. A key difference to understand is that game rooms are not freely selectable but instead are assigned by the server itself.

When in a Matchmaking Server you’ll see a “Play Game” tab near the top of the menu, and within this page of the Matchmaking Server you can select which mode of play you’ll be assigned to. For now we only offer Original mode gameplay to help players focus on understanding the basics of how the server works at CSN:Z’s launch. Clicking on the “Original” mode image will get you stated.

As this is an environment focused on competitive matches, it is to your benefit to get a good team assembled as the opposition may be just as organized! This is done with the Clan system in CSN:Z, which allows you to form a group of trusted team mates for exclusively the Matchmaking Server. It is separate from the Family system, so members of your Clan can be recruited from within or beyond a Family if you are a part of one.

notes.title: CSN:Z Trading Cards are now Live!
notes.content:
[h1]With CSN:Z being published exclusively on Steam, we felt it was a given that CSN:Z supports its [b]Trading Card system[/b].[/h1]

Please review the following FAQ to understand how this system works and what it gives to Steam users.

[b]What are Steam Trading Cards?[/b]
•	Steam Trading Cards are virtual cards earned by playing games on Steam. Collect a set of cards to earn items that help you customize your profile and show off your interest in CSN:Z.

[b]How does someone receive a card in Counter Strike Nexon: Zombies?[/b]
•	As CSN:Z is a Free-to-Play game, Trading Cards can be obtained after having made cash purchases in its Shop. Spending more in the CSN:Z shop on cash purchases enables more Trading Cards to be obtainable.

Once you've earned a possible Trading Card drop in CSN:Z, playing the game will randomly add cards to your Steam inventory automatically.

•	CSN:Z Trading Cards can also be traded with other Steam users, and purchased from the Steam Community Market if others are offering to sell them.

[b]What are Steam Badges?[/b]
•	Once you’ve collected a full set of cards (9 available in CSN:Z) you can craft them into a game badge. A badge is an icon on your profile (and it is tied to your account) that represents the trading card sets you've collected.

[b]How to craft a badge?[/b]
•	From your Profile page, click on the "Badges" link near the top of the right column or select "Badges" from your profile name drop down in the Steam menu. From your Badges page, the "Badges in Progress" tab will show which badges are ready to be crafted. Select a ready to craft badge to view its details and click on the blue "Craft a Badge" button.

[b]Are there different type of badges?[/b]
•	Each game has 6 types of badges: 5 levels of the standard badge, and the foil badge. When you craft a game's badge the first time, you'll receive the level 1 version of the badge. Crafting it again will upgrade the badge to level 2, and so on, up till level 5. Once you reach level 5, you cannot craft that game's cards into a badge again. The foil badge for a game can only be crafted once.

[b]How do I craft a foil badge?[/b]
•	In addition to the 5 levels of the standard badge, each trading card set has a foil badge. You earn the foil badge by completing a set of foil versions of the cards for that set. Foil cards are rarer than the standard cards, and thus the foil badge is much more difficult  to obtain.  

[b]Do I get anything from crafting a badge?[/b]
•	All badges give you XP which contributes to your Steam Level, a summary of your badge collection. Each level of a badge is worth 100 points of experience (so a level 5 badge is worth 500 experience.) If your Steam Level increases, the limit on the size of your friends list will be increased by five, and potentially you'll unlock the ability to customize your profile with showcases.

•	Most importantly crafting game badges earns you marketable game related items like:
[list]
	[*][b]CSN:Z emoticons [/b]- Steam emoticons can be used anywhere on Steam where you can type, like chat, discussion boards, and profiles (Note: emoticons do not function for CSN:Z's in-game channel and room chat), 
	[*][b]CSN:Z profile backgrounds[/b] that can be used to customize your profile with a background image. (5 in CSN:Z – 2 common, 2 uncommon, 1 rare). 
Level up your badge by collecting the set again and earn more items!
[/list]

[b]What is and how can I get a booster pack?[/b]
•	Once you have received all of your random card drops, you become eligible for a booster pack, which is a set of 3 trading cards that may include both basic and foil cards. Booster packs are granted randomly to eligible users as more badges are crafted by members of the community. Make sure you log in to Steam each week to maintain eligibility. 

[h1]Note: We also added Steam’s [b]CSN:Z avatars[/b] that can be used by anyone for free for their Steam Profile. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/Avatar/List]Check out the available avatars here[/url][/h1]

CSN:Z Team

CSN:Z Team

Sincerely 
CSN:Z Team

Sincerely, 
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [Maintenance][Finished] 12.10.2014, CEST - A patch update for the connection error reported including compensations.
notes.content:
Dear Survivors, 

As we already had mentioned that the CSN:Z Team is currently working on creating a patch and building a new client to fix the connection error to servers.

We will implement the fix today (12.10.2014) during a technical maintenance beginning at 03:00AM CEST. During the maintenance, which lasts from 03:00AM - 05:00AM CEST, all game servers will be unavailable.

In addition, we prepared a compensation package for making a huge trouble today. 

[A patch]

- A fixed server patch for users to connect log in server 

[Compensation]

Players who login from today after the patch until 11:59PM, 19th of Oct will receive a package including Grade-A Blueprints X3, 24-30 Day Durables X3 and 19,200 Points per each account. 

It will be issued once per each account.

Thanks to all of your supports and patience, we can continue to work on improving the game and resolving all issues. 

Regards, 
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [UPDATED] The issue report from 13:26PM to 22:31PM, Oct 11th, CEST.
notes.content:
Dear Survivors

[Updated]

22:13PM, Oct 11th - The issue has been resolved temporarily. 

Currently the issue has been temporarily resolved. Over last few hours, we have excavated the issue with connecting server and sudden server crashes in various regions. 
 
We are preparing a patch to fix the issue and are scheduled to have a maintenance with downtime. 

Once we conduct a patch with a maintenance for designated period from an hour to 3 hours, the issue should be resolved affirmatively.
  
Many of users are suffering from our connectivity issue and we must apology once again. All of our staffs in various countries are working toghether regardless of time differences.

We will post a maintenance hour once again. 

We really appreciate your taking care of the issue, putting up with it and lots of cheering ups and hating ups. Both are to be our big energy and reason why we must do more efforts for our users. 

Sincerely,
CSN:Z Team

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Dear Survivors. 

First of all, we must express our sincere apology not to cope with the issue in time and we are still investigating the issue. However, it takes a few more hours from now on.

For several hours, we've been receiving reports of connection issues with our game service. We have conducted a system-wide check and found some technical problems with log in servers. Because of  this, it has affected connections of all new CSN:Z players and current users as well.  

We are currently working on addressing this issue and get our game service back to normal. We will give an update  as soon as we resolve it.

We cannot appreciate your continued support and we know some of users will permanently hate us. However, we try to our best to show our endeavors to communicate with all of users. 

And we exactly know the compensations are not always the best solution. But we will do what we can support with all our respects. 

[Isuue report]

1.13:26PM, Oct 11th - Users bounced back to Windows A.K.A the server crash.

2.16:04PM, Oct 11th - We restrarted game server in EU but it had not been effected all users yet. 

3.19:00PM, Oct 11th - We announced additional server restart to restore users' sessions. However, it had not been resolved the issue. 

4.20:00PM, Oct 11th - We had conducted a system-wide investigation with physical machines, and we found out the issue. 

5.21:37PM, Oct 11th - We announced the issue and what we are doing now. 

We will keep you posted once the issue will be resolved. 

Once again, please keep patient and understanding more. 

Sincerely 
CSN:Z Team.

notes.title: [Update] Connectivity issue
notes.content:
[Updated] Oct 13th

Dear Survivors, 

Connection issues were affecting many of you over the weekend. A fix has been implemented on our end to correct this problem. 
We can't thank you enough for the support you have shown CSN:Z during its first full weekend even in light of such problems. 

To get this week started on a better foot you can enjoy a 200% bonus on XP and GP for all the matches completed. It's already live and will run until tomorrow October 14th, 9am (CEST). 

Additionally every survivor that logs in the game until 9am Wednesday October 15th(CEST) will receive a special support package that includes 3x [A] Blueprints , 3x 24~30 Day Durables, and 19,200 Game Points! 

Once again, a big thanks to everyone for being a part of CSN:Z. 

See you in the game! 

Sincerely 
CSN:Z Team

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
[Updated]

An issue report from 14:00PM to 18:58PM, Oct 12
Dear Survivors. 

Yes, we did something for fixing it. However, we have not fully fixed it yet due to unknown socket errors in login servers. We need all of human resources from everywhere in the World but we stuck in weekend. 

[Updated] 

- 18:20PM, Oct 12th, CEST - The login server issue has not been eradicated yet. 

- 200% buffs and XP set up until the issue will be solved. 

If you guys can give us 1 more day to find out and keep playing with unstable servers yet, we will do fix it definitely. 

Sincerely, 
CSN:Z Team 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
Dear Survivors, 

As we already had mentioned that the CSN:Z Team is currently working on creating a patch and building a new client to fix the connection error to servers. 

We will implement the fix today (12.10.2014) during a technical maintenance beginning at 03:00AM CEST. During the maintenance, which lasts from 03:00AM - 05:00AM CEST, all game servers will be unavailable. 

In addition, we prepared a compensation package for making a huge trouble today. 

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[A patch] 

- A fixed server patch for users to connect log in server 

[Compensation] 

Players who login from today after the patch until 11:59PM, 19th of Oct will receive a package including Grade-A Blueprints X3, 24-30 Day Durables X3 and 19,200 Points per each account. 

It will be issued once per each account. 

Thanks to all of your supports and patience, we can continue to work on improving the game and resolving all issues. 

Dear Survivors. 

Regardless of our efforts, the issue has not been fixed yet. First, new connection we built last night is now unstable. 

Almost one third of users can access the servers due to limited of line allocated. 

As a staff of CSN:Z, It is to be regretted that we didn't expect and forecasted multi telecom related server issues. 

Now that we must go deep into the machines, we are about to have an hour maintenance from now on. 

[Urgent Maintenance] 

16:45PM, Oct 12th to 17:45PM - Machine analysis. 

I am assure that there might be a chance to express our deepest apology not only with a text with lots of excuses but also face to face via on/offline. 

Please keep with us and scolding us for this issue. 

Sincerely 
CSN:Z Team 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

Dear Survivors 

14:00PM, Oct 12th - A connection failure happened yesterday has been detected. 

We acknowledged that the issue was resolved but unstable. 

Thus, we did several measures to step up and build up concrete connections to servers. 

However, it happened again. Nonetherless we know the issue and how to deal with. 

We are handling it now and it will be resolved asap. Please keep patient with it and monitoring with us! 

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

[Updated] 

22:13PM, Oct 11th - The issue has been resolved temporarily. 

Currently the issue has been temporarily resolved. Over last few hours, we have excavated the issue with connecting server and sudden server crashes in various regions. 

We are preparing a patch to fix the issue and are scheduled to have a maintenance with downtime. 

Once we conduct a patch with a maintenance for designated period from an hour to 3 hours, the issue should be resolved affirmatively. 

Many of users are suffering from our connectivity issue and we must apology once again. All of our staffs in various countries are working toghether regardless of time differences. 

We will post a maintenance hour once again. 

We really appreciate your taking care of the issue, putting up with it and lots of cheering ups and hating ups. Both are to be our big energy and reason why we must do more efforts for our users. 

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

Dear Survivors. 

First of all, we must express our sincere apology not to cope with the issue in time and we are still investigating the issue. However, it takes a few more hours from now on. 

For several hours, we've been receiving reports of connection issues with our game service. We have conducted a system-wide check and found some technical problems with log in servers. Because of this, it has affected connections of all new CSN:Z players and current users as well. 

We are currently working on addressing this issue and get our game service back to normal. We will give an update as soon as we resolve it. 

We cannot appreciate your continued support and we know some of users will permanently hate us. However, we try to our best to show our endeavors to communicate with all of users. 

And we exactly know the compensations are not always the best solution. But we will do what we can support with all our respects. 

[Isuue report] 

1.13:26PM, Oct 11th - Users bounced back to Windows A.K.A the server crash. 

2.16:04PM, Oct 11th - We restrarted game server in EU but it had not been effected all users yet. 

3.19:00PM, Oct 11th - We announced additional server restart to restore users' sessions. However, it had not been resolved the issue. 

4.20:00PM, Oct 11th - We had conducted a system-wide investigation with physical machines, and we found out the issue. 

5.21:37PM, Oct 11th - We announced the issue and what we are doing now. 

We will keep you posted once the issue will be resolved. 

Once again, please keep patient and understanding more. 

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
We would like to keep you updated about the connectivity issue that happened today 11.10 at 14 pm CEST. 

We are still investigating the issue 11.10 8 pm CEST. 
Please check announcements, we will keep you informed. 
We are sorry for the inconveniences and would be happy to provide compensation on Monday. 

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Connectivity issue happened on 11.10 from 14 pm (CEST) and it still present now (11.10 7 pm).
Currently we are looking into this problem.
Despite our hard efforts we can't completely resolve it now.
But we would like to assure you that we are doing all the possible to fix it.
As a gratitude for your patience on Monday we will provide compensation to all affected users.

We are sorry for the inconvenience.

We would like to update you about the status of the issue.
8 pm 11.10 we are still looking into the problem. 


Thank you.
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies is now Available!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to Official Launch of CSN:Z![/h1]

We hope you are ready to enjoy the game and events.

For those who had the chance to join in on the Open Beta of CSN:Z, you’ll notice changes have been made with the latest version of CSN:Z available at launch. Take a look over the following list to get a quick outline of what changes you can expect.

To everyone else who’s joining CSN:Z for the first time with our official launch, you are still welcome to look over the following changes, as The CSN:Z Team really can’t stop you from doing so.

[b]Design Changes:[/b]
•Synthesis of Crafting materials no longer requires a fee of Points.
•Disassembly of items no longer requires a fee of Points.
•Leaving a match in progress no longer incurs a penalty of points.
•Lobby UI is now permanently in windowed mode. Video settings for fullscreen and different resolutions are applied when entering gameplay.
•Length of chat messages increased to 60.
•List of Daily Missions updated to include more 

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
•Quick Start button now correctly searches for matching game rooms when player is not already inside a channel.
•Music no longer missing from Challenge maps.
•Non-functional Find option for rooms list has been removed.
•Buy Menu for Terrorist SMGs no longer shows an MG or other incorrect weapons for its 2nd slot.

[b]Other Details:[/b]
•Improved instructions for Crafting menus to help players learn about different grades of quality for Crafting materials.
•Added color coding to game mode names to help players browsing through the list of game rooms.
•Altered appearance of buttons for in game Buy menu to direct players to important functions.
•Changed which pages appear first for Crafting and Mission menus to help direct users to most commonly used pages.
•Secondary Password system disabled for Crafting menus.

notes.title: CSN:Z LIVE Today at 6 PM (CEST)!
notes.content:
Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies is officially and metaphorically opening its doors to the public and on Steam, [b]Today at 6PM (CET)/ 9am (PST)! [/b]

Still no need to purchase it just like in our Open Beta, CSN:Z is Free to Play and in just a few clicks you will be able to get started playing.

But before that, please take a moment to check out these special CSN:Z Launch Events and Sales!

1)	[b]Consecutive Attendance Event[/b] – Free Crafting Materials!
Period: 07.10.2014 – 05.11.2014
Rewards: Light Zombie, Nata Knife, Bomb Expert, MK48, Battle Revival, Perm Durable, Grade-1 Blueprint [S]

2)	[b]Zombie Scenario Season 2 Chronicle Event[/b] – Rewarding Zombie Slaying
One of the biggest modes in CSN:Z is Zombie Scenario, combining PvE action with the characters and story surrounding how the undead have risen! Through 22nd October, completing Season 2 of Zombie Scenario in chronological order will earn you some big rewards for your efforts!

By completing all maps of Season 2, you will be rewarded with the following: 
UTS-15 (15 Days), MK48, AS50 (15 Days), King Cobra (15 Days), Dual Katana (15 Days), Medical Kit (L), Round Retry x20, Battle Revival x20
[NOTE] – Chronicle Event rewards can only be earned once per map for the event’s duration.

3)	[b]Play and Craft[/b] – Free High End Crafting Materials!
You’re here to play, right? There are plenty of modes and maps to choose from for that! But to sweeten the deal, how about getting everything you need to craft just by playing?

It starts when you log in, but you’ll get more rewards, the more play time you clock!

Play 10 min, 20 min, and 60 min to receive rewards.

4)	As we promised we’ve got a [b]special treat for users who participated in the OBT and came back[/b] for the official launch!
a)	Log into the game 07.10 - 05.11 to receive a Nickname Change Coupon
b)	Log into the game on 07.10 to receive Random Grade Blueprints [A] (x3) and 24-30 Day Durables (x3)
* Users who purchased the Big Support Package during the OBT will receive 72 Day - Permanent Durables, Grade-1 Blueprint [S] and 25,600 points, as promised.

5)	[b]Limited Time Offer[/b] – Jennifer and Natasha Permanent Sale
We are celebrating the launch of Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies by letting our diehard fans get in on a rare opportunity. Visit the Item Shop from 7th October to 5th November to find both Jennifer and Natasha available for permanent durations!

6)	[b]Weekend Hot Time[/b] – Increased EXP and GP!
Starting 11th October and ending 2nd November, every Saturday and Sunday will offer bonus 50% EXP and GP for all matches completed! Join in on the frenzy of PvE and PvP Zombie gameplay, hit up some classics of CS, or try out the unique offerings of FUN mode…

Whatever your pleasure, you’ll be rewarded greatly!

notes.title: Join the CSN:Z Open Beta!
notes.content:
With loads of Zombie PvP and PvE action, matched with the competitive Counter-Strike FPS experience, topped off with an incredible amount of content… what else is left?!

[h1]Free stuff, of course![/h1]

Read up on our OBT events below:
1)	[b]Craft Your Weapon![/b]
•	How to participate?: Log in once from 23rd to 25th September (CEST).
•	Reward: 3x 30 Day Durables, 3x Random Grade Blueprint [S]

2)	[b]Item Shower[/b]
•	How to participate?: Log in once per day from 23rd to 25th September (CEST).
•	Reward: Light Zombie, Large Medical Kit, M134 Mini Gun

3)	[b]Special Treat [/b]
•	How to participate?: Log in on 23rd September (CEST), and again on the CSN:Z official launch date (to be announced).
•	Reward: 1x Nickname Change Coupon on the CSN:Z launch date.

We also have the best deal ever for 3 days only!

Bulk up your Zombie game with the Merciless Destroyer (10 Days) + Heavy Zombie (10 Days) + Fire & Curse (10 Days) Set! [i]If you buy this discounted set during the OBT, you will be eligible to receive it again after the launch FOR FREE! [/i]

[b]Moreover, we'll throw in an additional package with the Grade-1 Blueprint [S] + Permanent Durables, and 25,600 points at launch as part of this special offer![/b]

CSN:Z’s Beta is a small taste of the vast amounts of content, but we won’t stop you from trying to experience it all at once. In fact, we will support you with these free rewards! 

All these rewards will be a lot to take in, but we’re confident you can pull it off! Keep stopping by CSN:Z throughout the Open Beta, running between Sept 23rd 6PM CET and Sept 25th 6PM CET. 

Following the Open Beta, The CSN:Z Team will have to wipe information from accounts that participated. However, nicknames registered –will- persist from Open Beta to Launch. Make sure to log in on both the Launch Day and the Last Day of Open Beta to get that free Nickname Change Coupon for a free revision on what name you snagged!

As this is a Beta there may be issues which arise. This includes both game server instability, which may result in unscheduled reboots of our servers, and game bugs. We will be eager to hear both feedback about the Open Beta and reports of bugs which players have come across. Use the following sticky threads in the forums to let us know about both!

[b]Feedback Thread: [/b]
http://steamcommunity.com/app/273110/discussions/0/613936673597809716/

[b]Bug Report Thread:[/b]
http://steamcommunity.com/app/273110/discussions/0/613936673597994019/

Have fun!

notes.title: The Classic & Melee Weapons – What Set the Standard
notes.content:
The [b]Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies[/b] team is working hard to deliver a remarkable addition to the CS library on Steam. It’s not just-zombies when there’s so many modes, maps, and new additions to such an amazing competitive FPS franchise.

But that is not enough for many, and we agree. CSN:Z would not be a member of the Counter-Strike family without its downright iconic selection of weaponry! We’ve got you covered.

[b]All weapons and equipment from the original Counter-Strike are in CSN:Z.[/b] AWP? FAMAS? Dual Berettas? Even if you’re somehow aching to storm the bomb with a TMP it is all here More than that, it is easy to setup a match to play with only those classic weapons both in the original CS maps and maps exclusive to CSN:Z.

Far more than just a means of self-defense, [b]melee weapons[/b] have been around ever since human civilization first found its roots and remains an effective form of combat to this day. It is safe to assume the idea of a sharp blade in your hand may outlast human civilization itself should the Zombies have their way!

Melee weapons are diverse, can fit specific needs, and can be downright artistic in design. In Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies there is no shortage of options for cutting enemies down who dare to fall within arm’s reach. It’s important to offer so many options! With both Counter-Terrorists and Terrorists bringing one to battle regardless of the mode it is a vital piece of your loadout.

[i]Plus you run faster while holding a knife. Everyone knows that.[/i]

Some might be familiar faces to those joining CSN:Z, such as the Balisong, a trusty Hunting Dagger,  or even a Katana or two. Choices for melee combat can be practical as well! A damn big Hammer can work to knock back Zombies more effectively than other weapons, for example.

However, it only takes a little exploration to see how fast the options open up to you for slicing and bashing your enemies, alive or formally-alive. The SKULL-9 is a huge axe to let you split some skulls or nail crowds with large swings. Nata knives sport a long finely sharpened blade, and the lucky few can wield one in each hand… Or just give up subtlety entirely with the BALROG-IX to throw some truly explosive punches. Literally.

[h1]Get up close and personal this Sept 23rd in the CSN:Z Beta![/h1]

notes.title: The Classic & Melee Weapons – What Set the Standard
notes.content:
The [b]Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies[/b] team is working hard to deliver a remarkable addition to the CS library on Steam. It’s not just-zombies when there’s so many modes, maps, and new additions to such an amazing competitive FPS franchise.

But that is not enough for many, and we agree. CSN:Z would not be a member of the Counter-Strike family without its downright iconic selection of weaponry! We’ve got you covered.

[b]All weapons and equipment from the original Counter-Strike are in CSN:Z.[/b] AWP? FAMAS? Dual Berettas? Even if you’re somehow aching to storm the bomb with a TMP it is all here More than that, it is easy to setup a match to play with only those classic weapons both in the original CS maps and maps exclusive to CSN:Z.

Far more than just a means of self-defense, [b]melee weapons[/b] have been around ever since human civilization first found its roots and remains an effective form of combat to this day. It is safe to assume the idea of a sharp blade in your hand may outlast human civilization itself should the Zombies have their way!

Melee weapons are diverse, can fit specific needs, and can be downright artistic in design. In Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies there is no shortage of options for cutting enemies down who dare to fall within arm’s reach. It’s important to offer so many options! With both Counter-Terrorists and Terrorists bringing one to battle regardless of the mode it is a vital piece of your loadout.

[i]Plus you run faster while holding a knife. Everyone knows that.[/i]

Some might be familiar faces to those joining CSN:Z, such as the Balisong, a trusty Hunting Dagger,  or even a Katana or two. Choices for melee combat can be practical as well! A damn big Hammer can work to knock back Zombies more effectively than other weapons, for example.

However, it only takes a little exploration to see how fast the options open up to you for slicing and bashing your enemies, alive or formally-alive. The SKULL-9 is a huge axe to let you split some skulls or nail crowds with large swings. Nata knives sport a long finely sharpened blade, and the lucky few can wield one in each hand… Or just give up subtlety entirely with the BALROG-IX to throw some truly explosive punches. Literally.

[h1]Get up close and personal this Sept 23rd in the CSN:Z Beta![/h1]
