notes.title: Maps - From Aztec to Vostok
notes.content:
We've heard you, the burning question in the minds of Counter-Strike fans who learnt the news of Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies coming to Steam. “Is such-and-such map from the original CS going to be in it?” No one could blame fans for wanting their favorites to be represented in a game with ‘Counter-Strike’ in the title, what with some preferring their dosage of [b]DE_Dust[/b] to be 24/7.

Did you know there’s over [b]70 maps[/b] in CSN:Z?! Environments that span the globe, vivid and varied battlegrounds that can let you switch up the routine every time you sit down to play. We even offer an option to setup quick map-rotations so you can sample from such a large offering with even greater ease.
How about maps to fit specific, challenging modes of play? AWP and Melee only maps that were created with just those entertaining styles of combat in mind. Many of the maps are designed for the unique modes in the game, so fighting against Zombies isn't shoehorned into a map that wouldn't be ideal for it.

What about maps which deviate from the norm? For a game loaded with Zombies, it suddenly doesn't seem so strange to find yourself in a war zone where you’re the size of rats or are facing off in a boxing ring.
However, many may have just been skimming this announcement for the big answer to the big question: Yes. 

[h1]
All of the original maps from Counter-Strike are available and will be Free to Play. Come check it out on the 23rd with CSN:Z’s Open Beta! 
[/h1]

notes.title: Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies' Open Beta
notes.content:
[h1]New details of modes, maps, and guns emerge for this highly anticipated zombie shooter, available for Beta testing from 23rd September[/h1]

We are pleased to announce the launching plan for the highly anticipated free-to-play Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies, as the Steam page for the game goes live. [h1][b]The game will have its Open Beta on 23rd September[/b][/h1]
It comes with a variety of modes, maps, guns, and character options in which to destroy the undead hordes.

A huge number of modes will be available, featuring both PvP and PvE gameplay. Possess and use, to a dangerous effect, the various unique abilities in Zombie Hero; lead a team of survivors to build and defend a base against continuous waves of zombies in Shelter Mode; or advance through intense Zombie Scenarios that will throw players into boss fights, among other activities. Even outside of zombies, there are more than 20 modes to explore, such as Beast Mode, Bazooka Mode, and Football Mode. Veteran fans of the Counter-Strike series will also surely be glad to see a number of offerings from the original iteration, such as Bomb Defusal and Hostage Rescue.

All-time favourite classic maps will be included in the game, such as the unforgettable de_dust, along with a selection of new maps, such as Big Tree, Camouflage, Rex and Greesia, and 60 others. The arsenal of weapons available will also be significantly larger and more diverse in Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies, with essentials ranging from sniper and assault rifles to more compact PDWs and SMGs. For players willing to be a little more adventurous, weapons such as Dragon Claws, energy pistols, and sci-fi styled machine rifles are available in zombie modes.

A wide variety of characters are available, both male and female, terrorist and counter-terrorist. Players can select characters merely based on style, or they may choose a character with which to explore the story elements surrounding the zombie outbreaks and terrorist attacks unique to Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies. 

[i]“Both fans of Counter-Strike and players who are new to the game will have a full-blown shooter experience in a well-restored legendary FPS”[/i] said Kenny Chang, Nexon Europe CEO. [i]“New weapons, new modes, and new elements inspiring new styles of play, mixed with everything that made the game such a classic in the first place are some things that we’re really looking forward to bringing to Steam.”[/i]

[h1]
Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies will be playable for all those with a Steam login. [/h1]

Just head to the [b] [url=store.steampowered.com/app/273110] Steam page [/url][/b] to get started and follow the official [b] [url=www.facebook.com/en.CSNZ] Facebook page [/url][/b] and [b][url=twitter.com/CSN_Z] Twitter feed. [/url][/b]
